title: Spinners
description: Spinners. You get dropped a spinner every 2 hours 5 times per day. Each spinner is also made by the community in Discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something fantastic. Compete with friends, win the most unique item and become a spin master!

title: Game of Squares
description: Squares is a pattern matching 2D game inspired by the Rubik's cube,. Customise the game's rules to your liking. Challenge yourself by getting faster.

title: Net.Crawl
description: Net.Crawl is a puzzle rogue-like about White Rabbit lost in the unfriendly cyberspace. Dive deep into the bizarre digital world and outsmart dozens of unique Cores(mini-bosses). Short runs, deep strategies, crazy combos and a ton of replayability.

title: The Adventure of Popo
description: Join the adorable polar bear Popo on his adventure! Use shakes strategically to evade enemies and collect hints to overcome obstacles. Will Popo safely reach the polar bear village?

title: Ball In The Box
description: Move platforms to get the ball into the box in a challenging minimalist physics puzzle

title: Anomalous Adventure
description: Slay monsters and explore procedural worlds in this old school hack and slash Mini-RPG set in a fantasy world. Battles are a combo of turn based and real time elements. Block enemy attacks and enhance your own using active abilities.

title: Market Master Simulator
description: Take charge of a bustling supermarket in Market Master Simulator. Manage staff, inventory, and product creation while mastering advanced energy systems. Navigate challenges in this dynamic simulation game now in Early Access.

title: Inertial Craft
description: "Inertial Craft" is a simple-to-operate racing game in a cyber world. You can experience a thrilling race with the strong and inertial behavior unique to a craft floating off the ground. Enjoy unique behavior and UI for each craft.

title: GymBro
description: GymBro – is a clicker game that immerses you in the world of sports and lets you click a kettlebell! Quickly join our community, play the mini-game where the main object is a kettlebell, change its appearance through the inventory, and earn rewards... Of course, in the form of kettlebell skins!

title: Lefty
description: A cozy 3D puzzle game where Lefty, a left-handed character, navigates whimsical mazes by only moving to the right. Experience unique mechanics, culturally inspired gameplay, and increasing puzzle complexity, perfect for fans of casual, cozy, and puzzle games.

title: Deliberate
description: In this game, you're transported into a mystical forest brimming with the whimsical charm of cartoonish pixel art.

title: Lore of the Frog
description: You are a frog archaeologist on a journey to the elusive Frog island. Cozy hiking adventure in a magical forest with casual puzzles, ancient frog statues... And put hats on frogs!

title: Exit Station 7
description: You entered a train station and appear to be stuck in a loop. Multiple levels to test your observation skill. See if you have what it takes to escape the loop!

title: Minced
description:
Explore the Minced Meat Processing Co. facility, a place drenched in darkness, secrecy, and dread. Your mission: uncover the chilling secrets hidden within. But beware, meaty entities are prowling the shadows, and you must avoid them at all costs.

Solve puzzles, gather clues, and piece together the factory's nightmarish history to find out what really went wrong...

title: Ooga Booga: Troubles in Time
description: Get ready for an exciting adventure in "Ooga Booga: Troubles in Time"! Choose your character and travel through different universes to defeat the forces of evil, the enemy is waiting to beat you up! Try the best controls for platform games. Jump over obstacles to pass the level. Fight against a multitude of enemies in different scenarios. Escape from the rolling stone down the hill. Ride the pig and dodge the thugs. Talk to the characters to defeat the final boss. BEWARE, the enemy wants to trick you, don't fall into his traps. Prove that you are the chosen one!

title: Botan's Bird Beats
description: Botan's Bird Beats is a fanmade game based on Shishiro Botan. The game has you play as Shishiro Botan and you shoot birds in beat to the songs playing.

title: Poketale
description: It's been 70 years since Frisk freed the monsters from Underground. However, the monsters are no longer the same: after an event in which a light illuminated all of Ebottia, all the weak monsters were transformed into Pokémon, causing society to have to adapt to the new creatures without intelligence and with powers beyond their control. all understanding. Can you discover the secret of transforming monsters into Pokémon and become the new Champion of Ebottia?

title: Sclash: Sakura
description: Spring is here, and with it sakura petals as sharp as steel. Unlocks a sakura-themed weapon and mask to use in the game.

title: Ruins of Endoth
description: Third-Person ARPG set in a dark fantasy world. Fight enemies, collect random loot, level-up and explore the World of Endoth. Forge your destiny amongst it's heroes!

title: Some Heroines Climb Up a Tower to Ask God Why the Game Has a Name That's So Long
description: In this erotic turn-based strategy rogue-like, make it to the final boss by pushing and pulling your way through a relentlessly difficult horde of God’s demonic angels. Get new sets of class skills every single run and master them to combo your enemies back into the afterlife.

title: Tidal Nexus Online
description: Tidal Nexus Online is a submarine themed old school open world MMO. Fight with monsters, trade and collect valuables in the depths to upgrade your sub. Join clans, participate in world events, make friends and enemies along the way.

title: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost - Touhou Mystia's Izakaya Collab "Beneath the Purple Cherry Blossoms Once Again"
description: A collaboration between 『Touhou Danmaku Kagura Phantasia Lost』 & 『Touhou Mystia's Izakaya』 is here! The in-game music 『Beneath the Purple Cherry Blossoms Once Again』 from the popular restaurant simulator 『Touhou Mystia's Izakaya』 will be playable in this new added content. Don't you miss it!

title: One Minute To Close
description: One Minute to Close is a stealth adventure game set in a supermarket after hours. Utilize the environmental interactions and physics based tactics to outsmart the shop assistants who use an advanced AI that learns from your actions.

title: Undead Inc.: Worky DLC
description: Unlock a Director: Weaponized Worky. A customized version of Worky's Office Rentals' Robot Receptionist by the same name, Weaponized Worky has come to work really hard and punch stuff sometimes.

title: Box Bakery
description: This is a simulation management game for baking bread. You need to earn more coins by continuously selling bread to animals customer, thus unlocking more types of ingredients and other rarer animals.Unlock more of their stories and collect items as well as stickers to learn the stories behind them.

title: Chrono Ark: Summer Twilight
description:
Summer-themed DLC for Chrono Ark, featuring a new, optional boss with her own substory, new equipment and relics, as well as swimsuit skins for Lucy and 5 investigators, with accompanying VFX.

The investigators obtaining a new skin are Azar, Charon, Huz, Pressel and Trisha, with Sizz slated to receive one in a future content update.

title: Flame Land
description: A 2D platformer inspired primarily by Kirby's Adventure and secondarily by classic Sonic. A collectathon with new characters and exits hidden around every corner, and an arcade game in which you compete for high scores. Cute and colorful, snacky and full.

title: My Dog!
description: MY DOG! is a puzzle game where you have to collect puzzles in the form of pictures and memes with the antics and misadventures of a cute dog (My Dog!)

title: Ghost Light
description: The ghost Light is a light-spooky, mystery-oriented RPG. You will play as a girl named Mary, exploring dungeons to find escape codes and escape paths in the face of ghosts and traps.

title: DCS World: Kola Map by Orbx
description: Orbx proudly presents the DCS: Kola map, which covers northern Norway, Sweden, Finland, and the Russian Murmansk Oblast and parts of the Karelia region.

title: Puppet Master: The Game - Dark Horse Skins
description:
Unleash the shadows with skins inspired by lesser known dark horse characters from the franchise!
Totem Ravager
New Skin: Homunculus
New Weapon Skin: Ritual Daggers - Scimitars
New Emote: Bow (also works for Totem Warrior, and Head Hunter)

Leech-Woman
New Skin: Puppet Master 3 Dress
New Emote: Blow Kiss

Zombietoid
New Skin: Toy Soldier
New Weapon Skin: Battle Rifle - Toy Musket
New Weapon Skin:Machete - Toy Sword
New Voice: The Master from Demonic Toys (1992)

Watcher
New Skin: Demon

title: Oopz-Oofs
description: A quirky, playful dog sim where you body-swap with a dog. Waking up from a sweet dream, John finds himself in his dog's body! Sniff, bark, beg, and use paw to interact with the townfolks. Can John find a way to return to his human form, or will this unexpected adventure change them forever?

title: For Hell's Sake
description: For Hell's Sake is a fast-paced 2D platform game where you play as a demon on a mission to break an old contract. Constantly hunted by a superior entity, you will have to move forward. Avoid the traps scattered around the world. Don't get caught. Don't die.

title: Crimson Snow Deluxe
description: CRIMSON SNOW DELUXE: A psychological horror RPG where you destroy the world you've created...

title: Galactic Starfire: Squadron
description: Galactic Starfire: Squadron is a Future Sci-Fi Space Shooter game set in different environments around the universe. Complete the challenges and stay alive as you progress through the different types of levels.

title: Pet Crossing
description: A cruiser came to a blue planet and found a planet with many ice-blocked caves, which contained frozen animals that were sent in before the catastrophe. Only paired animals could survive after thawing. The expedition team needs your wisdom to help match these animals and restore life to the planet.

title: Tea for Sana
description: Tea for Sana is an explorable visual novel set in the mountains of a Slavic-inspired fantasy world. Discover recipes, forage for ingredients, and cook traditional dishes to restore the balance between the mountain spirits and the villagers below.

title: Hélène est dans mon Ventre.
description: You follow a troubled girl whose only friend is her talking tapeworm inside her belly. This one will help and advise her in order for her to get closer to the person she loves.

title: Find X
description: "FindX is an all-age suitable first-person casual shooting game, where players need to find differences in two time-frozen and similar worlds, and use a variety of quirky weapons to address these discrepancies."

title: Tower Networking Inc.
description: An internet service provider simulation game. Design and build network connectivity and services to clients in an ever-expanding randomly generated tower. Configure and maintain equipment to ensure you meet the requirements of tower dwellers. Manage your spending for expansion and daily operations.

title: Timestamps: Lost Love
description: An exciting adult Visual Novel with a unique intriguing story featuring Sci-Fi, Time Travel, Romance, Sex, Humour, Character Development and some fun references.

title: Clash for Crust
description: Clash for Crust is a 2-4 Player local multiplayer party brawler. Customize and take control of a Crazy Gull and fight using your Seagull Attacks and Power-Ups to grab the Golden Crust and to battle for the honor of becoming Top Gull.

title: Wish You Happiness
description: Move with 'WASD', switch characters with the number keys

title: Tower! Simulator 3: RJTT Airport
description: As one of the busiest airports in Asia, it facilitates over 85 million passengers annually. Haneda features a sleek, modern architecture with three passenger terminals, which are renowned for their efficiency and high standard of service.

title: Paragon Pioneers 2: Happy Southburghs
description: Makes all Southburghs in the game smile and supports indie development!

title: Dig a Road
description: This is a puzzle, pixel style game about how to dig a road.

title: Paragon Pioneers 2: Turn the Orc Table
description: Swaps all human graphics with orc graphics and vice versa. Support the development of indie games and kick some human butts!

title: Epic Roller Coasters: Dynasty Dash
description: Ride a roller coaster built in the middle of the Great Wall of China, while the Imperial Army faces evil hordes of Yaoguai who try to destroy humanity. This DLC includes: - Roller coaster map: Dynasty Dash - One roller coaster cart

title: The Time Game
description: Bend the rules of time to your while to outsmart and out-think your opponents. Fun 4-player co-op strategy card-game which will leave you on the edge of your seat!

title: Super Drift Blade
description: Explore the world of Super Drift Blade, a Roguelike game where you can slash with just a swipe of your mouse.

title: Jurnal Malam: Bestfriend
description: In this game, players will play the role of Afdal, a person whose fate is the opposite of Rahmad's, so one night Rahmad asks Afdal to help look after the house, but unfortunately, everything is not fine, because of the terror that Afdal is experiencing.

title: Survivors of Journey to the West: Bald Guy vs Wukong
description: "Survivors of Journey to the West: Bald Guy "vs" Wukong" is a spin off story about the product "Survivors of Journey to the West". The story draws inspiration from the Western Journey to the Wilderness and traditional cultivation system, playing the role of the Flower Monk - Lu Zhishen, who explores the world of Western Journey, freely combining various gameplay and genres through over 200 massive skills and resonance. At the same time, you can also meet Taoist priests, farm and build, recruit young brothers, and fight against enemies together

title: Shop Crush
description: Run a mysterious thrift shop in a story-rich Visual Novel. Meet eccentric customers, uncover hidden illusions, and unveil the sinister secret of your shop.

title: Muscle Girl Lisa: Training Diary
description: "Muscle Girl Lisa: Training Diary" is a visual novel game that follows the story of Lisa, a cute girl from the United Kingdom who aspires to be a bodybuilder. Make the right choices to help Lisa grow her muscles and enjoy unique dates with her.

title: Nangol
description: Delve into an ancient tomb to loot it's treasures and unearth the secret fate of it's former inhabitants.

title: Type Galaxy
description: Embark on the ultimate cosmic quest where your typing prowess holds the key to victory! Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled voyage through the stars in Type Galaxy, the definitive typing adventure that will leave your fingers itching for more!

title: The Other Side: Tower of Souls Remaster
description: The return of a 2014 classic now fully remastered for modern platforms! Can you resolve a family squabble before the gates to the realm of the dead swing open in this collector's edition of The Other Side: Tower of Souls?

title: Megan's Adventure
description: Megan's Adventure is a 2D platform game, you just have to move, dodge, shoot and enjoy (optional)

title: War of the Western Deep
description: Explore a lush, hand-animated world as you solve puzzles, meet intriguing characters, and duel nefarious foes in tense sword battles. Join Mirren, a royal courier sent to the dangerous Border Coast on the eve of war, and immerse yourself in this innovative mix of adventuring and cinematic combat.

title: OG Memory: Spring 2K24
description: OG Memory: Spring 2K24 is an casual memory game with stunning images. You have to find all of the correct pairs to complete the game. your best round will be count and always be displayed in game, to compare your rounds. try to reduce your turns every game and set up your new record.

title: Super Hangman
description: Super Hangman: the ultimate kids' word game! With colorful graphics and exciting challenges, it's a fun way to learn new words. Guess right, avoid the hangman, and expand your vocabulary across various topics. Let the word adventure begin!

title: MeowFall
description: MeowFall is a charming 2D platformer in pixel art style. Take control of an adorable cat, overcome obstacles and uncover the secrets. Are you ready for an adventure to find the best hat ever?

title: Shrimpwrecked
description: Riding an extra-terrestrial weapon disguised as a guitar, battle to the bottom of the ocean deep to turn the tides of impending worldly destruction; krill or be killed!

title: Siberian Dawn: Heroes of the Union
description: Heroes of the Union adds 8 new Rank 7 Units to the Union Bloc, and also adds the Guard status to the tactics cards. The Heroes can be added in a couple of ways to the game from within the ARK, and all these new cards can be used in all modes except the Training Missions

title: Otherworld Legends: Zilan
description: This content requires the base game Otherworld Legends 战魂铭人 on Steam in order to play.

title: Otherworld Legends: Fluffette
description: This content requires the base game Otherworld Legends 战魂铭人 on Steam in order to play.

title: Duck Adventures
description: Duck Adventures features 30 levels of exciting gameplay. A game that will not leave you indifferent to the fate of the duck. Who returns home after a long fishing trip.

title: Vector Space
description: It is a game about switching squares to make board full

description: Help Veronica solve another dark mystery and reconcile with her sister.

description: Explore 'My Days With Mia,' a visual novel of romance and choice in a vibrant college setting. Connect deeply with Mia through an interactive story, full voice acting, and rich artwork. Experience the thrill and intimacy of college love.

title: Call of the Grave
description: You find yourself in an ancient graveyard, where mysterious statues and forgotten tombs hide ancient secrets. Under the moonlight, you solve puzzles, revealing a portal to dark caves. Inside, dark corridors await you, littered with bodies but no living souls.

title: Soul of the Forest
description: Embark on a quest to unite the forest against the tyrannical king in an hour long, turn based RPG epic! Soul of the Forest was created by a team of 55 students over the course of 2 semesters as a case study of modern turn-based RPGs.

title: WisdomGems
description: WisdomGems is a relaxing and challenging puzzle game where you have to solve temples by moving three gems to their correct square. WisdomGems takes inspiration from traditional games like the Rubik's Cube or the sliding puzzle, providing a minimalistic and intellectual experience.

title: The Pirate's Quest
description: The Pirate's Quest - You go in search of exciting adventures and ancient treasure hidden on a mysterious island. You will explore dangerous seas, coves and ancient ruins in search of a treasure map, face competitors and fight sea monsters.

title: Survive Game
description: This is a relaxing, single player PC survival game where you can chop down trees, hunt, or build cabins to see how long you can Survive with wild animals and ai enemies throughout the large and beautiful map.

title: Strange Labyrinth
description: Amy is pulled into a dimension of labyrinths by the villain Ayashii Meiro, who mysteriously appears on her TV. Now, Amy must solve the puzzles of the labyrinths and defeat Ayashii Meiro to return to her world, collecting fragments of her soul along the way.

title: Bellumentum
description: Ever play a MOBA and wish you could be every one of your teammates? Well, it was DEFINITELY their fault, but time to see if you could do any better.

title: Sorcerer Smackdown
description: In Sorcerer Smackdown, joining the fight is simple: grab a friend, choose a character, and let the match begin! Unleash both physical and magical attacks using the keyboard for commands, mixing and matching moves to craft devasting combos to prevail against your opponent!

title: Sprint Star: A Running Manager
description: We present a running management simulation. Train your hero in different running disciplines, keep an eye on his health and energy level and race against the best in city or hill runs!

title: Iterations
description: Help solve a crime.

title: Take Your Altushka
description: A meme visual novel.

title: Disney Speedstorm: Season 8 - Journey of Emotions
description: The “Journey of Emotions” season, inspired by Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out, brings a memorable adventure and content to the game, including the brand-new Riley's Mind racing environment! Racers Joy, Fear, Anger, Disgust, and Sadness are revving up their engines to take you on an emotion-filled racing challenge.

title: Film Morbid
description:
You wake up in a small and messy room. There's a storm raging outside, with the lightning illuminating a projector in the middle of the room. You investigate the projector, which surprisingly is still equipped with a film reel. You get it going, but you're not sure if that was the best decision...

Do you have what it takes to escape the room and it's looping projector?

Film Morbid is a game made by Point Vertex, during the 8th Black & White game jam. The development of the main game took 10 days.

title: Limbus
description: You continue to wander through an endless looping corridor beside the abyss. Is there a way out... Is there salvation...? You walk on without understanding anything. All you can do is choose the right path. Will there ever be an end to this nightmarish journey.

title: The Memory of Mallet
description: September 2020, Shenyang, where the story begins. Originally the most beautiful youth, it has been cast a faint shadow by the epidemic. Did we make another choice at the time, and our outcome would be different?

title: Makutsu no Liliane
description: Make money by creating zombies! Liliane, a girl who wants to be a necromancer, creates lots of zombies to earn money to be recognized by her demon lord daddy. Sometimes she will mess around with zombies and wolf boys to make boyfriends.

title: System Upkeep
description: Operate machinery, brew coffee, shovel coal & flick switches in this UNFAIR & CHALLENGING multi-tasking JOYRIDE.

title: Star Child
description: A VR action adventure from Playful.

title: Sprout of Control
description: Sprout of Control is a puzzle-game that requires wits, patience and timing. You can move in any direction as long as it is not occupied, but while moving, you can't change direction until you hit another solid object. Crawl your way through the levels and use evil fireflies to your advantage!

title: Space Warrior
description: Experience the world of an alternative future of the Earth and get caught up in a plot of a full-on space saga. It would seem that there is nothing to discover in the Solar System. But in the most remote corners of the Universe mankind has come up against cruel resistance. You are the only one who can save the galaxy from an alien race of invaders! Choose Railgun, Blaster or Lasers and go up against hordes of alien foes. Float like a butterfly and pity like a bee in true 3D combat. Get the cash and pump up your ships and complete all of the campaign levels. FEATURES: - popular space setting - futuristic enemies and bosses - breathtaking 3D world - tons of gorgeous shots, explosions and effects - old-school bulletstorm arcade - very easy to play, have fun You like space, shooting and old arcades - this game is for you!

title: Scary Horror
description: "Scary Horror" is an innovative game in the analog horror genre. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of an abandoned and cordoned off neighborhood, the only way out of which is to collect all the bottles along the way. Explore the city district and enjoy breakthrough graphics.

title: Questscape: Survival
description: On a secluded medieval, awake in a small village surrounded by wildlife nature and bandits and many challanges. Evolve your land in search of new adventures.

title: Pintaris
description: Pintaris is a multiplayer competitive puzzle game that you can draw different blocks with various paint tool to clear lines and get scores.

title: Parina's Demon Lair Adventure
description: Step into the fantastical world of Parina and embark on an exhilarating journey through realms of magic and mystery! Sharpen your senses as you delve into this captivating hidden object adventure, where every scene is brimming with treasures waiting to be discovered.

title: Snowbound: Dead of Winter
description: Snowbound is a roguelite farming game with tower defense elements. Build your farm, survive the night with a range of defenses, and complete missions to progress deeper into the forest.

title: Extra Cream
description: Run your own LEWD coffee shop

title: Simple Fight 2
description: Match Man roguelike

title: Happy Uppen Sometimes Downsad
description: A soul-crushing, non-linear, foddylike Miseryvania.

title: Planetoid Evasion
description: Planetoid Evasion is a SCI-FI action shooter. You are controlling a swat member who was kidnapped by aliens and brought to their planet. Your goal is to escape the planet by any means necessary.

title: Ilíada Espacial 2
description: Destroy hordes of enemies and save Sivinina in this RPG-Space Shooter hybrid!

title: Swing Game
description: A silly game about swinging!

description: It Happened At Night is a short horror game where the player must complete basic objectives to advance the story and immerse themselves through the eyes of the protagonist.

description: This is Chess on a conveyor belt -- an ingenious roguelike, melding tactical strategy and explosive action! Deal with a mind-bending scrolling board that pulls towards you relentless waves of foes and perils. Prepare for their violent collision with your pieces. Prepare for Total Zugzwang.

title: Death Sword Spirit
description: In this mesmerizing gray brown game,

description: As a member of mankind's most top-elite military corps, your mission is to save the universe, no less.Cyborg Force is a classic arcade run'n'gun that will give you a healthy dose of shooting, platforming and score hunting.Good luck, soldier!

title: Pozionista
description: Travel through a world surrounded by nature, collect plants and use them to create potions, invent new recipes, sell potions in stores and explore the world.

title: Planet Game
description: Tired of making watermelons in 2D? Then the next step is to make a sun in 3D!

title: Tow Truck
description: Tow Truck is a 3D car game. You got a job as a tow truck driver and it's your first day! You've received your first order and you can't screw it up! Get behind the wheel of your vehicle and go to your first job!

title: The End of History
description:
"The End of History" is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

description: Embark on an epic journey with Mono to retrieve the Lost Lanterns and restore light to the realms of Lunaris, Arcadia, and Luminis. Face unique challenges and formidable enemies in this thrilling platformer!

description: Explore, fight, solve puzzles and bend gravity to escape the dream-like world of the Halls! Metro Gravity is a mind-boggling musical adventure with rhythmic combat and compelling lore.

description: Survive the absurdity in Fun Gus.

description: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.

title: Space Zone
description: The world's first science-based photorealistic interactive 3D planetarium that models the entire Universe, using procedural generation for uncharted areas.

title: Pirate Combat Trainer
description: You command a small sailing vessel. Take on endless waves of enemy pirate ships as you battle to keep your ship alive. Maintain a tactical advantage as you attempt to survive on the high seas. Destroy as many ships as you can to achieve a highscore to prove your naval aptitude.

description: You are a kunoichi who sneaked into Oedojou. If you think it's not Japan, turn back. If you think it's Japan, don't turn back. Escape from patrolling soldiers.

description: Find the code, Solve the puzzle, open the door.

description: Survivor in the Forest is a 3D puzzle adventure game with clicker elements. You find yourself alone with nature and must overcome all obstacles to get out of the forest.

description: This game is a arcade block placing game mixed with action-packed Tower Defense gameplay mechanics. Build forts out of tetrominoes high up in the sky and defend it against the incoming waves of airships, by shooting at them with your minigun and building defenses!

title: CyberHoney
description: Players can choose up to 4 heroes to fight. In hundreds of random levels, there are nearly 100 types of enemies and dozens of powerful Bosses waiting for your challenge. Each character has unique weapons and skills. Using different weapons can change character's attack range,

title: Suika Jelly Game
description: Merge cozy and bouncy fruit jellies to create watermelon. The goal of the game is to merge watermelons and watermelons. How many watermelons can you merge?

title: Mind the Abyss
description: Mind the Abyss is a fast-paced movement shooter that combines fourth-dimensional abilities and ever-evolving weaponry within an alien planet.

description: Losing your father a few years after your mother's death caused great trauma to you. You wanted to go to the house of the step-aunt, who lives in SunCity. That's where your intrigue, sex, fun and career adventure starts for you.

description: A lonely ancient vampire who was banished into the tangled and dangerous dark forests by the forces of ancient magicians. Left without your normal strength, you must explore cursed forests, encounter and defeat various enemies and creatures.

title: Underground Prisoner
description: Underground Prisoner is a necromancer's journey through a world of dangerous adventures in search of a precious soul herb that can summon and control the souls of the dead. Explore dark forests, abandoned cemeteries and dungeons, fight terrible monsters.

description: Ultrakanoid is an exciting game that will allow you to immerse yourself in a nostalgic atmosphere. In this game, you will control a platform and juggle fish, which must break blocks on the playing field to complete the level.

description: As an elite hacker, you have received an anonymous commission. You will collaborate with the special agent "Saku" from an unknown organization to complete a thrilling cross-border mission.

title: Shop Town Dooter
description: A chaotic party top-down shooter. In arenas that throw different surprises every round, find a way to out-perform your friends, even if it means cheating, bribing, or bringing a MECH to a gunfight! Upgrade your guns mid-fights for maximum results. - no refunds in case of friendship destruction.

description: Embark on a mysterious journey in 'Wanderer's Shade: Path of the Void,' a 2D pixel art and adventure game that blends intricate puzzles with deep narrative exploration. Discover secrets, solve challenges, and uncover a story of forgotten identities in an enigmatic world.

title: Sky Mad
description: Futuristic jet fighter combat racing game.

title: Pyramid Game

title: 3D Pets: Splat! The Cat
description:
3D Pets: Splat! The Cat is one in a series of nine virtual pets released by Neechez Innovation Limited.

All the games play in a similar manner. When installed the player has two new programs in the Windows Start menu, hatch.exe and, with this game, pcpet.exe. All creatures are first hatched, there are nine cats to hatch but only one can be alive at a time and the game only allows the player to hatch egg number one when the game is first played.

Each virtual pet needs at least ten minutes attention per day and if treated well it lives for sixty days at which point it becomes an egg again at which point a new egg is hatched and the process of training begins all over again. The game screen consists of a background around which the cat moves, in the upper left is a fish skeleton which is a hotspot for the game control menu, in the upper right is a question mark which opens the in-game help. The game control menu comprises a series of numbers and icons, the numbers show the cat's current status, some of the icons move the player from one location to another while others turn the cursor into one of the cat's toys.

The game is basic and quite easy to play, thought buttons appear over the cat's head showing whether it's hungry or wants to play. When in the kitchen the player can open a cupboard to get cat food, or they can open the fridge to get milk, to put into the feeding bowls. In the TV room the TV can be turned on to entertain the cat and if the fire is lit the cat will fall asleep in front of it. If the player is unable to play with their pet for a few days the game has a 'babysitter' function which automatically cares for the cat until the owner returns. The game also allows the player to play 'Connect 4' with their pet.

title: 3D Pets: PC Pup
description:
3D Pets is a game where the player takes care of a variety of different creatures.

Each 3D Pet begins its life upon hatching out of an egg (yes, a dog hatches out of an egg!) and must be cared for at least 10 minutes per day. If you are unable to play with your pet there is a babysitter feature that does so until you return.

PC Pup is the second half of the first volume in the series, alongside Splat! The Cat.

Once you name your pup, you are free to explore a handful of interactive rooms including a bedroom with a stereo, bathroom with medicine in case the pet gets sick, living room with a television, and a garden where your pet must be trained to 'do its business', as well as others. Little thought bubbles will appear over PC Pup's head indicating what he wants the player to give him, or how he is feeling.

At the end of the pets lifespan, you will see him shrink slowly and then be presented with an 'Angel's Certificate' with stats about the pet's care listed. You may then hatch your next pet and let the circle of life continue.

title: Train Sim World 4: Cargo Line Vol. 2 - Aggregates
description: Discover different freight services with Skyhook Games' Cargo Line for Train Sim World 4. In Volume 2, get into the nitty gritty of aggregate services with the distinctive HOA Hopper - be ready to rock and roll.

title: Ember Knights: Wrath of the Architect
description: The Wrath of the Architect DLC opens a portal to a new dimension! It is your mission to battle through four altered worlds filled with deadly new monsters and bosses… with the fate of reality itself at stake!

title: She is Home Alone
description: Embark on a sky-high adventure in She is Home Alone! Take the wheel and race through the clouds towards your love interest's house in this quirky first-person endless runner, all while grooving to the synthwave soundtrack.

title: Project 13: Nightwatch - Canteen
description: Step back into the mysterious world of Project 13 with the latest expansion pack for Nightwatch. As the night falls, your duty as the Nightwatch intensifies. You've already braved the Gate Area, but now, you find yourself amidst the enigmatic halls of the Project 13 HQ.

title: DNA: Season 2 - Episode 1
description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. You play as the main character Leo to find his true purpose in life. Thus begins the fascinating story of DNA!

title: Count to Ten: Supporter Edition
description: Gain a special badge, some extra options, and early access to future updates by supporting Count to Ten with the Supporter Edition. Practice your skills or have a more relaxing experience by turning off the timer or removing the most difficult elements.

title: I am an Air Traffic Controller 4: Airport Narita - RJAA
description:
This product (ATC4: Airport NARITA [RJAA]) is DLC for "I am an Air Traffic Controller 4".
This DLC includes control of Narita International Airport in Narita, Chiba, Japan.

title: Liquidum: Secrets of the Deep
description: Three new level packs with 24 levels for Liquidum, an aquatic logic puzzle game.

title: Stumble And Fall
description: Stumble and fall is a comedic local multiplayer controller beat 'em up game set in bizarre and dangerous locations

title: Survivor Cells: Virusbane
description: Unlock the supreme power of Virusbane! Master the battlefield with the new cell, unleashing a devastating storm of blades to annihilate viruses. Get the DLC now and elevate your gaming experience to epic heights!

title: Free Chess: Primitives Set
description: You can never have too many cubes or cylinders!

title: Star Conflict: Bark-2
description: This bundle includes:Unique rank 16 gunship fighter “Bark-2”Special weapon: Autocannon 2M-84Active module: “GPB-20000”Unique portrait “Ivan Oakenshield”Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

title: Star Conflict: Bark-2 - Deluxe Edition
description: This bundle includes:Unique rank 16 gunship fighter “Bark-2”Special weapon: Autocannon 2M-84Active module: “GPB-20000”Unique portrait “Ivan Oakenshield”Additionally, the pilot receives:Permanent 10% bonus to credits gainPaint: “Hexagonal chain mail”Decor: “Fire of the Motherland”Additionally, the pilot receives the modules:Aiming overchar

title: Star Conflict: Yith'Mor - Weapons of Victory
description: This pack includes: Weapon “Yith'Orm weapon” R11-17, Active module “Guiding crystal” R13-17, Modifier “Crystal combat recuperator” R13-17, 500 xenocrystals, 60 monocrystals, A set of resources for 50 ores: (Vanadium + Silicon + Graphite + Osmium) + 50 Crystal shards.

title: Star Conflict: Shrike
description: This pack includes:Rank 17 Federation cover frigate ShrikeUnique weapon Hybrid blaster “Alpha-N”Active module “Universal repair module”Rahil “Coin” Weintraub portraitSpecial bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

title: Star Conflict: Shrike - Deluxe Edition
description: This pack includes:Rank 17 Federation cover frigate Shrike Unique weapon Hybrid blaster “Alpha-N”Active module “Universal repair module”Rahil “Coin” Weintraub portrait Additionally, the pilot receives:10% bonus to credits gain for 90 days“Predatory colour” pattern“Monte spheres” decorAdditionally, the pilot receives the modules:Unique mod

title: Unveiling the Unknown
description: Welcome to Balethorn Manor, where five maids are waiting to serve your every need and desire. By the day, talk to your maids, fall in love, and make love. By night, dive into an expansive dungeon system and collect untold riches to level your maids and upgrade the manor!

title: DNA: Season 2 - Episode 2
description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. You play as the main character Leo to find his true purpose in life. Thus begins the fascinating story of DNA!

title: Kicking The Ball Over Mountains Of Stuff
description: Game inspired by Getting Over it. Kick the ball over mountains of stuff to reach the end.

title: DNA: Season 2 - Episode 3
description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. You play as the main character Leo to find his true purpose in life. Thus begins the fascinating story of DNA!

title: Siberian Dawn: Winterflood
description: The Mentor Winterflood arrives in SIberian Dawn

title: Isle o' Little Men
description:
Isle o Little Men is a

3d,2d,point and click,action,adventure,visual novel EVERYTHING.

EVERYTHING PACKED IN ONE GAME. GAME OF THE YEAR 2023.

Made for 1-Bit Jam in 1 week

title: Cat Bait
description: Cat Bait is a casual game with cute pixel graphics. Control the Cat Bait, dodge enemies, and use the unique abilities of helper cats.

title: Sexy Futa: Mecha Battles of Islands
description: Sexy Futa: Mecha Battles of Islands is a role-playing game where you can choose a mecha, customize its appearance to your liking and engage in battle with huge fighting machines in danger-filled locations. Get ready for uncompromising confrontation!

title: The Villainess Is Adored by the Prince of the Neighbor Kingdom
description:
With her engagement annulled, Tiararose was supposed to have been exiled from the country.

"This is the otome game I played!" She realized on the day before the story's ending. Is waiting for my conviction the only thing I can do? But I did not do anything too cruel... Thinking so, the ending proceeds. However, during the judgement, something that was not possible in the game happened. Tiararose was proposed to by the crown prince of the neighboring country.

title: Synaxarion Christian Stories: Holy Martyr Savvas the Goth
description: Born in 334, Savvas the Goth underwent fierce persecution as a Christian. This is his story.

title: Colorizing
description: Coloring by numbers game for relaxation.

title: Yohane the Parhelion: Change set "Beach! in Numazu!!"
description: Let's change into a perfect swimsuit this summer and adventure in the mirror world!

title: Tekken 8: Lidia Sobieska
description: Warrior Prime Minister Lidia Sobieska joins the tournament! Lidia is not only a world-class karate champion, but also one of the political world's most passionate foodies. Osu! Lidia will show you what she can do in TEKKEN 8 for the people of Poland.

title: The Bridge to Yesterday
description: Step into a beautifully crafted world, where you'll embark on an emotional journey filled with intrigue and danger. Explore the touching relationship of two sisters, their struggle for survival, and their unwavering determination in a world where the past crumbles and the future is uncertain.

title: Bagel
description: "Bagel" is an exciting multiplayer online game. While civilians fight strategically to stop the Enemy, the Enemy does not hesitate to shout to hunt down civilians. Collect weapons, choose your class, and embark on a competitive school adventure!

title: Parts of the Elephant
description: Weird things are happening in the Elephant Hotel. It's getting late, you're getting drunk, and moments in the lives of strangers are scattered around you like spilled puzzle pieces. Can you put it all together?

title: Furry from Outer Space
description: ✨Come on an interstellar trip with Furry from Outer Space — into space, love and steamy sex! ✨ Choose your character’s gender, explore faraway worlds and different story branches while enjoying fully voiced animations! ✨

title: Dungeons & Furries
description: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

title: Furry Fairy Tales
description: ✨Beloved classics in a spicy, furry wrapping. ✨ Adult fairytales with steamy beginnings and happy endings! Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!

title: Orient on the Murder Express
description: This is a murder mystery visual novel where you take the role of the detective. Search for clues, make discoveries, and talk to other characters to find out what is truly going on on the Murder Express.

title: Parking Tycoon: Business Simulator - Seaside Business
description: Dive into Miami's vibrant Seaside District in the expansion for Parking Tycoon Business Simulator! Enjoy stunning ocean views, manage a surfboard rental shop, and implement high-tech parking solutions. Build your empire and become the parking tycoon of the sunny waterfront!

title: Turbo Pulse Race
description: In the game, when you drift, you increase your level with the points you earn and unlock cars accordingly. With fast and fluid gameplay, your mistakes might not leave cars behind you.

title: Shamania
description: Shamania is an open world survival game. Get ready to farm, craft, build and fight, but with a unique feature: use your shamanic skills to your advantage in creative ways! Survive in this sandbox with your friends in CO-OP mode.

title: Timeless Tesseract
description: Introducing Timeless Tesseract - The First 3D Parkour Platformer That Lets You Control Time! By Captain Tesseract

title: Brawlers of Duality
description: Brawlers of Duality is an arena fighter where damaging enemies launches them harder. Launch enemies into obstacles to defeat them using martial arts, magic and technology. Battle in 1v1, 2v2, and a mode where you collect loot to power up and fight in a free for all.

title: Herald of the Mists
description: A narrative-driven RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Step into the role of the Queen's Herald and traverse a mist-shrouded realm to uncover the fate of her lost army. Will your choices uphold loyalty, or lead you down a path of betrayal? The secrets of the mists await.

title: Roulette Simulator 2025
description: Roulette Simulator 2025 offers players an incredible modern Roulette gambling simulation. Experience the emotions of gambling in real-time as you try to beat the roulette wheel as you bet on each spin.

title: The Bad Boy's Cars
description: Welcome to The Bad Boy's Cars game, where dominance is the name of the game.

title: Rework
description: Build fantastic contraptions in this open world sandbox, set in an expansive forest with ever changing climate. Protect your base from enemies and work together with friends to discover the secrets hidden beneath the surface.

title: Alter Age
description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure with a party whose ages change!

Arga has been training daily to prove himself superior to his father, who holds the title of the strongest man in the world. During this process, he awakened the job "Soul Alter," a unique skill that changes the states of himself and his companions between adult and child. Sometimes a young man, sometimes a boy, he faces great trials with his companions.

Alter your team in turn-based battles between adult and child states to alternate between attack or support types! Utilize a wide range of formations and elements, including equipment and passive skills, to strategically navigate battles.

Explore a vast expanding world depicted in beautiful pixels, from puzzle dungeons to detour dungeons! Collect ingredients while walking around to cook meals, take on special quests limited to the child state, and fully enjoy every corner of the world of Alter Age!

title: Genshin Impact: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn
description:
The fourth major update of Genshin Impact, known as Version 5.0, which includes:
• New characters: Mualani, Kinich, and Kachina
• New region, Natlan
• New gameplay mechanics: Saurian Indwelling and Nightsoul’s Blessing
• New main story quests: Archon Quest, Chapter V - Act I & II
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: Good Luck Seducing an Ace Witch
description: Jo Arcour, after finishing work, gets kidnapped by a witch in order to be chopped up in the potion as the main ingredient! Depending on your choices he might die or find a new friend.

title: Koibito no Nazo: Lover's Enigma
description: In Lover's Enigma, you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

title: Tekken 8: Heihachi Mishima
description: Heihachi Mishima is the third DLC character for Tekken 8 planned for release in Autumn 2024 alongside a free story update for the game that includes his return to the narrative and reveals his place in the ongoing events.

title: Moon Ghost
description: 2199. Androids resolves the regrets of "ghosts", human souls, in the "Garden" lunar base.

title: Love Letter: First Draft
description: Summer break approaches. With wishes unfulfilled, Danielle strives to find fellow students to attend Romance in Literature with her. If she can't, she may never be able to study Romance and Love at all!

title: Dark 7
description: Dark 7 (sometimes styled Dark7) is a ZDoom mod created by Bryant Robinson (Gunrock).

title: Risk of Rain 2: Starstorm 2
description: Starstorm 2 is a work-in-progress adaptation of the Risk of Rain 1 mod "Starstorm". It currently features four new survivors, three new monsters, over 20 new items and equipment, and numerous new challenges to shake up your runs.

title: Risk of Rain 2: Aetherium
description: Aetherium is a variety pack mod for Risk of Rain 2 that adds in a wide range of items, equipment, artifacts, and more!

title: Dong Dong Never Die: Judgment Day
description: Dong Dong Never Die, the cult classic fighting game originally released in 2009, makes its triumphant return! Truly, Dong Dong never dies. Judgment Day is a massive overhaul of the entire game that makes radical changes to every character and the game systems. It is the culmination of about 20 months of intermittent work, and we think that it's evolved into something really special.

title: Ace of Gifts
description:
Ace of Gifts is a visual novel about a date between girlfriends. Visit the various stalls at the city's annual holiday market, browse the products and balk at the prices. In between stalls, the couple discuss their relationship, as well as the obligations and expectations of family over the holidays.

It's a cold December afternoon, and Sophie has just received an out-of-nowhere text from her girlfriend, Annette, inviting her to the seasonal holiday market. Sophie's elated to attend, but can't help but be a bit worried. Usually, these sort of dates mean that Annette has something on her mind...

title: Date Everything!
description: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

title: Carlos and the Dark Order Mystery
We'll Be Alright
description: Jonghyun, a strange cafe owner, runs the Zodiac Cafe with a side business in the back. He tells fortunes from reading tea leaves for curious customers- who lean more supernatural than not. Even mythological entities want to know how their life will pan out!

title: Holonomy
description:
"Holomony" is a short kinetic visual novel about two adventurers getting trapped in a shifting dungeon-- are they in over their heads?

- Made by ekkoberry as part of O2A2 2024 - Visual Novel Jam

title: Cyberwave
description: Fight Endless Waves of Cyber-Mutants in an ever evolving combat simulation.

title: Inversed
description: A short, interactive visual novel set in the mid-19th Century, in which a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life. Poetry is the answer, but what is the question?

title: Monochrome Pixels
description: Can you bring back the colors into your life?

title: Exiting the White Room
description:
An owl, a goat, and a wolf live in a white room. They’ve been stuck there for a long, long time. One day, the owl wakes up with a fleeting recollection of the day prior. You, the owl, tries to recall what happened.

A short mystery game where you try to uncover what happened to you and your surroundings the day prior.

title: BoyKisser Clicker
description: Click on the Boykisser and take over the world.

title: Angelic Syndrome
description:
The isolation facility "Bird Cage" is a mysterious place like an urban legend, which is different from the world.
It was supposed to be a place that had nothing to do with the 12-year-old Angel, who had never been ill, but the snow-white feathers on the girl's arms robbed the girl of her freedom without any warning….

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Huntress
Toree Missions
description: 24 small but tight challenges that use the traditional 3D Platformer Gameplay of Toree in unique and new ways to give a final spin to the known formula.

title: Toree Jumbled Jam 2
description: Four levels that remix the themes seen in Toree 2 in new and interesting ways. Including some new chiptunes as well as some old songs. Worth mentioning: Those challenges are only for those who really know how to handle Toree! Hard as a beak!

title: Halloween Revenge
description: A short horror game inspired by trash horror movies from the 80s. Mixing weird horror with comedy and weird characters. This mix results in a nostalgic game.

title: Jägermörder 1: Chemical Lab
description: Jägermörder 1: Chemical Lab is a single-level PWAD designed by Derek MacDonald (Afterglow) for Doom II. It uses the music track "Damage Assessment" by Mark Klem.

title: Castle Crashers: Painter Boss Paradise
description:
We used to be enemies. We used to destroy the world around us. Now, we create!
The DLC will include:
Steam workshop capabilities – create your own knight skins, choose your magic, and share with the world!
New official character: play as Paint Junior, use your imagination, and unleash powerful art to vanquish your foes!
New player and weapon artwork for all official playable characters (with an option to toggle on or off).
Endless knightly possibilities – if you aren’t feeling creative, choose from thousands of community characters or preloaded characters created by our team!

title: The S.H.O.W.
description: Fight your way through hordes of hungry pigs, and find the truth behind the motives of the swine.

title: Crysis Maximum Edition
description: Crysis Maximum Edition includes Crysis and the new sequel Crysis Warhead. This epic story takes players into a changing environment, forcing them to adapt their tactics and conquer battlefields ranging from newly frozen jungles to gravity-free alien environments. Includes multiplayer such as Crysis Wars, a new multiplayer experience featuring new online game modes and 21 maps. 7 new maps are available for online combat.

title: SJS1: Streets Of Fear
description: A demon-overrun town. Originally this map was meant to be a part of an expansion to Bloodrust.

title: SJS2: Outpost
description: A dark tech themed map

title: Fervent
description:
A short, VHS - style horror game where you step into the shoes of a paranormal investigator. As you venture into the eerie Fervent Campsite, you'll uncover mysterious obelisks with cryptic symbols, abandoned white tents, and an unsettling ritual book.

Average playtime is 10 minutes.

title: Flutter of birds II: Tenshi-tachi no Tsubasa
description:
The miracle happens again... in another country-

The son of an Englishman and a Japanese woman, our main character is Shin'ya. Having grown up in his father's native land, he wanted to visit the homeland of his mother, who died when he was young. White snow covers the town of Kuramachi. His other hometown, the last trace of his mother. That is where his father and mother met and were married. And the time comes when Shin'ya's wish is granted. His aunt Miyu says she'll look after him at her church..

In his mother's hometown, Shin'ya injures his leg and goes to a clinic. As Shin'ya stays in the small, snow-covered town, waiting for his leg to heal, he encounters various young women.

title: Hayato's Journey
description:
Hayato's Journey is a SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis homebrew game that works like an unofficial spiritual sucessor of Kenseiden, a cult-classic SEGA Master System game.

Hayato's Journey is the first full SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis game powered by the Scorpion Engine by earok.

title: Chill Corner: Extras
description:
This DLC added new characters (included outfits) and pets
- New male character Victor with two outfit
- New female character Emillia with three outfit
- New variants of Cat and Dog
- New exclusive decorator
- New room

title: Step Right Up: Adventure Isle
description: Welcome welcome to Step Right Up: Adventure Isle! The park has now opened with a plethora of things for you to enjoy! Try your luck against 14 anomalies with 5 songs and 6 contestants! See if you can discover the secrets of the park if you're up to it... And always remember to HAVE FUN!

title: Tribute to Shadow of the Colossus
description: Tribute to Shadow of the Colossus, also known as just 'Tribute', is a passionate Brazilian fan project dedicated to honoring the timeless masterpiece that is Shadow of the Colossus by remaking it on PC and not only restoring all the cut content, but also the ideas that Team Ico could not even began to program due to time constraints. With a soulful dedication, Team Tribute is bringing to life to all the unused colossi —Griffin, Devil, Phoenix, Roc, Saru, Sirius, Spider, Worm, Yamori and Evis— infusing them with the essence of the game's original vision.

title: Beyond the Forbidden Lands
description: Beyond the Forbidden Lands is a non-profit fan-made PC remake of Shadow of the Colossus with the restoration of cut content as a major focus, including the Unused Colossi and removed areas from the game. The game will provide the option of playing as close to the original Shadow of the Colossus as possible, along with the inclusion of a 'Story Mode' which is set before SotC.

title: Shy Guy Surfing
description:
Slide, jump, and float over the ocean in this arcade-style fangame by LucasPucas. With over a dozen unique areas, rip-roaring rival battles, and a brand-new New Game Plus mode, the world of Shy Guy Surfing is packed with content like never before!
Travel across the wild seascape and face off against bosses in Journey Mode, or shoot for a high score in Endurance Mode.
Jam to classic music from the Mario series and more, arranged by an all-star cast of chiptune artists!
Customize your experience with a wide selection of screen borders and unlockable costumes.

title: Artus Against the Demon of the Museum
description: Artus Against the Demon of the Museum is a point-and-click adventure game designed as an educational game to teach children about classical paintings, their history and creators with its main character Artus de mouse.

title: Toolkid Creation
description: Toolkid Creation from Emme studio is an educational game offering kids a set of activities to create art piece on their computer and learn how to start DIY in real life as well.

title: Duskfade
description: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

title: Fort Boyard: Millennium
description: Trapped in the heart of Fort Boyard, you will have to try to escape by solving many puzzles and avoiding the traps of Arok and his evil creatures. The game uses the fort from the famous TV show of the same name in a platform/horror style.

title: Pinko Linko's School
description:
Pinko Linko's School is a game I dug up not too long ago when I was visiting my grandparents. I found it while searching for some old tennis equipment in there storage. The box indicated that it was made in 1998, and yes, you can truly see that it is from that era. The first Doom game also came out in 1998, so this must have been some kind of kids-learning-toy-doom-clone. Anyway, I got it running and managed to rip the files, so here they are!

Side note: I rebinded all the keys from being the arrow keys to wasd, also there were some things in the game that were kind of [REDACTED], but that might have just been me. When you are done with the game you can take a look in the YouWon folder, I left [REDACTED] in there,

title: The Woods Have Horns
description:
Welcome to Camp Shelterlake! Enjoy a beautiful view, take a walk on the woods, and don't be brutally mauled by the legendary Goatman!

Do you have what it takes to survive this pixel-art gorefest?

title: Stealth Kill VR Missions
description: Welcome to D.A.R.P., Operator. You have been chosen to prove your Infiltration, Weapons and Explosives skills throughout various objectives in this Physics based Stealth Action VR Game. Candidates unable to comply or show signs of weakness, will be terminated immediately.

title: Jefe, La Cuenta
description: Sisebuto has a problem. He likes to drink a lot and pay very little. And today, the trip home is going to be fun. Everything is going to go from bad to worse.

title: Barista
description: This game was created for the "Games for Blind Gamers" game jam.

title: Foxo's Fun Schoolhouse
description: Foxo's Fun Schoolhouse is an educational fun game where you have to find comics for a friend! Foxo, the main teacher will help you with your adventure. It won't be an easy though!

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Voice Set
description: This set includes the following DLC: Holo Core Voice: Renne Bright, Holo Core Voice: Judith Lanster and Holo Core Voice: Barkhorn.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails through Daybreak - Bonus Set
description: This set includes various cosmetic DLC and some consumable item sets.

title: Sudoku Infinite
description: A typical sudoku game with an endless supply of new Sudoku puzzles to solve.

title: Lots of Cats in Every Moment
description: “Lots of Cats in Every Moment” is a game where you find hidden cats while romance unfolds!

title: Lots of Cats in Every Moment: The Whereabouts of the Photo
description: “Lots of Cats in Every Moment: The Whereabouts of the Photo” is an expansion pack that contains the latter part of the story from the base game.

title: Forestrike
description: Forestrike is a tactical kung-fu fighting game with a supernatural twist. Use your 'foresight' ability to visualize fights before they happen and hone your skills then rumble in reality, where defeat means starting over from scratch.

title: Pirates of the Caribbean: New Horizons
Wayne's World
description:
Wayne's World is an adventure game based on the movie with the same name. The game itself is a classic point and click adventure, and should not be confused with the platform game based on the movie.

You play both Wayne and Garth, and you can switch between them at any time. The plot is simple; In an attempt to save their tv-show, Wayne and Garth decide to hold a pizza-thon (a charity show with a pizza-theme) in order to raise money. In order to be able to hold the pizza-thon Wayne and Garth must embark on several quests to collect items and hire people they need for the show. The adventure includes participating in babe-jeopardy, joining a biker's gang and baking pizza. The graphics are in 2D and the sound contains several samples from the movie.

title: Ogre Labs
description: Ogre Labs is a single-level PWAD for Doom II by Russell Pearson. It is a very large tech-base themed map for limit removing ports and uses the Doom music track "The Imp's Song" by Robert Prince.

title: Carpathian Skies
description: A downloadable visual novel for Windows, macOS, and Linux

title: Gallop Racer Online
description: Gallop Racer Online was a Windows-based online game released only in Japan, based on the same series.

title: The Well of Heaven-Reaching
description: the Well of Heaven-reaching is a platforming game. Choose from a variety of jumps where you'll need to make your way through traps and obstacles to reach the top of the Well of Heaven-reaching.

title: Love Curse: Find Your Soulmate
description: It is a girls' love visual novel set against the backdrop of college and the workplace. The protagonist carries a love curse and is searching for her true love. However, as events unfold, she finds herself facing even bigger challenges...

title: End's beginning
description: 'End’s beginning' is a Japanese-style fantasy romance visual novel. As Carter Evan, uncover the truth behind his death and Shermanland's fall. With a nearly 300,000-word script, experience four unique relationships: Brother and Brother, Monarch and Knight, God and Follower, and Vampire and Prey.

title: On All Clear Days
description: A short visual novel set in the post-war world

title: The Walls Still Stand
description: Step into the eerie Kowloon Walled City in "The Walls Still Stand", an indie horror walking simulator. Complete daily tasks, uncover dark secrets, and explore with 3D spatial sound. Think critically to unlock all six endings in this 1-2 hour journey. Can you escape the city's grip?

title: Tritime Space
description: A stand-alone monster-killing game that performs action strikes and releases cool skills according to the beat of music: -- You can sense energy from the rhythm, and the energy will be transformed into stronger power!

title: Monster Commanders
description: Turn-Based Sci-Fi Strategy Game

title: Wayfarer
description: Progress thought labyrinthine caves and solve entertaining puzzles. Explore this incredible adventure where loneliness becomes your closest companion as you search clues amidst stunning landscapes and ancient ruins.

title: Cute Socks
description: Cute Socks is an interactive story about an eighteen-year-old girl who is home alone. She quickly sheds her clothes and begins playing around the house in just her socks. When her friend Julia arrives, their friendship turns into a budding lesbian relationship full of happiness and multiple orgasms!

title: Neon Express
description: Take the helm in this cyberpunk uber driver narrative mystery. Traverse the city delivering contraband and nefarious passengers. Rekindle old contacts and reconnect with an underworld you were trying to leave behind.

title: Recursive Riftfall

Broke in another world, you have to find a way to survive in a corrupt city. At least there are beautiful women of various fantastical races to build relationships with.

title: Wing Haven
description: Wing Haven is a relaxing idle game about building cozy bird sanctuaries. Collect rare and exotic feathered friends, give them plant shelter, and watch them grow in real-time! Progress from a basic enclosure to a beautiful nature preserve in old-growth forest, desert oasis, or wetland climates!

title: Fortress Forge
description: As a mighty commander, you'll oversee the defense of your base and use weaponry to repel the oncoming hordes. Harness the unique properties of various soldiers and weapons to land devastating blows to the enemy!

title: Hole*
description:
explicit, 18+

under 500 words

vulgar and dysphoric language

made for the 2026 toxic yuri vn jam 2

title: Veil Runners
description: Veil Runners is an action roguelite arena auto-shooter where you fight through waves of creatures to reach the next planet in search of the source. Level up, loot, buy randomly generated items and more to upgrade your character and units into an awesome and game-breaking build.

title: Stick Infinite Kingdom
description: Master strategic gameplay as you build, train, and upgrade units to protect your statue and king. Switch between leaders, unlock chests, and compete on the leaderboard. With stunning visuals, diverse zombies, and easy controls, it's an epic battle for survival!

title: Dungeon Baller
description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball, where every bounce is a battle.

title: Star-Wired
description: Repair the circuitry of your Starship and clear out the intrusive programs in a cute and casual puzzle game. Plug in cables, activate moving objects, and dodge malicious entities on your quest for success!

title: Thirsty
description: Help poor Charlie grab a glass of water. He's up late at night, again.........

title: Capy Island
description: Capy Island is a party game where players, who are capybaras, play minigames on an island to collect hats. These hats will give them a step up in the final showdown where they will all battle it out. The capybara with the most hats wins!

title: Sonic 2006
description: A level pack that demakes Sonic The Hedgehog (2006)'s zones to Sonic Robo Blast 2.

title: Path of Exile: Settlers of Kalguur
description:
In Path of Exile: Settlers of Kalguur, help Kalguuran pioneers to build the town of Kingsmarch and establish trade between Wraeclast and their homeland.

The July expansion introduces the Settlers of Kalguur challenge league, a new trade market system for currency, balance improvements including two Ascendancy Class changes, Endgame improvements, some further additions to the Campaign and some Quality of Life features.

title: Dreamtone
description: Dreamtone is a traditional RPG, set in a whimsical pastiche of the American 1980s!

title: Holiday After Special
description: Holiday After Special is a short slice-of-life, horror anthology following the Step Sisters' adventures over the holidays before the events of Halloween After Special.

title: Soulthread
description: A dynamic, turn-based RPG set in a world full of mystery! Play as Mabel and unravel the secrets of the universe by finding the four crystals of the book. With the help of her old high school friend, Will, and a mysterious mage named Nyxra, anything is possible in this world of epic proportions!

title: Moro's Poodle
description: Join Gift and his friends in their journey to go home! All while uncovering a strange plot as more and more hidden truths about Gift's life rise to the surface.

title: Connected Fates
description: A story-driven puzzle adventure game with unconventional game mechanics.

title: Call To Summon
description: A short game where you can use an old phone to summon objects by simply calling them. Use it to advance through the old complex, reminiscent of liminal spaces.

title: Muso
description:
Muso is an RPG where you take control of a young High School Freshman, named "Atabi" on his journey to discover the secrets of the universe with the help of his childhood friend "Markus", a detective named "Casey," and a rebellious teenage rabbit named "Nuttallii."

Venturing through mysterious worlds created by a mysterious group of antagonists known as, "The Mauve," Atabi and his friends must unlock their true potentials and go through the task of understanding the true intentions of one-another in their misfit group in order to restore balance to the world and merge split realities caused by an unknown force in order to take over the world.

title: Grove Grown Guardians
description: A fantasy turn based strategy game about growing plants. Position plants strategically for the best results. Sell plants to buy seed packets. Compost plants to gain grove energy to fuel powers. Feed plants to guardians to make them strong enough to fight off the corruption in auto-battling format.

title: The Digital Asset Inquisition
description:
A recent data leak of highly valuable and confidential files has prompted your clients to hire independent contractors to investigate, suspecting the leak to have originated internally. They have reason to believe one of the asset managers may be responsible for the breach.

This individual has not checked in recently, but you have triangulated their last known location to a space hotel on the fringe of the galaxial terminal, where it is suspected they plan to make their escape.

Your mission is to infiltrate the hotel and recover evidence of their involvement in the data leak by
a) retrieving their suitcase for evidence and
b) obtaining the target's brainbox for analysis
Further details are on the chalkboard, and be sure to check your notebook.

title: Marth.exe
description: Very short game that takes Fire Emblem: Shadow Dragon and turns it into a corrupt .exe game.

title: Ghost Wave
description: Ghost Wave is a free space shoot 'em up game.

title: Dr. Bloodshot
description: Dr. Bloodshot is a short survival horror game. It's set in an old mansion filled with monsters that the player has to avoid (either by running away or by hiding in cabinets). The objective is to reach the well secured laboratory of Dr. Bloodshot, which can be done by sabotaging various power stations across the mansion.

title: Cast Away: The Oddysee
description: "Cast Away - The Oddysee" is an RPG Maker XP game developed by TheLuigiplayer and LamaZ Game Studio (formerly JS RPG's), which has been in development since 2011. The game is based on the concept of a classic dungeon crawler and follows the story of the sailor "John Maynard," who is named after the ballad by Theodor Fontane. John finds himself stranded on what initially appears to be a deserted island. However, events soon start to unfold, revealing what mysterious occurrences are taking place on that island!

title: Everhaven
description:
Everhaven (Working title: Project Dragon) was a cozy sandbox survival crafting multiplayer RPG- a buildable world made of blocks inspired by Minecraft filled with fantasy characters and quests inspired by Breath of the Wild.

This title was abruptly cancelled in the final stages of development and weeks before it's scheduled reveal and Early Access launch by Phoenix Labs's new owner Forte (a blockchain company that recently purchased the studio), resulting in mass studio layoffs.

title: Mechenosets
description: A game based on the movie “Меченосец” ("The Sword Bearer"). This is a drama about how society makes a monster out of a human being, about love and hate, capable of turning fragile flesh into steel. In the role of the main character of the movie you will have to go through all the iconic locations of the movie and fight with numerous opponents. The game repeats and in a way complements the plot of the movie, turning the combination of game and movie into a unique experience for the player and the viewer.

title: Before the Moon
description:
A short walking simulator.

Inspired by old dreams and looking at the Moon.

title: Indoor Haul
description: In Indoor Haul, you once again find yourself at an abandoned indoor mall. Using your trusty shopping cart, grab as many valuables as you can - but BEWARE! The heavier your cart gets, the harder it is to push! Try to get a high score in the 2-Minute, 5-Minute, and Free Play modes!

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Storms
Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Reptile
Mortal Kombat 1: Invasions - Season of the Soul Eater
Playback Trauma: The Dog
description: Your dog Marla got lost in the most terrifying forest in New Jersey while on a walk, and now it's up to you to find her. Search the area, clean up Marla's poop, and avoid the creatures that may be lurking in the darkness.

title: Park Beyond: Beyond the Depths - Theme World
description:
Bring a splash of fun to your dream park with the Beyond the Depths expansion. Create a sunken water world with new scenery objects and watch as visitors get soaked up while diving into new water attractions.
Beyond the Depths includes the following content:
• 250+ Scenery Objects
• 11 Building Prefabs
• 2 Flat Rides
• 2 Entertainers and Impossification
• 2 Coaster Modules
• 1 Track Type
• 3 Coaster Cars
• 2 Sandbox Maps

title: RealFlight Evolution: Blade Eclipse 360
description: The Blade Eclipse 360 combines a fully-molded EPO body with futuristic looks and a high-performance airframe to deliver a unique blend of hovering, scale-like, sport, and aerobatic flying capabilities for intermediate to experienced heli pilots.

title: RealFlight Evolution: E-flite Cherokee 1.3m
description: This updated and upgraded version of the popular E-flite Cherokee 1.3m is a Smarter tribute to the general aviation classic that features a variety of scale details and functional features including lights, flaps, a full-flying stabilator, and more.

title: RealFlight Evolution: Triple Tree Float Flight Line
description: Fly your model aircraft from the dock or the water at the premier floatplane site at Triple Tree Aerodrome in Woodruff, SC.

title: RealFlight Evolution: E-flite Turbo Timber SWS 2.0m
description: The E-flite Turbo Timber SWS (Sport Wood Series) 2.0m is the largest Timber model from E-flite yet, plus it offers the advantages of lightweight, stiff and strong wood construction.

title: RealFlight Evolution: E-flite UMX Conscendo
description: The E-flite UMX Conscendo is a scaled-down, ultra-micro version of the Conscendo Evolution 1.5m!

title: SMYS: Retro Blocks

title: Pixel Game Maker Series NyanxTech
description: Simple character control + stage gimmicks to be unlocked at the same time. This is a finger-tip confusing action puzzle. Challenge yourself with numerous difficult puzzles!

title: Gearbits: Raider Expedition
description: Gearbits: Raider expedition is an expansion campaign for Gearbits. The campaign is a side-story, taking place after the end of Gearbits. The expansion features new missions and maps. A new cast of characters and new playable units.

title: Medved Hellraiser 3: Green Elephant
description: 3D first-person shooter where you have to fight monsters, gopniks, debt collectors and homeless people!

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KPIT Airport
description: Control over Pittsburgh International Airport (IATA: PIT, ICAO: KPIT, FAA LID: PIT), with destinations throughout North America and Europe developed by FeelThere team for Tower! Simulator 3.

title: H.E.N.T.A.L.K.E.R.
description: Forget about the rules, there are none here. Just you, your weapon and the endless, ominous wastelands waiting for you to plunge into them. So, are you ready to become a predator among predators? Then welcome to H.E.N.T.A.L.K.E.R.. It will hurt, but damn it will be fun!

title: Svarog's Dream: Return of the Old Gods
description: Bringing more action, expanding on the story, and everything else you liked in the core game.

title: Screaming Savage Blood Death
description: Take charge as freshly-hired camp counselors and rescue campers from natural nasties, supernatural spooks, as well as a mysterious maniac in a retro side-scrolling survival-horror adventure set in the wetlands of New Jersey. Can you uncover the dark secrets lurking within the Pine Barrens?

title: H.I.v.C.A.: Human Intelligence vs Computer Algorithm
description: "H.I.v.C.A." is a strategic game where every choice matters. Gather resources, develop technologies, and strategically place your forces to ensure victory over opponents. There is no room for a draw in this game - only one can become the absolute ruler of the new world.

title: DNA: Season 2 - Episode 4
description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. You play as the main character Leo to find his true purpose in life. Thus begins the fascinating story of DNA!

description: The DNA action rpg franchise is created by a solo dev as an episodic side scrolling action hack and slash beat em up, story-driven 2d anime that welcomes the world into the DNA universe. title: DNA: Final Episode - Part 2
