description: Naribiki Village is a first-person, single-player exploration horror game. The focus is on exploring the uncharted village of Naribiki, where uncovering clues will reveal the truth about what happened there.

description: Alternative online turn-based trading card game, that allows you unlimited deck-building options. Three different game modes, including Solo, Gauntlet, and Multiplayer to choose from! Earn cards, packs, and coins, and try to stay on top of the leaderboards For the Glory of Gods.

description: Night Driver - 3D car game in which you will drive at night through dark alleys!

description: Blast into action with your trusty air cannon with gameplay inspired by Air Hockey and additions like traps and power-ups. Play with your friends in the classic game or go all out in the destructive chaos mode where you have more than your opponent to worry about.

title: Don’t Trust
description: There are ten of you. Only two roles. Not everyone can be trusted. And the next victim has already been chosen!

title: Slot Gun
description: Slot Gun is a satisfying deckbuilding slot-machine game where you face off against several opponents to control the board. It is a blend of luck and skill where timing is key and dopamine is everywhere.

title: Kingdoms of Lost Valleys
description: First in the series will be a turn-based multiplayer Trading Card Game where players can collect, buy, sell, customize, trade, and rent warriors and all this will happen in the game environment.

title: Vedmaak
description: Vedmaak is an action RPG with Turn-Based Combat centered around battling foes and gathering valuable loot. Vedmaaks, elite warriors adept in melee combat, marksmanship, and practical magic, are sought for missions surpassing the abilities of ordinary warriors.

title: Vision Ghost 2
description: This case takes us to a large mansion located deep in the mountains. In this small world almost cut off from the outside, the main leadership of a large company resides. They harbor secrets unknown to outsiders, which will gradually be revealed due to the occurrence of an accidental incident...

title: RC: Car Maniacs
description: RC:CM is a fascinating arcade simulator of radio-controlled cars that will allow you to plunge into the world of children's fantasies by driving radio-controlled cars: rally, drift, high-speed and other types of cars! Race with your friends! Speed, adrenaline and excitement await you!

title: Cuprum2929
description: After waking up disoriented near the sea, a young kid must navigate through an enigmatic city controlled by AI screens, searching for their missing dog, Pythagora. Solve intricate puzzles housed in unique locations and unravel the secrets of this advanced island and reunite with your companion.

title: Hentai Senpai: Konbini no Shirigaru Onna
description: Dive into the tantalizing world of Hentai Senpai: Konbini no Shirigaru Onna! Solve steamy puzzles and meet 52 alluring Shirigaru Onna. Enjoy stunning 5K visuals, a sensual gallery, and a chill lofi soundtrack. Unlock and uncover the sensual secrets of the Shirigaru Onna! 🧩

title: Magic Patrol Envoy
description: In the face of many monsters, the best way is to build a strong piece of equipment.

title: Project Starcrash
description: Use your powerful punches to defeat alien invaders in this 2.5D platformer.

title: Footsy
description: Footsy is a chaotic multiplayer soccer party game set inside grandma's house! Smash furniture, shatter bottles, and tumble TVs as you compete in wild, goal-scoring action. Customize your characters, challenge your friends, and embrace the crazy destruction in every room!

title: Powerplay
description: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.

title: Sex Inspector
description: Sex Inspector is a 18+ visual novel where every sultry alley and shadowy figure could lead to thrilling encounters or chilling discoveries. Think you can handle the heat?

title: Cos-249
description: Welcome to your new job. You will be viewing a recording of COS-249. The test subject's is E-376 he will be recording his full experience in the room.The room is full of anomalous objects and entities. The only objective is to stay alive.But don't worry there is cake at the end.

title: Night of The Abattoir Man
description: The story of Michael D'Amato, a young 23-year-old man who flies to New York with the intention of starring in his uncle's new horror movie. However, he finds himself in a real-life horror scenario as he becomes the target of a 10-foot-tall maniac known as the Abattoir Man.

title: Gensokyo: Presumption of Guilt - Pansies Before Dawn
description: An ancient village, once sealed by yokais for a millennium, is now plagued by a series of bizarre yokai murders. Follow the protagonist as they delve into the investigation, unravelling the mysteries submerged in the history.

title: The Catalyst Acolyte Tower Defense
description: Defend the Catalyst Crystal against adorable yet menacing bugs in The Catalyst Acolyte. Strategically construct defenses in handcrafted levels, aided by helpful items every 10 waves. Engaging gameplay and charming visuals make for an addictive tower defense adventure.

title: Manda: Mario and Ana
description: This is my first game. This is a game that can be played by yourself or in pairs. You can control Mario to jump, run, and control Ana to shoot, heal Mario, or clear obstacles. Survive as much as possible in a random world to get higher scores.

title: Times of Survival
description: A top-down action-rpg survival game where you face the threat of zombies alone or in co-op and expand the survival zone of humanity. Explore a ruined city, gather supplies and craft powerful weapons. Support human settlements, reclaim territory and win the war against the zombie hordes.

title: Idle Casino Empire
description: An idle casino tycoon where you build the floor, then rig it. Turn casino psychology into upgrades. Play blackjack, roulette, and slots in Owner Mode. Use the Owner's Edge to cheat: nudge reels, peek at hidden cards, read marked cards. Eight venues, a prestige loop. The house is you.

title: Gachi Feasting
description: Gachi Feasting is a hardcore action puzzle game. You will have to connect wrestlers into chain using their arms and other naughty parts. Will you be able to withstand this gachi world of falling men and their mighty fists?

title: 7Years
description: 7Years is a first-person, story-based horror game. Traverse open-world maps as you investigate for clues, solve puzzles, uncover mysteries and elude unique demonic enemies, each created to trigger a specific fear and keep you from your only mission: survive and save your wife.

title: Oryks
description: 2D platform game inspired by the Halloween atmosphere like in Tim Burton's films. In the game, we conduct conversations, solve investigations, move left and right, jump and shoot to defeat enemies, we also interact with the environment. We also make decisions that affect the course of the mission.

title: Star Shogun
description: Kohanga Shogun is a first person sci-fi colony building game with economy management and vehicle combat. We've got a touch of 4X, a touch of RTS, and lots and lots of mech on mech action!

title: Lalli
description: Lalli tells the tale of a Finnish folk hero and freedom fighter. In 1240, Finland is invaded by the neighboring Swedish Kingdom, aiming to convert the tribes to Christianity by force. This is when a regular woodsman is forced to adapt into a warrior - and a legend, remembered centuries later.

title: Grand Fantasia: Origin
description: New engine, New gameplay, New adventure, the classic MMORPG 《Grand Fantasia：ORIGIN》technological innovation, reigniting the heart of adventure, and composing a new chapter of the fantasy World with Sprites.

title: Colorful Ghost
description: Embark on a puzzling adventure in COLORFUL GHOSTS! Guide ghosts through challenges where candies change their colors, allowing them to blend with others. Overcome obstacles with logic. With ColorAdd accessibility features, easily identify colors. Can you solve these spectral puzzles?

title: Tank Hunter
description: Wasteland sci-fi style light meat pigeon tank shooting game

title: The Protagonish
description: An adventure game, where you don't control the adventurer. Play the side characters in a medieval village, and decide to help or hinder the adventurer in their mysterious quest.

title: Judofuri
description: You only need one button to compete in this fruity party game! Press it, squeeze it & mash it in a series of silly mini-games for 2 to 9 players and claim your spot as the juiciest fruit of ‘em all!

title: Oil and Sand
description: An exciting tower defense game where you have to defend your island from the invasion of enemy forces. Your task is to build and upgrade towers to repel waves of attacking enemies.

title: The Fight: Aftermath
description: Embark on a thrilling odyssey through a world torn apart by catastrophe. As a lone survivor, navigate treacherous terrain, scavenge for essentials, and confront the horrors of the apocalypse. Will you overcome adversity and rebuild civilization, or succumb to the chaos of the wasteland?

title: Sex Industry XXX
description: Sex Industry XXX is a unique game that combines elements of visual novel and clicker, allowing you to immerse yourself in the world of the adult film industry.

title: Senile Zombies
description: Senile Zombies is a magic-themed zombie survival shooter that can be played alone or in co-operative multiplayer. Shoot your way through multiple rounds of increasingly strong enemies, while upgrading your own powers to keep up.

title: Encounters
description: Encounters is an open-world, Exploration game about hunting for aliens and cryptids

title: Satan
description: Experience the thrill of retro boomer shooters in this action-packed game where you'll battle hordes of demons and face the ultimate challenge: Satan himself. Relive the glory days of classic shooters with intense gameplay, a variety of weapons, and relentless enemies.

title: Fast Running
description: Fast running, challenge the limits.

title: Kelder
description: Trapped in a sinister post-Soviet basement, uncover the truth behind dark experiments and eerie anomalies. Solve puzzles, find keys, and survive against terrifying entities as you explore this atmospheric survival horror. Can you escape the depths of the Kelder?

title: SuperHyperHappyGame
description: [3D first person runner game]Run through aiming for the goal!

description: Astraia is an innovative game that combines equipment building, dungeon challenge, platform jumping and LAN team up online. The game requires a certain amount of maneuverability, players need to sprint, jump, and avoid enemy skills and barrage.

title: Exanimate
description: Exanimate is a 1-4 player co-op survival game where you face off against never-ending legions of Zeds and their innumerable variations in a valiant attempt to escape with your lives, your riches and your highest possible scores! How long can you hold out against the Exanimate?

title: Crazy World of Caleb: Level 1 to 7

title: My New Memories: The Beginning

description: Fight back against the killer robots in this strategy RPG with a unique twist: every unit has a limited supply of power.

title: Pig Rush
description: "Pig Rush" is a maze adventure game set in a deep forest. In this game, you guide a brave little wild boar named Argan. Argan will evade traps, defeat enemies, and keep moving forward to find the answers needed to save his tribe.

title: Dominance Chess-like
description: Turn-based strategy game where the players use their game pieces to gain control of the fields of a chess board one move at a time.

title: Skill Random Defense
description: - Game Description Combine awesome skills to win against waves of enemies! Skill Random Defense is a casual defense game that combines 60 skills to block enemies. Combine the optimal skills using the skills you have.

title: Wobbly Heights
description: Enter a world where blocks defy norms! Stack, grow, shrink, and solidify blocks in a puzzle game that's all about strategy and creativity to make the tallest tower possible as demands keep rising. How tall will your tower become?

title: WASDJK
description: Complete a adventure story in this maze with only operation hints.

title: Puzzled Hive
description: Puzzled Hive is a simple, beehive based puzzle game in which you play as Meo and help him explore this strange place in search of his answers.

title: Crowded. Followed.
description: You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else. A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.

title: Red Planet Rampart
description: You are deployed to the desolate red planet to reforge humanity's hope. With no hospitable atmosphere, no nurturing water sources, only relentless storms, unknown alien creatures, you must use wit and determination to survive on this alien land and build a Mars base of your own.

title: Golden Ball
description: Playing this game will give you the experience of feeling like a child and competing in a little athletic competition. You may also learn to understand a little more about how molecules feel. If you are looking for a game for a change of pace from other games, try this one.

title: Lost Girl Platformer
description: Lost Girl Platformer is a thrilling 2D platform game where you play as a courageous girl. Your task is to jump from platform to platform to survive and escape. But be careful: time is limited, and every jump must be precise!

title: Legends of The Internet
description: Legends Of The Internet is an exhilarating card video game that transports players into the dynamic and captivating realm of cyberspace. Set in a fantastical digital universe, the game combines elements of strategy, luck, and storytelling to create an immersive gaming experience unlike any other.

title: I Did It All For The Cookie!
description: You are hanging out at a festive Christmas party when your eyes discover the most perfect Christmas confectionery ever! You must have it!... but someone already has it! What will you be willing to do, to get your Christmas wish?

title: Chemist Wanted
description: Chemist Wanted is a crafting game with a difference! In this lab simulator, you use practical chemistry to make compounds and sell them. Set up your equipment, run the experiments and create your products. But be careful who you cut deals with - you might get more than you bargained for!

title: Sombra
description: Sombra is a 2D platform video game with a pixel art style where you have to guide a cat to the exit of the cave it has fallen into, with the only option of clicking a button to perform different actions.Help this scared little kitty find her way back home.

title: Little Fish Swims On
description: Little Fish Swims is a relaxing and enjoyable idle game with a casual simulated fish tank located at the top of the screen. There are over a thousand types of fish in the game, and you can customize your own fish tank and background skin style.

description: Not a Masterpiece invites players on a whimsical journey through a vibrant cartoon world, where nothing is quite as it seems

description: Bring flowers from nature to venues in Florist Business Simulator. Develop your business by gathering flowers, making stunning arrangements, and decorating venues to delight your customers with beautiful spaces.

title: Rescue Team: Clouded Mind
description: The world faces a brand-new threat as a dangerous cult spreads its influence. People begin to betray their free will and follow the cults orders, as reports flood in from various locations worldwide, it's down to the Rescue Team to save humanity once again!

title: Medieval Businessman
description: Welcome to the Empty Patch of Land. Can you create your own beautiful kingdom here? In this strategy in real time you can build farms, taverns, barracks, and more.

title: Verve
description: Welcome to Verve. You are RT-6, a member of Liminal Leap's highly-trained professional rescuing team. You are tasked to find the location of a small group of research scientists who sent out a high-level distress call from deep within the void of Verve. Good luck, the Verve is unforgiving.

title: Shattered Melodies
description: Slash and shred your way through the vibrant, musical world of Soronos. Summon all your rhythm, dexterity, and puzzle solving chops to beat down the fool that nabbed your little sister!

title: Light: Die to Survive
description: Explore a haunted house, shadowy forests, and ominous roads with a flashlight in "Light - Die to Survive," a spine-chilling horror game. Solve random, terrifying paranormal mysteries in a night-shrouded environment. Experience dynamic horror, immersive sound effects, and mystery solving. Can you escape the darkness?

title: Chronal Stasis
description: Travel to the past and blast your way through to save the timeline in Chronal Stasis, a 2.5D time-traveling platformer-esque game that combines classic run and gun elements with time-based abilities. Join Henry as he fights to save his family and fix the timeline. Is it really that simple though?

title: Evil Dark
description: Keep the lights on until dawn breaks—or risk becoming prey to what lurks in the darkness.

title: Combat Evolved 2D
description: Unleash Your Inner Warrior in a Fast-Paced Top-Down 2D PvP Extravaganza! Strategy meets skill in intense player-versus-player combat! Master your hero, outsmart your opponents, and rise to the top in this vibrant, action-packed battleground.

title: Penalty Challenge
description: Embark on an exhilarating journey with Penalty Challenge, the definitive 11-meter shot simulator crafted for those passionate about elevating their football abilities.

description: the new foddian on the block

description: Can you make the right choices and unravel the secrets of this alien world.Your cosmic adventure awaits! Embark on a unique space adventure.You take on the critical role of a remote mission controller. Your task? Guide a stranded astronaut who has crash-landed on a mysterious alien planet.

title: LoveAndComplex
description: LoveAndComplex is a simulation game set in college. Like any other simulation game, you can watch all sorts of endings by your choice.

description: You've just bought your first Pub. First steps are to clean it, stock it, set your markup and let in the Patrons. Keep the drinks flowing and try not to shortchange anyone! description: A sci-fi fantasy 2D Platformer. Story rich.

description: Earthbound Dimensions is a fanmade unofficial playable reimagination of EarthBound/MOTHER 2, but translated and adapted to modern 3D systems.

Pilots operate a machine equipped with an anti-gravity engine and race through a high-speed thrill of up to 400 km/h.

A horror game to find the anomalies.

There are no items to collect, no puzzles to solve, and no hiding, running, or fighting.

title: You VS Drugs: Education & Prevention
description: 'The Enemy' can enslave anyone, anywhere. By taking on the role of real-life Agents who exist in our brain and embarking on an adventure that will defy your imagination, you will be empowered to better protect yourself, and the people you love —if you have what it takes!

title: Lake Of Roaches
description: Created for the 7-day Fishing Jam. Pay a visit to the Lake of Roaches.

The game tasks the player, who was a vengeful demon hunter, with the growth of a warrior shrine maiden girl, after she has inherited your demon slaying powers. The game hinges on the player’s ability to foster her schedule which seeks to build her physical and mental attributes.

C.O.Ś. is a 3D futuristic sci-fi horror game focusing on feelings of isolation and fight for survival.
During its gameplay player learns the history and secrets moving alone through an abandoned space station.

Two lovers sitting in a train trying to fix their relationship before the ride ends. Can you help them and reach the best of the 3 outcomes?

Global Game Jam 2022 Entry

description: The last place truly beyond the reach of intergalactic capitalism.

description: Dive into a fresh and vibrant world of fruity fun with the 'Fruits & Vegetables' expansion pack.

description: Aurora is a famous healer who lives in a place known as the boathouse and hides a dangerous past that comes back to haunt her. As the last of her kind, Aurora is being hunted and now so is her daughter Alma. To survive, she will need to master her powers and fight for those she loves.

From the developer, Inusuku, comes a fun-filled expansion DLC for the hit game Living With Sister: Monochrome Fantasy!

This expansion DLC adds a ton of new content, and some quality of life features.
Features:
- Many Additions to the Main Story and Side Events
- New Quality of Life Features Including an Album
- New Art

An immense beast walking, someone who is not you sleeping in a house - things you've seen, heard, the last piece of a strawberry that you must remember to keep existing.

Wake Up Magical Girl

To bring death and destruction upon this dying world. Drench the land with bodies and flood the rivers with blood. Fill the void of your frozen heart with vibrant colors and infinite beauty caged inside.

It's a megawad composed of short maps, where every map has death exit. Will you find it in your heart?

description: An oniric walking-simulator ﻿tribute to TNT: Evilution ﻿﻿

description: Paradise Up Above: Gold Label Edition comes with 18 total maps tak﻿ing place in beautiful tropical locales, majestic skybound islands, Heavenly hot-spots, and the sinister shadow of Hell that eternally follows Doomguy wherever he goes, even in his journey for a peaceful place to rest his weary hands.

description: Croak Cafe: From Pond to Plate is a thrilling roguelike game where you craft dishes under time pressure to serve demanding frogs. Upgrade your skills and face challenging bosses in this fast-paced culinary adventure. Can you become the ultimate chef?

title: Spellsided

You need to play the role of a fleet commander in the field to make money for the company , just try to survive in these miserable times. Fortunately, you have friends, life goes on.

description: An adventure game that combines first person shooter and Roguelite random elements. Players can manipulate heroes with different abilities in the game. Embark on adventure challenges in random levels. Every time you respawn, you can unlock new skills and equipment to challenge stronger enemies.

In addition to your choices, there is also the random element of chance that may affect your fate. Due to the constraints of the game engine, can only be viewed in windows mode.

title: Project X: Light Years
description: A modern reimagining of the classic Amiga side-scrolling shooter. Engage in high-octane space combat as you navigate through visually stunning environments, obliterate swarms of enemies, and upgrade your arsenal to become the ultimate space fighter pilot.

description: Survive against zombies in this turn-based tactical roguelike. Outsmart your enemies in fast-paced battles using different weapons. Pick rewards and power up your character to conquer increasingly challenging levels.

Obtain all the stars with the fastest times to surpass the other competitors! How fast will you rush back to the kitchen?

description: Drive out is a horror game for up to four players in online co-op. As a member of a Ghost Exorcism Agency, accept commissions and, together with friends, travel to various locations to investigate, find ghosts, and exorcise them.

title: Floor 9: Beginning
description: In Floor 9, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious hotel known as "Hotel Liminal." To escape, you must identify anomalies on each floor. These anomalies can be anywhere - on the ground, in paintings, or even right in front of your eyes.

title: Project Heck
description: This is a casual and entertaining typing game that lets you experience the thrill of hacking systems by rapidly typing on your keyboard. Whether stress-testing your keyboard or unwinding after a tough day, this game has got you covered!

title: Five Nights At Skibidi Toilets
description: FNAST offers a unique gameplay that combines elements of strategy, survival and horror. Will you be able to solve the mystery of this mysterious building and prove the truth of the information from the newspapers?

title: Stars Commander
description: This is a game set in space and focused on trade of resources between spaceships and space stations.

title: Norowareta: The Three Treasures
description: Embark on a chilling journey as a young woman uncovers her past, answering the call of a tormented soul. Explore an isolated shrine in Japan and be transported back to the Edo period. Navigate through the mysteries and terrors of a fateful night in this spine-chilling horror survival game.

title: Made in Tower
description: Go up to the 100th floor！

title: Lumen Inferius
description: Explore a haunting and punishing world in this 2D action RPG. Lumen Inferius combines fast-paced combat with intricate RPG mechanics. Traverse ancient ruins, dark forests, and decaying castles, uncovering secrets of a cursed land. Your skill and strategy will determine its fate.

title: High Impact
description: First Person Shooter with very detailed worlds. It includes Platforming and rooms with Puzzles that you need to solve in order to advance.

title: Creeping Dusk
description: Creeping Dusk is a tower defense game. Build a town around an abandoned gold mine and defend against monsters that swarm the area. Fortify your defenses, and prepare for the increasingly challenging nights. Will you be able to protect your town from the encroaching darkness?

title: Supermarket Together
description: The multiplayer supermarket has arrived to your neighbourhood for free! Stock your shop space, unlock perks and franchises, hire employees or chase those pesky shoplifters. The more players, the more action!

title: California Escapades
description: In this simulation and adventure game, explore 19th-century Gold Rush California. Join Jim and Emma to build and manage your farm and city. Plant crops, raise animals, construct buildings, complete missions, uncover secrets, and collect treasures. Start your adventure now!

title: Business Simulator 2026
description: In Business Simulator 2026, you start with a small capital and aim to build a business empire in the city by deciding which business to start in which shop and deciding the prices. Business Simulator 2026 is a business simulation that will test your business acumen and strategic planning skills.

title: Backseat
description: Backseat is a horror game where you play as a taxi driver forced to transport sinister passengers and survive the ride. An unknown man has kidnapped your wife and demands you gather information on each passenger. Can you survive the night and uncover the mystery behind your wife's kidnapping?

title: Cinema Simulator 2025
description: Cinema Simulator 2025 is a simulation game where you will manage your own movie theater and test your strategy and management skills. Starting from a small movie theater, try to become a giant in the movie industry.

title: Roadlike
description: Roadlike is a roguelike arcade racing game combining classic high-speed thrills with procedurally generated tracks. Customize your car with upgrades and enjoy endless replayability, racing solo or with friends in local multiplayer!

title: Azooma Escape
description: Hide. Dodge flying slippers. Avoid that "ONE" uncle determined to feed you. Your mission: escape Uncle's celebration alive and unfed. This culturally rich stealth comedy follows an introverted teen fleeing the world's most persistent hospitality. Can you survive the family gathering?

title: DuaLight
description: In this challenging cyberpunk platformer switch between day and night environments, go through dangerous obstacles by manipulating gravity and time. Upgrade your abilities to conquer these levels with an intense soundtrack. Are you ready for the ultimate adrenaline rush?

title: Nordhold: Origins
description:
Immerse yourself in Nordhold: Origins, a tower defense game with high replayability. Build a medieval Nordic village, develop its economy, and defend it with unique towers and upgrades. Choose heroes and relics, compete on leaderboards, and aim for the Valhalla rank!

Nordhold: Origins is the Prologue Game for the full Game "Nordhold".

title: Himegashima Island
description: Kokomi is sent to the island of Himegashima, where his cousin demands that he spend his summer making happy memories. Having grown up sheltered, there's a whole new world of things for Kokomi to experience.

title: Nyaz
description: A dungeon crawler for cats that even beginners can play.

title: Multiversal Time Survivors
description: Classic Spin on Survivors Genre. Choose one among many characters and Travel though multimple dimensions battling foes.

title: Black Hole Survivor
description: A physics based twin-stick shooter about surviving as long as possible and getting a high score. Use your gravity beam or your gravity mine to destroy endless waves of enemies situated around a black hole.

title: Pretty Agent
description: Urgent mission! According to reliable intelligence, the female drug Lord Miss S is hiding in the city's X hotel. In order to avoid causing unnecessary panic, please play as female agent 33 to the destination to execute secret arrest!

title: Survivor Company
description: Survive waves of WWII enemies with your squad in this 2.5D roguelike. Use support & assault cards to amp firepower. Time's ticking, make your stand!

title: Undivine
description: A dark metroidvania with RPG elements, "Undivine" challenges you to explore, battle, and uncover secrets in a desolate, interconnected world. Customize your abilities, wield unique weapons, and delve into deep lore filled with mystery.

title: Penguin Panic!
description: A penguin's life is never easy. Even more so when you're a penguin mother, looking to protect her eggs. Penguin Panic is a cute platformer and features simple controls, secret challenges and cheerful graphics. A fast-paced action game that no one will want to put down.

title: Ice Cream Wars
description: A madcap arcade driving game in the unexpectedly cut-throat world of the frozen confectionary distribution industry. Race against the clock (and Gelatoni's henchmen) to provide the residents of Rippleton with the sweet frozen treats they're craving.

title: Globe Games
description: A suite of turn based games and puzzles on a spherical grid: Chess, Go, and Othello.

title: Hot Springs
description: Immerse yourself in the warm waters and relaxing atmosphere of Japanese's Onsen

title: False Mall
description: You have wandered into an infinite looping shopping mall in Japan. If you notice changes within the mall, you might be able to escape.

title: Myst of Guatemala
description: Experience this first-person horror game in a tiny Guatemalan home. As a journalist, you investigate a mysterious villa after your long-lost friend Eddie calls. Grim halls, monsters, and rusty mailbox blood await. The four chapters include spooky stories, jump scares, and difficult riddles.

title: The Sunday
description: The Sunday is a short walkthrough horror game where the idea of being alone will hunt you, until the drakness settles in your brain. The line between reality and nightmare is razor thin.

title: Ship on Wheels
description: Welcome to Ship on Wheels, an exciting arcade racing game! Easily join the official seasons or create your own custom tracks. Players can also design unique arenas with mini-games. Dive in and start racing!

title: Womb Defense Force
description: Run and gun your way deep into the neo-humanoid territory and save mankind from its own creation! Fight as special ops commander Layla in this mutant blasting weapon rich 2D action sci-fi shooter!

title: Sex Airlines
description: Welcome aboard SEX Airlines - an adult visual novel where you shape the story of professional pilot Arthur and people around him!

title: Sex Massage 2
description: Enter the captivating world of the visual novel SEX Massage 2 , where you take on the role of Daniel, a talented masseur and owner of a small massage parlor. Daniel is determined to elevate his business to new heights, but the path to success is filled with challenges and temptations.

title: Merge Donut
description: Merge Donut is a delightful clicker game where you click on Donuts! Every 3 and 18 hours, receive a surprise Donut to grow your vibrant collection. Can you gather them all?

title: Forest Heroes
description: Forest Heroes combines defense gameplay with roguelike deck-building. Enjoy intense battles and diverse strategies with simple controls!

title: Futanari Sex Adventures: Episode 2
description: This is an adult visual novel series featuring a stunning red-haired futanari as the protagonist. In this episode, the story unfolds at a luxurious spa center.

title: Lizards Must Die 2
description: Lizards Must Die 2 is a cooperative slasher action game, a high–quality continuation of the SENSATIONAL first part. Insidious lizards attacked the lands of the Rus again. HYPERBOREA is on fire and only the GLORIOUS HEROES can lick the invaders from their homeland.

title: Magic the Wandering
description: The Lemmings roguelike. Magic the Wandering is a puzzle platformer where you learn spells, discover powerful wizards, and build your party to guide them through the world.

title: Escape Gaia
description: you will play as Gaia, the shattered will of a planet, and command your spaceship to explore new worlds, collect and refine various resources, build a home on the damaged spacecraft, summon a wide range of monsters, and ultimately, devour other shattered wills to repair yourself.

title: Esoterica Order
description: Drop in take on the challenge, in this third person shooter. The odds will be against you and continue to not be in your favor. Good luck Phantom.

title: Overnight Watch
description: As a new hired employee of Paranormal Security you need to monitor live surveilance cameras and report any anomaly you can find. Can you find them all and will you survive?

title: Queen Slayer
description: 'Queen Slayer' is a turn-based RPG set in a fascinating fantasy world. The player must lead heroes of various professions and skills to defeat the powerful queens who dominate the underground dungeons and save the kingdom from darkness.

title: CardScrawl
description: Enter the Chaotic Tower and take part in the Tower Lord's gambit in this Auto Battler, Roguelike Deckbuilder. Wielding the power of your Creature and Enchantment decks, the limits of your strategy will be tested. The Tower Lord awaits a worthy opponent. Are you ready?

title: Nezha Crossing the Sea
description: With more arms and weapons, you will be able to defeat many opponents at the same time - this game will bring you a unique multi-arm combat experience.

title: Stellar Checkpoint
description: Inspect alien documents as Earth's first interstellar border agent. Verify passports, detect forgeries, and make crucial decisions that impact human-alien relations. Can you keep Earth safe while navigating complex intergalactic regulations?

title: Spellarium 11
description: Play Match3 Puzzle and return the dying world back to life!

title: Dark Era
description: A Game set in post-apocalyptic world where an alien virus has taken over, kill the infected ones ,Survive their attacks , clear the levels to complete the game. There are currently two game modes one is level based and another is Arcade mode.

title: Nerl's Crazy C"rough"t!
description: A falling block merge puzzle game starring the wizard Nail. Drop blocks from above and evolve them... but there are three evolution paths! Each block has a freshness level, and if left unattended, it will turn into trash!?

title: Peech World
description: An action - packed turn based bullet hell RPG. Explore and save a vibrant world!

title: Hero of the Hive
description: Take flight in this casual adventure game as a bee on a mission to save your crumbling hive. With the Queen mysteriously missing, it's up to you to gather resources to rebuild, explore the vast basin, and embark on quests to help the animals of nature as you become the hero your hive needs!

title: Super Dungeon Muncher
description: Avoid becoming Muncher's next meal in this fast-paced adventure! Control your anger, this game is hard!

title: Small Maze
description: Through maze after maze

title: Campgrounds Adventures
description: Campgrounds Adventures: The Big Oopsie is a captivating time management and strategy game where you build and manage thriving campsites. ️ Balance tasks, develop strategies, and progress through levels filled with lush landscapes and bustling campsites. Dive in and start your adventure today!

title: A Pair of Feathers Squawk Together
description: "A Pair Of Feathers Squawk Together" is an easy-to-play, challenging-to-beat platformer inspired by the likes of Jump King and Bread & Fred. Flap the Parrot only has two controls: a right flap, to flap to the right, and a left flap, to flap to the left. As you get higher up the island, you'll encounter new regions with new gimmicks and traps to be wary of. Avoid getting sent back to the ocean down below, and find the treasure at the peak!

title: Cats-Shaped
description: Cats-Shape is a clicker game, in which you click on a cat shape!Earn random cat shapes to grow your collection!Come hang out with us and let's become the kings of cat shapes!

title: Naals Tales
description: Hook into a physical platforming adventure with Scark'Tee, a fearless Naal who dwells on the inhospitable moon of Naltiune.With his long tail, Scark'Tee swings, fights, and slides through perilous environments, helping his friends and facing unique challenges.

title: Isle of Reveries
description: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve head-scratching puzzles, and fight dangerous enemies in this retro-inspired action adventure.

title: End Gate: The Last Passenger
description: You wake up, alone, in a hypersleep box, with no memories left. You find yourself in an enormous space station, orbiting with a strange asteroid, around a gigantic black hole. And now, it's time to search, everywhere, to understand who you were. And most importantly, what's left to do here.

title: Surrounded by Death
description: Lead your people, fight for survival, become their ruler in this 2D strategy game. To accomplish this, you will have to create powerful walls, an efficient economy and a strong army

title: The Good Colony
description: A co-op horror about investigating and recording aliens. Turn in your recordings to the Colony for a reward. You keep the recordings you make whether you die or survive.

title: Nightmare Within
description:
Nightmare Within is a first-person psychological horror where fear is born within the protagonist’s mind. A house, familiar from childhood and youth, gradually loses its logic: light behaves strangely, objects come to life, and the past seeps into the present.

The game focuses on atmosphere, psychological tension, and storytelling through the environment.

title: S.X.E. Slider: Dungeons
description: A dungeon inspired sliding tile puzzle game featuring 25 gorgeous images with a fantasy theme.

title: Snowfall Symphony: A Tale of Crustallus
description: Immerse yourself in a captivating visual novel set in a dark vampire world where romance and cruel decisions shape your fate, leading to multiple unique endings.

title: Make It Count
description: Make It Count is a post-apocalyptic, top-down shooter with roguelite elements. Venture into different missions with randomized routes and bring carnage to the filth that is infesting this world!

title: Dropped into the Modern World: Surviving the Red-Light District
description: After an attack by a monster, the sorceress Daiya suddenly gets teleported to modern-world Kabukicho! Without a home and all alone, she gets offered shelter by a person named XiaoHong. With their help, Daiya is able to start a new life, but can she return to her home world…?

title: Pan Beats
description: Cute simple rhythm game! All you have to do is press the falling notes in time with the rhythm! The game can be enjoyed by both sound game beginners and those who are familiar with sound games, with familiar songs and three different difficulty levels. Please try to play this game!

title: Master of Shotgun Camper
description: Hey Corner Campers! "Master of Shotgun Camper" is designed for you to perfect the art of corner camping and pre-aiming.

title: Ninja: Shadow of the Dash
description: Ninja: Shadow of the Dash is a fast-paced 2D speedrun platformer where you race against the clock to finish challenging levels as quickly as possible. With precise controls and high difficulty, only the best gamers can master it. Test your skills and aim for the fastest times!

title: Gourds Up
description: Gourds up is a 2D shooter, with many roguelike-y elements. You will progress through runs by choosing the next rooms, through the form of cards, that you will fight in, allowing for more strategy during the run. Get random weapons and upgrades, and just don't die!

title: Find it! Festival in the Hotel
description: We are holding the Find it! festival in the hotel! Walk around the rooms and search for hidden items. In rooms filled with many things, can you find the items you're looking for? Enjoy 10 different themed rooms.

title: Tennistronic
description: Increase your reflexes by hitting the ball that reaches higher speed with each bounce, and at the same time give it spin to score a goal to your opponent.

title: Greengrocer's
description: Greengrocer's is a clicker game where you click vegetables! In Greengrocer's, you click vegetables to gain even more vegetables! For every 3 clicks, you get a new vegetable! You will also receive extra vegetables for the time you spend managing your Greengrocer's.

title: Cyber Hearts Club
description: Cyber Hearts Club is an immersive game where players enter the virtual world of the Social Media Club. In this game, you'll have the opportunity to study and navigate the fascinating intricacies of social media, encountering various challenges and characters that enrich the experience. Throughout your journey, you'll make important decisions and discover new ways to interact with the digital community. Cyber Hearts Club blends captivating storytelling with a deep exploration of social media phenomena, providing an UNFORGETTABLE gaming experience.

title: Circuit Runner
description: Circuit Runner is a fast-paced cyberpunk game where you collect resources to escape a dystopian tower. Use active and passive skills to outwit enemies and overcome obstacles. Compete on Leaderboards for ultimate bragging rights in this thrilling race for freedom.

title: Riftcast
description: A cyber companion for your desktop inspired by LCD virtual pets of old. Collect, train and fight all sorts of Reverians as you take on daring ventures, fun mini-games and fierce battles.

title: Raceborn
description: Raceborn is a racing game featuring miniature cars in diverse locations with extensive vehicle customization options. Win races, earn upgrades, and showcase your creativity to become a racing legend.

title: Lullaby Data
description: Follow the story of Lullaby and Echo in a futuristic world. Mixing action and adventure, meet many unusual characters, play numerous mini games, and explore space to discover the secrets of Lullaby and the mad gods.

title: Level Up 80
description: LEVEL UP 80 is an action game with magic and shooter mechanics, where a lone knight must level up from 1 to 80 to defeat a massive orc army. Utilize various spells and weapons to protect peaceful lands from invaders.

title: Skidaddle Skidoodle
description: Skidaddle Skidoodle is a single-player arcade game about a small forest gnome mage who protects the forest from evil creatures with magical spells, restoring harmony and balance to nature.

title: Hue Hop
description: Hue Hop is a visually captivating color-matching game in a minimalist isometric world. Navigate a luminous circle across a grid of colorful rings, aligning matching colors to score points. With intuitive controls and a competitive scoring system, it offers a relaxing yet challenging experience.

title: A Room You Can't Exit Unless You Find the Numbers
description: You have been trapped in a room you can't exit unless you find the numbers. Let's find the numbers inside the room and escape.

title: Get Rich
description: "Get Rich" is a thrilling 2D roguelike shooter that plunges you into a corrupt metropolis teeming with danger and intrigue. Join the quest to get revenge and justice in a city riddled with corruption.

title: Iltami
description: 2D Fantasy game. Chill and easy to play or fast and difficult..? The GREEN circle is for play, the BLUE circle is for controls. Collect all the birds and reach all the levels as fast as possible. Have fun! It goes well with red wine or cold beer...

title: The Ninja Gaiden as Interpreted by MiniMacro Sound
description: This is a from-the-ground-up reimagining of the first Ninja Gaiden NES game. All of the levels are redesigned from scratch, the soundtrack is entirely remixed and there are new graphics.

title: Wuthering Waves: Thaw of Eons
description:
Version 1.1 of Wuthering Waves, which included:
• New characters: Jinhsi and Changli
• New location: Mt. Firmament
• New companion story for Changli (Immortal Blaze)
• New echoes, events and more!

title: A G-G-Ghost!
description: A point-and-click adventure about a man exploring a spooky mansion. Contains 1(one) ghost.

title: Mental Salvo
description: Mental Salvo is a top down art game with an infinite open world where you can explode your head and do so many other things, they're impossible to list. It will tickle your brain in various ways. You can spend hours walking and interacting and keep stumbling upon new things. Follow your curiosity.

title: Transmute Syndrome
description:
You have been detained by the Stellar Coalition Police Department for carrying a dangerous disease known only as "transmute syndrome". This condition is said to give the infected an unnatural ability to morph themselves into identical copies of other living beings. However, what they don’t know is that it only applies to inanimate objects, and where you come from, the ability is just as natural as breathing to you. Do you think you can escape?

Transmute Syndrome is a stealth / puzzle game featuring a total of 9 levels across three different areas, numerous copyable objects, fully recorded voice lines as well as a unique soundtrack. The game was developed over a course of 2 weeks for the Pirate Software Game Jam 15.

title: Beer Drinkin' Terrorist Hunter
description: Beer Drinkin' Terrorist Hunter is challenging, fast-paced, 2d shooter. Inspired by games like Wolfenstein 3d, Doom, and Duke Nukem. Fight your way to downtown by collecting and unleashing a full arsenal of 2d weapons. Visit places like the mall, downtown, and a factory. Fight on highways, in warehouses, and on rooftops. Shoot a variety of enemies including bosses.

title: Destiny Encore
description: A frenetic third-person shooter with roguelite elements and a large skill tree.

title: Galaxy Idle Clicker
description: Embark on an interstellar journey with Galaxy Idle Clicker! Conquer galaxies, upgrade your spaceship, and face off against a myriad of enemy ships. With engaging minigames, powerful upgrades, GIC delivers an unparalleled idle space adventure. Join the cosmic conquest today and dominate the universe!

title: Covert Operations
description: Covert Operations (sometimes shortened to Covert Ops) is a tactical military Doom II total conversion created by Black Shadow Software that requires the source port EDGE and reuses many resources in 1998's Twilight Warrior made by the same team. Covert Ops abandons DeHackEd patches and instead uses DDF to create custom enemies and re-loadable weapons. The WAD was an early showcase of EDGE features including 3D floors, colored lighting, translucent deep water, falling snow, and RTS action triggers.

title: Sclash: Joystick
description: Let's celebrate French video games together! Unlock a Games Made In France mask and weapon for use in the game.

title: Me & My Friend Pippa!
description: Make your mark as an aspiring adventurer by embarking on a journey to save King Elesio's missing Pippa in this charming bite-sized RPG!

title: Morriton Manor Stories: Nordic Whispers
description: A mystery detective game with RPG elements. Cursed by demonic forces, a mysterious island is trapped in a time loop. Leah Glessner, Private Investigator of the Supernatural, uses her unique gift of photographic memory to confront evil. Skill your character. Investigate. Solve the case.

title: Taboo Trial: 5.0 Weapon And Dark Gold
description: The DLC5.0 for Taboo Trail.After enabling this DLC, you can open 5.0 game content, which is independent of 4.0 saves and allows you to freely choose different modes for a gaming experience

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2: Sweet, Affectionate, and Devoted Long-lost Friend GP-02
description: "Long-lost Friend" is now compatible with the following content added in "CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP02." 1. Marriage system 2. Private maid mode 3. Empire life mode

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2: Sweet, Affectionate, and Devoted Long-lost Friend GP-01fb
description: "Long-lost Friend" is now compatible with the following content added in "CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP01fb." ・Sexy love date play ・Happy happy morning!

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2: Sweet, Affectionate, and Devoted Long-lost Friend GP-01
description: "Long-lost Friend" is now compatible with the following content added in "CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP01." 1. Empire Life Mode

title: Custom Order Maid 3D2&2.5+: X1+Vol.01
description: This DLC adds X1 compatibility for 5 personalities. You'll get to play special honeymoon events and yotogi as well as a Fishing minigame. Maids will now be compatible with the following events: 1. New Mode “Honeymoon Mode” 2. ”Honeymoon Yotogi” 3. ”NTR Honeymoon”

title: DayZ: Frostline
description: Embark on an unforgiving journey in DayZ's Frostline Expansion, set within the icy Sakhal archipelago, covering 83km² of winter wilderness. Face new challenges, manage the cold, and discover the beauty and peril of Sakhal. Coming Fall 2024. Prepare to survive.

title: Deck Dash
description: Create your deck, improve your cards by merging them, and defeat all your opponents. To be a survivor, don’t forget this; collect the best items you can find and upgrade them. Exciting duels await you on this island.

title: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown: Ford GT 2006
description: Inspired by the famous 1960s Ford GT40, the 2006 Ford GT pays tribute to the four-time winner of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. The design of this prestigious and high-performance car is reminiscent of its predecessor.

title: Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown: DLC Solar Content
description:
The Solar Content pack includes:
- Maserati MC20
- Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 1LE
- Board Committee Member outfit for your avatar
- Solar Crown sticker pack for customizing your cars

title: My Hobby: Needlework Galore - Tiny Home
description: Tiny and cozy Houses, Fantastic and beautiful now here, try to relax with calming Embroidery process DLC includes 20 artworks from Small to Large

title: My Hobby: Needlework Galore - Household
description: A sweet home requires care. You will find the coziest embroidery patterns here with relaxing Embroidery process DLC includes 20 artworks from Small to Large

title: Paper Nomad: Master Edition
description: All Paper Nomad Base features + Online game Hosting + Import\Export + XXL Maps

title: Sand Land: Custom Vehicle Colors - 3 Types
description: Customize vehicles with 3 special colors. Colors can be applied to all customizable vehicles.

title: Raven's Daring Adventure
description: Raven has challenged you to various games to decide which of you will have to complete humiliating dares. A Choose-Your-Own-Adventure ENF-Themed game with over 1,700 3D Images and voice acting. Also includes 'Raven's Daring Trivia Night' and 'Alice'

title: Unicopia
description: Unicopia is a retro 2D platformer featuring a Unicorn racing to rescue her girlfriend from the clutches of an Evil Poodle. Jump up and down towers, collect gems, and reveal the key before the clock strikes and you're haunted by the ghost of time!

title: Sugar Rush
description: Enter the sweet world of Sugar Rush, an action packed top-down roguelike filled with sweets and treats to empower your journey. Test your skills by facing various fruit snacks, defeating them with color instead of damage. Find the best set of treats to survive as long as possible!

title: Zoe The Exhibitionist
description: Zoe has locked herself out of her house...naked. Your job is to help her make the right choices that'll lead her to clothes without being seen by too many people in a Choose-Your-Own-Adventure ENF-Themed game with over 1,700 3D Images and voice acting. Includes 'A Night With Itsuki'

title: Minecraft: Tetris
description: Dig into the strategic world of the Tetris DLC for Minecraft, where classic 2D Tetris meets the blocky adventures of dungeon crawling! Make your way through the matrix dungeons, battling colorful Tetrimonsters and unearthing pixelated secrets. With two different gameplay modes, iconic character customizations, this is Tetris like you’ve never known it before!

title: E-FCC
description: Immerse yourself in the action with E-FCC, the official Fast Close Combat video game, now available on Steam! E-FCC brings you a realistic airsoft simulation experience, based on the innovative sport of Fast Close Combat (FCC). Take on your friends or other online players in intense 1-on-1 duels where every hit counts.

title: Over Tooned
description: A game done in a GenX arcade style with an anime-ish feel

title: The Verbose Vault Venture
description:
The Verbose Sky Vault has opened for business recently, specialising in securing various high-value objects. A multi-layered security system operates at all times with an additional five-factor authentication containment unit protecting the main vault. Your client has become particularly interested in a small safe that was deposited here not long ago.

Your mission is to infiltrate the Verbose Vault, traverse the many layers of security, retrieve the safe and finally escape. Due to the highly secure nature of the vault, no alarm defuse boxes were located on site. Extreme caution is advised.

title: ACB Studios
description:
A TV studio themed level with multiple studios and hub-ish elements
also including many secrets and a few simple puzzles.

title: Atlas Fallen: Reign of Sand
description: In solo or co-op, experience Reign of Sand, the ultimate version of Atlas Fallen. Ride the sands of a timeless land and defeat legendary monsters in spectacular Action-RPG combat using devastating powers.

title: Tobichiyon X
description: Tobichiyon X is an Azumanga Daioh fan-game featuring Chiyo as the protagonist and Chiyo-Father as every enemy encountered in the game. It is a shoot-em-up primarily drawing inspiration from Ikaruga. The scoring system follows the player collecting star drops from enemies killed, these stars double as points and also bomb usage. Players must collect stars one after another without allowing them to fall off-screen to chain points together, doubling until the player reaches the star cap before resetting. It is vital that the player carefully chooses which enemies to kill as killing the wrong enemy will lead to stars falling out of reach, thus resetting the counter. Certain mini-boss like enemies will drop 3 stars upon death, with each star retaining the current score multiplier.

title: Intrigue Inc.: Raven's Flight
description: A legendary secret agent has gone rogue and Intrigue, Inc. needs you to track him down. Uncover Raven's diabolical plan and foil his grasp for power and glory in this exciting Hidden Object Puzzle adventure game. Take on Raven's incredible intellect and think two steps ahead to capture him before he takes over the entire planet in Intrigue Inc.: Raven's Flight

title: Apogea
description: Apogea is a medieval fantasy massively online multiplayer role playing game.

title: Balocks
description: Balocks is a casual arcade game made for people that enjoy arrenging pieces without leaving spaces with a twist, you move all the pieces at the same time!

title: Orange Blossoms
description: Finish a Project, Deal Catnip, and Find Love?! [BL]

title: Divine Trials
description: Will you choose your angel... or your devil?

title: The Shuddering
description: Lose yourself in a lonely entity's embrace...

title: Banana & Tomato
description: Banana & Tomato is a clicker game, in which you need to click on magic Banamatos to gain even more Banamatos! Play longer and click more often to get more unique items! Welcome to Banana & Tomato world!

title: Rushdown Revolt: Nemesis The Torment

Animal articles have pictures, descriptions, and video clips. In addition a user can be tested with quizzes on the animals.

title: A South Sea Tale
description: A Short Story about Life and the Ocean

title: GeoRunner
description:
You are a member of the Blit Rescue and Tracking Squad (BRATS). Your unit's mission is to rescue Blit whenever he gets captured, which is basically his job. Blit skateboards, crashes, and ends up in a cage. In order to free Blit, you must find a number of keys scattered across different countries in a region. To obtain the keys, the game tests your geographical knowledge.

GeoRunner prompts you to select a region of the world (North & Central America, South America, Africa, etc.) and to configure a skill level. The skill level determines a number of settings:* The difficulty of the clues. Early levels simply tell the player to visit a certain country. Later levels challenge the player on capitals or even trivia related to the country.

title: Mystery Boxes
description: Mystery Boxes are strange, ancient artifacts that transform numbers according to their individual rules. Your goal is to figure out these rules and use them to trigger a specific transformation that will unlock the box.

title: Spectre Divide
description: Spectre Divide is the genre-evolving, competitive 3v3 tactical shooter driven by Duality. Use Duality to control two bodies in real-time, letting you defend two sites at once, cover your own cross, or even trade yourself. Master tactical gunplay and an arsenal of future tech to achieve infamy.

title: Melody's Melon Mania
description: Embark on a delightful free-to-play puzzle-solving journey with Projekt Melody in Melody's Melon Mania!

title: Gum Flesh
description: Gum Flesh is a turn based roguelike that takes place on the back of a celestial monster. Use your wits and fragile supplies to take on strange creatures and fauna on a planet where you are definitely not welcome. The air is different here. Your body is starting to change.

title: Sexy Girl Next Door: Virtual Valentine Sex
description: Meet and connect with various girls, engaging in conversations and building relationships. Customize intimate scenes with diverse animations, poses, and sounds. Tailor each character's appearance to your liking. Immerse yourself in a detailed and interactive virtual reality experience.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2: Renault Trucks E-Tech T
description: The Renault Trucks E-Tech T boasts impressive specifications, including a powerful 540kWh battery that enables it to cover up to 350 kilometres on a single charge when using a DC charger during a one-hour break.

title: Mortal Glory 2: Reign of Tyrants
description: Reign of Tyrants is an expansion pack to Mortal Glory 2. Dominate the tournament with new playable boss characters and discover powerful new items, skills and more!

title: No Ghost in Circus Caravan
description: It's a small... somewhat eerie circus caravan. Each round lasts a few minutes, leading to numerous endings. Unravel the mysteries and control the outcomes. In the end, you might just hold it in your hands...

title: Security Guard Sex: Episode 3
description: A visual novel series with animations about a guy working as a security guard: things get interesting when he catches two attractive women smoking in the restroom.

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Emote Expansion Set: Grab Bag
description: This pack includes new emotes for characters to use. • Try Your Luck • Eat Rice Ball • Dance • Umapyoi Legend 1, 2, and 3

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Character Expansion Set: Sandalphon
description: This set unlocks the new playable character Sandalphon and comes with useful items to get him started. • Supreme Primarch's Awe Sandalphon-Unique Sigil • Canaan Whitebloom x 3 • Azurite's Splendor x 10 • Ambrosia x 5

title: Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Character Expansion Set: Seofon
description: This set unlocks the new playable character Seofon and comes with useful items to get him started. • Spirit Edge's Rally Seofon-Unique Sigil • Supreme Weapon Essence x 3 • Damascus Ingot x 5

title: Cool Kid Cody: Season 3 - Episode 09
description: Season 3 Episode 9: Ascend Game! Cody gives the best kaiju fight of the millennium while Peter keeps tabs on the city below.

title: Payday 3: Boys in Blue Heist
description: The Boys in Blue Heist takes you to a New York City police station to steal back valuables falsely confiscated by corrupt police officers.

title: Hell Let Loose: Polish Parachute Brigade Uniform
description: The efforts and sacrifices of the 1st Polish Independent Parachute Brigade are unfortunately much overlooked or diminished in the recounting of Operation Market Garden. And so now you can enlist as the brave troops that fought at Driel.

title: PowerWash Simulator: Cruise Ship Sun Deck - Summer 2024
description: Cool off with sudsy, high-pressured water this summer in PowerWash Simulator’s latest Seasonal Special. Take a vacation from Muckingham’s mainland to clean up the sun deck of Crab Bay’s cruise liner following a messy departure.

title: The Spreader
description: Learn to master the art of spreading and compete for the best times in the online leaderboard to prove you are the master spreader in this groundbreaking, never-before-seen spreading experience. Develop new strategies and execute them perfectly to have a chance for a top spot.

title: Omni Blade
description: Omni Blade is an immersive and tactically challenging retro RPG inspired by classic games such as 7th Saga, Grandia, and Chrono Trigger.

title: Mewing Simulator
description: Funny clicker game in which you should increase your chin for becoming trully sigma. Upgrade your Brainrot and Gyat Size and etc for more score!

title: The Best Duck Clicker
description: A small clicker game about destroying ducks! Collect 25+ ducks, upgrade all your stats, and repeat!

title: Pixel Restorer
description: A retro pixel-style casual game where your task is to restore all the missing pixel images in the machine.

title: Coins
description: A F2P Coin collecting game. Get Coins to trade and collect!

title: Hamster Bomba
description: click click click

title: Rise of the White Sun: The Yellow Way
description: Near Anyang, an alliance between a Yellow Way master and a mysterious man claiming to be a ninth-generation descendant of the Ming dynasty has sparked an outright rebellion against the Republic.

title: Kimi ga Nozomu Eien: Enhanced Edition
description: "Kimi ga Nozomu Eien" returns as an Enhanced Edition! This legendary visual novel left fans emotionally wrecked for days after its release, and two decades later, its rollercoaster storyline still captivates hearts. Experience the romance that shook a generation!

title: Zebulon: A Lost Cat
description: Zebulon the cat is lost in a strange place, but he has a lot of courage and curiosity quickly replaces fear as he explores and unravels the world around him. It also helps that smelly green food is everywhere to grab!

title: Highrise City: Vacation Season
description: Vacation Season expands on the strengths of Highrise City and adds a new group of citizens to the mix. A group which needs to be satisfied as well: Demanding tourists.

title: Cursed House 4
description: A very unusual Match 3 Puzzle game with some unique features!

title: Play And Pray
description: Play And Pray is a clicker game where you can open as many loot boxes as you want. As you collect more items in your inventory, you'll unlock various achievements.

title: VBR Clash
description: VBR Clash is a challenging platformer where you must go through exasperating and sometimes maddening levels that requires skill and precision to complete. The different gamemodes will offers you different platforming experience to bring you one step closer to mastering the art of platforming.

title: Big City Dreaming
description: An open world visual novel filled with lots of intrigue and stories.

title: Gas Gas Heli!
description: The military's routine training flight has turned into a disaster, and now it's up to you to save the day!

title: Dadish Collection
description:
Three rad games in one!

He's a dad AND a radish! Join Dadish on his quest to rescue his missing kids in three classic platforming adventures. Dadish Collection combines Dadish, Dadish 2 and Dadish 3 in one rad package.

title: Love and Sex: Second Base - For A Fistful Of Waifu
description: For a Fistful of Waifu adds 3 new love interests to the roster of girls in Love and Sex: Second Base but that's not all! You also get a new date location and new scenes for every other girls!

title: Workplace Fantasy: Raina's Ending
description: Free update DLC No.1: Raina's new story and ending.

title: Angel Legion: Secret Gift - Purple
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: My Hobby: Needlework Galore - Vintage
description: Open Vintage world with relaxing Embroidery process DLC includes 20 artworks from Small to Large

title: Tower! Simulator 3: KONT Airport
description: Ontario International Airport (ONT) is a bustling transportation hub located in the heart of Southern California, just 35 miles east of downtown Los Angeles. Realistic modeling with over 50 custom modeled buildings, taxi signs, and amazing background scenery, buildings, roads developed by FeelThere.

title: Sonic x Shadow Generations: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The digital deluxe edition allows access to the game 3 days earlier, it also Includes:
-The Base Game + Digital Deluxe Season Pass:
-- An additional character skin and level for Shadow (releasing Holiday 2024)
-- Terios Skin
-- Extra BGM Pack
-- Digital Art Book + Soundtrack
-- Skill Points (Sonic Generations)

title: City Legends: The Witness in the Rye DLC
description: Armed with your wits and courage, step into the unknown and uncover the truths that lie hidden beneath the surface of Darkwood!

title: Scotland Yard: Hunting Mister X
description: Find Mister X in Scotland Yard’s trickiest case yet! Mister X has gone underground somewhere in London, and the only clues are the tickets he carelessly threw away. But where did he use them? Look! There! Was that a quick glimpse of him?

title: Mortal Kombat 1: Khaos Reigns Expansion
description:
Mortal Kombat 1: Khaos Reigns Expansion will include the Khaos Reigns Story Expansion and functions as the Kombat Pack 2 bundle, which won't be available separately.

The characters Noob Saibot, Cyrax and Sektor will be available when the expansion launches on September 24th while Ghostface (Scream Franchise), T-1000 (Terminator 2) and Conan the Barbarian will be available later on with a 1 week early access period as part of this package.

title: Crymachina: Trinity Set
description: A set of Trinity-centric content. Allows the following to be controlled as playable characters: ・Hayat ・Vida ・Can

title: Crymachina: Standard Uniform Set
description: A three-item set of school uniform costumes. Includes the following: ・Standard Uniform (Leben) ・Standard Uniform (Mikoto) ・Standard Uniform (Ami)

title: Violent Horror Stories: Anthology
description: 4 short horror games from different authors and in different genres. Each game is an author's vision on the theme of 'pursuit'.

title: When You See It
description: Search for 5 creatures across real photos in this hidden object horror game. Look closely at each image. If you see the creature, press spacebar before the camera changes. But be careful, if your face is too close to the screen, the jumpscares will be worse.

title: Never Stop Rolling
description: Never Stop Rolling is a single-player 2d platformer with a heavy focus on precisely timed jumps. Players will need to navigate through spikes, cannons, and more to reach the end.

title: Escape From Warehouse
description: The journalist goes to the warehouse to record a documentary, but becomes a witness to creepy stories. The guards and warehouse workers look very strange. What is really hidden behind the endless shelves and how not to become a victim of the warehouse?

title: Bàito
description: Are you looking for a fun couch game up to 8 Players? Challenge your friends to reach the final score! Vote each round for your favorite modifier! Endless possible maps and combinations! Use your creativity to defeat your opponents and climb the leaderboard! Get ready and "Fai del Bàito"!

title: Spinny Dungeon
description: The slot machine roguelike. Each time you hit the SPIN button monsters creep closer to you. KILL 'em! LOOT 'em! EAT 'em! Focus on spells or synergies between symbols. Spin to DIE... or spin to SURVIVE!

title: Ten Bells
description: You're trapped in an old English pub. Unravel a chilling tale by discovering anomalies while trying to escape. Confront the horror as you survive Ten Bell's endless loop.

title: Neighbors
description: A folk noir detective horror game. An old time detective trying to find out the truth behind a missing girl in a mysterious place.

title: Through the Galaxy
description: Immerse yourself in an unknown galaxy. Collect resources, upgrade your spaceship and experience an exciting mix of action and adventure with intense battles in a calm atmosphere. Discover new worlds and master challenges on your epic journey through space.

title: The Liminal Theory
description: What are liminal spaces? What happens when these places collide with each other? Dive into this third-person adventure to explore The Liminal Theory in unique environments like Backrooms, Pools & more. Encounter unique creatures born from Chaos and Limen.

title: J-Room
description: J-Room is a turn-based strategy probability game. Playable only with the mouse. Manipulate your opponent's action probabilities with cards. Swords are strong against guns, guns are strong against helmets, helmets are strong against swords. An eerie world set in old Japan. Escape from J-Room.

title: Rogue Titan
description:
Tactical Turn-Based Roguelike
Choose from 8 distinct Archetypes, each offering a unique blend of skills and playstyle, tailoring your Prometheus to your preferred combat strategy. Battle your way to Olympus in this tactical turn-based roguelike, where every combat is a deadly dance, and the world moves only when you do. As the Titan Prometheus, master strategic combat, upgrade abilities, and face mythic foes and permadeath in procedurally generated dungeons.

title: Three Alpha One Nine
description: A modern approach to platformers and adventure where speed, precision, and curiosity are not only required, but rewarded. As robot 3A19, jump, run, and boost your way through a wide range of locations throughout time and space.

title: Children of Saturn
description:
A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

CHILDREN OF SATURN blends first person adventure gameplay with real video recordings to tell an authentic slice of life story.

title: Scaler
description: Scaler is a 3d platformer adventure with unique mechanic that allows you to fully control your size/scale (i.e., to shrink and to grow). Use this ability to explore the game space and find a way to close the rift spheres that are metastasizing into our world.

title: Quiztopia: The Ultimate Trivia
description: Quiztopia : The Ultimate Trivia is Quiz Game for kids for age 5 and above. This game helps everyone to increase their knowledge by completing various different trivia challenges.

title: Forces of Ether
description: Blast your way through an Isometric Open World Galaxy. Fly seamlessly to space. Lead your chosen faction in ground and space battles. Stop the imminent Collapse of civilization... Or let it all fall into ruin.

title: Bee Hero: Bug Blaster
description: Bee Hero: Bug Blaster is an Action RPG Looter Shooter with a focus on build theorycrafting. Exterminate bug hordes, collect gold and items, level up, acquire new skills, upgrade your weapon and fight bosses.

title: Dawn of Survivor
description: A third-person survivor roguelike game where waves of zombies come at you. By killing them, you get random opportunities to acquire equipment, weapons, and new skills. You can have up to 8 skills, giving you immense power. Come and see how far you can go!

title: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian
description: This is a narrative role-playing game telling the story of a crown prince of the Blessed Arknian Empire. You possess great power, but are also burdened by duty. Can you change the world and stay true to yourself? Every decision comes with a cost.

title: Goooool!
description: Have you ever tried playing cards with a bear? But bears don't know how to play cards... That in this incredible game you will feel yourself in the role of a bear who is trying to play cards, but he does not succeed. All he can do is smash everything around and scream Goooool!

title: Exo Mayhem
description: Exo Mayhem is the ultimate supervillain experience! Fly, Shoot, Stab, Explode, and Traverse Paradise Mall, a lush multi-biome open world ripe for conquering!

title: Little Droid 2: Escape
description: "Little Droid 2: Escape" is a classic 2D (Metroidvania) side-scrolling pixel art adventure where you need to find a way to escape a mysterious planet.

title: Alchemist Shop Simulator
description: Conquer the arcane market in Alchemist Shop Simulator! Set up your very own magical store, full of wonders. Keep expanding your business! Experiment with ingredients bought or home-grown in your garden to brew potions for your quirky clientele. Buy low, sell high, make your store legendary!

title: Let Them Breathe: Selena's Awakening
description: Selena awakes in a dark and hot room where fire burns in stone ovens. She is told by her "roommate" she needs to find the key to unlock the door. Unlucky for Selena, she has to find many keys to unlock many doors all the while enemies lurk in the shadows.

title: Conspiracy Crew
description: A 3-10 player space station scavenging social deduction game. Will you be able to meet quota with your team? Or will you do everything in your power to sabotage them as the traitor?

title: Bloody Sky
description: This is a game where you defeat three bosses. The hero's challenge continues until all the bosses are defeated.

title: Loki's Revenge
description: Loki’s Revenge is a bullet heaven roguelite where you play as Norse gods fighting Loki’s army of monsters! Level up to gain powerful upgrades and explore the hand-crafted maps to find secret items. Build the ultimate overpowered god with permanent upgrades and master each god’s signature weapon.

title: Bazaar Simulator
description: Bring the traditional market experience to the modern world! Arrange vegetables and fruits on stalls and fulfill customer orders. Set prices, hire staff, and expand your market. Online orders, home delivery, and much more coming soon.

title: PirateWar
description: piratewar is an fps/tps game. Kill your enemies and win.

title: Say Cheese
description: Hunger speaks louder! Help our rodent hero find his way to the cheese in a maze full of challenges

title: Block Bot: Puzzle Journey
description: BlockBot: Shape-shifting puzzle adventure in a vibrant pixel world. Transform, solve, explore. Each level unlocks new potential. Perfect for quick plays or long sessions, offering unique challenges every time you dive in.

title: Ker-Chunk!
description: Kalva is a bit clumsy, losing all his catnip, but maybe, just maybe, this weird catnip-eating cave has some treasure in it.

title: Bunny Bunker
description: Bunny Bunker is a small game, mixing City Builder with Tower Defence, where your objective is to help the bunnies build a Bunny colony that is strong enough to send bunnies into space, inorder to escape the ever growing hordes that attack your Bunny Colony.

title: Angel Guardian
description: Angel Guardian is a side-scrolling action shooter where players take on the role of Kita, a warrior guardian, tasked with saving a prince from the forces of evil. Players can use action shooting, stealth, and hacking to defeat enemies and overcome obstacles

title: Mage's Legacy
description: Mage's Legacy: Explore the World of Magic

title: Blu-Dude In The Quest for Chocolate Milk
description: Blu-Dude in the Quest for Chocolate Milkis a whimsical and lighthearted puzzle game that invites players into a world of fun and silliness. Join Blu-Dude, a quirky sprite who loves to flap his arms, on a delightful adventure to find the ultimate treat—chocolate milk!

title: Pixel Collector
description: Collect Pixelart items! Get 1-4 tickets every 2 hours to spin the lucky wheel. Win pixelart items or higher rarity tickets! All items appear in your Steam inventory and are tradable/marketable, making it easier to complete your collections.

title: JetWireClimber
description: Mole Dad aims for the surface, flying around inside the cave! A flying-type climbing game.

title: Frontline Crisis
description: This is a top-down shooter with tower defense elements‘ set during the great war between insects and humans.

title: Dragon Clicker
description: Every click changes the color of your dragon, collect drops every 3 hours!

title: X Simulator Drone
description: Experience stunning drone realism with two difficulty levels. Fly two advanced drones across beautiful maps. Switch perspectives, including a controllable drone camera, for the ultimate piloting challenge.

title: Beach Secrets
description: Embark on a quest to uncover the "Beach Secrets"! This captivating 3D game lets you fly across the map and search for hidden objects, unraveling the mysteries and secrets of an enigmatic beach.

title: Sodablood
description: Chase pins as a bowling ball with dreamlike abilities in a surreal bowling alley.

title: Splort
description: Use your elastic hand to climb, push and fight your friends in this intense local multiplayer physics-based combat mayhem, across countless levels, with a huge variety of unique weapons at your disposal.

title: Refarm
