description: Alberto López Felisberto is a normal young man with a problem... Not being able to stop laughing at the most inopportune moments. Today, the event is his grandfather's funeral.

title: Boxcar Brats
description: Boxcar Brats is a wacky, top-down, multiplayer, "anti-racing" game. Your box car is out of control, so do everything you can do stay in last place! Swerve, skid and smash everything in sight to build up your brake meter and spin out your opponents! So hop into your boxcar, cause some mayhem and eliminate your buddies - nothing is off limits when you're a brat!

title: Donald Duck's Basics in Education and Learning
Donald's Basics in Hamburguers and Learning
Cenk The Chopper
description: Cenk The Chopper is a fast paced hack-and-slash game. Fight through hordes of mutants and robots in a world you've made go to hell. Chop 'em up everything you see till the end of it.

title: Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age S - Ultimate Edition
Thregnar and the Crystals of Chaos
description: Thregnar and the Crystals of chaos is a cute but challenging platformer where you take control of a ninja on a quest to save the world. Mastering his legendary dive kick is key to overcoming any obstacle.

title: Chernobylite 2: Exclusion Zone
description: Explore the mysterious open world of the Chornobyl Exclusion Zone in this post-apocalyptic action RPG adventure. Craft your story by facing sinister hazards and monsters. Survive furious encounters with the help of your crafted weaponry, developed skills, gathered teammates, and supported factions

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 5
description: Put your hands together for the next Festival Icon! Fresh off her historic stadium world tour, award winner and pop culture powerhouse Karol G brings her Latin sounds to the world of Fortnite in Festival Season 5.

title: Fountaintale
description: FOUNTAINTALE is a fan-made sequel to UNDERTALE, inspired by elements from it and DELTARUNE as well, adapting both games into a fresh and new experience.

title: Fountaintale: Chapter 1
description: One year after the events of UNDERTALE, Monsterkind has been adapting to their new lives on the Surface. The game begins on a very special day, Frisk's Birthday! After a very fun party night with their friends and family, Frisk is ready to end the day, though fate still had a gift of their own to give...

title: The Guardian Shift
description: The Guardian Shift is a whimsical adventure about a young guardian, awakened from slumber, who faces a series of perilous trials to fulfill their destiny of safeguarding the planet. Despite the daunting challenges, the guardian must rise to the occasion and protect the world. Go forth, Guardian.

title: Roadies: Unsung Heroes
description: Fast Paced Roadie "Simulator"

title: Gunzle
description: Gunzle is a game made in 3 days for the Nonejam 9. In the game you control Clover and you have to use your gun to pass trought the levels and reach the stars. As the game jam theme was genre mix the game is a mix of Gun and Puzzle.

title: Cargo Hunters
description: A third person shooter and extraction looter shooter which involves robots trying to survive rather than humans. A PVE and PVP shooter game with looting mechanism to build/craft gears in your Outpost. Gears and items can also be sold or bought from the market in your Outpost.

title: Halo Infinite: Operation Fleetcom
description:
This content update brings a bunch of additions and improvements to the game, including the return of two beloved modes from Halo 3 and Halo: Reach, a veritable swath of enhancements to Forge, major sandbox changes, a free new Operation Pass, and more.

The free cosmetic "operation pass" which launched aside this update ran from July 30, 2024 to September 3, 2024. It was made available in perpetuity to those who purchased the pass.

title: Mystery Trackers: Darkwater Bay
description:
Elephant Games presents the latest exhilarating installment of the Mystery Trackers series!

When a renowned scientist goes missing from the Poseidon research vessel, you're sent to investigate. You quickly uncover that there's much more to this expedition than simple research. A powerful and dangerous artifact awaits beneath the waves, and the Mystery Trackers aren't the only ones after it! Can you uncover the artifact's history and keep it from falling into the wrong hands? Find out in this thrilling hidden-object puzzle adventure game!

title: Save: Teaser - Before the Dawn
description:
Save Teaser: Before the Dawn

"SAVE Teaser" is a first-person survival psychological horror teaser game set just before a nightmarish search mission in ‘SAVE’. Players take on the role of a protagonist trapped on the 6,000-ton ship 'SENARA,' which is sinking due to mysterious phenomena. Experience the desperate escape process in this hyper-realistic real-life 6,000-ton ship 'SENARA,' and immerse yourself in a hauntingly realistic atmosphere of mystery and horror.

title: TrotMania: Aeternum Obscurum
description: TrotMania: Aeternum Obscurum is the third entry of the TrotMania series. It is primarily based around the fourth season of My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.

title: TrotMania IV: Euphorius
description: TrotMania IV: Euphorius is an unofficial My Little Pony rhythm game and the fourth entry in the TrotMania series. The game is focused on adding songs from the fifth and sixth seasons of the show, alongside various fan songs, putting over 100+ songs in this installment.

title: Godforged: Origins of Ozgalor
description: Godforged: Origins of Ozgalor is a story-rich, single-player Action RPG set in the world of Nelethar. Experience tactical combat, class blending, and kingdom ruling in a world besieged by a god, where your actions and choices shape the future of Ozgalor.

title: Portal: Google Translate Edition
description: This mod seeks to take the text, dialogue, and developer commentary of Portal, put it through varying amounts of languages in Google Translate, then put it back into English.

title: The Dreamers Foresight
description: Embark on a dreamlike journey as a ninja in this roguelite adventure, shaping your world with randomized biome tiles, align similar Tiles for better loot. Build a powerful deck from a variety set of cards while balancing your energy to battle relentless nightmare creatures.

title: Project: G-216
description: Project: G-216 is a Horror themed Observation Game, where you monitor the CCTV feed of a cursed place to check it for supernatural annomalies.

title: Portal 2: Google Translate Edition
description: As with previous works from BinkusTheTrinkus such as Half-Life: Google Translate Edition and Portal: Google Translate Edition, Portal 2: GTE aims to take all of the dialogue, text, and developer commentary of Portal 2, put it through several different languages in Google Translate, then put back into English. This fills the base game with a bunch of garbled nonsense that makes it nearly unrecognizable.

title: The Wanted Man's House
description:
In "The Wanted Man's House," plunge into the shadows of a slasher suspense, inspired by iconic horror films from the '80s and '90s. Take on the role of Mason, a daring adventurer in pursuit of fame, determined to break into the infamous residence of the sought-after killer known as "Baby Face."

The story unfolds as Mason, armed with courage and a camera, discovers that the location of the house has been inadvertently revealed by his own friends. His goal? Record every chilling moment to expose the terror in the city's newspaper. However, things take an unexpected turn when Baby Face returns home. Are you ready to face the nightmare?

title: Daemon Bride: Additional Gain
description: Daemon Bride: Additional Gain is an updated version of the 2009 Examu game, Daemon Bride, a game about people that have made contracts with demons or angels. The game features some of the traditional angel/demon contractor staples, such as a boy with a succubus and alluring female with a magic snake, but also some more oddball and unorthodox characters, like a gang member with an angry squid attached to his arm, and a dog with a bird form of Satan that follows him around. The cast is very balanced and a lot of fun to play with given their unique designs, tools, and play styles.

title: Umblight
description: Umblight is an Inscryption-like card game adventure where you're trapped in a dark, machine-filled room that changes as you go. Build your deck of shadow and light cards, make new cards by combining them and play mind-bending synergies as you try to defeat your dungeon master!

title: RetroRealms: Halloween
description: Step into the RetroRealms, a 16-bit Pixel Art world, and take control of classic horror icon Michael Myers! Fight your way across multiple levels of platformer action filled with sights and sounds inspired by the original Halloween film. Slice your way through Haddonfield, face-off in epic Boss battles against familiar faces from the movie, and overcome blood-soaked challenges in this intense retro throwback to classic arcade action!

title: RetroRealms: Ash vs. Evil Dead
description: Step into the shoes of Ash Williams from the Starz television series Ash vs Evil Dead in a horrifying new Pixel Art platformer! Wielding both his trusty chainsaw and 12-guage shotgun, play as Ash and battle Deadite hordes across multiple levels of 16-bit gameplay filled with enemies from the Ash vs Evil Dead series. Journey into the Dark Realm to overcome additional challenges and save humanity from the Necronomicon in this groovy throwback to classic arcade action.

title: Rex! Your Interactive Pet Dinosaur
description:
Dinosaurs aren't extinct. They can live, play and grow on your computer.

Nuture and care for Rex as you guide him through complete life-stages of infancy, adolescence and adulthood.

Teach Rex to play fetch, color cave paintings, sing, dance and more.

Explore 6 unique environments with Rex incuding caves, forests, deserts and more.

Watch as Rex grows and develops a unique personaility. Your interaction with Rex influences how he will behave and respond.

Own up to 5 different dinosaur pets - each with their own unique personality.

title: Fortress
description:
Me and my friends used to play a game called 'fortress'.

Fortress is a game made for GameMakerItalia Terroroctober jam. The jam theme was "Cut"!

title: Tasogare
description: Tasogare is an adult visual novel developed by Leaf and was originally released for PC on February 02, 2001.

title: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks: Stunt Mayhem
description: Packed with epic stunts and your fan-favorite monster trucks in action! You can smash, crash, and perform mind-blowing tricks across fantastical arenas in this adrenaline-fueled arcade adventure!

title: Dormant
description: The game's story is about the mental torture of an individual who lived in a hostile and isolated environment. Little issues with no way to vent build up until the victim lashes out.

title: Shattered Dreams
description: Do you hate your life? Well, boy, do I have the game for you! Follow the story of a social reject turned evil, soul-sucking CEO. Battle your inner demons, suppress workers' unions, and travel through space and beyond to increase your profit. But watch your step while getting off your ship.

title: Real Life Day: Threesome
description: "Real Life Day: Threesome" is designed for those who appreciate deep, realistic, and emotional stories. The game is perfect for fans of visual novels who are interested in relationships, life wisdom, and intimate moments.

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles - DLC 1
description: DLC 1: A Strange Fate includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles - DLC 2
description: DLC 2: The Fairy Queen’s Labyrinth includes new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content for That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime ISEKAI Chronicles!

title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime: Isekai Chronicles - DLC 3
description: This DLC includes a new Scenario, Character, Subquests, and Building Types content. Players can campaign through the Additional Scenario: Martial Arts Tournament, where they can liven up the party with the Additional Character, Milim. The game also features Additional Subquests, such as Valentines Day, Blumund Cooking Contest, Prepackaged Curry, and Beer. Additionally, players can sharpen Tempest with the inclusion of new Additional Building Types, including an Edgy Liquor Store, Edgy Tool Shop, Baron Goblin, Edgy Apartment Complex, and Edgy Armory.

title: Arderico's Journey
description: Arderico's Journey is an interactive fiction adventure that draws inspiration from the fascinating realms of fantasy tabletop RPGs and classic gamebooks, enriched with dynamic character interactions, meaningful choices, and content that reacts to your decisions.

title: Climbing with Silly Cat
description: Fun and difficult game about climbing with cute silly cat that rotate a lot! With 10 unlockable skins Game includes cute cat pictures! And you can meow!!!

title: Pixeplorer
description: Explore an infinite amount of pixelated worlds in this adventure sandbox game, and find villages, enemy camps, and quests along your journey!

title: Tetris Crush
description: A game of Tetris played with guns.

title: Organ Game: Merge Puzzle
description: When you hit the same organ, the organ will “evolve”! Evolve organs more and more to get bigger organs! The goal of the game is to get a high score so that the organs do not overflow from the beaker. Aim for the first place in the score ranking!

title: Erogoddess: Asgard
description: Erogoddess: Asgard is a dating simulator with feminized Norse gods. Odin, Loki, Thor and other gods are waiting for you. Discover new gods by spinning the wheel of fortune and go on dates with them, liberating them and undressing them. Add new goddesses to the gallery until you undress them all!

title: Raccoon on a Boat
description: Get unforgettable photos at the ultimate eco-learning park, Raccoons on a Boat. A boat ride at night is always fun.

title: Sticky Business: Camp Zinnias
description: With a vibe that mixes the energy of Camp Rock with the tenderness of Heartstopper, Sticky Business: Camp Zinnias is a lighthearted yet profound coming-of-age tale.

title: Dying Noise
description: Soramimi-Inspired Walking Horror GameDecipher the voices. Your survival depends on your ability to listen.

title: Get Down
description: Get Down to the deepest point, to this Game's Creator, to RESET his gone wrong game world and save its NPCs. WHY YOU? Because only the file called Player can execute the reset button. BUT NOTE: If you fall, there's no saving.

title: Daydream Mosaics 5: Crimson Veil
description: Rejoin Juliette and her companions in their quest to find Raven. Solve intricate nonograms, unlock mini-games, rebuild ancient sanctuaries, and lift the sinister curse that has befallen the Crimson World.

title: Land of Mushrooms
description: Dive into the Land of Mushrooms , where enchanting fungi come to life! Combine a delightful array of mushrooms, from the elegant Parasol to the flavorful Chanterelle, as you skillfully drop them into the pot.

title: Forget
description: Immerse yourself in a living nightmare where every dark corner of the apartment hides terrifying secrets. Wake up without memories, Pursued by an enigmatic presence, and discover the truth about a missing child. Reality or illusion? It's up to you to unravel the inexplicable.

title: Lord's Journey
description: The Lord's journey is a strategy-based large-army auto chess game, the great demon lord fell in love with the human princess at first sight, but the evil prince kidnapped the lord's beloved. In order to save the princess, the lord embarked on an expedition!

title: PokerBall
description: An all new block-based puzzle game, using Poker rules!

title: Goblin Quest: Remake
description: Goblin Quest:Remake is a ground up rebuild of our nonlinear fantasy game Goblin Quest. From playing the hero who saves the lands to the villain who destroys it, the world will adapt and respond to your actions. You decide your fate.

title: Girls on Campus, from Freshmen to Faculty, All Fall for Me!
description: In this exciting love interaction game, players act as a photography-loving sophomore who, after being knocked out during a shoot, finds themselves entangled in various indescribable scenarios with female seniors, juniors, and a married teacher!

title: Dog vs Cat Othello
description: Cute Growth-Based OthelloA growth-based Othello game featuring cute dog and cat characters. Flip your opponent's character and evolve my character into stronger one! Playable in both single-player and local two-player modes.

title: Comet Alpha Rescue
description: Comet Alpha Rescue is a sci-fi 2.5D real-time action/RPG game made in a retro, cartoon style art with comic book-style storytelling, customisable combat abilities allowing for various play styles, detailed character development and progression and interaction with the environment as you explore.

title: Imitation
description: A choice-driven adventure where you play as a young girl in a world where immortality is the norm. In this world, immortal humans are referred to as "Players." Your choices affect Stress and Affinity. Through multiple playthroughs, get closer to the hidden truths and endings.

title: Sonic.2017
description: This is a playable Subterfuge game created by Romeo-Hosting, based on the short animation by Coda.

title: Elevator Down
description: Judge the Fate of the Dead in this satirical, bureaucratic, decision-making game. Talk to Souls, check their documents, reference Holy Texts and decide if they're going Up or Down. Follow the Rules or trust your own moral compass and see where your choices take you - hopefully not the Elevator Down.

title: Apexaris Tower
description:
Climb your way up the dangerous Apexaris Technologies Tower for your only chance at a cure. Many have tried and failed, could you be the first?

Careful where you step you could possibly fall all the way back to the start! avoid the zappers in each section, they will zap you back to an unfortunate location.

Use your special high tech boots to traverse the tower with double jump/ Dash! combining those with upgrades like Hover, Triple Jump, and a Surprise!

Warning: Rage may follow

title: Snap Snap
description: SNAP SNAP is a first-person psychological horror game with an oppressive atmosphere and intense gameplay. Use your camera to escape the monster and solve some puzzles. Use the charge sparingly, as the battery may run out and while it is charging at the station... you are defenseless. The game has four endings. Will you be able to open them all? Beautiful graphics, oppressive atmosphere and high-quality sound will help you fully immerse yourself in the terrifying world of SNAP SNAP.

title: H2 Multiplayer Mod
description:
H2 Multiplayer Mod was a mod for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered (H1) that aimed to recreate the original Modern Warfare 2 Multiplayer experience with new twists. The mod featured a wide variety of maps, new progression, unique camos, remastered weapons, custom attachments, and more. The original MW2 killstreaks made a return as well, completely changing the way Modern Warfare Remastered feels and plays.

On August 15th, 2024, just one day before the mod was set to release, Activision Publishing, Inc. sent a cease-and-desist letter to the members of the H2M-Mod team, effectively rendering the mod defunct. While the mod team ceased all activity on the project, a playtester leaked a build of the mod, making it available to the public.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Limited Edition
description: The Limited Edition includes The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Deluxe Edition, "SSS Classified Files" Hardcover Art Book, "Anthems of Crossbell" Official Soundtrack (10 Select Tracks), "Special Support Section, Assemble!" Cloth Poster (17” x 24”), "Heroes of Zero" Acrylic Stand, Steelbook and Collector's Box.

title: Darkside Adventures: A Game with a Kitty 2
description: The arch-chancellor's vacation turns into a nightmarish metroidvania adventure.

title: H1-Mod
description:
H1-Mod is a modded client for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered. This client aims to provide a better-than-vanilla experience, with many quality-of-life features which are designed with gameplay enhancements in mind. The original game on Steam did not have a huge player base and is considered a forgotten Call of Duty. Also, the original game has so many game-breaking features that it is hard to play the original experience without facing a issue every so often.

With H1-Mod, new features include, but are not limited to: unlocked field of view adjustment, HUD safe area adjustment, detailed sensitivity adjustment, multiple fullbright modes, disabling of broken shader caching, unlocking all cosmetics, stat changing, uncapped max FPS, and a dedicated server browser.

title: A Game with a Kitty 3
description: Here's what happens when kitties go treasure hunting.

title: A Boney Night
description: It's just one of these nights for a witch... let's just get this zombie apocalypse over with and go back to bed, okay?

description: Sonic: After the Sequel - Omega is fan-made enhanced version of Sonic: After the Sequel.

description: The Digital Deluxe Edition includes the Base Game, Premium Cosmetic Set and Starter Set DLCs.

title: Believer Clubhouse
description:
Enter a world of Chaos.
Play minigames themed around the content creator Astral Spiff.

title: Scary Shadow Spot: Last Farewell
description: Scary Shadow Spot: Last Farewell - Haunted by his past, Mark explores a haunted house where nothing is as it seems. Chilling puzzles and shocking truths await. Are you ready to uncover the mystery hidden in the shadows?

title: The Knightling
description: The Knightling is a platforming action adventure where you play as an aspiring knight in search of their missing mentor, Sir Lionstone. Equipped with only a legendary shield, you’ll brave your way through the lands of Clesseia to become the unlikely hero.

title: Project_Structure_01
description: Project_Structure_01 is first-person exploration game focusing on atmosphere and exploration of surreal liminal spaces that feature brutalist architecture.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 12 - New Frontiers
description: Blast into action with Juno, the new Martian support hero, an intense Clash game mode featuring two new maps, divine mythic skins, and more.

title: Two Point Museum
description: Curate and manage incredible museums! Explore to discover amazing artifacts. Design and refine the layout, keep staff happy, guests entertained, donations plentiful… and children off the exhibits.

title: Silver Pines
description: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

title: Mushroom Season
description: Mushroom Season is a mushroom picking simulator! Customize your character and immerse yourself in the competitive world of mushroom picking. Explore rich forests filled with diverse mushrooms—some delicious, some deadly. Master the art of identification, tackle survival challenges, and engage in fun side quests. Drive vehicles to cover more ground and aim for the prestigious mushroom picking trophy. Ready to prove you're the best forager out there? Dive in and find out!

title: Jack in the Box
description: Your son found an imaginary friend. But you have no idea what terrors are you about to witness...

title: Take A Look Around
description: You find yourself in the middle of a nightmare in an endless warehouse. They are everywhere... Mannequins... Are they alive?

title: Baguette Wars
description: Dive into the hilarious and intense clashes of Baguettes Wars in Paris, with 40 captivating levels, a unique cartoon style, and a leaderboard to challenge your friends!

title: Haunted School: The Presence Behind You
description: Here's an even shorter version, around 150 characters: "Midnight School Terror" Trapped with 7 ghosts. 360° horror forces you to turn. Uncover pasts, make choices. Salt is life. Creepy figures lurk everywhere. Escape or become the 7th spirit?

title: IsoCraft Story
description: Isocraft Story is an isometric Minecraft-like sandbox game. Shape the infinite and procedurally-generated block world. Collect materials, play online, advance to higher tiers of tools and weapons, go deeper into the world and build a new spaceship to escape from this planet!

title: War Job
description: If there was the war between professions, which side would win? Chef, Cameraman, Police, Singer, Farmer or other professions…?Use silly weapons like a pan or a spade, balloon ,pencil, needle, chicken, buffalo... 20 different job Will create a chaotic surreal physics effects on funny match 5vs5.

title: Sex In The Block
description: In this exciting game, you explore a luxurious high-rise complex searching for beautiful women to flirt with. Win their hearts with your charm through fun mini-games. As they fall for you, they'll send amazing photos as rewards. Dive into this captivating world and become the ultimate flirt master!

title: Walking Steel
description: Fight epic tank battles, upgrade your vehicles and survive in dangerous conditions. Explore the world, find resources and fight enemies to become the best tanker. Join "Walking Steel" and prove your strength and tactics on the battlefield!

title: Neonova
description: As an Administration A.I. of a deep space probe, you're tasked with scanning and reporting back about a new galaxy. You'll weather cosmic events, witness oddities of the universe, and fly through points of interest to find answers for the base station.

title: Goodnight, Sweetie
description: One day, the protagonist begins to have strange dreams. He's chased by bizarre dolls, and the cozy attic from his childhood feels unrealistically large. He must navigate between dream and reality to understand why this happens. Always treat Teddy with respect; he loves you and remembers everything.

title: Kingdom's Architect
description: A medieval fantasy tower defense strategy game.

description: This game features a white little character riding a mount that can spew fire

title: Peach
description: In this world, simply being near or gently tapping one of my peaches ensures a fresh delivery to your Steam Inventory every 30 minutes. Embrace this future, and taste the excellence of natures blessing.

title: Devils Adventure
description: 2.5d Platformer where you control devil character. Mission to avoid traps and enemies and finish different levels and find skulls

title: Twizzle Puzzle: Dragons
description: Twizzle Puzzle: Dragons - is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime.

title: Tree Eater
description: Embark on a journey to restore a magical portal by helping a female centaur regain her powers! This game contains fetish themes such as: ass expansion, breast expansion, centaur weight gain.

title: Gladiator Of Valor
description: "Enter the arena in 'Gladiator of Valor,' a thrilling hack and slash adventure in the underworld colosseum. Play as Arcus, Zeus's son, battling fierce demons, orcs, undead, and mythical creatures. Face epic challenges and prove your might in this intense, action-packed journey for glory!"

title: Dinosaur Running
description: Dinosaur Run "is a casual parkour type single player game, where players control dinosaurs to escape modern civilization and the chasing tyrannosaurus rex, constantly running, crossing every obstacle and danger, and finally escaping danger. Let's start together with more friends.

title: Divine Light
description: This game is a shooter where players pilot a high-tech spacecraft through vast skies.

title: Difference
description: An officer who decided to take the subway home was trapped. Each time he returned to the same station, which is endlessly repeated, but something different from the original. You will need to detect and mark all the anomalies to get out.

title: Cursed House 5
description: An advanced Match 3 Puzzle game

title: Multiplayer Shooters
description: Multiplayer Shooters - A fast paced shooter game with lots of different game modes and weapons

title: Kour 64
description: KOUR 64 is a goofy 1st-Person Parkour platformer, inspired by Collectathon games from the late 90's. Explore a wacky dream world using a dreamlike depiction of parkour, meet funny characters and grab a bunch of loot in this short adventure.

title: Fighting Fantasy Classics: Armies of Death
description: Agglax the Shadow Demon is amassing an army of undead warriors to conquer Allansia. Can you defeat the nightmare horde of undead? Rally your troops and join a quest to seek out the special powers you will need to defeat the dark lord!

title: Cybernated
description: Near future, state security special agent E-9 is sent on the most difficult operation of her career - to track down and eliminate the head of terrorist hackers, however, in the process it turns out that not everything is as simple as it seems... Hack&slash adventure game.

title: Pantsu!
description: Experience the ultimate thrill of a 2D side-scrolling endless runner game, controlling your character to jump, dodge obstacles, challenge yourself for higher scores, and enjoy relaxing background music.

title: Marine Quest
description: Simple turn-based RPG where you make your way across different marine-based landscapes, fighting several harmful species or objects in a quest to save the ocean.

title: Danny Phantom: Ghost Sweep
description: Explore two huge 3-D levels in this frightfully fun adventure! New "toon-shaded" graphics! Be stealthy--sneak up on ghosts! Go to Phantom mode when attacked!

title: Sonic2.EXE
description:
An unofficial prequel to the Sonic.EXE creepypasta game.
It explains the events before the MY5TCrimson's Sonic.EXE game.

title: Just War Trains
description: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The objective is to outgun the opposing train with precise shooting. You can play with up to 24 people in WAR TRAINS!

title: Undertale: Wildfire
description:
Undertale Wildfire is a fangame and prequel to the RPG Undertale. In this game you play as the second human - the Bravery SOUL - who fell to the Underground. Riley has spent roughly a month living among the Monsters of Snowdown, when one day a fateful encounter forces them to step out of the comfort of the small life they've built and begin a journey to New Home.

Using various trinkets, PLAYs, and your wits, you'll embark on a journey and confront monsters and puzzles along the way, and choose how you'll advance through the Underground. How will your Bravery manifest?

title: Sightings from the Deep
description: Sightings from the Deep is an "On-Rails Photography game", inspired heavily by games such as Pokémon Snap, but set in a dying, Bloodborne-esque, horror setting.

title: AOL Girls Museum
description:
AOL Girls Museum (AOLGIRLS.WAD) is a PWAD for Doom II.

The museum displays erotic images of women that were shared in AOL chatrooms between the years of 1994 and 1998.

title: iceicellClicker
description: Clicker game

title: Sammy Jukes: Twin Lakes
description: Detective Sammy Jukes is the man on the job when an anti-oil activist is reported missing in a small town on the new oil pipeline route. Talk to witnesses, shovel through evidence, wrestle with the wolves and chase after chickens to find the truth in this first-person open-world adventure game.

title: Bike Rampage!
description: Dan the Biker has one goal... Run over everything with his bike.

title: Dredge: Complete Edition
description: Dredge is a critically acclaimed single-player fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Dredge: Complete Edition nets together the base game and its three DLC packs.

title: Mirth Melody
description: Play as Dodo the duck exploring a beautiful little forest. Strum your favorite guitar and watch as the forest creatures happily vibe along to your music.

title: Phantasy Star... 20 Years Past
description: Phantasy Star... 20 Years Past is a fan game of the original series of Phantasy Star Games.

title: Super Loco World
description: Effortlessly build and automate intricate railroads and deliver goods to meet the demands of a dynamic world! Make clever use of signals and signposts to avoid traffic jams, and watch your villages blossom into bustling towns in this cozy take on the train tycoon genre.

title: Windpunk
description: Recycle The Apocalyptic Wasteland, with a moving waste disposal plant. Craft, Refine, Survive. Restore the environment to a balanced ecosystem and recruit help by finding survivors.

title: Instants
description: A heartwarming journey through time. Use your wits and creativity to lovingly craft photo albums and piece together the story of one family throughout the generations.

title: MainFrames
description: MainFrames invites you to meet Floppy and to browse a clever and charming platformer that plays out entirely within the windows and desktop of a PC monitor. You won’t want to press the escape key on this cozy outing!

title: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss
description: In this cozy management lifesim, care for cute cats & customers while exploring a bustling folkloric city. Build the cat cafe of your dreams and fill hearts with delight using the power of cats, coffee and community

title: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
description: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

title: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
description: Test your skiing skills in serene mountain scenery. Perform tricks, discover shortcuts and try to best your time in the snowy followup to Lonely Mountains: Downhill. Enjoy the slopes alone, participate in thrilling online multiplayer races or gather your friends and conquer the mountains together.

title: I Hope To See You Again
description:
Memories of a goodbye.

I hope to see you again is a short immersive videoclip made as a contribution for the Zium Gallery.

title: Pavu
description: Pavu is an action adventure game where we are going to follow a young boy's quest in search of answers about himself and humanity in a fantastical land filled with robots, challenges and encounters that was once habited by a human civilization that has vanished.

title: Estranged
description: Estranged is a 32 level megawad that uses stock Doom & Doom2 textures, with a variety of environments. Levels are playable from pistol start.

title: Obituary
description: Obituary is a May 1995 Doom II megawad by The Innocent Crew. It contains 17 new single player levels, three new monsters via a DeHackEd patch, some new graphics, and an optional weapon patch which replaces four weapons. Two new deathmatch maps are included as well.

title: Urania
description:
Urania (URANIA.WAD) is a megawad that contains 32 new levels by riderr3.
The megawad features difficult gameplay based on the style of The Plutonia Experiment, but maps are mostly larger, often with non-linear progression and heavy opposition.

title: The Evil Unleashed
description: The Evil Unleashed is a Doom episode replacement mod of nine levels, created by The Innocent Crew

title: 99 Ways to Die
description: 99 Ways to Die is a three-level PWAD for Doom II, released in April 1996 by Warren Marshall. It is noted for its quality in lighting effects, and its regarded as the PWAD that "...raised the bar for lighting effects in Doom.".

title: The Talosian Incident
description: A swansong megawad done by The Black Star Coven before heading over to Quake. It stood out against other WADs of the era for its strong emphasis on creating moody atmospheres, helped by a predominantly ambient soundtrack in the vein of Doom 64.

title: Earth
description: Ten level episode replacement for first episode of Hell on Earth.

title: Witness Of Time
description: 9 map episode similar to favillesco alpha and mano laikas.

title: Number One Kill
description: #1Kill is a Doom episode created by Angelo Jefferson in 1997. It was released at the same time as #1Kill Extra and was followed by Number One Kill The Next Generation later in the same yearr

title: Number One Kill The Next Generation
description: Number One Kill The Next Generation is a 22-level megawad for Doom II that was created by Angelo Jefferson and released in November 1997. It is a sequel to Number One Kill, a Doom 1 Episode replacement. This WAD is noteworthy for its difficult levels relative to its early release, leading to comparisons with The Plutonia Experiment and Hell Revealed.

title: Favillesco Episode 1: Genuflected on Io
description: Favillesco - Episode 1: Genuflected on Io V1.2 is a Doom 1 episode designed entirely by Nicolas Monti that attempts to emulate the Phobos style to the best of his abilities, released in 2013.

title: Number One Kill Extra
description: #1 Kill Extra is a single-level PWAD for Doom that was designed by Angelo Jefferson and released in 1997. It was released at the same time as #1Kill and was followed by Number One Kill The Next Generation later in the same year.

title: Monochrome Mapping Project
description: A collection of maps experimenting with the concept of simple textures in order to emphasize the fundamentals of level design (lighting, elevation, thing placement, simple contrast, etc.)

title: Countdown to Extinction
description: 32 maps for vanilla Doom, each one made in one hour over a period of 3 weeks.

title: Azagthoth
description: A collection of larger maps than normal Doom2. Should provide about four hours of play on Ultra-Violence. Three of these maps were released in earlier versions as "Perdido", 1,2 & 3.

title: Erkattäññe
description: Erkattäññe is a set of 11 levels for Doom II by Nicolás Monti, aiming to imitate the style of 1994-1996 maps, with a restrained texture set for thematic consistency being the only concession given to aesthetics. The levels are dominated by curves and irregular shapes, and filled with secrets.

title: Eternity
description: Travel through the time and find your grandfather in Eternity, a fun and amazing Hidden Object Adventure game! After inventing the time machine, your grandfather decided to experiment on himself and is sent hurtling through time. Use your courage and puzzle-solving skills to travel through time and find him somewhere in Eternity! Meet characters from all parts of the past and future, and solve perplexing puzzles.

title: Stomper
description: Stomper was a once unfinished megawad for Doom II, created by Pawel Zarczynski (NMN). A year later, Przemek Zimny (alterworldruler), began working on a finished version of the megawad with NMN's permission and barring 1 map was able to do so.

title: Realm of Chaos
description: Realm of Chaos is a Doom II megawad that contains 32 levels and was released on October 31, 1996 by The Macintosh Team (TMT). As the name of the mapping team implies, the project was exclusively built by Doom mappers on Apple Macintosh computers.

title: Blackjack Elf
description: Play this casino gambling card game with some elves and win big money.

title: Habilis
description: Follow Nathan Walters as he quickly descends into insanity. Discover the ancient secrets held within a futuristic abandoned factory. A bodycam, Lovecraft-style horror experience not for the weak of heart. Hide, and survive if you can.

title: Nostalgic Entropy
description:
As the sun sets on the horizon, the last rays of light fade in the sky, like dancing ambers of a half-forgotten memory.

This place feels strange yet familiar in a nostalgic way. But you know not all memories are good, so steel yourself for the journey ahead.

title: Skyless Blind
description: Skyless Blind is an upcoming surreal space exploration RPGmaker game about uncovering the mysteries of a broken universe. Travel across beautifully ancient worlds and meet strange new friends, collect mystifying artifacts that bend reality, and discover the dark secrets that shattered the skies.

title: Midnight Fury
description: Experience a TV show featuring Max Cobra and his teammates as they clean up zombies in quarantine zones. Impress sponsors and boost your fame.

title: Elite Exorcist Miko
description: A bullet hell shoot 'em up featuring hololive’s Sakura Miko! hololive has been possessed by evil spirits! Combine melee and ranged combat with a variety of items to fight your friends and set them free!

title: Nightmare Pursuit
description: Nightmare Pursuit is an intense multiplayer horror game where survivors must avoid the deadly traps and unique abilities of terrifying killers. Rely on stealth, strategy, and teamwork to survive in horrific environments. Experience the thrill of the chase—escape or become the hunted.

title: Spirits of Baciu
description: SPIRITS OF BACIU is the enigmatic adventure of The Lost One, a mysterious cat-like spirit who suddenly awakens in the dark Baciu forest. Help him to find his way through the woods, solving puzzles and facing the spirits that inhabit this strange place.

title: Pet Lands
description: Collect quadrillion of coins, hatch pets to mine for you, and unlock 100 unique hand-crafted areas! An incremental clicker/idle creatures-collection adventure. Dopamine heaven has arrived!

title: CrisisX
description: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and build your own territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world.

title: Days of Night: Episode 1
description:
You're freshly 18 and seeking experience in the work force. You struggle to find work until one day the opportunity of a life time would come your way.

Little to you're knowledge you would be stepping in a world of HORROR!

Experience the HORRORS of working night shift at you're local grocery store.

title: Room 202
description: While traveling, you get tired and decide to stop at a hotel. Little do you know who - or what - else has checked in.

title: Helward: A Tanuki Story
description:
Helward is a gay furry romance VN about a fish out of water tanuki named Howl. After a year of an intimate long-distance relationship, he will finally pursue his romantic interest.

Given his propensity for misfortune, many mishaps await Howl in his efforts for love. On top of that, in the territory of Helward secrets and dangers abound. He'll have much to overcome while also juggling secrets of his own.

title: Oh So Hero!
description: Oh So Hero! is a lewd furry metroidvania game! Play as the dragonesque Joe to fight and fornicate with your rivals, get intimate with a menagerie of anthropomorphic characters, and embark on a sex-filled adventure to win the mysterious alien tournament being held on Joe's island!

title: Derma
description: Short horror RPG

title: Immemory
description: In Immemory, Chris Marker has used the format of the CD-Rom to create a multi-layered, multimedia memoir. The reader investigates “zones” of travel, war, cinema, and poetry, navigating through photographs, film clips, music, and text, as if physically exploring Marker’s memory itself. The result is a veritable 21st-century Remembrance of Things Past, an exploration of the state of memory in our digital era. With it, Marker has both invented a literary form and perfected it.

title: Paper-Girl-Chain
description: A short dreamlike visual novel about a shy girl and her obsession with her best friend.

title: Shien Mogui
description: Two girls travel to a small abandoned village to investigate an urban legend. This game is an incomplete work that was discontinued. Therefore, the ending is included halfway through.

title: Smog City
description: Smog City is a 10 level mapset for Doom II with a toxic, industrial theme.

title: Urban Side
description: Urban side is a 5 level (plus 1 credits map) boom wad, themed around a urban city environment.

title: Ruined Vacation
description: Ruined vacation is a wad composed of three (plus a credits map) action packed levels to kick some ass through

title: Star Light Dynamics
description: Star Light Dynamics is a doomII boom wad comprised of 5 (plus a credits map) science fiction themed maps

title: Cave Halls
description: A single level for vanilla Hexen with about 25 minutes of gameplay. Both combat and puzzles (not switch hunting) included.

title: Thirty Monsters Challenge 2: Thirty Aliens
description: A sequel to the original 30MC, the task was simple: create a map with 30 monsters in it. This set of 36 cl21 maps features work by a number of talented community map designers and contains some custom assets on top of the colorful Ancient Aliens texture pack!

title: Dark Scythe
description: Dark Scythe is an April Fool's project where mappers were tasked with making a Dead Simple knock-off that's beatable. Apologies to anyone thinking this has anything to do with Scythe.

title: Persona 3 Portable: Kotone Cutscenes Project - Steam Version
description: The Kotone Cutscenes Project implements reanimated versions of every cutscene from the original PS2 release of Persona 3 to match the Female protagonist route of Persona 3 Portable. This includes alternative versions of scenes for choices exclusive to this route (eg. Theodore or Elizabeth).

title: ReBullet
description: This is a local two-player tank battle game where two players control blue and red tanks; Players will use a limited number of bullets to eject and defeat enemies in the scenario!

title: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow
description:
Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow is a fantasy visual novel game with a colorful cast of playable characters, each with their own unique mechanics, and all of whom are necessary in solving this mystery. But be careful, as your choices will determine whether their stories end in ruin or victory.

Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Your decisions determine how many clues are uncovered for the final player character, the detective. Explore each stage of grief: Chapter 1 stars Orven as he navigates the shocking deaths of his dream and his hero.

title: Upekkha
description: Escape reality and find peace through meditation, wall running, interacting with mushrooms, discovering hidden easter eggs, and more.

title: Schismo's Sideshow
description:
A hand-drawn action roguelike set inside of a strange circus attraction.

Defeat hordes of fast-moving enemies to generate energy for the circus. Collect Schismo's lost Stamps to change your playstyle and raise the skill ceiling. Meta-progression comes in the form of Marlbes that offer mutually exclusive choices.

title: Nululu Online
description: Nululu Online was a Thai fantasy MMORPG for PC and Symbian mobile devices.

title: Epic! The Humorous RPG
description: Epic! The Humorous RPG is a parody RPG game made by the YouTuber The Mysterious Mr. Enter in 2012. The game runs on the Official Hamster Republic Role Playing Game Construction Engine.

title: Lost in the Dark Woods
description:
In the dense, shadowy forest, the crackling fire is your only defense. The flames flicker and dance, casting long shadows that keep the predators at bay. But the fire is weakening. The night is alive with sounds—rustling leaves, distant growls—reminders that danger lurks just beyond the light.

You must gather wood quickly, feeding the flames to keep them strong. Every piece of wood you find is a lifeline, each spark a promise of safety. The fire is your shield, your beacon of hope in the dark wilderness.

If the fire dies, the predators will close in, their eyes glowing in the darkness, and the forest will consume you. You have no choice—keep the fire burning, or face the terror that waits in the night.

title: Steamed Hams, but it's RPGMaker2003!
description: "Well Seymour, I made it, despite your directions"

title: Void Dash
description:
A simple endless runner arcade game about dodging dangerous asteroids.

Use powerups to break your highscore and collect Voidbucks to unlock new skins in the shop.

title: Factorio: Space Exploration
description:
Space Exploration is an overhaul mod for Factorio that continues player's journey after launching the rocket. Expand your factory into space and manage interplanetary logistics. Travel around the solar system in buildable ships and reach light speed to beat the game.

The Space Exploration mod predates the Space Age DLC and both are being developed by the same individual, so they will have similar elements. Space Exploration is meant for players looking for a lengthy, expert challenge.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Legend of Z RPG
description: A fan-made Dragon Ball Z RPG Maker 2003 fan game that takes place from Saiyan-Buu Saga with some 'GT' and 'Super' content afterward.

title: Tailgate
description: Hyde, an aging labrador retriever, wakes up and realizes that Derek, his beloved Human has disappeared. The doggo reluctantly leaves the house to investigate, only to find himself in the middle of an ancient dog prophecy.

title: Chatty's Bratty Tryst
description: Chatty's Bratty Tryst (CBT) is a fan-made visual novel made in Ren'py centered around Lucy Pyre, the cringe femcel demon girl Chatty loves and adores.

title: Satisfactory: 1.0 Update
description:
The 1.0 release of Satisfactory, a 3D co-op factory building game.

1.0 will contain many new features, including story content, and the addition of tier 9 and phase 5.

title: Locked Room on Rails
description: A Murder Mystery visual novel starring homicide detective Santiago Moore, as he tries to solve a sudden murder on the luxurious Jacob's Ladder Express Train.

title: Asphodelium
description: A melancholic boys love visual novel about killing cults and your past confronting you.

title: Miraculous: Paris Under Siege
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure where heroism, acrobatic combat, and stunning parkour collide as Shadow Moth unleashes a wave of villains across the city. It’s up to Ladybug and Cat Noir to save the day!

title: Naddagil: A Nordic Nightmare
description: Enter the mythical world of Naddagil: A Nordic Nightmare. In this cozy-horror game you have to guide a little child back home. But be aware, that not all creatures in this world will try to help you. Your only chance of survival is to hide and avoid the mysterious Naddagil lurking for you.

title: IguaRPG 2
description: Welcome to the world of IguaRPG 2. Become an adorable iguana and jump, fight, chat, put things in your pocket, and finish quests!

title: Arrival, or Attack of the B-Movie Clichés
Sawdust
description: A collection of seven maps scrapped from Valiant early in it's development.

title: Death of the King
description:
The King of Robots has been betrayed.

Caught off-guard, he finds himself trapped in his Mech. The Mech itself can probably last until help arrives -- but its overheating core can't. Use an army of robots running around the Mech to try and stabilize it!

title: A Day to Bring Them Happiness
description: Made for the Global Startupcities Gamejam with the theme "A Win-win situation".

title: Doki Doki Ace Attorney
description: A mod for DDLC based on the Ace Attorney series, where you must defend Sayori for a murder she didn't commit!

title: FNF x Ace Attorney: Turnabout
description:
OBJECTION!!
Phoenix Wright fights in court using the power of funk, against Miles Edgeworth, in the pursuit of a Not Guilty Verdict!

title: The Devil Within
description: A Sonic.EXE re-take by Brigandistian.

title: Pearl Rising
description:
You play as Pearl, a young cadet, woken up when your city is under attack by the Bugs. Your job is to secure the area and find out what's going on!
The only good bug is a dead bug, they say.

title: Sugary Shifter
description: Sugary Shifter is a short, turn-based RPG that is easy to understand and finish without any guides. It features graphics inspired by 1980s video games.

title: Sojourn Through the Decade
description: An autobiographical game focusing on the ten years of creating worlds and its respective characters, with The Sojourner seeing how his stories have fared since then.

title: Stellar Bewitching
description: A Sci-Fi turn-based RPG featuring teenage drama, touching storylines, and fast-paced battles!

title: Whispering Dream
description: Aisly is a little boy who was having his sweet dream after a long time. Different from the usual, he was engaged in quite a realistic dream. As he goes, someone was trying to wake him up from his sleep...?

title: Luciel Angel Mission
description: This is the story of the apprentice angel 'Luciel' who loves to study about the world. Once upon a time, all 3 worlds were ruled by God. after the war between The angels are led by 'Lucifer' the anti-God. Defeated and expelled, but then one day he disappeared, no one knew where he was. and gave the mission to Luciel for some reason.

title: The Haunted House
description: Our heroine "Mikae Mitsu" lived in a house with his aunt after the death of her parents. Mikae was in the house when she woke up and saw the letter placed on her table. But she didn't care Because it was everywhere the water was going anywhere Mikae went to the bathroom. Enough to come back to the room, but suddenly, something unusual happened. Because of a sudden noise from behind her when she turned around, she discovered that a ghost had broken into the house, and Mikae hurried to hide, she began to feel anxious and afraid Then Mikae So find a way to get out of this house.

title: Prenup Struggles
description:
Prenup Struggles is the game that is about the story of a young man from Buriram who wants to marry a woman, yet he wasn't able to do that because of the high prenup from the woman's father.

The young has no choice, but to move to the new city to fulfill his dream

Or not?

title: Farewell, My Dearest Love
description: What if the only room for an overnight stay is haunted by supernatural stories? Can you survive until morning?

title: 77Survival Part I
description: 77Survival is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players will control four characters who accidentally find themselves stranded on the rooftop of a 77-story building. Their mission is to survive as long as possible or venture down to the first floor to uncover the mysterious events happening in the building. Each character has unique abilities, allowing them to solve puzzles and complete missions. If all four characters die, the game is over.

title: There's an Only One Way Exit.
description:
Dream is kindly illusion. Find the way to wake up, find the truth beneath the fog.

An interactive RPG game that you is someone who struck in the dream place, find the way to exit, true or lie this is no fault, it only meet the end.

title: Touhou The Excalibur: Mystic Arena of Reversal Spirits
Shepherd’s Plan
description: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

title: Jigoku Train
description:
Waking up to an unfamiliar place, what course of action will you choose?

Play as Ling, your average office worker having her usual shifts and living her usual life, woke up on the train one night, finding that she was not going to head to her usual destinations.

Not only that, you will also play another character! He wakes up with no memories on a train heading towards an unknown location. Grant is your average amnesiac guy.

Where are they heading, and what can they do in order to head back home? Or is there even any way home?

title: Borrowed Book
description: Borrowed Book is a simple yet heavy-dialogue; psychological horror RPG Maker game on two microorganisms attempting to completing their chores for the librarian to get out from the library quickly.

title: Mary Had A Lost Lamb
description: Mary Had A Lost Lamb is a exploration psychological horror RPG Maker game on a microorganism who is finding her lamb. Do be aware this game is very dialogue heavy.

title: Twilight Horizon
description: A surreal sci-fi horror RPG. Play as two protagonists, trapped in two doomed realities. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and survive industrial nightmares in a haunting journey through the Twilight Zone.

title: Loneliness Butterfly
description:
Loneliness Butterfly marks the thrilling conclusion of Arachne's Anthology trilogy.

Picking up right after the events of Realm of Lament, this installment introduces Eddy Ruina, Feedra's wife and a lieutenant in Measuryville. Alerted by Penelope's email regarding Thomas's disappearance, Eddy joins the search. Their investigation leads them back to the events of Carnival, where they uncover the existence of the Soul Realm Gate, a potential path to Thomas. But is it truly that simple?

title: Adventure in Wachirawit World
description: In this game, you will go on an adventure in Wachirawit's world.

title: Gallium
description: A 3D platformer where you are being raced against the clock! Get the fastest time possible across all the elements in the Periodic Table of Elements while finding secrets! Keep a close eye for shortcuts though!

title: Escape from the Cursed Convent
description: Escape from the Cursed Convent is a narrative-driven adventure game set in a medieval girls' convent, offering a rich storytelling experience, and several gameplay styles including QTE, hunting, cooking, and puzzle-solving.

title: Cage: Story of Lust
description: The story of the love of a fallen angel with a beloved angel. You have to make him love you and make this world colorful again!!

title: De:Lithe Last Memories
description: "De:Lithe Last Memories" is a Rogue-like RPG game.

title: Charlie Charlie Challenge
description: A 1-4 player CO-OP horror game, you have come to try and banish a ghost, or is it a demon? At the end of your venture you will just be trying to escape.

title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
description:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

title: The Kantist
description:
The Kantist is an action-packed adventure 2D-Platformer.

Escape the testing facility and explore the deep and reaching vents of the lab to uncover its secrets. Use your abilities as a test subject to find new Zones, master minigames and befriend other test subjects.

title: A Shelter Full of Cats
description: A Shelter Full of Cats is a hidden object game set in a cat shelter specially designed for cats with special needs. Join the Shelter's manager, Hannah, as she prepares a charity party to help these cats find their forever homes. Let's show that love has no boundaries!

title: Chicken Strike: Cluck Ops
description:
In a world where chickens have had enough of being served up on platters, one fearless fowl rises to lead the resistance against the fast-food giant known as FCK. Welcome to "Chicken Strike: Cluck Ops", the action-packed adventure where feathers fly and the claws come out!

Take control of a courageous chicken armed to the beak with an arsenal of weapons, from egg launchers to poultry-powered rockets. Embark on an epic quest through a variety of vibrant environments, from bustling city streets to the heart of the FCK empire. Prepare for intense battles against waves of crispy adversaries, including Major Fanders.

Join the resistance, cluck up your courage, and embark on an egg-citing adventure to save chicken-kind from the clutches of the fast-food industry. It's time to show FCK who is the boss!

title: Half-Life 2: Aftermath
description: Half-Life 2: Aftermath is a singleplayer first-person shooter Half-Life 2 modification (mod), running on Source engine. This mod brings together content from the cancelled Half-Life 2: Episode Three, and Half-Life 2: Episode One, with more updates to come.

title: Dead Cells: The End Is Near
description: Dead Cells final new content update. It brings new mobs, weapons, mutations and biome effects all expanding on the curse mechanic, 40+ new head skins, almost 20 new legendary affixes, extra accessibility options and more.

title: Kong: Survivor Instinct
description: When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

title: Fever Golf
description: This is a game about early 2000s bargain bin CD culture, that is, games that few people played & fewer remember. They were the last few digital artifacts that were allowed to fall into the quiet oblivion of history—the rear guard of an older era that pre-existed our current climate of perpetual distribution. This is a game for the MySimAquariam and MoonTycoons of the world; bottom-shelf junk-ware with a soul.

title: Read, Write, & Type
description: A game for kids following "Lefty" and "Righty" as they attempt to get back the letters than Victor the Virus stole. The game teaches kids how to read and type.

title: Love the Game
description:
Love the game is a semi-autoclicker unlockable type of game!
For every space button pressed over a passing civilian, your love meter increases. hit target goals to unlock wacky costumes and bonuses to help increase your love points.

title: Inside My Friend's Mind
description: An abstract adventure inside my friend's head. He inspires me and motivates me to move forward.

title: Hard Nut to Crack
description: Blast through 32 chaotic levels to rockin' MIDIs from 'round the net! These short but weird levels, inspired by powerful mappers like Sandy Petersen, Stanley Stasiak (Castle of Evil), and Greytale (DARKHELL.WAD), include a wide variety of challenges and themes.

title: Into Sandy's Cities
description:
Welcome to "Into Sandy's Cities". This MegaWAD shows what Doom 2 from an alternate universe might look like, with all 32 maps being made in the style of Sandy Petersen's original levels. And not just visually! Layouts, gimmicks, enemy placements, even all bugs, glitches, limitations and other quirks have been faithfully recreated.

This WAD doesn't distinguish between "good" or "bad", it just aims to recreate the original experience as accurately as possible, warts and all. It's a celebration of Doom 2, and a love letter to Petersen's design philosophy in particular.

title: Sam & Max: The Complete Trilogy
description: What's better than one Sam & Max season? Three Sam & Max seasons!

title: The Things You Do For Love
description:
A dark romantic-comedy where you get to play as a hopeless yandere who is desperately trying to understand their newfound, romantic feelings all while taking down the competition.

Whether you decide to stalk your crush, eliminate your rivals, or make new friends, just go out there and win some love — no matter what, no matter how!

title: VirusRush + Hazard of the Ages
description: Face powerful bosses in a soulslike challenge amidst bullet hell! Each one will test your adaptability, skills, and strategic thinking, as you are fragile and will need to manage your stamina to dodge with your dash amidst intense, fast-paced action! To progress, you don't just need to defeat them but also master the combats to achieve the best rankings and obtain the stars needed to unlock more battles.

title: Dragon Ball Gekishin Squadra
description: This brand‑new title is a battle arena game that will divide players into teams of four and have them fight it out! You can take part in exhilarating battles where you overwhelm your opponents and enjoy amazing teamwork with your allies!

title: Witch & Fieriness
description:
Witch & Fieriness is an action-packed adventure beat-them-up game where you take on the role of "Flameryn," the Fire Witch, who embarks on a journey to find her lost sister, "Iceika." Armed with powerful magic, Flameryn can overcome all defensive and offensive obstacles.

However, despite her fiery prowess, Flameryn is vulnerable to sunlight! Players must navigate carefully and prioritize finding water sources to keep her cool and prevent her from being overwhelmed by the scorching rays.

title: Alice in Vivaldi's Four Seasons
description: Alice walks into a magical Music Clock dropped by the White Rabbit. But the clock is broken, and Alice is trapped inside!

title: ReSetna
description: ReSetna is a post-apocalyptic Metroidvania, in a crumbling world dominated by the APEX AI. As a mysterious Signal driving robots to madness emerges, ReSetna sets off on a journey to uncover the mystery. Explore, engage, evolve, navigating through the crumbling ruins of a once glorious civilization.

title: Nobk Overlay
description: Welcome to NOBK Overlay, the ultimate fruit-clicking adventure! Your task is simple: click on delicious, vibrant fruits to generate even more fruits. The more you click, the more your orchard grows, and the juicier your rewards become!

title: QuickBite Express
description: QuickBite Express is an ultra-dynamic platformer about the challenges of courier work. Deliver orders on time and undamaged across multiple cities to maintain your rating.

title: Eye of the Commando
description: A turnbased grid movement dungeon crawler with an 80s action movie theme. Players raid an island fortress of evil, fighting, exploring, gearing up, and solving puzzles.

title: Train Sim World 5
description: The Rails are Yours in Train Sim World 5! Take on new challenges and new roles as you master the tracks and trains of iconic cities across 3 new routes. Immerse yourself in the ultimate rail hobby and embark on your next journey.

title: Miku'n Pop
description: This game is stylized like an action platformer game from 80's - 90's. Your objective is to defeat all enemies on the screen. Each character has their own different play styles. Featuring 2 difficulty modes; Hard Mode & Easy Mode. There are 9 stages, & for each 10 levels, you will encounter a boss.

title: Payday 3: Chapter 3 - Houston Breakout
description:
Dallas found his brother, Houston, alive but not safe. On trial for a slew of charges, Houston is injured, about to be sentenced, and sent off to one of Concord’s private prisons, from which he’s bound never to reappear.

Whether you break him out silently or go in guns blazing is up to you, either way, we’re getting our man out.

title: Banana & Cucumber
description: Banana & Cucumber is a clicker Game, in which you click a Banana & Cucumber! In Banana & Cucumber you click the Banana & Cucumber to gain even more Banana & Cucumber!

title: Car Clicker
description: Car Clicker is a clicker Game, in which you click a Car! In Car you click the Car to gain even more Cars! Every 1 and 18 hours, you get dropped a car. Each cars is also made by the community in discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something awesome !

title: Clothing
description: Clothing is a clicker Game, in which you click a Clothing! In Clothing you click the Clothing to gain even more Clothings! Every 1 and 18 hours, you get dropped a clothing. Each clothings is also made by the community in discord. Come hang out with us and let's grow into something awesome !

title: Box Clicker
description: Box Clicker is a game in which you break Boxes to get more Boxes. And that's just the beginning!

title: Sniper Elite: Resistance
description: Offering unparalleled sniping mechanics, stealth and tactical third-person combat, Sniper Elite: Resistance turns the attention of the award-winning series towards a hidden war, far from the front lines, deep within the heart of occupied France.

title: RoadCraft
description: As the leader of a company specialized in restoring sites devastated by natural disasters, use your construction machinery to restart the local industry. Clear debris and faulty equipment, rebuild roads and bridges damaged by weather, and much more!

title: Tapple: Idle Clicker
description: Welcome to Tapple, the idle clicker game where every tap brings you closer to an ever-growing collection of Tapples. Build your empire one tap at a time, discover unique Tapple drops, and experience the rewarding gameplay that keeps you coming back for more.

title: We Harvest Shadows
description: A first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

title: Honey Peach Clicker
description: Honey Peach Clicker is a Clicker game, which you can keep click the honey peach to Relieves stress. And also, Honey Peach Coin (HPC) will drop after a period of time while the game runing. HPC can be used to exchange special items to Enrich your community inventory collection!

title: Revenge of the Savage Planet
description: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

title: Pizza Clicker
description: PIZZA CLICKER. You get dropped a pizza every 2 hours 5 times per day. Your chance to try every kind of pizza in the world and share it with friends!

title: Banana Monkeys
description: Banana Monkeys: The Ultimate Monkey Collection.Dive into the enchanting world of Banana Monkeys, where you collect whimsical, quirky monkeys every 3 hours and share the fun with friends through trading and exciting events. Join a vibrant community of collectors!

title: Borderlands 4
description: See if you have what it takes to go down in history as a legendary Vault Hunter as you search for secret alien treasure, blasting everything in sight.

title: Meh
description: Meh is a game where you click on a computer to earn random computers from time to time. Collect them all!

title: Melon
description: Click the melon! Check out discord for more info and news.

title: Raspberry
description: Raspberry is a simple and fun way to collect and trade raspberries with others. Most importantly to declare war on the evil banana's!

title: Goat Simulator: Remastered
description: Goat Simulator Remastered is the latest in goat simulation technology. Your favorite chaotic sandbox is back and more beautiful than ever, with updated graphics, every DLC, and more bugs that you can shake a goat at. WASD to rewrite history.

title: Dying Light: The Beast
description: Dying Light: The Beast Restored Land is a new enhanced version of the game that includes the base game, all previously released updates and the premiere Restored Land content in one package. This includes Legend Levels, New Game+, Ray Tracing, Nightmare Mode, dozens of new brutal finishers, hundreds of parkour and gameplay improvements, and numerous visual and audio enhancements - delivering new ways to experience the apocalypse.

title: Eggz: Collectible Eggs Clicker
description: Click on the Egg: after 100 clicks, the egg will crack open, and you'll unlock a unique skin. Collect all the skins and become the master of eggs! Unlock legendary skins and enrich your collection!

title: King of Meat
description:
King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against devious dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight.

Progress through official and community-built dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to becoming the ultimate contender!

title: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
description: Team-up, brawl and build in this co-op action game that blends hack and slash combat with roguelite-inspired missions and town-building progression that goes beyond the run! Unlock and upgrade gear, rescue robot allies, and lead the resistance against the world-dominating Combots!

title: Bananamana
description: Bananamana is a clicker Game

title: Butt
description:
This is a game about collecting butt.
You click butt, you get butt. Sometimes a little, sometimes a lot.

title: Ducks
description: Enter the universe of NFDs (Non-Fungible Ducks)! Click the duck and earn more ducks. Collect as many limited edition and rare ducks as you can!

title: Pickle
description: Pickle is a clicker game, click to win new styles of pickles! Let's start clicking!

title: Reanimal
description: The creators of Little Nightmares I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

title: Masters of Mayhem
description: Masters of Mayhem is a free-to-play social deduction game with roguelike twists for 4–15 players. Work together to restore abandoned facilities and contain terrifying monsters — unless you're an impostor, in which case… have fun unleashing mayhem!

title: Starfield: Rev-8
description:
This update added the REV-8 land vehicle, available after installing a vehicle module. It is an armored vehicle with a mounted turret and boosters that will be automatically deployed outside your ship wherever you land.

Along with the general fixes and improvements for the game, this update also included new Xbox Series S display settings to mirror the existing Xbox Series X settings with frame rate targets, Visual or Performance priority options and a VSync toggle.

title: A Shrimpful Adventure
description:
A Shrimpful Adventure is a free short 2D puzzle-platformer developed in under four days for GMTK 2024 by a small team with minimal game development experience.

"Two shrimps, a father and a child, embark on an adventure in search of treasure."

title: Herdling
description: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

title: Masters of Albion
description: In Masters of Albion, shape a living world as a god - or step into it and experience it through your people. Build, guide and defend your town by day, then survive the night when everything is under threat. There is no single solution. Only yours.

title: Floatopia
description: Discover all the beloved elements of life simulation games—farming, fishing, logging, and decorating your dream home. With a sprinkle of magic to sweep away your worries, set sail on your very own floating island and journey through a world of superpowers!

title: Mafia: The Old Country
description:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

title: Dave the Diver: Potion Craft
description: Dave the Diver: Balatro is a DLC that adds content themed around the management simulation game Potion Craft.

title: Dave the Diver: Balatro
description: Dave the Diver: Balatro is a DLC that adds content themed around the poker-themed roguelike deck-building game Balatro.

title: Dave the Diver: Mxmtoon
description: Dave the Diver: Mxmtoon is a DLC that adds content themed around the American singer-songwriter and YouTuber mxmtoon.

title: Retrojam I
description: Map-Center's first endeavor into Quake 1 mapping. Features 24 new classic Quake maps.

title: Journey to the Centre of Nirn
description:
Follow in the steps of a famous explorer as you follow the clues to the location of a long lost city.
Travel through vast magma chambers and dark caverns solving puzzles, riddles and intriguing mazes before finally discovering the fate of a lost Ayleid city.

title: Pip My Dice
description: Pip My Dice is a Yahtzee Roguelike experience. Score enough to make it to the next round, customize your dice to score more and collect relics to create game-breaking combos. Climb the leaderboards and enjoy a different run every time!

title: Burger Kombat
description: Assemble your most expensive burger from whatever you can find in the kitchen.

title: Kawaii Slime
description: An idle/clicker game where the player collects slime inventory items over time. Slimes can vary from size, color, shape, and rarity. Some limited slimes maybe released during certain times of the year for a short time so be sure to stay alert for new announcements.

title: Ciggy World
description: Ciggy World is a clicker game where you click on a cigarette to earn rewards! In Ciggy World, every click brings you closer to a treasure trove of drops, or butts.

title: Labyrinth of Eclipse
description:
Arcade style roguelite where you fight demons an angels to try to stop a cults leader from ascending to god hood.

Made for the 2023 1 bit gamejam

title: Coconut
description: Welcome to Coconut! ✨ Dive into the ultimate coconut-clicking frenzy where the fun never stops. Ready to get your click on?

title: Pets
description: PETS is a platformer puzzle game. You will cross different dimensions and go through the maze, find your dogge.

title: Letters
description: Letters is a clicker game where you click a letter to get more letters! Every 3 hours you can get 4 common letters, Every 5 hours you can get 2 uncommon letters and every 24 hours you get a rare letter.

title: Phat Phrog Clicker
description: Join the community of Phat Phrog Clicker enthusiasts today and become the ultimate cute creature collector! Earn 28 unique Steam inventory skins, dropping every 30 minutes of gameplay. These skins can be traded or sold on the Steam Marketplace. Can you collect them all?

title: Coin
description: Invest in ChadCoin by simply clicking! In ChadCoin, you click the Coin to gain even more Coins! Get a random coin every time you click enough and grow your collection!

title: Weeb
description: Weeb is a Anime Clicker game where you will gather new friends to your collection.

title: Banana Gine
description: Banagine is a clicker game. There is a banana and there is an aubergine. So, this is a Banagine. Click to Banagine and count more Banagine. Because everyone loves Banagine!

title: Lemon
description: Welcome to Lemon, the clicker game more addictive than cat videos! Click your way to Lemon glory, gathering Lemons faster than you can say "Lemon counter." Unlock mysterious inventory drops with golden Lemons, magic Lemons. Dive in and may the Lemons be ever in your favor!

title: Idle Kitties Online
description: Welcome to Idle Kitties Online! This is a free game with relaxing gameplay where you can collect cute kitties alone or with friends.

title: The Apple
description: The Apple is a clicker game where you click on the apple to increase your score.

title: Poop
description: Poop is an idle-clicker game where you click poop to get more poop
