title: Befriended Curse
description: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.

title: Bloons Card Storm
description: A turn-based collectible card game set in the Bloons universe.

title: Gravelord
description: Gravelord is a fast-paced boomer shooter voiced by a badass protagonist featuring hand-crafted levels filled with secrets and hordes of enemies to kill. Dish out some brutal carnage with powerful guns and collect Tarot Cards to gain even more killing power. Let's put the fun back in funeral!

title: Payday 3: Chapter 2 - Boys in Blue
description:
What would you do if some corrupt cops raided your completely legitimate business, planted some evidence, and showed every sign of wanting to keep the gold they “confiscated”? Well, in Vlad’s case, he got in touch with his old friends in the Payday Gang to enact revenge and get his damn gold back.
The Boys in Blue Heist tasks the gang with breaking into a secure holding facility of the NYPD on Vlad’s behalf. He wants his gold back, and the gang has never let him down before.

title: Eldritch Empathy
description: Learn the language of a cosmic colossus in the Lovecraftian rogue-lite Eldritch Empathy. Study eerie horrors to learn their secrets, or destroy them and face the consequences. Your choices determine the fate of humanity.

title: Orange: The Annoying Clicker
description: Orange is a spiritual successor to certain phallic fruit clicker Game, in which you click an Orange, only a little bit more annoying *wink*! All you have to do is click the Orange! No Drama No Stress

title: Mindfall
description: "MINDFALL" is a tense first-person psychological horror game that explores the depths of the human mind and its struggle with the unknown.

title: The Hamster
description: Welcome to "The Hamster" – a fun and relaxing clicker game where you collect unique skins for your adorable hamster. Earn points, unlock new skins, and enjoy the simple yet captivating gameplay. Perfect for those looking for a light and enjoyable gaming experience.

title: Crazy Corn
description: Crazy Corn is an addictive clicker game where your clicking skills can lead you to unimaginable riches! Improve your level, automate your income and unlock new items.

title: Tiny Dino: Royale
description: Can you avoid extinction in Tiny Dino: Royale? A new genre bending clicker game where you compete with players to see who can survive the longest. Collect unique dino skins that can be used to craft rare rewards, climb the leaderboards, and find out how many ways you can destroy asteroids.

title: Watermelon
description: "Watermelon" is a gamAn interesting and unusual clicker game in which you need to level up!

title: Bertha Butt's Boogie
description: Made for the June 2013 Monthly AGS competition. Bertha wants to win a dance contest, and needs her family's help to win.

title: Have Your Monster
description: An experimental interactive poem about toxic lesbians ripping each other apart, under 800 words with 2 outcomes

title: Chronicon: Survivors
description: Fight a mix of familiar and new dangerous foes in this fast paced horde survival game! Upgrade your weapons, unlock new items & characters, advance in the permanent passive skill tree, and try to survive the horde! Based off the ARPG Chronicon by the same developer.

title: Alys vs. the Phantom Feline Foe
description: An adventure game in the style of an early 90's Sierra adventure with a lewd twist! Alys is trapped in Bizarro World. Help her escape or she shall be trapped forever as the unwilling sex slave of Ignatius Cat, the Phantom Feline Foe.

title: In Search Of You
description: Rekindle the exhilarating sensation of youthful passion—to perfectly capture the essence of romantic endeavors, making the experience of falling in love both sweet and meaningful, and to inspire players with the beauty of love within the nightlife entertainment industry.

title: Dreamlike Love with Seira
description: Enjoy the memories with a beautiful maid in your dreams and heal your fatigue in reality.

title: Las gafas nuevas del yayo Carmelo
description:
Josemi's grandfather has been fitted with new glasses that make his eyes huge and, apparently, these glasses allow him to see far away.
A very short interactive fiction about a summer afternoon between a grandfather and a grandson.

title: Diablo IV: Season of Hatred Rising
description:
Mephisto’s hatred has spread far and wide, creating nightmarish monstrosities to roam the land and reinstilling a sense of dread in the hearts of Sanctuary’s denizens. No one and nowhere is safe from the Lord of Hatred’s maddening influence, not even you.

Stand against encroaching hatred with fearsome new power in Diablo’s latest major update. Experience updated progression systems, more levels, gain all-new skills, discover new items, grow your glyphs to a new legendary level, and test your mettle in new difficulty levels that reward the most daring. Seek out and take down the Realmwalkers and explore the Seething Realms. Unite with allies via Party Finder and save Sanctuary from the relentless tide of Mephisto’s corruption.

title: Let's Build a Dungeon
description: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

title: Forza Motorsport: 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3
Forza Horizon 5: 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3
Stellarcraft
description: Stellarcraft is a captivating sci-fi tower defense game that delves deep into the vast expanses of the universe, offering players the opportunity to explore planets, gather resources, and defend against numerous threats.

title: Dungeons of Dreadrock 2: The Dead King´s Secret
description: Dungeons of Dreadrock - The Dead King's Secret is Part 2 of the (yet unfinished) Dreadrock Trilogy. In this episode you'll puzzle and fight your way through the ancient cavern parts of Dreadrock Mountain. The game features 100 levels, 5 bosses, two different endings and tons of adorable pixel art.

title: Bauhaus Bonk
description: In this single-player game of skill, the movement is not straightforward. Switch between pivot points to maneuver your way through Bauhaus art-inspired arcade levels. Avoid obstacles, reach the goal and beat the high score!

title: The Games You Make
description: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

title: Hamster Combat
description: Hamster Clicker is a clicker game about collecting hamsters! Every 3 and 18 hours, you get dropped a chest with hamsters!

title: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Versus
description: Versus is a free game mode* providing an entirely new way to play Warhammer: Vermintide 2. Engage in thrilling 4v4 battles, alternating between the Five Heroes of Vermintide and the Skaven Ratmen, all set against the backdrop of the rich Warhammer Fantasy Universe.

title: Pizzeria
description: Click to eat delicious pizzas, buy powerful upgrades, and become the ultimate pizza master. Seek out exclusive drops to make your collection unique. Can you get them all? Start clicking now and rise to pizza greatness!

title: Banana Cat
description: Banana Cat is a simple clicker in which you click a “catnana” (a fusion from a cat and a banana). If you wait a specific amount of hours you’ll obtain cat bananas, some cat bananas will also be drawn by YOU in our discord server. What are you waiting for? Come and click banana cats with us!

title: Mob Trader
description: Poke the dungeon and stick around to see what comes out! Every 60 minutes you will receive a tradeable mob in the form of a Steam Item. Grow an impressive collection of unique mobs to show off and trade with other players on the Steam Market!

title: Apple Clicker
description: Easy clicker game for apple enjoyers!

title: Adventure in XX City 2: Finding BB
description: Fangame for the "Anthology of the Killer" series

title: Fruits
description: You get a fruit every fixed hours of game time, each fruit is different it ranges from rarity, fruit and a multiplier to your basket clicking. You can also chop any unwanted fruit into fruit bits and use those to craft another fruit Each fruits and bits can be traded and sold.

title: Giraffe
description: Welcome to the world of Giraffe Clicker – an addictive clicker game where every click brings you closer to a new giraffe! Tap the screen, earn points, and collect rare and unique giraffes, each with its own special traits and abilities.

title: Mars Attracts
description: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

title: Croak?
description: This is an idle game that places numerous frog tanks on your desktop. Just let it run, and your screen will be filled with ugly yet adorable frogs!

title: Will: Follow the Light
description: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

title: Rogue Waters
description: Rogue Waters is a tactical turn-based rogue-lite in a cursed pirate world. Build a fierce crew of rogues and form alliances with mythical creatures as you navigate an ever-changing world and master combat on land and sea. The crew and the Kraken await your command—will you heed the call?

title: Dfuse
description: FPS meets MOBA in DFUSE’s adrenaline-fueled mashup. Wield realistic military tools and outsmart your rivals in quick-fire matches that blend strategic depth with adrenaline-pumping action. Plant the bomb, secure the defusal, or dominate the battlefield.

title: Faaast Penguin
description: "Faaast Penguin" is an action-packed racing game where up to 40 penguins compete in a chaotic race to the finish. Players can unleash attacks, ride on ultimate rides, use shortcuts, and outpace rivals to reach the finish line first.

title: Maui The Shapeshifter
description: Play as Maui the demigod in an adventure to save his island home from a darkness that threatens to consume it. Transform into majestic animals, meet spirit Aumakua, explore unique biomes, face epic bosses, and defeat nefarious enemies in this epic hand-painted 2D open world Metroidvania.

title: Echoes of Mystralia
description: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

title: Nightmare House: Reimagined
description: No sleeping beyond this point. Escape a waking nightmare in this classic survival horror experience. She's waiting for you.

title: God Save Birmingham
description: Doom has come to Birmingham, and you are the last soul alive. Survive an undead plague in a painstakingly recreated medieval market town. Manage your needs, master physics-based mechanics, and evade the horde for as long as you can.

title: Banana 2: Fruit
description: Bop your banana.

title: Wilmot Works It Out
description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

title: Egg Surprise
description: A fun clicker with economic simulation in the penguin kingdom. Obtain rare collections, venture into dangerous dungeons, and build your own civilization!

title: Blackthorn Arena: Reforged
description: Re-experience the thrill and challenges of managing a Gladiator arena in this management/simulation game. With new content with over 10 hours of gameplay, new graphics, Quality of Life updates, and all DLCs packed into this new experience, this is how Blackthorn Arena was meant to be experienced.

title: Huaxia: Warring States
description: Build your own epic story in the Huaxia: Warring States. Start a clan, conquer the lands, and build an empire. Or roam the Nine Provinces as a lone warrior fighting bandits and monsters. The choice is yours!

title: Doom: The Golden Souls 3
description: Explore giant colorful worlds while completing quests to obtain Golden Souls! You can fully explore the maps at your own pace, and even experience completed missions again!

title: Endoparasitic 2
description: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.

title: Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition
description:
The remastered edition of the acclaimed adventure features 4k, HDR, and overall improved graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. Apart from the visual improvements, it includes a brand-new Free Roam mode with a new open world spreading over several biomes that includes all playable animals and new mini-challenges!

Owners of the original game will be able to upgrade for a small upgrade fee!

A breathtakingly beautiful world holds the secrets of its past for you and your companion to uncover in this 5-hour journey.

title: DigDigDrill
description: DigDigDrill is an underground mining and resource collecting game. Dig freely for minerals and treasures. Use the items you collect to forge your original drills in a hack-and-slash style equipment system.

title: Warriors of Nova Thera
description: Warriors of Nova Thera is a roguelike action-adventure where you play as Pixelmons! Explore and battle your way through the different biomes and discover exciting encounters. Collect shardstones from your expeditions out into the wild and use them back in the game hub to unlock upgrades and become stronger.

title: SubwaySim 2
description:
Dive into Simuverse Interactive's new public transport simulation!
SubwaySim 2 allows you to explore not only the underground network of Hamburg but now also that of the German capital Berlin! Face various unique scenarios and transport your passengers safely and punctually from station to station.

title: Galactic Economy
description: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

title: Hoomanz!
description:
Scare away all the invading Hoomanz!
A stealth-adventure packed with coziness and humour, featuring non-combat gameplay & family-friendly content. Play as Shoo, the mythical guardian of Planet Erf, with a hidden dual nature. Darkness is nature’s friend, light is its enemy.

title: Sigilfarer
description: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice. Master a dice-building system while navigating a sprawling, procedurally generated world. Strategize your route, manage resources and push your luck to the limit!

title: Kinu Shoku Ryuu Hana: Weaving The Blue Orient
description: Kinu Shoku Ryuu Hana is another Touhou shooting game which is, unfortunately, not very popular due to lack of publicity. With standard gameplay, the gameplay mechanics rely on 2 features: spell card system and spark counter, with the spell card system the player may choose 2 of 7 different spell cards before embarking on a mission. The spark counter consumes magic gauge and is basically very similar to a bomb that will fire lasers to eliminate enemies and bullets. The game's story is around Marisa who is investigating magic fluctuations.

title: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
description: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

title: Micro Wars
description: Micro Wars is a fast-paced real time strategy game that throws you into the action in short, intense online battles featuring up to 8 players. Tailor your strategy with a variety of commanders and units, build your base, mine some minerals, and micro your way to victory. Hone your skills with the campaign and custom maps, and demonstrate your prowess to climb the ranks!

title: Tony Hawk's Underground 2: The Shell Secret
Tony Hawk's Underground 2: Wuhu Island from Mario Kart 7
WinDepth
description:
WinDepth is a Windows game developed by the Japanese freeware group Bio_100%. It’s an arrangement of the 1992 shooting game SuperDepth (originally for PC-9801) for Windows.
In WinDepth, players control a warship moving on the water’s surface while countless submarines lurk underwater. The objective is to destroy the submarines while avoiding their torpedoes and mines.

title: Sports: Renovations
description: Give sports facilities a second life in this relaxing first-person simulator! Restore the glory of old gyms, courts and pitches as you try to make enough money to save your hometown basketball court.

title: Half-Life 2: Game of the Year Edition
description:
The critics agree, Half-Life 2 has been named PC GAME OF THE YEAR by over 35 organizations worldwide. Play the game that set a new benchmark in gaming with its startling realism, digital actors, advanced AI, and physical gameplay.

+ Also Includes:
Counter-Strike: Source
Half-Life 2: Deathmatch
Half-Life: Source

title: Park Ranger Simulator
description: Manage your own park facility in a huge open world in Park Ranger Simulator. Take on all the tasks that need to be completed as a park ranger - alone or together in cross-platform multiplayer! You have a variety of vehicles and equipment at your disposal to complete the challenges ahead!

title: Hexahedral
description: Hexahedral is a cuboid, challeging, 3D platformer, physics based, puzzle game with specific mechanics and surreal atmosphere, where you need to understand how your movement works and use your abilities to your favor to reach as high as you can. This game is intentionally difficult and confusing at some points, though the mechanics are pretty simple, once you learn how to move propperly, you will notice it isn't enough for you to overcome it, you must as well have patience and be persistent, then you may be able to reach the end. This journey depends completly on you, so don't give up, and remember, it can always get worse.

title: Slimey Climbey Chambers
description:
Help Sobay the Slime get out of this strange tile maze! Use goop to propel yourself to new heights, and gain new forms and abilities by collecting the mega slime essence!

Made for the GMTK 2024 Jam in 96 hours, for the theme "Built to Scale!"

title: Terminal City
description:
What if you took 80s adventure games like Space Quest, crossed them with auto-runners like Canabalt and threw in a dash of Another World?

You'll need all your wits, cunning, and typing skills to make it in TERMINAL CITY, as you guide street-kid V-Loc on his quest to evade the evil Syndicate corpos and rescue his friends.

In a world of instant-deaths, no checkpoints and dead ends, how far will YOU get?

title: The Strawman Augment
description: A game made within a month with Adventure Game Studio

title: The Last Scaler
description: A Foddyvania, where you build yourself up from scrap, collect new abilities, and scale a sacred mountain.

title: Mario Doom
description: Mario Doom is an awesome unofficial mod of Doom created by Valigarmander that runs in Zandronum and GZDoom. A port running on Vanilla Doom was later made by Doomkid. The Mod acts as a texture pack replacing enemy and gun sprites alongside sound effects and animations. Since it is vanilla-compatible, it will run with any port, including the 2024 release of Doom on PS5, Switch, and Xbox.

title: Horizons: The End Of Words
description: Humanity has written all there is to write about anything and everything. Words will soon lose all meaning. Find fragments of lost words drifting in space and explore the universe through your prose.

title: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
description:
Countless souls wander the ring road at night.
The title of “fastest” never fades, no matter how times change.

The stage of battle is a sealed future Tokyo.
Race through the night highways weaving through the city in your customized machine.
Defeat the countless rivals and aim to become the fastest on the Shuto Expressway.

title: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die
description: Lost in Random: The Eternal Die is an action-packed, rogue-lite adventure in the world of Random. Play as Queen Aleksandra and wield her living die-companion Fortune, as they go all in against the ancient evil that took everything from her.

title: Musicmenia
description: Musicmenia is a strategic and musical card game. Face off online against other players, build your deck, and adapt your strategy to win. Adjust the tempo and lead your concert to victory!

title: The First Descendant: Season 1
description:
Step into the action in The First Descendant’s thrilling Season 1 Update: Invasion starting August 29th!
Tackle new dungeons, unlock fresh content, and play as Hailey, the new sniper Descendant.

title: Microsoft Flight Simulator: World Update 18
description: World Update XVIII provides pilots the highest resolution yet for the stunning scenery of Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

title: Box Bop
description: Box Bop is a simple game where you just get to tinker and play with funny physics with boxes and spheres and stuff in a ball pit. Just made as a fun little tinker game...?

title: Mightreya
description: Join schoolgirl superhero Reya and her manager Nio as they embark on their journey as Hero Content Creators, fighting monstrous beings that emerge daily from a dimension beyond. Anime-inspired, heart-pounding hero action is waiting for you!

title: FNF Weekly
description: A new FNF mod every single week? You must be tweaking, boss!

title: 13th Friday Night: Funk Blood
description: Boyfriend and Girlfriend have decided to join up few campers for a camping trip, while hanging out by themselves they decided to have some fun, but unknown to them they have entered the forbidden territory and their presence has reawakened the dormant killer.

title: Sonic Legacy
description: Sonic Legacy was a fan-made game collection celebrating the 25th anniversary of Sonic the Hedgehog. It included HD remasters of classic titles such as Sonic Adventure, Sonic Adventure 2, Sonic Heroes, Sonic the Hedgehog (2006), Sonic Free Riders, and Sonic Boom: Rise of Lyric. The game also features bonus content like playable Amy and Knuckles in Sonic CD, and special stages from Sonic 3 and Knuckles in Sonic 2.

title: Lysium: Stardiver
description: In the distant rings of the planet Alphios, rookie mechanic Samantha Krain takes her first careful steps into the field as an official member of a crew of misfit space salvagers. When a huge salvage mission turns up on the surface of the planet, however, the race is on as opportunity calls to be the first one to reach a trove of technology. Is it fortune smiling upon the intrepid explorers, or is treachery leering from the shadows...?

title: FNF: Executable Mania
description: FNF: EXEcutable Mania was a Friday Night Funkin' creepypasta mod created by danii. The mod planned to star several EXEs and internet horrors in a grab bag fashion. It has 7 songs on its demo, with more planned on its full release.

title: Friday Night Funkin' vs. LSE
description:
Vs. LongestSoloEver is a Friday Night Funkin' Mod featuring YouTube guitarist LongestSoloEver, with all new original music, artwork, charting, remixes and more.

The full week features five songs, and two "mania mode" remixes.

title: Una noche sin nombre
description: This is a world where witches and demons dwell on the fringes of reality. Charles finds himself in the rain, seeking shelter when he encounters a woman in the forest who asks him for a favor—to search for something very precious to her. At that moment, Charles finds a house and ventures inside, where he encounters a mysterious girl.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Hex
description: What's this? Your Girlfriend's father is making an award show and you're invited? Seems like nothing can go wrong! Besides that, a familiar face appears. It's Hex! Your robotic lookin' fella from before seems to have a performance scheduled during the event and he asks for your help. With the whole country watching you, people you fought before, and your Girlfriend, there's no way you could lose!

title: FNF: V.S. Tabi Ex Boyfriend
description: Your girlfriend, invited by her dad's friend for some unknown reason, asks you to come along with her. When you arrive at the place, there was no one, except for one weird guy that scared your girlfriend out. Will everything go well or is something bad going to happend

title: Pharaoh's Purse
description: An economy focused tower defense where you play as an Egyptian pharaoh seeking to reclaim his lost wealth in modern times.

title: Payday 3: Gold Pass
description: The Payday 3 Gold Pass includes all four Year 1 Expansions - Syntax Error, Boys in Blue, Houston Breakout, and Fear and Greed - as well as some special bonus content.

title: Payday 3: Houston Breakout Heist
description:
Houston is on trial for a slew of crimes, and Concord is lurking behind the scenes, waiting to snap him up the second the sentence is rendered.

Whether you sneak your way through and pass without trace, or smash your way through the judiciary system with your own brand of justice is your choice; either way, Houston has a problem, and it’s your job to solve it.

title: Shapez 2: Supporter Edition
description:
Show your support and get two unique rollercoaster inspired track pieces for your space railways, plus 40 minutes of additional music and the full soundtrack!

Rollercoaster Railway Pieces
Use the Twist and the Loop to add some rollercoaster flair to your railway lines!

Additional Music
Unlock additional 40 minutes of in-game music from the composer of the original shapez soundtrack, Petter Sumelius, with some tracks by Patrik Pettersson.
Official Soundtrack

The upgrade includes access to the full soundtrack, including the base game music and the additional music for a total of 80 minutes sci-fi inspired electronic music, keeping the essence of the original shapez sound while adding a touch of space to fit the new theme. High quality FLAC versions of every track are included.

title: Monster High Skulltimate Secrets
description: It’s your first day at Monster High, where all monsters are welcome… but some strange events are happening. Can you uncover the mystery of the doors and ancient keys and bring the school back to its authentic, spooky self? Play and discover its skulltimate secrets. Create your unique monster character with a vault full of different monster kinds, skills, and scary-chic looks to choose from. Explore the school with your beasties Clawdeen Wolf, Draculaura, and Frankie Stein, and find creeperific clues and powerful new skills. As the newest member of the Boo Crew, you’re in for one hex-citing adventure!

title: Troy: The Red Winged Hero
description: Play as Liam Newguard in a Item-Turn Based RPG game about weird things nobody asked for. Run through many locations finding new skills and spells for each of your party member's two classes. Enjoy well over 15 hours of gameplay/story in this conglomerate of inspirations I created for thee.

title: Subway Surge
description: Subway Surge is a fun endless runner game featuring pirate heroes. Navigate using your mouse, and collect gold coins by running, jumping, and sliding. Help the pirates gather all the gold!

title: Weird O's: Chaos Royale
description: Dive, dodge, and dash your way to victory in the wildest fantasy brawl! Weird O's: Chaos Royale is a 3D platforming battle royale like no other, blending hilarious co-op exploration with chaotic free-for-alls. Team up to gather crystals, unleash your animal spirit and conquer wacky obstacle courses.

title: Dead Detention (Rescribbled)
description: Dead Detention is a scribbly interactive story about a nerdy teen turned dooms day survivor! Play as 15 year old Max as he tries to escape his high school during a deadly zombie pandemic! Will he and his new friends get to safety?!

title: Cursebane
description: Cursebane is a fast-paced, stylish katana-action roguelite. Step into the forest of fate, where your choices twist your journey. Empower your sword and spells as you seek out those doomed by prophecy and save them from the Curse.

title: Clutter
description: The first un-hidden object game in the long running Clutter series of PC games

title: The Pyrite Talisman
description: The Pyrite Talisman is a 3D graphic adventure involving exploration in third person direct movement, puzzle solving and inventory use through a point & click interface. During gameplay the player will play with two characters switching through time to collect informations to progress further into the story.

title: Rubber Head Bob
description: It's a mountain climbing game with a rubber-headed human! The controls are incredibly challenging! Bounce around like crazy!

title: Snow Wave Community Project
description: Snow Wave Community project is Christmas holiday project that ran from 2023 November to January 2024. Initially, there were 21 levels submitted, but for undisclosed reasons, it became 20 levels pack. Difficulty goes from easy to really hard, use difficulty skills provided if you find set too hard to manage!

title: Block Factory
description: Block Factory is a production and automation game focusing on creating 3D figurines from building blocks in a factory. Shape your models, design and optimize your assembly lines to bring your creations to life!

title: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era
description: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Explore the map solo or in multiplayer, triumph in iconic battles and establish peace on a continent where it was never an option.

title: The Duck Song Game
description: The ever so loved The Duck Song has returned.

title: Xin Yi Tian Tu Long Ji
description: Xin Yi Tian Tu Long Ji was an RPG published in 2000 by Soft-World International Corporation. The game was adapted from The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, also known as Yi Tian Tu Long Ji, a famous Chinese martial arts novel by Jin Yong.

title: The Cope
description: The Cope is a 2D, point-and-click game that presents the fear of the unknown. Your night shift client service job as a janitor will start with you getting entangled in a series of strange stories in The Cope mansion. Work cleaning and serving your client and find the truth of this mansion of fear.

title: Guilty: Takiko's Nightmare
description: Guilty: Takiko's Nightmare is a single-player story-based game. Play as Takiko to explore several areas inside her unique reality. Players can interact with various objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, or discover some unreal phenomena.

title: Frequency of Fear
description:
"FREQUENCY OF FEAR" is a third-person, episodic psychological horror game that drags you into the disctrict of Halimun, a village that used to be known for it's mysticism, folklore, and secrets. Are you brave enough to find out? Discover what's still there in Halimun District!

Play as Maya, an aspiring urban explorer. Break taboos, film forbidden places, and explore the district of Halimun. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, but be careful. Some curses don’t wait to be believed. Stay hidden, and don’t get caught!

title: Psycho Dead
description: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

title: DeMyth
description: DeMyth is a short puzzle game inspired by Helltaker. In it, you Interact with cute demit girls to find your missing aunt in the Astral Realm.

title: Onward: Asylum
description: Going onwards as we escape this horrific asylum— an indie 2D horror sidescroller where your task is to get out of the facility without getting captured by the monster itself.

title: Disconnect
description: What happened to the protagonist !?!? You're a skull, connect the dots in the platforming levels to expand upon the story and solve the mystery. All set in a black and white art style, inspired by classic 80/90s Punk posters.

title: La Perlas
description: A survival horror set in the Philippines.

title: Demon Guardian
description:
Four girls and a newbie witch doctor explore their friend's haunted house. Although welcoming at first glance, the house shows its true colors when night falls...

Based on the ghosts and beliefs of Thai folklore, Demon Guardian is a visual novel with multiple endings, told from the perspective of Pim, a girl who attract spirits. She quickly drew the attention of the new transfer student, who seems to have a ton of these spirits under his control...

title: Backyard Beans
description: Lovingly smack your loved ones and stylishly throw them into various things! As Backyard Beans, you meet where it hurts and joyfully brawl through your circle of friends.

title: Microsoft Golf: Multimedia Edition
description: Multimedia Edition adds video segments such as tutorials, course previews and tips as well as more voiced samples and sounds for a more interactive experience.

title: Zooika
description:
Zooika is a casual puzzle game where you match animals in order to create a larger animal. It's a Suika style game with animals, leaderboards, challenges, achievements.

It features Twitch integration, allowing chat to play the game in 'chat plays' mode. And a whole new dimension is unlocked when chat plays against/with the streamer, voting on events and effects to occur and helping or hindering the streamer.

title: Aether Diving
description:
"The Aether Diving program aims to perceive energy levels in the body and help get rid of imperfections. These imperfections get in the way of a healthy lifestyle. Pairing the latest in technology and relentless study of the Divine Scriptures, we have kept our followers’ faults and defects at bay. Join us now, diving deep into consciousness and freeing the mind from torment. Enlightment awaits."
-High Priest Maxime

title: Uboat Attack
description: Rise through the ranks and become a legendary commander!

title: The Secret Behind the Exam Paper
description: A first person horror decryption game with bizarre rules

title: Assassin's Creed Mirage: The Forty Thieves
description: The Forty Thieves is a downloadable content expansion for Assassin's Creed: Mirage, following Basim Ibn Ishaq as he investigates the legend of the Forty Thieves. Initially given to players who pre-ordered the game, it was later made available to all players on Ubisoft Connect for 60 units.

title: Solaris 2
description: Free online MMORPG game. Play with your friends. Conquer the continent and be the best. This is a private server for Metin2.

title: Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level
description: Sega vs. Capcom: The Next Level is a fan game made by 4CYDE Studios that crosses over the two major franchises, resembling the combat style of Tatsunoko vs. Capcom.

title: Artifact Seeker: DLC 1 - The Legacy of Mortia
description: New characters, new maps, new boss, new Synergy, new artifacts, new events, and many more new contents await everyone’s exploration!

title: Brute Horse
description: Brute Horse takes you into a savage world of South Vulgaria. Play as barbarian called "Brute", carrying his injured companion through the divided kingdoms. With the help of Michelle, an inventress, forge an unlikely bond, either in singleplayer or coop, that will change Brute's fate forever.

title: 60 Minute Marathon 2
description: 60 Minute Marathon 2 is a 74-map MBF21-compatible gigawad made (mostly) in a single hour, just like last time, but with more than twice the friends, including me, @Synami, and new friends @Phoenyx and @OverflowingMocha, twice the "production quality" as last time, and even a completely bespoke soundtrack made by Phoenyx! Much like the first 60 Minute Marathon, this was mostly a fairly simple yet somewhat extreme mapping exercise, this time with four mappers all making 16 maps over an hour and deciding to jam them all together at the end alternating between each mapper, with maps only being edited after the designated hour to actually make them possible.

title: Piglet's Big Game
description: Point-and-click adventure game loosely based off the 2003 film Piglet's Big Movie, where the main objective is for Piglet to collect all the ingredients for a soup in the Hundred-Acre Wood's annual Very Large Soup Party.

title: Cold Steel
description: A classic RTS with a major twist. Your units are fully autonomous drones. Every unit runs code which you design using an intuitive visual coding interface. Automate everything from mining, to combat, even unit production.

title: Drömmar
description: Drömmar is a map based on images from Astar's dreams related to doom.

title: Battle Wizard Attack
description: Unleash your inner spell caster in this action-packed, retro-style RPG! Choose from eight powerful magic disciplines and face monstrous hordes across sprawling maps packed with destructible chaos.

title: Sprawl 96
description: Sprawl 96 adds enemies and gameplay from the 2023 game Sprawl into the original Quake.

title: Reignbreaker
description: Lockpicks meet spiked iron gauntlets in this 'medievalpunk' single-player action-roguelike. Fight through hordes of lock-operated mechs and free the world from the corrupt elite. Plunder their coffers, smash the kingdom and become The Reignbreaker.

title: Hidalgo
description: Embark on the most iconic and cozy adventures from the classic novel "Don Quixote of La Mancha". In a handcrafted, colorful puppet world, you'll battle windmills, be knighted, will solve puzzles with Don Quijote and Sancho and fight for the love of your beloved Dulcinea.

title: Trickster Trove
description: Feel the fear and adrenaline in the deadly dungeons in search of treasures. Create impenetrable catacombs, protecting loot from other players. Test your skills and strategies in a world where every decision can be your last. One life - one chance!

title: Telly the TV
description:
Telly the TV is a throwback action/adventure platformer with a 1-bit style. You'll explore six themed worlds while collecting Remote Control Keys in a scavenger hunt gone wild. Can you defeat the baddies of TV Kingdom and restore the airwaves?

Enter six exciting and quirky worlds while bashing baddies and traversing terrible traps! Collect items to save each TV program, and face-off with the enemies of TV Kingdom.

title: Micro Ninja
description: A game that fits into a 64 x 64 space, made to LOWREZJAM.

title: Nodebuster
description: Nodebuster is a short, experimental incremental game about busting nodes and destroying reality.

title: Squirreled Away
description: Be the squirrel. Scurry through gardens, up trees, and leap limb to limb in this craft and thrive park life adventure. Explore solo or with up to three squirrel buddies in co-op. Meet and help other residents and collect bits here and there to build and decorate your dream treehouse.

title: Anonono. Kimi to Sugoshita Ano Hi Ano Toki Ano Mirai
description:
The protagonist suddenly returns to those bygone days of three years ago ...

Leading a life choked with regret, just wishing that he could have one chance to set things right ...

The protagonist is an ordinary college student, living out his tedious days in relative peace. But even through his college life, he feels a kind of disquiet that is hard to place -- the root of which comes from the incidents of a certain failed school festival three years ago. After that time, the life and the friends that he had known were scattered to the winds, leaving him with the life he knows now.

But if he had the opportunity to do things over again, to set things right, what would he do?

title: The Life of Me
description:
The story revolves around Oliver, an eighteen-year-old man who has just moved back to the town he grew up in. Amidst old friends and new acquaintances, he learns about the world of grown-ups; responsibilities, sexual exploration, and that everyone has secrets they wish to keep hidden.

Will he find love, uncover his friends' secrets, or just learn to enjoy what the world has to offer?

title: Words Guesser
description:
Words Guesser is an engaging word puzzle game that brings the thrill of collaborative gameplay directly to your Twitch stream. In this game, you and your viewers work together to uncover hidden words from a jumbled board of letters displayed on your screen. With each round, you'll need to find as many words as possible, relying on your community’s quick thinking and sharp eyes.

Each level presents a unique board of scrambled letters, challenging you to discover a majority of the hidden words to advance. The game progressively increases in difficulty by introducing trick letters and mystery letters that only reveal themselves after a certain time or when a player successfully guesses them.

title: Golf: The Ultimate Collection
description:
This collections consists of:
- British Open Championship Golf Special Edition
- Greg Norman Ultimate Challenge Golf
- Picture Perfect Golf: Harbor Town Golf Links
- GolfAmerica (a golf guide)

title: Boosted Survivors
description:
Boosted Survivors is a sandbox rogue-like, filled to the brim with exciting secrets. Fight dangerous waves of enemies, find legendary upgrades, and boost your hero along the way.

Boosting lets you increase or decrease any value of your hero, weapons and abilities, giving you complete freedom to reinterpret the game in new and exciting ways. Every run is completely unique and limited only by your creativity.

title: Cactiverse
description: The world of Cactiverse, where gardening meets dragon-fueled fun! Grow your cacti, unleash fireballs, and join a vibrant community on Discord. With weekly tournaments and hilarious gameplay, Cactiverse is your next obsession. Fun, challenging, and social—what more could you ask for?

title: Car!
description:
CAR! is a simple game set against a mountain backdrop under a nice blue sky. With the player controlling the car, traverse down the road, whilst trying not to fall off and avoiding obstacles along the way.

CAR was nominated for the BAFTA YGD (Young Game Designers) Game Making 10-14 Award Too!

title: Motioning Monument
description: This game that need a little imagination, exploring the abstract landscape and aim of revive mysterious monument. Collect motion fragments and place them in the right place to revive the monument. Enjoy the exploring and letting your imagination run wild!

title: Cinnabar Nights
description: Cinnabar Nights is a first-person rpg with turn-based combat. Explore diverse landscapes, unearth powerful equipment, manage your resources, and harness otherworldly powers.

title: SimCity 2000: Scenarios Volume 1: Great Disasters
description:
Scenarios Volume 1: Great Disasters is an expansion pack for SimCity 2000. This particular addition adds a total of 10 harrowing scenarios which range from a fictitious UFO attack in Atlanta, Georgia – in Dec. 2050 no less – to the very real great Mississippi floods of 1993 (the Davenport flood in this particular instance). Play SimCity 2000 Scenarios Volume 1: Great Disasters online!

This expansion was bundled with SimCity 2000 Bonus Cities and Scenarios and the SimCity 2000 Urban Renewal Kit for Maxis’ 1995 release of a special CD-ROM edition of SimCity 2000.

title: Hoky
description:
Hoky is a minimalist local multiplayer game from the abstract minds of Kitty Calis and Jan Willem Nijman, with audio by Eirik Suhrke.
A non-traditional take on the classic sport of hockey, HOKY bends the rules and intentionally avoids deep knowledge of the source material.
Ignorance or a fresh perspective? There's only one way to find out!
Up to 4 players grab their sticks and slide onto the ice, cheered on by dynamic audience AI and their personal lust for sports.

title: Hellmouth
description: Hellmouth is a competitive cooking game where players collect ingredients from a hellish death course and cook it to perfection to feed Satan. Created by Fantastic Arcade 2014’s BARFCADE host Thu Tran and her Cleveland Games collaborator Ivan Safrin.

title: Risky Bison
description: Risky Bison is a game about managing the financial affairs of a herd of buffalo, from the creator of Fantastic Arcade favorite Enviro Bear 2000 and Desert Golfing.

title: 1986 Scary Mr. Chainsaw Escape
description: Solve the puzzles & use the tools. Get away from Psychopath butcher. He is mad!

title: HeShe
description: 2 players cooperative platform puzzle. Made after LD30, this is the post-compo version.

title: The House of Da Vinci VR
description: Experience the world of The House of Da Vinci like never before in this captivating VR puzzle adventure. Solve complex puzzles, uncover hidden items, and escape rooms, all embodying the Renaissance spirit. Use your intellect to discover what led to your master’s disappearance.

title: Kimi sae Ireba
description: Hundreds of years later, humans and Heflites coexist on a hidden planet near Earth. Finding a mate is the goal, but will something like that really help her break free from the deep darkness she experienced as a child? "...This feeling...is not an obsession..."

title: El Camino Del Zorro
description: El Camino del Zorro or The Fox's Path in English is a platform game created for a school project. It's about our character, Foxy, who wants to return home. Along the way, he encounters some difficulties.

title: Apartment Story
description: A third-person thriller about three people and a gun in a single apartment. Navigate escalating real-time narrative events whilst managing Sims-esq stats to stay strong for an inevitable showdown. You play as Arthur, a young man trying to make it day to day before a gun turns his life upside down.

title: Single Player Tarkov
description: SPT is a mod that allows you to play Escape from Tarkov offline and customize your game settings.

title: Pokemon Tactics
description:
From a region where Pokémon are feared, you accompany Professor Ceibo, a researcher isolated from society. To the region of Xicadia, a place where humans and Pokémon live in peace, fighting hand in hand... and with each other.
The objective: To investigate on an evolutionary method, which manifests itself with the bonds of humans and Pokémon, an evolutionary method for humans.
For that Professor Ceibo together with 3.... well 4 mercenaries to help you. Brigham, a bard with a face of few friends accompanied by his Chimchar, Lily's older brother. Lily, a girl who supports her cowardly Chikorita from a distance. Murchadh, a berserker with a good heart but who doesn't talk much about his past, accompanied by a friendly Mudkip. Finally Valentina, a thunder mage accompanied by a rather lazy Shinx.

title: Pokémon Consonancia
description: Pokémon Consonance, inspired by Pokémon Masters, is a game in which you will travel to Passio as a novice trainer, there you will meet different characters from all the official releases together, from Kanto to Paldea, as well as characters brought by the Masters, such as Professor Margarita, You will participate in the WPM, a high level tournament that seeks to determine the strongest trainer of all, to achieve this task, you must improve as a trainer, but also, you must recruit different characters for your team, some of them will do it by history but many of them will depend on a RNG factor: The gachapon mode. It won't be easy to be the best, so testing strategies and team combinations will be fundamental!

title: Pokémon Abismal
description:
A thousand years ago, a meteorite hit the Kingdom of Celestia. From its interior, an evil being emerged that tried to plunge the world into darkness, but after a bloody war, that being was banished to another dimension... Until now, because it is said that the seal that held him captive has been destroyed.

Live a unique adventure to unravel the mysteries surrounding the Kingdom of Celestia. A radical climate change, the appearance of the mysterious Astral Pokémon and the existence of a sect that worships the Dark Star are just some of the many threats to the peace of the kingdom.

Will you be able to save Celestia from its end or will you be a mere witness to its destruction?

title: Pokémon Sombras de Arceus
description:
Pokémon Shadows of Arceus is a deconstruction of the traditional Pokémon story, giving it a more strategic touch and offering a real challenge for Pokémon lovers.

The story focuses on exploration, getting all the necessary resources to continue the adventure and is open, you can do it in the order you want.

There will be training facilities to be able to create different combat strategies.

Create your ultimate multicolored team thanks to the random shiny wells!

The story originates in the region of Heria, where a group of scientists manage to develop a whole industry around Pokémon battles.
Their mission is to train Pokémon for competition and sell them to trainers to gain popularity in battles and funding for their projects.
They use the same cloning method they used with Mewtwo. Thanks to him, they started to awaken and capture legendaries to make Pokémon battling a much bigger spectacle.
But something terrible happened when they awakened Arceus and the world as we know it was almost destroyed to ashes.

The story is set 10 years after this event and shows us a post-apocalyptic world, plagued by very strong wild Pokémon and evildoers lurking around every corner.
After suffering an attack, our protagonist receives his first Pokémon and once he overcomes the first challenge of getting his first medal, the destiny that has been waiting for him for so long, finally appears.

title: 6 Great Games: Windows XP Edition
description:
Compilation of 6 games consisting of:

- Creatures 3
- Microsoft Golf 1998 Edition
- Missile Command
- New Vegas Games
- Platinum Pinball
- Tomb Raider III: Adventures of Lara Croft

title: Pokémon Berilo
description:
In your region, there's no training for Pokémon trainers, and thanks to Professor Rosa, an acquaintance of your parents, you get a ticket to Nubia. There you get your first Pokémon and can challenge the eight Leaders of the region to challenge the Champion. In your path will cross a completely untraditional Villain Team, what will they want? What will be their role in your adventure? They are up to something and you can be sure it won't be good.

Traversing Nubia will be no easy task, full of story elements, quests, ruins, hidden treasures and colorful NPCs that will help you in your adventure (or not). If you are a person who enjoys exploring everything and looking for the hidden secrets of the game, you will find that the game is not easy.

title: Picture Perfect
description: WARNING 18+: You're a photographer who is close with three young women. There's 18 year-old Miracle who is so shy and introverted she won't leave the house without you. 20 year-old Sasha who dreams of starring on Broadway. And 22 year-old Paris who dropped out of college to mooch off you once more.

title: Pokémon Pro
description:
Developed with Pokémon PSDK for RPG Maker XP, you will enter a new region called Zealon. With your pokémon team and your friends, you will face challenges in which your skills as a trainer will be tested. Get ready for an adventure where the darkness can catch you. But remember: Stars only shine when the sky is dark.

In the past, the Zealon region was inhabited by humans. The pokémon were predominant throughout the region, until one day it was discovered by humans. This caused a great conflict in being conquered by the great powers of that time, causing great wars for the territories of the region.

Not all humans had the same greed to obtain the territory of others. One trainer wanted harmony in the region.
This same trainer created an alliance of a few trainers to help end the wars that the region was suffering, after seeing that the great powers did not want to reach a pact. But even so, the alliance was not enough to stop the wars.

Pharaoh, legendary Pokémon and considered sovereign of life. He had been observing the wars caused by greed for decades. He came to the conclusion that these wars were caused by the conflicts of the humans themselves.
The balance of life among the pokémon was breaking down and Pharaoh ordered Kenaice and Spiwolf, pokémon guardians of the balance between life and death, to stop these wars.

Kenaice and Spiwolf appeared in the battle. Thanks to their power they were able to put an end to the wars, and helped those trainers and pokémon who wanted harmony by giving them some of their energy to recover.

That trainer and his companions, managed that several cultures lived in harmony for many years and thanks to those legendary pokémon the balance between life and death was restored.

Nowadays, during your adventure in exploring the region and overcoming the challenges that await you, you will be involved in the chaotic history that can happen again in the Zealon region.

title: Pokémon Panteón
description: In an ancient region called Olympia, our protagonist embarks on an incredible odyssey proposed by the philosopher professor Palmiro. Defeat the leaders of the different Agoras of the region and solve their mysteries. Confront the students of the Platena Academy and meet your eternal rivals, Lira and Aulo.

title: Pokémon Z
description: Discover what happened in the Kalos region 300 years ago.

title: Brigand: Nightmare
description:
BRIGAND - NIGHTMARE revamps the original story of BRIGAND - OAXACA, adding in more difficulty and new features from the BRIGAND - PANAMA DLC such as woodcraft, traps, and voodoo-casting baddies, as well as a new optional map accessible from Chapter 6 on.

It's a lot harder than the original, meant for hardcore fans. Hunger increases 50% faster, and baddie AI now picks up items. There is also a partial Spanish translation included called NIGHTMARE (ES).

title: Tiny Technologies
description:
Think with scaling! Resize object and yourself in order to navigate through 8 puzzle levels.
The game was inspired by Portal and Talos Principle and created as part of the GMTK 2024 game jam

title: Pokémon Conquerors
description: The Ransei Region is divided into kingdoms for each elemental type, and these are at constant war. Nobunaga the Warlord of the dragon kingdom of the North has the ambition to conquer all Ransei to destroy it, and you, the protagonist Warlord of Aurora must find a way to stop him by forming your army.

title: Pokémon Hero
description:
Pokémon Hero is an original Pokémon adventure beyond gym leaders, featuring a cast of characters who may see you as a hero or villain based on your actions. It includes Pokémon from all generations, adaptive enemies across three difficulty levels, and mandatory and optional bosses.
Scripted battles add strategy and narrative, while Zorua illusion zones reveal hidden treasures and mysteries. Explore an extensive map with Ultraflight, complete missions and achievements, and take on riddles and challenges alongside extras like Pokémon following you and route-based Pokémon tracking.

title: Pokémon Evol
description: Choose your partner and begin your Pokémon adventure in the Dalaris region. Crime has increased and someone close to you has been splashed. Does this mean that an old Team Villain is about to return?

title: Pokémon Existence
description:
Original Pokémon (only a few families) ranging from Gen 1 to Gen 9. (For now, there is access to 40 families within the fangame).
In total, the game features over 200 Pokémon species, most of them being original to the game, native species.
It features the Mega Evolution mechanics, although the concept has been readapted and is based on the “Divinization” of the species, which are orbs that react to the Vital Particle.
Creation of many new moves with very diverse effects, in addition to a large number of moves per tutor, which gives more variety of attacks to the game.
Within the Gyms, there will be 1 employee who will be able to teach useful moves to the protagonist, beyond those already found as normal with the passage of the adventure.
It does not have mechanics such as Dynamax or Z-Moves, since it does not make much sense for the development of our story. However, apart from the forms by Divinization, there are also several form changes between species, fusions and use of armor (without the need for a final evolutionary phase).
There are several regional forms of existing Pokémon (examples would be Slugma and Sableye).
Improved the probability of finding shiny Pokémon.

title: Habromania
description: HABROMANIA is an offbeat, unsettlingly charming, narrative rich point-and-click game inspired by Alice in Wonderland. It follows 19-year-old, well-mannered Alice as she tumbles headfirst into Wonderland. With no memory of her past and no real allies except an enigmatic, grinning cat, Alice must outwit, outmatch, and maybe even befriend the mildly psychotic people and creatures she encounters as she tries to return to her world - with or without going mad herself.

title: MadBreak
description: Dive into MadBreak, a captivating reimagining of the beloved "Brick Breaker" game. With each level, you'll face exhilarating challenges that push your skills to the limit. Can you master the unique twists and turns that MadBreak throws your way? Break through the ordinary and embrace the extraordinary. Test your reflexes, strategize your moves, and discover if you have what it takes to conquer MadBreak! Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled journey where every block shattered brings you closer to victory. Are you up for the challenge? Game SUPPORTs controller use!

title: Frog Galaxy Survivor
description: Hi, it's Frogus! A nasty vortex has appeared in the sky and turned my frog friends and the Earth into puzzle pieces! Help me find them in these different space universes and platforms !

title: Wuthering Waves: In the Turquoise Moonglow
description:
Version 1.2 of Wuthering Waves, which included:
• New characters: Zhezhi and Xiangli Yao
• New main event: By Moon's Grace
• New companion story for Zhezhi: True Colors
• New echoes, events and more!

title: The Midnight Bus
description: A short narrative horror experience, in which you find yourself in the middle of nowhere in a snowstorm without knowing what has happened to the driver or the other passengers in the vehicle, you just know that there is something out there lurking.

title: a Dragon's reQuest
description: a Dragon's reQuest is nominally a classic-styled retro JRPG with a few modern bells and whistles: Character talkie-pictures, exhaustive character dialog, DEEPLY investigatable background maps, difficult subject matter, mature character relationships that occasionally get sexual, spicy subject matter, bunny suits, and-

title: Five Nights at Freddy's Cleanup Crew: Employee Assessment Teaser
description: Hide from animatronics and sneak your way through environments on the exciting Story Mode, discovering the deepest and darkest secrets that lurk within a mysterious partner to Fazbear Entertainment.

title: Garrulismo
description: Garrulismo is a Doom II megawad created by Eye del Cul. It contains 32 maps and was first released on October 16, 2003. Its title is Spanish and can be loosely translated to "thuggery", and the mod's irreverent tone contains many references to popular Spanish media and pop culture, seen most prominently in its humorous story. The title screen features popular Spanish singer José Luis Cantero Rada and comedian Chiquito de la Calzada.

title: Hispanic Community Project
description: Hispanic Community Project {HCP} is a boom-format megawad inspired by Doom 2 In Spain Only and JPCP made by members of the hispanic doom community and spanish-speaking mappers. Thanks to @OceanMadman for the project's idea!

title: Date with Modeus
description:
Let me ask you this:
"Do you want to have a lovely date with Modeus? "
Well... In this silly little Visual Novel game, You can do just that :D

title: FM7X: Continental Odyssey
description: Continental Odyssey, a full-fledged episode consisting of 7 single player levels, 2 of these are secret and 4 are multiplayer-only.

title: Memetomo
description: A turn-based card battle game with RPG elements, in which you must use more than 140 cat cards to win battles and become a “cat meme master”!

title: Ashunnor's Game
description: A short, fully hand-drawn visual novel about the magical fantasy kingdom of Thrungia.

title: Find Cats 3
description: “A cute game for cat lovers of all ages! There are several maps and the opportunity to look for furry ones that are hiding intelligently!”

title: Storm Cleaner
description:
Action Cozy meet Hidden Object games.

You are a Storm Cleaner. After a storm left an island, you will visit them and organize everythings to their original position.

title: The Wicked Witch of the West
Bear in Venice
description: Be the bear, take the ride.

title: I Klopi tou Krasiou
description: When the carnival of Potamia is once more up against conditions of sabotage, Nionios, the carnival mascot will have to save the day, with the help of the association, and this year with yours as well!

title: Pinochestein 3D
description: First-Person Shooter based off a standalone version of the Zandronum engine.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Tyranid Elites
description: Two deadly new units join the Tyranid roster in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector: the nightmarish Broodlord, and the devastating Hive Guard.

title: Cold as Hell
description: Cold as Hell is a total conversion for Doom II set in a fictional military research facility in Greenland in the 1950's.

title: SCP: Containment Breach Multiplayer
description: Multiplayer survival horror game based on stories from the SCP Foundation. The game is about a facility containing anomalous entities known as SCPs. When a catastrophic containment breach occurs at one of the facilities, it is your main goal to escape the facility. Try to escape with your friends!

title: Fatal Run 2089
description: Atari’s Fatal Run 2089 delivers over-the-top driving action across a post-apocalyptic landscape. You’ll have to race against a countdown clock at incredibly high-speeds and destroy enemy vehicles by any means necessary. Fail to complete your missions and you put humanity in jeopardy.

title: A Secret Between You and Me
description:
"A Secret Between You and Me" is an adult visual novel game in the horror-adventure genre.
Become the protagonist and win the heart of the mysterious heroine.
This game is a sequel to the free PC game, "You, Me, and Empty Words."

title: Mihomi Dream
description:
“This is the venomous cry of a person defeated by life.”

A novel containing two stories, Mihomi and her brother's point of views.

A fandisc for Menherafflesia.

title: A House in the Rift
description: A HOUSE IN THE RIFT is a sandbox harem game with monthly updates. It’s densely packed and easy to navigate.

title: Matsuri Messiah
description:
“Would you like to peek in my heart, which is darker than the abyss?”

Two short stories. A story of Matsuri's past, and a future where she lived.

A fandisc for Menherafflesia

title: Nenene Noble
description:
“If you fail to realize your happiness, you will step into despair. Like poison corroding a flower..."

Nenene's point of view, of her past and behind the scenes of Menherafflesia.

title: Strigoi
description:
"We, my sister and I, have long lived abroad, together with the longing for our homeland. Not long ago, we received an invitation to a party in Romania, in the Carpathians. My sister, without hesitation, got into the car and left. I refused to go, but after some time I received a terrifying message from my sister. Frightened, I dropped everything and quickly set out to find her. I wonder what happened?"

Strigoi is a first-person horror shooter set in the Carpathian Mountains. You will face various enemies (Vampires, Strigoi...), encounter interesting puzzles, and find different items that will help you overcome obstacles and enemies.

title: Haitoku Shirene: Anata no Shiranai Naraku no Soko
description:
You must not set foot in this story with a pure and loving heart.
When you pursue the forbidden secret of the girl, you will be struck down to the depths of hell...

title: Kubitori Sarasa
description:
Attack, or be attacked? A Japanese horror game where you spend a night together with a beautiful woman.

You're a man lost in the snowy mountains and a beautiful woman saves your life! The blizzard is so bad that you're going to spend the night in her hut together.

Will he attack her, or will she attack him?

title: Mojika: Truth Rears Its Ugly Head
description: Haunted by the ability to read minds, Suteru embarks on a journey of revenge against those who wronged him. Uncovering the secrets of his tormentors, he must confront his demons in a story that explores the depths and darkness of the human mind.

title: Yanderella Death Harem
description:
“The worst, worst, and most beloved story, told all over again...”

A story from Hinata and Honoka's point of views.

A fandisc for Yanderella.

title: Jammer Dash
description: Jammer Dash is a 2D rhythm game in which you move and destroy objects on beat made for Windows and Linux! Inspired by many awesome games such as Muse Dash, Geometry Dash and osu!. Made in Unity and C#.

title: Sacrifice Villains
description: Ever since the day the powers appeared, crime has ruled the streets of Scum City. As the conniving villains grow stronger and stronger, and the heroes find themselves walloped rather than walloping... it falls to you to rehabilitate S-rank villains in this short visual novel!

title: Mikuri Sacrament
description:
“At the end of the world, a girl leaves behind her femininity and locks her heart in ice."

A story of Mikuri's past and her meeting with Megi and Angelica from her point of view.

A fandisc for The Cradle of Ruin.

title: Death's Apprentice
description: Death's Apprentice is a PC-Windows game. It's an Arcade Platformer with a linear progression through the stages.

title: Kimi to Boku to Hitorigoto
description:
“Well then, here and now, let's talk about the truth that was never revealed.”

Empty words, secret words and finally, "my own words". Everything about the mysterious boy "Akino" is revealed here.

title: The Nightscarred: Forgotten Gods
description: Embrace your destiny as the daughter of Erlik, the god of death, in this immersive first-person action game. Craft your own spells, creatively combine them with Nightscarred's hybrid combat system, and assassinate your foes to restore balance in a physics-driven shamanic world based on Turkic mythology. Play alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode.

title: Yanderain
description:
Poor communication skills, plain, dumb, poor, and gloomy is all that could be said to describe this story's protagonist, Amatarou, who is an unpopular student with nothing special going for him. He begins to have a secret relationship with Shigure Yadori, an honors student in his class.

When it rains, unbeknownst to anyone, the two of them have a secret rendezvous behind the school building. Forced to do vile crimes and hardcore sexual acts by Yadori, the worthless Amatarou begins to develop a superiority complex from having a secret relationship with her and becomes engulfed in her twisted relationship.

title: Yona Yona
description:
Nekura Yotarou is an employee of an old-fashioned love hotel "Hotel Yonaguni". One of his hobbies was peeking into the nightly affairs of his guests night after night.

One day while he was doing his usual peeking, he saw something he should not have seen. His destiny changes when he learns of a certain secret of the hotel...

title: Saikoro Saiko: Memento Mori
description:
“Death is salvation. I'm sure she would want it too.”

Behind the scenes of Saikoro Saiko, the story of Saiko.
The fearsome yandere who knows everything, and what happened to her.

title: Saikoro Saiko: Promises
description:
“Someday — Someday, until this happy dream gets shattered.”

Two short stories. A sequel to Saikoro Saiko that reveals what happens to Metarou and Saiko. And a prequel to Saikoro Saiko that shows us the story about a promise between two girls, Nana and Saiko.

title: Saikoro Saiko: Miss Fortune
description:
“This is something that can't be helped, you see. To be pitiful... is just so cute.”

Two stories regarding Saiko.
Lethal dose of Delusion: The story of Saiko's first love with Metarou, from her point of view. In order to monopolize his heart, I have to be in more pain. In order to be seen as pitiful, her self-harming ways escalate...
Danger Rhododendron: A story from Metarou's perspective of what happens to him and Saiko after the IF end. Just when you think happiness is yours...

title: Tsukame, Jinsei no Migiuchi! GoGo Zenkaiten Arashi wo Yobu! Honoo no Pachinkas Road
description:
The main character, Gintarou, is a salaryman working at a cell phones sale company. Ever since his senior taught him how to play Pachinko, he's been going to the Pachinko parlor to play. One day, he sees a customer who seems to have lost at Pachinko.

“ Uwaaaaaaaaaaaan—!!! Uwaaaaaaaaa—!!!”

The man's roar echoed sadly. I felt as if there were a melody... like a flower yearning for the spring breeze. People passing through simply laughed at the man and took pictures, eventually an employee came from inside the store and taps the man on the shoulder, signalling him to leave. It's surely an unacceptable reality for that man... I can understand how he feels. Because I, too, am a man on the loser's path. That man's present will become my future.

That is how the protagonist is living, before he meets “Reiyo Yuria” at the Pachinko parlor, changing his life completely...

title: Gozen 4-ji no Manimani: Nisemono World's End
description:
An ordinary writer creates, longing to be like God [Fenikkusu]. One night, at 4 AM, he meets a mysterious girl called "Feni" in a park. "Oji-san, would you like to know the truth... or would you remain happier if you were blissfully unaware?"

She entrusts the protagonist with a mysterious, golden bird's egg. If the protagonist can make someone happy, the phoenix can rise again. "What I am about to tell you is the end of the fake world, that was created by God."

The girl speaks to him, "This is a story of love, madness and the bizarre, the end of... "me"."
At 4 am, the Phoenix awaits its end. You and I, who have sinned, spend our last moments together.

title: Mikoto Memory
description:
A mid-length novel game containing two stories.
Pandora Diary — a story where Mikoto tells a “certain someone” about her sins, her loves and her vow, and “he” who atoned for those sins.
Happy Birthday • Happy End — Several years after Matarou turns himself in, leaving behind Mikoto and Mitarou. Several years later, on April 27th, Mikoto and Mitarou hold a birthday party for Mikoto's birthday. In the meanwhile, the police are informed of an escaped inmate in the neighborhood...

A fandisc of Mikoto Nikki.

title: Megi Amantes
description:
"...... Thank you for being born, my precious treasure."

This disc contains two short scenarios.

A Dream of a Mechanical Doll and a Fetus:
A story about Megi's past life and her life now. Her memories of becoming a doll, and the meaning of her birth as told by the girl in the blue flower field.

At the End of the Blue Star's Dream:
A sequel to the main story of Cradle of Ruin. After Hotarou leaves the shelter, those who he left behind are...

title: Hatsumonogatari
description:
Which of the four heroines will you choose?

Detarou is enrolling into a private school, the formerly girls-only "Lovely Academy", which has only become co-ed starting this year. Deepen your romance with the heroines via interacting with them after-school! Which of these heroines will become your first love?

title: Plant Mall
description:
There are 3 warlords who need to cover their mess with beautiful flowers. A gardener's job in society is to cover the world in flowers on their own free will, but also for anyone who asks, no matter who they may be. You are the Gardener.

This game is a small maze explorer where you will plant flowers and meet new faces along the way.

title: Lost Paradise of Karuta
description:
"The one who came to meet me as I attempted suicide was a pure white grim reaper."

"A visual novel ensemble drama gift for those who find living in the present difficult."

A visual novel game themed around life and the human psyche, dedicated to those struggling to live in today's challenging times. This is a story searching for the answer to why we live.

title: StellwerkSim
description: StellwerkSim is a simulator game about german signalling. Its based of the german Sp DR S 60 signal system. Its singleplayer (training mode) or multiplayer.

title: Houmatsu Tunnel
description:
There's a tunnel that is rumored to allow you to meet a dead person if you pass through it at 2am.
After hearing this, Kyoka, decides to go to the tunnel with his boyfriend Yukio, but...

A short BL visual novel.

title: Shuyaku ni Narenai Boku-tachi ha Kadan de Kaeru wo Tsubusunda.
description:
Kimura Natsuya is average at everything he does, with a complex about his mediocrity.
Then, a celebrity called Tokiwa Akihiko, who was known as a one in a hundred million beautiful boy, appears before Natsuya...

-- Natsuya's emotions are shaken by Akihiko's presence...

title: Sayo-kun no Omajinai
description:
When he was in elementary school, Suzue Masato met Tsutsui Sayo, who was in the next class, at a psychiatric clinic.
Sayo asks Masato to be his friend.
They promise to stay friends forever, and so the two become best friends.
However, after becoming a junior high school student, Sayo becomes addicted to online streaming and starts to get estranged from Masato.
Feeling betrayed, Masato started hating Sayo and posting hateful comments on anonymous message boards, but...

A short BL visual novel.

title: Inkya Danshi de Asobou!
description:
Chifuyu, the main character, has a cute face but his personality is the worst sexual pervert.
Chifuyu also bullies and humiliates his "toy" Natsuna today!!!

title: Saitama Zombie Parade
description:
In 2121, there was a zombie outbreak in Saitama.
Saitama had turned to pandemonium.

Run. Run. Run.
I wonder how long I've been running for now.
I can't stop. If I do, I'm dead meat.
I mean, I'm in the very middle of a zombie apocalypse!
No matter where I go, there's zombies walking around.
I can't seem to find a single human that hadn't yet been transformed.
I would imagine people all around the world have already turned,
but then again, it feels like the virus is only still running rampant here.

"Ooh... A-aagh..."

A zombie suddenly walked out from behind a utility pole.
"This is it", I thought, closing my eyes reflexively.

I was ready to get bitten, but I didn't feel any pain.
Instead, I heard a sharp buzz and the sound of meat being cleaved.
Then, the zombie let out an agonized moan.
When I opened my eyes, I saw...

My friend Makina, wielding a chainsaw.

title: Animal Water Pang!
description: Combine cute animal plushies to earn points and create larger plushies! Try not to let the plushies spill out of the claw machine on your quest for a high score.

title: White Eternal
description: There's something hiding in the cold of winter. What made your friend disappear? Snow's begun to fall. Let's just wait a little bit longer.

title: Ignition Arena
description: Ignition Arena is a competitive space combat game where players build and customize their own starships to engage in intense PvP battles. Set in a futuristic arena, the game emphasizes strategic shipbuilding and fast-paced combat. Players can choose from a wide array of ship components, including weapons, armor, and equipment, to create their ideal battle-ready vessel. With a focus on skill-based gameplay, Ignition Arena offers a dynamic multiplayer experience where tactics and customization are key to victory.

title: DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 4
description:
DeLight: The Journey Home - Chapter 4 is the fourth part of the five-part story.

Chapter 4, after leaving the shelter, Sammy and Deli finds themselves struggle to make the journey possible. They come to a post office who desperately in need of help making some deliveries. Sammy agrees to help in return for a car ride but what lies ahead may not be that simple...…

title: DsDooM3
description: DsDoom 3 is a 32-level total conversion for Doom II created by Sniper 109 for Boom-compatible ports. DsDoom 3 was created to maintain compatibility with the DS Doom port, which was created to play Doom on Nintendo DS handheld consoles and is based on PrBoom. As the name of the WAD and the title screen indicate, the mod is heavily based off Doom 3, with its weapons and most of its enemies being closely modeled after that game, featuring new and unique behaviors through DeHackEd.

title: Chrono Ark: High Roller
description:
Casino-themed DLC for Chrono Ark, featuring a new, optional boss with its own substory, new equipment and relics, as well as casino-themed skins for Lucy and 6 investigators, with accompanying VFX.

The investigators obtaining a new skin are Helia & Selena, Miss Chain, Momori, Narhan, and Silverstein.

title: Sonic Souls
description: Sonic Souls is a Fan made creation, its been made with Unreal Development Kit (UDK).

title: Sonic The Hedgehog 2D
description: A 2D remake of Sonic '06 which features a complete remake of all Sonic stages and bosses.

title: Uraankhians Dygyn: The Beginning
description: URAANHAI! Finally, we have all together driven Alaa-Mogus into the underworld! Now let's have a real Ysyakh and celebrate! Let's organize the first "DYGYNA" game and find out who is the fastest! Play in multiplayer and become the FIRST!

title: I Remember This Dream
description: "I Remember This Dream" is a first-person survival horror game which takes place in a cold winter forest where there is only you and your fear hiding in the shadows of the trees.

title: No Blood, No Fowl
description: You accidentally killed someone with a rubber duck. Time to hide the body!

title: Orbo's Exodus
description:
After a whirlwind odyssey with his friend, our accountant-turned-hero Orbo decides to make his way home by way of Peeb's signature biplane. While flying over the coast of a mysterious vacation resort, Peeb's attempt to demonstrate a cool loop-de-loop turns into a spectacular nosedive that is only one-upped by the resulting explosion.

Following the crash, Orbo is left stranded, with Peeb nowhere in sight. Left to his own devices, Orbo begins an all-new quest to buy a ferry back to the mainland, but in the process he may discover there's more to the island than meets the eye...

Armed with some new moves and a set of snazzy hats, Orbo sets out on his final adventure: an exodus of epic proportions.

title: Disney's The Little Mermaid II: Return to the Sea
