description: Disney's The Little Mermaid II: Return to the Sea is a PC CD-Rom game based on the movie of the same name. The game has the player follow Ariel as she introduces us to her daughter, Melody, as they both go on magical adventures throughout the underwater world of Atlantica.

title: Apex Legends: Shockwave
description: Grab the squad, because the Games have a whole new energy! Drop back into the fight with Revivals, feel your power surge with Akimbo, use two new Battle Sense features to narrow in on your enemies in the heat of the fight, and more updates that make the Outlands legendary for all. Hone your skills in Bot Royale and hit new heights in E-District, your very own neon playground. Customize Stat Trackers to suit your needs or your ships, and you’ll automatically unlock three new ones for logging in this season. Time to Tap in, Legend.

title: Unicycle Pizza Time!
description: Unicycle Pizza Time! is a rage inducing platformer where you navigate a dense cityscape without falling over.

title: Pinball Mania Plus
description:
A remake of Pinball Mania which updates the 2D original tables into 3D.

The tables are:
- Daredevil
- Kick-off
- Jackpot
- Jailbreak
- Tarantula
- The Visitors

title: Roswell Pinball
description: An alien themed Pinball table.

title: The Avengers Pinball
description: Pinball table based on the TV show by the same name.

title: Light-Years Away
description: Light Years Away is an epic sci-fi ARPG survival game that plunges you into the vast, uncharted depths of space. As a stranded starship captain, you must navigate through mysterious galaxies, gather resources, and recruit a unique crew to help you on your journey home. The game combines elements of top-down shooter action, resource management, and exploration, creating a rich and immersive experience.

title: Solace Creek
description: Solace Creek is a Horror game with a focus on suspense, exploration, stealth & puzzle solving. You wake up in a sinister place, haunted by a monstrous presence. Uncover the mystery of this dark place... or become its prey.

title: Surfpunk
description: Become a wave-shredding Raider in this intense, PvE co-op extraction ARPG. Hop on your Rushboard, loot ancient artifacts, hack n’ slash through hordes of monsters and escape in style. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

title: Electric Fairyland
description: Join Stix the fairy on an a tiny 3D adventure through the dense undergrowth of a fantasy garden. A bite-sized collectathon inspired by 90s platformers and childrens' picture books.

title: Funny Rain
description:
Ichihashi Sanae lost his wife and daughter in an accident one year ago. After their deaths, Sanae loses his will to live, is diagnosed with depression, and begins to have suicidal thoughts.

He is no longer able to work or even do simple household chores, but there is someone who takes care of him.

It is Sakamaki Yura, the younger brother of his wife Yumi.

title: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo
description: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo enables players to customise their decks with new cosmetic card skins featuring characters from The Witcher 3, Dave the Diver, Vampire Survivors, and Among Us.

title: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
description: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

title: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker
description: This Sea of Stars DLC finds the Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale venturing into the miniature clockwork world of Horloge. In this magical land where denizens are threatened by a cursed carnival, our heroes will need to adapt to unfamiliar rules if their Sun and Moon powers are to manifest.

title: Morsels
description: Morsels is a fast-paced creature collecting roguelite with a rotating roster of characters to switch between at will. Overcome a clique of killer cats as you fight your way out of the sewers in this unique, action-packed journey.

title: Tret
description: A hybrid puzzler set in a synthwave world. Complex platforming meets physics-based synthball manipulation, with a dash of high-speed races across a neon-soaked landscape, all set to the tune of a killer electronic soundtrack paying homage to the colorful eighties.

title: Pico Park 2
description: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

title: Tetris Forever
description:
Tetris Forever celebrates the original, genre-inspiring puzzle game that escaped from behind the Iron Curtain, onto the world stage, and into our cultural consciousness.

More than 15 playable classic games from the series' history are featured, including many being released for the first time outside Japan. Battle your friends in the multiplayer cult favorite Tetris Battle Gaiden, create massive explosions to clear lines in Super Bombliss, and see where it all began in 1984 with an accurate recreation of the first version of Tetris on the Electronika 60 computer.

title: Star Overdrive
description: Use your powers to explore a massive world on your Hoverboard at lightning speed, face multitudes of enemies and epic bosses. Journey through four uniquely distinct biomes, each brimming with challenges and secrets to uncover.

title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter
description: A remake of the first installment in the main Trails series, serving as the beginning to the Liberl arc and the series as a whole. The game follows protagonists Estelle Bright and her adopted brother Joshua, who journey through the country of Liberl to train to become senior Bracers, members of a non-government multinational organization that acts to keep the peace and protect civilians.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Patrick Star Game
description: Patrick fans, your time has come – and Bikini Bottom is your open-world playground! You can skydive with just a parasol (or nothing at all), search for buried treasure in the Dump, or release the rage in Mrs. Puff’s Rage Room. Use almost any item you find, - from the reef blower to a paint can, - to make the world more Patrick. And take on challenges only Patrick would attempt, set by up SpongeBob, Sandy Cheeks, Mr. Krabs, and more. So become the Star of the show, put your silliest ideas into action, and enjoy the physics-based chaos that unfolds all around you!

title: Capcom Fighting Collection 2
description:
Capcom's newest fighting collection hits the stage!

Choose from fan-favorite games like Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001 and Project Justice to 3D action games like Power Stone and Power Stone 2 in this collection of eight classic fighting games!

Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op!

Get back in the ring and duke it out in battles that everyone rumored, but no one believed!
Whether it's with a rival new or old, give it your all and strive for victory!

title: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land
description:
In a world where alchemy is deemed "taboo", the alchemist Yumia yearns for the "truth" that lies hidden in the ruined continent.
Now, she takes her first steps on a grand adventure across the continent─

title: Castlevania Dominus Collection
description: Three incredible action adventure games from the Castlevania series have finally returned, for the first time! But wait, there's more! Haunted Castle Revisited, a redesigned version of the very first Castlevania arcade game, makes its debut!

title: Tales of Graces F Remastered
description: Tales of Graces f Remastered is an action RPG with high-speed battles that allow you to switch between fighting styles to match your play style. The remastered title adds more than 80 DLC packs and items release for the original and features stunning visuals, newly localized scenes available in English for the first time, and notable quality of life enhancements such as auto-save.

title: Quidget the Wonderwiener
description: Quidget the Wonderwiener is a spin-off of peninja

title: Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story
description:
A game where you run a sweets shop with the popular manga character Doraemon. Let's make Doraemon's favorite dorayaki and create a store that will be the talk of the town.

First, make the sweets, set up the shelves, prepare the tables, and get ready to run the shop. In addition, various characters from Fujiko・F・Fujio's works will appear as customers.

title: Beyblade X Xone
description: 'BEYBLADE X XONE is a "Beyblade action" game that faithfully recreates the BEYBLADE X series (distributed by TOMY Company, Ltd.) that is popular among fans of all ages. Battle through intense Beybattles and aim for the top of The X!

title: Unless
description: Take a trip back to the nostalgic era of platforming games built without gimmicks or a story. Race through bite-sized levels solo, or with a co-op helper to get the best time among your friends, or maybe even the world!

title: Individualism In The Dead Internet Age: An Anti Big Tech Asset Flip
description:
This is an interactive-essay-meets-walking-sim about technocapitalism and the things we lost along the way.
Follow coins under the electric mist of a clouded starry sky. Discover hyper-links. Listen to the words both inside and outside your head. Seal your fate before the productivity machine. Together we can defeat the machine.

title: Resident Fear 2
description: Take part in heart-stopping first-person action with waves of ravenous zombies. Use your weapons wisely, keep your ammo count at bay, and stay focused—all decisions are literally matters of life and death.

title: Haunted Castle Revisited
description:
Haunted Castle Revisited, a redesigned version of the very first Castlevania arcade game, makes its debut!

The game was released within the Castlevania Dominus Collection.

title: Byte Breakers
description: Byte Breakers is a platform fighting battle royale for 40 players. Navigate a massive city, gear up, and escape the encroaching glitch zone while battling the world to become the last duo standing.

title: Spikeball Smash
description: Play loud. Spikeball Smash is a 1–4 player online party sport. Smash, dive, and spike your way to victory on the beach, the quad, or the arena in fast-paced matches. Perfect for friends, built for parties, and ready to pick up and play even if you’re going solo.

title: 512 Linedefs of /vr/
description: 512 Linedefs of /vr/ is a 32-map community megawad for Doom II designed for Boom-compatible source ports by various members of 4chan's retro videogames board, led by MacGuffin and released on the Doomworld forums on June 28, 2022. It is a restriction-based project inspired by similar /vr/ projects (such as 200 Minutes of /vr/ and 2048 Units of /vr/). Mappers were limited to creating maps with no more than 512 linedefs.

title: An Aunt After My Own Heart
description: Discovering his beautiful young aunt is engaged to be married, a nephew takes matters into his own hands.

title: Chaos Caster
description: Cast spells, dash around hordes of enemies, and assemble powerful combos as you explore procedurally generated dungeons. Chaos Caster is an action roguelike focused on strategy, playstyle variety, and replayability.

title: Real Hentai Situation! DT
description: This newest entry in the Real Hentai Situation series brings all of the sex appeal and laughs you've come to expect, and more!

title: Real Anime Situation! DT
description: I’m Shun, and I have a talent for crushing romance flags—in real life! Featuring even more eye-popping art, nuanced animations, plus a fresh-faced cast of DT-obsessed heroines, this censored release of the Moe Game Awards-winning comedy franchise also received its own hit anime adaptation.

title: Adrian Ford in the Tomb of the Moon
Fantasy Friends: Dream Worlds
description: Come and play with Aurea in Fantasy Friends: Dream Worlds, an ultra-cute puzzle and platform game. Enter this wonderful place and make lots of fantastic friends!

title: Strashilki: Shestoe chuvstvo
description: Strashilki: Shestoe chuvstvo (Bogeyman Sories: Sixth Sense) is a 2D point-and-click adventure game set in the world of the Russian early 2000s.

title: A Light Jog
description: A Light Jog is a 2D endless runner game with 4 different places to travel through as you, the player, jog as long as you can while passing hazards that could stop you.

title: Secret Of World
description: Secret of World is an MMORPG that immerses players in a vast, dynamic world where they can choose from four distinct characters, each endowed with unique and special abilities. The game features a balanced gameplay style with a focus on Player vs. Monster (PvM) content, making up 70% of the experience, while Player vs. Player (PvP) battles account for the remaining 30%. Players can align themselves with one of the three powerful empires, each offering its own challenges and rewards. In Secret of World, strategy, skill, and alliances are key as you navigate a world filled with danger, adventure, and intense competition.

title: Jevilswap
description: The world of UNDERSWAP as you've never seen it before! Play as a human child and enter the Underground: a world full of odd Monsters who all want your Soul.

title: My Party Needs an Alchemist
description: Gather herbs and brew powerful potions as you travel a magical world and forge a party of intriguing companions to defeat the demon lord in this cozy fantasy adventure game!

title: Pairs & Perils
description: Pairs & Perils is a memory-game roguelike and dungeon crawler. Match cards to attack enemies, avoid traps, shop for relics and consumables. Sharpen your mind as you journey through the depths of the dungeon in search of The Dealer.

title: Travel to Canada
description: Travel to Canada sets off for another exciting journey with Hudsons. Enjoy the sights of Canada, from beautiful nature to astonishing big cities!

title: Liminal Border Part III
description: Following the events of Part II, Itsuki and the gang's "Rave" business is close to getting off the ground. Itsuki looks to Meryl Hathaway, a young girl often seen accompanying Kotoko, as a counter to the violence of the Umon-kai as he searches for a way to destroy them once and for all.

title: The Alchemist & His Battle-Scarred Homunculus
description:
A heartwarming tale of two broken people finding a new life together!

This heartwarming and dramatic tale follows Rakels, the young alchemist who helped create living homunculi to better the lives of mankind, only to have his partner betray him and turn their creations into tools of war. After years of exile for speaking out against their use as weapons during the war, Rakels discovers the battered form of Mel, a homunculus who was discarded by a slave trader.

As the two begin to confront their traumatic pasts together, a new bond is formed that helps them heal and forge a loving future together. Sweet and tender moments abound as Rakels and Mel face their fears of society and intimacy to truly come together as a couple.

title: Touhou Emblem
description: Fan-made crossover tactical RPG built as a Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones ROM hack, bringing Touhou Project characters, music, and locations to a 26-chapter campaign with a mini route split. Play classic grid-based, turn-based battles with Touhou units across areas like Scarlet Devil Mansion, Netherworld, and Former Hell, released as a free digital fangame via FEU.

title: Touhou Emblem 2
description: Touhou Emblem 2 will focus around Reimu and Marisa being dragged into another set of incidents that are happening in Gensokyo. However, a sinister hand lurks around the corner, threatening to set Gensokyo into chaos, with a set of very old (and perhaps unfamiliar to new fans) faces lurking in the shadows.

title: Breakers
description: It is a turn-based hip-hop-breaking dance game where two players compete in intense dance battles. With 60 seconds to perform moves and earn points, QUARC blends the energy of breaking dance with strategy, offering a unique and engaging experience.

title: Infinity Rising
description:
Infinity Rising is an open-world sandbox MMO and multiverse simulator set between Cornucopias, the nation in the sky, the fractured Earth below, and the unknown worlds beyond. Born from the aftermath of the Calamity—a quantum storm that shattered reality—players rebuild civilization under vast domes powered by advanced quantum tech.

Guided by “The Messenger,” you’ll explore, gather, craft, trade, and defend in a player-driven economy across land, sky, and beyond. Quantum Rifts, mysterious anomalies tied to The Prophet and The Terra, challenge survival and progress as players rise into infinite possibilities. Whether you craft, farm, fight, or build empires, every choice shapes the future of the Cornucopias Republic—humanity’s last beacon of hope.

Infinity Rising is a call to ascend without end—world, player, and technology together.

title: Forest of Perdition 2: The School Trip
description: James Everhart and his classmates embark on a school trip to the abandoned Tranquil Hills, a forest park shrouded in mysteries and horrors. As they explore the area, they uncover dark secrets and confront malevolent forces that threaten their lives and the truth of the past.

title: Shadows of the Werewolf
description: Shadows of the Werewolf is a cinematic, third-person action-adventure game that places players in a suspenseful, horror-filled world. The story unfolds across various locations, including a suburban home and a mysterious forest retreat, where an innocent couple faces a relentless werewolf and other monstrous creatures. Players will engage in tense exploration, object interaction, and combat, using stealth and strategy to hide, fight, and escape from supernatural threats. The game blends elements of classic horror films and survival horror games, offering a narrative-driven, single-player experience filled with fear, suspense, and the challenge of survival under the full moon.

title: Magical Chaser: Stardust of Dreams
description: Magical Chaser ~Stardust of Dreams~ is a Japanese dōjin 2D fighting game for Windows, developed by the dōjin circle Dakken for the Fighter Maker 2nd engine and released in 2008. The game is a crossover of five magical girl Anime series: Ojamajo Doremi, Princess Comet, Fushigi Mahō Fan Fan Pharmacy, Fushigiboshi no Futagohime and Kasumin.

title: Geo-Political Simulator 5
description: The new evolution of Geopolitical Simulator series, the hyperrealistic simulator of today's world! em geopolitical simulator 5 , play as the Head of State ou CEO de uma compania and extend your influence around the globe. By playing as several countries, try to change the destiny of our planet with orchestrated actions.

title: Deltatraveler: Section 4
description: Shining Savior (or, alternatively, Section 4) is the fourth Section of Deltatraveler, taking place in the world of The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past.

title: Hina-chan's Sticker Survival
description: Hina-chan's phone has broken and can't text or make calls! Use stickers to keep her friends fooled so they don't find out!

title: Epstein 2
description: Join detective Michael in his psychological horror-filled adventure to gather evidence and find his mother on Epstein's dark island. In this single-player game, read notes carefully, collect equipment to protect yourself from aggressive test subjects, and uncover the truth...

title: Nightmares Mansion: Scary Dreams
description: Explore a scary mansion in the first-person adventure horror game. Talk to kidnapped souls, collect grimoires, and discover the hidden secret inside the many doors. Your soul was stolen, and you found yourself in the underworld. Can you escape?

title: Climb Quest
description: Climb Quest is a challenging vertical platformer where you navigate through a fragmented world of floating islands, overcoming devious traps and solving intricate puzzles. Your goal is to ascend to the top, close the source of destruction alone or with your friends.

title: Rapta
description: 15 minutes and a terminal. Your sister's life in your hands. Navigate the Silicon Sneaky system, explore the digital underworld to secure $20,000, and make irreversible decisions. Your choices define her fate.

title: Candle Wood
description: A brutal and gorgeous hand-drawn 2D platformer in a world of candle folks!

title: Against the Storm: Keepers of the Stone
description: As the struggle for survival against the Blightstorm continues, Against the Storm - Keepers of the Stone introduces a new species, a new biome, and a selection of new buildings, orders, risks, and opportunities for any Viceroy up for the challenge. The Frogs join the effort to push back the storm, bringing their skill with stone masonry and love for water with them. Meanwhile, a changing of the tides has unlocked new potential in the distance – the Coastal Groves have finally become accessible after countless cycles spent under the deluge. Though they remain isolated and hard to reach, the ancient, submerged settlements of the area hold great treasures waiting to be uncovered.

title: Plutonium T6 Multiplayer
description: A modded client for Call of Duty: Black Ops II's multiplayer mode that adds dedicated server support, anti-cheat, expanded controller features, custom map support, and other quality of life additions.

title: Park Beyond: Beyond the Skies of Arabia - Theme World
description:
Enhance your dream park with this new themed world. The all-new Beyond the Skies of Arabia expansion allows you to bring the wonder and delight of 1001 Arabian Nights into your park.

Beyond the Skies of Arabia - Theme World includes the following glittering wonder content:
• 230+ Scenery Objects
• Building Prefabs
• 2 Flat Rides
• 4 Animatronics
• 2 Entertainers and Impossification
• 2 Coaster Modules
• 1 Track Type
• 1 Coaster Car
• 2 Sandbox Maps

title: Overseer: Field Trials
description: Step into the role of a paranormal agent. It's time for field trials where you’ll identify anomalies firsthand. The trials are partially staged, with your team ready to assist, but stay alert—unexpected threats may arise. Successfully report anomalies multiple times to earn your Field Agent badge.

title: Kyoryu
description: Ever wanted to run around a post-apocalyptic Japan where you, playing as a genetically re-engineered dinosaur, are the apocalypse that eliminated humanity and is now the dominant species? Heck yeah you have! Kyoryu is a third-person action-adventure where you get to do just that, picking through the literal bones of humanity while battling rival dino factions.

title: O reino em outro mundo
description: You have been transported to a procedurally generated voxel world where every decision matters. Manage resources, fight zombies and prepare for the harsh winters. Survive, build and thrive in an environment full of challenges and discoveries.

title: Pillaged Village: Humbled by Savages
description: Uh-oh, those marauding barbarians are back, banging on the village gates! It’s high time you bore arms and showed those savages who’s boss... After all, not one but TWO childhood sweethearts are counting on you to save the day—godspeed, soldier!

title: Labyrinth Flowers
description: Etched in your memory, only a riddle remains. You, a budding adventurer, arrive in town to conquer this dungeon. The local adventurers’ guild wastes no time in evaluating your skills, then offers you a tantalizing proposal...!

title: Bards College Expansion
description: A mod for Skyrim Creations that greatly expands the Bards College with a brand new main questline, new side quests, mini-games, shouts, abilities, skill system, weapons, and more to help you become a Bard!

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Flying Aureus Shot to Lupine Rue
description:
Version 2.5 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New characters: Feixiao, Lingsha, and Moze
• New Trailblaze Continuance: Finest Duel Under the Pristine Blue (Part 2)
• New area: The Skysplitter
• …and more!

title: 32in24-14: How the Hamburglar Stole Christmas
description:
32in24-14: How the Hamburglar Stole Christmas is the fourteenth edition of the 32in24 series of PWADs, where a 24-hour mapping session is held with the aim of creating a full megawad of usually multiplayer maps - however this time, the maps were designed for single player, making it the first single player 32in24 since Diet, and the first attempt at a full single player megawad since the failed second session. Wary of the increased challenges of creating a single player map over a deathmatch one, mappers were allowed to reuse architecture from previous 32in24 maps to assist them in creating theirs.

Continuing the food and holiday themes introduced by the thirteenth edition, this session was held on 21 December, 2014, and so the maps generally carried a Christmas theme, complete with map titles that mostly referenced either Christmas or food. The subtitle of the session itself refers to a Christmas story by Dr. Seuss As with the previous few sessions, a week was allowed after the session for minor polishing of the maps based on feedback.

title: TTV!Zone Collection 1
description: A large collection of Speed-Maps made during the Tango TV 5 in 100 events. Each Map was made in 100 minutes and had to use a special ingredient. (Decided by Supreme Decider Seele00TextOnly).

title: The Cummunist Manifesto: Dommy Mommy Commie Adventure
description: The Cummunist Manifesto is a kinetic novel retelling of the classic Communist Work "The Communist Manifesto" by Karl Marx except Karl is now a busty babe.

title: Ohio Distinctive Software Vol. 1
description: An old PC learning game for kids comprised of 4 CD disks that had many ODS mini games.

title: Wladyslaw
description: You are a citizen of the Władysław Empire. Sealed from the outside world by towering Walls you get mixed up in a ritual that changes your body. Now trapped in the Castle of Władysław only one thing is on your mind. Can you escape the Castle?

title: The Unholy Smoke
description: THE UNHOLY SMOKE is a small, Half Life inspired retro FPS set in a certain desolate city in Finland. Help Jerry through a completely ordinary looking apartment complex which has definitely not suffered from any unmentioned events, in the hopes of reaching his apartment and having his long awaited smoke break.

title: Everspace 2: Titans
description: Dreadnought and Leviathan have arrived in Cluster 34. Titans brings new story and massive repeatable challenges to EVERSPACE 2. Discover two exciting storylines alongside a cast of new and returning characters!

title: Virtual Death
description: Androids. Humans. A chain reaction. Angels. Where is everyone? What will you decide to make out of this world?

title: Yuki
description: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.

title: Fish Fear Me
description: A top-down action roguelike about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, and try to become the greatest battle-fisherman of all time.

title: Onikura
description: A fast-paced and challenging boss-rush with options to customize your playstyle as you progress. Defeat all enemies in your path with unique attacks, specials, parries, and abilities.

title: Yarimono: DLC 1
description:
With this DLC you get:
Additional battles
Additional items
Bad ending scene

In addition to this, players can also watch the bad ending scene.
You can watch the story that happened within a few days after if the protagonist was defeated in the ruins event that appears in the main game.
After winning the battle, the main plot will be advanced.
※ The defeat will not have any impact on the story after the level is cleared.

title: Mul-Ty-Player
description: The online multiplayer mod for Ty the Tasmanian Tiger. Join your friends as you hike through snowy mountains, swing through dense rainforests, and sprint across the wide open outback. All the Australian goodness of the original game with extra koala chaos. Collect together, play hide and seek, race the time attacks, or try out the built in collectible position randomizer.

title: Sakura Succubus 9
description: In the ninth part of the Sakura Succubus series, Hiroki returns to Astoria with Ayu as she prepares for the concert of a lifetime: a joint show with her fellow idol Mihama Shizuru. Will this concert end in success, and will Hiroki's harem get even bigger?

title: Five Lethal Demons
description: Five Lethal Demons is a free 2D point-and-click adventure. You play the role of Helga who likes bloody and violent games. Therefore she hires a team to develop such game to her liking.

title: Elly's Adventure
description:
Go on an adventure to get your toys back!

Elly and her best friend Natalie are children who love toys more than anything else. But when the diabolical engineer Chandra steals the girls' toys, it's up toe Elly to leap into action! Lead Elly through 20 wonderful stages to track down Chandra's army of robots and get your toys back!

title: Helga Deep In Trouble
description: Helga Deep in Trouble is a traditional hand-painted point’n'click adventure game reminiscent of the 90s classics. You will spend your time exploring scenes, picking up items and having branching conversations with other characters. Don’t worry, though – we are aware of the shortcomings of the old adventure games and we’re trying to avoid frustrating elements, such as pixel hunting. The game interface is streamlined and it even offers an (optional) hint system, which tracks your progress and gives you just the one hint you need without spoiling the challenge for you.

title: Ashita Deatta Shoujo
description:
MOONSTONE's debut work follows Aisa Ryu who wakes up to find himself looking up at the sky in the rural village of Takachiho. He soon realizes he has no memory of his past. Confused, he is taken in by his cousin, Kittaka Sanae, and moves into the Tachibana family home, where he meets the four sisters. However, an incident in a neighboring town leads Aoi and the sisters into a series of ongoing murders in this suspense visual novel.

Viewing all endings unlocks short stories for each heroine.

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2017 KTM 250 SX
description: Start your engines! Purchase the 250 SX two stroke bike from KTM and experience real off-road riding!

title: MX vs.. ATV All Out: 2018 Yamaha YXZ1000R SS SE
description: Start your engines! Purchase the YXZ1000R SS SE UTV from Yamaha and experience real off-road riding!

title: I Hate My Legs
description: A Foddian style game about Jeff, a turtle with human legs trying to find his father! The faster you move, the further you jump. Time your jump with your speed to make it to your father!

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2017 Yamaha YZ125
description: Start your engines! Purchase the YZ125 two stroke bike from Yamaha and experience real off-road riding!

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2011 Kawasaki KFX450R
description: Start your engines! Purchase the Kawasaki ATV from KFX450R and experience real off-road riding!

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2011 Suzuki LT-R450
description: Start your engines! Purchase the Suzuki ATV from LT-R450 and experience real off-road riding!

title: MX vs. ATV All Out: 2017 Husqvarna FC 250
description: Start your engines! Purchase the FC 250 MX bike from Husqvarna and experience real off-road riding!

title: Low Batt
description: Step into the thrilling world of Low Batt, a heart-pounding Top Down Shooter that pits you against the formidable security forces of L.E.A.D. Industries. Navigate through intense challenges requiring a blend of skill and strength and embark on an epic robotic adventure to rescue your robo-dog.

title: Shelley Manor
description: Find your way through a puzzle filled manor while barely dodging human-eating monsters. You wake up in a dark room with one objective: escape those sharpened teeth. However, you should not worry; you will meet friends along the way.

title: Katto: Rising Tides
description: Katto: Rising Tides is a funny and dynamic platformer game! Enter the kingdom of Egatlea, face terrible Nari enemies, move and jump between floors and obstacles, and do your best to restore peace for your kingdom.

title: Hunter's Trial: The fight never ends
description: In the depths of the forest lies the Delain Academy, a school for Monster Hunters, humans with special skills that keep the Earth safe from terrible devastating beasts. On a fateful day, an unexpected attack leaves the fate of the School and humanity in the hands of the most unlikely heroes.

title: CarX Street: Sunset Speedway
description: The Sunset Speedway DLC offers you new horizons for speed and luxury. The Sunset Speedway racetrack awaits with picturesque views and difficult turns, along with three unique new supercars.

title: Quiet as a Mouse
description: A short, ambient, audio-focused game about a mouse.

title: Demonology: Incubus: Chapter 1
description: an erotic interactive fiction series

title: Demonology: Incubus: Chapter 2
description: an erotic interactive fiction series

title: Arboneer
description: Welcome to Arboneer, a top-down survival game set in a verdant forest full of wildlife. Your adventure will consist of chopping down trees, building houses, crafting tools and venturing into deep dark caves to gather valuable materials.

title: Carpathian Survival
description: Can You Survive the Wilderness? Step into a brutal, untamed world where survival is your only mission. Scavenge, craft, and hunt as you face the dangers of nature. Explore at your own pace, build shelter, chop down trees, mine for valuable resources, and fight to stay alive against the elements and wildlife. With every choice impacting your survival, can you rise above the odds?

title: Only Climber 2
description: Only Climber is a game to reach the top, created by combining many platform elements. It has a single-player structure in the TPS genre. Feel the challenge in the world of many different themes in this game, which shows that reaching the top has never been this difficult.

title: Ghost Jumper: Red Hoodie
description: "Survive to the end while avoiding terrifying ghosts. "Ghost Jumper is a 2D action casual game where you must survive by avoiding ghosts in the Haunted Forest. Challenge your high score as a cute wolf in a red hood.

title: Escape From Exit 7 of the Theater
description: You're stuck in an infinite loop in the theater. You must escape to exit 7 to open the hidden door. Go forward and find the hidden door.

title: Upload Simulator Silicon
description: Upload Simulator Silicon is an incremental game about uploading, making money, hacking, and ascending as a powerful entity that controls the very laws of the universe using powerful technologies you discover throught your journey.

title: Sons Of The Dream Forest
description: The beautiful and cruel wilderness requires you to learn survival skills, such as building campsites, making tools, hunting, and gathering. You can cut down trees, fish, plant crops, and even collaborate with other players to tackle environmental challenges together

title: Farting Simulator
description: Get ready for a gut-busting good time with Farting Simulator! You experience the joy of controlling an uncontrollable bodily function in a meme-filled and comedic open-world sandbox environment. Farting Simulator is a hilarious and entertaining adventure that's sure to leave you FARTING out loud.

title: Incel Simulator
description: You are Alex Dysfuctional and you have never had a girlfriend. But maybe it's not too late to change things. The only question is what is closer to you - to try again and again to pump up your body and spirit or to become the king of the incels? Make life-changing decisions and change Alex's life.

title: Sheepers
description: Take on the charming challenge of raising and nurturing a vibrant flock of sheepers.

title: 100 Fantasy Cats
description: A cute adventure through fantasy-themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of fantasy places and cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 China Cats
description: 100 China Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the China themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of China places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Italy Cats
description: 100 Italy Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Italy themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Italy places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Sea Cats
description: 100 Sea Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Sea themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Sea places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Thailand Cats
description: 100 ThailandCats - Join the cutest adventure in the Thailandthemed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Thailand places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Indonesia Cats
description: Join the cutest adventure in the Indonesian-themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of Indonesian places and cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

title: 100 Hidden Cats: Pirates
description: 100 hidden Cats: Pirates is a hidden objects/clicker game. There are 100 pirate crew cats on the map, Your task is to point out all of them.

title: There's No Santa
description: There's no Santa is a hidden object game with a selection of 4 locations and Christmas-themed items to find for each of them.

title: Find Us Cats
description: Find Us Cats is a new hidden object game starring our favorite feline friends! Find dozens of cats in each level and aim for a high score in the Planetarium and San Francisco. Don't forget to try out the Painting mode! ️

title: Cats and Seek: Tokyo
description: The 4th Cats and Seek series is here! We're off to Tokyo to find cats playing all around the city . Can you spot them all?

title: Cats of the Song Dynasty
description: Explore the enchanting world imagined by a Southern Song Dynasty painter and find the adorable cats!

title: Secret Cats: Zoo
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Zoo" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Gold
description: This is an idle game! You can randomly drop a gold bag when you idle! Click on the gold bag to open it and you can get gold! The value of gold depends on its weight! The heavier it is, the rarer it is!

title: Catcelona
description: A nice, cozy and entertaining video game that mixes Barcelona's architecture and hidden cats. Find them all!

title: Plants Huddled Together
description: An interesting irregular puzzle game featuring beautiful plant illustrations. Come and relax with this game!

title: Cats in the Forbidden City
description: Explore the Forbidden City, where Emperor Qianlong resided, and find the adorable cats!

title: Walk in the Park
description: One day, you decide to go to the park with your pet Daisy, to have a relaxing walk under the sunshine. When you are near the park, you notice that the sky starts to get covered with clouds, and as soon as you enter the park, a gust of wind suddenly closes the door, and it seems to be locked. You must find another way to get out of there.

title: Caco Bell
description: Short boom compatible slaughtermap inspired by Garbage's wad, McDoomalds.

title: Turtle Champs
description: Play as a Turtle and duke it out in a game of Football. Use your gun to fly around the field or even shoot the ball.

title: 1-Hour Speedmapping 2018
description:
This is the first in what may be a series of compilations of 1-hour speedmaps.
Maps must be built within a 1 hour time period. You can do testing and bug-fixing after the 1 hour period. The map must be in a playable state and have an exit. Boom and limit-removing (complevel 2+9) format maps allowed. It resulted in 33 maps done by various authors.

title: Wayblazer Dämmerung
description: After 25 years, Eushully's expansive JRPG universe opens its doors to the world with a sprawling party-based adventure. Quest across the land, unravel a web of corruption, and dismantle monsters for their precious parts to commission powerful weapons and revitalize the kingdom's struggling trade!

title: Turtle Champs: Cosmetics Pass
description:
What is the "Cosmetic Pass" ?
The Cosmetic Pass is an optional DLC that allows players access to the cosmetics that the game provides. These items are all for shows and have no gameplay advantage against others.

title: Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow
description:
A port of Castlevania: Dawn of Sorrow included in "Castlevania Dominus Collection."

Draw the correct magic seal quickly, or your enemies will never die! Fight and explore through one of the largest castles ever seen in the series! Race another player through custom-made castle rooms in versus mode!

A year has passed since Soma Cruz discovered the evil of Dracula hidden inside his body. Now, a mysterious cult wants to release the power of the Lord of Darkness. As Soma, you must do everything in your power to stop them before it's too late.

title: Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin
description:
A port of Castlevania: Portrait of Ruin included in "Castlevania Dominus Collection."

Explore exotic locales through portals created by the lord of the castle! Switch characters in the heat of action or fight side-by-side using the abilities of both heroes! Battle hordes of enemies and huge bosses in the quest to vanquish evil!

An ancient vampire threatens the fate of the world by utilizing Dracula's accursed castle and mystical paintings to open portals of Death. Battle together as Jonathan Morris, a young man who wields the legendary whip Vampire Killer, and Charlotte Aulin, a spellcaster with tremendous magical abilities. It's time to conquer evil in man's darkest hour.

title: Highline Volleyball VR
description:
Get ready to play volleyball in stunning locations at various times of day.
On the beach, in a stadium arena facing crowds, and more.
Improve your volleyball abilities and tactics through virtual reality and lifelike interactions.

title: Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia
description:
A port of Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia included in "Castlevania Dominus Collection."

Use the brand new Glyph system with over 100 different attack combinations to battle Dracula and his minions throughout 20 explorable areas! Take part in side quests and collect items to power up! Experience a gripping storyline featuring new characters!

In the absence of the Holy Whip, those who live in fear of Dracula seek a replacement, which takes the form of the Order of Ecclesia, an organization that holds the secret to manipulating Glyphs. Shanoa, a young woman possessed with a unique ability to channel Glyphs, is chosen as our protector. This is her destiny and the story of the sacred Order of Ecclesia.

title: Piper
description: A Western take on the story of the Pied Piper of Hamelin, starring Jason David Frank (of Power Rangers fame) as the titular Piper in the town of Midas Valley.

title: StarbaseSim
description:
Operate the Starship space launch system and learn how to catch a rocket to understand what it takes to colonize Mars in this ever-evolving simulation of SpaceX Starbase Texas.

This is a physics sandbox where you can play around with Starbase devices. This is not a flight sim. There are some basic flying mechanics, but they are mainly intended to be able to catch the rockets with the chop sticks.

title: Home World Run
description: Two baseball playing sisters have been kidnapped by aliens, now they have to use their athletic skills to avoid hazards, solve puzzles, and most importantly bash some slimy creatures to bits in this hand drawn platformer beat-em-up!

title: Flob and the Shattered Dimension
description: Flob and the Shattered Dimension is a platformer game where you can test your skills while traversing various stages filled with challenging obstacles.

title: The Real Face of a VTuber
description: A courtroom investigation visual novel. You play as Prosecutor Justin Truth, investigating a murder at a VTuber agency where that VTuber's real face is the key to cracking the entire case.

title: Who is the Criminal
description: Set in school life, “Who is the Criminal” is a text-based adventure game featuring comedian and inference elements. With inquiring suspects and debating with “evildoers”, he gathers pieces of puzzles and reveals what truly happens in every incident.

title: Plane Graveyard Simulator
description: Visit the world's largest airplane graveyard and explore the huge desert filled with wrecks. Hundreds of tons of steel and rusted electronics are waiting. Dismantle airplanes, earn money from scrap, and complete tasks from your employer!

title: The Town of Nie
description: The protagonist is a young man named Hisora, who works several blue-collar part-time jobs. One day, he suddenly finds himself lost in a strange world. This is an otherworldly boys-love fantasy in which Hisora will risk his life to find a way back to his world.

title: Botworld Odyssey
description: Venture out into a huge and diverse open world to discover new bots, collect rare scrap to build them, and deploy them in tactical real-time battles on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster.

title: Metro Quester: Osaka
description:
METRO QUESTER | OSAKA is a dungeon exploration RPG based in a post-apocalyptic futuristic world created by the manga artist Kazushi Hagiwara, with a deep game system designed by Hironori Kato that offers the excitement and surprises reminiscent of 1980s computer games through hack and slash.

Moving the location to the city of water, Osaka, it features 32 characters and 8 classes, enjoyable combo skills, numerous customizable weapons, a bestiary, and features like NEW GAME+ for replayability, offering plenty of depth for dedicated gamers.

title: Possible One: Lunar Industries
description: Possible One is the ultimate colony management game set in space, and the only space-related RTS game based on proven or very feasible technologies, avoiding sci-fi.

title: Match In Peace
description: In this terrifying, genre-busting strategy game, find and match monster pairs to unleash their terror on your enemies. Battle in PvP, conquer the Tower and Roguelike modes and find alchemy components to craft new powerful monsters. Can you keep your calm under pressure and Match In Peace?

title: Hungry Horrors
description: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

title: Gulping Snake
description: Gulping Snake is a simple, but not easy, 2D puzzle game.

title: Platform Control
description: In Platform Control you can control both your player character and the platforms he has to jump on to get to the trophy and complete the level. Unlock more and more unique platforms as you progress through the levels and sharpen your problem solving skills!

title: 1 Fast Fight
description: 1 Fast Fight or 1ff.wad is 12 speedmaps in boom format/cl9 with a time limit of 1 hour each. The maps are generally small and fast paced with a twist. All enemies have their healthy vastly decreased, but have their movement speed vastly increased to compensate, the idea was the make everything "go by faster".

title: I Commissioned Some Dogs 4
description: I paid more artists to hide dogs and bones in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Butterflies 4
description: I paid artists to hide butterflies and flowers in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Butterflies 5
description: I paid artists to hide butterflies and flowers in 15 artworks. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: I Commissioned Some Dogs 3
description: I paid more artists to hide dogs and bones in 15 pieces of artwork. Can you find them all? Warning: Relaxing.

title: Hidey Ducks: Seasons
description: A charming hidden-object game where you find 400 ducks across 8 seasonal scenes. Use your umbrella power to clear obstacles like rain and snow, collect and upgrade stickers for passive income, and unlock upgrades for enhanced gameplay. Optional challenge mode adds extra excitement!

title: Net.Attack(): Code or Die!
description: CODE OR DIE! Hack enemy systems & survive the security response by engineering lethal bullet-heaven algorithms. Your brain power determines your firepower across 150+ programming nodes. Debug your failures. Optimize your code. Complete the heist. HACK THE PLANET!

title: Dagger Froggy
description: Dagger Froggy is a small action Roguelike, Where you face hordes of enemies... Cute? With each round you get stronger, But so do the cute creatures. >:)

title: B-Air Micro
description: Made for #lowrezjam and carried on afterward, B-Air Micro is a roguelike-like in the vein of games like Spelunky. Explore the treacherous caverns deep below the earth and define your aspirations as one of eleven unique classes. Do you have the courage to venture to the bottom?

title: Geomancers
description: Geomancers is a PVP card game turn-based shooter where you command powerful elemental magic from a wide array of spells of your own choosing to destroy and create terrain, manipulate your mana and spells, or even summon powerful creatures to fight by your side.

title: Haunted Castle
description:
A port of Haunted Castle included in "Castlevania Dominus Collection."

Count Dracula sleeps for a long hundred of years. During this time, peace exists at the village and Dracula is nothing but a mere legend.

However, one day a young couple named Simon and Serena were celebrating their wedding at the village's church.

The couple were enveloped with happiness, as the wedding bells rang, their future seemed blessed...

Suddenly, the empty sky was covered with dark clouds and with a rolling thunder that shook the earth, Dracula has once again awakened. Asking for the beautiful girl's blood, he flew down during the middle of the wedding and suddenly took the bride with him.

Now in order to save Serena, Simon heads to the demon castle

title: Boost Panic
description:
The Space Grand Prix has long been defined by the grace and elegance of its champions. Some legendary racers have even managed to navigate hazard-strewn courses without a single scratch on their ships.

But all that's gonna change.

You invented BOOST technology and built a ship sturdy enough to slam into walls at high speeds, and it's time to haphazardly carom your way to victory! Just cross the finish line before your ship falls apart, and you win!

Prove you're fast enough and you may even spark a revolution in the space racing scene!

title: EXVS2
description: The Final Mod Compile for the classic game Ultimate Knight Windom XP.

title: Tomb Raider: The Kurtis Trent Chronicles - Chapter 1
description:
It is the late 1990s. Former legionnaire Kurtis Trent now operates as a freelance mercenary. His specialism: the supernatural.

Following a series of mysterious deaths after the discovery of a medieval shrine deep beneath a Welsh mine, Kurtis has been hired to find whatever otherworldly force is wreaking havoc, and take care of it. Little does he know that what he is about to stumble upon will lead him down a dangerous path, one of ancient cults and arcane knowledge, that will bring him face-to-face with demons from his own past, and ultimately, into a battle for the very survival of mankind...

title: LEGO Harry Potter Collection
description: The LEGO Harry Potter Collection brings LEGO Harry Potter: Years 1-4 and LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7 to the PlayStation4 computer entertainment system for the first time with both top-selling videogames remastered on one disc. This compilation unites the creative prowess of LEGO and the expansive world of Harry Potter, with an exciting journey full of spell-casting, potion-making, puzzle-solving, lessons, dueling and much more for players of all ages to enjoy. Gamers can experience the entire LEGO Harry Potter adventure featuring content from seven books and eight films, with enhanced graphics, environments, lighting and visual effects, along with two downloadable content (DLC) packs. Sure to delight fans of J.K. Rowling’s ever-expanding Wizarding World, the LEGO Harry Potter Collection serves as a perfect gift for those eagerly anticipating the upcoming film, Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them, a prequel to the Harry Potter film series.

title: Beyond the Room
description: Beyond the Room is the eight game by Dark Dome. In this point-and-click game, you will explore an abandoned building and unravel its mysteries.

title: Fazbear Nights
description:
Dear new security guard, welcome back to Freddy Fazbear's Pizza!
Since the last time you were here we actually got our paychecks! Now we have brand new systems for you to use on your job! Though... we still have to pay the bills here so we're giving you a limited amount of power, use it wisely....

title: Fazbear Nights 2: Quaesitor Mortis
description: After a long hiatus, Fazbear Entertainment welcomes you back to a brand new establishment! As Fredbear and Friends went out on indefinite vacation, it is time for new faces to take the stage and bring the joy to unprecedented levels! With outstanding ahead-of-their-time security technologies, you and your children will be safer at Freddy's than in your own home, so come on in and invite yourself to a delicious pizza, served by yours truly, Freddy Fazbear.

title: Meat Jam
description: A community map jam for Quake 1, where participants had a month to create a level focusing on meat. This pack contains 12 maps, including the start map. Runs on the Quoth mod, which is included, and adds new enemies, weapons, and powerups.

title: Beff Jezos Simulator
description: Beff Jezos Simulator is a simulation that includes all the details of owning an online sales store. Select the products, supply them, put them on sale in your online store and ship the incoming orders.

title: Bruma
description: Experience the mysterious journey of a cat searching for the memories of her friend, an old lady who has lost them.

title: Driving Is Hard
description: Challenge yourself in Driving Is Hard! Drive a bathtub on wheels through steep, unforgiving terrain where every mistake costs you progress. Master tough physics-based gameplay, sharpen your patience, and uncover Jeff’s journey of self-doubt, family struggles, and emotional growth as he finds strength, self-acceptance, and hope for a brighter future.

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Drudging, Drifting, Dreaming
description:
Version 7.7 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter IV: A Shore Under Watch
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Schicksal's Imperative (Theresa)
• New Featured Event: Born From A Dream
• ...and more!

title: Dusk City
description: A flourishing civilization had sunk into the sea. The night never dawns...... and a sense of apocalypse hangs over the world. You'll land on an island in such a world, and as you explore the town and ruins, you'll come into contact with fragments of the world's mysteries.

title: Undergrounded
description: “Undergrounded” is a puzzle adventure where you explore a dungeon formed by the accumulation of American history. Become Scott, who wandered underground in search of his lost engagement ring after failing to propose to his girlfriend, and plumb the depths of the past itself with your buddy Canary!

title: WinWar II
description: A strategy game similar to Risk set in World War II.

title: Street Fighter V: Season 5 Premium Pass
description: The Street Fighter V - Season 5 Premium Pass allows access to the 5 characters joining the roster in Season 5, Dan/Rose/Oro/Akira/Luke, as well as new stages and costumes for existing characters.

title: Tomb Raider Tokyo 9: Grand Lodge / Dark Lair
description: A Tomb Raider fangame made with TRLE.

title: Systematic Corruption
description: Systematic Corruption is a medium-sized e1-themed techbase.

title: Toxic Cove
description: A community-created mod for Doom II. It is a heavily Alien Vendetta Map10 (by Kim Malde, titled "Toxic Touch") inspired sewer map, initially created in roughly 110 minutes.

title: Not Quite Vegas
description: A short map making use of Nick Baker and Sam Woodman's Morister Resources texture pack.

title: The Missing Daughter
description:
A missing person, a shady investigation, the mob on your back... Only your deductive skills will allow you to make progress in this difficult case.

"The Missing Daughter" is a card-based investigation game made for #AdvJam2019 under 2 weeks. It features a unique mechanic to investigate, gather clues and interrogate people.

title: Caring & Chilling
description: A game made for Enchant Jam 1.

title: Press Paws: Idle Clicker
description: Press Paws is a casual, laid-back and cute Idle Clicker Game in Pixel Art style with mini-games.

title: Colorfire Redux
description: Colorfire Redux is a beat the time game about a ship fighting against hordes of enemies.

title: YAPG
description:
Refill your batteries to avoid staying in a collapsing world by solving puzzles!

This rule-discovering game was made for the Theana GameJam#27 in 7 days. Around 1 hour of playtime, with a bonus challenging section for the more motivated players. It draws heavy game-design inspiration from games like Taiji or The Witness.

title: Federation Mycha
description: Step into a world over run with Mycha, a strange mineral with seemingly magical powers. Clear monster-infested environments and protect researchers on your own or with up to three other players online. Welcome to The Federation.

title: Physiblock
description: A physics-based first person parkour puzzle game, go through various tests as a test robot and be careful not to fall into the water, not to get caught by other robots and to use objects that will help you cross carefully, the game will be released on itch.io on September 5th, would you like to see what life is like through the eyes of a robot? Then grab your computers and wait for September 5th!

title: Providence
description: A psychological horror exploration game where you investigate a long-abandoned asylum, solve environmental puzzles, uncover dark secrets, and make choices that shape the outcome. Communicate through your walkie-talkie, navigate shifting spaces, and confront the horrors that still linger within.

title: Prophesy of Pendor
description:
From the Founding of Pendor - the year is 354. A King has not ruled the shattered land of Pendor for many generations. What was once a proud accomplishment of man now is steeped in the myths of folklore and told as children’s bedtime stories. Yet, the legends live on of a prophesy of hope. A tale of a champion who comes from a distant shore and unites the lords of Pendor under a single Ruler and brings peace and prosperity once again to this ravaged war-torn land. All is not as it seems as there are many powers who have their own ends in mind and an epic struggle is about to unfold.

Strap on your sword, and buckle your imagination. Prepare to enter the world of Pendor and accept the challenge of the Prophesy - if you dare.

A total conversion mod of Mount & Blade Warband, it introduces entirely new factions, overhauled mechanics, deep immersion, and a completely original story filled with fleshed out characters, kingdoms, and mythologies.

title: This is Not Your House
description: Crush someone's skull, suffer from hypothermia, transcend your mortal frame, find all 10 endings. GET YOUR HOUSE BACK.

title: Peter's Adventures in English
description: Take control of Peter as he travels across the kingdom, solving puzzles, making friends and defeating monsters. This game is designed to be accessible to a very broad range of players, including young children and people learning English as a second language.

title: Undertale Yellow: Dual
description: Ever thought "Damn they did ma boy starlo dirty in the genocide route", yeah a lot of people did. well now we finally have a fight against him on this route in this fangame.

title: Atre: Dominance Wars
description: Attain the powers of a God and dominate in this lore-driven 4X game full of unique species. Evolve your units to command diverse armies. Develop magnificent cities. Research and master arcane spellcraft to lay waste to the world itself. Find your own path to power and Ascend above all else.

title: Wick3r: Cheese, Keys & Speed
description: Join our petty thieving protagonist Wicker on his Wicked adventure about Cheese, Keys and (naturally) Speed, in this 2000s inspired Momentum 3D Platformer with radical levels and a coolness factor off the charts!

title: Too Many Nights
description: Too Many Nights is a FNaF fangame that doesn't follow the usual 5-night structure normally seen in other games. Instead, it's an endless endurance test where every night you have to pick more enemies, extra penalties, or purchasable shop items to deal with or take advantage of in the future.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Mitama Dance of EXP
description:
Additional downloadable content that increases the spawn rate of "Kushi Mitama", demons that drop items that give the protagonist EXP, and "Ara Mitama," demons that drop items that give ally demons EXP.

*There is still a low chance of Mitama spawning even without this DLC.
*You can revert the spawn rate mid-game from the Options menu.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Mitama Dance of Wealth
description:
Additional downloadable content that increases the spawn rate of "Saki Mitama", demons that drop items that can be sold for Macca.

*There is still a low chance of Mitama spawning even without this DLC.
*You can revert the spawn rate mid-game from the Options menu.

title: Shin Megami Tensei V: Vengeance - Mitama Dance of Miracles
description:
Additional downloadable content that increases the spawn rate of "Nigi Mitama", demons that drop items that give the protagonist Glory, points needed to learn new Miracles.

*There is still a low chance of Mitama spawning even without this DLC.
*You can revert the spawn rate mid-game from the Options menu.

title: Constriction: 1024
description: Based both on Congestion 1024 and Claustrophobia 1024, all the maps have a playable area of 1024x1024 Doom map units or less using OTEX. You can't escape the boundaries of the maps, but your enemies can.

title: NoLimits 2: Roller Coaster Simulation - Professional License
description: This Professional License DLC adds more features to the standard version of NoLimits 2.

title: No Recollection: Swimsuit DLC!
description: This DLC will allow you to enable swimsuit outfits for the main cast! You can finally live out the fantasy of seeing them half naked!

title: Something Is Wrong With My World Map
description:
"Something is wrong with my World Map" is a puzzle game, where you need to play with various sizes in the world map in order to create the right path to continue.

Switch size by exiting a village on a different side, or even by simply opening the map!

Step on a mountain to flatten it, or switch to the small size to enter caves!

Will you "step up" to the challenge?

title: Ode of Resurrection
description: Oldsk00lish challenging semi non-linear techbase.

title: Elegy for Them Vigil
description: A sequel to the previous map Ode of Resurrection, Elegy is a nonlinear "tech base being turned into an outpost of hell"-themed map.

title: Yohane the Parhelion: Numazu in the Mirage - "Yohane the Parhelion" song set
description:
The following elements are included in the "Yohane the Parhelion" song set.

-"Yohane the Parhelion" song set
A song set that you can listen to!
Includes a total of 4 songs, comprising three tracks featured in 'Yohane the Parhelion -SUNSHINE in the MIRROR-' plus the theme song 'Deep Blue' from 'Yohane the Parhelion -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE-'!

title: Crime Boss: Rockay City - Cagnali's Order
description:
Resist Cagnali’s Order!
A new threat is coming to Rockay City as the police force cooperates with a new rival – Cagnali Industries!

Stop Cagnali’s high-tech army’s rapid advancements before Rockay City becomes a totalitarian dystopia. Fight against a robot army in new big heists with brand new story, enemies, soundtrack and more!

title: Terry The Turtle's Big Adventure
description: Terry the Turtle carries his house on his back, but what makes a house a home? Can Terry help all the lost animals?

title: Castle of Asleep
description:
One-way non-field RPG.

Released in Japan in 2015, this released version in 2022 is fully translated into English.
Proceed while defeating enemies that appear in your path, picking up items, and investigating. Reach the sleeping castle in less than 3 minutes.

title: The Springlock: Aftermath
description:
In a timeline where Henry's plan has failed...
You're working for a group of investigators who are trying to get rich information about Fazbear Entertainment and their connection with William Afton. Your job is to investigate the old private warehouse of Fazbear Entertainment and save all possible information to the cloud storage. Things get worse when spectral visitors arrive. So, are you ready for the third round?
The Springlock: Aftermath is an FNaF fan-game featuring over 2 hours of gameplay with 10 intriguing main nights and tons of extra content, giving you a genuine FNAF game experience. There is something new to experience every night!

title: Coromon: Rogue Planet
description: Choose your starter Coromon, upgrade your gear, then battle your way across the wilderness of Velua in a modern-day Monster Tamer with a Roguelite twist! Tame monsters, battle Crimsonite bosses, and uncover the secrets of the galaxy!

title: Panic in the Woods
description: A horror survival and extraction game playable in single player or co-op for up to 4 players. Lost in a creepy forest, you and your friends are hunted by a monster. Stay quiet while extracting keys through nightmarish realms using items like traps, sonars, and flare guns to survive!

title: MBOS
description: MBOS.wad is a 13 map wad created during NaNoWADMo, with main inspirations from NoReason's NoSp (Map31) JAM by Vortale, Judgment by Rayziik and 1 bad wad by Spendoragon

title: Pompeii: The Legacy
description: Rebuild the city of Pompeii and climb the social ladder. Roman society is full of intrigues that you have to solve in order to become a powerful ruler.

title: The Devilz Work
description: Here are 7 SP/coop maps designed for DOS Doom2

title: Minecraft: Minecon Live - Rush Race!
description: Minecraft: Minecon Live - Rush Race! is a thrilling and dynamic mini-game that captures the excitement of competitive obstacle courses. Created as part of the Minecon Live celebration, it challenges players to race through imaginative tracks filled with parkour sections, traps, and puzzles. The game emphasizes speed, skill, and strategy as players compete against each other in vibrant and ever-changing environments, making it a perfect showcase of Minecraft’s creativity and community spirit.

title: Frontiers of the Mind
description:
"Between 1987 and 1994, the British channel Network7 broadcasted 112 episodes of the TV game show Maze Masters, an interactive adventure targeting younger audiences. Only some parts of the show were aired.

The different sections of this CD-ROM explore the format and the backstage of the show. The idea is to shed a new light on the strange events which have been revealed afterwards."

title: Kirby: Wacky Episode
description: A bite-sized fan made adventure is coming your way! Explore those worlds, pull off some new insanely stylish moves and dash through levels at an exhilarating pace! Equip yourself with 2 copy abilities at once and duel with some of Kirby's past foes yet again! Alongside Story Mode, 3 unlockable game modes are now available for players to push their skills to the maximum. This sure is going to be a wacky time you won't wanna miss!

title: Trifling
description: 4 speedmaps done by Phml

title: Chaos Order
description: A large level with two different paths. UV is much harder than the other difficulties.

title: Bloody Rust
description: A small community project where the maps are reminiscent of a rusting, aging, tech environment.

title: Bloody Rust 2
description: A small community project where the maps are reminiscent of a rusting, aging, tech environment.

title: Tarragona 4: Devil's Lair
description: Devil's Lair is a bonus level for the previous one. Does the Devil still live near the bridge? May be Lara will find him at home! Enjoy this 167 room level and see how is the hell! If the previous level do not had too many enemies (I do not like the free violence), in this one there are some, do not hesitate to shot them: They are not longer human, they are Wraiths! If you see them do some strange things like walk over lava, some time they do it, do not worry, it is not a Bug, they are not humans and they can do things that Lara can't do it. If you do not help them (with the weapons) to leave their actual existence, there system can slow down and additionally you will not find some pieces that they give you before disappear!

title: Tarragona 1+2: Escipions Tower/Escipions Caves
description: The source of inspiration fro these 9 levels was the town Tarragona, a Catalonian city. The UNESCO declared the city in 2000 to World heritage.

title: Tarragona 3: Devil's Bridge
description: The Devil's Bridge is inspired in the Tarragona's roman aqueduct. The legend tells that a shepherd requested to the Devil to build a bridge between two mountains, this will make his live easier because he will save time moving the sheeps. The Devil built it in one night! The next morning the Devil request the price to the shepherd: the soul of the first who cross the bridge! But he told him to take the correct soul. He was not the first one to cross it! The first one was a sheep.

title: Tarragona 5: The Underground Empire
description: Lara has discovered something hidden near the Devil's Bridge. It's a kind of secret base. Before finding the exit, she must walk through the maintenance tunnels, warehouses, moles, unused corridors and a garden.

title: Tarragona 6: Algernon's Lab
description: This level is related with the previous episodes of the Tarragona: World Heritage (TWH). Before finding the exit, she must walk through the laboratories, maintenance tunnels and office sections of the secret base.

title: Tarragona 7: Civilisations Crossroads
description: At the end of TWH6 Lara was teleported by the blue cube very far from the Earth. Where is she now? She is now in a Crossroad Civilisations.

title: Tarragona 8+9: Final Countdown
description: These two levels are the final of the saga. Lara now is boarding a space shuttle and she is trying to find the way back to the earth.

title: Lara at the Movies: Blood from the Mummy's Tomb
description: Lara becomes instrumental in unleashing unmitigated horror by bringing back to England the gift of Tara, the Egyptian Queen of Darkness. The Egyptologist Professor Fuchs has been looking for the Queen Tara idol hidden in the Cat Temple. When he was close to get the objects to open the temple, communication with the base had been suddenly lost. Lara starts her own search for the Idol.

title: A Witch Shall be Born
description: The witch Morgana, found King Arthurs' sword Excalibur hidden in a lake. Now the sword is somewhere in Greenland, in Morgana's hideout, and Lara is looking for it.

title: Samba Hero
description: Feel the samba rhythm by pressing the notes at the right time and become the next Samba Hero! Do you have what it takes?

title: Graft
description: GRAFT splices together tense survival horror with a dark RPG experience in a thrilling new adventure from the developers of BATTLETECH and the Shadowrun Trilogy. Explore a dying world haunted by darkly fascinating characters and nightmarish monsters as you delve into the mysteries of the Arc. Tear pieces from your enemies to transform yourself into something new—something capable of surviving the horrors that prowl around you. Every Graft brings with it some piece of its previous owner’s identity, changing more than just your physical body.

title: Dig Dug Island: Minami no Jima no Pukapukapon
description: A short-lived MMO based on Dig Dug II, developed by VerX.

title: Long War of the Chosen
description: Long War of the Chosen is a port of the original Long War 2 mod by Pavonis Interactive to XCOM 2's War of the Chosen expansion. It is a complete overhaul of the vanilla game that attempts to make campaigns more engaging, longer and more challenging. Overall, you get more tools (items, abilities, soldier class types), but you have to deal with more enemies and a greater variety of enemies.

title: Monoch Room
description: After losing consciousness, I found myself in a strange room. An unknown figure guided me deeper into the room. "I thought you would make it this far." Eventually, I saw a past I had forgotten... "monoch room" is an adventure game with puzzle elements.

title: Emergency Call 112: The Fire Fighting Simulation 2 - Volunteer Firefighters
description:
In the DLC you have the possibility to customize the appearance of your character. For the first time, female firefighters also join the volunteer fire department. If you are not alerted to a mission or invited to a training course, you can spend the time in your player apartment or in the freely explorable world.

With your own car, you can always get to the fire station quickly from anywhere. There you can meet your comrades for courses or missions.
Go through courses from squad leader 1 to group leader and go on missions according to your qualification. In addition to a theoretical part, the courses always include many practical exercises. In this way, you can gradually expand your knowledge and apply it directly in practice.

title: Emergency Call 112: The Fire Fighting Simulation 2 - The Swap Body Vehicle
description:
The add-on ‘WLF - Swap body vehicle’ is the second expansion for Emergency Call 112 - The Fire Fighting Simulation 2 and adds the eponymous vehicle to the player's vehicle fleet.
Different roll-off containers can be attached and transported with the swap body vehicle. This allows additional equipment and material to be brought to the scene.

title: Road Maintenance Simulator 2: Winter Services
description: In Road Maintenance Simulator 2, take on a variety of authentic tasks that occur every day in a road maintenance depot - now including winter service! Choose from a wide selection of tools, attachments and vehicles to master the challenges ahead.

title: Backrooms Media
description: Backrooms Media is a multiplayer co-op exploration game that plunges you into unsettling, hyper-realistic liminal spaces. Navigate eerie environments filled with lurking horrors. Group up with your friends to face the terror of the endless backrooms together and... try to escape.

title: Aprenda Libras
description: 'Aprenda Libras' is a game aimed at teaching Libras - Brazilian Sign Language. It's an educational game used for both literacy and basic Libras teaching. It's a light, multiplatform, point-click game with a low degree of difficulty.

title: Ice Truckers
description: Welcome to Ice Truckers, where the frozen wilderness becomes your proving ground.

title: Tambourine Tangerine
description: A previously unreleased map of SuperCupcakeTactics that plays for E1M1. A little bit of chaos.

title: Nanopineapple 2018
description: Thirty-two maps, all first made during November and then further refined in December 2018.

title: CityDriver: Moruga Turbo
description: Expand your car fleet in CityDriver with the Moruga Turbo DLC. This sleek SUV with 550 horsepower and a 0-100 km/h sprint in 4 seconds will have you whizzing through downtown Munich. The Moruga Turbo has room for 4 people and 4 suitcases, while its powerful combustion engine and automatic transmission make for an exhilarating driving experience. Discover the true meaning of power and style with this SUV DLC!

title: Astroneer: Glitchwalkers
description:
Travel to the Aeoluz system in pursuit of a grand threat in Astroneer: Glitchwalkers.

The Glitchwalkers DLC is our first ever expansion to Astroneer, offering a new space to explore as well as new narrative, gameplay, and mysteries to uncover.

title: Antuel's Lament
description: A true antventure

title: AMFM
description:
a dimension-hopping & contraption-building game_ anomalous multiverse, Fleeting Machinations_

A biologic supercomputer banished to a lead planet called the "enigma core" awakes from its restless slumber to turn the fabric of reality into an unmaterial broth of pain and suffering. You control a minimum wage school cleaner. Take care of this mess I created.

title: Rainchaser
description:
Rainchaser is a vertical shoot'em up game set in a world of decaying machines and witches.

Crimson Star, a powerful magical artefact was stolen by a group of six witches. You were sent on a mission to defeat them and return the Crimson Star, with an operator Scarlett as your only help.

title: A Tasting Flight of Names
description:
A kinetic-ish novel, ~7k words at about a 20 minutes read.

In the hazy night of the city, a runaway slips into an unmarked shop, seeking its owner with a 'simple' request -- to steal away a name.

title: Near Mint
description: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

title: Mouse Knight: A hero's rising
description: Explore the forest, complete quests and help villagers in this top down RPG

title: Worldseekers
description:
Worldseekers is a GPS exploration RPG. Discover rare cards, events, and unique characters as you delve into the expansive lands and deceptive dungeons of this world.

To help encourage mental and physical health, Worldseekers uses GPS mechanics and links to a phone app to help you get outside and walking. Of course, the Steam version allows you to play from your PC for hours while still rewarding you for taking an extra stroll. For all you streamers out there, we adjust / hide location by default.

title: Tiny Kingdom Builder
description: Tiny Kingdom Builder is a small puzzle/scoring-based game. It mixes mechanics from the boardgame Kingdomino, Tetris and Puyo-Puyo!

title: Mondly: Learn Languages in VR
description: Experience the ultimate way to learn languages, without leaving home! Enjoy talking to our virtual characters and gain confidence for real life situations. Get instant feedback on your pronunciation, enrich your vocabulary and discover the fun in learning languages! Fluency in 30 languages awaits!

title: Twilight City
