description: Once unlocked, you can wear the skin for your character in the game. The skin will also unlock new dynamic effect for the character!

title: CyberHoney: Fashion - Celebration Clothing
description: Once unlocked, you can wear the skin for your character in the game. The skin will also unlock new dynamic effect for the character!

title: Microcosmum 2: Mission Generator - Abyss
description: Map Generator "Abyss" for endless gameplay. A great way to relax, diving back into the world of Microcosmum 2.

title: Cats and Seek: Kyoto - Extra Level & Jigsaw
description: Extra content for Cats and Seek : Kyoto Thank you for your support - 1 more level - Find and collect jigsaw puzzles

title: Angel Legion: Shadow Woven - Cyan
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Stellagate
description: Stellagate is a puzzle action with gates that can connect different locations. The connected areas are seamlessly connected to each other, and you are free to throw blocks or lasers through them.

title: Backrooms Cleanup Crew
description: Backrooms Cleanup Crew is a fresh combo of cleanup simulator and fast-paced action, all set in the liminal halls of the Backrooms

title: Red Rocket Defencism
description: You, a military officer from our great autocratic motherland, must protect our precious rockets from the evil capitalist enemy in this revolutionary base building strategy game. Bribe! Surveil! Purge! Imbibe! The end justifies the means when you have to protect our invaluable rockets!

title: Detective Nekko
description: Mystery adventure where no one dies. Use your “ability to see too much” to uncover an inconvenient truth.

title: Gravity Drop
description: Take it to the skies in a physics-based puzzle platformer, where you'll navigate through two dozen of levels, overcoming challenges to deliver packages to their destinations. Master your flying skills and conquer the gravity!

title: Mech Havoc
description: Fight against hordes of Evil Robots to safe the world! Control powerful machines! From building sized Mechs to nimble Delivery Trucks. Unlock new weaponry and demolish your enemies (and buildings) using Artillery Strikes. Or gain extra firepower with deployable Turrets.

title: Helicop Investigates Words and Numbers
description: An edutainment game teaching kids spelling and maths.

title: Planet Strike
description: Experience the ultimate cosmic billiards. Solar winds that accelerate planets with intrusion. Asteroids decelerating on impact. Lead the planets of the solar system to the black hole by utilizing various devices placed in the field.

title: Doki Doki Blue Skies
description: Doki Doki Blue Skies is a Visual Novel game, developed by Blue Dissonance Development, which was released in 2020.

title: Undertale: Act to Flirt
description: A new human has fallen to the underground two weeks after the events caused by Frisk, who mysteriously disappeared after being last seen in New Home. A lot has happened in these past two weeks... aside from monsters figuring out how to get to the Surface.

title: The Screecher
description: An official horror mod made by Don't Starve creators that adds a short campaign. You are a survivor of a camp in the woods that has to collect notes and find out what heppened to his colleagues.

title: BlockWorld Ai
description: RPG puzzle game in which players train a mysterious AI, Hoshihabito-kun, who learns how to move puzzles and the results, and fight powerful bosses together with players

title: Visegunne
description: Visegunne is a single-player shoot 'em up featuring explosive, narrative-driven missions, a vast arsenal of weapons, and over-the-top visual effects. Pilot a soul-powered combat mech as you protect the colonies from a pro-Earth terrorist conspiracy. Shoot. Survive. Ascend.

title: 7 Minutes in Hell
description: 7 Minutes in Hell is an intense, co-operative horror game, where 1-4 contestants must face high-stakes challenges! In this thrilling gameshow experience, work together to hunt for loot and internet fame, while escaping from monsters, traps, and obstacles, before your 7 minutes are up!

title: Stario: Haven Tower
description: Build a vertical city in a world of a tower. Lead the dwellers to gather resources from the sky and build upwards. Make vertical transport and climbs up. Explore the creatures and sceneries in higher skies.

title: Lunavania
description: Lunavania is an Anime pixel horizontal action shooting game with unique pixel art style and roguelite elements.The game has rich build structures, over a hundred different styles of weapons, equipment, skills, which can be infinitely stacked and freely combined to experience the fun of meat pigeons.

title: Dread Tomb
description: Dread Tomb is a multiplayer cooperative horror game based on Chinese folk rumors. You will face a rugged random map environment and terrain construction, adventure in various harsh random weather conditions, and discover a variety of thrilling mechanisms and mysterious monsters waiting for you.

title: Fools, Maniacs and Liars
description: A narrative-driven game of suspense, crime, and dark humor. Amid exquisitely crafted art and a gripping story, the Wushan Great Buddha's demise unfolds.

title: Illusion Box
description: "Illusion Box" is the first virtual reality entertainment project of the 21st century. However, malicious rumors and computer virus infections forced the company to shut down the project. Now, the long-abandoned "Illusion Box" devices are being reactivated...

title: Pod Jam
description:
Pod Jam is a retro-inspired puzzle game where you guide alien pods to safe landings through strategic planning. Each level presents unique challenges with arrows that interact differently with the environment, requiring careful sequencing to prevent pods from getting stuck.

Offering 100 increasingly challenging levels, Pod Jam offers a blend of challenge and satisfaction. The ambient sci-fi soundtrack and minimalist retro visuals create an immersive experience. Easy to learn but hard to master, the game is a perfect title for logic puzzle and brain-teaser lovers.

title: Parcel Master
description: Outsmart the Gridlock! Master the art of delivery in this deceptively simple puzzle game where every road counts!

title: Find-o'-Lantern
description: Solve logical riddles in this simple, yet challenging game based on the classic star battle format.

title: The Pane Puzzle
description: Layer and match colored tiles to restore pictures in The Pane Puzzle. Simple at first, but it gets tricky as you progress!

title: Maze Craze
description: Dash through hazardous mazes in this fast-moving, action-packed game! One wrong move, and it’s game over. No touching the walls!

title: Lost Island of Jungata
description: This is a 7 map episode for Doom 2 for use with GZDoom that features several new weapons, new enemies, new textures and new music. This wad is very loosely based on an island Lizardcommando made for an unreleased RPG Maker 2003 game and a really old unreleased Doom 2 map from many years ago. Also loosely based on their "Make a Good Mega Man Level 3" submission called Lost Caverns of Jungata.

title: Scattered Thoughts
description: Twelve sleepy speedmaps made in three hours or less by The Afternoon Crew, led by @finnks13. Between larger projects, we want to make these smaller, easier affairs. We hope you have fun.

title: Volcano Valley
description: 2 maps that were inspired by the Sonic 3d blast game for the Sega Genesis.

title: Pixel Cross Stitch: Color by Number
description: Relax and create beautiful pixel art with color-by-number and cross-stitch fun!

title: Star Freight
description: Can you deliver the goods? Board your spaceship and go!

title: FullAni
description: FullAni is a fully animated mahjong game, developed and published by Leaf, which was released in Japan in 2006.

title: Inagawa de Ikou!!
description: Inagawa de Ikou!! is the third entry in the Leaf Amusement Soft series.

title: Aruruu to Asobo!!
description: Aruruu to Asobo!! is the fourth installment in the Leaf Amusement Soft series.

title: School Fighter
description: School Fighter is a top-down arena roguelite shooter where you play as a student who fights off school enemies using paper airplanes. You have access to a school shop, unique perks, and an upgrade station to help you create a powerful character and overcome the school nightmare!

title: Atari 50: The Wider World of Atari
description:
The story’s not over yet! THE WIDER WORLD OF ATARI introduces a new timeline with more games, historical artifacts and video interviews that explore the creation of Atari games. From early arcade games through fan-made homebrew titles, you'll learn why passionate Atari fans are loyal for life.

It contains 19 new games:
Atari Video Cube (2600)
Avalanche (800)
Avalanche (arcade)
Berzerk (2600 Voice Enhanced)
Berzerk (2600)
Berzerk (5200)
Berzerk (arcade)
Desert Falcon (2600)
Destroyer (arcade)
Football (arcade)
Frenzy (arcade)
Off the Wall (2600)
Red Baron (arcade)
Sky Diver (2600)
Sky Diver (arcade)
Steeplechase (2600)
Stellar Track (2600)
Submarine Commander (2600)
Super Bug (arcade)

title: Indiana Jones and The Great Circle: Premium Edition
description:
Live the adventure with the Premium Edition, including up to 3-Day Advanced Access** and Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: The Order of Giants Story DLC†. You’ll also receive a digital artbook and the Temple of Doom Outfit, Indy’s iconic look as seen in Temple of Doom.

Premium Edition Includes:

Base Game
- Up to 3-Day Advanced Access
- The Order of Giants Story DLC
- Digital Artbook
- Temple of Doom Outfit

title: Indiana Jones and The Great Circle: Collector's Edition
description: The Collector’s Edition features an exclusive set of items inspired by Indy’s office at Marshall College. Map your travels with The Great Circle 11” Globe, including a plane magnet that attaches to secret locations on the globe and reveals a hidden storage compartment. Keep track of your adventures and leave no clue behind with the New Adventure journal.

title: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

title: Railway Empire 2: India
description:
Railway Empire 2 – India whisks you into a gorgeous new era. Discover vast, vibrant plains, roaming elephants and bustling mega-cities, all waiting to be transformed by the blessings of the railroad.
Beginning in the Golden Era of the East India Company, you will help establish a vast railway system within the Indian subcontinent. Should you succeed, your network will become a roaring motor for growth, trade, administration and military control over India. However, a few decades later, the grip of the East India Company is waning. Work together with the British Crown while forging your own path for a prosperous railway infrastructure in the west.

title: Threads of Time
description: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

title: Synduality: Echo of Ada - Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada
• Deluxe Edition Content
Be ready for anything with a new outfit, access to Deluxe Drifter Pass seasonal bonuses, and a Magus Remake Ticket!
- Magus Costume School Uniform
- Deluxe Drifter Pass Voucher
- Magus Remake Ticket

title: Synduality: Echo of Ada - Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition includes:
• Synduality Echo of Ada
• Ultimate Edition Content
Be ready for anything with two new outfits, access to Ultimate Drifter Pass seasonal bonuses, and two special tickets - including one to obtain Mystere from SYNDUALITY Noir!
- Magus Costume School Uniform
- Magus Costume School Uniform Purple
- Ultimate Drifter Pass Voucher
- Magus Remake Ticket
- Mystere Magus Type Exchange Ticket

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Ken
description:
DLC Character 2 "KEN" (Scheduled for: Summer 2025)

A veteran Metro City street fighter who sets his sights on South Town, seeking closure for an incident to which he was wrongfully tied. Burning with determination and a fiery arsenal of unmatched offense, this former US National Fighting Champion eventually crosses paths with the Legendary Wolf himself—and with that, the wheels of fate are set in motion.

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Chun-Li
description:
Grants access to the following in FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves.
- DLC character "Chun-Li"
- Additional stage

title: Streets of Handbags
description: A shopping-themed rogue-lite game with cooking elements!

title: Battlefield 1918
description: The total conversion modification Battlefield 1918 (or BF1918 for short) takes Battlefield 1942 into a whole new scenario, the first world war.

title: Inayah: Life after Gods
description: INAYAH - Life After Gods is a thrilling action-platformer with metroidvania elements. Immerse yourself in a story with multiple choices, explore diverse biomes, face more than 20 bosses, and develop your character with a unique progression system.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Characters Mature & Vice
description: "MATURE" and "VICE" can be used in THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV.

title: Legends Of Heropolis DX
description:
Build the town of Heropolis.Gather your strongest heroes and destroy Evilcorp!
The town of Heropolis has been destroyed! Can you rebuild it to be the center of justice once more?
Grow your heroes, gather your friends, and battle evil in this superhero simulation game.

title: Neptunia Riders vs. Dogoos
description: Neptunia Riders vs Dogoos is a bike action game in the Hyperdimension Neptunia series. This game follows Uzume and the four Goddesses on motorcycles in a fight against the Dogoo army and collecting them.

title: Bible Verse Challenge
description:
Test your Bible Verse Knowledge. Try to get the highest score without running out of hearts!

Need to break in the middle of the challenge! The game saves your progress after each question, so return whenever you want.

If you need help you can use the Book Review to study up without worrying about losing hearts, but it doesn't save a score. You'll also be able to use multiple versions of the Bible including KJV (King James Version) and ASV (American Standard Version).

Don't forget to go into settings to update your profile, book version, and control the sound effects and music.

title: Automaton Heart
description: Automaton Heart presents a world unlike any you've seen in a computer game before. Enter the RPG sequel to Automaton Lung, now with a detailed organ management system, many dungeons and overworld areas, experience system and equipment upgrades, plus more.

title: HoooPizza
description: An experiential game where you control a hula hoop instead of a regular game controller to make pizza. Spin the hulahoop to make the largest pizza ever!

title: Depth Loop
description: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

title: Castlevania II: Simon's Quest Revamped
description: Castlevania II: Simon's Quest Revamped is a fan reimagining of the NES original in a 16-bit style with added subweapons, new music, an in-game map and more!

title: Cladun X3
description:
The third numbered entry in the Cladun series.

Cladun X3 is a highly customizable and dynamic pixel art action RPG with a focus on hack-and-slash gameplay. Utilize a variety of weapons, magic, and actions to fend off the monsters monsters and traps that await you, and clear the dungeons!

title: Last Helion
description: Last Helion is a bounty hunting extraction shooter with short, intense play sessions. Take down wanted fugitives across procedurally generated worlds. Battle warring factions and bosses to secure valuable loot. Craft gear, build your ship, and upgrade your character to tackle bigger challenges.

title: Project Ethos
description: Project ETHOS is a free-to-play, 3rd-person roguelike hero shooter.

title: Drop Duchy
description: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game. Use block-dropping mechanics to collect resources, recruit troops to fight against belligerent armies, and let every block shape your realm, leading your path to victory!

title: Kaya's Prophecy
description: Kaya’s Prophecy is a unique village builder where you establish your tribe, gather resources, and craft tools and buildings in a vibrant world. Explore and combat various challenges and other tribes in this vibrant, deck-builder roguelite while appeasing your god to earn his favour.

title: The Planet Crafter: Planet Humble
description:
Experience a fresh start as a Planet Crafter on the brand new world of Planet Humble!
Alone or with friends, scout this unknown land, discover its story, novelties and secrets and accomplish once again the task to terraform an entire world!

title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League - Season of the Joker
description: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League – Season of the Joker launched on March 28, 2024, introducing Joker as a playable character, a Joker-themed Elseworld location, new missions, additional gear sets, and a Battle Pass with cosmetic items. The update is available for all platforms as a free expansion.

title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League - Season of Freeze
description: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League – Season of Freeze launched on July 25, 2024, adding Mrs. Freeze as a playable character, a frozen Elseworld location, new missions, Infamy gear sets, and a Battle Pass with themed cosmetics. The update is available for all platforms as a free expansion.

title: Stickman Strikes: Conquer Fantasy World
description: A dragon's breath turns you into a stickman! Conquer castles, plunder territories, or lead your squad in this fantasy world! During your journey, you can explore various dungeons, discover hidden treasures, engage in trading, farming, craftmaking and more. Will you survive and regain your true self?

title: Hirogami
description: Explore a beautiful origami world as Hiro, a fan-wielding master of the art of ‘folding’. Embark on a mystical journey to save your fragile home from deadly digital invaders. Take on animal forms to traverse the landscape, solve puzzles, overcome enemies, and save the realm.

title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Immortal Pillars
description:
Unleash the power of Chinese mythology in Age of Mythology: Retold’s first expansion, Immortal Pillars. Discover a new pantheon of gods, legendary myth units, and awe-inspiring god powers in an epic campaign inspired by ancient legends.

Summon the fierce goddess Nüwa, command Chiyou, the bull-headed god of war, and call upon Nüba, the relentless bringer of drought. Control the skies with Yinglong, the mighty flying rain dragon, and experience so much more.

title: Island Dwellers
description: Island Dwellers is a calm, turn-based strategy game where you guide a small island tribe through the challenges of rising sea levels. Manage your growing population, gather resources, and explore new islands to secure the future of your tribe.

title: Rolling Football Player
description: Rolling Football Player is a bizarre athletic game where an eternally rolling soccer player takes on athletic challenges! Push your limits in single-player mode!

title: Macho Shot
description: Merge Machos, a fast-paced merging puzzle game, challenges players to grow their Machos by combining like types, while carefully avoiding letting them overflow off the play field. Reach for new high scores as you master the art of Macho merging. Compete against friends in multiplayer modes, with support for up to 4 players using shared Joy-Con controllers. In Score Attack, increase your score and aim for the top of global leaderboards or battle head-to-head, strategically blocking each other out to be the last Macho standing.

title: GhostlyRyokan
description:
An abandoned inn where lost souls wander, your decision will determine its outcome. The truth about the horror and tragedy hidden in an abandoned ryokan. You step into an abandoned ryokan where ghosts wander about, and you will discover the mystery of a terrible tragedy that occurred in the past. The ghost of a maid who once worked there still wanders the inn and drags visitors into the depths of fear.

Players will be forced to make the ultimate choice: to search through the horror-filled inn and collect hidden clues, or to release the spirit or release the grudge. Will you be able to escape the inn safely?

title: Beardbarians
description: Prepare your hair to attack, smack and knock back anyone who dares oppose you in Beardbarians! Pick from a colourful cast of characters and stages to duke it out with friends, locally or online, or work together to protect your gem from goblins by upgrading your abilities in the tower defence mode!

title: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration - Digital Expanded Edition
description: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration Digital Expanded Edition gives you access to the full Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration game plus DLC 1: The Wider World of Atari and DLC 2: The First Console War.

description: Adds the weapon "Recruit Roller Bomb (Homing)."

description: Adds the weapon "Recruit Bug Spray (Rapid-firing)."

description: Adds the weapon "Recruit Sonic Pile (Long Range)."

title: Earth Defense Force: World Brothers 2 - Heavy Load Scatter Gun w/Shield: Recruit Dexter (Spread-Firing)

description: Adds the weapon "Recruit Reverser (Special Weapon)."

description: Adds the character "Riho Futaba, Age 14 (Summer)."

title: Atari 50: The First Console War
description: Well before the current day console wars dominated social media and message boards, Atari's VCS and Intellivision collided in the first major video game rivalry in 1979. The battle only intensified when Intellivision started making games for the VCS, its fiercest rival's machine! In a series of exclusive interviews, the game makers who lived through the first console war explain how and why this unique chapter of video-game history unfolded.

title: The Vanishing
description: The Vanishing is first person horror game. Explore an abandoned town where shadows whisper and secrets lie buried deep. Uncover the truth behind a vengeful spirit awakened from an ancient slumber. Solve puzzles, face your fears, and survive a mystery that claimed so many before you. Can you escape?

title: Hotel 12th
description: Trapped in a mysterious hotel with 12 floors, you're caught in a never-ending loop. Each floor hides secrets and clues—only by paying close attention to the details can you break free. Your goal? Descend to the 0th floor and escape, but beware, the hotel doesn't want you to leave…

title: Isekai Survivors
description: Isekai survivors is an Action roguelite with RPG elements and addictive gameplay loop, cute stylized art style and attractive heroines with unique playstyles to choose from. Collect items, complete quests, upgrade your stats and learn new powerful spells to dominate the battlefield.

title: Netherworld Covenant
description: In the abyss where the mortal realm and netherworld intertwine, becoming a warrior wielding the power of the Ethereal Torch to fight along with the fallen souls. With hardcore action and intriguing roguelike builds, shatter the cursed barriers and unveil the truth woven from blood and soul.

title: The Milliner
description: Explore a failed utopia, slaughter mindless and maniacal foes, and master slick movement in “The Milliner,” a noir gunslinging metroidvania. Your journey will be one of hardship, as a ruthless visionary known only as the Milliner will do everything in its power to stop you and all you stand for.

title: Void Stealer: Bodycam Horror
description: Survive the hostile wilderness of the Cluster in a ferocious bodycam trip to find the source of a mysterious Delta radiation. Use its power to turn yourself into the deadliest hunter and knock the shit out of the most horrifying beings of the multiverse.

title: Outbreak Survivors
description: In the apocalypse, survive against the zombies until the rescue come for you. In this Action Roguelite game, you will unlock new weapons, characters and unique skills to help in your survival.

title: Meteorder
description: Meteors are falling from the sky. Eliminate them by aligning same-colored blocks and launching them upward.

title: Lady Dracula's Mansion
description: Explore a creepy gothic mansion and survive the night while being hunted down by a lady dracula! Lady Dracula's Mansion is an FPS horror game with retro graphics where you must sneak around and use your wits while scavenging whatever weapons and resources you can find to help you survive.

title: Storage Hunter Simulator
description: Bid, win and then sell for profit as you work your way up from the bottom to become the king or queen of the storage auction. Take risks and fight for garages amongst fierce competition as you compete with other bidders to find hidden treasures that will help you turn a profit.

title: City of Nightmares
description: You are a detective who wants to investigate how all the inhabitants of a city died due to a virus. It all started in a hotel that was abandoned along with the city, and it was rumored to be haunted. You are on a quest for answers.

title: Bloodshed
description: BLOODSHED is an exhilarating fusion of Score Chasing gameplay and Roguelite elements, combined with lightning-fast and captivating, retro-styled first-person shooter action.

title: Escape Factory
description: Escape from the deadliest factories in the world with a party of 4-8 players. Experience multiplayer co-op, physics-based challenges.

title: Tales of Grimace
description: Yi Ping is a teenage boy whose life is forever changed when his small town is attacked by an evil cult known as the Maluum. Who is this strange cult? What mysteries are they hiding? And is Yi Ping more closely connected to them than he thinks? Join Yi Ping and his friends on a quest to free Terra.

title: Virulent Vessels: The Legend of Gobbledygunk
description: The Legend of Gobbledygunk

title: Riot Ride
description: Riot Ride is a car-combat roguelike where you play as a car in retro and Tron-like vibes. Speed, drift, and pull off the craziest maneuvers while crushing challenging enemies and bosses with endless synergies of weapons and items.

title: Unto Deepest Depths
description: A dark fantasy strategy game where you must build a party and lead them into the unknown to vanquish the horrors below. Battle through turn-based combat, upgrade your units, and plan your moves carefully in this punishing roguelite where any move could be your last.

title: Clicky Coven
description: Clicky Coven is an incremental game about building a witch coven. Assign witches to gather ingredients, brew potions, and sell them to earn gold.

title: Bramble Royale: A Meteorfall Story
description: Bramble Royale is a wild, no-holds barred card brawl in the wacky world of Meteorfall. Build a face-melting deck, break the rules, and stomp your opponents in this fast-paced & fresh take on roguelike deckbuilders.

title: Kairo: Lore of the Magic
description: Guide Kairo throughout this exciting and challenging metroidvania adventure. Defeat enemies, solve mysteries, learn skills and restore peace back to the kingdom of Haamit.

title: Spook-A-Boo
description: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost-hunting couch co-op game for up to four players. Team up with friends and family to locate and capture sneaky ghosts hiding in plain sight.

title: Apico 3.0: What Lies Beeneath
description: Apico 3.0: What Lies Beeneath invites you to dive into the crystal blue ocean waters surrounding the Apico archipelago and explore its depths. New areas, forageables, quests, and, of course, new bees are yours to discover deep bee-low the watery abyss.

title: Orendale
description: Orendale is a fantasy turn-based RPG with strategic elements. Embark on an epic journey while crafting powerful gears, and forming alliances with diverse combatants to fight 3v3 alongside them. Master a variety of unique classes and Fight formidable foes uncovering the secrets of a dynamic world.

title: Rogue Factory
description: The AUTOMATION bullet heaven! Build, automate, autocast, OBLITERATE!

title: Carbox
description: Carbox is an arcade racer with an ever-growing collection of tracks and challenges. Unlock cars, win cups, and explore user-generated maps. Build and share your own worlds and circuits with the powerful, easy-to-use World Editor, and prove your skills on our global leaderboards!

title: Runny Bunny
description: Get ready for a fast and furry twist on puzzle action in side-scrolling pixel art platforming style!

title: Ascendance Fighters
description: Ascendance Fighters is a bloody indie platform fighter about a distant future in which the government has implanted cybernetic chips into a select few in the military, granting superhuman powers.

title: Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & The White Guardian
description: A mainline Atelier game that's completely offline, standalone, and without gacha elements. This mainline entry sticks to the longtime traditional Atelier series gameplay experience while also building upon it. Atelier fans can enjoy an evolution of the familiar Synthesis and Turn-based Battle systems, culminating in a heartwarming story for all to enjoy. A separate original title set in the same world of the "Atelier Resleriana" gacha game awaits from developers Gust & Team Ninja.

title: Sultan's Game
description: Sultan's Game is a card-based simulation and narrative game, inspired by The One Thousand and One Nights. You are one of the ministers of the mighty Sultan, a fickle, cruel king that treats his subject like pawns of a deadly game for his own pleasure. Forced to make dreadful choices to save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Sultan’s Game, but its consequences too.

title: Harry Potter: Quidditch Champions - Deluxe Edition
description: Your next chapter takes flight! Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Quidditch by playing solo or sharing the magic with friends and family.

title: Colorless Odyssey
description: Colorless Odyssey is a 2D action roguelite that tells the story of a mage who battles the monarch who has stolen all the colours in his world. Defeat them and become ever more powerful with unique upgrades and powers.

title: Calvar: The Darkest Gate
description: First-person horror survival game that plunges players into a dark and disturbing world. As Leonard Valentin, you must fight against supernatural threats while uncovering the mystery behind the cursed piano and the sinister plans of a dark cult.

title: Necrocat
description: In a card field, choose wisely your next move on the grid, for every item collected and every monster defeated brings you one step closer to death. Answer the call and uncover Necrocat's schemes that disrupt the cycle of life!

title: Deep Copy
description: Deep Copy is a top down point-and-click literary adventure set in a hand-painted science fiction world. Awakened with no memory, you must solve puzzles and navigate a branching story to piece together the dense, interconnected mystery at the heart of the lab.

title: Terror Diversion
description: A text-based horror game in which you investigate mysterious urban legends. Along the way, the player takes on the role of a character who gets “lost” and encounters a series of random events.

title: Venus Vacation Prism: Dead or Alive Xtreme
description:
On this island, the moment of love.

The first ever full-fledged first-person adventure romance game in the DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme series, offering romantic encounters with six cute, charming girls!

title: Waligie 3: On Mars
description: Waligie is a critically obscure fangame character (and the collective name of the game series he is in) who was accidentally created when Hippoman and ShadowMan were talking about a spelling mistake made by King Piranha Plant.

title: Storage Guys
description: Team up with friends and run your own storage! Receive, store and ship items to make a profit. Handle everything from boxes to hazardous goods. Design and expand your warehouse, manage costs, power and staff. Make deals with smugglers at night, just keep it hidden from inspection.

title: Combat Directive: Napoleonic Wars
description:
Inspired by legendary classic wargames , Combat Directive brings the strategic depth and ideological brilliance of these classics to life, reimagining the monumental battles of the Napoleonic Wars. It's crafted for the true enthusiasts of historical warfare.

Join the ranks of history's greatest generals and redefine the outcomes of the most significant battles of the Napoleonic era. All it takes is a strategic mind and the will to command. Dive into our game now on Steam and lead your troops to glory!

Dive into 6 detailed campaigns each representing a pivotal phase of the Napoleonic Wars — from Preussisch-Eylau in 1807 to the battles of 1814. Each campaign offers a series of battles that shaped the course of history, bringing over 150 missions to your screen.

Each mission showcases a historical battlefield with meticulously positioned army regiments, bringing military history battle maps directly to your screen. Historical accuracy meets tactical gameplay here, where the positioning and terrain play as much a role as your regiments and decisions.

We've meticulously recreated the authentic design of Napoleonic Wars-era army regiments, complete with historically accurate uniforms and capabilities. It's not just about classifying units as infantry, cavalry, or artillery; it’s about the unique history of each specific regiment, which can significantly impact their role on the battlefield.

To provide full immersion of battlefield command, we’ve combined turn-based elements like hexagonal grid movement with the simultaneous actions characteristic of RTS. This results in gameplay with a more deliberate pace, where quick reflexes aren’t essential—only a keen strategic mind.

Leverage historical formations like squares, columns, or skirmish lines to gain tactical advantages on the battlefield. Transform your units dynamically to suit the unfolding tactical scenario. With a system designed to minimize randomness, predict the outcome of your strategies and attacks with high accuracy, similar to traditional tabletop wargaming.

title: AetherShot
description: Aethershot is a 2D top-down rogue-lite with a spell crafting system to allow for great customization when delving into the trial grounds at the Temple of Masrong.

title: Samabake! Scramble
description: Samabake! Scramble is a 3D community formation observation simulator set in a coastal town in a certain region depicting the residents of that town.

title: Tryment
description: "TrymenT" is a visual novel that explores themes of love, friendship, and personal growth. Set in a modern-day world, players follow the lives of the protagonists as they face their own struggles and aspirations, each hoping to change their circumstances and find happiness. Through interactive choices, players can influence the story's direction, experiencing multiple endings based on their decisions. With beautifully illustrated characters and an emotional soundtrack, this game offers a touching and immersive experience for those looking to reflect on the meaning of change and connection.

title: Fizz Quiz
description: FizzQuiz is a trivia game with over 100 topics and 10,000 questions. Play alone or with up to 10 friends in seven unique rounds, featuring questions in text, images, models, and audio formats.

title: Depths of Faveg
description: Fight your way through hordes of monsters, and try to reach the fabled treasure at the bottom of the dungeon of Faveg in this brutal Roguelike RPG. Can you train a party strong enough?

title: Hotelnomaly
description: Hotelnomaly is an endless loop anomaly hunt game where you play as a mechanic hired to fix an elevator in a lonely 1930s hotel. Discover eerie anomalies, navigate haunted corridors, and uncover dark secrets.

title: The Vanished Soul
description: The Vanished Soul is an indie, first-person, psychological horror game made by one person. It is set in 2016 in the fictional place called Novazenica. Dive into realistic and atmospheric setting, solve various puzzles and interact with many objects in the game!

title: Fengdu: Chronicles of Battle
description: "Fengdu Chronicles of battle" is a roguelike game that combines auto chess and card building. The use of cards will directly affect the battle situation. Collect different cards, elixirs and magic tools in battles, combine your own strategy and complete this journey to become an immortal.

title: Red Night
description: A 2.5D game immersing you in the atmosphere of Soviet perestroika. A grim mystery awaits in the city of M, where a terrifying incident has occurred. You’ll explore locations, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets hidden in the shadows of events that shook this world.

title: Moons That Belong
description: A 2D space strategy game that challenges your tactical prowess. Command your fleet, conquer planets, and outsmart your opponents.

title: Portraits of Doom
description: Portraits of Doom is a 20 map set for Doom I and Doom II. The first episode takes place in Doom I, followed by a special New Game Plus in Doom II. This NG+ features Doom II weapons and monsters. It also reimagines the first episode, complete with different progression at times. For instance: things that exploded in the first episode now lie in ruin in NG+. All combined into one single Doom II wad file for your convenience.

title: A Few Days With: Samantha
description: Embark on a sensual butterfly-hunting adventure with Samantha, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Samantha's enticing layers.

title: Blasphemous II: True Torment
description:
Blasphemous II: True Torment update includes New Game Plus mode, expansion of existing zones, new zone connections, new abilities, new enemies, new prayers, quality-of-life features, accessibility features and more.

In more detail:

Expanded zones: Choir of Thorns, Sunken Cathedral, and Basilica of Ancient Faces have all been reforged with new challenges to explore and conquer.
New connecting zones: Quicker traversal between previously explored areas.
A new challenge: the Labyrinth of Tides presents a new challenge for this ready to face it.
New Game +: Totally adjustable difficulty options from stronger enemies to deadlier spikes and lethal falls.
New Enemies: Cvstodia’s denizens rise to face you, are you up to their challenge?
A host of upgrades for the Penitent One, quality-of-life improvements, and new achievements.

title: Countess in Crimson: The Black Dawn
description: The Black Dawn DLC adds 3 new romance options into the game

title: Green Jumper
description: 2D Platform game and adventure with some puzzles levels to play

title: Langort
description: Langort is a roguelite deck-building hack-and-slash where you are a swashbuckling hero on a quest to defeat the Lich Queen. Fight endless hordes of undead, growing more powerful with every kill.

title: Banquet for Fools
description: The Pavura needs four volunteers to solve the mystery of an abandoned village. Answer the call in this party-based action adventure RPG.

title: Imperium Eternal
description: Immerse yourself in the ultimate real-time strategy war game where all of human history is at your command. Create powerful empires across all eras on a scale never seen before.

title: Cat-Astrophy
description: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

title: Croaktopia
description: Cozy game where you can farm, build, and fight as a cute frog!

title: Xenotech Arena
description: A Neo-Japan inspired roguelite arena shooter.

title: Rogue Flight
description: Rogue Flight is a breathtaking arcade space combat game inspired by the landmark style of 80's and 90's prestige anime. Traverse the Sol system and join a flight force voiced by a veteran cast, featuring Japanese talent from Sailor Moon, Neon Genesis Evangelion, Gundam, Naruto & One Piece, and English voice talent featured in Overwatch and Fallout 76, League of Legends and Marvel's Avengers. Jump into true stylish arcade action with a huge host of spacecraft upgrades, game modes and multiple narrative paths.

title: My Happy Village in the Kingdom
description: Welcome to your village in the kingdom, manage resources, complete tasks and events in real-time, get gold and materials from dungeons, win a new castle, steal items from magic characters, increase affinity and work on your popularity. And more in the Medieval Clicker. The magic dragon awaits you.

title: Foxlore
description: Foxlore follows the adventure of Filo, a cunning fox who stumbles upon a mysterious map leading to an ancient relic of untold power. As Filo unravels the secrets of the relic, he uncovers hidden truths that could change the fate of his world forever.

title: You Can't See Ghosts!
description: You Can't See Ghosts is a puzzle game about spatial awareness and deductive reasoning with a charming story where you play as an invisible ghost. Bump into walls, step on glass, and other clues to locate yourself and reach the exit. Perfect for both experienced players and newcomers alike.

title: Dexter The Hamster
description: Help Dexter chomp and shoot his way out of the deceptively oppressive Happy Hamster Farms in 6 personality packed platforming levels.

title: Zombie Restaurant
description: Prepare delicious meals with ingredients that fall from the sky to feed hordes of hungry zombies before their appetite turns to us.

title: Garden of Witches
description: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

title: Claritas
description: Claritas is a 2D, turn-based, party-building dungeon crawler RPG. Assemble your party from diverse characters with unique abilities. Battle through challenging dungeons, earning experience and loot as you prepare for the ultimate test of your skills. Endless strategic combinations await!

title: Mimic Me
description: Mimic Me is a turn-based roguelike where you control a crate mimic, rolling across a board to destroy enemy crates and collect gold.

title: NebulaStrike
description: Nebula Strike is a space-themed 2.5D top-down twin-stick shooter game. This is the first game I independently developed, and I hope you have fun playing it. If you have any comments or suggestions, please leave them in the comment section. Thank you again for playing my game.

title: Dai-chan's Great Adventure: World's End
description:
Flowing rivers, rushing waterfalls, unexplored towering trees...
Nitori's adventure begins here and now!

title: This is Fine: Maximum Cope
description: The world famous meme debuts in his first video game. Play as Question Hound in a retro adventure platformer, traversing perilous pits and enraged enemies to overcome the manifestations of his anxieties!

title: Minorcraft
description: Minorcraft is an experimental horror game.

title: Melting of the Winter Gears
description: The night outside is harsh, but the warmth of good words and company will keep our spirits high. Here, the storm cannot reach. See how the snowflakes melt upon the window panes? How the wind dies with a whisper? It’s as if the whole world is going silent tonight. Silent for the story I’m to tell. The story of a Doll without memory, a cat without form, a soldier without family and a drifter without a home.

title: Chroma Slayer
description: Slay chromatically-attuned monsters in front of the city walls.

title: The Technomagical Method
description: The Technomagical Method is a tough puzzle game about the scientific method. Every ritual has secret rules that you must gradually crack with inductive logic: "Why does this work and not that? What do these patterns have in common".

title: Alma the Captive
description:
Alma the Captive is a short exploration adventure game with a playtime of around 20 to 30 minutes.

Though originally created as a practice in game development, it turned out to be something easily enjoyable, so I’ve decided to release it.

The story has a dark, subdued tone centered around the theme of painting. While it is not intended to provide a horror experience, it does contain mild horror elements. Please be cautious if you are sensitive to such content.

title: Burger Witch
description: Magic meets mayhem in this frantic burger-crafting adventure! Assemble enchanted burgers, manage chaotic kitchen orders, and work with friends to meet your spooky quota before time runs out. Cook, cast, and conquer the kitchen—because in this dungeon, witches don’t brew potions, they grill patties!

title: Interstellar Pioneering
description: Interstellar Pioneering is a casual game where players collect energy gems in the starry sky, expand their territory, and gather resources. Recruit fairy helpers to assist in collecting and managing resources, balancing expansion and consumption to create a vast starry world.

title: You're a Dad
description: Be a responsible adult, make dinner and take care of your child. You must do this. Nothing else. Choose your path and accept the consequences in this sleep deprived text adventure where everything is totally fine.

title: Evil Vents
description: Evil Vents is a survival game where you are trapped inside a vent system with a creature that consumes flesh.

title: Sapphire City 2
description: After a narrow escape you find yourself in an unexplored part of the city with fresh opportunities and new enemies. Face off against corrupt officials, law enforcers and merciless gangs as you delve back into the shadows.

title: Aldo: Memory of the Kingdom
description: A simple, atmospheric adventure. No attack button needed—your hero fights on his own. Explore endless islands, save your village, and rebuild your kingdom.

title: Shuffle Quest
description: Gather your party and shuffle your spells, it’s questing time! Bring up to four friends together in a whole new dimension of roguelike deckbuilding. Four decks are better than one!

title: Night Hacking
description: An interactive story about hacking, unveiling secrets, chatting with people, and searching for purpose.

title: Ooze Keeper
description: Ooze Keeper is a tactical roguelike that combines monster collecting and resource management. You'll harness the unique abilities of various slimes, construct efficient structures, and optimize resources to grow your farm and earn money with each turn.

title: Celestial Crown
description: Celestial Crown is a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck can change completely between fights. Switch your equipment to cover your weaknesses, create powerful combos, and counter other decks.

title: Time Chess
description: This is a chess puzzle game where you can rewind time to any previous move, but the fate of death is unchangeable. Some pieces are unaffected by time and influence all past moves simultaneously. Use these mechanics, including reality overlap, to checkmate the king in the present or the past.

title: Heart of Artemisa
description: Heart of Artemisa is a rhythm adventure game, with dungeon crawler & Roguelite elements. The player has to defeat enemies and solve puzzles at the beat of music.

title: Curse Rounds
description: Survive random rounds and kill enemies with your pistolflash while choosing a curse card for yourself! No two attempts are the same!

title: Akaku Forest
description: Akaku Forest is a game that blends puzzles, platforming, and thrilling boss battles in a Metroidvania-style format. You take control of Aki-Maku, a courageous forest spirit. Use your torch to solve puzzles or face off against your enemies. Save the forest!

title: Rot in Paradise
description: Rot in Paradise is a short 2D horror visual novel set in October of Australia, following the story of a vacationist named June and her friends on a weekend getaway at an island resort where they have no choice but to go with the tides.

title: Elara's Light
description: Elara's Light is a relaxing, yet punishing 2D precision platformer. Every jump tests perseverance and precision—one mistake could drag Elara back into the darkness. Uncover the stories of the forsaken, and guide Elara toward the light she longs for.

title: Decay of Opulence
description: Survive the aftermath of a divine cataclysm in this 1-bit pixel art, turn-based horror RPG. Explore a rural town overrun by rival cults.

title: Space Cycle
description: Space resources are the battleground for warring factions. As a Space Defense Officer, protect your faction's assets in a vast, hostile universe. Allocate resources, upgrade defenses, and repel relentless enemy attacks! With over 50 unique units and deep strategy, experience real-time tower defense!

title: The Girl Who Wasn't There
description: Ranko and her friend Astrid must investigate the vanishing of a girl from their school. Learn about the secrets of St. Joachim to find her, but be cautious! A bad step may lead you towards an ugly end...

title: Chior
description: You had a pretty rough fall. Trying to regain your composure you try to look around before realizing you can't see anything. Hope that your other senses will serve you better.

title: Devil's Drizzle
description: An enchanting 2D pixel art platformer with an engaging story, starring a brave kid, their trusty umbrella, and Sumerian demons. It features a diverse range of mechanics and level designs, including action, adventure, horror, puzzle, and drama.

title: Spinal Fantasy
description: Spinal Fantasy is a 10 minutes parody game of Final Fantasy 7. It starts with Sephiroth stealing the spine of Cloud, who tries to retrieve it. On his way he meets Tifa, Aerith and Black Mage whom also have things stolen from them.

title: August Ends
description: August Ends is a short story RPG Maker game with supernatural elements that centres around cooking. It takes place over the span of a week in late summer and follows the monotonous daily routine of a woman living alone in the woods, isolated save for her trips to an abandoned shrine deep among the trees.

title: Heroes of Valor
description: This is war, soldier. Pick a class, gear up, and hit the front lines. Whether you're storming beaches, piloting fighters, or holding the line with your squad, your orders are clear: fight hard, fight smart, and never back down. Enlist now! Become a Hero of Valor today!

title: Lust Shards
description: An 18+ visual novel by MindOfFur. Each route contains interesting stories, multiple endings, and depending on your choices, intimate encounters.

title: The Dream Observatory
description: Become the dream weaver in The Dream Observatory. Craft the perfect oniric journey for each dreamer by using and combining dream portal cards, tailoring each experience to their needs and emotions in this immersive cozy single-player cards management game.

title: Space Diva
description: An interactive narrative experience about the most flamboyant beings in the universe. Join Carmen, a somewhat absent-minded middle-aged lady who has to endure bizarre situations in her space truck. And possibly mess things up like crazy.

title: Reliving the End
description: Well, we've all lived through the end, but the question is, are you ready to Relive, the End?

title: Kingpin's Lair
description: Your mission is to penetrate the residence of a Drug Lord, eliminate all resistance,and escape without falling prey to the temptations within. As you approach the entrance, you're shot with some kind of a dart. You pull it from your arm, and all too suddenly, things start getting strange. Panic grips you, and all you can do now is let instinct hurl you through this hallucinogenic craze!

title: A Hidden Mountain Factory
description: A map by Grzegorz Werner that has you infiltrate a hidden mountain factory.

title: Deceased.cable
description: Single map for Boom format made as a tribute to dead.wire by Xaser.

title: Origens: Story Mode Remastered
description: A 3D story-based game where you play as different members of twitch streamer ORIGETV's community.

title: Train Sim World 5: LGV Mediterranee - Marseille: Avignon Route
description: Experience the excitement of high-speed rail, aboard the iconic TGV Duplex, through sun-soaked Southern France with Train Sim World: LGV Méditerranée.

title: Duck Side of the Moon
description: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

title: Verde
description: Build a small town of seedlets, mysterious seed like creatures in this cozy city builder. Build facilities, put up decorations, and help the seedlets thrive!

title: Sea Sniffers
description: Sea Sniffers is a cozy diving game in which you explore the ocean with your trusty seal companion. Encounter strange creatures and exotic treasures in sunken ships or hidden caves. Discover the deep sea and all its secrets!

title: Blast Course
description: Blast Course is a first-person platformer centered around the classic game mechanic of Rocket Jumping. Control Kit in a day at work testing "Hyperboom", a revolutionary transport technology based on explosives.

title: The Legend of Khiimori
description: The Legend of Khiimori is a system-driven game where you explore the untamed land of 13th century Mongolia as a brave courier rider. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

title: The Great Farce
description: The Great Farce is a non-linear mystery game that follows Claudia Marcó, journalist and former First Lady, during a series of attacks targeting the recently democratized country of Castela's politicians and their families, having to unveil the deepest secrets of their young democracy.

title: A Tiny Eternity
description: A Tiny Eternity is a cute and difficult Souls-like with Rogue elements and Twin-stick controls. Walk throw endless arenas filled with enemies to find out how come you trully never "die".

title: Stellar Terminus
description: Stellar Terminus is a combat-focused, hard sci-fi dungeon crawler set at the heat death of the universe. Scavenge for resources, robots, and knowledge in the procedurally generated ruins of long-gone civilizations.

title: Detective of the Dead
description: In this narrative noir adventure game you are a detective in the colorful Mexican underworld and must prevent a conspiracy to ruin the classic Día de los Muertos forever. Investigate & use your wit to solve many cases, puzzles, mini-games. Your trusted magic companion dog Xolo is there to help!

title: A Night With: Spirit
description: Trapped within an old television, a ghostly girl with a mysterious past, awaits a player who can help her break free.

title: Jin & Jan
description: Jin & Jan: A ghostly puzzle game for two minds but only one player. Control two brothers, Jin and Jan, on a spooky adventure. Jin does what you say, but Jan always does the opposite! Master their unique movements to solve mind-bending puzzles and overcome obstacles in a ghostly world.

title: Iron Crown
description: Iron Crown is a randomly generated Turn-Based deck building with heavy Rogue-like elements. Following our fellow heroes on their journey players will find random elements to help them reach their randomly generated goal, discover secrets, and claim the Iron Crown.

title: Runeomicon
description: Cast runes to summon the goddess of death, unleash eldritch horrors to fend off villagers, and wield dark magic in this unique tower defense. Balance your power between summoning and fortifying as waves of enemies close in. Can you complete the ritual before your defenses crumble?

title: Infinite Library
description: Your mission is to protect the library from imminent danger. Navigate through treacherous puzzles using ancient books that allow you to manipulate the laws of physics.

title: Fishing Mayhem
description: Fishing Mayhem is a multiplayer game in which players catch fish and try to blow the other boats out of the water.

title: MoveFort
description: Movefort is a movable tower defense game where you build your own fortress on a moving base. Use resources to upgrade and power up Towers.Each tower has unique upgrade effects. Try different combinations to find the most effective way to defend against enemies.

title: Place Icebergs Apart
description: It's a puzzle game about placing iceberg tiles apart so they don't touch each other. Meet adorable polar animals and protect them from orcas!

title: Pizza Western
description: The Death King wandered the Wild West until he found a lone bar in the desert. After ordering a pizza, a stranger entered and dared to steal it. Without hesitation, the Death King pursued, ready to destroy anything in his way—bandits, zombies, or worse.

title: The Moon Ate the Sun
description: Defeat hordes of enemies, upgrade your weapons and abilities as the evil Moon that was dormant for millennia.

title: Fight Life: Vanguard
description: Engage in strategic turn-based combat, manage and upgrade each character, and strive to reclaim harmony in a world on the brink of oblivion. Take on the mantle of leadership as you guide a mercenary squad through perilous landscapes, selecting your comrades from a diverse pool of skilled recruits.

title: The Last Drop
description: The Last Drop is a pixel art top-down shooter where you control the last water droplet on Earth. Battle waves of enemies with unique weapons, customize the map, and compete on the online leaderboard.

title: Foosball Runner
description: Dive into Foosball Runner, a thrilling twist on table football where you are the ball! Navigate futuristic tables in a spaceship, dodge spinning figures, collect keys, and unlock gates to score under a minute. Use power-ups to stop figures or boost your speed.

title: Midnight Swamp
description: A grim point-and-click adventure where you dive into a world of dark fairy tales. Play as a tourist who must find a way out of the mysterious Midnight Swamp.

title: Clutter III : Who Is The Void?
description:
The first Clutter game in the larger 1024x768 dimensions. And bigger is most certainly better as the objects get cleaner and the action becomes more Extreme.

The Void has taken the Clutter game to whole new heights, but his or her identity remains a mystery. Can you sift through the clutter and reveal who he or she truly is?

And you might just learn a little bit about what it means to be a game developer creating games like Clutter.

title: Guardians of the Sanctree
description: You and allies, avian inhabitants of Sanctree City, build structures and production lines on the tree, crafting weapons to fend off subterranean insects. Defense is just the start—dig deeper, destroy nests, fortify new defenses against escalating threats for an impregnable stronghold.

title: Arid Arnold
description: Arid Arnold is a classic puzzle-platforming adventure, explore 9 unique worlds, travel in time, talk to racoons, go to hell and back in search of the fountain of water. In one world you might be rotating the entire level, but in the next you will need to travel in time, there’s even a few levels where you need to coordinate with a clone of yourself.

title: Cargo-Bot
description: The puzzle game that challenges your brain and helps you learn programming concepts. Give instructions to a robot arm which moves crates to the right place. Have full control in 36 levels. Be logical, play Cargo-Bot.

title: The Last One and Then Another
description:
The Last and Then Another is a free standalone expansion to the narrative-driven experience HOW FISH IS MADE.

"Your eyes will be my mouth. My fins will be your tongue. More is more is more is more! Devour your smallness! Fill the void!"

title: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
description: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based party games, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!

title: Murder Is Game Over: The Blackinton Curse
description: A new stand-alone murder mystery in the Murder Is Game Over series. Can you break the 150-year-old family curse before it claims another victim?

title: Cats Hiding in 3D
description: Explore the coastal town and find cats in this cute and relaxing searching game. Can you find all 100 of the hiding cats?

title: Black Dust
description: Explore a hand-drawn world of trash with your giant robot, trusty orb, and (lack of) platforming skills! These hostile lands will test your understand of many bizarre mechanics, and a complete exploration can only achieved by the most devoted of players.

title: Citadale: The Accursed Seal
description: The dark lord Rhogul is about to be resurrected and the only man capable of stopping him is dying. Explore a vast open world in this action game with metroidvania elements and join Arion Dorleac in his final days for one last time...

title: Retro Horror Story
description: Embark on a heart-pounding journey through a cursed maze in this thrilling survival horror game. Evade a terrifying monster and solve intricate puzzles to uncover dark secrets. Can you escape the nightmare?

title: Fossil Skater
description: A racing game where you ride dinosaurs who skate with car-shoes.

title: Idle Saga
description: Welcome to the world of Idle Saga, a magnificent world of swords and magic! Enjoy diverse gameplay, splendid equipment, and transformations into gods and demons that allow you to dominate all realms. With cool elves and powerful mercenaries by your side to battle ferocious bosses!

title: Cave Crawler 2
description: Cave Crawler 2 is a retro-inspired 2D side-scroller. Escape a series of winding caves full of strange creatures and treacherous platforming challenges.

title: Mullet Madjack: Deluxe Edition
description: Mullet Madjack is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a classic anime. The DELUXE Edition contains Mullet Mad Jack GAME, an official ARTBOOK and OST SOUNDTRACKS !

title: Hello Counsel
description: Hello Counsel is a short, romantic comedy visual novel that follows criminal sensation, Poise, who just got arrested! Good thing, her hot lawyer boyfriend Salem is here to help her avoid any jail time — only if she stops flirting with him, that is.

title: Piworld
description: First pixel 2D game, which include MMO and PVP system for anyone, who wants to try something new.

title: june 18 2024 (White people in China)
description: Adapted from 'Wet Dreams Can Beta Demo' by 'Immortal'

title: Be Yourself
description: be yourself is a compilation of 5 little games, inspired by Deimos' Endless Pursuit of Becoming Deimos: Part One, from deimos, and Kylie Minogue: Breathe (1998).mp3, from GURN GROUP.

title: Museum.exe
description:
Museum.exe is a virtual museum about games that have contributed to the field of game design without relying on combat, competition and violence. Games that changed the field of video games, and will be forever looked upon by generations of both players and designers alike.

This interactive museum brings its own challenges, puzzles and secrets for you to explore, in a first-person puzzler format. In it's five exhibitions, you'll get to learn about 25 games that you should probably know about, in a way you probably have not experienced before.

You can not die or win this game and at no point will you be forced to exit the museum. For your optimal experience, treat it as you would a typical museum visit.

title: Raide
description: train tracks!

title: To Clean The Mountain
description:
To Clean The Mountain is a platforming adventure where you throw yourself towards the summit. The spirit of the mountain will talk with you as you traverse a variety of environments.

Environments
Handcrafted levels based on a variety of mountainous landscapes. Each environment features unique mechanics for you to interact with and learn, combining the interesting platforming elements with puzzle solving.

The Mountain
Elements of the world change based on how you assist the mountain. The game is completable regardless of your choices, but the difficulty is up to you.

title: Minecraft: Bundles of Bravery
description: Minecraft: Bundles of Bravery adds bundles, as well as Hardcore mode for Bedrock Edition. It was announced at Minecraft Live 2024.

title: Ruins of Dawnseeker
description: Awaken to a world shrouded in mystery in this captivating JRPG dungeon crawler. Follow the intertwined fates of Feriza, Layla, and Yosephine as they navigate treacherous dungeons and face formidable foes, all while piecing together the fragments of their lost memories.

title: Battle Mountain
description: Battle Mountain, the pinnacle of Combat Climbing. Athletes from all over the globe gather to claim the ultimate prize: The Crowntain to grant their deepest wish. Fight across challenging maps with your friends in competitive 2-6 player chaos.

title: Free Durov
description: FREE DUROV – experience all the hardships of prison life and try to escape using your intellect and agility. Can you overcome all the traps and keep the encryption key safe?

title: Clone Your Way Out
description: Embark on a retro sci-fi journey in "Clone Your Way Out," a puzzle side-scroller with nostalgic pixel art. You'll control clones escaping from a mysterious lab, using a Clone Gun to solve deadly puzzles and traps. Enjoy retro visuals and unique cloning mechanics as you guide your clones to freedom.

title: Seifuku Kanojo: Mayoigo Engage
description:
In Fukuoka's Kurume, there lives a shy female student voice actor named Yumeha Nitahara. With her timid nature, she rarely receives work offers. Just as she is about to give up, a new transfer student, the protagonist, suddenly appears before her.

"I'm Yumeha's manager now!"

A relationship between a voice actor and her manager begins with a lie. Then, one day, a certain job opportunity comes Yumeha's way. The two, still struggling to fully grow up, repeatedly drift apart and come closer together. And eventually, this leads to love.

title: Nortopia
description: Help the penguins who fled from the plague and undead build a new life on the island of Nortopia! Construct a fortress, trade with other families, explore dungeons, embark on sea voyages for treasures, and engage in clan battles for power!

title: The Fireblue Conundrum
description: The Fireblue Conundrum is a miniwad for Doom 2 of varied difficulty and gameplay. It's Boom compatible and every map is meant to be played from a pistol start.

title: Grotto of the Scorned
description: Big non linear level for Doom II, expect the difficulty to be on par with something like Plutonia.

title: 40 Minute-r
description: This is a 14 map vanilla compatible wad where each map is made in about 40 minutes.

title: Last Zombie
description: LAST ZOMBIE is a Single Player Action Adventure Game taking place in the Half-Life 2 Universe.

title: Fear the Timeloop
description: Fear The Timeloop is a survival horror game where every fifteen minutes, the protagonist dies and resets to the starting point. Can you break the cycle and escape the loop?

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Crossroads
description: Patch 7.1 introduces: new main scenario quests; the first installment from the alliance raid Echoes of Vana'diel, Jeuno: The First Walk; the Extreme version of the Sphene's Burden trial; a new dungeon, Yuweyawata Field Station; a new Ultimate Raid, Futures Rewritten; a new type of high-end content, Chaotic Alliance Raids; and more sidequests and sidecontent.

title: Nerd: Tracing Dayline
description: An adventure game created with the concept of "a game for a single song."

title: Bokura: Planet
description: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores new possibilities in cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

title: Izon
description: Chibito, who possesses the power of creation, and Kyojin, a weapon of destruction, overcome obstacles and gradually understand and depend on each other. In a decadent and beautiful world, they navigate an adventure driven by the conflicting forces of destruction and creation.

title: PixelQuest: Herb's Adventure
description: A classic, story-driven JRPG with a modern dice-building combat system.

title: Regeneration
description: Regeneration is a third-person survival horror game where you explore an abandoned post-Soviet complex as a scientist. Isolated from the outside world, you face anomalous creatures born from past experiments. Survive, uncover dark secrets, and stop the nightmare before it consumes everything.

title: Shadow Leap
description: In the world of the night, the protagonist who has the power to manipulate "shadows" performs exhilarating actions to "leap" around and, together with his shadow clone, defeats his enemies. Shadow Clone Action game.

title: Bioweaver
description: Bioweaver is an RPG game with the main content of treasure hunting and character building. You can use basic programming logic to deeply customize your skill sets, and you can also create organs with different attributes and functions with the special crafting system.

title: Witch Halloween Dollhouse
description: This little addition sheds light on a possible future that Chelsey may have in the Doll House, and offers several scenes regarding the consequences of the exorcism. Having held on to the jester's box, Chelsey never thought she would end up on the other side of reality. In the house of broken toys, she will need to make a choice: should she stay and become a doll, or should she try to get out?

title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Safe Haven
description:
Brace yourself for the darkest chapter yet in the epic Poppy Playtime saga.

You are pushed deeper into the undiscovered depths of the Playtime Co. factory, far below anything the world knew. Here, you’ll encounter terrifying new threats and discover shocking revelations. Can you outwit the unnatural new creations lurking in the shadows? Can you survive here long enough to eventually unravel the mysteries behind the experiments? Every step will test your courage, every puzzle will challenge your mind, and every corner may be your last.

Will you escape the horrors hidden within Playtime Co., or will you succumb to the terror? Survival isn’t guaranteed. Fear is.

title: Tootum
description: Tootum is a charming pixel art metroidvania game that immerses players in a magical world full of mysteries. With magic-based combat, a wide variety of items, and an engaging narrative, Tootum offers a rich experience in exploration and discovery.

title: Time Riggers
description: Challenge your spatio-temporal logic and memory in this time-hop puzzle game.

title: Petrified Pawns
description: Petrified Pawns has chess-style movement and turn-based combat. Fight new types of chess pieces and bosses. Build your army and keep them alive while you advance through the dungeon. Use healing spells, loot and strategy to keep your king alive and to reach the end with as many units as possible.

title: Serke
description: Serke is a hack and slash game where you fight against a virus invasion. Use 5 different weapons to defeat your enemies and save the virtual world.

title: Retro Drive: Revamped
description: Get your '80s vibes in full throttle with Retro Drive! Immerse yourself in the retro aesthetic, gripping narrative, and an unforgettable synthwave soundtrack.

title: BlightFog
description: Journey across a dying world. Manage your resources. Build relationships with anthropomorphic characters. Find a new home or become a fuel drinking madman.

title: Signed Mary
description: A psychological horror visual novel, in which not your choices of action will determine the story’s end, but the choices of how to perceive your reality.

title: Kill The Dream
description: Kill The Dream is a survival horror game that combines brutal grid-based combat with first person exploration. Search the town of Frozen Pines, where survivors and monsters alike have been warped by the twisted presence in the lake. Hack your way through, end the nightmare, kill the dream.

title: Exovoid Carnage
description: Exovoid Carnage is an intense wave-based arena shooter that cranks up the chaos to eleven. Shoot! Shred! Survive!

title: Thaw
description: Mine for ore, trace your memories, and mine again. When you reach the Snow Crystal at the lowest level, the long winter will come to the end. This gentle and quiet mining visual novel offers a small sense of accomplishment, perfect for sleepless nights.

title: Calm Skies
description: Experience the thrill and tranquility of flying in Calm Skies. Perfect your wingsuit skills as you explore diverse biomes, dodge obstacles, and perform daring tricks to complete skill-testing challenges. Customize your character and enjoy a unique blend of excitement and serenity in the skies.

title: New Fief
description: A relaxed and peaceful territorial management game, without the interference of hostile/competitive forces, allowing you to farm with peace of mind.

title: Mint's Hints
description: Mint's Hints is a cancelled children's show, and you've found yourself on the old set. Find paw-shaped Hints with special ghost-detecting Flashbrights, and discover the secret behind the show's closure with your Happy-Go-Lucky Notebook, but be careful, the stars of the show are after you.

title: Banshee: Demon Girl
description: BANSHEE is a single-player third-person soulsborne stealth action game. The first Japanese kunoichi in 16th century Europe: an incredible story of revenge from beyond the grave. Fight with a katana, move like a ninja, seduce like a geisha, and use vampiric abilities, learn from mistakes.

title: Voice of Belldona
description: Voice of Belldona weaves a story of swords, magic, and sci-fi! The game features roguelike decks, turn-based combat, JRPG elements, and customizable builds. Choose a character and combat style, explore randomly generated maps, power up your team, crush your enemies and... interact with a cute loli?

title: Quibble Race
description:
Compete with the computer or your friends to earn the most money in a futuristic alien-horse racing game. Sponsor some of the quibbles or sabotage them to improve your odds.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Dragon Takers
description: "Rise, those who resist the dragons—"

title: Noroi Kago: The Grudged Domain
description: Noroi Kago: The Grudged Domain is a four-player co-op survival horror game centered on the supernatural "Yokai" from Japanese folklore. Trapped in a cursed domain, you and your companions must work together to endure the curse, hide from the terrifying Yokai, and find a way to escape.

title: Night Manor
description:
Trapped in a nightmare where you must use your wits to survive and escape!

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Deep Crafter
description: As a specially trained explorer in "Deep Crafter", you'll gather resources, design production lines, automate everything, and explore this vast, ocean-covered planet to uncover its secrets.

title: Grimstone
description:
Praise Biggan, the four of you survived the saloon fire. But somethin' tells me this story's just gettin' started... Almost two years in the making, this massive game was actually started before its thematic cousin Rail Heist.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Super Alloy Crush
description: "Super Alloy Crush" is a 2D side-scrolling fighting action game. Play as Kelly and Muu (No.02) to defeat enemies and obtain treasure! Join hands with friends and take on challenges together!

title: Mooncat
description:
Jump and dash through forests, caves and mountains, in search of the egg. Conceived as a spiritual sequel to Barbuta,
Game available on UFO 50.

title: Attactics
description:
Carefully arrange your troops for maximum advantage in this game of realtime tactics.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Mortol
description:
How many people will lay down their lives to save Mortolia? The first game in the Mortol series.

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Twin Flames
description: Embark on a mystical journey as Savitri and Satyavan, two characters destined to become Twin Flames. In this enthralling turn-based puzzle adventure, you'll guide them through a beautifully stylized low poly world, navigating a hex grid filled with obstacles and challenges.

title: Velgress
description:
The space pirate Alpha is trapped in the deep pit known as Velgress. Help her climb out!

Game available on UFO 50.

title: Avianos
description:
In a time when birds rule, an epic war rages between the red talons and the blue beaks.
Game available on UFO 50.

title: Mirage: Ignis Fatuus
description: As the world turns short of Mana, Mirage, the city of illusions, is in danger of collapsing! Help Kyuboy’d make his way through mind-boggling puzzles to save his hometown!

title: Dragon Front: Adventures
description: A turn-based, deckbuilding roguelike where you take charge of a legendary Champion and build your forces by collecting units, spells, supplies and relics. Explore unique combinations to overwhelm the opposition.

title: An Unexpectedly Green Journey
description: From birth to death, craft your orc's legacy. Wield the powers of a shaman or chief. Conquer the world. Become a god or a demon lord. Do what orcs do best!

title: Magic Archery
description: Train a commoner to become the greatest archer in this short incremental game! Increase your stats, buy upgrades, infuse your arrows with magic, and gather clout from quests.

title: Out of Your Mind
description: A hand-drawn, comic-style visual novel where your choices shape the storyline. Guide Lia through various decisions and emotions that lead to different outcomes.

title: A Hell of a Bloody Dragon
description:
In this Open World Horror Adventure FPS, You have been miraculously resurrected from the dead with a noble mission: to capture a magnificent dragon for the Red Lord, who believes that this act will bring happiness to his kingdom.

Embark on a perilous journey and gather essential tools along the way to aid you in successfully capturing the dragon and ultimately bring joy to the heart of the Red Lord.

You will rediscover yourself and go through some horrific challenges before going home.

title: All Whispering Tome
description: A reading adventure game about exploring stories. The hidden stories in the game are unfold while you read multiple seamingly unrelated stories.

title: Lost Diskettes Vol. 1
description: This is a collection of short and experimental horror experiences, focused on surreal and bizarre plots.
