Welcome to the mysterious world of Ancient Egypt! Solve mahjong levels and collect artifacts to uncover secrets of Giza valley, Old city, Desert and Nile.
Discover how the Great Pyramid of Giza was constructed, how Egyptians learned to read hieroglyphs, why Only the pharaoh could own a cat in Ancient Egypt and many more surprising facts.
Simple and engaging gameplay of mahjong solitaire is the best way to relax. We made it even better with new game features: you will find huge treasures, tricky locks, new bonus tiles and more. Solving some layouts is not easy, but you can always use powerups to beat the most challenging levels.

title: Deckarium
description: A deck-building pet simulator. Play pet cards to populate your terrarium or aquarium, be on the lookout for card-packs to expand your deck, keep your creatures fed to collect coins, and use them to buy more pets! But look out for ghosts! They hunger for the souls of your pets.

title: Shining Hero
description: A single-player roguelike game with pixel art that blends deck-building with grid-based turn-based strategy.

title: Babette
description: There's this old 90s virtual pet game at a yard sale. It's called 'Babette'. Now you can play with Babette the cat from the comfort of your bedroom. Just you and her! Keep Babette happy by playing with her, feeding her, and more! Except... Babette's more than just a cat. And she's coming for you.

title: Freckles
description: These are cute little creatures that come from the planet Mercury. On a mission to earth to the united nations, the freckles are challenged with the earth's space junk. While flying there spaceship they accidently crash into a fridge, crashing in the backyard of a greedy family named Maus.

title: The Devil's Whisper
description: A psychological horror Visual Novel with a full voice cast. Immerse yourself in a haunting mystery filled with dark drama and a touch of romance. Multiple thrilling alternate endings to play through! Choose who lives and who dies.

title: Spectral Prison
description: Trapped in an endless cycle, David Echo must navigate haunted houses and terrifying dimensions to escape the sinister warden. Find hidden keys, avoid monsters, and break free from the nightmare. Can you survive?

title: Manickologi
description: Manickologi is a game about getting sidetracked on your way back home. Follow mani the manickologist and his robot friend Stefan on their adventure. Swap between characters to make use of their unique skillsets. Collect hidden treasures and complete quests.

title: Sepulchron
description: An atmospheric puzzle-horror game where you have 72 in-game hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles that require logical deduction during the day, survive assaults from hostile ghosts at night, and uncover the mystery behind Astor Manor.

title: The Last Human In The Universe
description: You are the last human that exists, and you wake up trapped in a spaceship full of dangers lurking around you. You must perform maintenance on the ship to keep it functioning until you reach Earth. Once on Earth, will everything start again?

title: Party on Hallow Grove
description: Talk to kooky guests, trade party items, and explore Death’s mansion as you throw him the spookiest birthday party ever.

title: Deep Space Cache
description: Deep Space Cache is a short & simple semi-idle game about mining asteroids for resources and converting them into valuable bits for upgrades.

title: The Curse of the Demon Tree
description: A top down 2D JRPG exploring the stages of grief and loss in a post-apocalyptic landscape.

title: Puztrix
description:
Puztrix is a remake of the Gravnic game from inside the NES Puzznic game.

Vircon32 Game Features:
- 80 levels of the original game
- 2 skins
- High score saving and submitting for the original levels
- ability to turn music & sound on/off

title: My Arms Are Longer Now
description: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

title: RetroTime
description:
RetroTime for vircon32 is a game containing 8 retro based games playable in 3 game modes being Retro Carousel, Time Attack and Lives mode. The game is a port from the Playdate version which was a port from the SDL2 version from my competition entry for Fuze 4 for Nintendo switch, in collaboration with Wireframe magazine.

There are the 8 retro based games implemented in this game:
- Invaders
- Brick Breaker
- Toady
- Snakey
- Bubble Buster
- Block Stacker
- Color Invasion
- Faster Dave

title: Formula 1: Vircon32 Version
description: A Small Fictive Formula 1 Game & Watch style game with high score keeping.

title: Mazethingie
description:
Mazethingie is a maze generator / game.
Generate mazes of different sizes and solve them.

title: Get To The Top
description:
A challenging game about climbing various terrain areas using a pair of wire hooks.

You have to climb to the top using hooks.
Use the keyboard to move, and the mouse to control your hands and hooks (or gamepad if you are not in enough pain).
Only the most persistent will make it to the top.

title: Asunder II
description: More than a decade in the making this groundbreaking humorous fantasy ARPG is actually fun to play. But be forewarned it's a difficult game.

title: Mental Hellacious
description: The Most Difficult Action Climbing Game Hold to adjust jump distance simple controls. You'll likely fail countless times before mastering the jump. A single moment of error can ruin everything. Enjoy the experience the process of improving.

title: 9mm Girls The Visual Novel
description:
9mm Girls The Visual Novel is an LGBTQ+ urban fantasy/action project produced by the duo Soliko6, based on the 9mm Girls Webcomic.

The project focuses on the relations between you (the player) and complex characters while following an intricate storyline taking place in the dark megalopolis of Skyline City.
Your choices through the game will impact the ending but also the bonds you wish to build with the characters.

title: Mechanic Man
description: The evil scientist Dr. Bronze has stolen manufacturing equipment in order to assemble his own army of killer robots! Join our brave hero, Steel, as he journeys to take down the CU brand androids and storm Bronze’s facility to save the world. Run, jump, and shoot through ten stages filled with dangerous foes, tight platforming and intimidating bosses. It’s now or never, so fight, Steel! For everlasting peace!

title: Proportions
description: Proportions is an indie asymmetrical game where players take on the roles of either a giant or minis. The giant’s objective is to catch the minis, who must use their agility and cunning to evade capture. Designed with streamers in mind, the game features proximity chat to enhance the immersive experience and foster dynamic interactions.

title: Boxing Room
description: A boxing game where you must land as many punches on your opponent as possible before he falls to the ground.

title: Shawarma Legend
description: Have you ever wondered what it’s like to run your very own shawarma restaurant? Immerse yourself in Shawarma Legend, the newest and most exciting cooking game that lets you step into a world of culinary delight. Fulfill customer orders with precision and keep your restaurant thriving.

title: Adventure 2600 Reboot
description: Nearly 30 years after the original Atari 2600 classic comes a fan-made remake by PA G&T! Experience the game that pioneered the titular genre with 16-bit graphics, music, and other quality-of-life features. Explore the kingdom, collect the keys, and recover the Enchanted Chalice, lest the fearsome dragons eat you first. Try the game on different difficulty modes, or even customize your game for maximum enjoyment. Everything you remember and more are here in Adventure 2600 Reboot, the fresh coat of paint Atari never even made!

title: Sacrificial God
description: You were sacrificed and now have to find god. You can do this by talking to other creatures that were sacrificed. Will you be able to do this? Find it out by speaking to the creatures of Heaven!

title: Hole-y Golf
description: Control the size of the hole (aka cup, target) in golf from underground to help your dad win matches. Don't be too suspicious or you'll get caught.

title: Staars
description: In Staars, you play as a volunteer investigating unknown activities in a simulated environment. During a 24-hour test, events appear randomly, and you enter the virtual house via a portal to investigate. Observe, categorize, and report events based on Space, Time, Anomalies, and Reality.

title: One Skill
description: In this platformer you have 4 different skills but you can only use one at a time. Choose a skill to complete each of the sections across 4 levels.

title: Super Mario Bros: Adventure Journey
description: Mario goes on an adventure and a journey.

title: Super Mario Bros: Journey to Peach
description: Mario goes on a journey to save Peach.

title: Super Mario Bros: Coin Quest
description: Mario needs to collect red coins again.

title: Super Mario Bros: Kill Bowser
description: Join Mario in his quest to... kill Bowser!?

title: Super Luigi Paradise
description: Help Luigi explore this water filled paradise!

title: Super Mario Bros: Bowser's Terror
description: Save the Mushroom Kingdom from Bowser's reign of terror!

title: Super Mario Bros: Dark Days
description: Mario with guns and blood!

title: Heaven: Dare mo Kimi wo Shiranai
description:
This is an adventure game about juvenile delinquency. Control the amnesiac protagonist and unravel the incomprehensible psychology of a certain person.
The game focuses on solving puzzles and has few action elements.

title: Yoshi Click and Go
description: Click to shoot, and click Yoshi to jump!

title: Super Mario Bros: Koopa Chaos
description: King Koopa is causing chaos, as usual.

title: Mario's Run
description: Drop blocks and springs onto the course to influence the outcome of the game as Mario walks back and forth like a Goomba.

title: Save the Goombas
description: Use the mouse to break stuff and press switches in order to get all the Goombas to reach the goal.

title: The Whitaker's Library
description:
Welcome to the Final Days of James Whitaker's Library...

You’ve taken on what seems like a simple task: helping pack up the remnants of a once-thriving library.

title: Super Mario Bros: Kingdom Troubles
description: Save the Mushroom Kingdom from trouble!

title: Mario the Mathematician
description: Solve math problems to attack Bowser and his minions with fireballs!

title: Super Mario Bros: Shine Pursuit
description: Toadsworth has challenged Mario to a shine collecting game! Collect all the shines in a level to progress.

title: Super Mario Bros.: Crimson Hours
description: Mario with guns and blood! And explosions!

title: Eastern Cuisine Tycoon
description: A traditional Chinese food simulation cooking game. Play the role of a talented Chinese food chef, experiencing the production process of traditional Chinese cuisine firsthand, gradually transforming your small inn into a renowned food paradise.

title: Midheaven: Winds of Ambition
description:
Midheaven: Winds of Ambition follows the tale of a young Mahyine (an original species of the Midheaven saga, with naga-like features) noble in court who determines to follow their ambitions, along with the presence of one of the four Regals.

Winds of Ambition is a stats-raising visual novel, where every choice can result in the most fatal outcome. The objective of the game is keeping the protagonist alive for 12 seasons, and marry one of the four Regals.

title: Best Served Cold
description: Can you mix a cocktail while eye-to-eye with a criminal? Find out in Best Served Cold, a murder mystery set in a bustling speakeasy where you serve customers, make friends and enemies, and solve crimes. At the Nightcap bar, prohibition is a killer… and so are some of your customers!

title: Fuel Station: Drive & Pumping
description: Inherit an abandoned gas station in a desolate desert. Raise funds, renovate, and modernize the station. Expand your services to attract more customers. Test your entrepreneurial skills and maybe you'll become rich.

title: Pao Pao
description: Pao Pao is a wild mix of culinary diving and animal madness—where you become the ultimate restaurant boss and management guru! Gather ingredients, go fishing, and expand your spot solo or with friends. Every order turns into an epic adventure… Jump in and experience it for yourself!

title: Defense Breakers
description: A roguelike tower defense game. Pick your players, collect treasures, and break through the enemy's heavy barriers. Each expedition brings a new experience.

title: The Oneironaut
description: Dive into the surreal world of 'The Oneironaut,' where you'll race through the dreams of artists in this mesmerizing parkour runner. Jump, slide, and vault your way through fantastical landscapes, with each airborne vault propelling you to greater heights.

title: Sadball
description: Chase pins as a bowling ball with dreamlike abilities in a surreal bowling alley.

title: Anterris
description: Collect and train powerful creatures, known as Antera, as you battle through dungeons. Discover rare loot and evolve your squad by freely swapping between creatures while battling enemies in a fast-paced creature-collecting action RPG!

title: Hidden Cats in Tokyo
description: Hidden Cats in Tokyo is a hidden object adventure game where you must vaccinate all the cats in Tokyo before they turn into dangerous monsters. Collect cards of heroes, monsters, and cat things. Join the adventure and fight the huge monster with your giant robot in this fun hidden object game!

title: Proverbs
description: Proverbs is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle, inspired by Bruegel the Elder's 1559 painting "Netherlandish Proverbs"

title: Touhou Saibanmu: Rookie Attorney Legendry
description: A puzzle-solving detective game based on the Touhou series. It mainly tells the story of Marisa Kirisame who, by chance, becomes a lawyer. The story is divided into three chapters, each with multiple endings.

title: Callous
description: 1 large map for vanilla Doom 2 using alpha textures.

title: Journey to Incrementalia
description: Journey to Incrementalia is an incremental auto-battler RPG about a necromancer on a mysterious quest. Cast diabolical spells, summon an army and open the gates of hell on your quest to break down 99 legendary walls on the road to the lost city of Incrementalia.

title: Love in an Enchanted Realm
description: Lost in a magical world where true love is your only escape - form powerful connections, outsmart deadly enemies, and resist the temptation of a dangerous villain who swears you're destined to be his.

title: Slitherise
description: A snake robot climbs up a mysterious world. The only control is the mouse, and the goal is to aim higher.

title: Cube Snake
description: Slither through a retro-futuristic cyberpunk world in this 3D Cubic take of the classic 1976 & 1998 Snake games.

title: Morningtide Motel
description: Your motel is busy for the first time in years. Antsy city-folk and dispossessed teens flood your rooms, and you can barely keep up. Now, after a week of all-nighters spent managing reservations, room service requests, and Yup! reviews, you begin to wonder… could you even fall asleep if you tried?

title: The Fall: Act I
description: The story of three foreign students at a private British boarding school. Becoming information brokers within the school walls brought them money and respect, but knowledge can also bring trouble.

title: Idili
description: A first-person Survival Horror video game. Discover Sardinian tradition and experience its terrifying legends as they come to life in your hands. Investigate, explore, escape. You will have to survive with all your strength to uncover its secrets.

title: Ascension: The Immortal Alchemist
description:
Ascension follows the trials and tribulations of an Immortal Alchemist and his quest throughout time to transmute humans in to gods. Players descend into an ancient labyrinth where their souls are tested by cosmic forces to challenge the limitations of their mortality. Do you have what it takes?

Ascension is a modern resurrection of the classic 3D Action Adventure Genre - Inspired by the legendary writings of Hermes Trismegistus - a figure who rose to prominence in the mystery schools of Hellenistic Egypt & Greece, and whose timeless teachings are as relevant today; as they were when they were written.

Action-adventure, puzzle, platforming, atmospheric, difficult, speedrunner, escape room, maze

title: Please Smile
description: A 3D platformer with 60 increasingly challenging rooms. Manipulate time to reverse the game's movements. Redirect gravity onto objects to reach the most impossible places. Jump, run, shoot, and dash, as only with all your abilities will you escape.

title: 3:33 AM
description: A stranger calls at 3:33 AM. They know your name. Choose your words carefully in this fully voiced psychological horror game.

title: Carnage Kart X
description: Carnage Kart X is a retro-inspired hack n' slash experience combining the feel of classic karting games from the early 90s with Vampire Survivors-like gameplay, combining hand-drawn 2D pixel art and low-poly 3D models for a new perspective on the Survivors-like genre. It's style is reminiscent of something you'd play at the arcade down to the rockin' over-the-top music and over-sized blood spurts/body parts flying off of enemies.

title: The Redundant
description: Step into the metallic boots of an abandoned robot and fight back against an army of virus-infected machines. Sneak or battle your way around the facility, uncover its secrets, and isolate each section from the network - before it's too late...

title: Doctor Root
description: A platform game where you must use your drill skills to advance through the stages.

title: Kraktures
description: Collect, and fight powerful creatures known as Kraktures in turn-based or realtime RPG battles.

title: Mad Miner 2
description: The second game of Mad Miner, a dystopia where humans are forced to live in mines, takes place in the third dimension! Our main character joins the research team as a miner on a mission to dig deeper with his pickaxe.

title: Ragdoll Rumble
description: Ragdoll Rumble is a chaotic party game where toy wizards unleash wild spells in explosive spellcasting battles. Cast crazy abilities, outsmart your opponents, and prove you are the dominant doll!

title: Haunting: The Rosefield Manor
description: Haunting: The Rosefield Manor is a carefully designed single-player psychological horror game powered by Unreal Engine 5. The spirit of Rosefield Manor still lingers, and it is up to you to uncover its mystery.

title: Nexus Station
description: Nexus Station is a cross-platform Social Sandbox MMO. With endless possibilities; from world creation, crafting, co-op PvE dungeons, PvP brawler, competitive gameplay and more, Nexus Station is going to have endless amounts of exciting and varied content that you can be part of creating.

title: Let's Watch Steamboat Willie
description:
Two film nerds sit down for a comfy evening watching old movies. Next up is Steamboat Willie, and they quickly take to bickering.
By the time the cartoon is over, one of them will be dead.

title: Nazar
description:
Experience the world's first fusion of FMV genre and 2D platforming in this revolutionary sci-fi adventure. Explore Cappadocia's mystic realm where fortune-telling meets quantum physics. Join Nazar, unlock psychic powers, and race to prevent a dark future in this genre-defying journey!

Step into a world where ancient mysticism meets cutting-edge science in this groundbreaking FMV adventure from internationally acclaimed game designer Dr. Eray Dinç. Set in the mesmerizing landscapes of Cappadocia, Turkey's most enigmatic region, this game weaves a tapestry of Anatolian lore, arcane rituals, and futuristic technology.

Inspired by the time-honored art of Turkish shadow puppetry, this unique experience fuses 2D platforming with interactive cinema, all set to a haunting score by legendary composer Inon Zur. But what truly sets this game apart is its revolutionary mechanic: your ability to peer into the future.

title: Project Slippi
description: Project Slippi is a set of modifications for Super Smash Bros. Melee, which adds several quality-of-life improvements to the game, of which are commonly used within the competitive scene. Among the most popular mod is Slippi Online, a Dolphin-based mod which allows rollback netcode for Melee over the internet. Other features include the ability to automatically save replays through the Slippi Launcher on PC and on the Nintendo Wii with Nintendont-Slippi.

title: An Angel's Final Desire
description:
Play as Emil, who had a fight with his best friend Quinn and they are now missing and he has to find them before it's too late

Can you save Quinn, in the end?

Can you save the child?

title: Gnomecart Havoc
description: A roguelite shooter with snakelike elements. You control a group of Gnomes sitting in carts trying to take back their home. Explore the cursed, ever changing mine, upgrade your crew with treasures you’ll find in your journey and destroy every monster that stands in your way.

title: Rain;Check
description: RAIN;CHECK tells a short story set in a small, remote town about a girl just trying to get by in the middle of a rainy, tumultuous night. On this special occasion, an unexpected storm of events brews ever closer.

title: Re:Fragment - Absolute Ambition
description: We all dream of a bright future ahead, but life doesn't always turn out how we expect. Yuuma, the protagonist, lives a peaceful life until the student council president proposes a new controversial policy that changes everything they once knew forever.

title: Hit n' Bit
description: A dark fantasy Metroidvania platformer. Embark on two different journeys where you will fight monsters, explore a story-rich world, and encounter challenging puzzles. Reunite the royal siblings, defy the machinations of old gods, and redefine destiny.

title: UnHumanize
description: Can technology help humans achieve their dreams, or is fighting fate a big gamble for humanity?

title: Sacabambaspis' Friendly Adventure
description: A short and friendly adventure as a Sacabambaspis!

title: Limbus Company: Season 5 - Oblivion
description:
Season 5: Oblivion is the fifth Season of Limbus Company, released on October 10, 2024.

It consists of the game's seventh Story Chapter (Canto VII: The Dream Ending), centered around the character Don Quixote from the homonymous literary source, the 5th Mirror Dungeon, Line 5 of Refraction Railway, and a number of Identities and E.G.O based on story content.

title: Blackjack and Pomodoro Mystery
description:
"Human, go to work."

In the library, you are stuck with Blackjack, an unknown living creature that looks like a cat. Unexpectedly, lots of tomatoes appear in the library. It's also up to you and BJ to solve the mystery and identify the person who left the tomatoes lying around.

This is Pomodoro timer which has 25 minutes working-5 minutes resting and 60 minutes working-10 minute resting plans for player to select and work along with the moving black cat playing around the room.

title: Mythical Love
description:
Welcome to Mythic High, the highschool of mythical creatures where we can have great moments together with species and sex equality.
You can choose to be one of them and build your relationship to learn more about different kinds of love. So young and colourful. BUT sometimes, when something goes overboard, everything could collapse apart, including love. So choose wisely.

title: Yume Kakigori
description: Experience a text adventure unlike any other, communicate with characters through the art of color mixing.

title: Vampire Domain
description: Summon hordes of minions to defend your realm against invading heroes in this fast-paced fantasy strategy game. Unlock permanent upgrades, new levels and more advanced minions to survive the ever-growing threat.

title: The Butterfly Dreams
description: A visual novel exploring reality, imagination, and the gap between them that we believe to be there.

title: Wanagiri
description: Wanagiri is a short visual novel where you play as Kamila, who accidentally isekai'ed to an uncompleted book that your friend wrote. How will you end the story, and will you be back there again someday?

title: Lurking Darkness
description:
Lurking Darkness is a short, PS1-styled survival horror game about what happens if you get to close to the dangers that hide in the shadows...

On September 14th, 1990, four friends would enter the Greenlock Woods for an overnight camping trip.

Two days later, they were reported missing.

As part of a search party, your goal is to find any possible survivors. Keep your eyes peeled for anyone, and don't stray off the path.

title: Corrida das Blogueiras 6: A Maldição dos Zumbis
description: In this exciting game, you will face 8 super challenging stages, all set in the glamorous Corrida Das Blogueiras High School! Run through the corridors, jump over obstacles, defeat zombies and show that you have the charisma to be the school's Ultimate Blogger!

title: The Shade Forest
description: Fabulous, FREE and fun 90's inspired platformer game for Android, iOS and PC. Help Drag Queen Amanda Sparks to survive the Shade Forest and rescue her friend from the evil hands of the Hypocritics gang!

title: Barheim
description: A single-player, 3D Time Management Tower Defense where players experience the chaos of mixing drinks and maintaining a bar while defending themselves from thirsty Vikings!

title: Lost in Tropics
description: Lost in Tropics: Embark on an unforgettable survival adventure where the lush, unpredictable tropics become your testing ground. In this immersive game, you find yourself stranded on a mysterious island, where every corner hides both breathtaking beauty and perilous challenges.

title: Infinity Sweeper
description: Infinity Sweeper is similar to the classic Minesweeper, but turned into an endless rogue-lite adventure. Navigate through an ever-expanding grid filled with dangerous traps, enemies, and valuable treasures, trying to survive as long as possible.

title: Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth Special Trial Version
description:
A special demo for Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth included in Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name.

This trial version lets the player explore a portion of Honolulu as Kiryu Kazuma and have original scenes not included in the full game.

title: Problem Solver Club
description: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

title: Trilogi Keluarga Bahagia Side Story: Sulastri Si Tukang Jamu
description:
Sulastri hasn't paid the tuition fee yet.
However, he did not have enough money to pay, considering that his mother could not sell herbs because of illness.
Because of Mrs. Jamilah's kindness, Sulastri was given an additional 6 months deadline.
Will Sulastri be able to pay off her tuition fees after selling herbs to replace her mother for 6 months?

title: Trilogi Keluarga Bahagia Side Story: Yuni dan Puzzle Ajaib
description:
Yuni has been separated from her mother and older sister since she was 7 years old.
One day, she finds a magical puzzle piece that can grant her wish.
But to make this happen, Yuni must take all the pieces from those around her; Rio is a delinquent, Haryanto is smart, and Benjamin is kind.
Can Yuni put all the pieces together and make her dream come true?

title: Idumea
description: This is a re-release of Doom 2 in City Only MAP23 - Idumea, now including an additional version for lower and mid-range computers. A very large and non-linear MBF21-compatible (-cl 21) city map based around slaughter combat.

title: Silent Sadie
description: A puzzle-platformer in Hollywood's golden age. Join Sadie on her quest to become a star, tackling puzzles, stealth challenges, and fast-paced platforming. Inspired by silent film legends, this game combines humor, visual gags, and challenging gameplay in a charming adventure.

title: Godstone Tactics
description: An indie turn-based strategy game. Position your animal heroes in the isometric arena, protect your King, and defeat the enemy King. Adapt your tactics on various boards and master the strategic depth to win.

title: Wool at the Gates
description: Defend your base from hordes of invading sheep. Fight as a hero with powerful abilities or shapeshift into a flying eyeball to traverse the battlefield and command troops. Build your defenses and economy while creating synergies that unlock class bonuses and perks for your hero, troops, and towers.

title: Sonar Scout
description: Pilot your submarine to activate and reestablish a network of beacons while carefully utilizing your sonar to navigate the low-visibility depths of the ocean.

title: Dr. Priori’s Time Escape
description: Welcome back to the Curiosity Shop of Dr. A. Priori. Explore the building and unlock rooms full of mysteries. Use time bubbles to change the environment and solve puzzles. Unravel the mystery! Play this first-person puzzle escape room game solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

title: Deepest Dungeons
description: Venture into the ever-shifting labyrinth of Deepest Dungeons, a rogue-like with extraction elements. Explore a maze that changes with each attempt, battle enemies, avoid deadly traps and collect gear. Survive long enough to reach deeper levels, or escape with your belongings and try a new descend.

title: Hi! These Are Your Eyeballs
description: Our eyes define and shape everything that happens in life. Become a delivery courier for EyeBallStore and help the residents of Limb Alley see the world in a new light after a long time spent in darkness.

title: Galactic Caretaker
description: A space civilisation management game. Play as a Galactic Caretaker, controlling the growth of developing civilisations. Ensure each society reaches their galactic exploration potential….but not before they are ready.

title: Island Keeper
description: Breathe new life into forgotten islands. Pick up trash, recycle it, craft items, and build your own base. As you heal the land, it flourishes into a wild paradise. Explore by walking, riding a boat, or using a submarine, and change a world that reacts to everything you do!

title: Stage Cleared
description: You're just trying to beat a platformer, but something is stalking you outside. Keep an eye on your security cams while you’re gaming and stop the intruder from getting in. Stay sharp, or it’s game over.

title: Pinevale Settlements
description: Build and manage your own thriving colony in this engaging simulator. Balance resource management, strategic planning, and crafting to grow your settlement from the ground up. Perfect your strategy and watch your colony flourish!

title: Zaraq
description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you have access to a forbidden arcade from the 80's. Craft the best deck of symbols, artifact and spells to score the maximum amount of points to beat Zaraq.

title: Nightshade Mysteries: Eternal Moon
description: In 1930s Southern Europe, dauntless archaeologist Helena Nightshade gets entangled in the mysteries surrounding an ominous eternal lunar eclipse, prophesied by estranged Moon Worshippers also known as the Anaxagori.

title: Go North
description: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

title: Nnnnnight
description: Morning has ended, and night has begun. Somewhere, many people are spending their respective nights—walking their dogs, studying in their rooms, striving at work... You observe the night until "she" becomes "morning". "NNNNNIGHT" is an adventure game themed around night.

title: Fix This House
description: A relaxing and minimalist puzzle game where your task is to fix the building using a variety of blocks. Enjoy the interactive environment, soothing music, and sounds of nature. Solve puzzles, explore the world, and take your time.

title: Loss
description: Uncover the truth in Loss, a story-driven game about a teenage boy recalling the tragedies of his family. Explore a house, solve puzzles and gather items. All while fighting the ghosts from your past.

title: Steam Veins
description: The vampires help humanity with steampunk technologies, BUT you were bitten—now hunt the Master Lord King Vampire before you become his servant.

title: Spherebuddie 64
description: Embark on an adventure through vibrant 3D environments crafted with nostalgic pixel art, blending classic aesthetics with modern gameplay mechanics. Maneuver your spherical hero through challenging platforming with precise jumps and dash.

title: ETea
description: Help Glorbo master the art of making boba to satisfy customers and take down bosses in this unique blend of simulation and bobarista action!

title: Genesis Survivors
description: Welcome, hackers, you're being transferred to Eden City to defend its citizens against the alien threat! Genesis Survivors is a single-player survivor-like auto-shooter where players must defeat hordes of alien invaders until the extraction time.

title: Astral Wield
description: Embark on Felix's journey to stop an evil King from starting a great war between kingdoms.

title: One Room Dungeon
description: A roguelike team builder, auto-battler meets inventory management, where you are a little dungeon keeper who has to fit minions, artifacts, and items in a very tidy way in his tiny one-room dungeon to empower himself to protect the dungeon from the raiding adventurers.

title: The Lust City
description: You’re a seasoned explorer on a mission with your expedition crew into the deep jungle. Find lost treasure, explore the ancient mysteries that surround the tribe and build your own harem in The Lust City!

title: Yay! Spring Trip with My Coworkers!
description: Yay! Spring Trip with My Coworkers! is a Visual Novel created for Blossom VN Jam 2024 and Fuck Capitalism Jam 2024 as it's about a trip full of fun spring activities and complaining about your job.

title: Long Since The Eschaton
description:
It’s been five years since the apocalypse started, the zombies are slowly decomposing, even new zombies don’t last due to the lack of food source. The last two humans on earth find themselves stumbling upon each other. While one struggles to keep herself alive, the other just wants to end it all.

Long Since the Eschaton follows Kirana, a medic who switched between one survivor group to another until she’s all that’s left. She met Gabe, a self-sustaining survivor who stayed at the same town since the beginning of the plague. Slowly but surely, the two bond and perhaps help each other cope.

title: Murder Mystery Mayhem AI
description: Find the murderer in this AI-powered 1920s whodunit. Interrogate richly layered characters and piece together clues in procedurally generated cases as you roleplay a detective in this unique blend of deduction, strategy, and immersive conversations that drive each case forward.

title: Project Missionary: The Reckoning of Hizzokahpolis
description: A kinetic visual novel about a CEO's search for justice and an unexpected happening.

title: Bub-O Burst
description: Bub-O Burst your way through addictive, score-chasing fun, with fierce bubble action, in this throwback to classic 2D action arcade games! It's easy to learn, but do you have the skills to master it?

title: Milcham: From the Ashes of Hearts
description: A girl of low social class goes undercover to infiltrate a prestigious high school, tasked with a perilous mission.

title: Lost In Static
description: A psychological first person horror game. Your daughter has gone missing. You must find her.

title: Severed
description: Severed Is a first-person dungeon crawler that uses touch based combat mechanics. It has a loot and crafting system based on severing enemy body parts to create and upgrade armor.

title: Alien: Isolation 2
description:
The announcement was made on Monday 7 October 2024 to coincide with the 10th anniversary of the original game’s release.

“On the 10th anniversary, it seems only fitting to let you know that we have heard your distress calls loud and clear,” said Al Hope, creative director at developer Creative Assembly.

title: Labyrinth of Touhou Tri: The Dreaming Girls & The Mysterious Orbs
description:
A Fanmade Touhou Project DRPG With Not-So-Easy Boss Fights!
The girls of Gensokyo weave together a dungeon RPG with an estimated playtime of 30~50 hours. Pick a frontline of 4 and a rear of 8 to form a party of 12 characters out of a pool over 40+ and conquer extensive dungeons!

The girls of Gensokyo weave together a DRPG with not-so-easy boss fights! Form a party of 12 allies out of a pool of 40+, and create with 1000+ skills to choose from! Hack, slash, and grow stronger, then make builds (or counter-builds!) to take down powerful bosses awaiting you in the dungeons.

title: Side Alley
description: The city is a labyrinth. You always knew it, you just didn't have time to try different paths. Now, you have no choice. Did your coworker put a curse on you? Find out in this bleak horror visual novel featuring point-and-click gameplay elements.

title: Pathologic 3
description: Pathologic 3 is a psychological horror game in which you play Daniil Dankovsky, a rationalist doctor trying to defeat death itself as the same doomed town collapses around him. It is a standalone follow-up to Pathologic 2 and a reimagining of the Bachelor route from the original Pathologic, rather than a direct sequel or prequel. Its major new distinction is time manipulation: the premise remains a 12-day plague crisis, but the Bachelor can revisit and alter key events, reflecting his obsession with control, causality, and conquering death.

title: Play of Wire
description: Within the brain of "Funblood", you are a "Funblood" who has become severed. So of course, you have to get up now!

title: Twin-Stick Survivors
description: In this Tower Defense Survivor Game, the skill tree is on the ground of the battle map. Expand your base to capture more of the map and unlock more upgrades. Defend your position against thousands of enemies as they flow over the map.

title: Cheese: The Cheese Collector
description: Cheese - The Cheese Collector is a grindy clicker game. Compete against friends or the globe to have the most cheese. Unlock upgrades, choose a theme that fits you, View a user's profile and statistics.

title: Magician
description: Magician is an episodically released psychological horror visual novel. Currently, only the first day is out.

title: Rise of a Legend
description: Rise of a Legend is a third-person action RPG that immerses you in the ruthless era of gladiatorial combat. Engage in rich single-player progression or take on challengers in online multiplayer matches. Manage your Ludus, level up your fighters, and boost your house's prestige with every victory.

title: Top Classic Plaigarized
description: Welcome to Top Classic Plaigarized (the misspelling is intentional). This game was heavily influenced by "Top Neon Rush". Avoid obstacles and shrink when you need to (some obstacles can only be avoided by shrinking).

title: Bakudan Baku-tan
description: A simple caravan shooter with tiny creatures. A game focused on scoring points while dodging the hell of bullets and defeating enemies.

title: Arktwend: The Forgotten Realm
description:
Arktwend is a total conversion to The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind.

The player begins his adventure in a monastery where he grew up, outside the monastery the whole wide world awaits him. But strange things have happened in Arktwend, shadows roam the land and long-forgotten, old forces are pushing back the power. The age of heroes has begun!

title: Formula Karts
description: Formula Karts is a semi-realistic racing title that attempts to capture the spirit of kart racing with it's low slung feeling of speed, and corner after corner of impressive handling (and inevitable sliding). The title supports both simulation and arcade modes, and features some effective race AI for non-player vehicles. Two player split screen is supported albeit with some slowdown.

title: Tlatoani
description: Discover the wonders of the Aztec Civilization as you build your own magnificent metropolis in this ancient city builder adorned with beautiful hand drawn 2D graphics. From humble beginnings rise to build, trade and conquer to become Tlatoani (Emperor).

title: Madtoys Knights
description: Imagine a game where your childhood toys transform into mighty warriors, ready to defend their castle or conquer new realms. In Madtoys Knights, 32 players clash in intense battles where teamwork and cunning tactics are keys to victory.

title: Destiny 2: Revenant
description: Fikrul the Fanatic has re-emerged, possessing a powerful Echo and an army of undead Scorn at his command. Guardians will become Slayer Barons and upgrade their abilities with powerful tonics to confront the Scorn’s corrupted ether.

title: Parasitic Descent
description: In a world ravaged by a catastrophic event, humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. In "Parasitic Descent," you step into the boots of a lone survivor navigating the haunting remnants of a once-thriving civilization.

title: Wolfram
description: Wolfram is a modern remake of Wolfenstein 3D, game created by id Software in 1992. It is designed mainly for those fans who wants to play old good game, but who is tired of pixelated sprite graphics. Well, many people could say that it is nonsense, retro games are distinctive and original and do not need any graphic enchancements. This is the point, but we, the authors, think in a different way. We hope that the remake will find it's niche and some of you guys will like it.

title: Poly Fire
description: Poly Fire is a tactical multiplayer team 1st person shooter. Using a variety of weapons and characters, you will battle with up to 32 players on Various maps . By managing your skills correctly, you will lead your team to victory.

title: Paper Puzzle Ⅱ
description: Place all the pieces into the grid, and as long as they don't overlap, you can clear the level. Simple rules but a real challenge. Want to give it a try?

title: Konfronto
description: Sci-fi roguelike auto battler where you command an intergalactic carrier, outfitting it with new spacecraft and technologies to take on other players in asynchronous multiplayer

title: Portrait of a Cornish Woman
description: Portrait of a Cornish Woman is a Victorian Romance Visual Novel of Manners, capturing the subtle, yet powerful emotions of two women as they fight for their place in each other's lives while living under a veil of discretion.

title: Their Navy Is Their Doom
description: Command an advanced submarine in a heart-pounding horror experience as you hunt the last remnants of a defeated enemy beneath the Mariana Trench. Navigate, survive, and uncover terrifying oceanic secrets in this immersive underwater warfare game.

title: Raiden Nova
description:
Raiden unites! Get ready to blast into a thrilling new dimension like never before!

The legendary vertical-scrolling shooter Raiden is reborn as a thrilling twin-stick 2D shooter! Freely aim and shoot with dual sticks, dodging bullets from every direction.

Level up to unlock a variety of weapons and enhancements, and upgrade your ship to fight your way through epic battles.

title: Anomaly Corridor
description: Escape from the Corridor!

title: Nitro Gen Omega
description: A Spaghetti Anime turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a crew of mercenaries through wastelands overrun by ruthless machines. Engage in high-octane cinematic Mech battles, recruit pilots and grow relationships. Play solo or join an online world where every character is procedurally generated.

title: Songs of Conquest: Vanir
description: Songs of Conquest's first new faction has arrived from the shores of the Bleak East. Conquer the lands of Aerbor as the mighty raiders of Vanir and witness their powerful transformation into the Vildra.

title: Scramble Heart City
description: From the team behind Tough Love Arena comes Scramble Heart City, an exciting, 3v3 tag team fighting game that's playable in browser — no installation required!

title: Spell Tonaeru
description:
Keyboard barrage roguelike!

A game where you physically move around the on-screen keyboard and keep casting magic spells.

title: Gengu Survival
description: Survive on an open-world island with unlockable abilities that help you on your journey in Gengu Survival. Craft new items as you level up and build your own base wherever you want. But be aware, there is something strange on this island...

title: Halo Infinite: Operation Haloween
description:
It’s that time of year again where there’s a chill in the air, the wind howls and bites as the night comes early, a thin mist settles over the fields, and humanity marches on—their minds and bodies fueled by pumpkin spice lattes... With this change of the seasons, it is also time for a new Halo Infinite Operation. Welcome to Haloween!

Get yourselves in the Haloween mindset with the Survive the Undead playlist. Grab your friends, gear up, and jump into a unique twist on Halo Infinite’s Firefight experience as you stand your ground against endless waves of enemies that have been banished from their graves.

Celebrate Haloween with a free new Operation Pass, consisting of 20 tiers and featuring the Spartanstein armor set. This free cosmetic Halloween-themed "operation pass" launched aside this update and ran from October 8, 2024 to November 5, 2024. It was made available in perpetuity to those who purchased the pass.

title: Escape from Sharptooth Valley
description:
Escape from Sharptooth Valley is a single-player narrative game to walk, explore, fight, or befriend!

Choose your own story and discover the origins of the Gen-like life in the World of Nefthar.

title: Iris to Id: Ghosts in the Machine
description: A tale about four unexpected friends experiencing sinister events related to the sins of their past

title: Gabibbo Massacre
description: Indie horror game made as a parody of the popular italian mascotte "Gabibbo".

title: Grimwild Horror
description: A newspaper article from 1994, titled "MASS MURDER AT GRIMWILD", put everyone into trauma as all the residents of Grimwild were found dead, their bodies dismembered. After this incident, the city was cut off and everyone was prohibited from entering it. What might have happened?

title: Sapphire City Part 3
description: Beware the Horrors of the Future

title: Rouvy
description: ROUVY is an indoor cycling app built around scenic routes from around the world and realistic riding physics.

title: Horror Prison
description: Uncover the secrets hidden in the shadows, confront the monstrous results of these experiments, and escape with your sanity intact.

title: Towne of Gringle
description: Towne of Gringle is a comedy strategy game where you have been accused of murder, so you must manipulate a medieval town into declaring you innocent.

title: The Last of the 9 Lives
description: In this fast-paced, infinite jumping adventure, guide your cat as they leap from platform to platform, racing against the rising water that speeds up the longer you survive. Precision and quick reflexes are key as you collect milk and fish for bonus points, all while navigating randomly generated platforms. With its charming pixel art and simple controls, the game offers a challenging yet rewarding experience where every jump counts. A throwback to simpler times. How high can you climb before the water catches up?

title: You Are the Inch Valley Captive
description: "You Are the Inch Valley Captive" is a single-player Quake map, designed as an adventure where the player will tumble through the dangers of multiple dungeons in a non-linear quest to escape the Inch Valley.

title: Ukosz
description: Survive in a post-soviet style brutalist city...

title: Realm of Dissonance
description: A seven level episode for Quake, using the original texture set from the base game. Includes a secret level, and has support for Deathmatch and Co-Op, (although NOT fully tested, as it was designed primarily with SP in mind).

title: Cursed Hours
description: Cursed Hours is a psychological horror game. You play as a thief breaking into an old mansion, hoping for treasure. Soon, you realize something is wrong. Doors slam, eerie noises fill the air, and you're locked inside. A dark presence is watching you. Escape may be impossible.

title: Små Ord
description: Finn dyret som elgen tenker på i flotte naturomgivelser. Gjett deg frem ved hjelp av bokstavene og se om du klarer utfordringen!

title: Pizza Delivery in a Storm
description: A motorbike action game where you deliver pizzas in a storm

title: A Dark Forest
description: An incremental experimental idle/clicker horror game.

title: Beyond Astra
description: Lead your civilization in a galaxy brimming with life and intrigue. Seamlessly explore and expand across uncharted worlds, from their surfaces to the stars. Forge your destiny in this sci-fi 4X offering a unique blend of grand strategy, planetary city-building, and RTS combat.

title: EA Sports WRC 24
description: Elevate your rally experience with the WRC 2024 Season Expansion Bundle! Discover thrilling new locations, Tet Rally Latvia and the Orlen 80th Rally Poland. Drive the latest high-performance vehicles including the Ford Fiesta Rally3 Evo and Toyota GR Yaris Rally1 HYBRID '24. Customize your rally cars with more than 50 new liveries and compete against 52 official crews. Brace yourself to embark on your continued rally journey.

title: Cat Guardian
description: Cat Guardian is a flexible card game blending tower defense and survival. Manage resources, build, and strategize to protect the Tree of Hope from zombies. Can the cats of Meowx Planet succeed in their mission and survive?

title: Kitchen Wars
description: Kitchen Wars is a fast-paced party game with 2-8 players that plunge players into the chaos of a restaurant, where they must engage in strategic fights and theft while catering to their clients.

title: Splintered
description: A unique RPG where the villain randomizes the world with each defeat. Start with a classic RPG experience, then delve into shifting worlds where the overworld, items, and enemies shuffle, creating new challenges. Conquer these worlds to unravel the story and make your way to the final showdown!

title: Widget Inc.
description: A hybrid factory builder / incremental clicker game. Starting from humble beginnings, master the many crafting processes to build up resources and expand your factory. Then, using your newly automated production, unlock new technology and grow ever closer to your goal of spreading to the stars.

title: Toushin Gent
description: Seeking the coveted Goon Crystal and Bloodline Emblem, the Brutal Cook Gent must face Bendy Town and its strange dungeon. Guide our reluctant "hero" as he faces unwanted attention from friends and foe alike in this "unique" experience of a game.

title: City of Stolen Worlds
description: A mysterious creature has torn your home from reality. Explore the City of Stolen Worlds, uncover the secrets of its inhabitants, and try to find your way back. Or perhaps you want to become the new Master?

title: Luna's Twilight
description: Luna's Twilight is a fantasy romance visual novel that brings together classic fantasy elements with heart-fluttering romance. In a secluded mansion hidden deep within a a silent forest, four men from different races whisper words of love to you. Who will be the one to win your heart?

title: Cosmic Call
description: Cosmic Call is a brutal 3D FPS Roguelike Boomer shooter set inside the prison of the Great One. Fight your way out of this hellish nightmare, collecting otherworldly weapons and horrifying items along the way.

title: Dungeon Watchers
description: Survive and destroy monsters to your heart's content with the help of powerful and unique characters. Unlock new characters and discover the synergies with their abilities to unleash game-breaking builds and slay everything on your path.

title: Well to Hell
description: A short first-person horror game where you play as an urban explorer trapped at the bottom of a well. Find a way out before it finds you.

title: Isoland: Pumpkin Town
description: ISOLAND Pumpkin Town? What the hell kind of game is this and what does it have to do with ISOLAND, Mr Pumpkin.

title: Teeny Tiny Harbors
description: Chart courses to direct ships and juggle seafaring duties. Expand your tiny harbor whilst keeping everything under control—and pretend the chaos is all part of the plan.

title: Droian
description: Meet I.A.N, the Interplanetary Android Navigator, and humanity's last hope. With a heart of steel and unwavering determination, I.A.N is on a mission to navigate the treacherous depths of an distant isolated moon. Armed with advanced technology and a noble purpose, this extraordinary android will guide you through the haunting realms of DROIAN, all while reminding us that the fight to save humanity is a journey we all share.

title: Lurks Within Walls
description:
Lurks Within Walls is a tense survival horror game combining modern dungeon RPGs' exploration elements with fast-paced turn-based combat. Explore a series of cursed environments filled with terrifying creatures illustrated by the renowned artist Trevor Henderson.

A building under quarantine. Residents isolated. Those who failed to isolate themselves now stagger through the corridors, contaminated. But it's not just the infected residents—the darkness conceals other anomalies. It feels as if the building itself is alive.

title: Zen Rage
description: Zen Rage is a virtual stress ball game that allows players to vent frustration by digitally destroying their desktop or preset backgrounds with a variety of tools. Drawing inspiration from the 90s classic Desktop Destroyer, the game offers a fresh take on chaotic, cathartic destruction. Players can use tools like chainsaws, hammers, machine guns, Tesla-coil rifles, and more to wreak havoc. In addition to freeform destruction, Zen Rage includes a campaign mode where a scientist guides players through a series of tasks and mini-games, culminating in a humorous and unexpected twist.

title: Alex's Journey to the Grave
description: Alex's Journey to the Grave is a visual novel about a boy trapped by fate and a girl in dire need of a friend. Help guide them through some of the hardest decisions of their lives as they experience warmth, connection, tragedy, the inevitability of death... and the antics of a mysterious black cat.

title: Horror Office
description: As you open your eyes, it's already deep night, you find yourself waking up in the office due to overtime work. But tonight is different: strange sounds fill the air, and a knife-wielding rabbit is hunting you. Use anything you can find to escape, solve puzzles, and get out before it's too late.

title: Another Way of Gettin' Paid
description: As Shunji's various acquaintances begin to interact in ways they were never supposed to, he finds his social circle expanding farther than he could have ever imagined...

title: Frog Box
description: In "Frog Box," help a frog push boxes to form lines of three or more matching ones to clear the board. Explore challenging levels with natural obstacles like logs and streams that affect the movement of the boxes.

title: Sexy Memory Puzzle: Pool Massage
description: Solve the puzzles to reveal and collect pictures of a sexy girl receiving a sexual massage by the pool, hidden behind pairs of cards which you have to match. Flip two cards, and if the numbers on them match, they will be removed from the board, revealing a unique image.

title: CrapShoot
description: Kick the crap out of them! Side-scrolling bullet-hell shooter.

title: Missile Survivor
description: Survive a barrage of incoming missiles, defeat ace enemy pilots, and become the air combat ACE!

title: Reconquista
description: A fast-paced dungeon boomer shooter with melee combat, magic, and seed-based generated levels.

title: Calypso's Calamity
description: Calypso's Calamity is a ruthless magical rogue-lite platformer where you play as a courageous dog on a quest to rescue her princess, battling enemies, gathering randomized items, and unlocking new abilities in beautifully crafted levels.

title: Tile To Tile
description: Tile to Tile is an action platformer where the longer you move the faster you go! Your goal is to get the gem at the end of each level as fast as possible!

title: They Do Not Die
description: I just think that top down shooters are neat. It's a pretty zen time. A podcast game.

title: Sweet Coffee Shop
description: Sweet Coffee Shop - is a simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game with relaxing music accompaniment. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girl's photo in the gallery. (Updated AI painting style, more fresh and real)

title: Dreamstate
description: Dreamstate, can you survive your worst nightmare? In a point-and-click sit-and-survival psychological horror game, you fight off your nightmares throughout multiple nights to make it to the end of the week, with each night getting more challenging.

title: Days In Palis
description: Days in Palis is an immersive visual novel set in the fictional metropolis of "Palis." Players will experience passionate love stories and complex relationships centered around three female protagonists. By unlocking the plot, you'll gain a deeper understanding of their inner worlds.

title: A Fascinating Story: Ice Cream
description: In the game, you need to find two cards with the same picture and successfully eliminate them. On the contrary, the cards with different faces will not change. The way to pass the level is to eliminate all the cards in the picture. You can experience more character pictures after passing the level~

title: Darkly Glass
description: Trade your soul for digital fame in this psychological visual novel. As fallen tech mogul Doran White, navigate a treacherous social media landscape. Your choices shape his fate in this hand-drawn, neuroscience-inspired reimagining of Oscar Wilde's classic.

title: Mystical Sovereign Z
description: Mystical Sovereign Z is a sci-fi/fantasy hybrid strategy game. Experience real time battles and turn based strategy with various RPG elements and choices to be made along the way.

title: The Moments Before Death
description: (Text Base Adventure Visual Novel) Input via text with VN graphics. Waking up in a mysterious field, you find yourself invited into a quaint house overseen by a gaunt old lady and her children. Yet, an unsettling feeling grows. The house's rules, seemingly straightforward, begin to unravel.

title: Fork-U
description: Fork-U is a physics based forklift simulator. Drive and operate a forklift in 1st or 3rd person. Try your hand at loading and unloading pallets in a warehouse, delivering building materials in a construction site, keeping shelves stocked in a grocery store, and more!

title: The Memory In Walden Pond
description: Imitate ancient Chinese,In the bamboo forest landscape, survival hunting, farming herding horses, fishing qiao Jiang Zhu, build their own peach blossom source.

title: Yet Another Hentai Puzzle: Cyberpunk
description: Yet Another Hentai Puzzle game to keep you happy.

title: Bara Labs
description: Bara Labs is a short collection of experimental prototype games made by our team. We will decide whether or not to make a full-length game out of the shorts based on how the prototypes are received by the players.

title: Casual Sport Series: Hockey
description: Grab a controller, jump on the ice and score goals to prove you're a hockey champion. Play in campaign mode against teams from around the world, alone, or with three additional players in couch mode!

title: Spellagis
description: Spellagis is an arena-shooter and roguelite hybrid. Brave mages unite to prevent darkness and restore balance. By combining knowledge and artifacts, they engage in a battle where every step towards victory is deceptive and dangerous.

title: Colony: Arena Online
description: Fight against rebel robots together with your friends and save planets from invasion....

title: Zugnaex
description: Immerse yourself in Zugnaex. Compatible with DOOM and DOOM II, it blends classic FPS action with a modern user interface and a detailed heads-up display. Enjoy single-player campaigns and free* online multiplayer for epic battles. (* - requires DOOM)

title: Cheetahs Are Meant To Be Fast
description: An interactive storybook about how being a fat guy who eats a lot is very morally wrong and not at all awesome or attractive.

title: Craig 12: Craig's Escape
description: Oh no! Craig was taken away! You must help him get to safety, or else...

title: Nettle
description: A survival RTS game about exploring the vast cosmos, the many planets inhabiting it and their countless secrets. You'll need to explore, gather resources and research new technologies in order to survive, thrive, and eventually build a colony on a bizarre, foreign world.

title: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate
description: "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate" is a side-scrolling beat'em up with the heart of a fighting game, supporting cross-platform pixel art anime action with up to 8P online multiplayer and all the characters from "Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Overdrive"!

title: Hexity
description: Build your city! Start with tents. Expand and improve life in your city. Explore new technologies and discover new buildings.

title: The Path of Veins
description: I have seen the face. Amongst the small white bones wrapped in fabric. Beneath the veins leading to the goddess. Within the black blood of the eucharist.

title: Webfishing
description: Webfishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game! Relax and fish (on the web!)

title: Pet Cam
description: Arya living a peaceful life by day, but each night, an eerie phone call from her father haunts her sleep. One night, the call turns into a nightmare, unraveling a terrifying story about her past. Can you uncover the truth before it consumes you?

title: Fantasy War Heroes: Chilling Fog
description: Press one of your houses and drag to other house to move your troops. Conquer all houses for victory. Enemy wants to destroy your troops. Now with movable heroes that appear later in the game when you have learnt basics.

title: Tiny Pods Rescue: 2D Board Game Edition
description: Real time tactical board game, abstract graphics. Send commands to pods. Stack them up, move them around a procedurally generated board map known as a district. You need to re-conquer the districts of Earth and Solar System. Thousands of human and alien pods at your fingertips.

title: Silent Surveillance
description: Silent Surveillance is a horror puzzle game where you monitor multiple security cameras to find anomalies. Stay vigilant—you wouldn't want to succumb to the lurking terror waiting for a single moment of distraction. Can you survive the night?

title: World Rally Arcade
description: BRINGING THE ARCADE BACK TO RALLY

title: Save Scream and Run
description: Endless Runner game.A microphone is required for the game.The game is an endless runner in which the player controls a chicken that runs from a fox. The player must jump over obstacles and collect bonuses.

title: Earth Daddy
description: Are you ready to join the Plan and help shape Earth's future?

title: October Panic
description: An arcade-style platformer with five levels and no saving/loading. A small trick-or-treat bag packed to the brim with both treats and tricks.

title: Little Warriors Team
description: The Little Warriors team includes gameplay such as character development, material collection, equipment synthesis, and challenging bosses. The game allowing players to form battle teams according to their preferences and freely switch between controlled characters during battles.

title: Fishing Grind
description: Fishing Grind is a first person 1-6 player co-op fishing game with a twist. The place you are fishing may not always be safe...

title: Bratty Bottoms!
description: Play as a hardworking newcomer hired to help manage the family-owned motel, run by the bratty yet endearing Lila.

title: Magiscapes
description: Welcome to Magiscapes, the world's first AI sandbox adventure! Build your camp, create AI companions, and form unique bonds through interactions. Embark on a journey of discovery and enjoy the freedom to explore!

title: Into The Matrix
description: "Into The Matrix" is a multiplayer horror game where you and your friends must explore, survive, and outsmart dangers. Beware the Matrix Overseer, who watches and twists reality itself. Many entities are after you, but the Overseer is the true threat. Can you escape its grasp?

title: Broad Daylight
description: The day awaits. Whether it ends with you going to visit family, taking a breath in the park, or hiding inside your apartment, it all can be taken away without you having a say in the matter. Regardless of all the chances that life might provide, one truth persists: carpe diem.

title: Gun Frog
description: Gun Frog is a unique physics-based movement shooter where you bounce on lily pads, kill flies and explore a vibrant world as a frog that ate a gun.

title: Through the Veil
description: A horror game in which the line between madness and reality is blurred.

title: Xeno TD
description: The task is very simple - do not let the enemy forces pass on the way to your base. Enemies move along a marked path while you place defense towers along the path.

title: Theme Park Jam
description: Match 3 and ride the roller coaster

title: Pharaoh's Riches
description:
Toss coins and explore the mysteries of Ancient Egypt!
The pharaoh's golden riches await you!

title: Live Action-Bit Theater "Route Yonroku"
description: Suzunone Miu and Rinto will perform a live show in "Live Action-BIT THEATER"! Topping off the live show with energetic voices and sounds assigned to the buttons will make the live show even more fun!

title: ExpandoScape
description: Manipulate the size of the green gear blocks in order to make your way to seemingly unreachable goals in this unique puzzle-platformer.

title: Bones in the Boneyard
description: There are many bones in the boneyard. As they fall from the screen, arrange skulls in lines of three to clear them and line up complete skeletons to set them free.

title: Two Little Ghosts of that House: The Missing Toy
Mazer Laser
description: Dodge, teleport, and advance. Challenge yourself by moving at the speed of light through all kinds of mazes in this Arcade game, where precision and speed will be your best allies.

title: Cats & Dice
description: A roguelike dice-building game where the goal is to overcome an ever-increasing target score each round. Assemble a synergistic set of Cats and dice, go for crazy combos and try to attain as high a score as you possibly can. Master the synergy between cats and dice to win!

title: Refuted Wind
description: This is an atmospheric adventure that will immerse you in a mysterious story. During the game, you will visit many unique places, each of which evokes a feeling of fear and anxiety.

title: Deeplanders
description: DEEPLANDERS is a relaxing, minimalist strategic building game where you must satisfy the needs of the Deeplanders to populate the depths. Explore, build, and decorate your own underground kingdom... and when you're ready, embark on a journey to new, unexplored depths!

title: Hawthorn
description: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

title: Wild Script: Nature
description: A unique adventure generator by a solo developer. Dive into the wilds of a mysterious world: tame creatures, forge alliances or make enemies, build your own settlement, or hunt for ancient artifacts... Your adventure begins now!

title: Meso
description: Meso is a fast-paced exploration-action game with arcade feel and a unique underwater movement. Enter the microcosmic world of puddles and save the ecosystem. Fight against the algae plague and the mysterious invaders.

title: Blink and Die Replay
description: Blink and Die is a musical bullet hell with arcade aesthetics, in first-person, where you must move 360 degrees to dodge bars that moves to the song's rhythm and comes from all angles.

title: Chroma Zero
description: Explore a unique and connected world. Understand its fragile balance, uncover its deepest questions, and find more than just the answers.

title: Overwatch 2: Season 13 - Spellbinder
description: Bewitch the battlefield with Mythic Spellbinder Widowmaker, the new Junkenstein's Laboratory Halloween Terror mode, a My Hero Academia collab, and more!

title: Wordban
description: Wordban is a text-based Sokoban-style game where you control "Wordo" to push boxes and trigger each level's rules, altering the boxes' layout, quantity, and even attributes. Wordo is waiting to explore with you in over 100 unique levels.

title: Sunderfolk
description: Sunderfolk is an online and couch co-op turn-based tactical RPG where one to four players adventure together through the magical and dangerous Sunderlands.

title: Jill O' Lantern: Final Cut
description: Find the clues to make a time bending turnabout in this off the rails visual novel about murder, mayhem, and a thicc pumpkin girl with a machete.

title: Tombstone Tally
description: Tombstone Tally is a cross between bingo and a scavenger hunt where you check off squares based on ridiculous tombstones. Play with your friends! Smack them around with a shovel and challenge them on three maps, including a fast paced arena mode!

title: Star Wars: Episode I - Jedi Power Battles
description: Take back the Theed Royal Palace in this fast and furious lightsaber action game. You will have the power of the Force and your trusty lightsaber to help you ward off legions of battle droids, destroyer droids, assassins, and other creatures from Star Wars: The Phantom Menace.

title: Mini City: Mayhem
description: Mini City: Mayhem is a chaos-filled city-builder where you build against time. Become the mayor of a tiny town, plop down tiny building blocks to build a working city to progress. Manage your roads and building connections. But be quick, because time is ticking!

title: Gilbert and the chemystical island
description: When the egg hatches and the dragon Gilbert takes his first steps onto the beach, there begins a chemical adventure the likes of which you have never before seen, It is an adventure where your own curiosity and thirst for knowledge steer the course of the game. In the hunt for the various parts of the egg shell, which are scattered to the winds, you will learn the secrets of chemistry accompanied by the lab assistant, the desert bedouin, the lava man, the snow queen, and several others.

title: Hook Line and Sniper
description: You are a fish. Armed with your grappling hook-equipped sniper rifle, go on the ultimate krilling spree in Hook Line & Sniper! In this fast-paced arcade shooter, rack up points by mastering your arsenal and maximizing your style.

title: Pixelmancy
description: Pixelmancy is a bullet heaven action-roguelite where you play as a wizard battling demon hordes. Unlock legendary staves and tomes, upgrade your spell and character strength, and survive waves of enemies. Face minibosses, complete events, and grow stronger with every battle!

title: Rising Heat
description: Rising Heat is a fast-paced horde survival game combining momentum-based movement with strategic, deck-builder-style upgrades. Play the demo today and face waves of cyborg enemies, multi-stage bosses, and bullet-hell battles. Customize your build with powerful ‘hacks,’ discover synergies, and unlock new pilots and ships for endless variety. Experiment with Rising Heat’s Fusion mechanic to create unique playstyles and dominate the arena!

title: Scarlet's Haunted Hotel
description: A time management game with 60 levels. Scarlet, a young mother, arrives at a charming seaside hotel run by a distant relative, only to find herself at the center of a dark and mysterious saga. As she navigates the potential inheritance of the hotel, unsettling visions and a suspicious death cast a shadow over her stay.

title: Playtown Genesis
description: A stealth-based adventure set in the 1960s where you play as Doctor Clint, navigating the dangerous corridors of a secret underground facility. Outsmart guards, avoid detection, and team up with rebels to bring down a brutal regime.

title: Club Penguin Dimensions
description: Club Penguin Dimensions is a non-profit, educational recreation (under the principles of fair use/fair dealing) of the original Club Penguin game, which ended its activities in 2017. Since April 2, 2023, Club Penguin Dimensions continues the story from a new multiverse perspective, where different realities and events are interconnected by the Box Dimension.

title: The Ferry
description: Have you ever wondered what it's like to run the evening ferry across a calm bay? Scotto Bay's ferryman managed to break his leg mere days before a major festival and you're filling in. Unfortunately, the festival isn't the only big event, as a major storm is brewing and it's up to you to evacuate the nearby island. Do you have what it takes to help get everyone to safety?

title: Identifile
description:
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullethell roguelike where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms!

Your computer has been infected by an unknown virus, and with your antivirus down, it’s up to you—the cursor—to save it from being overrun. This action-packed roguelike plunges you into the depths of your file explorer, where every folder is a dungeon teeming with threats, and every file holds secrets, treasures, and dangers.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with relentless viruses. Utilize unique circling combat mechanics to eliminate threats, all while collecting powerful EXE files that radically change the gameplay. Inspired by Pokemon Ranger and The Binding of Isaac, Identifile seamlessly blends bullet hell action with deep exploration. Uncover hidden paths, discover game-altering power-ups, and reclaim your system, one dungeon at a time.

title: Corridor Geodesic
description: Corridor Geodesic is a steampunk style puzzle game all about collapsing and expanding the level around you to descend deeper into an ominous facility.

title: Frontier Legends
description: Welcome to Frontier Legends, the ultimate Wild West adventure where survival, crafting, and exploration come together in an expansive open world. Step into the boots of a brave settler who has just arrived by train, ready to stake your claim on the new frontier filled with untold mysteries.

title: Chimp Memory
description: A logical reasoning and memory game that allows you to solve the same logic tests that neurological test monkeys solve in real life and will make you question whether you are capable of being smarter than a monkey. Get your name in the rankings and compete for leadership.

title: Jack of Clubs
description: Play golf, fight robots, and explore an 18-hole course as Jack, a pilot stranded on a recently-abandoned island resort. Discover secrets and complete challenges to earn items that improve your golf game. Unravel the mystery of the island in pursuit of your golf ball across a huge, continuous course.

title: VTOL VR: AH-94 Attack Helicopter
description: The AH-94 is a twin-turboshaft attack helicopter with a tandem cockpit for two pilots. It features nose mounted optical sensors, and can mount a 20mm rotary cannon or 30mm chain gun. It is capable of carrying various air-to-ground missiles, rockets, and other equipment on 4 wing pylons, as well as two small air-to-air missiles on each wing tip.

title: PopSlinger vol. 2: Loveless
description: Return to the PopSlinger universe in this coffee-fueled sequel! Join an elite agent and a digital idol on a mission to rescue a lost heroine in a world full of vibrant chaos. Face new enemies, uncover the mysteries of the Purple District, and groove to a freshly brewed beat!

title: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero - Deluxe Edition
description:
Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Learn and master an incredible roster of playable characters, each with signature abilities, transformations, and techniques. Unleash the fighting spirit within you and take the fight to arenas that crumble and react to your power as the battle rages on.

The Deluxe Edition includes:

• Dragon Ball: Sparking! ZERO
• Season Pass - 3 Packs including Dragon Ball Super: Super Hero and Dragon Ball Daima content that contains more than 20 playable characters
• Season Pass Bonus - Summon Shenron and 3 Days Early Access to the 3 DLC Packs

title: Carry The Glass
description:
Team up as two quirky construction workers in this fun 2-player co-op platformer!
Carry a fragile glass window through colorful levels filled with challenges.
Communicate and coordinate to dodge obstacles and solve puzzles.
Can you finish the job without breaking the glass?

title: Path to the Goal
description: The protagonist, who aims to become a professional soccer player, sets out on a journey of training! Overcome various obstacles to become a professional soccer player!

title: Loot Stack: Relics Hunter
description: Explore ancient dungeons, uncover hidden treasures, and master the art of inventory management as you organize, stack, and collect precious relics in 25 scenarios. Can you find them all?

title: Retro Robots 2D
description: Action Game. Robots, Space Ships, Moon Car, Motorbikes & Jet-Pack. Space War - Save the Humanity. Kill the Aliens and Enemy Robots. Complete the Missions.

title: Chroma Cross
description: Chroma Cross takes Nonograms beyond the binary of black and white and brings them into a rainbow of color. Experience Picross in refreshing polychrome.

title: Journey Up
description: Gain sentience and climb up out of the mines and beyond on your own or online with up to 4 players. Play with checkpoints or without for a more tense experience. Supports VR and desktop monitor mode. Can you reach the top?

title: Fledgling Manor
description: A supernatural horror visual novel where vampires compete to save their eternal unlives in a high-stakes reality show.

title: OuJiang's Labyrinth Adventure
description: OuJiang's Labyrinth Adventure is an action-adventure game that features exploration of labyrinths, battles, and collecting, as well as a technical test of our Houdini-based level creation.There are various monsters, bosses, and props in the game. We hope everyone will enjoy our mini game!

title: InvisibleHand
description: In the bustling tavern, a variety of people are gathered. It's time to showcase true thieving skills!
