title: Rally Arcade Classics
description: Rev up your engines, it's almost time to race back to the past with Rally Arcade Classics! Including 44 iconic cars from the 70's, 80's, 90's and 00's, and 48 thrilling tracks to rev up their engines to the max while drifting every close turn, you will never run out of challenges to take upon.

title: Blood: Endless Pursuit
description: It's a horror game,you should press wasd to move and f to interact，with all the tools you find you can escape from the house and the glown.The enemy will chase you by your blood.The environment light is dark and you have initial iight surrounded yourself

title: ATC Ground Point
description: Control the ground movement of airplanes at various airports. As the air traffic controller, ensure the airplanes move safely and get to the stand or runway on time.

title: Order9
description: About this game ORDER9 is an ‘auto-battle card game' in which players use cards to turn the situation upside down in order to make their chosen character win in the arena.

title: ColorSweeper
description: A unique and addictive color puzzle game that combines Minesweeper and Nonogram! Like Minesweeper, the player's goal is to fill in all the blanks with the correct color, using the information given on the 8 adjacent squares.

title: Multiplayer Ninjas
description: Multiplayer Ninjas - The village is under attack, grab Your sword and go get 'em! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

title: AlongLong Road
description: Along long road is a road simulation game what you can feel the beautiful scenery and peaceful atmosphere. Players can walk the forest road , see a variety of animals, and enjoy hike at their own pace. If you empty your mind and move forward patiently, you can see the end of even the longest road.

title: Space Survivors
description: Annihilate hordes of enemy ships with devastating, unique, and powerful weapons upgrades! In Space Survivors, a survivor-like game with roguelite elements, every move could mean victory or death! head back to your station, hack cargo for pets and powerful cores, and prepare for an even tougher run!

title: Daburali
description: ”Double Lariat” Action GAME Blow away various enemies Wrench-chan's show starts now!

title: Shamoji
description: Serve the rice making sure the bowl is facing the right way.

title: Abolish
description: This is a delightful pixel-style adventure game set in a world of yellow land and blue sky, where you embark on an adventure as a Corgi puppy.

title: Manual
description: This game centers around a colorfully randomized ball which players must navigate along a winding path.

title: Defense Golem
description: Defense Golem is a tower defense game that supports random evolution.

title: Archetype and the Four Winds of Hell
description: Master the four elements, and kill demons. In this short Metroidvania, you play as the Archetype, a legendary elemental master, on a mission to close a portal to hell and end a demon invasion. Learn new abilities, fight demons, and if you fail, be reincarnated with mastery of a different element.

title: Benchmark
description: This game is a stress-relief title designed specifically for relaxation.

title: Tankbot Battle
description: A fast paced, action packed, roguelite game with tanks! Blast your way through procedurally generated levels, and build overpowered combinations of upgrades! Face off against a variety of different enemies and epic bosses.

title: Ostrich Run
description: Ostrich Run is a game where you guide a horde of ostriches out of a lab. Take every ostrich you can and avoid the multiple hazards on your way out. The ostriches will help you break harder windows and rescue more ostriches. Make sure to save them all!

title: Bad Parenting 1: Mr. Red Face
description: Mr. Red Face, a fictional character created by adults to teach their children, suddenly becomes real..

title: Balls Crush Simulator
description: The only simulator where you can crush balls with fun and pleasure!

title: Apathy: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi - 1995 Tokubetsu-hen
Take Notes
description: Take Notes is a puzzle game set in the near future within a bunker filled with 40 unique puzzles. Prepare yourself for a mind-bending adventure where every puzzle solved brings you one step closer to stopping the unthinkable

title: Mr. Bubble
description: A game where you blow bubbles into enemies and defeat the enemies by touching those bubbles. It has 3D enviroments and a story cutscene at the beggining. It came bundled with the DVD Disc for the Eee Stick alongside some other games.

title: Return of the Cyrus Cylinder
description: This is a third person action game made with UDK engine. Maziar is a talented and capable man; An Iranian who wants to defend his ancient identity and culture with his teeth. In the game "Return" you will be accompanied by the dangers of this brave man to defend his ancient identity and nationality. With the help of his longtime friend Jamshid, he wants to prevent his country's valuable antiquities from being stolen by smugglers and to achieve this goal he has to enter environments such as native forests, historic cities and ancient sites such as the historic Bam Citadel. Armed conflict and risk his life to save his national identity.

title: Shalnor: Silverwind Saga
description: Rynna has arrived on one of Shalnor's most dangerous Islands. Prepare yourself for an epic RPG/Action Adventure game. With focus on gauntlet-style combat, traps, boss fights and beautiful pixel-art scenery.

title: King of Ping Pong: Megamix
description: Table tennis meets arcade fighter in this fast-paced action-packed journey to become the best in the world. Defeat a series quirky characters utilizing quick wit and precise timing to secure victory in increasingly challenging matches!

title: Dinocop
description: In a world where dinosaurs and humans live side by side, you're the one and only Dinocop. And you got a meaty case to crack. In this mystery game set in a day cycle, uncover secrets scattered through time.

title: Mokhtar: Uprising Season
description: The 2nd part of the Ambassador of Love trilogy, this PC game narrates a part of Mukhtar Saghafi's life. In this season player as Mukhtar trying to gather people & uprising for a decisive war.

title: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death
description: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: Planetary Rewind
description:
Version 7.8 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter V: The First and Last War
• New Part 2 Open World: Langqiu, 100 Years Ago
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Lone Planetfarer (Vita)
• New Featured Event: Wilderness Development Logs
• Expanded LITE Function
• ...and more!

title: Mistake: Source
description:
Port of Mistake to the Source Engine

Mistake: Source is a fan-made port of the MISTAKE of Half-Life mod developed by Ashkandi, to the source engine. The original mod is a horror-themed first-person shooter.

title: Bylina
description: Embark on an epic journey to the Far Far Kingdom and challenge Koschei the Deathless to save your immortal soul and become a true hero in Bylina, an Action RPG rooted in Slavic folklore and myths. Take on the role of Falconet, a young bogatyr born without hero's powers, shunned and underestimated by almost everyone. Conquer numerous ordeals, overcome insurmountable odds, and become a legendary hero whose tales will be told for ages to come.

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Annals of Pinecany's Mappou Age
description:
Version 2.6 of Honkai: Star Rail, which includes:
• New character: Rappa
• New area: Penacony Paperfold University College
• New Trailblaze Continuance: Banana Outrage: Battles Without Ninja and Humanity
• …and more!

title: Tilebreaker Next Level
description: Destroy blocks covering the Earth in this top-down shooter. Dodge enemy attacks, face off against bosses, and unlock powerful abilities. Levels get progressively more challenging. Save the Earth!

title: Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery
description: Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery is an immersive post-apocalyptic trucking simulation game where players navigate the dangerous and desolate landscapes of the Deadlands.

title: Mystina Online
description: Mystina Online is a massively multiplayer online role-playing game (MMORPG) set in a unique fantasy world where four races—Humans, Beasts, Sylphs, and the Fallen—coexist. In this world, players engage in quests, battles, and treasure hunting, while also collecting heroes to aid them on their journey. One of the game's core features is its summoning system, allowing players to call upon heroes from different eras, using them as companions in battle.

title: Clash Force 2
description: Introducing Clash Force 2! The evil General Crackman has returned, hacking Clash Force’s weapons systems and launching a full scale attack on their home turf! Once again, Voom the Rhinoceros, Scorpido the Scorpion, and Echid, the aptly named Echidna, must armor up, take back their base, and launch an assault on Crackman’s powered up forces!

title: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game
description: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a bloody retro fighting beat em up with frenetic action and a lot of fun and references to the Terrifier franchise.

title: Sevver Levvel
description:
_SEVVER_LEVVEL_ is a limit-removing DOOM 2 WAD consisting of 11 base maps and 6 secret maps. It focuses on hectic spontaneous gameplay and features a few weapon and balance changes as well as two brand new enemies.
This mapset was inspired by Snowy44's favorite vibes, aesthetics, media and music. It features a variety of level types, ranging from small exploration-based ones to big arenas.

title: BangXBang
description: Bang x Bang is a text adventure game with elements of homosexual love, in which you are the son of a gangster, and even though you don't want to get involved in your "family business", one day a big gangster wolf suddenly finds you, then your peaceful life is far away from you...​

title: Tavern of Spear
description:
You play as "Eyvind"， a young wolf warrior from The Lost Spear Tribe who has come of age.

Following a tribal tradition, Eyvind leaves home and sets out on a journey.

You are the young adventurer from the Lost Spear Tribe who’s come of age and ready to prove himself as an adventurer.

But adventure leads you to a strange tavern tucked in a foggy forest.

Despite the threat outside, the beer is great, and the company is fun to be with.

Inspired by Fallout 1/2. DND, Teraurge, Ruina and Corruption of Champion.

title: Back Alley Arcane Shop
description: Back Alley Arcane Shop is a fantasy world-based furry gay romance visual novel. You become the protagonist - Resque, who runs a arcane shop in a back alley, and you will meet four furries. Discover the fate and future of the Arcane shop with your partner.

title: Farming Through The End
description: In Farming Through The End, players navigate a zombie apocalypse by growing food, gathering resources, and fortifying their land, as farming becomes humanity's last hope for survival.

title: Little Fighter 2 Remastered
description: Rediscover the classic combat charm of "Little Fighter 2," now with fully upgraded and redrawn graphics, support for local connections up to 8 computers, and every character move more detailed and extravagant, providing an unprecedented combat experience.

title: Mimic Alert
description: You are on a service to detect and destroy mimics - creatures capable of taking the form of any object. Your task is to carefully inspect your surroundings, use all your attentiveness and various tools to detect mimics.

title: HappyHazard
description: A survival adventure game where players explore vast stages, solve puzzles, and find treasure while avoiding or battling enemies. Limited resources and inventory management require strategic play, offering tension and challenge without horror elements.

title: On Wings Bringing Sleep
description: 'On Wings Bringing Sleep' is the story of Morgaine, an outcast among the fae as her people's power is ever-dwindled by the advance of human technology. When she meets a mysterious and enthralling human girl within the forest one day, Morgaine grows certain that this girl is in need of her magical protection. But Ilse has secrets of her own, and the growing feelings between them may cost more than either girl might ever pay...

title: Whimside
description: A creature collection game that sits at the bottom of your screen & fits easily into your routine. Whether you're working, studying, or relaxing, Whimside is always ready to offer you cozy pauses. Capture rare creatures, create new species & decorate your whimsical space in this soothing adventure.

title: Mentari
description: In a world frozen by The Stillness, one girl holds the power to undo the damage. Mentari is an action-adventure game where you take control of the titular heroine to make the world move again, through a unique, dance-based combat system.

title: Tomb Raider IV•V•VI Remastered
description:
Remastered collection of the Darkness Trilogy includes:

Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation – Lara Croft discovers the lost tomb of the Egyptian God Set, unwittingly unleashing him and fulfilling an ancient prophecy—one that plunges mankind into darkness.

Tomb Raider: Chronicles – Following the events of The Last Revelation, Lara Croft is buried in an Egyptian tomb and is presumed dead. At her memorial, those closest to her reminisce about secrets from her past.

Tomb Raider: The Angel of Darkness – Accused of murder, Lara becomes a fugitive on the run, while uncovering a sinister conspiracy involving alchemical experiments and the search for ancient artifacts.

title: Blood of Mehran
description: In Blood of Mehran, explore sweeping sand dunes, bustling bazaars and sprawling palaces. Go blade to blade with enemies, pick them off from a distance with your arrows, or slip by them like a ghost. Level up and build your legend.

title: G-Rebels
description: G-Rebels: An action-packed combat flight sim in a dystopian open world full of intrigue, free exploration and dangerous missions. As part of an elite unit, it is your job to ensure law and order. A secret mission calls everything into question: are you on the right side or part of a conspiracy?

title: War Mechanic
description: "War Mechanic" is a unique first-person simulator set in a dieselpunk world where World War II never ended. Manage a military base, explore with your combat vehicle, and survive in a world driven by war and money.

title: AuraVale
description: AuraVale is a cozy life-sim where your words shape your story. Create your Aura, design your perfect home, and build lasting relationships. Develop a thriving town and invite friends to be your neighbors.

title: Ghost Frequency
description: In Ghost Frequency, you are a ghost hunter from PIT - Paranormal Investigation Team. Your mission is to locate a sinister spirit using the EMF Ghost Detector to track paranormal activity, the IR Thermal Camera to reveal hidden entities, and the EVP Digital Recorder to capture eerie voices.

title: Tangerine Antarctic
description: Welcome, detective, to World’s End’s most luxurious hotel: the Tangerine Antarctic at Mt. Hope. The ultimate comfort for the powerful elites past, present and future. No desire is off-limits, privacy is absolute and nothing is certain. Except: you shouldn't be here. And the murders are very real.

title: Gravity Forge
description: Master gravity and parkour skills to slay hordes of enemies. As an elegant assassin, you can play solo or in co-op with friends.

title: The Spiral
description: The Spiral is a first-person roguelike dungeon crawler. To survive, you must descend into darkness and confront the nightmares within. Explore the randomized dungeon, find powerful equipment, and fight for your life.

title: Sonic Beyond the Speed
description:
Enjoy this fangame in 2d at full speed and platform.
Eggman plans to attack with his air fleet and so that sonic and tails do not bother them he will teleport along with the Chaos Emeralds to places of the past.

title: Steam Drulls
description: The Empire of Cats is trying to take over the Sky World with their steam-powered mechs! It's up to you to fight back in this 3D platformer.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog: The Home Saver
Mint's Hints 2
description: Step back onto the set of Mint's Hints, a cancelled children's TV show you were once the showrunner for. What begins as a curious exploration soon turns into a nightmare as you're hunted by the vengeful spirits that roam the abandoned set. Seeking refuge in an underground corridor, you stumble upon an android version of Mint, the show's once-beloved star, now deactivated and discarded.

title: Sonic Dreamscape
description:
An adventure for one hedgehog.

Sonic Dreamscape (or Dreamland in other regions) is a game about Sonic entering Dreamland in quest to stop Eggman from wielding the power of the dreamscape.

title: Rocket Rats
description: Rocket Rats is a survivors-like game where you defeat cheese-based astral bodies in space – as a rat! Clear waves of enemies, collect cheese, upgrade your gear, and conquer the moon!

title: A Little to the Left: Merry Mess
description: Merry Mess event unwraps five new puzzles between 22-26 December

title: A Little to the Left: Good Tidyings
description: A Little to the Left’s Daily Tidy Delivery gets a wintry wrapping

title: Goshzilla Is In Love
description: You are Goshzilla, a giant lizard monster. You are on a date with Moffy, a giant moth monster. Good luck! A very short & chaotic dating simulator.

title: A Little to the Left: Something Eggstra
description: Sweetening the neatening: four new egg-shaped puzzles to beat this Easter

title: Gay Monopoly
description: A recreation of the 1983 board game Gay Monopoly by The Parker Sister recreated within Tabletop Simulator.

title: Pokémon: Legends of Sinnoh
description: Pokémon: Legends of Sinnoh is an open world Pokémon Master Trainer board game made within Tabletop Simulator. The game is inspired by the Pokémon Master Trainer board games and Pokémon Legends: Arceus.

title: My Little Pony: Adventures in Equestria - Deck-Building Game
description: A recreation of the board game "My Little Pony: Adventures in Equestria - Deck-Building Game" made in Tabletop Simulator.

title: Tales of Rein Ravine
description: Tales of Rein Ravine is an indie horse game that aims to challenge its players with unique real-life inspired riding, as well as tell an intriguing equestrian story to a young adult audience.

title: Carol Coral's: Open the Door
description: Pixel point-and-click game for nostalgic.

title: Rodeo Clown
description: Welcome to Aurora, TX. Stay a while and learn a thing or two about yourself.

title: Demon Hunt
description: Demon Hunt is a rogue-lite top down shooter set in cursed lands overrun by demons, featuring intense boss fights and evolving weapons. Discover powerful artifacts, loot unique items and create outrageous synergies. Spend collected resources at your base to upgrade and unlock new ways of playing.

title: The Painting
description: A short, emotional visual novel following a grieving man who relives memories of days long gone. An exploration of loss presented honestly and kinetically.

title: Finnish Cottage Simulator
description: Finnish Cottage Simulator is the ultimate cottage experience. Relax and enjoy the Finnish summer nature, go to the sauna, get drunk, grill food or play games with others!

title: Traveller's Hymn
description: Traveller's Hymn is a top-down, grid-based, open-world adventure game. Explore a vast land, battle monsters, collect loot, help locals and cook hearty meals while unraveling the mystery behind the land's curse.

title: Starless Abyss
description: Earth has fallen. Science and the Occult have united forces to brace for the arrival of the Eldritch. But will the efforts against this strange, alien race be enough? Play as one of many Proximae used to help defend humanity in this turn-based, roguelike, intergalactic deck builder.

title: Little Screamies
description:
Explore the world of Little Screamies!

BUT BEWARE!!

Not everything is as it seems
at Little Laboratories Inc....

Made by development team at Nukepop Games!

title: Hexaroma: Village Builder
description: HEXAROMA is a strategy based charming little island village builder. Dive into a relaxing yet challenging experience where you strategize the best hexagon island placements in this cute little city builder game. Place the building pieces strategically, grow your village and your tiny island.

title: Nebelmer
description: Discover the unknown land of Nebelmer, a small open world game about exploration, movements and mysteries. Leave your village to uncover the wonders and secrets hidden beneath the mist.

title: Tekken 8: Genmaji Temple
description:
Genmaji Temple, where mysterious ascetic monks train themselves in blood-soaked drills in a secluded area deep in the mountains, is now available!

The scenery changes depending on the time of day. The daytime atmosphere is solemn, the evening is filled with dancing autumn leaves, and the night is filled with falling snow.

title: Byte The Dust
description: Make your way through increasingly harder platform sections. But be aware, one small error and it's back to the beginning for you!

title: Social Warfare
description: Be a troll-for-hire on social media! You will serve in the Social Warfare battalion and promote loyalty to the Great Kingdom of Eternia, while disrupting society in the enemy nation.

title: Lego Star Wars: End of War
description: Lego Star Wars: End of War sends the player on a journey throughout the last episode of the clone wars, including things like the Ashoka and Maul fight, with the style of the Lego Star Wars games.

title: Last Rollbug
description:
You are Beetle, a small rollbug who does some platforming stuff and also experiences horrors beyond its comprehension.
The rest of these tiny creatures have gone missing, will Beetle be able to find them, or will something else find them first?

title: Chica's Party World: Rebaked
description: Chica's Party World: REBAKED is the official reboot / re-imagining of the original game from 2018 by PoisonousPastels and BonBun_Studios. The game sees you playing as a security robot designated with the task of watching over the building and running basic maintenance tasks until proper renovations begin. However (obviously) things aren't quite what they seem at first.

title: Five Nights to Remember
description: It's been three years since the tragedy. The newly established Fazbear Ent. has attempted to turn the public perception of the once-beloved Fredbear's Family Diner around with a hit show and a new line of animatronics, and they want you to join the Fazbear family as a night watchman.

title: Viking Survivors: The Last Ragnarök
description: An action roguelite where you wield ancient weapons and unleash Norse fury on endless waves of monsters. Survive the bullet hell, collect mythic weapons, and prove you're the ultimate Viking warrior.

title: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
description: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

title: Canary: Kono Omoi wo Uta ni Nosete
description: A young man moves to Shikoku, the smallest of Japan's four main islands, to live in Kagawa prefecture with his uncle who runs a sound studio. Attending the Kotohira Middle School as a student with an ear for music, the player engages in interaction with seven female students who play in the school band. Some girls specialize in vocals and others wield instruments in the pop section. Music provides the glue for possible friendships and amorous maneuvers. A supporting cast of other characters including classmates, teachers and your uncle also supply additional interaction and bolster the storyline. The bulk of the interaction leads up to the school festival where you and band members hope to create beautiful music together.

title: MasterChef: Culinary Showdown
description: Master the Kitchen, Challenge the World! Sharpen your knives and compete with global chefs in wacky mini-games. Master over 120 recipes, unlock culinary challenges, upgrade your kitchen, and become the ultimate MasterChef.

title: Welcome to Elderfield
description: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

title: Manaka de Ikuno!!
description: Manaka de Ikuno!! is the fifth entry in the Leaf Amusement Soft series, and includes various games, like Magical Fight, a fighting game; Final Dragon Chronicle Guilty Requiem, a visual novel with RPG elements; Princess Collection, a card game; and Mananatsu a 3D visual novel.

title: Custom Nights at Freddy's
description: A new Five Nights at Freddy's game awaits! You already know the rules: you're a night guard in an office, facing 21 animatronics, each with unique functions. But this time, you're not in the usual pizzeria and you're part of an experiment.

title: Oto-hime
description: Shimako, a socially anxious office worker, escapes the pressures of her company's beach retreat by fishing alone, only to stumble upon a trapped turtle by the shore. When she rescues it, Shimako is mysteriously whisked away to a hidden underwater palace, where she meets Oto-hime, a breathtakingly beautiful but enigmatic princess. Drawn in by Oto-hime's charm and her lavish hospitality, Shimako soon realizes there is something unsettling beneath the princess's kind façade.

title: Pogger's Legends
description: Pogger's Legends is a turn based 'card' game where you recruit heroes to defeat villains. The battle system is made from the ground up using elements that affect eachother, per-unit stats and unique abilities that can be battle decisive. There are an infinite amount of per-save generated stages and near infinite possible units. Save the day in Pogger's Legends now!

title: True Nightmare: Roadside Сafe
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a night-shift waitress at a secluded roadside café, serve strange patrons and feel mounting dread. Each night, the nightmare becomes more real, and someone is watching from the darkness. Can you survive?

title: Half-Rats: A Fever Dream
description:
Half-Rats: A Fever Dream is a Half-life game mod that was released for halloween, 2015.

Somewhere in America, a mere decade before The Gay '90s. Half-Rats, a alcoholic, poor man, is woken up by his landlord and some loud noise coming from outside. After getting his revolver and a sword he and his landlord quickly learns that Hell, figuratively and literally, is on earth.

The first in the "Half-Rats" series. The game begins at the general store where you and Mr. Trask, your landlord and shop-keep must make a stand against a great horror whose origins will only be revealed at the close of this story. Though it is a general store, that does not mean it boasts unlimited resources...supplies and manpower will begin to run thin - and you'll need to face hell to go out and gather them. You may end up meeting a fresh face or two during the night's journey - try and keep them alive and kicking, yeah? Some of them could become great assets.

title: Midnight's Bell
description: Follow Midnight, a black cat who remains loyal to his owner even in death, as he travels across Heaven and into dreams to find out what's going on with his old owner, Mary.

title: The Rocky Horror Show Video Game
description:
Experience the strange journey of Brad and Janet like never before in this wild and wacky retro platform game adaptation of Richard O'Brien's legendary rock'n'roll musical.

Run and jump through Frank-N-Furter's mansion of madness with authentic classic sidescrolling platform gameplay.

Take on the mansion's tricks and traps in challenging classic platforming action, and with infinite retries, you'll never see a "game over" screen... good for relieving your tension, but it may drive you insane!

title: Terror In The Corn
description: In an endless cornfield where the sun never rises, you must break the curse or risk being trapped forever.

title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
description: Dive into Ayasa, a dark and mysterious platformer where light and shadow hold the key to survival. Journey through six haunting lands, solve challenging puzzles and restore balance to a world on the brink of collapse.

title: Half-Rats: Redridge
description: The first canonical mod in the Half-Rats series! August, 1999. You're a fresh college grad passing the time in your parents' rural retreat before the tourist season picks up and your first job as "Junior Researcher" at a nearby wildlife-themed resort begins. Located on the outskirts of the run down backwater town called Redridge, the crickets and your empty beer bottles are your only companions. It's getting late, and you decide to put on a pot of coffee and throw something in the microwave...just then, you hear a pounding at the door. Then...the windows...

title: Hell Frontier
description: ViolentBeetle's solo megawad with development spanning their entire mapping career.

title: Preekarity
description: PREEKARITY is a large and very challenging limit-removing single map for the DOOM II IWAD. UV players should expect to have their skills tested on all fronts: combat, movement, resource management, and navigation. Beware of resource starvation, combat puzzles, and general meanness. HMP and below are more forgiving and more focused on the "fun factor," but should still provide some spicy moments for non-Doomgods.

title: Doom III
description: This mod let's you get back into the fight against evil and it's gameplay is modernized while still playing very much the way Doom and Doom II did.

title: Demonology: Incubus - Chapter 5
description: an erotic interactive fiction series

title: Bitter Dream
description: Bitter Dream is a set of 10 MBF21 maps with all original music composed by LVENdead, intended to take you on a dark, cosmic journey with a variety of gameplay and a loose narrative thread. Maps start off easy and escalate to fairly challenging by the end by most reasonable measures. Bitter Dream will take most players between 5-6 hours to complete, as there are a few longer maps in the set. As such, it has been divided into 3 distinct Episodes.

title: Owl Force
description: Lead the legendary Owl Force and your wingmates on an epic journey defending the galaxy against the nefarious Darktail Order. Take on missions, upgrade your ship, and engage in heart-pounding battles to uncover the hidden secrets of the universe.

title: Croquet Conundrum
description: Croquet Conundrum is a compact puzzle game about hitting a ball through wickets and pipes to explore a world of interconnected islands. A small number of mechanics inspired by the real rules of croquet combine together to create challenging puzzles that will test your logic and reasoning.

title: Traxion 3000
description: Traxion 3000 is a cave-flyer set in outer space. Explore the underground caves of 6 different alien planet, fight enemies, solve puzzles and salvage the valuable cargo pods. Supports up to 4 players.

title: I Am Legion: Stand Survivors
description: Summon your stands and brawl it out! Dive into the thrill of mowing down enemies, synthesizing and upgrading, mining, forging gear, unlocking new characters and equipment. Discover unique stands combos and craft your own battle style to break through the chaos!

title: Tobacco Shop Simulator
description: Run your tobacco shop. Sign contracts with leading brands, order products, hire workers, expand your store, and never let your customers leave the store empty-handed. Play with friends or go solo, and enjoy the growth of your shop.

title: Fredbear and Friends: Reboot
description: It has been 26 years since the closure of 'Fredbear and Friends', the restaurant that had once brought joy and happiness, which was shut down for unknown reasons. Four daring teenagers decided to visit it's ruins at night, however, things didn't go as they planned.

title: Game of Fate
description: Immerse yourself in the first-person perspective, cross time and space, solve bizarre cases, save innocent victims, and catch a mysterious killer! You will solve murders, uphold justice, and also gain love. Are you ready? Play the "Game of Fate" that crosses time and space, life and death!

title: Barbecue With Friends
description: "Shashlik" is a multiplayer simulator of kebab cooking. You will make marinade, prepare coals and grill kebabs! You'll also be able to put out the mangal with water, marinate a stone, put a friend on a skewer and drink beer!

title: The Villain Simulator
description: A Non-VR and VR first-person adventure game that lets you experience the thrill of dominating and controlling powerful super heroines. Use a variety of machines and tools to hold them captive and experiment on them, all while guiding them towards a submissive and compliant behavior.

title: Super Mining Mechs
description: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

title: The Villainess Quits
description: "The Villainess Quits" is a multi-ending romance simulation game. As the villainess Emily, handle various problems, alleviate family pressure, and reverse hostile relationships at school. Can Emily become an outstanding graduate and win recognition? Every choice impacts her future.

title: Bonding, Now
description: A black-and-white stylized collection of visual novel stories with pixel graphics gameplay and lineart artwork. Experience how new bonds are created, how they evolve, twist and change. Complete with a separate open-ended adventure mode.

title: Atha: In Search of the Well
description: Adventure of the chicken Atha and his friend Bia, facing dangers to protect their homeland, using skills such as jumping, attacking and magic, as well as solving puzzles with boxes, buttons and levers.

title: Doggy Waiter 2
description: Stack the dishes with energizing casual fun! Plates, cups, mugs, and more as high as you can but don't let them drop! Then help the doggy waiter get them to the kitchen safely.

title: Amarillo's Butt Slapper
description: Slap it. Turn it. Slap it again. This incredible simulation of the human butt will leave you dizzy with all that bounce. It's an autoclicker, but instead of click, it slap. Way better imo.

title: Crimsonwood
description: Crimsonwood is a roguelike top-down shooter in a cursed national park. Collect various weapons, gain perks and battle hordes of enemies to survive. Play solo or online co-op.

title: Embers of Spiritflame
description: Embers of Spiritflame is an Emotional Point & Click detective adventure about the exploration of an old abandoned house. Inside, You go through comic book-inspired levels and begin to uncover why is everyone missing. View events and memories of the place and piece together the story.

title: Happy Birthday: With Sergio Spellbound
description: Better than a birthday card. Use the Steam gift system to deliver this birthday present to your friends. The amazing Sergio Spellbound will ensure they have the magical birthday adventure of a lifetime. They will point and click their way to BIRTHDAY GLORY. If they’re lucky, they may even survive …

title: Chained in the Backrooms
description: Chained in the Backrooms is a 1-4 player co-op, mission-based horror game. Trapped in a blurry subconscious and chained together, toy bears must solve puzzles, complete challenging missions, and survive against creatures trying to destroy them.

title: Savage Gears
description: Savage Gears is a violent, single-player FPS inspired by early 2000s objective-oriented action games. Armed with an Iron Fist and an arsenal of devastating weaponry, you play as Ero Lei'Bourne, a fearless soldier, on his dangerous mission to save the continent from the brink of annihilation.

title: Door4: Ultimatum
description: Dive into the captivating world of puzzles with the new part of the Door game series. Your task is to find the correct door among many options to advance to the next level. But be careful: only by understanding the patterns and solving puzzles you can unlock the coveted passage.

title: Opioid visions 88
description: Opioid visions 88 is a first person shooter. The game presents the protagonist's visions of substances that expand consciousness.

title: YuruYuri: Perfect Math
description: YuruYuri: Perfect Math is an unofficial educational RPG Maker VX Ace game which uses characters from the anime series YuruYuri. The game teaches players about creativity, logical reasoning, cognitive development and strategies for mental calculation.

title: License To Clone
description: Survive a harsh desert with sci fi technology, rampant wild clones and multiple factions. Start off working in a small town for any faction, grow your money and eventually start your own town, complete bounties to earn faster cash and progress.

title: Oasis Blitz
description: Oasis Blitz is a third person driller! Speed through floating islands, using your drill to dive down into terrain and then burst back out. Shred down slopes on your sandboard, and grapple to enemies for extra momentum.

title: Cardaire
description: Explore, collect, and build sweet decks. Cardaire is a single-player collectible card RPG. Adventure awaits in the Duelist Frontier, so crack some packs and bring your best deck to take on the challenge.

title: Sacrilegious
description: As a powerful female warrior, travel to new sections with different maps in each section, defeat enemies, collect loot and improve your equipment. Survive in this ever-changing world using strategy and skills.

title: Mars vs. Robots
description: Defend Mars from the Robots in this innovative roguelike survival miner. Mine Valueable Resources, Build Powerful Machines, and Fight! Will your planet fall to the greedy humans or will your defence be Robust

title: The Limb
description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by monsters due to an unknown virus, some people have managed to survive. During these times, an organization formed by elite members of society emerged, fighting against the monsters and aiming to restore the world to its original state.

title: BloodLight
description: BloodLight is a cooperative first-person horror game for up to 5 players. While working as a night watchman, you will face a demon that constantly changes form. Set out in a team or alone through the chilling environment to complete all the tasks.

title: Cornfield
description: Death Hides in the Harvest!

title: The Ghost of Nichishima
description: Inspired by real events and Japanese folklore, this immersive horror experience allows you to freely explore the village of Nichishima, after moving here you will soon realise things are not as they seem. Many scary encounters await you as you look for clues, and ways to conclude your story.

title: Mindflux: Dead Man Walking
description: You are a cybernetic detective on the brink of madness. The only doctor who can save you is missing. Modify your brain to extract clues, bargain with ghosts from your past at the cost of sanity, and survive a decaying world of nightmares in this first-person horror RPG.

title: Spirit Valor
description: In Spirit Valor, you play as a spirit caught in a struggle between magic and fate. After a magic outburst binds him to a human warrior Richard's body, the two embark on a perilous quest to stop the rise of demonic forces. With the world’s laws shattered, and the Overlord vanished, they must track down this elusive enemy before it is too late. Armed with the powerful Spellstones and magic, the spirit warrior sets out on an epic journey to restore balance to the world and prevent the transformation into a demon.

title: Floyd Factory Jam
description: Floyd Factory Jam includes 11 maps (+ start), with the aim of creating factory type environments with no restriction on theme or texture set. The only requirement is that Floyd must be included on your factory's payroll. This jam is based on Alkaline.

title: Rabbit Horror Show
description: One would never believe that something as extraordinary as this could happen to oneself, but fate had an unusual twist in store for me. Yesterday, as the dark storm clouds gathered ominously in the sky, a bolt of lightning, like a celestial spear, found its target, and that target was me. The force of nature's wrath struck me with a ferocity that defied reason. Incredibly, I did not succumb to death's cold embrace, nor did I bear any visible wounds. It was as if the universe had chosen me for a different fate, one that would lead me to a realm beyond imagination.

title: The Fading of Nicole Wilson
description: Aspiring to become a famous ghost hunter, teenage girl Amy embarks on a life-changing adventure at the long-abandoned Timberline Hotel in Montana. Ghosts, however, come in several shapes, and it is the living that seem to be hiding a dark secret from her.

title: Try Dying
description: A PvP party game where your goal is to DIE FIRST! Choose your cutest water dragon and hang out with your friends in a noose, catch knives and hug dynamite. But don't forget to stop your buddies who try dying!

title: BattleCards Saga
description: BattleCards Saga, the strategic card game where every fusion reveals a new creature and every battle shapes your legend.

title: Tron: Catalyst
description: The Arq Grid stands on the brink of collapse. With your Identity Disc and Light Cycle, fight to escape by wielding the power of the Glitch loop. Electrifying action and a rich story combine in a new adventure set within Disney’s iconic TRON universe.

title: VTumbler
description: Dive into the vibrant world of VTubers in a free-to-play arcade puzzle fighting PVP spectacle in VTumbler!

title: Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate
description: Secret Agent Wizard Boy must go undercover to topple Grumblemort's evil crime syndicate, hidden beneath his wizarding school. Learn spells, engage in espionage, and spread utter lore-unfriendly chaos.

title: Leenie's Tale
description: On a quiet, moonless night, an unassuming train conductor named Ballin had no idea he was about to become entangled in an ancient, sinister mystery that haunts these lands. Will he survive this fateful night?

title: World of the dead
description: The World of the Dead is an immersive zombie FPS game that combines first-person shooter and extraction PvPvE genres. In a world of walking corpses and deformed monsters, you'll have to forge your own path to survival while keeping an eye for new firearms and equipment.

title: Bible Puzzle
description: Bible Puzzle offers a relaxing and uplifting experience as you piece together beautiful biblical scenes. When you’re fully relaxed, it’s time to take on the challenge of ranked matches. Think you’ve got what it takes to beat other players?

title: ExoFrontier: Venus
description: ExoFrontier: Venus is a RogueVania with RPG elements and procedurally generated levels. Follow the story of Doug who has become an Explorer and help him make Venus a better place for humans!

title: Solar Collision Control
description: Control the power of the sun in Solar Collision Control, a thrilling arcade game where you must survive as long as possible by avoiding obstacles, collecting stars, and completing challenging missions to achieve the highest score.

title: Dicealot
description: A roguelike dice roller with deckbuilding elements

title: Navicula Meatus
description: A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.

title: I Want to Believe
description: I Want to Believe is a first-person action game with elements of detective work, simulation, stealth, freedom of action, and driving.

title: Office After Hours
description: Spot anomalies and uncover hidden clues to escape an office where overwork turns strange and experiments happen more often than coffee breaks.

title: Lycoris;Lastwords
description: Deliver three recently departed souls to the afterlife -- and keep their thoughts comforted. As best you can, at least.

title: Reconquer Online
description: Play a new community-driven indie MMORPG! Train, battle, quest, and explore a dynamic world. Solve puzzles, conquer dungeons, and join epic battles with friends. Compete for top scores in a fair, pay-to-win-free environment. Your feedback shapes our development!

title: Shift'n Slay
description: A brutal blend of turn-based tactics and roguelike. Take on the role of an executioner, grab crime by the throat with the hand of the law... and smash it! Because you are the law!

title: Shadow and Flame
description:
2 new factions, new heroes, spells and units for original factions, new maps, and campaign-compatible. Shadow and Flame is a modern reimagining of BFME1, with improved graphics and new gameplay systems.

Shadow and Flame has 6 factions to choose from; the 4 factions from the original game - Gondor, Rohan, Mordor and Isengard - have been overhauled with new mechanics, units, heroes and spells, and 2 new custom factions - Gundabad and Rivendell - have been added.

The goal is to create an RTS experience that is faithful to the spirit of Tolkien's mythos, with diverse, engaging, and balanced gameplay.

title: Dice Strategy
description: Simulation game using a dice. Game for those who love prisoner's base.

title: Legends of Boom
description: Legends of Boom is a fast-paced Card Battle game. Collect and upgrade cards, challenge human and AI opponents online, all while experiencing over 4 hours of commentary by our vice-laden puppet sportscaster, Flip Rimrod.

title: Ravenholm
description:
Developed in the Czech Republic by Lord Games, Ravenholm is a single-player Half-Life 2 modification based around the terrifying atmosphere, visuals and gameplay from the Half-Life 2 chapter of the same name. With a different and greatly expanded story and many new locations, you will find yourself battling many more zombies, headcrabs and more in a bid to free the town from this horrific, nightmarish infestation.

The atmosphere in the original HL2 game was both interesting, and terrefying, and that is the driving force behind our choice on creating a modifacation on that enviroment alone. All maps from this modifacation have a very similar kind of feel of atmosphere and gameplay from the original Ravenholm, but with an different and expanded story, and many new locations. So, you will find yourself battleing many more Zombies, Headcrabs, and more.

The sequel to the story after John (our player) escapes from Ravenholm goes on to Eye of the Storm.

title: Lost But Found
description: A combination of a job simulator & hidden object game. In a top-down table, you are an officer who oversees the lost items in an airport. Organize those items and distribute them to people who lost their belongings. Upgrade your office, manage requests, and more.

title: Mash VP! Re:Vision
description: Mash VP! Re:Vision is a next generation music game with exciting 2 column gameplay! Featuring new tracks composed by hugely popular music game artists, choose your favorites to mash up and create a new sensation!

title: Marry a Deep One
description: Establish your bloodline, lead a sinister cult and manage an isolated seaside village, where aquatic monsters crossbreed with humans. Use social manipulation and occult magic to slow down the inevitable descent into a spiral of madness.

title: Randomax
description: Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory! A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup that puts your resourcefulness to the test.

title: Bonanit: A Menorcan Horror Story
description: Experience sleep paralysis in Bonanit, where every game is unique and every blink counts. Face the terror lurking in the darkness of your room and find out if you can maintain your sanity until daylight arrives.

title: Zero Escape: Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors
description:
The first game in the Zero Escape series, originally made as a standalone title "Nine Hours, Nine Persons, Nine Doors". The Zero Escape rebranding and alternative cover of the game were released alongside its sequel in the "Zero Escape: The Nonary Games".

This version features updated artwork, voice acting, the choice of novel and adventure mode's and the addition of the FLOW Chart, along with other changes to adapt the game for a single screen from the original's two screens.

title: WhatRogue: Exile Land
description: "WhatRogue：Exile Land" blends roguelike, card construction, and tactical turn-based gameplay. The tactical element requires spatial strategies, enhancing strategic depth. Choose different heroes and companions to defeat various monsters and bosses.

title: Slasher: Origins
description: Slashers is a chaotic, 2.5D, auto-attack survival game with rogue-lite elements and noir-anime storytelling. Unlock powerful heroes, create builds of unique abilities, and survive the escalating inferno of Mephistopheles’ underworld.

title: Bonaparte: A Mechanized Revolution
description: 1789, Paris. Take Napoleon’s place in an alternate history as Céline or César Bonaparte in this ideology driven, turn-based strategy journey. Defend, reform or oppose the monarchy and write your own alternative history by combining cunning political skills and tactical military prowess.

title: Leap of Sins
description: Leap of Sins is a solo, first person psychological horror parkour game that thrusts you into a nightmarish version of hell. As a damned soul, you must climb a decaying skyscraper filled with deadly obstacles and deceptive jumps, all while battling the psychological horrors of your Hell Loop.

title: Cities Domination
description: Cities Domination is a city builder, resource management and strategy game. Gestion all the units and resources between cities for create an empire, attack enemies cities, build, defend and expand your cities and dominate the castles... or lose yours.

title: Psychopomp Gold
description: Psychopomp is BACK. The catacombs stretch down farther than ever before. Your entire life has been a lie. Delve into the depths, and discover the horrors that lie below. More realms, more modes, more secrets. An ancient voice calls to you from the center of the earth. Will you answer it?

title: The Report: The Eastwind Creature
description: A road traveler heads into Eastwind in search of a creature from a local legend to do a report.

title: Turbo Dismount 2
description: Turbo Dismount 2 is a comedy physics racing sandbox with Mr. Dismount and his friends. It is the officially ambitious sequel to the wildly popular, immensely successful, world-renowned entertainment juggernaut - Turbo Dismount.

title: MetroLand
description: MetroLand is a new endless runner that takes what you know and love about the classic endless runner and turns it up to 11!

title: The Harmony Chronicles: Chaos Realms - Collector's Edition
description: Join Mona on her quest and experience the ultimate hidden object adventure!

title: Prisnhax
description: Hack into 50 prison cells with light-based digital puzzle locks.

title: Magic Cats Pots
description: Repair magical pots with cats!

title: Yugo: The Non-game
description: Yugo: the non-game is a virtual space where you can drive a car, listen to the radio, and invite people to talk and share the experience with.

title: Trailcam
description: In Trailcam, you are a wildlife investigator called to the Appalachian Mountains to solve mysterious missing person cases. Using trail cameras from your watchtower, you'll uncover a sinister truth, navigating a non-linear plot full of twists. Can you solve the mystery?

title: System Death
description: Stylistically rich retro fast-paced combat open world fps space shooter with different weapons, space traps and bosses

title: Slide Faster
description: Master precision and agility as you conquer the ice. Race against time and challenge friends worldwide with asynchronous multiplayer features. Compete against the ghosts of friends and top players in time trials, pushing your skills to the limit.

title: Neptune Island
description: Neptune Island is a short puzzle game where you have been tasked with repairing the light of a lighthouse. The light has been out for some time, and the owner hasn't done anything to fix it. Unbeknownst to you, you have a much more difficult job ahead of you than you anticipated...

title: Monkeys & Typewriters!
description: Ever heard of those million chimps with a million typewriters writing the collected works of Shakespeare? Guess what, you're that monkey! Join Typo the Monkey in this rogue relax simulator which allows you to generate any type of story you can think of, explore and win it, and share it with others!

title: Sketchy Marathon
description: Platform in a world that's drawn for you! A 2D endless platformer game where you must evade obstacles drawn by a rogue pencil! Explore a variety of biomes while improving your high score and collecting hats along the way.

title: Tres
description: Tres is a cards-based game where you, with another player, have to compete againt each other to see wich one is the first to put on the table all of their cards.

title: A Work of Art
description: A dark, witty, psychological thriller in the horror genre, A Work of Art presents a 1-2 hour story-driven experience with Visual Novel features and RPG elements. Follow a colorful cast of quirky characters through a twisted tale of beauty and darkness; All to the sound of a Dark Original soundtrack.

title: Achilles: Survivor
description: Achilles: Survivor is a dynamic single-player bullet heaven game where you face thousands of enemies, build destructive structures, develop your character to return as an even more powerful machine of destruction and survive waves of enemies.

title: Records of the Flycatcher
description: The empire of Hadria has turned its war machine against the vulnerable eastern hinterlands of Altheim. With only your sniper rifle on your back, and a few strips of rabbit meat in your pocket, you must defend the motherland and wage a lone guriella war against the overwhelming tide of invaders.

title: Dashpunch
description: After the Tyrant Hand is stolen by a mysterious figure, an ancient being awakens to return it to its rightful place before it's too late. Dash and Punch your way through corrupted dungeons that fall apart at the seams, meet colorful characters, battle powerful bosses and carve your legacy!

title: Reaper's Odyssey
description: In this immersive and tactical Medieval SRPG, you play as a child born as a Reaper as they are being hunted by the Empire. Every choice impacts the story, and who you are, and how others view you. 12 different unique job classes to choose from with many different outcomes. Find your destiny.

title: Trainee Death Simulator
description: You will play as a Trainee Death, harvesting Souls to pay off your debt. Random choice events offer you various options: Lie in bed and slack off since the debt is endless anyway, Or follow your senior to earn some extra Souls, collecting outfits to switch up your style.

title: Nova: Space Armada
description: An exceptional sci-fi strategy game based on space adventure as its core.

title: Bygg båtar med Mulle Meck: Specialversion
description:
This port is a customised version of the original sponsored by the Swedish company Hemglass.

Some items are already available, and the whole map is discovered from the beginning. As such the the pieces gotten from certain quests will be missing due to this. The compass part is missing and makes some areas compleletly inaccessible. A new icecream kiosk is added which is Hemglass branded.

Any extra downloadable content that was available form the developer's homepage do not work in this version.

title: Clockwork Rabbit
description: Tessa the bunny was hired at a textile factory as a mechanic. Create and program robots to solve logical puzzles.

title: Midnight Special
description: Welcome to 'Midnight Special,' a gripping point-and-click survival horror game that pays homage to 70s and 80s cinema. The game's story draws inspiration from giallo, slashers, and sci-fi classics, while the presentation is inspired by 90s 16-bit aesthetics.

title: Delta
description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

title: Heroes of Hammerwatch II
description: A rogue-lite that offers extensive persistent progression. Build your town, upgrade and equip your heroes, before taking on the the ever-changing Dark Citadel - either solo or with a team of friends.

title: Fate: Reawakened
description: Revisit the quaint town of Grove and the realms beyond as you prepare to enter the Dungeon Gate once again! The award-winning FATE series has gotten a modern facelift while remaining true to the nostalgic dungeon crawler classic.

title: Void Path
description: "Void Path" is a first-person horror game set in a residential area of ​​Japan. There are no grotesque monsters. You explore a town depicted with retro-style graphics.

title: Aurora Defense
description: A unique roguelike deckbuilder + base-building tower defense game. Build powerful defenses in the last bastion of light, fend off relentless waves of darkness, and protect the final goddess!

title: Guidus Zero
description: A real-time grid-based action roguelike game. Explore the sinkhole known as the "Scar" to search for spirits and treasure chests, and defeat the corrupted enemies and bosses as you strive to reach the deepest floor of the Scar, where the source of chaos awaits.

title: Cooking Madness
description: A cooking game with very different ingredients.

title: Port Town: Survival
description: A deserted port town, missing people, and a dark secret waiting to be uncovered… Dive into Port Town’s open world, collect mysterious photos, and reveal the truth. But be careful… some secrets are meant to stay buried.

title: Mini Mini Golf Golf
description: An indie storytelling experience that goes beyond the lanes of the here and now into distant memories of a future planetary collapse. Destabilize the present and plunge into a neon psychohistory of a bizarre entity in distress. This is not a game about minigolf.

title: Wandering Monolith
description: You are the Wandering Monolith, falling from the sky. Summon towers, expand the board, defend your core, and build your deck of upgrades to conquer countless worlds.

title: Carnival Massacre
description: Drawing heavily from classic survival horror tropes, Carnival Massacre takes players on a haunting quest in a cursed theme park. Explore your surroundings, manage your messy inventory, solve puzzles and kill the four ringleaders of the park.

title: Newspaper Day
description: Take on the role of a newspaper delivery person in a seemingly quiet neighborhood. Every morning, you carry out your job, delivering the day's news to your neighbors' doors. However, you soon realize that things are not what they seem.

title: Awaken Infinity
description: A top-down RPG with visual novel elements. Wake up in a futuristic room with no memory, and unravel the mysteries of your past.

title: Path of the Oxiflame
description: Path of the Oxiflame is a 3D sokoban-puzzle-adventure inspired by classic Team Ico games. It features multiple playable characters as well as numerous puzzle mechanics beyond the classic pushing of boxes.

title: Terrorbytes
description: Collect pellets to power the safe room and survive. Solve the mystery of how you were sucked into this haunted arcade machine, and escape.

title: Anode Heart: Layer Null
description: Isometric card battler RPG with a touch of virtual creatures, set in a futuristic, digital world, with over-the-top villains and a very shadowy plot.

title: Kawaii Neko Girls 2
description: Kawaii Neko Girls 2 - It's a relaxing anime puzzle game with cute kawaii hentai neko girls. Solve puzzles and collect all the pictures. Enjoy high quality artwork.

title: Artificial Nexus
description: Susan has woken up in a strange, coffin-like device, with no memory of who or where she is. Uncover the answers as you solve puzzles to escape the building in this sci-fi mystery investigation!

title: Crash Puzzle Hammer-San
description:
A full-fledged action puzzle game with simple controls!
A massive 300 stages!
Includes an edit feature to create your own stages!

title: Astrobotanica
description: Discover Earth 300 thousand years ago as an alien biologist. Utilize your expertise in botany to survive, grow plants, harvest crops, compose and brew tonics. Reveal hidden powers of unknown plants. Engage with primal humans, leaving your mark on the future of civilization.

title: Booger Booster
description: A game created for the GBJAM (GameBoy Jam). Control a character that looks like a radio active booger and try to find the exit to the maze, to confront a boss and complete the game.

title: Out of Touch!
description:
Out of Touch is a captivating story of friendship, trauma, and healing.

At its heart is our hero CJ, who reunites with his childhood friends after years apart for their final semesters of high school.

Unbeknownst to them, ancient entities, unfathomably old and with inscrutable motives, lurk in the shadows and threaten to take control of the group and their latent powers.

title: Brain Drain
description:
Brain Drain is a little cute-em-up with four zones in a long single level.

Each zone ends with it's own boss.

Get hit once and die.

title: RAWR: Little Hungry Dragon
description: RAWR is a little dragon STG made in 9 days for the #GBJam.

title: Dog Walking Adventures
description: Dog Walking Adventures invites players into a cozy casual experience where the simple joys of walking with a canine companion become an adventure in itself. Walk around and explore immersive environments, all while playing with your dog, completing quests and collecting items.

title: Second Stellar
description: Second Stellar is a horde roguelike that focuses on engaging gameplay and buildcrafting. Fight through swaths of enemies and powerful bosses as two characters simultaneously, wielding unique weaponry and discovering potent combinations in pursuit of the galaxy's many secrets.

title: Back Light
description: Back Light was made for the Game Boy Jam in about 4 days. In Back Light you play a kid up way past their bed time. You just want to play your game boy but this is before hand held gaming had back lights. So to increase you happy meter and score stand under a lit lamp. Make sure to keep your happy meter up and avoid your Mom to try and get the highest score!

title: Vetitum_VRC
description: Explore all the video tapes about the forest and the paranormal activities that happen, discover all the secrets by controlling who records these videos in a first person experience. Do not watch the video too many times, there is something strange about it.

title: Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner
description: A broke young man takes on the night shift at a roadside diner. In the glow of the blood moon, routine tasks turn into a fight for survival. First-person horror based on a dark creepypasta with a set of rescue rules.

title: Uncle Chuck Incorporated
description: In 2005, the robotics entertainment company Uncle Chuck Inc. mysteriously declared bankruptcy. As an investigator, your mission is to infiltrate their abandoned headquarters, solve puzzles, and find a hidden VHS tape revealing the truth, all while evading the dangerous animatronic characters.

title: Moonfrost
description: Moonfrost is an isometric, next-gen pixel art, lo-fi multiplayer life-sim set in a fantasy version of the modern day that offers a premium experience but as a free-to-play game.

title: Fantasy Aquarium
description: Fantasy Aquarium offers an effortless way to enhance your gaming experience. You can nurture a diverse range of small fish with unique characteristics and construct a vibrant fantasy world from scratch, transforming mundane fish-keeping into an engaging pursuit.

title: Incremental Dice
description: Chill incremental game about dice making money. Upgrade your dice to make more money, to upgrade your dice to make even more money!

title: Pit of Gerstan
description: Pit of Gerstan is a roguelite dungeon-massacring action game. Hack, slash, throw and blast your way through hordes of enemies and bosses, as you collect various items, upgrades and weapons to create the ultimate dungeon-clearing hero.

title: Ragdoll Training Center
description:
Ragdoll Training Center is a physics based arcade game where you push a ragdoll character through the challenging maps to reach the finish.
Compete for thousandths of a second differences with other players in global ranking.
Create your own maps in Map Editor and try maps made by other players.

title: Retail Mage
description: Welcome, Retail Mage, to your first day of employment at MageMart! Get 5 star reviews from customers before the store closes. Say and do (almost) anything in this open-ended, creative co-op game!

title: Sports Girl: Village
description: Lucy is a sporty girl, this time she comes to a deserted village, in order to obtain the ancient magic, restore the girls who have been petrified by the spell, she needs to find 18 objects to make magic. There are 24 beautiful girls waiting to be rescued.

title: Obsolete: After the Accident
description: Obsolete: After the Accident, centers around a young girl who experienced a serious traumatic event, which ended in the death of her father leading to her exploring a broken pizzeria and having to survive 3 broken down animatrics

title: Lovish
description: Lovish is an outrageous 8-bit action-adventure game! Quest with Sir Solomon through a series of bite-sized rooms, as he attempts to free Princess Tsuna, the woman he loves, from the Devil Lord's clutches!

title: Monster Lover 2: Ambrosilas
description: He's a Failure of a Yakuza. He's an Arcane Murder Genie - Can They Find Love? Our main character has been a screw-up his entire life. That's what led him to the Yakuza. He needs help, and summons Ambrosilas. But this sexy murder genie doesn't like helping criminals!

title: Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre
description: Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre is a 2D action platformer with a real focus on speed, Tarantino-style violence, and a wicked grapple feature that lets ya zip around like an acrobat, eh! This is a prequel chapter for Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada, and the full game’s gonna have, like, five times the content of this demo, buddy! So buckle up, ‘cause you’re in for a wild one, don’tcha know!

title: BMPES
description: BMPES is a Brazilian mod for PES 2021 that adds new content such as teams, stadiums, and competitions, while also providing frequent player roster updates.

title: Silk: A Leo Parker Adventure
description: Silk is part puzzle game, part adventure, part graphic novel. Search Sir Francis’ home for clues, meet diverse characters, retrace Sir Francis’ steps and locate the ancient palace of a long dead Ming empress. Silk is by far our biggest adventure yet!

title: The Patient
description: Dr. Ellen Reed returns to work as a therapist only to discover an inpatient has been mistakenly dosed with a deadly mutative drug. With hospital records erased due to a power outage, she must work overnight to identify and discreetly euthanize the affected patient before it's too late.

title: Intelligent Strategy Games Volume 1
description:
A collection of classical board games which includes:

- Backgammon
- Draughts
- Gomoku
- Chinese Chess
- Bridge

title: Intelligent Strategy Games Volume 2
description:
A collection of board games including:

- Renju
- Reversi (mis-labeled as Othello on the box)
- Chess
- Four-in-a-Line
- Go

title: Cigo
description: Student adventure punk game

title: The Ghost of Redstone Manor
description: A first-person mystery game with puzzles and story-rich dialogue. Explore a 3D environment with original art, character design, and a distinct cartoon-y style. Investigate your own murder through branching conversations and a unique possession mechanic. Featuring original music by Svetlana Rudenko.

title: Dungeon Gore: Lost Treasury
description: Dungeon Gore is a FPS, strategy, and stealth horror game where you explore the dungeon and collect enough ancient treasure and escape with your findings.

title: Requiem For a Lost World
description: Requiem For a Lost World is a singleplayer/co-op roguelite bullet-hell game combining the fun of destroying thousands of enemies with unique builds and a pleasing stylized anime graphics. Unlock new characters, collect powerful weapons and create synergies with elemental reactions!

title: Rusty the Rooster
description: "Rusty the Rooster" is a captivating 2D pixel art platformer where players join Rusty, a brave rooster, on a heroic quest to rescue his girlfriend and unborn chicks. With its charming graphics and heartwarming storyline, this game offers an unforgettable adventure of courage and love.

title: Lost Friends Adventure
description: This is a platformer game with multiple controllable characters that can be played by one or more players in split screen mode and you will need these characters to solve many puzzles and defeat some enemies in this game to progress through the levels and move around the map.

title: Lost in the Mirrors
description: Enter a mysterious mirror maze. Your cleaning job becomes a survival game as darkness falls. Mirrors reflect your fears, creating eerie illusions. Grasp your cleaning tools and wipe away stains - it's your only escape route. Clear all stains to flee this maze. Dare to face "Lost in the Mirrors"?

title: Rosttle
description: "Battle Roosters" is a solo-developed 2D top-down shooter where players must survive each round by collecting yellow energy dots on the field, navigating map obstacles, and employing various tactics to vanquish monsters, earn coins, and secure rewards.

title: 9 Days
description: You have 9 days before the final fight. At your current state, you do not stand a chance! Explore this Open World to gain new skills and abilities for the battle. Choose where you go, what you do carefully. You cannot waste time! You have 9 days.

title: Gullet
description: Gullet is a tension-fueled psychological horror game in which you will rappel down into and explore a colossal mouth post-rapture and control how quickly you descend by how tightly you squeeze your left hand brake in real life and in the game.

title: AmaZoo
description: AmaZoo is a progressive and varied puzzle game, inspired by the classic video game Sokoban, but presented in side-view, like the old classic 2D games. In this game, you can solve a multitude of puzzles and put your logical mind to the test, moving and organizing different types of boxes to reach the exit and progress to the next stage. But be careful— some boxes are fickle, and watch your step!

title: Familiar Stranger
description: The Familiar Stranger is a 3D psychological horror game where twisted memories and nightmares blur. Uncover dark secrets while evading a relentless entity that watches from the shadows. Can you escape the horrors of the past, or will they consume you?

title: Messticulous
description: Aim and throw incongruous objects to create an organized mess by following the directives of a completely wacky "tidy up" system!

title: Exclusive Memory
description: Three Days of Crisis: Exclusive Memories "is a suspenseful love story full dynamic live action interactive video game. The whole game is a process of exploration and puzzle solving, in which you will delve into a complex and mysterious story. Collect clues through interactions with different characters, solve puzzles, and gradually uncover the truth hidden behind them

title: The Exit Project: Backstreets
description: You are trapped in an endlessly repeating place that looks ordinary at first glance. Observe your surroundings carefully, identify subtle anomalies, and make the right choices to escape the loop.

title: Survivor's Dawn
description: Survive in a challenging 2D zombie game! Face hordes of the undead, earn money by defeating them, and buy upgrades to increase your health, ammo, and more. How far can you go?

title: I've Fallen For You!
description: Eight women simultaneously appear in your life, offering you unconditional love and support! Will you choose to uphold your beliefs and become a good man, or give in to human temptations and become a bad man?

title: Cult Of Blood
description: Cult of Blood is a survival horror adventure that combines cinematic storytelling with modernized classic gameplay. Fixed camera angles, dramatic cutscenes and refined tank-style controls create a tense, atmospheric experience where survival hinges on every decision. Fans of classic survival horror will feel right at home.

title: SWAT Commander
description: In SWAT Commander you take charge of an elite special forces unit. Issue orders to your squad, manage its members and their equipment, but most importantly – complete your objectives successfully. Follow your operatives into a number of high-risk missions that will test your tactical abilities.

title: Bubbits
description: Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter. Perfect for casual and competitive players alike! Compete in a 25 Player Battle Royale, Play VS with friends or go Solo. Customize your Playfield, unleash Power Ups and experience crazy battle events that shake up the game!

title: Catch the Sperm
description: Catch the Sperm is a promotional game to raise awareness for HIV. The game was developed for the Stop AIDS campaign in 2001 (a joint prevention campaign by the Swiss Federal Ministry of Health and Swiss Aids Federation) in Switzerland. The player has to protect a couple having sex by shooting condoms at sperm cells and HIV viruses to catch them. The condom gun is located at the right side of the screen and can be moved up and down with the mouse, while sperm cells and HIV viruses are entering the screen on the left side. The goal is to catch as many sperm cells and HIV viruses as possible within 90 seconds. The game is immediately lost if a HIV virus reaches the other side of the screen. For each catch the player gets points, while each shot costs points.

title: Age of Castles
description: Age of Castles is a strategy game. Choose a character and reign over your people as prince, dwarf, wizard or warrior. Collect taxes, write laws and build a castle to fight dragons and enemy armies. 18 scenarios are included in the campaign.

title: Collection of Most Awful Things that Could Ever Happen on St. Valentine's Day
GatePass
description: A 2D platformer game with strong puzzle elements. Escape the 100-level labyrinth and return home safely.

title: Lab 77
description: The game you will love to make your friends play. In Lab 77 you play as Specimen S539-77, making your way through the challenges of Lab 77's test chambers under the supervision of the Director. Place versions of yourself to bridge gaps, collect lab notes, avoid dangers and complete your training.

title: Es
description: Es is an action game developed by 9thNight (Arthearts). The game was cancelled in 2007, having released only a Beta of the first two levels.

title: Buckshot to Hell
description: Russian roulette game where you can have fun with friends or compete with other people!

title: Bankiware
description: This game was created in a short period of time for the Touhou Game Jam 2024.

title: Cherry Jump
description: Cherry Jump is a 2D platformer where players race through levels, collecting cherries and aiming for the fastest completion time. The game features multiple paths, achievements to unlock, and various characters to discover. Players test their speed and skill in this fast-paced pixel art world.

title: Ao Oni R
description: The 'R' in Ao Oni R can stand for a lot of things - such as reboot, remake, or retelling, but at its core it is a labor of love. It is the Ao Oni experience everyone knows and loves, having been rebuilt from the ground up in RPG Maker VX Ace to expand upon the original games ideas while giving it a fresh coat of paint. New story elements and areas, graphics, music, sound, puzzles, expanded character backgrounds as well as multiple endings exist in Ao Oni R while still keeping the principles of the original, such as a low amount of dialogue when possible and the possibility of a fast play through.

title: Temehuatzl
description: A morning stroll through a slightly hazy, partially flooded jungle temple.

title: The Witch of the Wake
description: The Witch of the Wake is a seafaring supernatural horror/thriller visual novel inspired by media such as The Thing, The Terror, and Return of the Obra Dinn.

title: Anomaly Tapes: Beyond Reality
description: Uncover the truth in '[ANOMALY TAPES]: Beyond Reality'. Navigate through haunting levels, survive deadly anomalies with unique mechanics, and piece together a chilling mystery hidden within the tapes. Dare to uncover the secrets?

title: Paraedolon
description:
A short experimental experience.

A meteor approaches Earth from deep space. Carrying an unknown malevolent force.

title: Captain of the Guard
description: You have been charged with the defense of a new settlement in a hostile land. Prepare your guards and send them into battle against the horde of creatures that stalk the wilderness. As time passes and the settlement grows, so do the threats that you face.

title: Garden Snap
description: A relaxing game where you can remove alien plants to restore the forest. No quests or enemies, just relaxing. You can also change the weather if you prefer rain. Alternatively, you can also just walk around in nature in a peaceful forest.

title: ­Into the Deep Dark Green Sleep
description: A story woven with the sound of rain, poetic text, and gentle narration... A short visual novel where you can spend a relaxing moment in your own place, with time to yourself, where no one will disturb you, no one will come barging in. It could be a small, secretive café.

title: Cute Bless
description: Cute Bless is a game where cuteness is deceptive. Defeat various bosses to try to fill your emptiness. Or simply wander through the cities trying to find an explanation for the cuteness around you.

title: GladMort
description: In a faraway kingdom in a land of legend, a mysterious plague of unknown origin has rapidly infected the population. Dubbed the "Red Plague", the evil nature of the phenomenon is unmistakable: the dead begin to rise from their graves, and demonic incarnations begin to appear.

title: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
