description: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

title: Glow Up 2
description: Glow up the characters for each of the 9 stages, Units are divided into red and blue teams for auto-battle. Click to predict the winning team. If you guess right, you will be able to see the whole of the characters that have been Glow up.

title: Golf In Wonderland
description: Dive into a fantastical adventure where sport and fantasy come together in a world as delirious as it is enchanting. Welcome to "Golf in Wonderland," a unique golf game that transports you to the heart of the wonderland.

title: Anomalia O Despertar
description: Titan Tech was a factory known for creating machines that advanced humanity, but it was suddenly shut down with the disappearance of several employees. When you wake up you will come across machines that will try to catch you, Be smart and survive, death will be the least of your worries.

title: Seekers of Darkness
description: Dive into "Seekers of Darkness," a thrilling deck-building roguelike RPG with intense card battles and tower defense RTS elements. Unlock powerful characters, build unique strategies with over 70 cards, and compete in offline rankings. Burn enemies, freeze them, or overpower with weapons. Enjoy!!

title: Candy Golf
description: Minigolf game. 3 different levels with totally 42 holes. Play alone or against bots

title: TeleMorpher
description: "Telemorpher" is a high-tech weapon that can shoot teleportation spheres. With it, you can teleport to the sphere's location. Your sole objective is to use this gun to escape from the mysterious laboratory!

title: Entombed
description: You wake up in the middle of the night. The lights are all off and something feels off. You grab your flashlight and try to figure out the source of this anomaly. However, you grow hungry and head to the kitchen where things start to go horribly wrong.

title: HighKing
description: Use your mouse to climb the mountain. The road is very steep and long. But don't worry. You can use your arms and legs for this climb.

title: Goner In The Town
description: Goner In The Town” is a 3D FPS RPG game in which players explore a section of a city cut off from another world and fight enemies by switching between four different guns. The game takes place in the present day,

title: Mindbreak Mansion
description: Enter the enigmatic world of Mindbreak Mansion, where puzzles and mysteries await around every corner. Solve intricate challenges, unlock hidden secrets, and unravel the mysteries of this captivating adventure. Will you escape the mansion's grasp, or succumb to its mind-bending allure?

title: Mytho Duel
description: It's an adaptation of the classic card game "Triple Triad" for an interactive in-menu experience. This game offers engaging and strategic gameplay, allowing players to challenge their own strategic planning skills.

title: Take Off Mask
description: is a strategic action RPG where you can enjoy dozens of unit battles. Exploration and combat can reveal the secrets of the mysterious world, find hidden colleagues, and challenge the wider area. challenge the Devil of the North with the best combat power.

title: Carsh
description: Carsh is a battle royale game where you drive a car and play a puzzle game at the same time. Enjoy the most heated battles you have ever experienced.

title: Warp Speed: Infinity
description: Put your reflexes to the ultimate test with this unique arcade-style racing game: Warp speed: Infinity. Make your way through space at incredible speeds while dodging asteroids and space junk. Unlock a variety of different ships with unique features and handling by reaching ever higher scores.

title: Constance the Barbarian
description:
Constance the Barbarian - A humourous take on Conan the Barbarian/Xena Warrior Princess, with a dash of Monkey Island.

Originally made for September 04 MAGS, and as a learning project. But decided to make it as a demo/teaser for a larger more involved game. I won't hazard a release date at this point. I'm mostly improving my artwork skills.

title: Gravitational Phenomenon
description: IN THIS 3D ARCADE PLATFORMER GAME AN UNKNOWN CATACLYSM HAS ROCKED THE EARTH THE LAWS OF PHYSICS NO LONGER APPLY YOU MUST DESCEND THROUGH THE WRECKAGE Back to the OLD WORLD, TO EARTH

title: Rover's Tale
description: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

title: Skeletos Sword
description: Skeletos Sword plunges players into a thrilling third-person sword battle against a legion of crazed skeletons.

title: The Father's Story
description: Set in the first century, The Father's Story is a visual novel which offers a different perspective of the Christmas Story and the events surrounding that night.

title: Key Fairy
description: A hand-drawn, pacifist, folkloric, bullet-hell. Grapple and dance around monsters to collect their shattered stars, weave your way through twisting paths, encounter strange folk, uncover ancient magic, and evade forgotten gods in this frenetic 2D action-adventure.

title: May's Journey
description: May's Journey is a 2.5D puzzle game where players use pseudo code to solve environmental mazes and learn programming basics, guiding protagonist May to restore balance in a fractured, fictional world.

title: Gold Lining
description: Gold Lining is a narrative platformer about a teenage girl who must find her way back home from a beautiful, fantastical realm. There, she relives her memories, revealing a touching story about understanding her mother and finding meaning in life’s imperfections.

title: Nightshift Nightmares
description: In Nightshift Nightmares, navigate a night of horror in a mysterious asylum. Follow eerie rules, avoid dark entities, and uncover secrets to survive until dawn. Will you escape, or succumb to the nightmares?

title: Pepe's Revenge
description: A sci-fi themed FPS (Frog and Pepe Shooter). Wave after wave of amphibian-based mayhem. Choose your weapon and put those stinkin' frogs in their place. Git Gud, scrub

title: Evershire
description: Discover the ever-growing lands of Evershire. A cozy, minimalist strategy builder that encourages creativity and offers a challenge to those looking for one. Decide whether you want to create and decorate your own worlds in creative mode or try your hand at managing resources. The choice is yours.

title: Pizza Boy Z
description: Pizza Boy Z is 3D runner game, where you play for ordinary pizza delivery person who has become an unusual hero.

title: Dice of Arcana
description: Dice of Arcana is a wicked roguelite dice game. Survive a blood-drenched trip on a caravan led by a malevolent puppet. Bet your fingers, break the rules with special dice, face major arcana and prevail: losing means death.

title: Artificial Division
description: Online co-op dystopian casual shooter game with some cyberpunk wibe that has some plot in it. A few quest lines that can be completed solo or with friends.

title: Ascension to Bheaven
description: If you want a very smooth challenge try to beat this game. I know that you can't even reach the top of the first level.

title: Miniparty
description: Play against your friends in a group up to 4 Players or as a single player to beat your highscore. Either in a LAN Party or alocal in couch co-op mode. GAMES: Football, Car race, Tennis, Sprint, Parkour, Collect-it, Tower Defense

title: Reflex on Go!
description: Get ready for endless fun with Reflex on Go! This 2D platformer game challenges you to jump your way to a high score. Take on the platforms and try to beat your own record, but beware - one misstep and it's game over! Keep your reflexes sharp and challenge yourself in Reflex on Go.

title: Piggly Pagly Boom
description: Can you master this red-hot fireball platform shooting game? Save the world or get turned into roasted ham!

title: Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau
description: Time to fight back against the spirits! Play as an exorcist with firearms and purge unlawful spirits to solve the mystery of the Saiga village invasion in Nara!

title: Wallsurf
description: Wallsurf is a game that combines elements from CS:GO's Surf minigame, Jumps, and the beta release of Karlson. This game is a fast paced 3D racer based on the movement mechanic of sliding down walls.

title: The Paddock
description: Stop a carnivorous dinosaur from breaking out into the wild. Use CCTV surveillance throughout their night shift to watch over the dinosaur, electrocuting it whenever it gets too close to the fences. During the day, explore the map unravelling the mystery of how the dinosaur ended up in the woods.

title: The Backrooms, The Way Back Up
description: This is an FPS game where you are at level 0 which is the first level in Backrooms. It's your job to find the way out past aggressive creatures and men in protective overalls who will stand in your way and prevent you.

title: Nova Era: Atom
description: Welcome to the first trailer of Nova Era: Atom, Welcome to Nova Era: Atom, a sci-fi MMORPG game blending Chinese mythology. where you can DIY your own custom spaceship and explore the endless mysteries of the cosmos.

title: Last Story: Dungeon
description: Explore a mysterious dungeon in this 2D platformer, uncovering the secrets of Drystan and his missing parents. With stunning visuals and an engaging soundtrack, get ready for a challenging and mystery-filled experience.

title: Alien Outpost
description: Alien Outpost an adrenaline-pumping 2.5D twin-stick shooter places you at a remote outpost besieged by relentless waves of alien invaders

title: Robot Battle
description: Robot Battle is a sci-fi action game. Players need to use random items to fight enemies in random levels, survive as much as possible, and finally find a way to escape from this planet. The rougelike elements of this game make each adventure completely different for players.

title: Corpse58
description: "CORPSE-58" is a slow-motion bullet hell shooting game by UnderDoor. Players become human weapons created through clone and genetic engineering technologies, tasked with destroying former allies turned into 'corpses'.

title: Time to Go
description: Guide Angus or Lucy through a maze of tunnels in their search for food. Watch out for bad foods and dodge the obstacles in your path.

title: That Level Again 3D
description: Embark on a mind-bending journey through 3D puzzles inspired by the cult classic series. Explore unique mechanics and conquer challenging levels in this innovative twist on the original concept.

title: Meowstro
description: You are a cat with a piano and synthesizer made just for you! Meowstro is designed to be a versatile MIDI interface, allowing you to play using MIDI inputs and outputs. Humans can also interact with it using a standard PC keyboard.

title: Eternal Cocoon
description: Eternal Cocoon is a horror adventure game centered around Olivia, a girl whose boundaries between reality and dreams are blurred. Olivia must choose her own destiny while avoiding danger and an onslaught of monsters to uncover her truth.

title: Finishline
description: A driving simulator that helps you reconsider your life choices

title: Thor's Breakout
description: Immerse yourself in a thrilling Breakout adventure with 20 unique levels that challenge your reflexes, strategy, and endurance. Each level is meticulously designed and features creative obstacles that provide hours of fun. Are you ready to take on the challenge and master every surprise?

title: Cornelius Cat in: The Uncontrollable Pest
White Heaven
description: Canceled sequel to the 2012 Adventure-Horror game 'Anna.' White Heaven was to take place in an abandoned hotel nestled in the Italian Alps, eponymously titled White Heaven. Its narrative focuses on a kidnapped victim escaping his captivity after having fallen in love with one of his captors. The game was to follow three playable characters while continuing to explore the backstory of its predecessor rather than serving as a direct continuation. Early footage showcased chase sequences, which weren't attempted in the developer's previous work. The game was announced in 2013 and was being created in Unreal Engine 4 with an additional extension to aid with dynamic lighting. In 2020, its developers announced a cancelation of this iteration of the game, as they felt it to be "too much, too soon" in terms of the story they were attempting to tell.

title: Eternal League
description: In Eternal League, you'll embark on an epic journey through a fast-paced roguelike RPG that combines customization, strategic combat, and a unique session-based progression system that rewards your skill and creativity.

title: The Devil's Bride
description: Run from The Devil’s Bride, where you must outwit and escape from the clutch of the Devil’s Bride to save your niece, Nina. Solve challenging puzzles while hiding from the relentless Devil’s Bride in the world of Indonesian cult horror experience.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 1.2 - Tour de Inferno
description:
Version 1.2 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:

• New Characters: Caesar and Burnice
• New Main Story Quest: Chapter 4 - Tour de Inferno
• New Events
• ...and more!

title: Pakapow Party
description: Pakapow Party is an online board game for 1–4 players, where you’ll go on an adventure to protect villages from invading monsters and explore strange, unpredictable stories. You could end up becoming an ultrarich tycoon but beware, your teammates might just turn you into a poor wanderer

title: RailGods of Hysterra
description: Embark on a co-op survival journey for 1-5 players through a post-apocalyptic Lovecraftian world! Command and evolve a living, monstrous train, craft weapons, build a mobile base, gain powers, and face the Great Old Ones. Explore an ever-changing world, hold on to your sanity, and ascend to godhood!

title: Criminalist
description: You are a criminalist. A man has been murdered, and you've been sent to investigate. Explore the crime scene, gather clues, and solve the mystery in this amateur point-and-click adventure.

title: Tom Hanks is in: Jeopardy!
description: Can you save the world from Tom Hanks?

title: Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator
description: Transform your passion into profit with Hydroponics Farm & Store Simulator! Design, build, and manage your own sustainable hydroponics system. Experiment with different plants and fish, customize your setup, and harvest your success. Dive into the future of farming today!

title: Caravanners
description: Design your dream caravan in detail, roam freely with your mobile home, set up your camp with friends, and enjoy music by the campfire in a vast open world!

title: Puke the Pirate: Rebarfed
description:
The grossest pirate is back with a brand new remake of Puke the Pirate!
Revisit Spatter Island and collect as much of Black Barf's treasure as you can!

title: Dunebound Tactics
description: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

title: Cryptid Time
description: Follow Tiên through the forest as she meets her old cryptid friends for the last time.

title: Dreamless
description: In a remote provincial town, teenagers mysteriously disappear every 25 years. You're a high school student about to turn 18... But what if you become the next victim?

title: Cronos: The New Dawn
description: Cronos: The New Dawn is a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game that throws you into the heart of a deadly struggle against overwhelming foes, all while uncovering the mysteries of a twisted time travel story.

title: Blindfire
description: Blindfire is the first FPS game set in complete darkness. Rely on your insincts to eliminate your opponents. It's either hunt or be hunted... Ready to light 'em up?

title: Subnautica 2
description: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

title: Mistfall Hunter
description: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

title: The Legend of Baboo
description: Young Sepehr and his loveable dog, Baboo, set off on a harrowing quest to save their family from the mystical forces of an ancient evil. Embark on an action-adventure, story-driven journey and explore a vast, magical world caught in a battle between light and dark.

title: FBC: Firebreak
description: FBC: Firebreak is a 3-player cooperative first-person shooter set within the enigmatic Federal Bureau of Control (FBC). As the Bureau’s headquarters faces a deadly and prolonged siege by otherworldly forces, only Firebreak—its most adaptable response unit—has the skills and courage to restore order.

title: Hound: Automaton
description: In this hyper-realistic multiplayer horror game, one player starts as The Hound, while up to 15 players are human survivors trying to hide. Navigate through hyper-realistic environments, and experience the ultimate survival horror experience in multiplayer.

title: Bad Cheese
description: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation. Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

title: Shine On, My Little Sun
description: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

title: Poker Train
description: Poker Train is a video poker game where you must play scoring hands to keep the wheels turning. Use your best combinations to build steam and run the train as far as you can. Complete quests and find all the secrets the railroad has to offer!

title: Résop Paz Yandere True
description: Cute horror choice game with a lot of varied gameplay, from bloody battles to platforms. Come break the fourth wall that separates us! Choices that have real impacts, charming characters, a blend of retro and realistic video games. Come meet Résop and Paz.

title: Max Payne 2: Mona the Assassin
description: It's a fan made mission for Max Payne 2. It follows Mona on a mission to assassinate a character. It has very few levels.

title: Blips
description: Blips is a remake of the dos bips game made by Bryant Brownell, its a sokoban style puzzle game but with exploding dynamite and collecting coins

title: Super Mario Bros: Dual Dash
description: Play as both Mario and Luigi at the same time as they go on a journey to defeat Bowser and Wart!

title: Super Mario Subpop
description: Play as Mario in a submarine, and move up and down while shooting enemies!

title: SpaceSoldier3D
description: Wolfenstein inspired game by André Schnabel

title: CommanderTux
description: Short platformer game by André Schnabel

title: Steinkraft
description: Minecraft inspired game by André Schnabel

title: Mint Dodgers
description: Mint Dodgers is a simple game where this weird world that you're stuck in doesn't want you there! Dodge falling and flying mints, toxic rain, rocks, spikes, and so much more to come. Are you able to stick around long enough to defeat King Mint?

title: Okayu Nyumu!
description: One fateful day, our protagonist chanced upon a strange cat. A stray cat with a beautiful lavender coat and an empty stomach. Our protagonist decided to share the rice ball he was holding with the cat. Get ready for a heartwarming story about living with Nekomata Okayu!

title: Pokémon Lost Silver
description: Pokémon Lost Silver is a Pokémon fan game based on the creepypasta of the same name created by reidd. The game is a recreation of the haunted game from the original creepypasta story.

title: Gregory Horror Show Soul of Roses
description: Soul of Roses is a 2D rogue light action game. Absorb the abilities of your enemies, fight, die, revive, and repeat to advance the story.

title: SCP: Mystery Man
description:
Dive into the enigmatic world of "SCP - The Mystery Man," an Alternate Reality Game (ARG) that blurs the lines between reality and fiction. In this immersive experience, you become the investigator, unraveling the secrets of the SCP Universe through a series of intricate puzzles and cryptic clues.

In "SCP - The Mystery Man," you will explore a rich narrative by decoding messages, solving riddles, and scouring the depths of the internet for hidden information. Clues are scattered throughout the game in various forms—text, images, and videos—all carefully designed to guide you deeper into the mystery.

Your mission is to track down the elusive Mystery Man, piece together fragments of evidence, and unveil the dark secrets that lie beneath. Use the in-game note-taking feature to keep track of your discoveries and insights, helping you connect the dots in this complex investigation.

Every clue brings you closer to the truth, challenging your wit and determination. Whether you’re interpreting a cryptic message, analyzing a suspicious image, or deciphering an obscure video, each piece of the puzzle is vital to your success.

Are you ready to immerse yourself in the shadowy depths of the SCP Universe and uncover the mysteries that await? Embark on your investigative journey with "SCP - The Mystery Man" and see if you have what it takes to solve the enigma.

title: Worker 42
description: Worker 42 is a single-player first-person exploration game. Use your scanner to find your way in the interstellar darkness of space. Repair the various systems of the station, complete your tasks and return to Earth. But something seems wrong on this planet.

title: Plerbtonia
description: Plerbtonia is a Plutonia megawad featuring 32 relatively short, difficult maps intended to be played pistol-start.﻿ Most of the maps are done by Plerb, with a couple guest maps from RiviTheWarlock and OverflowingMocha.

title: Yogoe Hunter
description:
Embark on a roguelike text adventure game journey through Eastern legends!
Intense battles with mythical creatures recorded in history and a variety of choices leading to multiple endings await you.

title: Exit Terminal
description: Could you Exit Terminal?

title: Paragnosia
description: Observe every corner of your apartment by moving your camera along a rail that runs through the rooms. Find and take pictures of paranormal anomalies to exorcise them. Locked in your surveillance room, will you survive tonight's 8 rounds?

title: Grave Filler
description: A graveyard themed, suika style puzzle game.

title: Deepest Depth
description: uncover the deepest secrets of the ocean and go into a sea hole to see with your very own eyes what lies in the deepest depths

title: Imp Dreams
description: Doom Guy goes to the therapist says he's been counting imps to fall asleep.

title: Otherplane
description: Otherplane is a 1-4 player ghost horror escape room game

title: BugDive
description:
You are falling down a giant hole and you have to collect bugs!
Created for the Ludum Dare 48. Please enjoy the funny bug game (:

title: BugDive Deluxe Demo Edition
description:
BugDive Deluxe is a game/interactive comic all about finding bugs. Despite being called Demo Edition, this is just BugDive 2!
Featuring 8 bugs across 40 stages, funny Comic Cat, and some other funny things (:

title: Thorny Times
description: You will have to gather an army, explore vast strategic maps, learn spells and capture castles. Defend the royal throne in battles against enemy knights, sorcerers and evil beings.

title: RetroRealms Double Feature: Halloween + Ash vs. Evil Dead
description: Step into a 16-bit Pixel Art world filled with gory good fun as horror legends Michael Myers and Ash Williams! Slice and shoot your way across multiple levels of terrifying platformer action filled with familiar sights and sounds from the original “Halloween” film and the STARZ television series “Ash vs Evil Dead!” Test your skill, use your weapons, and confront twisted and fiendish versions of iconic characters in two separate games that can be connected for even more fun. Engage in epic, heart-pounding encounters to overcome the ultimate evil in this sprawling adventure filled with over-the-top terror!

title: Alien Ship Console
description: Alien Ship Console is an atmospheric puzzle game with arcade elements, where you must navigate mysterious interfaces aboard an alien spacecraft. Explore the buttons and levers, solving unique challenges posed by an unknown alien civilization.

title: Ex Terra
description: Lock and Release! A PICO-8 caravan shmup. Reach the core. Defend the Earth!

title: A Koopa's Adventure
description: Play as a Koopa and retreat into your shell to kill Goombas and smash bricks!

title: Super Mario Bros: Fierce Days
description: Bowser has taken over some islands in the Mushroom Kingdom. He then set up lots of forts. Mario received a letter telling him about the forts. Can you crush all of the forts?

title: Bowser's Recruitment
description: A game starring Bowser! After Mario beats up all of your minions, you need to go on an adventure to collect new ones.

title: Present Panic
description: Mario forgot to bring Peach a gift for Christmas! Help Mario collect presents for Peach in this block pushing puzzle minigame.

title: Super Mario Bros: Shine Expedition
description: Is there a way to stop Bowser once and for all? Embark on a quest to collect shines so that you can use them all to permanently kick Bowser out of the Mushroom Kingdom.

title: Super Mario Bros: Bloody Battles
description: Bowser somehow got ahold of deadly weapons, and is using them to terrorize the Mushroom Kingdom, spilling blood everywhere. It is up to you to avenge the deaths of so many. Annihilate Bowser and his minions with all kinds of weapons.

title: Super Mario Bros: Seeking Sunshine
description: There was one night that for some reason has lasted for an unusually long time. Mario now must go on an adventure to collect the shines solving all sorts of puzzles on the way, and restore daylight to the Mushroom Kingdom.

title: Escape the Ghost House
description: Oh no! Luigi is trapped inside a ghost house. Can you escape before running out of time in this minigame?

title: Hello Winter Mario Games 2009
description: This winter game includes winter remakes of Super Luigi Paradise and Mario's Run. In addition to this, extra new levels have been added.

title: Super Mario Bros: Restless Reality
description: Many years have passed since the Mario Bros last defeated Bowser and stopped his plans for world domination. The Mushroom Kingdom enjoyed years of peace. Until one day... Bowser is up to no good again! He is invading the once peaceful kingdom, and setting up forts! What could he be planning!? Mario must travel through many different locations to find out what Bowser is up to and stop his evil plans!

title: Super Mario Bros: Mythical Mushrooms
description: There is a legend that tells of five mythical mushrooms of untold power. Mario sets off on a journey to collect these mushrooms in this challenging metroidvania platformer.

title: Yokai Busters
description: Yokai Busters is an indie fantasy J-RPG featuring a diverse cast of female characters. You'll find a police officer, a caring mom, a shrine maiden, and more! Explore the maps and have a blast battling with your favorite Japanese girls, and Yokai!

title: Super Mario Bros: Ztar Turmoil
description: A dark force has begun to sweep over the Mushroom Kingdom. Guns have been introduced into the world mysteriously, and are being used to bring about death and destruction. It is up to Mario (or Luigi) to save the Mushroom Kingdom from the Ztars.

title: Yoshi Tanks
description: In Yoshi Tanks, the aim of the game is to take out all of your opponent tanks, whether they are your friends, or AI controlled.

title: Super Mario Eclipse
description: The eclipse stars, a source of mythical powers, have been unleashed upon the world. As a result, the entire Mushroom Kingdom has been shrouded in the shadows of an everlasting eclipse. It is up to Mario to collect these stars, and save everyone from an eternal twilight.

title: Succubers! Dark Covenant
description: Succubers! Dark Covenant is an indie fantasy J-RPG featuring a diverse cast of female characters. You'll find nurses, nuns, housewives, and more! Explore the maps with your favorite characters and achieve your ultimate dreams!

title: Super Mario Dynamo
description: The people of the Mushroom Kingdom have finally embraced industrialization, and it is all thanks to everyone's favorite plumber, Luigi! Unfortunately, Luigi's greed got the best of him, and the entire kingdom became shrouded in darkness. The thick smog emanating from Luigi's accomplishments have darkened the once bright and colorful kingdom. It is now up to Mario to try and solve this dilemma!

title: Hello Fangaming Collection
description: Join Mario and Luigi on their adventure in this ten year anniversary collection! This collection includes an assortment of remastered levels handpicked from a wide variety of fangames released by Hello Fangaming between 2006-2016.

title: Super Mario Prism
description: The Sprixie princess has been trapped in one of the painting worlds! It is now up to Mario to rescue her by collecting the power stars to restore color to the paintings in this 3D platformer!

title: Mario Editor
description: With Mario Editor, it's easy to play, create, and share your very own custom Mario levels! Utilize a massive selection of powerups, enemies, items, and other goodies in your creations.

title: Night Shift Nurses
description: A washed-up mad doctor is hired back by a devious former test subject and asked to twist her hospital into a corrupt donation mill. Will he seize this second chance to practice his own vision of "science," or will his many failings drag him down once again in this pseudo-medical visual novel?

title: The Shroom Project
description: The zombie apocalypse is nigh! The world is in utter chaos, and death is commonplace. A malicious group is responsible for all of this destruction, and is busy at work on a dark scheme known as The Shroom Project. Play as one of two characters, join a rag tag team known as The Resistance, and fight back against a mysterious, yet, familiar face!

title: Break Wolf
description: An Adventure RPG that deals with the life and death of wayward humans, striving to escape a syndicate that creates monsters.

title: Alfred Hitchcock’s Psycho Adventure Game
description:
Alfred Hitchcock’s Psycho Adventure Game is a classic point and click game.

This game created by one single person is a short "9 verbs" point & click adaptation in pixel art inspired by the classic Alfred Hitchcock's Psycho movie. It reinterprets the iconic scene of the film.

It follows the scenario of the original movie adding some new features...

You have to resolve some puzzles to progress in the game. Talk with characters, interact with your environment, use your collected item...to unlock the next challenge.

title: Stars Era: The Final Defence
description: We will be the last guardian of the planet, here will be our final line of defense. The Clyde Star Spaceguard will fight to the last moment.

title: Revert
description: In Revert, use the time-manipulation powers granted to you by the Animal Spirits to solve over 40 puzzles in this puzzle-platformer. You start out with the ability to Save the state of the world, and Revert to go back to how it was. Solve puzzles with the world now reorganized! As you progress, unlock more time-manipulation powers to solve increasingly complex levels. Use your powers sparingly, and you’ll please the Animal Spirits.

title: Robo Dome
description: Compete in the famed Robo Dome championship as Rei Castor. Test your ability in this roguelite shoot em’ up against a barrage of enemies and projectiles. Face off against giant robots and other contestants in an attempt to come on top of this year’s Robo Dome championship in Valhalla City.

title: Wally the Seal 2
description:
The new entry in the Wally The Seal series arrives! You were able to escape the mazes last time, but your second go around won't be so easy!

In Wally The Seal 2, your objective is to find and collect 4 mysterious flowers from each of the levels. Use the new Salmon Radar to track the flowers while avoiding Wally The Seal and his partner Mrs. Wally.

title: Duake
description:
Gaming enthusiast and developer Magic Nipples has released Duake (Doom in Quake). It's a Quake mod featuring the main character (Doomguy) and the original Doom weapons.

"Run through the Quake campaign as Doomguy. It's that easy!" the project's creator explained in the description of the Duake mod.

In addition to the Doom Slayer, the first version of Quake in the Duake mod featured a full arsenal of weapons from Doom, as well as an original interface in two versions (classic and compact from Doom 64).

The mod's source code is published on GitHub. The mod's developer has promised to make further improvements to the project.

title: Whites This
description: A 4D maze game, that can help exercise those 4D brain cells.

title: Shrew
description: You are an Etruscan Shrew, the smallest mammal in the animal kingdom. The animal cave is rumored to hold your great grandpa’s treasure. And you’re going to find it.

title: Pizza Delivery Survivors
description: Experience the thrill of pizza delivery in a zombie apocalypse! "Pizza Delivery Survivors" combines survival, strategy, and fast-paced action. Deliver pizzas, outsmart the undead, and turn everyday items into weapons to fight for survival.

title: SL The Game
description:
SL The Game puts you in the role of managing the public transport in Stockholm, Sweden. The player is tasked with managing all traffic and the full budget within the inner city of Stockholm, by planning out the metro and busses.

The player can either start with a map without any public transport, or start with the network of 1997.

title: Pokémon Covenant
description: A life of poor decisions has led you to this moment, the moment where you commit your greatest transgression. In the final moment, you are saved by a mysterious figure and given a chance at redemption. Can you, with your memories wiped and true goal unclear, fulfil the terms of your unbreakable covenant and be born anew? You must traverse the ethereal land of Varia and overcome the seven Vices that represent the aspects of your shattered heart, endeavoring to collect the mementoes along the way that will allow you to piece together your forgotten past.​

title: Heretic's Fork: Abyssal Update
description: Abyssal Update brings a new OST DLC, New Desktop Customizations, New Character Variants, New Achievements and a new “Torment Mode”!

title: Heretic's Fork: The Savior's Descent
description: Heretic's Fork: The Savior's Descent update includes: Endless Mode Optimization; Torment Modifiers; Japanese Localization; Continue Shift to Endless Mode; Full Controller Support and New Music:

title: Half Billion: Love Choice
description: "Half Billion" is a surreal simulation business interactive game, where you will complete the entrepreneurial journey with a start-up capital of half billion. Six beauty enter your life. How will you balance the relationship? Note that "wealth" and "likability" will jointly determine the your story.

title: Half Billion: Love Choice - 2K DLC
description: After downloading, the game graphics can be upgraded to 2K high-definition picture quality

title: Fullbright Presents: Toilet Spiders
description: Eight Legs… Four Eyes… Limitless Terror!

title: Stunt Dog Adventure
description: The "Stunt Dog Adventure" is a thrilling retro inspired 2D side scrolling action game. Collect bones, solve puzzles, swim and fly to rescue a team of kidnapped All-Star Stunt Dogs!

title: Lolagame
description: Lola Game is a management and simulation game with an isometric perspective. It is a game commissioned by Granarolo, an italian multinational company that operates in the fresh milk and diary-cheese sector. It was released as a free-to-play game on their website alongside a prize competition. The goal of the game is to be able to produce 310 litres of milk every month from the best breed of cows. The player starts in march 2003 with just 3 brown cows, 1 bull and 950 euros.

title: Sea of Thieves: Season 14
description: Roguery rules the waves in Sea of Thieves Season 14: Making Mischief!

title: Fingun Forever!
description: In a horrible tragedy, Casino Karen and her army of giant anime waifus have kidnapped your girlfriend. Pilot Fingun once again and save the day!

title: Dicey Chess
description: A chess game in which the throw of the dice decides how far you can move.

title: Sweep Maidens
description: A Minesweeper game in which anime girls assist you. (◕ω◕✿)

title: Tinymon
description:
Tinymon RPG is based in an isekai world that resembles Japan. The natives here speak Japanese, however thanks to higher powers you're able to communicate with them in English. Although, if you so wish, you can enable settings from the in-game menu that let you experience parts of the game in Japanese (or romaji). These settings can be toggled on or off at any time, so players that want to turn Tinymon into a full-fledged learning experience can enjoy toggling these settings on at their own pace, as they become more comfortable with their Japanese skills (which you'll have opportunities to learn and practice in the game). Of course, you can leave all of these settings off, and experience the full game in English. Alternatively, you can toggle all of these settings on, and experience the game in complete Japanese.
Tinymon's world setting is greatly inspired by Japanese culture, meaning you can learn about the real world Japan. Thus, Tinymon provides for a laid back experience that focuses on exploration, and education of Japan's locations, customs, culture, and language (to those that are willing). We will even teach you how to use the trains system, some things you should avoid doing in Japan, and the first things you should do after landing in the Japanese airport! (Some of them even should be done before leaving the airport).

title: Dead Island 2: Ultimate Edition
description:
The Ultimate Edition contains the Dead Island 2 base game, plunging you into the heart of Hell-A, with intense zombie-slaying action, along with both epic story expansions: Haus and SoLA.

Unleash a new level of carnage with special weapons and stylish gear. Included in the Ultimate Edition you’ll find: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II pack, Memories of Banoi Pack, Golden Weapons Pack, Pulp Weapons Pack, Red’s Demise Pack, and each Slayer’s Premium Skin Pack.

title: 101 Cats in Australia
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Australia landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: Carpet Gallery
description: An endless walker with procedural scenery and objects.

title: Secret Cats: Halloween
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Halloween" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Secret Cats: Spooky
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Spooky" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Secret Cats: Haunted Mansion
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Haunted Mansion" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Dual Discovery: Unite Challenge
description: Unlike traditional hidden object games, "Dual Discovery: Unite Challenge" offers you an entirely new treasure-hunting experience! Each mission item is cleverly split into two parts, scattered throughout the picture.

title: Hidden Objects
description: Immerse yourself in the world of hidden object search! In this exciting game you will find many unique locations hand-drawn by the artist. The game will give you positive emotions.

title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange and Pumpkins: Spooky Halloween Edition
description: Celebrate Halloween night with cute capybaras with orange! Find all the hidden capybaras in their Halloween costumes and light up the town on this magical night. A fun-filled adventure awaits you!

title: 100 Hidden Cats: Kitty House 2
description: 100 hidden Cats "Kitten House 2" is a hidden objects/hidden creatures game. The player's task is to find one hundred cats (and one hundred rubber chickens) located on the map.

title: Kill All Lice
description: Play as the egocentric Captain Soepp and the sarcastic Lieutenant Xam'Pu in this wacky RFun & Gun to kill evil at its root by defeating the king of lice, Lous the First! Go solo or team up to stop the infestation spreading across Eloise's family! KILL ALL LICE is a proper soap opera adventure!

title: Doodle Cats
description: Welcome to a playful world of childhood memories! In this fun hidden-object game, your task is to find all the cats, carefully sketched as if by hand in your favorite drawing notebook. Good luck finding them all!

title: InoLab Trials
description: InoLab Trials is a multiplayer game where players compete in a series of skill-based trials, either solo or with friends. Customize your character, tackle challenges, and climb the leaderboards.

title: Art Detective: Hidden Through Ancient China
description: Unveil hidden wonders in masterpieces! Explore Qiu Ying’s iconic paintings with around 700 hidden objects. Relaxing, timer-free gameplay with hints, 6 hours of content. Discover art and mystery!

title: 101 Cute Playland Dogs: Find & Paint
description: Find the cutest dogs hidden in a beautiful hand-drawn illustration and express your creativity by bringing them to life with color! Enjoy a relaxing mix of hidden object and coloring.

title: Boobs Hidden Los Angeles
description: 100 Boobs in all shapes and sizes are waiting for you to be found on the sun-kissed shores of Venice Beach in Los Angeles!

title: Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush
description: Doodle Hunt: Halloween Rush is a thrilling seek-and-find game set in haunted, hand-drawn Halloween scenes. Explore eerie maps, uncover hidden spooky items, and bring them to life with glowing color! A magical Halloween adventure for all ages.

title: Alühn
description: Alühn is a classic 2D Point & Click adventure game which incorporates a verb GUI that resembles games like ZakMcKrackon or Monkey Island. The whole game is riddled with gags, crazy characters but also with a few tricky puzzles that need to be solved.

title: Chess 'n' Blocks
description: Have you ever considered playing Chess and Tetris simultaneously? Guess what? My strange brain did for years; I don't know why. But I finally took the time to create this game. And that's how chess 'n' blocks was born.

title: Crowded Mysteries 2: Winter Romance
description: Unleash your inner detective in Crowded Mysteries 2 Winter Romance, an icy sequel where winter's chill adds a thrilling twist to crime-solving. Have fun as you unravel mysteries, collect clues, and find out what love and broken hearts can make people do, in the snow-covered Mystery City!

title: Holy Shift
description: A short psychological adventure about decisions and choices that will change your future. A visual novel about how you ended up in purgatory and met a Succubus.

title: Orange Roulette
description: Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped to safer markets. Can he survive what his captors have freshly squeezed for him?

title: Dusttale: The Murderous Comedy
description:
A complete reimagining of dusttale. New bosses, new areas, many different endings and 3 routes.

The main difference from other dusttale takes, is that here your choices really matter, and even just killing everyone can be done in different ways. As well as giving up killing and getting a good ending. Also remember, Sans is not the main character in this comedy!

title: F.E.A.R.: MMod
description:
F.E.A.R.: MMod is about enhancing original game with more gore, new sounds, new effects and gameplay tweaks.

It follows MMod series approach; new effects, weapon replacements, lots of tweaks, gameplay tweaks, graphics enhancements, updated gore.

title: Moonlight Frog Inn
description: Moonlight Frog Inn is a simulation game where Titi, a frog who dreams of reaching the moon, runs an inn to make that dream a reality.

title: Doors More Doors
description: Doors Moor Doors is a puzzle-adventure game set in a mysterious underground facility filled with countless doors. Your mission is simple: escape. But finding your way out won't be easy. You'll need to search for items, solve puzzles, and make your way through complex environments, each with its own set of challenges. The game offers a variety of doors to unlock, each leading to new surprises or obstacles.

title: Soccer in a Box
description: "Soccer in a Box" is a soccer game that supports 2-8 players competing on the same stage. Use various dances to kick all the balls into the opponent's goal!

title: Pac-Athlon
description:
Compete in five different events with Pac-Man and co.!

Pac-Athlon is a minigame that was originally released in 1999 as part of a Japan-only CD-ROM release from Namco known as "Pac-Man no Desktop Daisakusen". This version is a fanmade remake built from the ground-up. It faithfully recreates every aspect of the original while also providing a few new things to play around with.

The Retro Mode covers the game with the classic pixel graphics of Pac-Man's arcade games and a heavy dose of Namco fanservice as you can select from a whopping 17 different characters! You can also compete with friends locally in the game's alternative multiplayer modes!

title: Rockman & Forte FC
description: A demake of Mega Man & Bass in 8-bit style.

title: Sonic Dynamo
description: An adventure-style Sonic fangame, focused on exploration.

title: Fear Effect
description:
It can recognize fear… can you?
Fear Effect, the pioneering cel-shaded cinematic action game, returns!

Immerse yourself in this intense thriller featuring revolutionary Motion FX technology where you direct your cast of 3D characters within dynamic, full-motion-video worlds. Who lives? Who dies? Only you decide if you can control your fear.

title: Death Note: Killer Within
description: Death Note: Killer Within is an online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Players will be split into two teams with different objectives. To win the game, players will need to figure out each other’s identities and either eliminate L who threatens Kira's power or seize the Death Note.

title: Tsunagari Chess School
description: A psychological horror game taking place in a Japanese chess school. Get to know the girls, go on dates, and prepare for the worst.

title: Air Force Missions
description: You will pilot an helicopter with your more or arrow keys. It is very easy to move, because though it is 3D, you can only move in 2D. Prepare yourself, because this is going to be a hard war. You will have to destroy the armies of ground, air and water weaponry. Your helicopter will be attacked by other helicopters, jeeps, jet fighters, aircraft carriers, battleships, and any kind of enemy. Water, desert, mountains,... all of them are dangerous and full of enemies to destroy.

title: Long Drive North
description: Explore and survive the harsh American wilderness in the Long Drive North. Drive and repair your trusty old RV, scavenge for parts, hunt and cook to survive; all alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. No zombies or monsters await – just an immersive driving-exploration-survival experience.

title: Christmas Hustle
description: Christmas Hustle is a Christmas-themed hidden object game. Help Santa's elves to pack the presents to their respective reindeers.

title: Geometry Shooter Pro
description:
Geometry Shooter PRO takes the exciting foundation of the original Geometry Shooter and cranks it up to the next level! Jump into this hand-drawn arcade game where precision meets action.

Fire from a moving cannon at expanding geometric shapes like circles, squares, and triangles, all while mastering the art of perfect shots and crazy combos.

In this enhanced version, experience brand-new PVP and CO-OP modes, where you can team up or compete with friends for the ultimate score.

No more game-overs after a single mistake! Now you have 3 lives to keep the fun going! Plus, discover bonus balls with unique effects that add new layers of strategy..

Whether you're a fan of the original or a new player, Geometry Shooter PRO promises even more challenging and exciting gameplay. Can you master the art of the perfect shot?

title: Click Mage
description: Click Mage is a 2D resource clicker and building game. Mine and process resources, upgrade your clicking power and construct buildings on an idyllic island with beautiful pixel art graphics.

title: Fast:Run
description: Fast:Run is an exhilarating, fast-paced running game that challenges your reflexes and speed. In this game, Your goal is to navigate through these obstacles as quickly as possible without crashing.

title: Deep Snow Delivery
description:
Humanity is on the brink of extinction due to a self-inflicted ice age. Navigate the frozen wastes in an ancient WW2 tank fitted with a storage bucket and claw arm. Collect and sell junk, make deliveries between underground settlements, navigate mountainous terrain, and buy upgrades to make your job easier.

Thousands like you have tried and failed to undo humanity’s mistakes. Will your story be different?

title: Farm Frenzy Prostokvashino
description: Fun farm. Prostokvashino is a spin-off from the Farm Frenzy series of games.

title: Lunchy
description: You find yourself conveniently in the Lunchy factory after closing, your stomach rumbles, you're hungry. Your tasked to craft your own Lunchy meal to satisfy your hunger and escape.

title: Tartaros
description: Jump into a retro-style puzzle adventure that tells the mythical story of Hades and Persephone. Play as Persephone and use magical powers to escape. Encounter mythological creatures, immerse yourself in atmospheric journey and find your way out of the underworld!

title: Mouselash
description: Mouselash is an action roguelite where you are the mouse cursor. Create your build by combining weapons and stats as you satisfyingly pop waves of enemies!

title: Becoming Saint
description: Choose your doctrine and preach across medieval Italy in this real-time strategy roguelike. Gather your diverse cast of followers, venture out to convince and convert new believers, conquer towns, and strive to become a saint in your lifetime — or die trying.

title: DZ & Riggy Vs. the Fantasy World
description: Two guys on one adventure for the third time.

title: Tuonela
description: Tuonela is a roguelike survival game where you will choose among many heroes and battle your way through the endless hordes of undead, demons and many other foes. Set in medieval times and using 90s graphical look. Venture deep in the savage realm of Nendhir alone or with your friends. Gain new powers, collect gold to unlock more heroes and descend down to the dark hellish realms of madness and despair.

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Lights, Camera, Pants!
description: When an episode of the popular series The New Adventures of Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy is supposed to be filmed in Bikini Bottom and nobody shows up to audition except for one yellow sponge, the show is put on hold. With the show in danger of being canceled, the show's producer, Gill Hammerstein, makes it SpongeBob's job to collect props and find actors for the show to go on.

title: Grisù Tales from Dragontown
description: Discover "Grisù Tales from Dragontown", the PC game for children that brings the adventures of Grisù from the TV series into your living room! With 4 intuitive challenges (Racing, Photoshooting, Recovery, Exploration) and original scenes, experience the emotions of Dragontown. Fun guaranteed!

title: The Children of Clay
description: The Children of Clay is a short stop motion archeology horror game, where you have to study an ancient artefact and discover its dark secret.

title: April 8th
description: In April, when cherry blossoms flutter through the air, a gruesome discovery is made—a blood-soaked corpse in a quiet town.

title: Onion Detective 2
description: The sequel to the acclaimed game "Lil Onion Detective"! Play as Detective Onion and solve all the crimes in your little town!

title: Disaster Blaster
description: Disaster Blaster is a roguelite bullet heaven card game where you play a questionably sane scientist building the most over-the-top weapon in the universe. Evolve your blaster’s card sequence and let it rip against hordes of alien enemies across a galaxy of unfortunate planets.

title: Nonogram Halloween
description: Use your logic to paint beautiful images in this relaxing puzzle. The gorgeous visuals and relaxing soundtrack will help you forget all your problems and have a great time!

title: Scribe
description: Scribe is a scribe simulator in which you can secretly shape the destinies of the inhabitants of the estate: resolve disputes, influence the course of family intrigues, decide who lives and who does not. Choose what to write in letters and whether to change their recipients!

title: Move Out Manor
description: A grid-based action puzzle game set in a haunted mansion. Wander halls, find keys, and pack up items while avoiding spooky ghosts. Move out quick, or you may become a permanent resident.

title: Treat-Seeking Tricksters
description: Explore the mysteries of a street which only appears after sundown on Halloween night! Get as much candy as possible by judging which houses have candy and avoid those which instead hide nasty tricks.

title: Bloody Rune
description: Turn-based single-stroke drawing roguelike deck-building game. Draw and use various runes to defeat all enemies and win the Rune War.

title: The Blackwood Legacy
description: A first-person puzzle horror game set in the eerie halls of Blackwood Manor. Solve intricate puzzles, unveil long-held secrets, and decipher the mystery surrounding your father's disappearance.

title: Khodam: The Contract
description: A True First-Person Psychological Horror game inspired by Indonesian folklore about the protective unseen spirit, 'Khodam.' Play as Dara, a famous Southeast Asian horror streamer, as she unravels strange anomalies and seeks to uncover her true identity.

title: WolfFang Skull Fang: Saturn Tribute Boosted
description:
The steel wolf running across the earth × the sonic corpse that buries its prey.
DECO shooting game redeployed!

title: Bronana
description: Bronana is a thrilling and hilarious survival roguelike. Embody the spirit of a fearless banana warrior to take down waves of vicious snack monsters. Through a rich variety of random events, grow stronger, evolve abilities, and face off against challenging bosses to save the homeland.

title: Magical Bakery: Deluxe Edition
description: Welcome to a magical, flour-filled world!

title: Backrooms: Partygoers
description: Backrooms: Partygoers is a backrooms horror game based on Level 0 where you play as a researcher tasked to find anomalies inside the backrooms. You are equip with devices that can beep whenever an anomaly is near, where the partygoers roam and can hear you.

title: Sinvers on Wheels
description: Crazy racing game where the tracks change every game!

title: Pixel Game Maker Series: Chrotopia
description:
A world where only black and white exist.
“Chro”searches for his sister in various places.

title: Moorhuhn Jump and Run: Traps and Treasures 3
description: In Moorhuhn Jump and Run ‘Traps and Treasures 3’, 31 levels full of traps and enemies await you!

title: Model Debut 3 #Nicola
description: A fashion game where your unique, cute style comes to life! Become a new model, enjoy fashion, work, and sometimes romance, while aiming to become a top model!

title: I Love Finding Wild Friends: Collector's Edition
description: Discover lovable wild animals in this thrilling hidden object game!

title: Horizon Journey
description: Embark on an epic adventure to Mars in Horizon Journey, an open-world survival game that blends colonization, terraforming, and exploration in both single-player and multiplayer co-op modes. You're tasked with the monumental challenge of making Mars a new home for humanity.

title: Melon Head
description: Melon Head is a fantastical point and click adventure set in a delirious imaginary world.

title: Metal Thunder
description: Command the legendary gunship in a high-octane action-roguelite! Engage insurgents with devastating firepower in ever-changing missions. Upgrade your arsenal, adapt to dynamic challenges, and survive relentless waves of enemies. Every run offers new tactics and chaos as you dominate the skies.

title: Across the Wonderlands
description:
A whimsical open-world survival crafting game!
Build your magical base dimension and craft fun dishes to fight quirky foes on your journey to the fallen star.

title: Virus Alert 3D
description: "Weird Al" Yankovic is finally starring in his own video game - VIRUS ALERT! - based on the song from his latest album, Straight Outta Lynwood. It's more fun than a warehouse full of pink leotards! Hoards of viruses have spread throughout the computer network of Company-Tech Co., Ltd., LCC, Al's new employer. Help Al advance in his job by "deleting" the viruses and protecting machines from the spreading menace with antiviral CDs.

title: RagnaTales MMORPG
description: RagnaTales is a community-driven MMORPG that brings the classic experience of old-mmos to life with modern updates and new gameplay features. Players can explore vibrant landscapes, engage in epic battles, and experience nostalgic adventures, all while participating in dynamic group activities and large-scale events. With customized quests, unique server events, and balanced classes, RagnaTales offers both seasoned players and newcomers a refreshing take on their amazing universe!

title: Battle For Vera
description: Battle for Vera is a Real-Time Strategy game that draws inspiration from beloved classics, and improves upon many of their ideas to create an exciting new experience.

title: Cursed Feed
description:
In first-person horror game "Cursed Feed," players embark on a chilling journey with the Thornvale family as they confront a malevolent force unleashed by their own patriarch's archaeological discoveries.

Richard Thornvale, a renowned archaeologist, returns from a harrowing expedition in the Middle East with cryptic artifacts in tow, he unwittingly invites an ancient curse into their tranquil home. Soon, inexplicable phenomena plague the household, and Emily, their young daughter, becomes the focal point of the sinister presence.

With each passing night, the family is tormented by terrifying apparitions and escalating paranormal activity, leading them to unravel dark secrets buried within the walls of their own home.

As they delve deeper into the mystery, they must confront their own fears and uncover the truth behind the curse before it consumes them all. Will they break free from the grip of the past, or will they become mere echoes in the haunted halls of their own history?

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Lucky Dragon
description: The 11th free update for Dreamlight Valley brings the Mulan Realm to the game (inspired by 1998's Mulan), the new characters Mulan and Mushu, the Majesty and Magnolias Star Path, a new event called Memory Mania and a new feature of cooking delivery daily quests by Remy.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Dapper Delights
description: The 12th free update for Dreamlight Valley brings Tiana (from Disney's Princess and the Frog) to the Valley, a new restaurant building, a new Stall for buying prepared meals, the Dapper Delights Star Path and general quality of life improvements.

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: Jungle Getaway
description: The 13th free update for Dreamlight Valley brings a new day-night cycle to The Lion King Realm, the new characters The Night Show Star Path and the return of the Halloween seasonal event Trick or Treat.

title: Endless Empty
description: Sci-fi horror about a controversial company that removes the world's trash.

title: NGE: VR
description: Neon Genesis Evangelion for PCVR

title: Lilian Fourhand: Nuclear Soeur the Fighters
description: Lilian Fourhand is a side scrolling action game that uses characters and locations from Maria-sama ga Miteru. Players move from left to right shooting down all enemies that come along, ranging from the likes of birds and bugs to schoolgirls.

title: Formless Mother
description: Formless Mother is set of 5 MBF21 maps set in a dark, very red, atmosphere heavily inspired by the work of Suguru Tanaka.

title: Anna's Summer Splash
description: The peaceful Dolpik Isles are under attack by the notorious Gooble gang. They have stolen the power of the sun metals and the only one that can stop them is Anna, a cheerful inventor who just had her and her brother's vacation ruined!

title: Scotophobia
description: Scotophobia is a psychological horror in which you're your accommodation is rapidly changing ceasing to belong to you. Will you be able to uphold your abode, reveal the origin of the mysterious guests, keep sanity, and… survive?

title: Hover Groove
description: A physics-based platformer about a drone looking for a way. You are hovering above the ground with electric beams. Your goal is to angle the thrusters to overcome increasingly difficult obstacles. The controls are difficult, but mastering them is all the more satisfying!

title: Blockdock
description: Move, rotate, and place blocks to fill platforms. Play against the clock, be accurate, or just relax with endless play in this Tetris-inspired game.

title: Reality Rifts
description: 3D platformer with a portal gun! Solve puzzles, exciting levels, become a master of portal travel.

title: Enemy On the Tail!
description: “Enemy on the Tail!” is a turn-based tactical dueling game about aerial combat. Choose your plane, use its unique traits, anticipate enemy moves, and attack! Or shake off enemies with clever maneuvers! Train against AI and compete with friends online. Ready for takeoff?

title: Project SJHG
description: The Journey to Restore the Distorted Time and Space

title: Conflux
description: A horror game where you can interact with your surroundings to find clues, fight monsters and solve puzzles as you uncover new areas in search for a mysterious artifact.

title: Harvest Master
description: A farm puzzle game that makes you want to repeat it over and over again to achieve a high score!

title: A Story About Birds
description: The birds are coming back! So, gather some wood, some bird food, and build some amazing shelters. Explore Plumage Farm on a relaxing day and get to know its inhabitants and regulars. How will you use the day?

title: MatchOolu
description: A card matching game like no other. Test your memory. Test your dexterity. Explore your mind.

title: Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator
description: Unleash your strategic skills in Ninja Wars: Battle Simulator! Command your army of Swordsmen, Spearmen, and Archers in a stunning 3D world. Analyze enemy formations and develop tactics to lead your ninjas to victory.

title: Kung Pao Banqi
description: Kung Pao Banqi is a two-player game of chance played on half a xiangqi board. Play hot seat, against AI, or online and beat your opponents with luck and strategy!

title: Coffee Extra: Ukuzala
description: A mysterious board game that magically turns its players pregnant. Navigate through a spooky house and solve puzzles in order to beat the game and help the heroines escape unscathed.

title: The Dark Mind
description: Locked in Jessica's endless hallucinations. Carefully observe your surroundings to guide her back to reality. An Unreal Engine 5 short horror hidden object game.

title: Emberwake
description: A dark fantasy survival strategy game where you manage villagers, gather resources, and defend a burning campfire against waves of undead in a relentless battle for survival.

title: Cape Hideous
description: Amongst the motliest of all crews, an enigmatic woman prepares the ship to enter an intense thunderstorm that rages in the middle of the ocean. What otherworldly mysteries lie within?

title: Mother's Home
description: Mother's Home is a psychological horror game. The player is left alone at home while their mother is taken to the hospital. Sarah soon finds out she is not alone, and her mother is back inside the house.

title: Cosmic Raze
description: Cosmic Raze is a sci-fi tower defense strategy game. Control advanced weapons, build powerful synergies, and then blast away as aliens attempt to conquer Earth. Between rounds you'll earn unique augmentations, purchase and upgrade a huge variety of weapons, and unlock powerful synergy bonuses.

title: Fall Platform
description: Fall Platform is a puzzle game that consists of climbing as high as possible until reaching the top without falling, no saving possible, the game wants to be the most difficult on the steam market. legend has it that those who manage to finish the game will have an IQ between 120 and 200.

title: PlayGuys
description: Choose your skills, combine your equipment, match them with unexpected combinations and enjoy the joy of mowing grass. playgus is a survival-like game. Players will be free to take risks in a relaxed and pleasant style.

title: Mutant Crisis
description: If you like to fight zombies purely, and hope to have talents and attribute growth, be able to unlock epic weapons for free that previously required a recharge of $3888 in krypton gold games, and be able to cooperate with friends online to challenge BOSS, then don't miss this game.

title: Nowv
description: This game is inspired by Ningning, a member of the South Korean idol group aespa. It conveys the message that even one's flaws can become strengths through inner growth.

title: Doomsday Cleaner
description: In the game, you will play as a survivor, facing endless zombie threats. You need to use your weapons and intelligence to clean up every zombie, protect yourself, and find hope for survival.

title: New Journey to the West
description: "New Journey to the West" is a multiplayer RPG. Form a four-player team to defeat demons, explore poetic landscapes, and enjoy scenic beauty. The revolutionary aerial combat system allows you to enjoy smooth and graceful battles. Join this with friends!

title: 8alloween
description: Walking Simulator Inspired by the 8th exit, this game requires sound for identifying anomalies. Use speakers or headphones. Contains mild horror elements.

title: The Magic Garden
description: Welcome to a new fantasy world, where you start a new life in this realm. Explore the mysterious places of this world. Here, you can build farm, meet various characters.By farming, collecting items, and using items and skills, venture into dungeons to defeat monsters and collect rare items.

title: Tales of The White Knight
description: This is a new SRPG strategy role-playing game created by the WK-Studio. The game will feature beautiful graphics presented in a 3D top-down perspective. Set in the war-torn continent of Breskan, the protagonists will face many trials and tribulations, what will be their fate?

title: Wolfman
description: You are a wolfman hunter on a critical mission: to uncover the truth and prove that the werewolf is not just a legend, but a real and deadly threat. Your journey will bring you face to face with the beast, as you seek to end the nightmare once and for all.

title: Hidden Storehouse Top-Down 3D
description: Find the objects that are hidden on the map.

title: The Parish
description: A slow and atmospheric retro horror game. These hills hide more than just this congregation. Tend this remote church, give services to the needy and you never know... you might just survive the night

title: CatClimber
description: Adventurous 2D platformer, Smash bricks and climb up the floors of the dungeon to find the treasures of the dragon

title: Nabi
description: Can you escape this abyss, a place of despair and evil? Pride, lust, greed, jealousy, indolence, gluttony, anger Defy their temptations!

title: Deep Despair 3
description: Deep Despair 3 is an open-world survival action-adventure with RPG elements! Fight, survive, dig, build, explore vast worlds, engage in farming, breed animals, gather resources, and level up to the max!

title: SCP: A Star Replicator
description: It's an action shooting game that combines the elements of survival and action RPG, Weapons are enhanced with different parts, skills are upgraded to remove SCP. It deals with the unique SCP of the SCP world view, and enjoy casual survival and combat.

title: Fox and Shadow
description: Fox and Shadow is a scifi dual deckbuilding roguelike. Scavenge for resources in a broken city to maintain your crumbling bunker. Create a deck that contains your Pilot's emotions with your Drone's logic to destroy defective robots for parts. The world is in ruins, salvage yourself.

title: Souls of Shadow
description: Souls of Shadow seamlessly blends deep role-playing elements with thrilling action combat, delivering an unparalleled adventure for players. Get ready to embrace the challenge, uncover the truth, and save this world engulfed in darkness!

title: Chaos Entropy
description: This RPG features a unique combat system! After obtaining the Chaos God's Ring, you must evade the Goddess's minions while exploring the world, collecting divine weapons, and awakening heroic spirits. Assemble a knightly order to battle powerful enemies and uncover the ancient secrets of Eusayard.

title: Multiplayer Mongolians
description: Multiplayer Mongolians - They attacked Your village, They killed Your family. Revenge is a dish best served ... Mongolian! (Multiplayer or Single Player)

title: Roots of Harmony
description: Text-based 4X with a focus on turf war and resource management. Roots of Harmony is an old-school keyboard-controlled casual game where you have to lead your colony to different stages of development, while facing various threats and managing your doctrines and disciples.

title: A Conversation With a Magical Deer
description: Have a conversation with a magical deer.

title: Back to the Rooms
description: Back to the Rooms is a 6-player co-op horror experience. Survive and explore the backrooms with your friends or alone to save your home.

title: HexaTerra
description: Dynamically change the landscape in this hexagon block puzzle game. Strategize to solve complex puzzles with biomes that shift depending on adjacent tiles. Complete the story or play endless levels.

title: Blood=Bullets
description: Blood=Bullets is a bullet hell boss rush action platformer where you dash into bullets to refill ammo. In order to kill the blood itself, one must hack into the sequence.

title: Pogo Knight
description: Bounce your way to the top and claim victory... How hard could it be?

title: BoringFly
description: A turn based casual card game with a storyline that only requires the use of a mouse throughout the game. On the basis of simulating the gameplay of Lianliankan, add combat elements. At the same time, players can choose different talents and adapt to different gameplay expressions.

title: Auto_Battler_RPG
description: This is a game about automatical upgrades and unlocking of resources The game plays by itself while all you do is upgrade your hero... and attempt to move even further in the dungeon and by doing that growing in strength.

title: Desert Mercenary Corps
description: Welcome to Desert Mercenaries, a role-playing adventure game set in the desert. In the vast and barren Monchi Desert, you will form your own team and explore the unknown desert mysteries. Let your team win the respect and recognition of the entire Monchi Desert.

title: Chores in the Night
description: "I want this apartment spotless!" shouts your mom before going to her night shift. Use your cleaning supplies and courage to have the house cleaned before your mom comes back. A first person short story about doing chores and avoiding evil forces to survive the night.

title: Gunz & Golf
description: Gunz & Golf is a single-player, physics-based precision platformer. Master 3 unique guns, blast your ball through outlandish obstacles, and conquer a handcrafted pixel art course by the omnipresent Developer. Prepare for hilarious frustration and satisfying triumphs!

title: Skel Dungeon
description: Skel Dungeon is a real-time strategy defense game. Become a small skeleton and defeat the heroes invading your dungeon. Set up and upgrade trap rooms, expand your dungeon, and strengthen your skeleton to stand against increasingly powerful heroes.

title: Who is Paul
description: Isaac, a failed detective, receives a mysterious letter that leads him to investigate a desolate and abandoned house in order to make ends meet. However, upon arrival, he realizes that instead of investigating, he must survive. To escape this house filled with dark secrets,

title: Smoking Gun
description: Smoking Gun is a single player, western themed, vertical scroller, shoot 'em up arcade game. Step into the boots of an Arizona Ranger and fight for justice as ruthless bandits descend upon Hickstown, convinced the lawmen are behind their gang's mysterious disappearances.

title: The Stone of Wisdom
description: The Stone of Wisdom is a top-down, Zelda-like ARPG, it features action-adventure style gameplay. Players will explore egyptian cities, battling mythical creatures, solving puzzles, collecting special items, and finding secret passages.

title: WiThu, It's Time To Go
description: WiThu, It's Time To Go is an RPG Maker Horror puzzle game. You wake up in a familiar place. Something that everyone has is called a name, but you don't. Searching for who we are and the truth of these things. The adventures in mysterious lands are waiting for you.

title: East Trade Tycoon: Inheritance
description: Eastern Trade Tycoon: Inheritance is a trading simulator game.In the game,you can from zero to hero.By trading markets, build a business,earn money,level up, investing accurately, and manage family to become a trading tycoon!

title: The Carnival Killer
description: Step right up to the most twisted carnival you'll ever encounter! In The Carnival Killer, 4 players find themselves trapped in a nightmarish amusement park where laughter turns to terror. Killer Clowns stalk the grounds, hunting down anyone who fails to escape the nightmare.

title: Pix'Hard
description: "Fight off endless hordes of enemies with your ship! Upgrade it to defeat increasingly powerful opponents! Choose your upgrades carefully, manage your priorities, and find your enemies' weak points!"

title: Recovery Phrase
description: Uncover hidden words, piece together clues, and think beyond the game screen to unravel mysteries. Every challenge pushes the boundaries of your creativity, demanding you to use both in-game elements and real-world insights. Each step brings you closer to decoding the Recovery Phrase.

title: Miner Open Chests
description: It's a relaxing miner style game full of fun. You can use various tools to break barriers or jump onto platforms. Find your way through maze-like levels by solving puzzles and operating machineries to find treasure chests. The pixel mode bring you classic 1990s' game experience.

title: DuckLaserDuck
description: DLD offers synergies unfettered by balance. Chain lightning proc'ing explosions for exponential chaos. Your brain won't be able to handle the copious amount of Juice. If things get too crazy, it's your fault! :D

title: Laundromat Simulator
description: Furnish, Manage, and Maintain multiple stores in Laundromat Simulator! Collect and Count your hard-earned pennies and improve your stores to keep customers happy and maximize your profits. Expand your business, improve customer experience, and make your laundromat the best in town!

title: Just Squat
description: Just Squat is a shmup and visual Nobel game that focuses on boss fight by growing up a boy. Grow the boy by encountering various events at the gym and school, and push Babel out with all your might! The difficulty of boss fight and the boy's growth will be determined by the exercise you choose!

title: Shepherds
description: Shepherds is a 3D, two-player co-op musical adventure game in which players control unlikely partners - a shepherd girl named Zoe and a magic wolf named Kin. Players must cleverly combining their unique mastery of musical melodies and distinctive movement styles to solve puzzles.

title: Kindred: Subject 6244
description: In this eerie, horror visual novel, you are confined in a room with a monster. How will you fare against petrifying odds? Will you be able to work your way into the mind of an indecipherable beast, or will you be added to the casualty count? A word of advice: Choose a side; don't look back.

title: Eternal Ninja
description: Eternal Ninja is a 2D platformer with puzzles and traps. Players learn from each death to progress through ingeniously challenging levels. It's a fun yet tough game, designed to test your skills!

title: Mission Delta
description: Challenge the tower solo or co-op in this high-octane sky crawler action rogue-lite. Stack power ups and steal destructive weapons as you dodge, dash and mutilate your way to the top. Your retribution awaits.

title: Departed
description: Departed is an anomaly detection game, where you are stuck inside a looping subway system. Explore the station carefully and spot the differences. Nine consecutive correct decisions will bring you closer to your goal. Can you make your way through the endless platforms or will you get lost forever?

title: Alien Video Game Scientist
description: A 3D platformer collectathon featuring puzzles, mazes, and a bit of speedrunning in a retro-minimalist package evocative of the PS2 era. Can YOU figure out how to grab all the things, and do it efficiently? FOR SCIENCE!

title: Last Subway
