description: Have you ever had such a gaming experience? It’s filled with wild screams, even mocking the developers, yet you find yourself moved to tears at the end. Perhaps this game is one of those! Why? The truth lies at the last subway station.

title: Halley2061
description: This is a space sci-fi survival and building game. You take on the role of a retired astronaut on a top-secret mission to the Halley’s Comet. Resource and time management will be key to your survival. Will you wisely use limited supplies to build your own space base and achieve self-sufficiency?

title: Under The Blue Horizon: Aquarium
description: "Under the blue horizon - Aquarium" is a game for those who want to enjoy watching fish. Observe fish in the sea and in aquariums. Discover more types of special fish. Enjoy it while working, relax, or clear your mind.

title: Astral Pursuit
description: Tear through hordes of otherworldly creatures and defeat their ruler before the universe ends. Travel between planets, gather powerful relics, and shape the galaxy to your whim in this objective-based action rogue-lite.

title: Arcade Manager
description: Build and manage the Arcade of your dreams. Unlock lots of fully animated games, set their jackpots and build prize zones. Start with a humble local arcade and expand into an major arcade entertainment center!

title: Wild Haven
description: Wild Haven is a nature ecosystem builder. You will build the forest and create a thriving ecosystem. Clean up polluted land, strategically place wildlife together, discover more complex plants and animals and rebuild the ecosystem your way!

title: One Turn Kill
description: One Turn Kill is a PvE card game where card drawing and deck control are the keys to victory. Engage in battles limited to a single turn for an exhilarating, suspenseful experience.Join the protagonist in a pixel art wasteland to face off with the strongest of enemies and see what story awaits.

title: Infinite Idle: Online Clicker RPG
description: Hold down the spacebar or left-click and join the action! Upgrade, grow stronger, and progress endlessly. Enjoy infinite fun with your simple yet powerful strategy to reach the top!

title: Delve Diver
description: Fall-down platformer with Auto-generated stages. Obtain items to help your journey - but beware, you should only bring what you can lose.

title: Mosquito Simulator
description: Mosquito simulator is a prank game in the type of simulation and survival.

title: Forgotten Fables
description: In "Fábulas Porteñas," the subway leaves you at an unknown station, and you must venture in to find a way to get back home. You will solve puzzles and explore while a creature lurks in the shadows.

title: Jeepney Stories
description: Jeepney Stories is a heartwarming, slice-of-life, funny and chill visual novel about family, chances, getting old and living in the third world.

title: Dungeon Flowy
description: An auto-battle hack-and-slash RPG. Assemble a party of six and combine your favorite jobs to aim for the deepest part of the dungeon. Enhance your stats with passive equipment obtained from treasure chests or alter the probability of skill usage. Create your own unique build!

title: Fairy Card Battlers
description: A DCG with fast-paced strategic battles that conclude in 8 turns. Simple yet deep mind games emerge from card placement and the choice of benefits at the start of each turn. Will you enjoy the fairies' antics in the story, or aim for the top of the rankings in pseudo-multiplayer?

title: The Exit of Nightmare
description: The Exit of Nightmare is a psychological horror game with collection and puzzle elements. You're trapped in nightmare world and your goal is to find your way back to reality.

title: CatTrio
description: A physics puzzle game in which you have to put cats in a pot and match them! Aim for a high score!

title: Keep Your Eyes Open
description: Everyone must blink, and you are no different. Blinking allows you to see and move around, just watch out for the giant monster who appears to hunt you down when you don't keep your eyes open.

title: Owold
description: Owold is a type of Psychological Horror game. A story that emerged after an event that took place years later when humanity completely placed itself in the multiverse.

title: Butcherbird
description: 10 years have passed since a swarm of apocalyptic constructs wiped out most of humanity. Among the ashes of old Earth, a small band of survivors now find themselves with little else to do and far too much ammunition.

title: Towards Future
description: Waking up in the darkness, unable to see the sunrise, he remembered the little master carefully carried him home. The base has already fallen into ruin and there are no signs of any living people here. Where did the little master go? Is there any hope left under the doomsday?

title: Damsel: Chapter 1 - Stress on the Tress
Gratis
description:
A shop has opened, the shopkeep has moved in, and shoppers need assistance. A quick salve, a trifle, salvation. Help them.

This is a short narrative horror-lite game that can be played in about 20-30 minutes with keyboard and mouse. Play multiple times to see all 11 characters!

title: Depths of Endor
description: Classic, turn-based dungeon crawler RPG. A retro-styled adventure that combines the best elements of old-school role-playing games with modern features of a roguelike.

title: Echo Of The Horizon
description: Echo of the Horizon (EOTH) is an open-world RPG built in Unreal Engine 5, featuring single-player and multiplayer modes. Players can form clans, tackle dungeons, engage in PvP, and embark on epic quests in a vast, immersive universe.

title: Touch The Bubbles 4
description:
Pop the bubbles and avoid red traps. It's as simple as it gets. The challenge grows every level. If it is too easy for your taste just keep playing and see.
Classic mode saves your progress but is slightly harder. Arcade mode however is all about the highscore.

title: Cá Trê
description:
Cá Trê means catfish in Vietnamese.

Walk through a dreamscape and experience the horror of catfish.

title: The Dream Of Yourself
description: "The Dream of Yourself" is about the discovery of the “other” in yourself, through a spiritual exploration of your subconsciousness.

title: Daibouken: Yarinaosu
description: Daibouken: Yarinaosu is an Action Adventure RPG where players explore vibrant worlds, solve puzzles, clear dungeons, and battle foes within a mysterious time loop. Join Aurora as she navigates a fate intertwined with gods and time itself.

title: Creature Packets
description:
Creature Packets is a game about cooking tiny creatures. Using a microwave, you can bring creatures from packets to life. Use blender to explore new substance packages to cook even more creatures.

The game was made in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 56 on the theme "tiny creatures".

title: Dead Ascend
description: A 2D point'n'click-like adventure game written in Qt/QML and Javascript

title: Bricks Survivors
description: Bricks Survivors combine le charme des casse-briques rétro avec l'intensité des roguelites modernes. Survivez à des vagues de briques rapides et affrontez des boss en pixel art, le tout conçu par un seul créateur. Une expérience unique et addictive, disponible exclusivement sur PC.

title: Stealth Syndicate
description: Stay hidden among the crowd and defeat your opponents before getting spotted, or you risk not surviving in this party game where you need to mix stealth, speed, and tactics. Playable locally and online for 2 to 10 players.

title: Radio_Wishers
description: A Yume Nikki styled game where you follow three amnesiacs trapped in a strange building. The only way these three can recover their memories are through finding them in their dream worlds, and have to work together in order to escape.

title: Escape Floor 13
description: Escape Floor 13 is a survival-puzzle game with adventure and simulation elements. Set in a mysterious hotel, players are trapped on the 13th floor and must carefully navigate each level to reach safety. The primary goal is to cross each floor and reach the elevator, but supernatural anomalies complicate the journey. If an anomaly is sensed, players must retreat to their starting point to survive. The game’s tense atmosphere is heightened by the ever-present surveillance of the hotel, challenging players to rely on their instincts to escape.

title: Kassei: Road Cycling
description: Kassei: Road Cycling is a summer sports simulation game. To win the yellow jersey you have to manage your team optimally: as "directeur sportif" you decide on training plans as well as race tactics.

title: Hacky
description: Become an elite hacker in cyberpunk typing simulator. Infiltrate networks, steal data by typing simple commands. Unlocking new abilities as you go deeper. No coding skills needed.

title: Rise of The Newborns
description: In a dystopian world consumed by the VAS, become one of the Newborn: A new generation of humans immune to the plague, surviving the ravages of disease, mutants, and sinister AXIOM. Fight for hope, rise against the odds, and pave the way for society to be reborn in a unique online sandbox RPG.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutants Unleashed - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition includes:
• Full Base Game
• Season Pass Content:
- 1987 Animated Series Pack
- 1984 Comic Book Pack
- Metalheads Pack
- Fresh Meat Mission Pack

title: LEGO Horizon Adventures: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
LEGO Horizon Adventures is an action-adventure game developed by Guerrilla Games and Studio Gobo, blending the Horizon series setting with LEGO-style visuals and humour.
Players follow a retelling of Aloy’s story as she travels across a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by machine creatures. Gameplay includes exploration, combat, puzzle-solving, and cooperative play.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
• The base game
• Roller Coaster Customization
• Banuk Armor outfit
• Shadow Stalwart outfit
• “Alloy” Aloy outfit
• Ratchet outfit
• Rivet outfit
• Sackboy outfit

title: Farmagia: Digital Deluxe Edition
description: Contains the base game, the Buddy Booster Pack, a Digital Artbook and the Original Soundtrack.

title: Gravity Strike
description: Physics based action game. Use gravity forces to manipulate dynamic objects to destroy your enemies.

title: Cozy Together
description: A single player RPG, Inspired by Old School Runescape custom rulesets played by youtubers, such as Settled's "Tileman", FlippingOldSchools "Gold to unlock the map" and Gudi's "Game of Chance"

title: Spelesammlung 1,000 XP-Spiele
description: A collection of 1,00 games for Windows XP featuring a wide variety of puzzle, dice, sports and skill games.

title: Mirror Mirror
description: MIRROR MIRROR is a first-person psychological horror game. You repeatedly find yourself in a house where your find presence of unknown entities. Go through unreal experiences in the house and uncover the secrets of your fractured mind. Experience the tension and fear in the repeating space.

title: Deep Lake Mall
description: A small town mall has a big secret.

title: Dreadborne Dungeon
description: Dreadborne Dungeon is a pixel art, retro shooter inspired by old school games like Doom and Heretic, as well as mechanics taken from Souls Like games and dungeon crawlers. Explore dark dungeons, fight enemies and survive in a retro-styled world. Die, draw conclusions and don't give up! Good Luck!

title: Soup Boy Goes to the Soup Convention
description: The Soup Convention is in town. Can you win the soup eating contest?

title: Korter 1996
description: You find a secret passage at your new flat leading to other people’s homes. Unpack your stuff, collect items and solve the mysteries of each of the apartments to unlock the story of the apartment block. You might not feel so lonely, after all.

title: Strand
description: Step into the desolate void of a high-tech space station in STRAND. Face mind-bending puzzles to escape an infinite time loop while uncovering the fate of your crew. Every detail matters as you unravel the mystery and question humanity’s role in the vast, unforgiving universe.

title: Angst: A Tale of Survival
description: ANGST is a solo & co-op wilderness survival game set in a freezing, gritty, stylized Low-Poly limbo-like world. Craft tools and weapons, hunt, fish, and fight to stay alive. Upgrade skills to venture deeper into the wild, but be warned: what lurks there can thwart your plans. Survive the ANGST!

title: Kremlin 3D
description:
Vladolf Putler, a psychopathic ruler of an evil empire, is disturbing the global peace again.
He has to be stopped before more lives are lost. Are you up to the task?

title: Placid Plastic Deck: A Quiet Quest
description: A wholesome game where you can’t die. A relaxing and witty adventure featuring colorful pixel-art locations, peculiar characters, quirky dialogues, elements of deck-building card battles, and a lot of ducks. A tale of friendship and revenge!

title: Shop Simulator: Supermarket
description: DESIGN, SELL & EXPAND – YOUR SUCCESS IS IN YOUR HANDS. Put your entrepreneurial skills to the test in Shop Simulator: Supermarket. Immerse yourself in the world of retail and start your own business today!

title: Project Songbird
description: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

title: Shiina Taki's Decameron
description: Shiina Taki's Decameron is a doujin interactive fiction based on anime「BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!」. The story concentrates on Shiina Taki, the drummer and song writer of MyGO!!!!! and her fight against fate till the last breath.

title: Deck of Haunts
description: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

title: Void Scout
description: Save reality one mission at a time! A seemingly unimportant Void Scout gets thrown into the middle of an interdimensional war, as the only one who can prevent the Exoforms from consuming reality. Strategize, plan, and execute in a suspenseful tactical roguelike. Save the multiverse and die trying!

title: Escape from Mutation Station
description: A short, unconventional escape room experience. You are the candidate. You must find a way out of this room. Things are not as they seem.

title: My Last Friday
description: My Last Friday is a first-person horror-adventure game with a disturbing atmosphere, clever puzzles, body horror, and tense combat. Explore a twisted world, confront terrifying enemies, and endure the nightmarish challenges ahead.

title: Egg Run
description: Collect the twig and get to the base of the ladder in as few moves as possible.

title: The Victor Initiative
description: The Victor Initiative is an atmospheric horror game about exploring an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago.

title: Satanic
description: Satanic is a first-person survival horror game about escaping a satanic cult. Hunted by a relentless demon that responds to your actions, you must avoid detection, scavenge for resources, and navigate your way through an ex-soviet missile silo deep below the surface.

title: White Knuckle
description: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

title: Deathbound: Accepted by Death
description: Enter the mysterious liminal space between Life and Death a floating rock in the void. In this epic DLC you must release the great essences of the 5 bosses representing five stages of grief – Denial, Anger, Bargaining, Depression and Acceptance – before unlocking Path to Death for the final showdown with Grief – The Purifier – the mightiest of them all.

title: Blind Exposure
description: Navigate through claustrophobic, completely dark world illuminated only by scans you manage to create; listen carefully to sounds coming from the darkness, and don’t let dread and paranoia get to you.

title: Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors
description: You are Earth's last line of defense in a relentless alien invasion. Experience intense top-down roguelite action across diverse landscapes, fighting invaders with a versatile arsenal. Outsmart, outgun, and survive your foes. Every run increases the challenge - so adapt, evolve, dominate!

title: Mircea
description: Mircea is a short spooky adventure game. Explore a subway infested by mysterious, bug-like beings. Investigate and understand the monsters to capture them... before they capture you.

title: Vile: Exhumed
description: A game about misogynistic entitlement. Browse an old computer's files to uncover information about adult film actress Candy Corpse, and her recent departure from the industry.

title: Star Ronin
description: Star Ronin is a top-down action-adventure game set in the far future. Your family, indebted to a massive megacorporation, must use all of its skills to survive.

title: Burnin' Rubber 6
description: Burnin' Rubber 6 is an intense car-combat racing game where you race, drift, and blast through competitors in explosive battles. Explore the open world and customize your car collection to perfection. Become the ultimate racing mercenary! Includes split-screen multiplayer and a track editor!

title: Empire of the Ants: Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
Experience Empire of the Ants like never before with the Digital Deluxe Edition. This exclusive package offers players a deeper dive into the world of ants with a 3-day early access, a digital artbook, stunning HD wallpapers, and an immersive soundtrack.

The Digital Deluxe Edition includes:
- Full Game
- 3-day Early Advanced Access
- Digital Artbook
- Digital Soundtrack
- Digital Wallpapers

title: PowerWash Simulator: Halloween Seasonal 2024
description: Something filthy this way comes in PowerWash Simulator’s latest Seasonal Special. You’ll have to hose off more than a few cobwebs to take the Halloween House from mortifyingly mucky to party-ready perfection.

title: Ducky Dash
description: Ducky Dash is a tribute to classic handheld games, featuring a charming green monochromatic palette and a retro soundtrack that evokes nostalgia. Embark on an exciting journey with a fearless little duck, using your Dash skills to overcome obstacles and explore vibrant worlds.

title: Cat in Rain
description: Dive into the whimsical and challenging world of Cat in Rain, a captivating 2D precision platformer that combines classic gameplay with pixel-art graphics. Prepare for an adventure where every step matters, and every jump counts! Whether you're a seasoned platformer veteran or a curious newcomer, Cat in Rain has something for everyone. Choose between Easy and Hardcore modes to tailor the challenge to your skill level.

title: Beware Tomorrow
description: You must escape a mysterious facility and solve complex puzzles in this psychological horror game. An unseen entity manipulates both you and a deranged man, forcing you to make life-or-death decisions to survive.

title: My Pirate Husbandos
description:
Having nearly drowned at sea you find yourself an outsider among the handsome pirate crew who rescued you. They sail by day, do depraved things at night, and you can't keep your mind from thinking about them.

Set sail into the sexy and dangerous story of My Pirate Husbandos.

title: Vampire Survivors: Ode to Castlevania
description: The Vampire Survivors have come a long way in their honorable hunt, and after joining forces with the Belmont Family, they are the closest they've ever been. Finally, within their grasp... A vampire. Possibly, at least.

title: Treasure 'n Trio
description: Team up with a brute-force warrior, a nimble and wily thief, and a cowardly wizard with teleportation magic. Use all three characters with different abilities at the right time to solve puzzles and collect treasures.

title: Sausage Cat
description: A short and cozy puzzle game about cats with an innate talent for stretching. Your task is to lead them to the milk pots while filling the room.

title: Squash Ball
description: Welcome to Squash Ball, the ultimate idle clicker sandbox game with physics, themes, clicking stats, and a leveling system. Perfect for casual gamers and those who love to fidget with items digitally. With its colorful design and addicting gameplay, it's easy to pick up and hard to put down.

title: Let's Build Wonders: Galaxy
description: Let's Build Wonders: Galaxy is a multiplayer cooperative game focused on building space wonders. In the game, players collaborate by trading resources and planning routes, working together to expand their alliance’s galactic territory and form a defensive community to resist pirate attacks.

title: Nuts About Nuts
description: Nuts About Nuts is a “stress free” co-op game where you partner up, pick your tools, and let the factory floor become your playground. Use your skills, to manufacture and deliver complex parts to keep the assembly line moving and your friends in sync.

title: The Basement Ritual
description: The Basement Ritual is a short indie horror game where you have been kidnapped and must escape a cult’s basement premises solving puzzles and hiding from a demonic creature.

title: Metamathema
description: Engage proxy wars as an elite merc on Metamathema, the secret military service platform providing millions of stealth missions. Arm yourself fully to infiltrate the enemy FOB. Complete the mission and survive in a jungle surrounded by enemy troops. Search, eliminate, and gather intel.

title: Back Alley Darts
description: Back Alley Darts is a crowd-play game designed Back Alley Darts Game experience. The aim of the game is try and get a bulls eye or the hiest points going and be the top of the leaderboard. The more points you get the better it is as you will unlock stuff in the game to be able to use in the game

title: Egg Raiders
description: Egg Raiders is a cooperative horror game where four players work together to infiltrate an area teeming with aggressive monsters. You must survive for three days, gather valuable loot, and escape before more monsters come after you. Teamwork and strategy are the keys to success!

title: Hot Rod Mayhem
description: Race against tiny troublemakers across dozens of crazy courses and take on unique and thrilling trials! Ride on single tracks, unleash powerful items against your rivals, or face off in exhilarating challenges to compete for the championships!

title: Aria of Song
description: This is a single player role-playing adventure game, where you need to play as a human and go to a different world to defeat four disaster monster bosses, obtain their disaster core, and ultimately win the game!

title: Dark Blue Dungeon
description: Dark Blue Dungeon is an adventure game inspired by D&D-style role-playing games

title: Juuni-ban-me ni Warui Yume no Sachi
description:
Juuni-ban-me ni Warui Yume no Sachi is a 2D action game with hand-drawn characters.
Explore the wonderful world to collect sheep.

title: Stray Memoria
description: A contemporary juvenile mystery about young boys and girls who grow up confused and troubled, and adults who harbor secrets.

title: 0101: Classic Bonus Levels 1
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Classic levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Counter Bonus Levels 1
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Counter levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Pusher Bonus Levels 1
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Pusher levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Pusher Bonus Levels 2
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Pusher levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Classic Bonus Levels 2
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Classic levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: 0101: Counter Bonus Levels 2
description: This DLC includes another 10 bonus Counter levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

title: Steel Knight's Armis
description: "Steel Knight's ARMIS" is a roguelike robot game. Lead the rebellion through five chapters, fighting against the Imperial Army and Earth Federation. Customize and upgrade your robot to survive the intense battles ahead.

title: The Land of Fog
description: Game type: turn based strategy action bar mode Rich plot, diverse skills, players play as several mercenaries, use strategies to challenge various levels, gradually unravel the fog of the Mist Continent, and complete their legends

title: Livers Ikusei Card Game
description: This game is a "Deck-Building Liver Development Card Game."You will nurture aspiring livestreamers (Livers) and help them become outstanding Livers.The goal is to earn as many LP (Liver Points) as possible.To achieve this, you'll need to build an optimized deck.

title: Can You Get Off Work on Time?
description: This is an independent role-playing puzzle game. You will play as a worker who is about to get off work at six o'clock, but encounters a series of workplace troubles that prevent you from getting off work on time. Is it really just a luxury to get off work on time?

title: Kyosho
description: Slash or be slashed. Protect yourself from vengeful spirits with the sword you picked up while approaching the mystery hidden in the mansion. A Japanese-style puzzle action and metafiction mystery horror game with an unusual "inventory puzzle" and sword "parry counter" features!

title: Haunting Record: Sins of Lust
description: This is a walking simulator with elements of horror and suspense. You are trapped in an endless corridor, where eerie events keep unfolding, as if something is trying to stop you from escaping...

title: Multiverse Loot Hunter: Three Kingdoms
description: This is a brush treasure adventure game across the heavens. The protagonist awakens his powers and freely passes through different planes such as Xiuxian, history, Wuxia, magic, and future. Collect equipment, spirits, characters and cheats distributed across all planes through battle.

title: Cyberkiller2049
description: Cyberkiller 2049 is a platform-action fast-paced game that battles numerous enemies on destructible platforms. Manipulate the character, kill with one hit, sprint, kill enemies. Picking up bats, remote-controlled bombs. Fight enemies with different abilities.

title: Horoboshi-hime
description: This is a small and concentrated Roguelike RPG. It offers short but crunchy battles and powerful growth. It is a simple adventure that the protagonist alone takes on, but a series of profound choices are continuously pushed upon you.

title: Novels Rogue: Isekai Koshodo to Fuuin no Majo
description: Enjoy the cards and the story with a combination of "deck building" x "JRPG" x "pixel art."

title: Incident Mahjong
description: "Incident Mahjong" is a Mahjong game where you play while keeping an eye out for "incidents" that occur during the game. When you spot an "incident," make the appropriate tile discard decision, and sometimes point out problematic melds or discarded tiles.

title: Disciple
description: Disciple is an eldritch horror pachinko roguelite. Launch your disc into the Abyss, shatter crystals for their essence, and wield the artefacts of a forgotten god. Harvest enough essence and you are reborn to descend again. Fail, and the Abyss devours you too.

title: Elf Survivor
description: Elf Survivor is a challenging 2D survival action game. Players will struggle to survive in a dangerous world, facing a constant stream of enemies.

title: Strategy Master
description: What Kind of Card Game Is This? This is a fantasy-themed card battle game where players strategically deploy various card skills to capture strongholds and defeat opponents.

title: Smash Simulator
description: Inherit a failing company and transform it into a destruction empire! Build and manage your own Rage Rooms, let clients smash objects to relieve stress… and turn it all into profit!

title: Dark Tank
description: Multiplayer online catapult game in the style of Warcraft. The game's combat scenarios are rich and varied, and players can use terrain and power-ups to fight and use a variety of unique weapons and skills to defeat their opponents.

title: QR Dead
description: Your phone is the key to solving the mystery. Scan QR codes, they hold hidden clues. Find herbs for the infusion to save your grandfather. But be careful. A fog has engulfed the village, and a monster with a crossbow for a hand roams within. You are only safe at the altar. Why is it chasing you?

title: Twelve Sticks
description: Play hide-and-seek with friends online, hide from the monster, or play as a monster and catch other players. Get scared, have fun, collect points, buy upgrades, and most importantly, have fun.

title: Shop Simulator: Pet Shop
description: In SHOP SIMULATOR: PET SHOP you can fulfill your dream of running a pet store. Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of retail and keep your customers happy. You and up to three friends can customize your store and take care of all the needs of a pet store.

title: J.B. Harold no Jikenbo: Murder Club
Half-Life 2: Survivor
description:
The arcade version of Half Life 2 was released mainly in Japan on June 28, 2006. Survivor runs on the Taito's Type X with a 32" attached monitor running at 1360x768.

On June 18, 2013 the complete Half-life 2: Survivor 2.0 content dump was released, soon after that the game was modified to run on a regular Windows PC by Marphy Black, ben1066, and several other members of Facepunch Studios Forum. The port gives access to the developer console which was disabled in the original arcade version, therefore making multiplayer possible through the use of console commands.

The game requires the screen resolution to be at least 1360x768, as the position of most of the user interface elements was optimized for the arcade machine's resolution and cannot be changed.

title: Garten of Banban 0
description: Explore the origins of the mysterious Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dark past of the establishment. Try to make some friends. Uncover the truth behind the place, and who you are

title: Ice World
description: Ice World is a survival sandbox game set in a post-apocalyptic frozen Earth. After a blizzard lasting decades, humanity is on the brink of extinction. Players must explore icy landscapes, tame wild animals, and build shelters using snow and ice. With a husky puppy as your companion, you’ll hunt, gather resources, and face mutated beasts in a struggle to endure the cold apocalypse.

title: Virmachina
description: After a nightmare, Eli wakes up to find his fiance missing. To follow her trail, he finds himself navigating an uncertain future. A future being hammered out between competing visions while he deals with visions of his own.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 1.3 - Virtual Revenge
description:
Version 1.3 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:

• New Characters: Yanagi and Lighter
• New Game Mode: Simulated Battle Trial
• New Events
• ...and more!

title: Shadow Generations
description: Play as Shadow in a brand-new story campaign featuring never-before-seen abilities that prove why he's known as the Ultimate Life Form! Speed through iconic stages from Shadow's history, discover hidden secrets in an expansive hub world, and unlock new powers to take on Black Doom and save the world.

title: Outpost 16
description: Outpost 16 is a single-player level for HL2:EP2 that has a cinematic, moody tone with custom voice acting, models, scripted sequences and music.

title: Blosics 2
description: Blosics sequel. Bigger, stronger, better!

title: Fight the Skeleton Mage from the Crypt!!
description:
Welcome brave Wizard, take your staff and be ready to defeat an old plague who has emerged from the Crypt!

In this sidescroller game all you have to do is defeat the enemy. Easy and simple! The head is the weak spot!

title: Isle of Birds
description: Isle of Birds is a cute and cozy Town Builder about populating an island with, well... birds! Place and merge a diverse array of feathered friends to build colourful and varied high-rise bird houses until your island runs out of space!

title: Goofy Soccer
description: According to the author, Goofy Soccer is designed to give you total control on the ball when dribbling, passing and shooting. Having little mastery on the gameplay will give you the feeling that you are a creative play-maker since you can all set the direction, curve, height and power of your passes. Also the game supports ordinary computer assisted mode for beginners. The game is easy to play, but the harder levels can only be beaten with your great skills.

title: Syobon Action: New Something
description: There are millions of Syobon Action Alternate Universes, which are known as "Syobonverses" that are characterized by changing the appearance of the world, although they are the same plot but with few differences and one of them is New Something, the cat Syobonina has to recover her "cocaine in the form of an Artichoke" and thus not be sad, lots of memes and no sense.

title: Faceless: Prologue
description:
A little girl is lost after sleeping for too long at the nursery. Can you help her find her way home?

Many dangers await her on her way, the dark creatures are always ready to consume her small spirit. On this journey, she got a question and gave a promise, but could she remember them until the end?

title: Call the Tune
description:
You'll be following Neo, a young idol dissatisfied with her life. After suddenly moving to a new school for one week, she finds herself wrapped up in the school's student council and its (unofficial) idol group.

But all takes an unexpected turn once a simple accident causes our cast to delve deeper into the school's lower floor. During a series of investigations done by the astute Detective Emilia Ruth, your actions will determine the conclusion of the case as well as the story as a whole.

title: TibiaScape
description: 2D MMORPG heavily inspired by classic tibia, with many innovations and improvements adding depth and longevity to it.

title: Sunny Side Nightmare
description:
Eddie is a clown apprentice that dreams of becoming like his now retired idol.

However the day he thinks he's finally going to debut, the Ringmaster announced that they're closing the fun side of the circus in favor of the scary side, that just the same day, is finally presenting their new show. An open house show where the public can now participate.

Needless to say, Eddie is not happy with the sudden announcement, and has some complaints to voice.

Follow Eddie inside the nightmare that is the open house and help him take his job back... or at least escape alive.

title: Nehan: Kanzenban
description: A horror adventure game made with RPG Maker, with enphashis on cosmic horror and body horror. There are no battles with minor enemies, only event battles. It is more of an adventure-like content, where you explore the ruins with your survival on the line.

title: Nehan 2: Darkness Fantasy
description: The Sequel to Nahen. Whereas the previous version was a direct panic horror where you escape from the mansion, this one has a psychological sense of fear as the strangeness of the surroundings gradually emerges. Its an RPG Maker 2000 game with cosmic horror and body horror elements.

title: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
description: Pirates Outlaws 2 is a swashbuckling roguelike deckbuilder. Collect & fuse cards, gather powerful relics and adapt your strategy during each run. Become a reputed pirate, loot the Sea Masters, challenge giant creatures and triumph in the great Arena!

title: Bonded in Darkness
description:
Arnaud just wants to be left alone.

Turned into a vampire against his will long ago, he's nonetheless managed to carve out a largely peaceful existence in an abandoned manor—a peaceful existence routinely interrupted by the vampire hunter Julien, seeking blood for blood.

Over the years, animosity has morphed into a strange sort of respect, and on one stormy night, Arnaud is greeted with a sight he never expected: his mortal enemy Julien, gravely injured on his doorstep.

Will Arnaud take him in, or will he use this opportunity to grasp the peace he's been seeking for years?

title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: We are Legion
description:
We Are Legion is the first DLC for Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance, a gritty real-time strategy game set in the intense universe of Terminator: Dark Fate.

It plunges players back into the heart of the conflict as they take command of Legion, the relentless machine army fighting to dominate a shattered world. This DLC expands on the story, focusing on Legion’s mission to eradicate human resistance and assert dominance over a world ravaged by war.

title: Cursed Conundrum
description: In Cursed Conundrum, you are immersed in a 2D pixel-art world, where you can interact with objects and solve puzzles using only your mouse. You will need to investigate objects, decipher clues, and exorcise cursed items, experiencing a mix of intrigue and discovery as you try to uncover the truth behind your master teacher’s disappearance.

title: Portrait of a Ghost
description: A "spirit photographer" learns that ghosts are far more real than he thought.

title: Cat Clean Ocean
description: In Cat Cleans Ocean, play as a cat in an astronaut suit on a serene mission to clean a polluted ocean. Explore six unique regions, using tools like the Trash Magnet and Doddy the Drone to collect trash and upgrade your equipment. Relax, strategize, and restore the ocean’s beauty.

title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - Flame's Story
description: Flame's Story — a hardcore story mod for GTA: SA with 100 hours of gameplay, where you'll be in the shoes of a man who's always out of money, many debts, but a great appetite for food!

title: Coffee Express
description: Open your own coffee shop and become a barista in the cozy and colorful world of Coffee Express! A unique experience awaits you with stock tracking, realistic coffee making experience and shop customizations. Make your customers happy by making excellent coffee in your own coffee paradise!

title: The Gray Cowl of Nocturnal
description: For a long time no one claimed the Gray Cowl of Nocturnal. The last one was the Champion of Cyrodiil at the ending days of the Third Era. But what happened after the Oblivion Crisis? Where is the Gray Cowl now? You're a thief and during stealing and pickpocketing items around the world, a vision appears in front of you. The Gray Cowl is calling. The big journey has started... Where will you go now? Many places are awaiting you. Legendary places, mysterious places, ancient places that needs to be cleaned up from the sands of time. The Gray Cowl wants you.

title: Rethawed
description:
Breathe new life into Tony Hawk's American Wasteland on PC with reTHAWed, a comprehensive mod that injects the game with a massive dose of fresh content and long-awaited fixes.

Shred with a legendary roster of skaters, including those previously cut from the game or those that hail from other Tony Hawk's Pro Skater titles.

reTHAWed doesn't just expand your skater selection, it lets you customize them further than ever with a wealth of new clothing, hats, and deck options.

Experience classic levels from across the Tony Hawk's franchise all while battling
your friends online thanks to the mods restored and improved multiplayer functionality.

On top of that, reTHAWed tackles lingering bugs in the original game, introduces a custom launcher for ease of use, and even throws in widescreen support and adjustable physics for a fine-tuned skateboarding experience.

With frequent updates adding even more content, reTHAWed is the ultimate way to revisit and revitalize Tony Hawk's American Wasteland.

title: Pippa Funnell 4: Secrets of the Ranch
Afterlight Catacombs
description: Afterlight Catacombs is a horror exploration game in which you attempt to escape a procedurally-generated labyrinth while a mysterious stalker chases you in the dark. Explore the winding tunnels, learn the secret about this dungeon and, above all, do not let your torch run out!

title: Distressed
description: 5 Player Co-Op horror investigation game. Instead of sanity, ghost draw energy from equipment to hunt. Ghost also gets helpers along the way. New take on ghost hunting.

title: Out Of Memories
description:
A surreal, minimalist spooky ride through impossible geometry, deadly traps and caustic commentary from the observers of the player's attempt to stay alive for just a little longer, as a toxin kills them little by little.

The game has text graphics and uses the character set from the original PC from 1981. It's presented as if running on that hardware, on a green phosphor monitor - with just a hint of red.

title: Fulfillment Center Simulator
description: Fulfillment Center Simulator puts you in charge of a small, scrappy warehouse fighting to grow into a fully optimized logistics hub. What starts as a rundown shack with limited tools quickly evolves into a fast-paced management challenge where every second counts, every order matters, and efficiency is the key to success. Take control of the day-to-day operations of your fulfillment center—receiving shipments, organizing inventory, preparing orders, and keeping your clients happy. As you master the workflow, you’ll expand your space, upgrade your equipment, and transform your operation from a humble startup into a streamlined, high-performance facility.

title: Water Level / B.l.u.e. Exploration
description: the water level exists for swimming

title: Gardenscapes
description: Create the perfect garden! Comb the rooms of a gorgeous mansion for hidden items and restore a once stunning garden to its former glory. Choose from tons of garden accessories to customize the garden to your taste. Become part of the city’s community and compete in the “Best Garden” contest. No worries if you are a garden design novice - an amusing and witty butler, Austin, will always be of assistance. Become an outdoor décor pro in this cutting hedge game!

title: Napobination
description: An action-rpg set in Naples, save the city from the local mafia who created an army of gigant crabs, use your skills to save your friends and fight bosses!

title: Olivers äventyr: Drakens förbannelse
description: Olivers äventyr: Drakens förbannelse is an adventure game set in a fantasy world where you play as Oliver. The dragon has awaken once again and the princess has gone missing, it is up to Oliver to rescue the princess and put the dragon back to sleep.

title: Jönssonligan: Jakten på Mjölner
description: Jönssonligan: Jakten på Mjölner is a puzzle-solving point-and-click adventure game based on the Swedish comedy films which uses the same characters but a new plot.

title: Jönssonligan: Går på djupet
description: Jönssonligan: Går på Djupet is a puzzle-solving point-and-click adventure game based on the Swedish comedic films which uses the same characters but a new plot

title: Lord of doors
description: A quirky, emotional and tragic tale of love with cosmic horror. Created by Studio Lemi.

title: Wrong Door
description: This is an abstract, chaotic and meaningless world. A man embarks on a strange adventure in pursuit of absolute power and truth. He becomes the protagonist in the story, a player. In this world, anything is possible. Many things have no explanations. Just accept the present and solve the problems. In this confusing and difficult journey, perhaps something can be understood until the end, or maybe there is still no knowledge or gain, and all the efforts end up in vain. But in any case, one cannot stop here. The road will keep extending. Keep moving forward and fighting. No matter what lies ahead, there is no fear.

title: Harbingers of Desspair
description:
You have died, and those aren't the pearly gates before you...
Your soul has traveled through a wormhole and ended up on the remains of a library on the remnants of a once thriving moon...you hear a mystical voice in your mind directing you to talk to a skeleton a short distance ahead...

After some 'training' the skeleton has you follow him to a magical rostrum where you can select a new body for your soul to inhabit...
You are presented with 32 different bodies and the ability to possess an instance of Desspair himself or one of his trusted Guild Officers before traveling back in time to try and help stop the wormhole from causing the devastation and your interesting predicament...

Embark on an epic adventure as you Explore, Quest, & Survive in the 1st batch of 14 wonderous zones...

With the setting of a Jupiter sized planet with 3 earth sized moons along with a couple pocket dimensions for good measure, good times & numerous memorable adventures are bound to be had...

title: UFO-Man
description: Control the UFO. Carry the Luggage. DON'T DROP IT. – A simple yet challenging foddian game for aliens.

title: Jill O' Lantern
description:
A slasher satire visual novel where the Final Girl, Vivian Finala, teams up with the monster, Jack Headed Jill, to find out who really killed everyone on Lake Shish Kabob.

Make choices, investigate crime scenes, and meet a cast of queer and colorful characters!

title: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
description: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

title: Bananounce
description: Idle game with banana bouncing everywhere!

title: Anomaly President
description: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

title: VinylMinty's Video Game Quiz
description: From sound effects and places to textual questions, multiple choice, naming characters based on images or voices, and many, many more, dive in with a deep mix of game tests besides music. Bring all that you love about gaming into one truly immersive experience, and it's interactive with Twitch chat to let your audience join in and help-or challenge-you along the way.

title: Find This Pixel Anomaly
description:
In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.

Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.

title: Keyboard Crush
description: 2D action game where every click determines your survival! Enemy shapes - squares, circles and triangles - drop down from above and it's your job to destroy them before they overwhelm you. Each enemy has its own specific characteristics that force you to be ever vigilant and quick.

title: Quest for Camelot: Dragon Games
description: Quest For Camelot Dragon Games is a video game published in 1998 on Windows by Knowledge Adventure, Inc., Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment Inc.. It's an action and strategy game, set in a licensed title, mini-games and medieval themes, and was also released on Mac.

title: Pour Quelques Bonbons...
description:
Play as a little child in the mysterious village of Enserine.
Collect as many candies as you can and fill your candy book before the other children and win the race !

title: Köy
description: Mystery of a village.

title: Nymphomaniac: Sex Addict
description: A visually stunning story about a nymphomaniac who loves her body, sex and adrenaline. All this presented in a photorealistic audiovisual setting.

title: Is It Okay for Me to Live
description:
A strange little Windows 98 style game about life, made for the Spooktober Visual Novel Jam 2024.

Based on some dreams and strange trips, combined into something more akin to an experience versus a traditional story. Heavy inspirations from Tsui no Sora and its peers.

title: Death to Venice
description:
Take part in a collective rite of putrefaction.

In a wounded world, you're dying. Venice - frail, alien, abandoned - welcomes you in your last moments.

Experience memories of death in Venice's past through six game poems across the city's sestiere districts: a death of biodiversity, a death of institutions, of community... then ponder your feelings on endings and change, talk it out with the city herself. It's all either of you has left.

Venice and its lagoon are dying. This game is for them, and for the Venetians who resist.

title: HamuHamu
description: A game in which you play as a hamster "Hamuhamu♪" and explore the continent of Hamrica.Meet strange people and say unreasonable things, and the story takes a strange turn.Overcome many difficulties and restore peace to the continent. Please, is it fun? full of mini games

title: Kodokuhime
description:
Himiko's been a wallflower her whole life- so plain and quiet that even the spirits around her never take an interest. But a chance encounter on her way to school might just be the thing to thrust her into the forefront of her very own story.

With black-and-white styling and comic-inspired presentation, Kodukuhime aims to emulate the feeling of a classic shonen manga- full of humor, action, and drama. Framed as the "first chapter" of what would go on to be a weekly series, it can be played through in a single 20-30 minute session.

title: Seven Seas: Adventures
description: Welcome to the Seven Seas: Adventures! Set sail and chart your course to fame, fortune, and adventure in this unique age of sail sandbox game!

title: Drosera: Lady Bad End no Hatsukoi
Her Deliverance
description:
A woman ventures to a church amid a storm to see if she can't get some help with some... eerie visions and feelings. Haunted by them, she seeks salvation in any way she can.

Is this really a curse? And if so... can she overcome it, in the end?

title: Hazel & The Deep
description: A Doxy certified classic returns! This original web game is now remastered in a new engine, fully voiced and animated to shine through its sexy glory!

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 1
description:
Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 1 - Sanatorium

- Completely New Slenderman Experience on Android and PC!
- You have to collect 8 pages, but this time you have a GUN !!!
- Shoot Slenderman and Escape the Horror.
- Great 3D Graphics
- Change Level of Details to fit your device ( phone or tablet )!

This game is not like any other Slenderman you've played.

title: This is a Black Parallelepipedon in a Yellow Field
description:
The enigma of the fields. Unknow a shape.

Consider the idea of a black storehouse in a yellow field. Charred walls. Painted walls. Walls smudged in black ash.
Maybe consider an unreal crop.
Or consider, observe, establish, evaluate an above-ground pool. Which would be an odd find, right here in the middle of a field, but then again, that structure in the middle distance has got to be something...

An absurd, alienating game developed as part of the Briefs series, a gold extra project with additional support by Strange Scaffold.

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 2
description:
Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 2 - DEAD SPACE

- New Slenderman Chapter For PC
- You have to collect 13 Energy Cells, but this time you have more guns !!!
- Rusty Bars Can Be Shot With A Weapon
- You Can Jump And Crouch! ( Trust Me You're Gonna Need It )
- Shoot Slenderman and Escape the Horror.
- Great 3D Graphics
- New Slenderman Model!
- Great KILL Animation!
- Slender Man Free Full Version

This game is not like any other Slenderman you've played.

title: El Engaño de Barbapoca: Capítulo 1 - Esta Pizza Está de Muerte
El Engaño de Barbapoca: Capítulo 2 - Competencia Fantasmal
Touhou Monjusen: Bubbling Imaginary Treasures
description:
Touhou Monjusen ~ Bubbling Imaginary Treasures is a vertical danmaku shooting fangame developed and published by Gore, who had previously released Frantically Forbidden Fruit and Re.Phantasmagoria of Imagine Breaker.

The gameplay derives elements from several official Touhou games, such as Double Dealing Character, Wily Beast and Weakest Creature, Hidden Star in Four Seasons, and Subterranean Animism. The game features five playable characters with three partners each. Your player's weaponry depends on the partner chosen at the player select screen.

The main game mechanic is the Assist Spirit Strike system. By collecting coin items dropped by defeated enemies, you fill up a gauge at the bottom of the screen. Once you have enough money, you can spend some of these coins by pressing C to activate an Assist Spirit Strike, the exact kind varying widely depending on your player character.

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 3
description: Slenderman Must Die: Silent Forest is the third episode of the Slenderman Must Die series from Poison Games.

title: One Map: Never Ending Battle Royale
description: One Map is an online shooter where the entire world fights in the same never-ending battle. No lobbies, no waiting—just instant action. The dynamic map adjusts to the player count, ensuring non-stop combat. Survive, compete, and help break the world record for the most players online in a game.

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 4
description: Slenderman Must Die: Silent Streets is an intense and chilling first person shooter game with horror elements.

title: Smoke Masks
description: A poem about fire season, with a virtual environment to explore while reading it.

title: Crust Shump
description: CRUST PUNK SHOOT 'EM UP. BLAST BEAT BULLET HELL. HARDCORE ANARCHO ARCADE ACTION. BRUTAL, BLEAK, SHORT AND INTENSE. NO SCORE, NO LEADERBOARDS, NO GODS, NO MASTERS. CAVE MEETS NAPALM DEATH.

title: Plutonium: Kilimanjaro Oddysey
description: This was originally meant to be “Plutonia 11” in reference to another Plutonia jokewad but ended up being a decent wad that mixes variety of quality in mapping (experienced and new mappers in the Project) with some humour BUT IT IS NOT A JOKEWAD.

title: Amatsuki Mahjong
description: Amatsuki Mahjong is a free-to-play ACG style mahjong game that offers real-time multiplayer online matches. It features four styles of mahjong: Japanese, Sichuan, Taiwanese, and Hong Kong Mahjong. Enjoy a variety of play styles tailored to your preferences.

title: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
description: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 5
description: Slenderman Must Die: Underground Bunker is the fifth episode of the Slenderman Must Die series from Poison Games.

title: Mad Void
description: Mad Void is a chaotic space survival online co-op, you face alone or up to 3 crewmates alarming dangers on each mission. Sent out by the Galactic Confederation to extract lost tech from fallen spaceship that succumbed in epic space battle, find your way in the mad void of space to retrieve the tech before the Enemy returns.

title: Animal Use Protocol
description: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

title: Rottweiler
description: an interactive essay on memes, labels, cauterization, and the decay beyond idealism.

title: Astrumis: Survive Together
description: Astrumis - Survive Together is an exclusively co-op horror game. One player controls a survivor on an abandoned spaceship and the other the ship itself. They must work together to survive against the mysterious monster.

title: Meikyuu Gou Mayoroba
description:
"Mayoroba Labyrinth" is an exploration adventure game where you can freely roam a mysterious labyrinth world, sightseeing and getting lost.

The game features entirely original graphics and background music , and is aimed at players who place importance on production, atmosphere, and image/sound.

It is a walking simulator-like game that focuses on atmosphere, with the main focus being on walking around, looking at the scenery, solving small puzzles, finding hidden passages, and collecting collectible items called "treasures," and there is almost no story.

title: Effulgence RPG
description: Effulgence is a party-based RPG in a sci-fi setting. Players will explore a distant, possibly extinct world, battle its hostile inhabitants, craft gear, and develop their characters. All graphics in Effulgence are made of text symbols, making it visually unique.

title: Sonic.EXE: The Assault
description: Forgetfulness… Regret… Revenge… When he makes mistakes… what would a father get from his son? What would a son do to calm his sorrow? And what would a ruthless demon commit to feed his rage.. And to calm his hunger? Play the game and resolve the mysteries through a bunch of spooky environments, lots of obstacles, challenging puzzles & an intense terrifying gameplay!

title: Blockoverse: The Legend of the Pix
description: Blockoverse: The Legend of the Pix is an upcoming 2d sidescrolling collect-a-thon platformer. After a group of hammy villains (The Cubies) accidentally unleash an ancient demon named Vertex, a square named Red must harness the powers of 5 archaic spirits, known as the Pix, in order to defeat Vertex. Traverse 5 unique worlds, each sporting their own unique enemies and challenges, on your search to find the 5 Pix, harness their awesome power and bring peace and justice back to the universe.

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 6
description: In Slenderman Must Die: Industrial Waste, you'll navigate terrifying and surreal industrial landscapes as you play a soldier lost in the chaos of war. Immerse yourself in the eerie silence as you work to find 9 vital notes that provide a way out. But beware of the lurking presence, Slenderman. This game combines elements of survival, horror, and first-person shooter gameplay for an unforgettable gaming experience.

title: Shantae and Asha: Dream Fantasia
description: A Monster World IV sequel and crossover

title: Sonic and the Mayhem Master
description:
Sonic and the Mayhem Master is a fanmade RPG game that is based on the Sonic Storybook series. The game offers a new look that fits to the aesthetic of the genre. Explore the world of steampunk, as weird things are about to happen. Solve cases with your sugar-freak partner, and find out the truth of this mechanical city.

The game was eventually rebranded, losing the ties to Sonic the Hedgehog, retitled as Mekanikko.

title: Sonic Regress
description: Sonic Regress is a fangame trying to follow the functionality of the classics of the 16-bit era, with the goal of being another classic Sonic adventure.

title: Kokoro Clover Sun: Prehistoric Invaders!
description: The second installment in the 2000s era styled anime-themed Kokoro Clover series! A visual novel paired with boss battles! Our heroes' next adventure is in...dinosaur times?! This time the bad guys are trying to destroy the future! The only way to fight back is with dino-transformations!

title: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Storybook Vale
description:
Be whisked away to the Vale and embark on an enchanting adventure with a cast of new characters including the Lorekeeper – a magical book holding this fantastical land together. However, a happily ever after is a ways off as you discover that discordance between two iconic Disney Villains - Maleficent from Disney’s Sleeping Beauty and Hades from Disney’s Hercules, has torn this land apart.

Causing mysterious phenomenon across The Vale’s three biomes – the Bind, Everafter, and Mythopia – their conflict has yielded Ink seeping out of the very ground and sent the pages of the Lorekeeper near and far as enchanted page pieces called Snippets.

title: The Amateur Deity Society
description: An interactive fiction game with a point-and-click interface. Follows the members of an ostensible high-school computer club as they attempt to program a world-simulator.

title: With Sprinkles
description: You play as Vanilla, an ice-cream boy who lives with his best pals Chocolate and Strawberry. Wander around a colorful and fun town while running errands for the big surprise!

title: Bubble Shot
description: One smart shot - bubbles gone!

title: Tae Kwon Dog
description: Tae Kwon Dog is an infinite runner where you must perform combos without touching the ground and prevent the dog from being hit. The goal is to achieve the highest score and compete on the leaderboard.

title: Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 7
description:
Slenderman Must Die: Abandoned Graveyard is another amazing installment from the sinister and creepy Slenderman Must Die series.

Find it and Burn Slendermans body + Halloween Special

In Halloween Special - Explore the big city and find 9 green pumpkins.

The game was initially released as a standalone program and Android application in October 2017. The WebGL version was released in March 2018 and has been updated with a new version in March 2019.

title: Terminal North
description:
Explore the Global Seed Bank as the official delegate from the United States Office of Disaster Preparedness.

All you have to do is deposit a few boxes of seeds.

You’re alone, cold, and in the dark, but the man on the other side of the terminal will help guide you.

Ignore the logs.

title: Fazbear in After
description: Fazbear in After is a non-horror FNaF fan game action platformer that has RPG elements, a combat game inspired by Sonic stuff about the Fazbear family saving the world from destruction.

title: I Can't Believe it's Not Sonic 1
Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 8
description:
In the episode titled From Burn To Return (Hell Fire), Slenderman Must Die: Chapter 8, demons take over the town and kidnap everyone. A horror game.

In this chapter, Slenderman has gained the power of fire, making him more dangerous than ever before, and the only man who can stop him is the town's brave firefighter.

As the player, you must save the town from this fiery nightmare.

title: Leshy Prelude
description: A horror action-adventure with a gripping story. Fight through the forest using energy granted to you by greater powers lest you succumb to the will of the forest guardian Leshy.

title: Slenderman Must Die: Survivors
description: Slenderman Must Die: Survivors is a survival shooter game that allows you to switch between third-person and first-person camera views. Choose from five different characters and confront waves of weird creatures coming at you from all directions.

title: Six Textures #3
description: 17 maps done with the main rule: *6 textures only* including the sky, but not including utility textures (trigger/clip/skip, etc.) or liquids

title: Pick Me Pick Me
description: "Pick Me Pick Me" is an innovative 2-player online game that brings the chaos and hilarity of dating to the virtual world. Step into the Battlefield of Love, where you'll compete to use your creative ideas to have an engaging conversation with different characters powered by AI, showing your stylish outfits and taste, and placing strategic skill cards to win over your virtual partner and outshine your opponent.

title: The Death of Fo-gu
description: The Death of Fo-gu is a short adventure game made for the 2024 $108 Adventure Game Challenge whose theme was: The Dunning-Kruger Effect.

title: It Takes Two to Tangle
description: It Takes Two to Tangle is a 2024 King's Quest fan game release. It is an unofficial follow-up to King's Quest VIII and continues the story of Queen Cassima, wife of King Alexander and Prince Edgar, lover of Princess Rosella on a long, perplexing journey which will ultimately decide the fate of both themselves and their loved ones.

title: Central Standard
description: Central Standard is a short adventure game made for the 2024 $108 Adventure Challenge about a cook starting an apprenticeship at the hot new restaurant: Central Standard!

title: Sesari 1
description: Sesari 1 is the first part in a haunted science-fiction point-and-click adventure game series about two women suddenly and completely losing their memory at a gas station in the middle of the desert,

title: Rise of the Pawn
description: Rise of the Pawn is a chess and poker hybrid strategy game.

title: PUBG: Blindspot
description: PUBG: BLINDSPOT is a dynamic 5v5 military shooting game, presenting a realistic and fast-paced gunplay like never before in a top-down shooting game. Use real-time shared vision with teammates and a variety of tools to create and execute creative team strategies.

title: Raanaa: The Shaman Girl
description:
Raanaa is a third person adventure 3D platformer.
Raanaa, a courageous shaman girl, helps the spirit worlds that are in danger. With the help of her shaman abilities and her magical dress, she can defy gravity.

Raanaa travels through wondrous spirit realms and collaborates with different Gods and Goddesses to fight evil spirits and deities in order to obtain balance in the universe and save humanity.
Raanaa travels through spirit worlds that are all inspired by old Saami and Norse stories and mythology. In every episode the player gets to visit in a new spirit world. Become the savior of the spirit worlds!

title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange in the Whimsical Library
description: The Capybaras with Orange are back! Find them all in the fantastic library. Search for them between books and on the stained glass windows. Light them up at night with amazing colors.

title: TAGAP 4
description:
During his adventures, the cyber-penguin Pablo has saved the world multiple times – from a world-conquering mad scientist, a megalomaniac penguin general and a whole race of space penguins from Pluto. However, an event during his previous adventure has thrown our hero out of this world. Out of this time.
What if Pablo wasn't there to save the world? What if the mad scientist Glowenko wasn't stopped in his tracks, but now rules the world with a rubber glove?
Stuck in an alternate timeline, Pablo has to find a way home while fighting the whole world gone mad.

title: Finn Dorset's Institute For Livestock Replication
description: An animated incremental game about cloning livestock. Make as many moon sheep as you can. Research technology, upgrade your operation and become a clone farm billionaire!

title: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time
description: Cards of Eternity: The Wheel of Time is a strategic card game where players harness iconic characters, creatures, and the mystical forces of the One Power from the legendary fantasy world. Build decks, master unique abilities, and outplay opponents in dynamic, lore-rich battles.

title: Cubio
description: Navigate through an atmospheric space tunnel, avoid incoming cubes and collect special ones to increase your score. The pace gradually rises and the color theme shifts over time, creating an immersive and minimal reflex experience.

title: Gor Lab
description:
This game is based on survival. Set in a zombie engulfed laboratory.
Gor Lab is a fast-paced action game that will test your reflexes and strategic thinking.

Players will find it stressed fighting the zombies while waiting for external help. With untamed calling and waiting for the arrival of backup personnel.
It becomes just a will to survive, saving the day, one day at a time.

title: Insurgency: Sandstorm - Chemical Combat Gear Set
description: Withstand challenging environments and conquer the battlefield with the Chemical Combat Gear Set for the Security team. This set includes five different cosmetic gear pieces.

title: Insurgency: Sandstorm - Protective Gear Set
description: Gear up for chemical warfare and gain the upper hand over your opponents with the Protective Gear Set for Insurgents. This set includes five different cosmetic gear pieces.

title: The Mystery of the Art School
description:
The Art School, a legendary institute deep inside the city of Toledo, a peaceful place until a promising pupil gets desappeared. Play as Willtif Smothson, a student of the Art School who gets involved into an adventure that will never forget.

Walk through the classes of the Art School, meet the students, and the teachers that makes this place unique. The Mystery of the Art School is based on the real Art School…

title: Shadowveil: Legend of The Five Rings
description: Recruit and command a party of samurai on expeditions into the Shadowlands of the Legend of the Five Rings universe. Gain experience and cards in battle to develop units and create powerful combat combinations in this strategic roguelite.

title: Mole Mine Rocks 0.15
description: Mole Mine Rocks is a clicker game where you manage a mole mining operation. Mine rocks, gather resources, upgrade your abilities, and explore levels. Hire moles for passive income, fix leaks, and interact with dynamic dialogue. Enjoy cutscenes and strategic planning to become a mine manager.

title: Slenderman History: WWII Faceless Horror
description: In Slenderman History: WWII Faceless Horror, you're plunged into a sinister World War II environment, where the Nazis are conducting nefarious experiments. The aim? Creating a super soldier and summoning Slenderman through the use of an ancient artifact.

title: Pit of Goblin
description: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed him, and you might be the next meal!

title: Kill The Music
description: Auto-Attack to the Beat of the Music and Hit Rhythm Inputs to boost your Damage! Build up your Solo Meter to trigger beautiful animations and cascading effects to mow down hordes of enemies!

title: Last Look along Woodward Boulevard
description: A horror puzzle adventure, where your thoughts and mood affect the environment around you.

title: Nonolith
description: Discover the countless secrets of the NONOLITH. Copy and paste blocks to reach new areas, and master hidden mechanics that let you do the seemingly impossible. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

title: A Little to the Left: Trick or Tidy
description: Five ghoulish new puzzles inbound for the season of scares.

title: Choko Loco 2
description: A fairly linear action adventure game where you collect spam, extra lives and fight lovecraftian monsters. There is some exploration but it's more of an action game. I consider it of the "psychological horror" genre. It is also a 3d platformer, like Mario 64 but insanely twisted. You can also swim underwater, and you will have to to finish the game. There are other environmental hazards such as mud and slime.

title: The Hundredth Hike
description: The Hundredth Hike is an Indie Psychological Horror game, living the story of you, as a mountain hiker, reliving your tragic past and finding the calm of the nature under your boots. Unaware of what lies before you, you unleash a powerful and mysterious truth.

title: Jeff The Killer: Slendermans Betrayal
description:
When two dreaded horror villains start kill-stealing from each other, all hell breaks loose and a bloody showdown begins in Jeff the Killer: Slendermans Betrayal!

This ultimate battle between two blood-chilling myths is set in a spooky urban environment, and there are a total of 14 levels to complete.

title: Pinball M: Camp Bloodbrook
description: Welcome to Camp Bloodbrook where campfire stories become a reality. Use every ounce of your pinball skills to escape the grip of Jacob Wells, The ‘Wellbound'. A slasher classic swooping you back to the 80s.

title: Starlair
description: Fly through an endless universe visiting the planets of other users and taking on their challenges in a Metroidvania style game!

title: Crispy Chicken Speedmap Session 04
description: Full 32 map megawad of autumn/fall goodness brought to you by the fine folks at @Clippy's Crispy Chicken Chillzone discord. Expect a lot of black and orange, healthy mix of natural, gothic and techbase environments, and a approachable difficulty for the most part.

title: Wayward Puritans
description: Wayward Puritans is a spooky, survival horror-inspired single level for the Doom 2 IWAD, with an ending map in MAP02. Explore a creepy mansion, uncover the secrets of an ancient cult, and fight for your sanity against forces more terrible than social science can theorize! Taking inspiration from Resident Evil 1 and cosmic horror, combat has been extensively retooled, so be prepared to make due with more meager resources than your usual Doom map.

title: Muv-Luv Supplement
description: Muv-Luv Supplement is a fan disc of Muv-Luv and contains various things, like an after story of Muv-Luv Extra; a series of short stories focusing around one of the main heroines; and Muv-Luv Duelist, which is a trading card game.

title: Ved: Recure
description: Ved: Recure is a fast-paced action roguelite where you play as an adult trapped in the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

title: Peaks of Yore: The Great Alps
description: Take the Alpine Express and travel to the picturesque Einvald Valley to conquer the Great Alps' collection of crags, boulders, mountains, and more.

title: Combine 2 Pumpkins
description: Combine 2 similar pumpkins into a new larger one! Use special pumpkins to achieve crazy combos and compete for the highest score!

title: Prison Princess: Trapped Allure
description: At long last a completely new sequel to Prison Princess, the mystery-solving adventure game where you guide princesses to escape the clutches of the Demon King!

title: Samurai of Hyuga Book 5
description: Back from hell and into Hyuga, enemies and allies clash in this epic sequel! Overcome ultimate despair or be consumed by it: the choice is yours, ronin!

title: Grounded Sim
description: In this comical adventure, you embody Giles Outlandish, who drunkenly stumbles into a portal, mistaking it for an exit from a bar. Now trapped in Kayloo's Games, you must conquer diverse levels of various game genres to escape. However, the key to success lies in entertaining the mischievous creatures and avoiding the wrath of the monsters. With simple humor and clever thinking, players must navigate this whimsical realm to find a way back home before they become trapped forever.

title: Necromantic Thirst
description: Necromantic Thirst is a Boom compatible (-complevel 9) 32-map megawad developed by the French Doom Community (and friends), inspired by some well-known classic wads of yesteryear, and featuring a new take on the standard progression : classic UAC techbases slowly but surely blend into a new, twisted, green and black hellish world. Beware of the evil spirit that inhabits these industrial and medieval worlds, or you might end up losing your sanity.

title: Office Chair Curling
description: in this game you throw office chairs at a target

title: Curvelicious
description: A fast-paced, competitive multiplayer curve game where up to 8 players battle in local matches. Customize your gameplay with dozens of power-ups and game modes, from classic no-powerup duels to chaotic arcade challenges. Master your curve and outlast your opponents! Gamepad supported.

title: The End of an Obsession
description:
You feel groggy when you finally wake up.

The back of your head is throbbing and your mouth feels dry, as though it has been stuffed full of wool.

With bleary eyes, you glance about.

What time is it?

Where are you…

And, perhaps more importantly, who are you?

Try though you might, you can’t remember.

This could very well be your end — but wait. Who is that woman standing by your bedside, who looks like a rose?

Perhaps she can help you.

Now, why don’t you open your heart up to her?

Learn how to love her, and perhaps this story might even have a happy ending.

title: Ding Dong Die
description: Even a broken clock is right twice a day

title: Shotgun II: Double Barrel
description: Shotgun II: Double Barrel is the second installment of the SHOTGUN series and while not all the changes are present in this teaser, the way the game is played will have some cool tweaks worked in, plus cutscenes and a more in depth story!

title: The Punch Drunk Monk
description: Your temple has been raided by a bloodthirsty gang and one monk has had enough! Play as Punch Drunk Monk and make your way back to your desecrated temple for a showdown with the leader! There are many different hazards throughout your quest for vengeance, as well as dangerous foes such as deadly warriors, evil sorcerers, and enraged spirits!

title: Skibidi Sandbox
description: Skibidi Sandbox is a sandbox game where you can have lots of fun. This includes spawning items such as Skibidi Toilet so you can shoot it or you can blow it up by spawning in rockets. Skibidi Sandbox is the perfect game to have some action. There are also two maps you can explore and have some fun shooting/blowing things up and finding secrets. This is the perfect game for you if you want to have some skibidi fun.

title: Ultima Online: Outlands
description:
Join us in launching the most anticipated Ultima Online server! UO Outlands is a free-to-play shard set in the T2A era with over 3 years of development.

Be among the first to form a guild, place a house, conquer a dungeon, kill one of your fellow adventurers, or master a skill. There is nothing quite like the rush of logging in with hundreds of other players for the first time, all on equal footing.

Outlands features auto-account creation, so simply download our installer, pick your assistant of choice (Razor or Steam) and login! Because Outlands is a highly customized gaming world featuring a brand new map, new monsters, new clothing items, custom hues and more, we have made the installation process as easy as possible.

title: Accolade Sports Collection
description:
Accolade Sports Collection is a retro collection featuring some of the most iconic sports games from the early 90s. This collection includes titles like Summer Challenge, Winter Challenge, Hardball 1&2 and Hoops Shut Up and Jam!.

This collection offers a complete retro gaming experience, where players can easily select from the different titles available, with features like save states, filters options, manuals and more!

title: Blades & Battles
description: Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

title: Bird Simulator 24
