title: Hardware Store Simulator
description: Compete with up to 4 players to build the most successful hardware store! Design your shop, manage inventory, hire employees, and influence market prices in this detailed business simulator. Master retail management as you expand your store empire.

title: Fortnite Festival: Season 6
description: It’s the Snoop D-O-Double G! With more than 35 million album sales worldwide, Snoop Dogg is one of the biggest rap and hip-hop icons in the world, and now he’s the Icon for Fortnite Festival Season 6.

title: Solitary Echoes
description: You were a technical support engineer on a geoforming outpost on LV-513, tasked with changing a very important light bulb when the outpost was overrun by a hostile alien lifeform. During the attack you managed to grab some supplies and lock yourself into a maintenance room. After some days, the noise and the screams from outside slowly die down. After some weeks, your supplies slowly run out. Time to head out. See what's going on. Find help. Survive.

title: World Drawn
description: World Drawn is a game in which you play as two characters who save a young girl.

title: Henk Stroem in: Lost in Cellar
Star Sentry
description: A tower defense game where player defend their star against enemies that intelligently circle around obstacles.

title: Hidden Celtics
description: Point and Click Adventure between Barcelona and a Mystical Galicia

title: Mug
description:
Mug is a clicker game where you fill a mug.

It's hot and thirsty. Click and fill the mug. Please!

title: Haunted by Femboy
description: In this choice-based NSFW visual novel after inheriting a strange house from your parents, you stumble upon an ancient book and accidentally summon a mischievous femboy ghost. Now bound to your home, the ghost becomes your roommate, and it's up to you to find the missing pages of the book while navigating your unusual new life together.

title: Quasimorph: End of Dream
description: Quasimorph: End of Dream is the first chapter of the extraction turn-based RPG Quasimorph. Confront your fears in brutal shootouts with PMC -fighters and demons and try to survive to complete your mission and bring the gear back to your spaceship!

title: Tales Beyond the Tomb: Pineville Night Stalker
description: After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a mysterious inheritance awaiting her in the town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny, she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deception.

title: Senpai Puzzle: Waifu Summer
description: The free swapping puzzle game with stunning 4K Waifus, 10 free Waifus, beautiful Waifu gallery, chill lofi music, and customizable settings. Experience the sizzling allure of Waifu Summer today!

title: Winning Post 10 2025
description: The "Winning Post" series, which celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2023, is an "authentic horse racing simulation game" in which players take on the role of an owner-breeder (horse owner and producer) and experience the drama of horses and people in the horse racing world.

title: Beyond Citadel
description: Beyond Citadel is an anime style retro throwback shooter inspired by the classics of the 90's, with realistic gunplay mechanics, anime violence and fast paced combat. Fight your way through the heavily armed mechanical fortress and discover the secret that lies beneath.

title: The Supernatural Power Troll
description:
The Supernatural Power Troll is a puzzle platformer in which you control a troll that can grant humans superpowers. By doing so, the troll overcomes obstacles and solves puzzles.
The game features diverse NPCs with AI generated dialogs, a level editor,

title: Zombie Fun Run
description: Join IRA, Crossing Guard Robot 2nd class, as he joins the Zombie Fun Run circuit and saves the day with the power of friendship and heavy artillery in this turn-based comedy RPG.

title: Ardente: La Grande Guerre
description:
In 1917, the war is violent on the Verdun front. But you are not one of those heroes who take up arms and kill enemies by the dozen. You are on the front to save the lives of wounded soldiers in the trenches. Fortunately, the invention of the “Little Curie”, a car created to transport radiology equipment on the battlefield, will help save lives where the wounded are dying.

You will drive and move from tent to tent to help doctors on site. But be careful, war is all around and the number of wounded is significant. Most will die, whether you like it or not.

Now the real question is : who are you going to save?

War isn't won with feelings and your choices will have consequences. Everything is going very fast and the slightest hesitation can be fatal for you and others.

You alone cannot change the course of war, but you can change the fate of many families.

title: Dungeon Crystal
description: Travel the seas, corrupted by evil crystals. Transform into different spirits and animals to solve puzzles. Find hidden treasures and become stronger to defeat the wild monsters. Save the islands by destroying the beautiful but destructive crystals. And take a break while catching some fish on your own sailing ship.

title: Ipseity: Arena
description: Ipseity: Arena is a modern-day take on classic fast paced multiplayer Arena Shooter genre in which players get to choose Ipseities, movement types such as bunny hopping, sliding, or walljumping that players can choose to play as before entering the fragging grounds!

title: Chalk River
description:
Chalk River is a dynamic Wild West-themed metaverse that blends immersive storytelling, intense PvP action, and player-driven exploration. Set in an expansive frontier, players can forge their legacy as outlaws, lawmen, or entrepreneurs.

Engage in high-stakes deathmatches, craft powerful NFTs, trade rare items, and complete story-rich missions to uncover the secrets of the rugged Chalk River Valley. With evolving gameplay fueled by blockchain technology, Chalk River offers a unique mix of adventure, strategy, and community-driven content. Saddle up and carve your path in this ever-expanding digital frontier!

title: Holy Valkyrie EXS-TiA: Concerto 1
description: In an ordinarily peaceful town plagued by disasters, the heroine Haruna becomes involved for reasons seemingly unknown. But in reality, she is a transforming messenger of justice on a mission to eliminate the root cause of the crisis.

title: Touhou Chaos of Black Loong
description:
Chaos of Black Loong is a Chinese Touhou Project fangame made by LonHong Team on the LuaSTG engine. It features recurring canon Touhou characters, 6 stages plus Extra and high quality voice acting.

Chaos of Black Loong reintroduces the partner mechanic. The game provides 4 playable teams with 2 characters each: Reimu Hakurei and Marisa Kirisame; Sakuya Izayoi and Hong Meiling; Koishi Komeiji and Satori Komeiji; Yukari Yakumo and Yuyuko Saigyouji

The player may freely switch between the two characters of the selected team by pressing C, along with their own shot type and Spell Card. By collecting items, grazing and defeating enemies, the Reward meter on the right side of the screen increases. Once it hits 1000, the player is awarded with a Life or a Spell piece. In addition, the game introduces a new type of item - Dragon spirits. Dragon spirits are a special item that disappear after a while onscreen. They increase the value of point items and lower the Point of Collection shown by the purple bar on the left side of the screen. The player can have at maximum 9 dragon spirits, and they can be released outside of a boss' Spell Card to cancel a radius of bullets around you. If you have at least 6, getting hit will consume 5 and give you an automatic deathbomb.

Additionally, the stage bosses in the game have secret Last Spells similar to Imperishable Night. When the halved sum of the current spells captured and dragon spirit count is higher or equal to the boss' total spell count, the boss' Last Spell will activate after the main battle.

title: Blightstone
description: Blightstone is a challenging, dark fantasy turn-based roguelike that brings unique twists to combat through freedom of character placement, interactive environments and hardcore resource management. Dying, learning, and meta-progression will be key in your mission to destroy the Blightstone itself

title: Stones of Flesh
description: Make your way through a land of unknown horrors, where the walls are made of flesh and seem to breathe as one. Defend yourself against the creatures with unique abilities in RPG combat.

title: Delicious Date
description: Can you (socially) survive your first date with a really cute and hungry guy?

title: Plain
description: A woman thrown into the future must find a way to fit in to her new reality.

title: Bat Bots
description: Enjoy a modern take on timeless arcade action with Bat Bots, a nostalgic shooter inspired by the classics. Take down waves of robotic bats using precise aim and quick reflexes. Engage in solo play, challenge your friends and family, or work together to defend against the oncoming waves.

title: Smash It Wild
description: Smash It Wild is a tactical turn-based game combining volleyball and dodgeball in a fantasy universe. Upgrade your players and defeat your opponents in an intense roguelike competition!

title: The Strange City
description: Embark on the adventure as Agent G, a lone survivor drawn into a mystery after a brutal car crash. Pursued by relentless monsters and trapped in eerie, shifting environments, you’ll need courage and wit to survive. Can you uncover the secrets at the journey's end—or will the shadows claim you first?

title: Murder on the Nord Express
description:
It's a visual novel with elements of mystery and suspense, predominantly about the relationship between the Sheriff (Postman) and the Train Conductor (Gravekeeper).
It's heavily based on the detective novel that is considered to be the inspiration behind the story of the Essence and contains spoilers for the original work.
Additionally, the characters' backstories have been altered to better suit the story, and there are lots of headcanons and personal interpretations of these characters' original deductions.

title: Crowpoint Manor
description: Step inside Crowpoint Manor, where every guest harbours a dark secret. As an undercover detective, you’ll solve bizarre puzzles, navigate dangerous traps, and witness hilariously tragic accidents.

title: Räkna med Alfons
description: Räkna med Alfons is a mathematics game starring Alfons Åberg (Alfie Atkins). In this game he teaches you how to do simple mathematics and counting using visual and sound aids.

title: Nightmare Flight
description: Nightmare Flight is a horror game that takes place in an airplane. Survive through three different horror scenarios, while trying to fly an airplane without a co-pilot. You must check on the passengers, and noises from the plane, but do not leave the cockpit for too long. The Undead, Aliens, and different creatures have boarded the plane. They will try to grab, attack, and drag you to your death. Fly the plane, while fighting off these monsters to survive the flight.

title: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler's Courtship
description: In this heartfelt novella-like story of romance, newfound friend Fuddler needs a helping hand to express his feelings.

title: FiendFinder.com
description:
At FiendFinder.com, we understand that conventional dating just doesn't cut it for everyone. That's why we've created a platform where the desperate and the damned can come together in unholy matrimony.

Whether you’re haunted by loneliness, thirsty for revenge, or yearn for forbidden knowledge, we’re here to match you with the perfect soulmate to fulfil your soul’s deepest desires – for a price.

title: Leucanthemum Eyes
description:
On a rainy day, Daisy went through a tunnel to wait out the rain.
Suddenly she found herself in a place that looked like a sewer, but hellish.
Daisy needs to escape from that place full of ghosts and a beautiful mysterious women.

title: Procedure
description:
A game made very quickly for Flatgame Annual 2016. I had surgery with a general anaesthetic for the first time in my life just before Christmas. This game is my response.

I tried to follow the rules for a flatgame as closely as possible – to make me work differently. The most striking thing for me is how directly personal it turned out. I had a vague idea of what the game might be about. The graphics were abstract scribbles done in half an hour. The game was put together in about three hours. I'm aware I haven't done anything interesting with space in the game but the focus was very much on the story.

title: Mythic Merchants
description: Craft magical gear in a bustling workshop! Upgrade your tools, automate processes, and hire goblin interns as you travel through time. Meet quirky heroes like Tony the chronomancer, Mino the strong minotaur, Rana the alchemist frog, and Vulf the tech-savvy wolf. Will you become a Mythic Merchant?

title: Gravity Goomba
description: Enter space as a lonely Goomba. Explore a small universe and discover the locations of the Power Stars.

title: SpreadCheat
description: SpreadCheat is a puzzle game that fuses intricate spreadsheet challenges with a comedic, 90s financial vibe in a retro Windows 3.11 setting. The Player takes on the role of the new office prodigy, solving absurd tasks and manipulating spreadsheet cells to hit specific targets using clever formulas.

title: Right Turn
description: Challenge your attention to detail and driving skills in this 3D psychological thriller. Spot the anomalies and take a right turn to draw closer to the exit. Fail and be forced to start over!

title: Amabieda! (Like FC)
description: A shoot'em up with 8-bit console-style graphics. Japanese Yokai, Amabie, defends the galaxy by defeating COVID!

title: Escape From Castle Matsumoto
description: Two shinobis race against each other to recover stolen items and escape a Japanese castle, using their wits and tricks to outsmart the opponent. Retro split-screen duel arcade game using pixel art in 3D.

title: A Pinky Problem
description:
Skye has lots of friends! That's because she's the coolest girl you've ever met: stylish, and kind, and talented, and bad at keeping her mouth shut when she needs to.

You said you'd keep her secret safe, but she hasn't been making it easy. As the years flew by, her secret grew bigger, until you found yourself snarled in a web of lies and questionable choices.

With your biggest hurdle looming over the horizon, you've got a stressful three days ahead of you.

How far will you go to fulfil your promise?

title: I'm Not Crazy, Right?: The Cell
I'm Not Crazy, Right?: The Well
Tiny Pasture
description: Meet your new little desk buddies! They’ll snooze, scratch, and scamper around while you work or study (don’t worry, they’ve been trained not to invade your workspace). If you’re good at animal management, they will occupy the bottom of your screen with different kinds and colors!

title: Indiana Jones and the Crown of Solomon
Siren Head: The 8 Pages
description: This game is based off of the game Slender: The Eight Pages but instead of Slenderman it is Siren Head and this game also has unlockables and secrets

title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of the Spheres
Indiana Jones y la estatua sagrada
Death By Chatter
description: A 2D platformer rage game developed by Youtuber PinoPrime that is directly affected by your Twitch chat. Try to get to the top as your own chat sabotages you along the way! (Disclaimer: Game may cause rage even for epic gamers like me)

title: Opia
description: Opia is a short comedy-horror visual novel with a few endings and many choices. The player is on their first date with Kira, but right from the start, things feel strange.

title: Informe Zenteno
description: Travel through Chile on the early 90s, while trying to discover who is the mysterious bomber!

title: Cum On! Bukkake Ranch!
description: We'll grant the Demon Queen's demands! Live a lovey-dovey life on the ranch with monster girls!

title: Whispering Hills
description: Whispering Hills is a Mod for Fallout 4 that aims to reproduce the look and feel of Silent Hill inside the Game of Fallout 4. It is made by Team Whisper and is to be considered a Fanmade free mod.

title: Minecraft: The Traveling Trader
description: Trade us absolutely nothing, in return, we’ll give you a Traveling Trader adventure! Explore multiple villages, meet a cast of delightful villagers, and learn terrific new trades. Do we have a deal?

title: Minecraft: 10 Years Of Minecraft
description: Celebrate 10 Years of Minecraft with this amazing new map from BlockWorks. Witness the History of Minecraft from its humble beginnings, wander the Mob Garden, explore glorious Redstone Contraptions, and much more. Keep an eye out for Hidden Easter Eggs and secrets.

title: Minecraft: James Web Space Telescope
description: Explore NASA’s groundbreaking work in a dynamic and interactive new way. Engage with exciting, hands-on tutorials that explore the wonders of the James Webb Space Telescope. Learn about star formation, planet characteristics, and Galaxy structures then dive into a Creative Build Challenge to create your own solar system.

title: Powdergray
description:
Suffering from a severe heart condition, Satomi Kubodaira's life is prolonged
by a combination of medical progress and miracles...
But he receives the news that he will die by the age of 24.

He starts living with childhood friend Fumiyo Nukui to spend the days left to him...
But one day he becomes lost in an unfamiliar part of town.
In the midst of his helplessness, he witnesses a murder.

Cornered by the lust murderer Some Fujiwara,
Satomi is suddenly on the receiving end of a confession of love...

title: Spellwheel
description: Combine runes and sling spells with a magic wheel to defeat goblins, knights, and killer robots. Experiment with magical runes, fight quirky enemies, and defy the will of Death itself, all to rescue your beloved.

title: Knightfall Showdown
description: Step into the ultimate chess rumble! In Knightfall Showdown, 100 players face off on a massive board, upgrading pieces and outsmarting opponents in intense elimination rounds. Strategize, rise through the ranks, and become the last piece standing!

title: There Exists Nobody
description: You arrive at a deserted street that feels familiar yet is filled with unease. Pick up your camera, capture the hidden anomalies, and break this endless loop.

title: HR Simulator
description: An HR management simulator about navigating workplace dynamics, hiring and training a diverse workforce, and balancing professional growth with personal life in a bustling cityscape.

title: Arisen Force: Life Devotee of Wukong
description: Enjoy a free-to-play, stylish action combat experience as you explore a chapter storylines from Journey to the West.

title: Butterfly Dream
description: What is the experience of mixing Chinese Taoism philosophy into a Dark Horror Middle-age world? Do you want to do gun parry like Bloodborne in PC? You will find it all in Butterfly Dream, an old-fashioned Souls-like game.

title: Snowboard Legends
description: Get ready for a thrilling snowboarding adventure! This game lets you ride through 12 exciting tracks filled with jumps, sharp turns, and breathtaking snowy landscapes. Race down steep slopes, carve through icy forests, and discover hidden shortcuts.

title: Escape Depths of Immanis
description: Escape the treacherous depths of Immanis, where danger lurks at every turn. Navigate through dark and mysterious caverns, harvest valuable resources, and outsmart relentless enemies as you fight to reach the surface. Will you survive the depths and find your way to freedom?

title: Lil Guys
description: Lil guys building castles and fighting monsters. Build creative defenses, protect the crown, and make more lil guys.

title: Locomotive 115
description: It's difficult to know how many locomotives have been swallowed by the suffocating blizzards of the Widow's Run. Cursed with creeping tales of things that lurk in the dark and overshadowed by frequent casualties, it now stands as your only path forward. Will you be able to survive?

title: Altered Anomalies
description: You are trapped in a nightmare on Mumbai's late-night local train. Shift between horrifying alternate dimensions as reality bends around you. Use your phone to scan, analyze, and solve puzzles in the warped world. Race against time to find your way home before the altered anomalies consume you.

title: My Daughter In Family Ai
description: As the one who has been entrusted with their young child by FengHuang, you are going to be the father/mother of the Daughter. With different method and attitude of parenting, you will lead her walk to many more possible endings.

title: Spirit Level
description: Jump, twirl, and flip your way around this spooky castle! Unlock doors and find your way through this haunted land. Collect all your lost spirit buds, and unlock the mystery of the tower.

title: Dosukoi Slime
description: The player's slime is weak at the start and starts at the bottom of the standings. It is a slime that gradually becomes stronger, and you will move up the rankings. The goal of the game is to become the champion in five seasons. Good luck!

title: Clones Run
description: A puzzle action game where Clone humans race through stages aiming for the goal! Move blocks that are impossible to handle alone by teaming up with everyone! Bring as many clones as possible to the goal!

title: PrismNeedle
description: PrismNeedle is a Roguelike Survivors game where you can take control of living magical helmets and fight waves of enemies using unique swords and upgrades.

title: Virus Hunter
description: Become a nanomachine and defend the human body from viruses and bacteria! How long you can live depends on your efforts.

title: Karoshi Club
description: Explore the afterlife world of Yomi as a soul sales manager in the Japanese business punk first-person horror adventure "Karoshi Club".

title: Hollow Space
description: Hollow Space is a multiplayer horror FPS game where you play as a mutant or member of the rescue crew.

title: Nox Mortalis
description: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

title: Batography
description: Play as a curious bat on his mission to take a full fledged photo of the moon. Run, Climb, Glide and Snap your way through an array of obstacles while interacting with the cheeky characters in the neighborhood. Can you collect all ten moon cakes?

title: Hotel 188
description: Exploration and calm horror game. Walk around, look around, and search for clues to escape. There are no monsters chasing you or jumping out at your screen. It can evoke fears of getting lost, darkness, and tight spaces.

title: Grandma's In Hell
description: Addictive and unique tower defense game. Play as Grandma as she outwits waves of demons across 40 amazing levels. Build mazes that send demons to their doom. Spend countless hours on one of the best strategy games available.

title: Ship of Mist
description: In the future world, artificial intelligence will replace the human brain, causing humans to lose their dreams and self-awareness. Weak Water will steal dream storage tanks to restore self-awareness and earn rich rewards for a small number of people, but she will encounter various thrilling events.

title: 1989 After the War
description: An atomic war has reduced the world to a heap of ruins. However, there are still those who refuse to give up and seek to bring justice even in this chaos. Use your blade, granades and shotgun to fight your way through this post-apocalyptic scrolling action-platformer in pure 80s arcade style.

title: Maestro's Cold War 2
description: Revive the Cold War in this simple yet effective strategy game, offering depth and great replayability.

title: Magical Massage
description: In a world where magic reigns, you're a rare mundane masseur, easing stressed magicians to prevent disaster. Flaming nostrils, flowers sprouting from backs, floods on the bed—nothing too fancy that you can't handle. However, if your skills fall short, these powerful, unclothed threats may kill you.

title: Compactory
description: Team up with your friends in a small space to produce as many resources as you can!

title: Rusty Dudes
description: Assemble a team to complete various missions, while fighting off hordes of freaks. In your will be available two dozen unique mercenaries with different skills. Combine them at your discretion.

title: Twinsanity: Trapped in Time
description: Twinsanity: Trapped in Time is an RPG game which is based on the series "Twinsanity The Animated Series". Prepare to race against time with the evil mastermind Time Shadow. He trapped Twinsanity in another timeline and your job is to return him home. Are you ready to help him?

title: Echoes of the Architects
description: Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where creativity drives victory. Design modular, programmable units to build your perfect army. Adapt and outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes that reward tactical precision, ingenuity, and strategic mastery.

title: Tierras Runicas
description: Runic Lands MMORPG: Save the 10 survivors and defeat Drakoria on planet Earth... Venture to unknown islands after the ship Khamisa was shipwrecked.

title: James Bond: Who Wants to Live Again?
The Legend of Zelda: Chaos Rising
Slime Feet
description: Slime Feet is a linear visual novel, a love story for everyone who has ever had to love through a keyboard. Slime Feet is about the body horror of an inevitable drawn out death, and the lesbian slime feet cybersex that comes with it.

title: Fire Emblem: Path of a New World
description:
Fire Emblem: Path of a New World follows the tale of the Wayfarers, a group of elite soldiers sent to control a rebellion born of an aristocratic conspiracy, trying to subjugate Trames under the rule of it's sworn enemy, Algard, both countries of the continent of Gravia.

Their tale continues as they find much more than a war or a political crisis...

title: PACS: Post Apocalypse Courier Service
description: Can you build delivery vehicles to survive the post apocalypse? Go it alone or with up to 4 friends as you navigate treacherous environments, make deliveries, customise vehicles, scavenge for parts, and grow your delivery business!

title: Metroid RPG: Kilo Squadron​
description:
One of the Federation's finest teams, comprised of a group of...misfits, to put it somewhat bluntly.

This game is a spinoff akin to Shadow the Hedgehog and Luigi's Mansion, and Sonic Chronicles and Paper Mario, where the spotlight shifts to background characters, in this case a bunch of new ones, with a different RPG genre. Samus is almost nonexistent, instead the game focuses more on the biology, lore and backstory that enriches every Metroid game to date. It gives backstories and even a sense of family to once-faceless characters.

title: Defend Your Flaahgra
description: Reinterpreting the events in Metroid Prime's Sunchamber, Defend Your Flaahgra tells the tragic tale of a mutant flower's fight for survival in its own home. Using simple mouse controls, you must wield a diverse array of attacks and upgrades to resist the incoming legions of creatures and unleash the true power of the mighty Flaahgra!

title: Mega Man: Day in the Limelight 3
Project P
description: Explore the maze, run for your life and aim your arrows carefully in this minimal top down survival game.Use the layout of the maze to sneak around, take your shot and run before you get spotted by the monster you are trying to take down.

title: Super Mario XP
description: A Mario fan game that combines the world and level design of the Super Mario Bros. games with the slower platforming gameplay, aesthetics and combat of the Castlevania series.

title: Super Mario Terrestrial
description: Super Mario Terrestrial is a platformer with a Super Mario World-styled gameplay.

title: Mario & Luigi: 4 Party
description:
Mario & Luigi: 4 Party is a fangame of the well-known Mario Party series. It is a multiplayer game centered around playing as Mario and co. in minigames reminiscent to the Mario Party games themselves.

The game consists of several fun games in which four players battle each other for victory!

title: Metroid Dread
description: Join intergalactic bounty hunter Samus Aran in her first new 2D Metroid story in 19 years. Samus’ story continues after the events of the Metroid Fusion game when she descends upon planet ZDR to investigate a mysterious transmission sent to the Galactic Federation. The remote planet has become overrun by vicious alien lifeforms and chilling mechanical menaces. Samus is more agile and capable than ever, but can she overcome the inhuman threat stalking the depths of ZDR?

title: The Legend of Zelda: Time Crystal
The Black Maple Anomaly
description: Another Anomaly, Another Mission. It's your job to work your way down the floors of the Black Maple Motel, Keep track of the anomalies, and reach the Lobby to try and safely close the Anomaly that has enveloped the building.

title: Forestygian
description: Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Action RPGs. Build a powerful deck to support abilities of your hero. Use abilities to puzzle through hordes of enemies.

title: Songs of Rats
description: The Wreckage resounds with the echoes of countless songs, filling the air of a constantly shifting maze where bravery and sacrifice are key to staying alive. Then, without warning, one song goes silent. Will you step into this dicey labyrinth and uncover its secrets in this minimalist and dark RPG?

title: Jonny and the Sweet Fragrance of Feces
Five Nights at Freddy's Stars
description:
Five Nights at Freddy's STARS it's a Team-Based Online Fan-Game for up to 8 players.

Select a team: Protect or Attack, your main goal it's to get the highest score to win!

title: Spiral Clicker: Christmas Survivors
description:
Helen, your servant and partner-in-crime has a special surprise for you this Christmas; a trip to the North Pole realm where you can add Sandy to your harem. There is just one small problem; someone else already beat you to her!

With the North Pole swarming with mindless elves, imps, and succubi, the only chance you have of adding Sandy to your harem will be to survive their attempts to break your will and stop the source of Sandy's corruption... So you can corrupt her yourself.

6 characters from Spiral Clicker make an appearance in the game, and each specializes in one of the 6 spells in the game to change how that spell works for them.

Each character has a 5 part story line that plays out between stages, each concluding with a new full screen CG.

title: Super Phantasy Fighters
description: Super Phantasy Fighters is a "Phantasy Star Online 2" fan game, with Smashlike fighting game elements, featuring a unique cast of monster fighters.

title: Westild's Law
description: Westild's Law offers shootouts where you must use every element of your arsenal to win. Throw dynamite or your weapon at your enemies to stun them when ammo runs low and then take their weapons. When the situation gets critical, activate "ultra-sense", slow-down time and enhance your abilities. Embark on adventures through 48 levels, each offering unique challenges.

title: Tombs of Myra
description: Descend into the cursed tombs of Myra and free the souls of ancient warriors.

title: Shirogane Maid Club
description: A whimsical romantic comedy centered around the Maid Club!

title: Fish Shop Simulator
description: Manage your own aquarium shop in a cozy neighborhood of New York. Buy and sell fish, aquariums, and decorations to friendly customers. Create beautifully decorated aquariums and make a profit by selling them!

title: Souls That Wait: Penunggu
description: Step into the shoes of a new security guard at a Malaysian school with a dark history in this first-person, realistic supernatural thriller. Encounter spirits rooted in Malaysian folklore, make critical choices to free trapped souls, and uncover the truth behind the eerie manifestations.

title: Coin Cascade
description:
Coin Cascade is a crowd-play game designed around the classic 2p Machine and is a traditional arcade game, We have two looks to the game which allows users to change the machine to different views.

Twitch streamers share the gameplay with their followers, interacting through chat and video. This is a gaming collision of Arcade 2p Machines and social video streaming at its finest, with a growing collection of playable Machines.

title: Dino-Ducks Dash
description:
Dino-Ducks Dash is a 2D Hi-Score Multiplayer Runner with PvP and Co-Op or you can even play it as a single player to beat the leaderboard.

It has a couch co-op mode and an online co-op mode, but you can also beat the stuffing out of the other cute Dino Ducks with a machete!

title: Beneath the Frost
description: Beneath the Frost is a short, single-player, psychological horror game set on a frozen, desolate planet. You take on the role of the sole survivor of a spacecraft crash, using a robot companion to gather parts for an SOS device while uncovering an eerie mystery that suggests they may not be alone.

title: False Hope
description: False Hope is a survival visual novel set in a winter that doesn't forgive. One camp, rations for four, a fifth on the way. Every choice costs you: who to feed, who to trust, who to let die. Sharp dialogue and one-way forks, where you decide what hope is worth and when it turns into a lie.

title: Planet Miners
description: Control a mining robot and dig for mineral resources on various planets. Transport the valuable ores with your spaceship. Buy or craft upgrades to improve your tools. Defend yourself against the dangers of each planet to mine even the most valuable treasures!

title: Aleator
description: Can Debt-laden gamblers grab at straws and escape, or plunge into a bottomless pit

title: Kingdom Ascension
description: Step into the role of a lord, starting from scratch to build your kingdom. Gather resources, construct buildings, recruit troops, explore, and embark on adventures to continuously expand your territory and defend your homeland.

title: Brahmarakshas
description: "The Cursed Monk" provides a rich narrative experience, combining exploration, puzzle-solving. The village, named Bhagwatpur , is a picturesque and tranquil place nestled at the foothills of the Himalayas.

title: Idle Sphere
description: A supreme idle game played by fantastic spheres. Its overwhelming beauty in your hands.

title: Evil Dungeons 2
description: This is a first person shooter dungeon-master-like style, for the 40th anniversary of the Thomson MO5 computer. The game is in French only, but you don't really need to speak French in order to play it.

title: Eve Frontier
description: EVE Frontier is an in-development, crowd-built virtual world and player-driven sandbox. As a space survival simulation its inhabitants will find themselves awakened within a shattered region of space, warped by the presence of supermassive black holes gravitationally bound in a macabre dance. Rogue AI infests its depths; corrupting and consuming the remnants of what still stands.

title: Quantum Witch
description: Wake up lovely, you've got things to do! First, find your lost flock of faer. Then find your wife, she'd look so cute wearing that flower you found. And if you have time, attack and dethrone god. Ok? Don't worry about that portal. I'm sure it's nothing. Now be careful. Every choice matters.

title: La Carbonara
description: A short adventure game with multiple endings about how the iconic italian dish is made.

title: 868-Back
description:
The Hacker was known as the best of the best, delving into dark servers no one else could penetrate and returning with glittering data to sell on the black market.

Nobody knows why they quit. Some say their will was broken by the dark secrets at the heart of the Mainframe. Some say they simply retired to a penthouse suite in Low Earth Orbit.

But when you leave the world of high-stakes cybercrime, it's hard to stay gone. With a call from an old enemy in need of help..

868-HACK is 868-BACK.

title: La Caza del Espía
description: find evidence against Gustav Monch, allegedly a German Spy

title: Explorers of Esmar
description: Explorers of Esmar is a game about building your settlement and establishing complex production chains.

title: Super EarthBound
description: An unofficial crossover game that combines the platforming of Mario with the characters of EarthBound.

title: MXGP 24: The Official Game
description:
After a 3-year break, the official game of the MXGP is back. All the official bikes and 20 tracks of the 2024 calendar await to give you the full championship experience.

Play as your favourite riders, such as Jorge Prado, Jeffrey Herlings, Maxime Renaux and Andrea Adamo in the MXGP and MX2 categories. Over 50 riders are available, including those from official teams like Red Bull KTM, Red Bull GasGas, Monster Energy Yamaha, Honda HRC, Kawasaki, Nestaan Husqvarna, Monster Energy Triumph, Fantic and Beta MRT.

The extensive career mode offers full immersion in the championship. Manage the development of your team, schedule and rivalries. Start out as an amateur rider with the aim of being recruited by an MX2 team and, once in the MX2, achieve great results to be selected to join an MXGP team.

By free riding around the 4 km² (1.5 sq. mi.) training area, you can improve your technique and test your bike on six circuits and different terrain types.

MXGP is a realistic game that uses advanced physics to provide intense riding sensations, while offering user-friendly controls to help beginners quickly improve.
And for the more competitive players, the online multiplayer mode lets you compete against the best riders in the world.

title: Mario and Donkey Kong's Lost Island
Mario Learns About Colors
description: Mario Learns About Colors is a platform puzzle game that requires you to paint Mario different colors to pass through blocks and reach the silver pipe.

title: Hunting Simulator 3
description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog or fellow hunters by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

title: Deadcam
description: Sealed shut inside a rural, abandoned house for a paranormal hunting TV show.. Something is VERY wrong with Margo. Her live headcam is still rolling.. and you can see the whole thing. Run, hide, and escape the house in this first-person survival horror. And remember: the raccoon knows everything.

title: Passant: A Chess Roguelike
description: Passant is a chess roguelike. Gather powerful pieces, items to win unwinnable games and badges which can provide power-ups and change how the game is played.

title: Throne of Valoria
description: An epic 2.5D RPG adventure with metroidvania elements and unique artstyle. A compelling story with challenging bosses and fluid combat, all in an immersive environment

title: U.A.S
description: A psychedelic first person shooter heavily inspired by Cruelty Squad, made as a submission to LSDJam 2023 and serves as a spiritual sequel to Portland: 2024.

title: Nekron: 24
description: A fast paced FPS Roguelike where you, a rogue AI created by the last Supercomputerist, are tasked with forging connections between programs. On your mission you will also destroy unthinking machine men and rescue relics of humanity.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Aurelia
This War of Mine: Forget Celebrations
description:
This is a charity initiative. All proceeds go to our partners: War Child, Amnesty International, Liberty Ukraine, and Indie Games Poland Foundation.

10 years have passed since the release of This War of Mine and the game’s message still remains poignant. In October 2024, the game was awarded a Special Recognition Award by Amnesty International. Sadly, the same award shows that the world hasn’t become a more peaceful place since the game launched in 2014. So instead of a big celebration, we’ve decided to dedicate this anniversary to doing the right thing. This War of Mine: Forget Celebrations is a DLC with a new story, special items, and, most importantly, a chance to support people in need.

title: Mind Benderz X
description: A short, psychedelic first person shooter.

title: Flesh Prison
description: Flesh prison. Who is trapped? You? Or your mech. Blast your foes with immense firepower. Rocket launchers, machine guns, and your trusty massive flesh saw. Turn off your lights, close the door, turn up the volume and rip the knob off. Blow them to pieces as this is what you are now, you are no different than the beasts you massacre. Is this earth? Or is this hell?

title: Dust and Echoes
description:
Dust and Echoes is a semi-open world fps that takes place in Oregon after doomsday. The game has 3 missions that can be completed in any order. After completing all 3, a new location will open on the map for the ending.

You can engage with NPCS and merchants to buy better gear and replenish health and ammo. Killing raiders will also allow you to sell their fingers for currency. "Dire coin" is the crypto currency of this world.

Underneath lies a story about accepting your face and learning to deal with the issues that surround you. Your life is what you make of it.

title: The Dreamer
description: The Dreamer is a top down shooter where you, the player, engage in a psychedelic dream version of New York City. This game is short and contains two separate endings. See if you can complete them both. NPCs can help you with hints to that days quest. Created by Hunter Brown and Josie Coulter.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Shattered Dimensions
What is this Thing?
description: What is this Thing? is a highly unconventional, episodic platform game made by DJ Yoshiman.

title: Portland 2024
description: FPS inspired by LSD Dream Simulator and Cruelty Squad. Fight your way through each level and explore till you find doorways with moving smiley faces.

title: A Woman for All Seasons
description: A short 1 room adventure game visual novel

title: Ant: Protect The Queen
description: Face endless hordes of fierce and powerful invaders. Fight, gain experience, evolve and become stronger to protect the queen.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Oracle of Secrets
Nether Dungeons
description: Nether Dungeons is an action-packed dungeon crawler. Battle through procedurally generated dungeons, face relentless enemies, and defeat epic bosses. Customize your hero, wield diverse weapons, and survive intense challenges as you descend into ever-changing, dangerous depths.

title: Polarity Warthog
description: A sci-fi noir themed horizontal shooter. Somewhere deep in space, battle the dark energy alien forces, while collecting light energy to level up your weapons.

title: Vartra Abyss
description: Vartra Abyss is an isometric ARPG that has the player exploring a dystopian underground cavern in search of their lost friend. You must learn to fight using your new abilities that you will attain by slaying enemies. Play your way and mix up your abilities to suit your playstyle.

title: PockeDate!
description: Your Pocket-Sized Dating Simulator! Every launch brings a new date with unique dialogues! Spend endless hours with your adorable, love-struck virtual girlfriend.

title: Mortadelo y Filemón: Una Aventura de Cine - Edición Original
description: Extended version of the merging of 'Dos vaqueros chapuceros' and 'Terror, Espanto y Pavor,' with additional and alternative content.

title: Memoralysis: The Scorched Home
description:
An unusual case calls for an unusual detective.

MEMORALYSIS is a murder mystery visual novel with point and click elements that follows the psychic detective Philon Delancy to a strange seaside town to solve the murder of one of its most notable public figures. What starts as a routine house call quickly reveals a tangle of messy relationships, local superstitions, and past unsolved mysteries— and at the center of it all is the victim’s enigmatic niece, Celosia James.

He’s not one to balk at whisperings of the occult. How could he, when the greatest tool at his disposal is the ability to catch glimpses of his suspects’ memories? But surely the rumors about the young heiress have been greatly exaggerated. After all, everyone knows demonic possession isn’t real.

title: Angel Legion: Future Dream - Green
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Rayadillo
description: History-inspired game set during the Philippine-American War. Pick up your rifle and defend your country from both external and internal threats. The current version revolves around the Aswang storyline.

title: Nephilim Resurrection
description: Embark on a furious journey, protecting precious cargo in a perilous world. Boomer shooter mechanics blend with puzzles and strategic encounters. Engage in PvE action, solve puzzles, and battle foes to a heavy metal soundtrack, immersing you in the adrenaline-fueled atmosphere.

title: Desperate 1: After Sunset
description: The first work of the "Desperate" series - After Sunset, it’s a horizontal 2D action game with hand-painted, and using a new keyboard operation, you can feel a more intuitive combat experience in this game. Fight for the thing you loved in your life in every street you pass by！

title: Glass Heart: Retold
description: A modern romance otome/visual novel filled with drama, angst, adventure and, most of all, love. With a twenty percent chance to survive, you decide to experience living outside of a hospital for the first time. Can your heart handle the love that you find along the way?

title: Sweet Cards
description: Sweet Cards - is a card-matching game. Players can choose one of three decks of cards to match. Each deck of cards has a different style. As long as the player successfully matches all the cards, he can enjoy the beautiful girl's beauty in the viewing mode at any time. Tutu.

title: My Caligula
description: My Caligula follows the Roman Emperor Caligula and his sisters as they navigate college life in the modern day. In this visual novel your choices will determine if you live or die as well as your love interest.

title: Battlerace Support Package
description: Your purchase of the package is crucial for our operations, enabling the development of more innovative games. With your help, we can continue working on creating satisfying productions that will deliver unique experiences to our players. Thank you for your support!

title: Quest Girl
description: 《Quest Girl》is a cute and relaxing mini-game that takes place in a miniature fairy tale world. Players can explore the world, collect stars, and use them to heal small animals. Please enjoy this beautiful little landscape.

title: Okthryssia and Saturnia's Bureaucratic Adventures
description: Help Okthryssia and Saturnia navigate the tormented ways of bureaucracy and claim their inheritance.

title: Glitch Hero
description: A fatal error has trapped Ada’s father inside Codeland! As young Ada, wield the (virtually) mighty hammer.exe and debug the corrupted virtual world while learning basic coding concepts in an irreverent, fun and thrilling action puzzle adventure.

title: Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes - Hope of the Alliance: Special HQ Statue
description: Add-on for Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes, containing 1x Special HQ Statue - (Nowa Haniwa) Please double-check all descriptions before purchasing.

title: Hell Let Loose: Airborne M1942 Reinforced
description: Drop into the thick of the action with our latest Free DLC. This uniform showcases the historical changes the US Airborne had to make to their uniform due to the material lacking strength in key areas such as the elbows and knees.

title: Angel Legion: Shadow Woven - Blue
description: Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world! Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy…… Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

title: Molo's Revenge
description: Molo's Revenge is the incremental journey of a mole dragon to avenge his village by doing the thing he does best: Digging.

title: R-Space
description: R-Space is a fast-paced first-person shooting game that supports up to 4 people online. Players need to survive round after round of trials, continuously strengthen their abilities, and challenge higher rounds.

title: Mercenaries of War
description: Welcome to Mercenaries of War, an online hardcore PvP survival game with permanent death.Keep yourself protected by buying weapons and stocking up on bullets. If you die, your character is permanently dead and you will have to start over fresh.

title: Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade: Nekozeno Shin - Collaboration Commemorative Residentization DLC
description: A collaboration DLC project between "Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade" and Vtuber "Nekozeno Shin"! The phantom thief "Nekozeno Shin" appears in the world of "Rota's Nautical Chronicles of Trade" transformed into a pixelated character!?

title: Embershade
description: A psychedelic roguelike where you sell pieces of your soul to gain power against surreal, impressionistic monsters.

title: Gates of Despair
description: Gates of Despair is a captivating single-player survival horror game with multiple chapters. Experience randomized gameplay, creepy jumpscares and terrifying enemies. Uncover the captivating story through cutscenes and master a variety of challenges. Are you brave enough?

title: Melly the Naughty Dog
description: Melly the Naughty Dog is a short, funny point-and-click puzzle game with hand-drawn and digital art. Play as Melly, navigating his dream world, solving puzzles, and meeting characters like the fairy dog and the knight to reclaim his jug and return home.

title: Floor X
description: Floor X is an anomaly hunting game. You need to escape from a surreal office where the space is constantly changing. Take pictures of anomalies, try to survive and reach floor 0.

title: DachStudio Puzzle Box: Robots by datGestruepp
description: Get 20 beautifull traditionally hand drawn Robot paintings from datGestruepp to puzzle.

title: Silent Breach
description: A short cosmic horror game where you remotely operate a land rover through an unknown planet labeled the silent zone.

title: Telomeria
description: A short, horror themed point-and-click adventure set in an empty, dreamlike pre-rendered world.

title: Holi-Zone 97
description: Holi-Zone 97 has been saved from digital obscurity and its restored servers now live in the public domain. Check out the most popular holiday-themed MMO of 1997. 64kb internet connection recommended.

title: P.O.S.S.U.M.
description: Explore the city rooftops and a haunted hotel lobby to find artifacts from the past. Made for the Haunted PS1 2021 Madvent calendar.

title: Please Don't Feed the Creatures of the Deep
description: Use your trusty potato gun to feed the local wildlife. Horror-themed low-poly shooter set by the sea.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Chiming Bells
description: Join Link and Chia in their adventure to stop Rodrick in the only steam punk inspired Zelda fangame created!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Threads of Despair
Pokémon Berserk Version
description:
The Awakening Phenomenon is a phenomenon we have recently discovered by using the power of the Berserk Gene found from different types of species of Pokémon.

It temporarily increases your stats in battle, although the phenomenon still has a couple of quirks so you may not want to use it all the time, or else your Pokémon may have some... Unfortunate side-effects.

title: Zueirama 2077
description: Zueirama 2077 is an update to the game Zueirama, the humor game based in brazilian games now with an futuristic aesthetic.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Time Walker
The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Online
No Stars No Problem
description: Awaken from your dream and explore the liminal remains of a dead universe. Explore an open city scape with all sort of platforming mechanics. Run across billboards, double jump between platforms, and leap from wall to wall. Talk to a wide variety of NPCs and delve into deeper and deeper states of unreality.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Mask of the Gods
The Adventures of Zomboy
description: A bite sized post apocalyptic point and click adventure game, where you play as a passive zombie.

title: Metroid Defense
description: Metroid Defense is a metroid themed 'Maul' Tower Defense Game. Like other tower defense games, the player builds towers to fight off hordes of enemies, but unlike most, the path is not defined - the player makes their own maze out of the towers.

title: Lights Out Luigi
description: The objective is to shine your flashlight on the boos by moving the mouse up and down and then click them with the left mouse button to make them disappear.

title: Paper Mario
description:
This game is a mix between Paper Mario and other traditional platformers. The player moves around in the same way he does in the original Paper Mario, while fighting enemies in a platformer-like style.

There is a point-based rank system in the game. Each time you defeat an enemy, you earn points. Every time you earn a certain number of points, you level up and earn more health. This gives you a reason to want to stop each and every goomba!

Paper Mario is a fangame that has been in development for about 2 years. It is a heavily edited version of Twinimage's Paper Mario Engine.

title: Gas Station Weed Simulator 2024
description: An immersive, analog-style simulator wherein the player explores a gas station, tries different varieties of cannabis, and interacts with the environment.

title: Hypnorynth
description: You are pursued by a malevolent entity. You must enter the maze, meet its strange inhabitants, uncover its secrets and reach its center if you hope to make it out alive. Will you escape the Hypnorynth?

title: Somnicoda
description:
Somnicoda features an assortment of dreams for your perusal, from idyllic forest pathways to brooding cityscapes. Be wary however as these dreams may twist into nightmares...

Through the somnia you will come across keys and equipment to help you progress through the dreamscape and piece by piece bring an end to the turmoil within.

title: 'Rift' Electric
description: 'RIFT' Electric is a first person puzzle game where you take a questionable job listing and must enter strange homes to turn off all the lights. Using a lens that reveals hidden objects and electrical connections, you must figure how the rooms are wired to escape safely.

title: Drive On Lucy
description: A simple atmospheric walking (driving) simulator, done in 7 days for LSDJAM 2023. WASD to move, SHIFT to speed up, and that's about it. Go link up some beacons along an abandoned road. Get those asbestos-filtered cigs.

title: Mercurial Dreams
description: In 'Mercurial Dreams,' you're a cat plush toy whose mind mysteriously entwines with that of your young owner, a kid, shielding him from bad dreams. The game is set in 'Mercurial Village', a weird place with a river made of mercury and strange buildings. Your job is to keep the kid safe from scary dreams by playing mini-games and completing tasks inside strange buildings. 'Mercurial Dreams' is all about adventure, mystery, and being a hero in a dream world.

title: Emre and Jevon's Tale of Knowledge, Emulating a Dream Where You Gain Wisdom and Knowledge and Probably Meet Hermes
description: This is the game we made for the LSD game jam in two weeks even though we had way more time. Its father is the sun and its mother the moon. And it was borne from the earth where it ascends to the heaven and becomes ruler over that which is above and that which is below.

title: Cannoneer
description: Bang bang! Cannoneer puts you in control of massive cannons, blasting thru several campaigns of fully destructible environments! VR and Flatscreen supported, as well as full crossplay between Meta Quest and Android Mobile users.

title: GirlDivers
description: GIRLDIVERS is a single-player, sci-fi pixel-shooter where you command an adult-themed female squad on rogue-lite missions across alien worlds. It combines strategic combat, RPG-style progression, and erotic visuals, all wrapped in a humorous and stylized sci-fi setting that supports both traditional and Safe For Work modes.

title: Carderia
description:
Rebuild and defend the fallen medieval town of Carderia where all is represented through cards. Stack your cards together and end your turn, to create buildings, mine ore, grow food and more!

But be careful to not run out of food throughout the nasty cold winters, live, survive and you may prosper during the verdant summers. Carderia is full of predictable and unpredictable events alike that spices up the gameplay in every run.

title: Odd Remedy
description: Escape the open-world island infested with monster spiders while on duty as a prisoner with your friends. Loot the city, destroy the caves, take some selfies on the way out in your car before you set sail.

title: Uncanny Cat Golf
description: Take control of the Canny Cat and launch your way to the goal! Watch out for any Uncanny Doppelgangers that lurk around...

title: Funko Fusion: Trap Jaw
description: Blunder your way through Funko Fusion with Masters of the Universe’ very own metal munching moron Trap Jaw, who is now a playable character!

title: Injustice 2: Black Lightning
description: Special skin that turns Raiden into Black Lightning – includes new appearance, moves, and dialogue.

title: Vesuvius
description: Explore the frozen depths of Vesuvius, a 2D action platformer. Set within the sprawling volcano, journey through fantastical alternate realities, battle corrupted mythical beasts, and survive a world steeped in ash and fable.

title: Kidname: Iceboy
description: KIDNAME: ICEBOY is a fan-made prequel to the legendary Sierra On-Line title CODENAME: ICEMAN. The prequel follows patriotic child JW as he embarks on the adventure of his young lifetime--a trip to the US Navy's new Submarine Camp program!

title: Ember Storia
description: Ember Storia is a strategic RPG by Square Enix with the character design by Yūsuke Kozaki (Fire Emblem Awakening, Fire Emblem If). The game will be out on PC and Mobile on 27/11/2024 in Japan.

title: Merge Together
description: Merge Together is a relaxing two-player puzzle game where strategic thinking, harmony, and teamwork are key. Players aim to combine sweet fruits, level by level, to achieve larger fruits and ultimately reach the final goal: the watermelon.

title: I Can't Trust My Eyes
description: I Can't Trust My Eyes is a short horror game about mental aberrations. Faces of other people started to distort after the accident - terrifying, isn't it? The game takes about 5-10 minutes to complete. Made for Acerola Jam 0 in 2 weeks.

title: Unwilting
description: Explore the unwilting gardens in this relaxing first person gardening adventure game!

title: Milon's Secret Hell
description: Join Milon as he dies and goes to Hell! Pure arcade fun, meet four cruel gods, and discover five secret rooms. A fanmade sequel to Milon's Secret Castle.

title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Chronicles: Battle for Greece
description: Chronicles features Age of Empires II gameplay set in antiquity. In Battle for Greece, the first chapter of this multi-part saga, fight with three new ancient civilizations and experience a grand narrative campaign, from the Ionian Revolt to the Peloponnesian War.

title: Plumber Waluigi
description: A story-based puzzle / adventure game, starring Waluigi and his apprentice, Percy Piranha.

title: Super Mario Bros.: The Cookie of Destiny
Super Mario: The Stellar Star Quest
Super Mario Bratarsi
description: Super Mario Bratarsi is Jaklub's Super Mario fangame, which joins gameplay of Super Mario 2, 3 and World and mix it with various Super Mario elements.

title: Firehawk: Swarmbreakers
description: Weave through gunfire, master aerial combat, and rain destruction from above in this high-stakes FPV drone roguelike shooter. Take to the skies and rise from amateur to pro to unlock an arsenal of weapons, against endless enemies with real drone physics and controls.

title: The Legend of Zelda: The Shadowgazer
description:
Close your eyes and step into a shadowy other Hyrule, a dream-like realm blighted by the Maren - ancient evil spirits that cause nightmares. Conquer your darkest fears and rid the kingdom of its bad dreams to unravel the mystery of the Maren's curse.

The Legend of Zelda: The Shadowgazer is a fan game being developed in Game Maker by King Mob, and features:

Two parallel versions of the game world: the everyday waking world, and its nightmarish counterpart, unseen by all except those trained to use the Shadowgazer - a magical totem that protects the bearer from the nightmare realm's maddening effects;

A rotating three-day schedule, governed by the comings and goings of the ships in the port town of Hyrule. Record valuable information regarding the nightmares of the passengers and crew in your Cabin Boy's Handbook.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Specter's Oculus
Davy's Dreams of Chasing Things
description: Created for LSDJAM 2020. "Davy's Dreams of Chasing Things" is a game poem about anxiety dreams.

title: The Legend of Zelda: Hall of the Dead
Bonnie Blob in Shapeville
description: Welcome to Shapeville, a colorful world filled with friendly shapes and endless fun! Meet Bonnie Blob, a bubbly little hero with a curious mind and a heart full of adventure. Explore the whimsical corners of Shapeville, where every click brings something delightful to life.

title: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
description: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

title: Dfiance
description:
Dfiance – Strategy Card Battles in a Fantasy World

Lead your army, collect powerful cards, and outsmart players in real-time PvP battles. Build your deck, master tactics, and dominate the battlefield. Play Dfiance for free on steam or browser!

title: Enemy Front: Limited Edition
description: Enemy Front is a first-person shooter in which players assume the role of an American journalist as he battles Nazis during World War II. The limited edition includes collectible protective case, a standalone mission Raid on St. Nazaire, the game's soundtrack, and extra weapons including the M1 Garand and Webley Pistol.

title: Car Guy Soundboard
description: Car Guy meets his new friend Blobinko and the two get into a debate. Car Guy is a short animation I released on April 6, 2022. Year later on November 27, 2024, I woke up with a vivid dream of me creating a Car Guy soundboard. I saw this as a vision and took it upon myself to make my dream into a reality.

title: Gothwane Towers
description: Welcome to Gothwane Towers, where murder is imminent! Carefully observe the occupants of the house. You may be called upon to identify a suspect. Gothwane Towers was created in December 2020 for the concurrent 7DFPS and PROCJAM game jams. It is a spiritual successor to Where's Tango? and a loving homage to the works of Edward Gorey and Agatha Christie.

title: Li'l Taffer
description: A procedurally generated stealth adventure! Developed in slightly more than 7 days for the 2022 7dfps and PROCJAM game jams.

title: Injustice 2: Power Girl
description: Special skin that turns Supergirl into Power Girl - includes new appearance, moves, and dialogue.

title: Injustice 2: Reverse Flash
description: Special skin that turns The Flash into Reverse Flash - includes new appearance, moves, and dialogue.

title: Injustice 2: John Stewart
description: Special skin that turns Hal Jordan Green Lantern into John Stewart Green Lantern - includes new appearance, moves, and dialogue.

title: Schloss der Wölfe
description: Schloss der Wölfe ("Castle of the Wolves") is a minimalist World War II first-person shooter with a classic horror twist.

title: Urban Dreambog
description: A short (~15 minute) walking sim in a dream like urban environment.

title: Funko Fusion: Sun Wukong
description: Unleash heavenly wrath as the unstoppable Monkey King, a legendary figure of unmatched will and determination. Where there is true will, there is always a way.

title: Undertide
description: You arrive by boat at a blinking tower, a body washes up in town. Talk to townsfolk and explore in this dreamlike mystery.

title: The King of Fighters XV: Omega Rugal
description:
Free DLC Character OMEGA RUGAL joins, THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV!

This dark arms merchant of death once ruled the world’s black market, and was never shy about digging his fangs into any fighter that dared challenge him. Through the power of Orochi, he was given life once again, until a group of fierce fighters brought his reign to an end. Now, due to Verse’s influence, he’s returned to the mortal realm to extract vengeance.

title: Joycoin
description: Gory economic simulator and clicker game, inspired by classic cartoons.

title: Planet Graveyard
description: Planet Graveyard is a short existential horror game based on a dream. It takes inspiration from LSD Dream Emulator and was originally created for the LSD Jam 2022. Explore bizarre and seemingly lifeless planet that looks like giant graveyard. Find out what actually happened to this world by interacting with different sights, scattered around. You are free to leave this planet whenever you want.

title: Big Dengi
description: Big Dengi is a wild blend of visual novel and clicker. Originally it was supposed to be a part of Anti-Capitalistic Game Jam. Play as a faceless clerk in one of the worst corporations in the world. It's violent, unsafe, and unhinged. Will you keep your humanity or will you succumb to the merciless capitalistic machine? Unfortunately the question is rhetorical.

title: Survival Tobita vs. Maniac-Man: Halloween Deathmatch Special!!!
description: Survival Tobita vs Maniac-Man: Halloween Deathmatch SPECIAL!!! is a simple dungeon crawler JRPG, where you play as Tobita himself! Explore Maniac-Man's deadly factory, fight psycho-wrestlers and try to survive.

title: Temporal Deadzone
description: Explore a place of dreams, frozen in time. Created for the LSD Jam 2022.

title: Yet Another Climbing Game
description: Yet Another Climbing Game is a punishing ascent, a twisted tribute to the agony of determination. You guide your climber with a single, clumsy mechanic, grappling upward with imprecise precision. That’s all there is. With persistence, you might find yourself soaring, stumbling, and sometimes hanging by a thread. Great mysteries and perhaps some reward await those daring (or foolish) enough to reach the top.

title: Amarela
description: With precise controls and refined mechanics, Amarela offers an intense and rewarding experience, perfect for those seeking exciting challenges. Find hidden secrets, unravel an engaging narrative through environmental details.

title: Beastbound
description: Explore the ever-shifting world of Beastbound where with every new run comes new Beasts to build your team with and new enemies to face.

title: HitTube
description: Top-Down arcade where you're a vlogger — Travel around the world, make streams of how you destroy everything around and play dozens of minigames!

title: Magic and Dragon: 4X Battle
description: Turn-based strategy game in a world filled with magics, demons and dragons! Build, expand, conquer, form alliances and wage wars.

title: Banana Next Gen
description: Banana Next Gen is a fun-filled 2D/3D side-scroller where you control a flying banana trapped in the Banana King's castle. Collect coins, unlock levels, and face the tyrannical Banana King in an epic final showdown. Can you save your family and escape?

title: The Forbidden Flask
description: In a kingdom that has outlawed potion making, an herbalist turned brew-master continues to sell potions on the underground market from the back of their tavern. Serve both ale and potions to customers, but don't get caught selling potions when the guards make their rounds!

title: Last Pickup
description: In "Last Pickup," players navigate a post-apocalyptic world, carrying fuel to keep their vehicle running and jumping over obstacles in dangerous areas. Be careful not to drop items, as doing so will return you to the last save point.

title: Terror On the Bayou
description: Terror on the Bayou is a 3rd person, exploration horror game where you must navigate your canoe through a hostile bog, alone and afraid. Will you take up the mantle of lighthouse keeper to keep the bayou safe, or will you become prey along the way?

title: Let Me Book
description: Let Me Book is an intense, first-person survival game where your goal is to return the books to their bookshelves and not DIE in the process. You're a late night shift worker at a haunted library. Danger lurks around every bookshelf! Return the books and escape the library!

title: Try 2 Sleep
description: Try 2 Sleep is a casual, local Co-op horror game made for two players. An evil spirit has invaded your house, collaborate with your partner and survive the night terrors!

title: Catwifhat
description: Catwifhat is the first Steam idle clicker where clicking directly drops tradable skins and items. Cats determine your drop pool — collect, craft, level up, and play actively or AFK.

title: Tchunk
description: A calming open world adventure where you play as a wiener dog to discover who and where you are.

title: Weird Wormholes
description: Weird Wormholes is a casual game about traveling through wormholes to try and get back home. Use your ship to mine planets for resources and process these resources into components to enable your travels.

title: Jump! The Floor Is...
description: Do you remember the excitement of hopping from spot to spot, avoiding the ”Lava”? We’re bringing back those childhood memories with a game inspired by the fun we all had growing up. You can test your reflexes, strategy, and competitive spirit. The goal is simple: be the first to reach the trophy.

title: Eco Ronin
description: Grapple, jetpack, shoot, and slash through procedural worlds. Collect philosophy pages, craft items, and go to space. A precision-platformer and action-roguelike made in Unreal Engine 5.

title: Cat Lines
description: Cat Lines is a minimalist puzzle game where you help a cute kitten explore every block on the grid. With simple graphics and engaging challenges, it’s perfect for cat lovers and puzzle fans alike!

title: Sugoroku Casino Party
description: Get ready for a thrilling adventure of strategy and luck! Let's play Sugoroku Casino Party!

title: Christmas Tree Decorator
description: Christmas Tree Decorator is a first-person simulator where you can unwind and decorate a Christmas tree. Whether you’re a casual fan or a dedicated celebrator, enjoy the cozy atmosphere free from pressures or perfectionism as you create your own unique holiday tree and decorations!

title: Block Puzzle
description: Block Puzzle is a strategy / puzzle game with innovative mechanics that will surprise anyone who plays it. With 5 different game modes you will not get tired of it in a long time.

title: Asteroids X
description: More addictive version of 《Asteroids》

title: Music of Destiny: Corrupted Dungeons
description: An ancient evil descends, and you will join the Crimson Knights to save the world! In this Roguelite game, assemble a team of knights and monsters, explore dungeons, collect gear, build defenses, and defeat dungeon monsters!

title: Ball Race Party
description: Ball Race Party is a game where you race against time or other players with your physical ball. You can play single player or multiplayer.

title: No Space For All
description: No Space For All is a top-down space shooter where you fight against an enemy fleet to claim your place in space. Upgrade your craft by collecting parts from destroyed ships and build the powerful Devastator Project. Follow the story through jokes in chat with your operator.

title: The Rangers in the South
description: Purge the lands in this 2.5D HD-2D Pixelart RogueLike ARPG! Create hundreds of characters with unique strategies and abilities, face hordes of enemies, explore different biomes, procedurally generated dungeons, and obtain unique items!

title: Katanaut
description: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

title: Lily's World XD
description: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu.

title: Caramel Performance
description: Caramel Performance - Game about circus, magic and personal troubles of the girl Evelyn Vozui. Where will the fate take her? Only you decide!

title: Wizards in Shorts
description: Wizards in Shorts is a fast-paced online arena shooter. Blast your friends with fireballs, electricity, puffer fish, and mysterious blue orbs.

title: Drunk Alien
description: Help this drunk alien find his way back to his spaceship in this challenging adventure!

title: Broken Time
description: Broken Time - a world where time no longer matters. This low-polygon action game immerses players in a post-apocalyptic environment where every movement changes the course of events. Fight and gather resources to survive in this madness.

title: Heartsworn Abyss
description: Heartsworn Abyss is a survival-thriller taking place in a modern dystopian world. Can Rei, a broken man whose life is on the mend, hope to oppose the sinister machinations of Saitou Corporation? Or will he and Akari be swallowed by Miyogawa’s darkness, to be strung along like broken puppets?

title: Panzer Planet
description: Fast-paced, twin sticker, top-down arena shooter with roguelite elements, where you pilot a powerful tank on spherical mini planets to fight hordes of zombies and monsters. Collect your bounty for killing your enemies to get new weapons and powerups to improve your skills.

title: Spase Defense
description: Stranded on a far flung planet, hold out for rescue against alien foes with a variety of guns, lasers, and explosives.

title: Bulletproof Tank Adventure
description: In a post-apocalyptic world, engage in a thrilling 3D tank battle game, fighting zombies and AI robots. Navigate challenging terrains with your tank and defeat enemies using powerful weapons. A struggle for strategy, danger, and survival awaits you!

title: Pair-A-Dice
description: Decide your fate with a game of Pair-A-Dice. A strategic fight to relinquish your cards with dice that match, while Navigating a strange world with even stranger inhabitants. Despite what they claim, no one seems to play fair. Will you?

title: Nexus M4
description: Nexus M4 is an oriental fantasy MMORPG featuring stunning graphics and dynamic combat. Explore a vast open world filled with adventures, face challenging enemies, gather valuable resources, and level up your character. Join clans, engage in epic wars, and claim your place in this unique universe.

title: Valet Simulator
description: Run your own valet company. Start as a beginner and rise to become the best in town. Park cars with precision, deliver exceptional customer service, and expand your business. Compete with rival valet services and dominate valet market with your top-tier valet skills.

title: Little Slippey
description: Dodge tons of missiles flying at you. Practice your reactions, memorize the structure of the maps and adapt to the ever-changing rules on them. What is the ultimate goal? Pure fun, of course :)

title: Alex and the Aliens
description: In ALEX AND THE ALIENS: Collapse of Time, you play as Alex, a survivor in a world ravaged by an alien invasion. Navigate a devastated Earth, battle deadly enemies, and make critical choices that will determine the fate of humanity. Can you stop the collapse, or will you risk rewriting the future?

title: Nothing Beyond This Point
description: In the Void, everyone is alone, and you're no exception. Use your health as damage, create your own character with abilities and Sigils, and fight through corrupted souls in this top-down action Metroidvania. Don't be fooled - you're nobody's last hope.

title: Orpheus' Revenge
description: Get ready to put your mouse to use and get smack talked by a bunch of pixels! Orpheus' Revenge is an 80s inspired arcade shooter with more sass than sense. Pixel graphics, neon colours and electronic beats meet greek mythology.

title: Gravenfall: Veil of Darkness
description: Gravenfall: Veil of Darkness combines turn-based combat with puzzle-solving in a story-driven adventure. Battle cursed creatures, uncover relics, and unravel the tragic tale of love, betrayal, and dark magic at the core of Gravenfall’s curse.

title: Vault
description: Uncover the story of a mysterious island through the lens of a primitive drone as you search for the artifact concealed within it, and avoid the guardian of the island.

title: Become The Devil
description: Two college students travel to a remote area to interview the owner of a resort. Along the way, locals warn them to stay away from the people at the resort. Since the new owner moved in, strange incidents have frequently occurred. The locals suspect something terrifying must be lurking in the resort

title: Hyper Tunnel
description: A roguelike action game, fly and fight in first person with 6 degrees of freedom!

title: Comet Rogue
description: Fast-paced mining roguelike where you mine and explore procedurally-generated asteroids. Collect dozens of unique upgrades to aid you in your quest for riches! (and freedom...)

title: Astronaut Adventure
description: The Astronaut's Adventures in the Vast Universe

title: Rough Rivals
description: Experience the perfect blend of American football and bar brawling. Be brutal and cunning, customize your team, upgrade your players, and dominate the field! Challenge your friends in split-screen to relive the joy of couch gaming. May the fiercest one win!

title: Willie's Nightfall
description: Willie's Nightfall is a first-person horror game. Explore the eerie offices of Willie's Company in search of secret documents. But you're not alone. The sinister company mascot, Willie—a distorted, murderous mouse—is hunting you down.

title: Venator Universe
description: Venator Universe is a sci-fi RPG survival game developed by VenatorGames. It aims to create a highly action-packed and hostile environment. The goal of the game is to survive, which requires players to gather resources, craft items, and improve themselves.

title: Kings of Emperor Bonaparte
