description: Prepare to embark on a journey of reflection, where you’ll seek answers to profound questions and uncover the ultimate truth: What truly lies within the black box?

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark: Tanis
Red Flagg: Don't Call me Blue Redux
Robbing the Princess
description: Join Alec and Suzy as they try to steal a ship's cargo in this short point and click adventure game

title: 3-Bit Explorer
description: 3-Bit Explorer follows its predecessors, being a game focused on world exploration. This time you find yourself lost in a forest that seems to have even more bits than you, making this world even stranger to our hero. Once more, the world does not need saving, but you need to find your way home (and also a good adventure).

title: Adarna
description: Loosely based on the 17th century corrido written by José de la Cruz, Adarna follows the journey of Prince Juan and his two older brothers, Princes Pedro and Diego. The King of Berbanya has fallen sick and the only cure for his disease is a song from the legendary Adarna Bird. One by one, the older brothers set off in search for the creature but the years pass by without them returning. Juan then decides to take matters into his own hands and convinces his parents — afraid for their remaining son — to let him go on the same quest.

title: Mini Dungeon
description: Mini Dungeon is a couch-coop action RPG with an emphasis on tactical combat with your friends. A variety of playable classes let you fill the role your team needs, whether damaging the boss or healing your teammates.

title: Another Christmas Game
description: In this game, you follow Lucas, a 16-year-old teenager who decides to spend Christmas alone at home until he realizes that he's not as alone as he thought.

title: 1000: The All-Mother's Embrace
description:
The washed-out red line traces a confident path away from the labyrinth city, toward the lands of dreams strewn with golden petals.
Were that line to break, a story would start. A story of the boundless and the omnipotent, of the minuscule and the fragile.

title: Paper Bride 6: Nightmare
description: "Paper Bride 6 Nightmare” is the sixth work to the Paper Bride series. Dive into a bewitching dream and immerse yourself in yet another immersive Chinese horror puzzle game!

title: Shuumatsu no Sugoshikata: The world is drawing to an W/end
description: In a week the human race will perish. In this situation the hero keeps going to school while everyone gives up. What is there ahead?

title: ParallHex
description: ParallHex is a puzzle game where you'll navigate increasingly challenging levels. Solve puzzles simultaneously in two distinct worlds, interconnected by your every move.

title: Planet Factory
description: A small quick game about building a factory to launch planets into a solar system! Grow your base and increase production to make the ultimate factory for launching planets!

title: Fallen Cage
description: A 3D action game where you control an angel striving to escape from a prison.The objective is to overcome waves of enemies using a variety of firearms and collect six hearts.Engage in combat to reclaim your freedom and take flight once again.

title: Anemone
description: This is a board game set in the fictional Japanese city of "Neverland." Enjoy local multiplayer with simple mouse-based controls. Original music and an unusual world await you

title: Days of Saturn
description:
There are sixteen days left until the Days of Saturn. Work hard, acolyte, and you may be chosen to be the Servant of the Mistress during the festivities.

A slightly creepy fantasy visual novel / stat-raising game. Made in four days for Velox Turbo 2.

title: Super Mario 64: Gore/Hard-Mode
description: Take a dive into the challenging world of Gore/Hard-Mode! Often called "Real life Mario 64", this mod originally started as a port of Kaze's Unfair Mario 64. It quickly grew into a cursed lovechild between Unfair Mario and 'I Wanna Be The Guy' sporting ridiculous obstacles and gory inspiration from both. Be prepared to die numerous times in unexpected ways!

title: Elon and the Divine Proof
description: A 3D action platformer. Elon must collect all the Burgers scattered around this mysterious place to open the passage back.

title: Denbora
description: Leap through time in Denbora, a darkly humorous 3D puzzle game. Navigate intricate puzzles and unravel the cyclical nature of the labor market, guided by a sarcastically witty AI. Each decision echoes through past and future!

title: Pragmatics
description: This is a classic match-3 puzzle game where the primary elements are colorful and uniquely shaped blocks.

title: Trouble in Warsaw
description: Trouble in Warsaw is a short, detective game, combining the genres of Visual Novel and Point&Click, featuring many puzzles, dialogues and related choices solidifying the plot and its finale.

title: Randungeon
description: Take on the role of a legendary hero on a quest to find the Dungeon Lord: a powerful creature lurking deep within a treacherous dungeon. Every game is different and completely random.

title: Shuriken Trigger
description: Master the ninja art of wall-running while fighting room after room of syndicate thugs and deadly robots in this top-down action shooter.

title: Stella Gladio
description: A precision platformer where you take on the role of Gladio, venturing into a mysterious magical tower with your companion—a sentient, talking sword "Stella".

title: Protory Jigen
description: 3D x 2D action with multiple shifting game genres! What awaits you after crossing the worlds?

title: 101 Cats in Singapore
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Singapore landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 101 Cats in Rome
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Rome landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 101 Cats in Miami
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Miami landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 101 Cats in Madrid
description: Find and discover 101 cute cats hidden throughout the Madrid landscape in this hand-drawn hidden object game. Can you find them all?

title: 108 Silly Ways to Die
description: Caichen made an appointment with a female netizen from the same school to meet at an abandoned medical college, but was caught up in a conspiracy. Caichen planned to explore here and find a way to escape, but the sudden roar and the appearance of zombies implied that there were secrets hidden here.

title: 10 Blaze Escape
description: Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing! Killing! Killing!Killing!

title: 10min Heroes
description: A 2D pixel survival game where you defeat waves of enemies and aim for the goal. Face over 50 types of enemies, wield 20+ unique weapons, and grow stronger as you progress through each stage. "Become stronger and reach the goal!"

title: Logic Mahjong Souryuu
description: A mahjong game where you can play against original mahjong players using the "character creation" function. In the story mode "Tile of Destiny," the hard-boiled world view and formidable mahjong players will draw you into the story.

title: Kokubyaku no Avesta: Refusal-Aushedar
description:
This is the first installment in a two-part visual novel adaptation of the web novel by Masada Takashi.

Under the world of the first Divine Throne, two forces are killing each other relentlessly. Black and White, Light and Darkness, Good and Evil. Until the other is destroyed, the fighting will never stop. That is the instinct called Avesta. Follow the wicked warrior Magsarion and his path of remorselessind breaking dualism, along with Quinn, who is tasked with collecting a "miracle".

title: Super Sorry
description: You play as a salaryman who gets caught in various everyday troubles and overcomes them with acrobatic bows. From boss reprimands to client complaints and family issues, showcase your elegant apology skills across different scenarios. What shocking ending awaits?

title: Haunting Record: Phantom Street
description: You find yourself on a street both unfamiliar and strangely familiar, where eerie events unfold one after another. Restless spirits linger here, their resentment palpable, as if waiting to drag you into the abyss…

title: All In Everyday
description: Winning gets you a model, losing means no life. Reincarnation follows, give it another shot! Don't talk to me about game theory, probability, or value regression, I'm all in! With a leverage that reaches the sky, I'm all in!

title: Maze Company
description: A short horror walking simulator where you just head from the workroom to the exit. Something may happen along the way, but don't worry, just keep going.Your goal is to return.

title: Karen Ready！
description: You run your own perfume store as the owner of a perfume store. A sudden accident has involved you in the investigation of your own resurrection from the dead. The truth gradually emerges with three employees - a love affair about perfume. Harvest the memories of your own heartbeat in the game!

title: Fuuraiki
description: PC/Steam port of "Fuuraiki"

title: Murder&Spies
description: From the creator of hit mobile game "Spy.io" comes "Murder&Spies", a unique take on the multiplayer murder mystery genre. In this online social deduction game, every player is a spy with a single objective: eliminate your assigned target while staying hidden from the spy hunting you.

title: Quantum Joe
description: Quantum Joe is a precision pixel platformer with 100+ levels of fun, fast-paced retro-arcade style. Complete challenges and unlock stickers to decorate your play area, build custom levels with built-in level maker and share them through Steam Workshop. Includes single player and local co-op.

title: Hood RPG
description: Dark Humor & Satire: Experience a story that blends comedic mischief with clever parody, ensuring laughs and surprises at every turn. Engage in unconventional turn-based battles. Be ready to fall over laughing!

title: Punchball
description: Grab and Punch your way through technical courses to top the timing boards in this fast-paced 3D action platformer.

title: AntonWare
description: Follow Anton and others along a short story full of minigames.

title: One Room: Yui Hanasaka Memorial
description: A new immersive animated novel game where you can experience the story of Yui Hanasaka, the main heroine of the popular short anime series OneRoom, from the protagonist’s point of view.

title: Omega Phenex Commenced Project Six
description: You will become a pilot of the mech “Icarus,” which has tremendous maneuverability. You will enjoy a fight and face large powerful armies and rivals by moving from skimming the surface of the sea to the cloud with Icarus. This game is a high-speed mech shooting game capable of firing massive amounts of missiles.

title: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
description: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

title: Stella Sora
description: In this top-down, light-action adventure game developed by Yostar, play as the Tyrant in a captivating fantasy world. Create memorable bonds with charming girls known as Trekkers, assemble perfect teams for diverse adventures, and conquer the mysterious Monoliths. Packed with exhilarating battles, randomized perks each run, and a variety of in-game features, Stella Sora will keep you coming back for more. Tyrant, your legacy awaits!

title: Rememento: White Shadow
description: Rememento - White Shadow is a turn-based RPG game. Make your own team and build tactics. Explore the vast world and make your own path of destiny.

title: Lonely Christmas
description:
Lonely Christmas is an indie horror walking simulator from the first person. Feel the festive atmosphere during the day and the scary atmosphere of loneliness at night.

Feel the Christmas atmosphere! The house is located in a beautiful place among a centuries-old forest. Kevin was left there alone as his parents had gone to the shop and left him a lot of tasks to prepare for the holiday.

In the evening, Kevin hears on the radio that a crazy robber has escaped from the convoy and that he may be near his house. You have to keep the robber out of the house, call the police and wait for your parents. Good luck.

title: Gift Collector
description: Gift Collector is a New Year's horror game from the first person, in the Japanese style and genre of walking simulator. Collect gifts and make the kids happy on New Year's Eve. But don't forget that Midnight is a time of miracles!

title: Reverse Problem
description: Navigate through small diorama islands and tackle 200 handcrafted parking challenges with 100 unique trucks and buses. For an extra challenge, create your own custom problems in the Sandbox mode!

title: To Eat A God
description:
Here is the game called "To eat a god"

"You will control a puppet during your stay in the game, you must blend in with your role to prevent a break with the continuity of the game itself and with the psyche of the characters within it....

The game has 3 characters that you can choose.... although with one of them you have to unlock a dialogue first before you can play it... haha

title: Legends of Allods
description: Legends of Allods - Non-commercial release of a game from the Allods series based on the Dungeon Siege engine. The developer is N-Game Studios.

title: Journey Across Japan: Mysteries of Mt Aso
description: This game was inspired by the Abroad In Japan - Journey Across Japan series.

title: Touhou: Fortuitous Strife in Arcane Land
The Seven Elemental Vases
description: The kingdom of gods and humans have separated, you will be the protagonist of all its consequences. With a lot of levels, characters, creatures, history and more in a 2D Pixel art style.

title: Work In Progress
description:
It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout...
Here is your gun, your contract.
Now go fire some people.

title: ESP: ExtraSensitive Pervert
description:
Blessed with powerful extrasensory abilities, a gross girl spends all day arguing with strangers on the internet about anime and eating junk food. Has she finally caught her lucky break when a beautiful girl she's never seen before comes knocking at her door? Find out how this easily excitable pervert handles this unusual development in her otherwise monotonous life.

An erotic kinetic visual novel, ~15k words in length.

title: Black Armor: Battle For Survivors
description:
In a world on the brink of chaos, Black Armor, Spicy, Charlie and other heroes fight to maintain balance, while the Grim Reaper and his dark forces threaten to destroy everything. Prepare for a story full of bravery, betrayal and redemption, where every fight counts.

Experience the most visceral and challenging combat. Don't miss it!

title: Archaeology: Sand Fantasy
description: A game of the genre find the hidden object.

title: Janken Horn
description: Janken Horn is a "Rock Paper Scissors" card game. When a simple luck testing game suddenly becomes a strategy game, you will understand. Why does it make you think so much when all you need to do is to pick one from Rock/Paper/Scissors?

title: ODouzy!!!
description: In ODouzy!!!, guide a cute rectangle through colorful levels, dodging bomb traps and collecting beans and douzy. With a blend of simple movement mechanics and challenging puzzles, navigate vibrant worlds and gather enough the douzy to emerge victorious in this lighthearted, strategic adventure!

title: A Few Days With: Emma
description: Embark on a sensual Christmas Baubles hunting adventure with Emma, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Emma's enticing layers.

title: Flash Doll
description: Surprise blind boxes and custom outfits combined with physics-driven action figures, automatic battles, custom moves, and intense showdowns ready to start!

title: Summons Sword: Pot Guardian
description: "Summons Sword: Pot Guardian" is a top-down, highly challenging action game. Teleport to dodge enemy attacks, fight with swords and summoning magic, and recover the treasure "Clay Pot of Darkness" stolen by the evil summoner!

title: HuntNPrey
description: HuntNPrey is a multiplayer hide-and-seek game for up to 8 players. By day, act natural and blend in with the herd to escape the hunter's sights. By night, transform into a wolf and flip the script—now it's your turn to hunt! Stay sneaky, stay sated, or get caught!

title: Fallen: Into the Darkness
description: Dive deep into the darkness in this free-to-play, single-player platformer. Time moves fast, so keep your light alive and watch your step, each attempt reshapes the entire level.

title: Sweet X'mas
description: Sweet X'mas - is a simple and beautiful puzzle game with a Christmas theme. It is accompanied by relaxing music. After completing the level, you can enjoy the girl's photos in the gallery.

title: Space Thugs
description: Space Thugs, join the space thugs as they got on an adventure across the universe. Includes strip clubs.

title: Jigsaw Swimsuit
description: Jigsaw Puzzle with illustrations of pretty Gals! The most puzzles have more than 20 pieces. Can you assemble back?

title: Polysemy‌

description: Potion Shopkeeper is a cozy 3D game where you run a potion shop, craft potions, set prices, and manage customer reactions. Unlock rare ingredients, experiment with recipes, and manage your reputation to attract more customers and grow your shop!

title: Quadrober Simulator
description: Are you a quadrober?

title: Real Pharmacy Simulator
description: Become the owner of a pharmacy in Real Pharmacy Simulator! Manage the business, serve customers, and balance profit with ethics. Order medicines, organize the space, and decide how to run your business - honestly or riskily. Your decisions will determine the fate of the pharmacy!

title: Parisian Bistro Simulator
description: Manage your own bistro in Paris and turn it into the place to be! Create menus, serve customers, and master every detail to grow your restaurant. Manage supplies, ensure top-notch service, and make your mark on the city of lights. Will you become the next Parisian brasserie institution?

title: Pirate Cove Simulator
description: Pirate Cove Simulator will have you run a shop and tavern on the Island of the Damned, to get rich and buy your way out of the pirate afterlife. Trade with restless undead pirates, run your own distillery and turn local plants into potent drinks, search for hidden treasures, or just go fishing.

title: Pizza Simulator Together
description: Pizza Simulator is a cooperative simulator where you manage a pizzeria, set up the kitchen, hire staff, prepare and deliver orders, and maintain the reputation and cleanliness of your establishment. Create your dream pizzeria!

title: Meowingtons Simulator
description: This isn’t your typical dance game...Explore club Oberhasli and Control meowingtons' movements, every dance is an opportunity to create something unique, funny, or downright absurd. Whether you’re bouncing around on the decks, or find a better place to throw down, there’s no wrong way to dance. neat

title: Metrogether
description: Metrogether is a train simulator where you drive, collect passengers, work together with friends and explore the subway network in a fictional city. Embark on your journey as a train driver or ticket inspector in single and multiplayer.

title: Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator
description: Manage your mini racer car shop, sell mini cars and spare parts, and unleash your creativity with custom builds. Test drive your creations on the race track before putting them up for sale. Transform your shop into a haven for mini car enthusiasts and build a thriving business in the process!

title: Monster Care Simulator
description: Become the manager of a care center for adorable little monsters in Monster Care Simulator. Earn money by meeting their needs, improve your facilities, and customize the environment to provide the best care and see the creatures thrive.

title: Morning Brew: Coffee Shop Management Simulator
description: Run and expand your own cozy restaurant in a peaceful Italian village. Serve bakery items and coffee to customers while customizing and upgrading your space. A relaxing simulation with resource management and building, perfect for stress-free, creative gameplay.

title: Mutual Assured Destruction Simulator
description: A short and surreal dark comedy-horror narrative game.

title: New Year Simulator 2025
description: In the game you will have to survive the pre-holiday bustle, celebrate the New Year, and then enjoy the peace after the New Year's lull. Relax and feel the atmosphere of the most important holiday of the year!

title: Landlady Seduction Simulator
description: Your goal is to seduce the landlady through carefully chosen interactions, flirty conversations, and bold moves—and to take her to bed!

title: Junkcity Factory Simulator
description: Collect scraps, manage a factory with 29 machines, 33 workers, and nearly 300 items, and sell your products in Junkcity Store. Optimize efficiency and dominate the market in this dynamic simulation game!

title: Liquor and Wine Shop Simulator: Store Simulator
description: Liquor and Wine Shop Simulator is a store management game that takes place in the charming streets of France where you run your own Liquor shop! Start small as a cashier, scanning items and giving the correct change to your customers, then work your way up to managing a full-fledged business.

title: Liquor Store Simulator
description: Open your own Liquor Store! Buy goods, manage your store, hire staff. Who knows, maybe you will be able to make a real alcohol empire out of a small store.

title: Make the Border Great Again: Visa Officer Simulator
description: Play as a visa officer in this chaotic simulator! Inspect passports, catch lies, and decide who crosses the border. But watch out—one bad stamp, and you're in jail! Test your wits in this hilarious battle of logic and deception.

title: Mall Simulator
description: Turn your building from a small shopping center into a huge city mall! To avoid going bankrupt, you’ll need to build new stores and restaurants, set smart prices, and keep up with trends. 15+ stores, dozens of machines & services, and hundreds of famous brands waiting for you...

title: Hand Cooking Simulator: Multi-Chef
description: A fun physics based hand simulator in which you prepare food.

title: Hand-Holding Simulator
description: An incremental idle game that is sure to make you feel love again. Synergize your Love Languages to produce a seemingly endless amount of satisfaction for you and your partner

title: Hell Yeah Simulator
description: Do you want to fly over beautiful landscapes, smoke a cigarette, gamble and kill people at the same time? Here is HELL YEAH Simulator You can do whatever you want and whatever seems cool to you in this game. You can run in dywars, you can get your lost speed, you can bunny hop, you can backhopping.

title: Hand Simulator: Shooter
description: Hand Simulator Shooter — a true contender for the shooter throne, inspired by iconic games of the genre. Take control of your hands to survive and dominate in physically realistic shootouts. Experience unique gameplay where every move matters, and become the master of the new king of shooters.

title: Street Chef: Food Seller Simulator
description: Start with a cart, upgrade to a van, or even buy a restaurant. Along the way, you'll face arguments, wild fights, and even baguette battles. It’s all about making hotdogs—how absurd could it be?

title: Frosty Enterprise
description: Manage your own ice cream truck. Enter your truck and start your business. Buy fruits, syrups and other ingredients to make ice cream. Add new setups to your truck to sell milkshake, float, sundae. Research new flavors to attract more people and grow your business.

title: ISS Simulator
description: The ultimate space simulator game, precisely modeling the space and space environment inside the International Space Station (ISS).

title: Global Shipping Simulator
description: Dive into the fast-paced world of logistics and become the master of delivery. Manage your business, customize your space, and ensure every order is delivered on time. Can you build a delivery empire?

title: Gokai Awesome Simulator +
description: Gokai Awesome Simulator + is a premium version of Gokai Awesome Simulator Lite with tons of new content than the original!

title: Go-Kart Simulator
description: Build Your Go-Kart Empire! Start with a small business, expand your fleet, upgrade your track, and secure big sponsorship deals to boost your profits. Host tournaments, grow your brand, and become a racing legend. Take the wheel and push your limits on the track!

title: Graffiti Simulator
description: Become a great graffiti artist and work your way to success! Have you always wanted to learn how to paint graffiti? Now you can do it in our Graffiti Simulator.

title: Greengrocer Simulator 2024
description: Can you rebuild a career that has hit rock bottom? Strive to rise from nothing to the top. Arrange your fruits & vegetables however you like. Keep track of price updates. Play the stock market and aim for the top. Meet people and grab a drink. Show the whole world who's the best.

title: Gun Factory Simulator
description: Take control of your very own firearms factory. Start with a workshop and a gun shop, and evolve it into a factory of mass destruction. Craft bullets to rockets, handguns to shotguns, design your own weapons, and become a merchant of death. Get use to the smell of gunpowder and cash.

title: Gun Store Simulator
description: Take control of a gun store in Gun Store Simulator and manage every aspect of the arms trading business. Buy licenses, select products, hire staff, and ensure safety to grow your store and build a successful chain. Can you dominate the market?

title: Finnish Pub Simulator
description: Run your very own pub in the Finnish countryside either on your own or with friends! Manage your pub's inventory, set your own prices, and be ready to refuse service if things get too crazy.

title: Football Life Simulator
description: Live the life of a professional footballer both on and off the field. Train, play matches, manage your social life, climb the career ladder, and spend your earned money. Decorate your life with luxury while managing your relationships and finances.

title: Football Pitch Simulator
description: Build your own football pitch business. Make repairs, expand your facilities, and attract the interest of football fans.

title: Friendly Sheeps: A Cozy Simulator
description: FRIENDLY SHEEPS is a relaxing sheep farming game in which you create your dream farm in a peaceful, colorful world. With its simple gameplay, meet the needs of your sheeps, craft and sell your products, and grow your business!

title: Gamestonk Simulator: Gone Rogue
description: Gamestonk is the first roguelite shop simulator. Manage the last videogame store in town, keep up with the latest releases, trade smuggled retros, select your modifiers strategically, hire workers, and deal with pesky shoplifters.*Disclaimer: game titles will crack you up!

title: Dream Home Simulator
description: Explore a beautifully crafted modern apartment in Dream Home Simulator. Relax and walk through a detailed, fully furnished space, offering a glimpse of your dream home in a peaceful, casual experience.

title: Dream Bar Simulator
description: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

title: Doner Master Simulator
description: "Run your own döner restaurant in Döner Master Simulator! Prepare delicious döner, satisfy your customers, and grow your business. Become a master döner chef and own the most popular spot in town!"

title: Doll Catching Simulator
description: In the busy life, do you long to experience the fun of catching dolls but are limited by time and space? Now, the doll catching simulator brings you a brand-new entertainment experience!

title: Drive Thru Simulator
description: Drive Thru is a simulation game that immerses you in the exciting world of fast food restaurant management. Take customer orders, prepare their meals, process payments, and expand your restaurant!

title: Drunk Builder Simulator
description: A construction simulator where one of the players plays the role of a foreman who has to catch drunk players. And the rest of the drunk players have to run, hide and search for alcohol on the construction site to survive.

title: Electronics Supermarket Simulator
description: Build and manage your own electronics retail empire in Electronics Supermarket Simulator. Design the perfect store, master inventory, outsmart your competitors, and grow your business into a tech giant. Are you ready to dominate the market?

title: Empire City Simulator
description: Become a ruler and build the ancient city of your dreams in Empire City! Unlock new opportunities for your city's prosperity, gain the support of the gods, construct grand buildings, and create unique infrastructure. Transform a small settlement into a magnificent center of civilization!

title: Cock Fight Simulator
description: Fight as a rooster in a 3D third-person game, equipped with unique weapons in dynamic arenas.

title: Clash Battle Simulator
description: Ready for the ultimate battle? Dive in and test your strategy skills now!

title: City Noodle Shop Simulator
description: This is a simulation game about the operation of a Chinese noodle restaurant. You will play the role of the owner of the noodle restaurant and develop a reasonable cost control strategy for the store, ultimately achieving profitability and development for the store

title: Cinemaster Cinema Simulator
description: Run your own cinema! Set showtimes, print tickets, buy new films, pop popcorn, upgrade and clean theaters. Vending machines, staffs, upgrades, and much more are coming soon!

title: Coconut Simulator
description: Coconut Simulator is a game in which you can become a coconut.

title: Corner Kitchen Fast Food Simulator
description: Buy cooking equipment, prepare delicious meals, and serve hungry customers. Upgrade your setup, read customer reviews, and expand your business to become the top fast-food joint in the city.

title: Crown Simulator: Royal Life simulation
description: Crown Simulator — a royal life simulation where every decision shapes the fate of your kingdom! Manage your army, strengthen relations with neighbors, care for your people and treasury. Can you maintain balance and become a great ruler? Make your choices and rule!

title: Delivery Point Simulator
description: Business simulator with strategy elements, where you manage a network of order delivery points in the conditions of severe competition, gray schemes and unexpected risks. Develop your business, improve points, defend against competitors' attacks, conduct risky transactions in the gray market.

title: Desert of Ash: a Post-Apocalyptic Gay Sex Simulator
description: The world has burnt to ash. Wander the wasteland, scavenge and trade for vital supplies, hook up with over a dozen hot guys, develop relationships—however fleeting—and decide how you want to live in this new world.

title: Casino Manager Simulator
description: Step into the mesmerizing world of slot machines and elevate your casino to the top! "Casino Manager Simulator" is a comprehensive simulation game that allows you to meticulously manage the operations of your casino.

title: CamGirl Simulator
description: Step into the tantalizing world of online entertainment with "CamGirl Simulator"! This immersive simulation game puts you in control of your own virtual cam model career. Experience the highs and lows of the industry as you navigate the challenges and rewards of being a popular camgirl.

title: My Café Manager Simulator
description: Unleash your inner entrepreneur! Balance renovation, product selection, customer service, and outdoor ambiance to build the ultimate café experience and keep your customers coming back for more.

title: Bush Simulator
description: Welcome to Bush Simulator, the game you never knew you wanted and probably still don't, but hey, it's here! Get ready to experience the ultimate in bush observation—because who needs explosions, zombies, or epic quests when you can just... look at a bush?

title: Bus Flipper Simulator
description: Have you ever wondered “What if I buy an old bus and convert it into a camper? Or maybe a cafe on wheels?”. This bus conversion simulator will give you that! You will get a variety of different buses and vans to convert. Clean, destroy, create, customize, test it, sell and make profit!

title: Cam Op Simulator
description: Cam Op Simulator allows real world camera operators to learn and practice operating a virtual camera using a gamepad (joystick), Nodo Inertia Wheels, or several supported "Mouse Wheels" like Rexy Wheels, Hammerhead Wheels, Blacktek, and Kino Wheels.

title: Car Service Simulator
description: Car Service Simulator is a car service business simulation game where you start from scratch and work your way up. Take the chance to successfully run your own service center, offering a wide range of services from car repair to painting and modification.

title: Insider Trading
description: Insider Trading is a roguelike deckbuilder where you bend the market to your will. Synergize perks, manipulate stock prices, and trade wisely or risk pricing yourself out.

title: Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator
description: In the "Christmas Store: Santa's Supermarket Simulator", you run a holiday store. Fill the shelves with Christmas goods, set discounts, serve customers, hire staff and decorate the shop in a wintery style. Expand your store and create the perfect place for Christmas shopping!

title: Bank Simulator
description: Take your customers' money and invest it to grow your bank. Lend it out, buy bonds, stock ATM Rooms across the city and keep the profits. Catch scammers, hire staff and turn a small branch into a global powerhouse in this business management and banking tycoon sim.

title: Bike Park Simulator: BMX, Dirt Jump & MTB
description: Bike Park Simulator is a realistic BMX, Dirt Jump, and MTB simulation featuring a large sandbox skatepark, multiple bike types, and fun physics-based riding. Perform tricks, explore diverse terrains, and become the most famous biker in the city!

title: Bowling Simulator
description: Bowling Simulator is a realistic bowling game where you’ll feel like a pro landing strikes, thanks to its easy to use controls. Grab your favorite drink and hit the lanes at Nashville Bowling Center, where bowling isn’t just a game—it’s life!

title: Breast Simulator
description: Breast Simulator is a fast-paced third-person arena survival game, where you face a multitude of unknown rivals, each with unique abilities and tactics. Earn the favor of powerful alien overlords through your combat prowess, gaining access to critical upgrades and enhancements.

title: Bunker Constructor Simulator
description: A simulator in which you have to build bunkers. Complete contracts from the city government and citizens to earn money to buy your own house and build your own protected underground bunker.

title: American Election Simulator
description: Plot your way through an American political campaign as you go head-to-head against a rival political party. Make tough decisions as you travel across the country and try to earn enough votes to become the next President of the United States!

title: Alien Market Simulator
description: Run a market on your space station. Restore and upgrade the station, expand your services, and sell to a variety of alien customers. Experience the challenge of managing a business in space and growing your market

title: Alchemy Laboratory: Simulator
description: Dive into a world of creation and discovery, where each element combines to form new ones. Experiment freely in this interactive sandbox. But be careful: every combination has its consequences..

title: Anime Shop Simulator
description: Manage your own anime shop. Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business. Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game.

title: Apocalypse Shop Simulator
description: Apocalypse Shop Simulator is a sandbox game set in a post-nuclear war world. Buy goods and sell them to customers.

title: APUS: Bird Simulator
description: Have you ever dreamed of truly flying? Experience the raw freedom of the skies as the fastest bird in the world. Feel the rush of adrenaline as you glide through air currents and master the intricate art of flight. This isn't just a game—it's the ultimate flight experience.

title: Krampus: Night of Horror
description: Survive the longest night of your life in a haunted 18th-century orphanage where Christmas becomes a living nightmare. Krampus is hunting you, and only the power of sacred holy gloves will keep you alive.

title: Mogradiz
description: The day has finally arrived, today you will become a monster tamer! Make friends with all of them and share a wonderful adventure, together you will explore different areas, take care of the crops and defeat great enemies.

title: Mega Met
description: A Mega Man fan game which features Metalls (Mets) as the entire cast of characters, enemies and bosses.

title: Sonic and the Elements of Harmony
Puzkin: Magnetic Odyssey
description: PUZKIN: Magnetic Odyssey invites players to explore a vibrant, magical world where magnetic energy sustains the balance of nature and creatures called Puzzies. Players, embodying chosen children, are transported to this mysterious realm to restore its harmony through epic adventures, collaborative construction, and immersive quests.

title: Ys X: Proud Nordics
description: Stand Proud for a new adventure in Ys X: Proud Nordics! Experience Adol and Karja's unforgettable journey across Obelia Gulf with new quality of life improvements, then discover the new story centering around Öland Island, and the mysterious newcomers Canute and Astrid. And once you're ready, challenge yourself in the devious, time-trial dungeon of Muspelheim, where every second counts. Your new adventure awaits!

title: Felltarune: Deal or Not Deal
description: Felltarune is an alternate universe of Deltarune. You have the chance to fight Sp4mton or accept his deals... It's all up to you! Don't give up!

title: Crypt's Game
description: You are out in the woods, in search of the entity known as Crypt. Stopping in your tracks, you see it approaching. You take aim with your shotgun, intending to kill it, when suddenly the ground beneath you gives way, dropping you down into the earth. You find yourself trapped in Crypts dungeon where it will play a twisted game of Cat and Mouse. Killing it is the only way out, will you survive?

title: Star Life
description:
Sandbox "Zero To Hero" RPG in futuristic setting. Game features deep economic gameplay with realistic economy and full freedom for a player.

While on a planet, range of opportunities is wide, from being employed practically at any building (should there be a vacancy) to owning any non-government building, influencing economy directly. Entire planet economy is based on real buildings present in the game and therefore player can shape it to his liking (if player is rich enough). Player can also choose to be anyone - from local business owner, to criminal or politician (or as it might often be - all at once). Skill development is only possible if player performs tasks which require those skills.

Player can travel from planet to planet and own or rent any spaceship, mining, pirating or simply trading goods between planets. While game has no quests & restrictions, there is a main story present which implies that player need to achieve certain results and actions to meet win condition, which does not stop player from continuing game thereafter.

Choose any path or all at once. Model employee, Business owner, Politician, Merchant, Pirate, Criminal, or just explore game as it feels.

title: Superstition
description: Your world just got a whole lot bigger.

title: A Day In The Future
description: Game that puts you in the shoes of a citizen of the future that need to find 3 keys to access to a gate. The main gameplay consists in a side-scrolling shoot 'em up, but there are some minigames as well.

title: Superstition S3
description: Learn the truth and unleash your potential.

title: Malevolent Madness
description: Malevolent Madness invites players into a tension-filled horror adventure, offering an experience rich in mystery and puzzles. A mysterious time machine unleashes extraordinary powers that could disrupt the balance between universes, but this discovery becomes a significant threat to humanity in the wrong hands.

title: Oryum
description:
Step into the immersive world of Oryum, a reimagined game where tradition meets innovation. Designed for hardcore grinders and dungeon enthusiasts, Oryum offers balanced mechanics, continuous quest series, and bug-free gameplay that redefine the MMORPG experience.

Engage in thrilling events, tackle challenging dungeons, and explore a meticulously crafted world brought to life by a professional development team. With flashy cosmetics, unique boosters, and a focus on community-driven updates, Oryum delivers a seamless blend of classic MMORPG nostalgia and modern enhancements.

Whether you're conquering epic bosses or building your legacy in the vibrant in-game economy, Oryum promises an unforgettable adventure tailored for veterans and newcomers alike. Join now and forge your story in a world that never stops evolving.

title: Schape Dodger
description: Enjoy a casual color and shape matching game. Easy to pick up but hard to master and complete all the challenges.

title: Shattered Time
description: Step into the chaotic world of Shattered Time, a 2.5D platformer set within the mysterious confines of a high-tech laboratory. As a lone experiment gone awry, you gain the ability to manipulate time itself, allowing you to reverse moments in the environment and use the past to reshape the present.

title: Guardian Grids
description: A pixel tower defense game packed with strategy and fun! Build Archer Towers, Magic Towers, Poison Traps, and Cannons to defend your castle from waves of monsters. With diverse levels, random cards, and upgrades, every battle feels fresh. Ready to defend? Begin your journey now!

title: Vertical Collapse: Ghost in the Machine
description: Vertical Collapse is a digital pinball game with an inverted twist.

title: Klonoa: The Dream Chapter
description: A Klonoa 3D platformer fan game

title: Dungeon Odyssey
description:
Aaron Hall's Dungeon Odyssey is an RPG where you will adventure to far off lands and encounter a multitude of different creatures.

But once you complete the game, the fun is not over. Dungeon Odyssey creates a random world for you each time you play. So no two games are ever the same. And to add to the fun, the game is completely customizable (moddable) so that players can create their own modules for others to play.

You will become a character within the game and will play the role of that character as you venture through the world. You will have one main quest to complete in the module, and many other smaller quests to complete if you wish. As you decide on a style of playing, you can shape your character towards that style with different items, skills, and spells.

title: Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League - Season of Deathstroke
description: Season of Deathstroke of Suicide Squad: Kill the Justice League delivers the final content updates for the game, bringing new features and enhancements. This season introduces Deathstroke as a playable character, alongside new melee weapons, Infamy sets, Notorious gear, and a fresh map called Elseworlds Mayhem. The season is divided into two episodes—Episode 7: Control and Episode 8: Balance—culminating in a battle against Brainiac.

title: The Finals: Season 4 - It's Showtime!
description:
Season 4 was the fourth season of THE FINALS. It launched on September 26, 2024, and ended on December 12, 2024. It was revealed on September 12, 2024, and previewed on September 20, 2024, at TwitchCon San Diego.

Season 4 puts particular focus on the sponsors of THE FINALS and the game show environment itself, with sponsors featured heavily in the season's arena and new progression paths.

This season was sponsored by HOLTOW, ENGIMO, and ISEUL-T, who introduced the all-new arena Fortune Stadium and the new sponsor career.

New content introduced in Season 4 includes:
- Arena: Fortune Stadium
- New cosmetics
- New Battle Pass
- Weapons: M26 Matter, Pike-556, .50 Akimbo
- Weapon sights
- Enhanced World Tour
- Progression: Sponsorships, new career levels

Season 4 reintroduced:
- Ranked Cashout tournaments

title: Depth-Blind
description:
It's the year 59,341, and you, multihyphenate Captain Mari, have been dispatched to the underwater depths of a planet on the Outer Rim of the galaxy, following a violently disastrous previous expedition. You're not alone though - your companion Ana is always supporting and supervising you via a camera drone.

With a variety of weapons and Ana by your side, shoot your way through waves of alien creatures in Depth-Blind!

title: Rescue Team: Evil Genius - Collector's Edition
description:
Stop a mad scientist replicating the most destructive forces in nature! The Rescue Team has its hands full as it braves volcanoes, earthquakes, blizzards and more to save the people, animals and homes that lie in the path of utter devastation! Download Rescue Team: Evil Genius Collector's Edition today and join the greatest group of heroes to ever battle nature's fury!
- Captivating story and vibrant animated world
- Expert and casual modes
- Learn-as-you-play instructions

The Collector’s Edition includes 20 bonus levels, 40 achievements to earn, gold level pass guide, character biographies, FBI files, concept art and music!

title: Pulsatio Cordis
description: Go on a date with the most popular guy at school!

title: Canvas
description: An exploration game with the core mechanic of painting the environment to alter the world. You must gain upgrades, abilities, and solve puzzles to eventually defeat the mad wizard that trapped you.

title: Straftat: Weapons, Maps and Hats
description:
The DLC "Weapons, Maps and Hats" contains :

- 70+ maps (totaling 140+ with the base game)

- 10 exclusive guns

- many new hats

Unlocked DLC content will be available for both players in owner's lobby.

Find the new guns on the DLC exclusive maps.

New cosmetic hats are unlocked immediately upon purchase.

title: Parasocial! Paranoia! Paradise!
description: You just got yourself a new girlfriend! She's everything you could have ever wanted! Now just be sure she doesn't escape.

title: Matryoshka
description:
Matryoshka is a spooky spot-the-difference puzzle game that tests eyes and nerves.

Cursed entities that devour humans have gotten into the Matryoshka dolls. Inspect them with extreme caution. If you encounter a cursed doll, you must immediately burn and seal it away.Miss a curse, or burn an innocent doll—even once—and... you will find out

title: Syntaxia
description: SYNTAXIA is a dream-dark adventure game that allows you to rewrite reality itself by changing the words that describe it. Use your creativity and intuition to escape. Which path will you choose?

title: Valor of Man
description:
Valor of Man is a roguelike tactical RPG where enemies react to your actions, giving you endless chances to outsmart them with your tactics.
Valor of Man is developed by Legacy Forge, small indie studio created by 2 brothers.

title: Space Engineers 2
description: Space Engineers 2 is an open world sandbox game where engineering meets exploration, construction, and survival in the vastness of space. Become a pioneer in the distant Almagest system, a new uncharted world with infinite possibilities for creativity and discovery. Build everything from starships to space stations as you craft your own path in this highly anticipated next chapter of the Space Engineers series!

title: Burger Shop Simulator 2024
description: This is a game developed in Japan where you can freely create hamburgers. You can use your bike to deliver burgers to your customers with a unique delivery system

title: Pathologic 3: Quarantine
description: Pathologic 3: Quarantine is a narrative-driven adventure about a young scientist in search of immortality and a mysterious plague outbreak in a small town. Learn how your story began and what drove a celebrated academic to leave his acclaimed lab. Examine patients, uncover strange secrets, and make first steps towards defeating Death.

title: Deltarune: A Different Snowgrave
description: A Deltarune Fan-Game containing creative, difficult battle based on the "Snowgrave" route from Deltarune Chapter 2, as well as several unlockable achievements!

title: Deadly Rehearsal
description: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

title: Sauk Mind
description: Three stories of three beings. Sauk, a soul and its mission as such. The life before the death of that soul with the issues he left to solve, and Estefan Tromani, Romanian that we incarnate in a big city. Tromani is involved in accessing a dangerous group of criminals called Club Five. Club Five is a small and discreet organization that operates above legality and morality, always involved in shady jobs, unknown to many and very few are able to put name and face to its members. They execute their business with bloody efficiency. The access to Club Five will not be free and everyone who belongs to them knows it well. Tromani will have to perform some loyalty and submission tests that few people would be willing to pass.

title: Walled City Sunset
description:
Welcome to Walled City!

You work here as an industrial climber. Fix AC units, talk to people, find lost cats, connect buildings and dream to witness the sunset at the top of the city.

title: Dequivsia
description: Dequivsia is a puzzle game developed by Nishikigatsuo in which you navigate to a maze-like structure and collect keys. Some rooms are holes, and entering them costs a life. Each room has an hint of how many solid rooms are around, needing a minesweeper-like strategy for navigating the maze.

title: Genshin Impact: Incandescent Ode of Resurrection
description:
Version 5.3 of Genshin Impact, which includes:
• New characters: Mavuika, Citlali, Lan Yan, and the Pyro version of the Traveler
• New outfits for Hu Tao and Xiangling
• New main story quest: Archon Quest, Chapter V - Act V "Incandescent Ode of Resurrection"
• New Tribal Chronicles quest for the Masters of the Night-Wind, and new story quest for Mavuika
• New permanent game mode: Repertoire of Myriad Melodies
• New main event: Springtime Charms
• New quality of life features
• …and more!

title: The Campsite
description:
The Campsite is a short point-and-click adventure game, inspired by and crafted in the style of early genre classics, and adapted for a modern-day experience.

If you have a passion for graphic adventures but never find the time to play, this might be exactly what you’re looking for.

With about 60 minutes of gameplay, a simplified UI, and no dialogue trees, it is an excellent choice for casual players. It can be played anytime, alone or with others, and is suitable for all ages.

For those new to classic point-and-click adventures, The Campsite is a great starting point. Featuring a balanced difficulty level and lighter gameplay, it offers an accessible and enjoyable experience for beginners, and hopefully, you’ll be captivated by the magic that makes this genre so special!

title: Wuthering Waves: All Silent Souls Can Sing
description:
Version 2.0 of Wuthering Waves is the game's first major post-release update, and it includes:
• New characters: Carlotta and Roccia
• New region: Rinascita, with several new areas
• New story quests: Prologue - Through the Sea Thou Break
• New exploration systems
• New echoes, events and more!

title: Honkai: Star Rail - Paean of Era Nova
description:
Version 3.0 of Honkai: Star Rail is the game's second major post-release update, and it includes:
• New characters: The Herta, Aglaea, and the Remembrance path for the Trailblazer
• New character path: Remembrance
• New Trailblaze mission
• New planet: Amphoreus
• New quality of life updates
• …and more!

title: Compartmentalize
description: A narrative Sokoban puzzler about grief, anger, reflection, and other complex emotions and feelings created for the Lady Arcaders Game Jam (LAG Jam 2024). "Sokoban" refers to the mechanic of moving objects around a level towards a marked goal.

title: Nippets
description: Nippets is a hidden objects game. It is inspired by the joy of people watching and telling small stories. Set in a hand-drawn, interactive city, you must open windows, pull blinds and shake treets to find items and return them to their rightful owners.

title: Baptisterio
description: With an analog camera, a gift from my father, a photo of the missing tourists and the illusion of my first big news I prepare to enter with the brothers to the enigmatic baptistery.

title: Pixel Dungeon RPG
description: Dive into procedurally generated dungeons filled with hidden treasures, cunning traps, and fierce monsters. Customize your hero with a vast array of weapons, armor, and magical items. Engage in strategic turn-based combat, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the rich lore of the dungeon. Face formidable bosses and adopt loyal pets to aid you in battle.

title: Runes of Legend
description: Runes of Legend is an immersive pixel adventure game set in a captivating fantasy world filled with mystery and magic. You can step into the role of a courageous adventurer tasked with exploring a once-peaceful land now threatened by the resurgence of dark forces.

title: Madness Below
description: Madness Below is a RPG dark fantasy horror game developed by Sif Kamira that began development in November 2024.

title: Kero Quest 64
description: Kero Quest 64 is a Collectathon 3D Platformer inspired by other games in the genre, especially those from the late 90s. You take control of Kero, a blue frog seeking to stop a prince from abusing his newly gained powers by collecting Magical Shards around the kingdom.

title: Ys vs. Trails in the Sky: Alternative Saga
description:
Finally, the walls between Falcom's legendary RPG series, Ys and Trails, are broken for the ultimate dream match up! Fan-favorite heroes and rivals clash in battles once thought impossible, with support from beloved characters across Falcom's classic titles to aid you in the fight!

This new version of the PSP title features remastered graphics, online multiplayer, English translation and voice acting, and other new features.

title: Arima Lodge
description: Arima Lodge is a free, 5-minute, fixed-camera short story that takes place entirely inside an elevator. It features limited dialogue options from Kai's perspective, and on-screen QTE events to open and close the elevator doors when a new character enters.

title: Katana Dragon
description:
Katana Dragon is an action-RPG adventure and dungeons exploration, where you play as the ninjas Shin and Nobi in their quest to end the curse that hangs over Sogen.
Learn ninja skills, upgrade your Dragon Gems, equip the Cursed Seals and level up. Avoid traps, solve puzzles and fight powerful enemies.
Your ninja way begins!

title: A War On Christmas 3: World War C
description: The third installment in the "A War on Christmas Series" featuring 12 maps of Christmas Mania.

title: Zenoken
description:
A stealthy space opera metroidvania where actions have consequences.
The stars call the Chinokitsune a space pirate--& often an assassin--but stranded on a strange alien world after a failed heist, It's up to you to reckon with your own past & motivations to thwart an ancient evil & maybe find love.

title: Cereal Killer
description: Follow Milton, a farmer who witnesses strange events on his farm until he realizes that his cereal plantation is more alive than it should be..

title: Kick To Hell
description: In Kick To Hell you control Jeremiah returning home from work, until after desecrating a ritual, inexplicable things start to happen and something starts to chase you.

title: The Bag Man's Curse
description: This game follows a 12-year-old boy called Peter who, despite rumors of missing children, decides to leave home and ends up discovering macabre things.

title: Haruka na Sora
description:
The censored release of the fan disc for Yosuga no Sora.
The fandisc features bonus scenarios and visual novel versions of web radio episodes. The bonus scenarios include routes for Kozue and Yahiro (who did not have routes in the original game), as well as an epilogue for Sora's main game route. Additionally, it includes a bonus scenario featuring the characters doing karaoke.

title: Perennial Dusk: Kinsenka
description:
Industry veteran Yukito Urushibara and prolific illustrator Saine join forces for the first time to craft a stunning tale about a group of young people in an eerie world of endless twilight. Follow their story as they struggle against limitless cruelty and confront the inescapable traumas of life and death together.

Perennial Dusk: Kinsenka is the latest visual novel written by Yukito Urushibara, whose work on Irotoridori no Sekai and Sakura Moyu captivated players with stories that inspire hope as readily as they induce despair.

title: Nekura na Classmate ga Ore no Ibukuro wo Tsukande Hanashite Kurenai
Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
description: Dash, dodge, and dive through the ultimate Japanese gameshow experience! Up to 4 contestants race through chaotic obstacle courses across Japan, filled with hilarious hazards and obscure obstacles. It’s so crazy, you’ll be shouting ‘Konnichi-what?!’ instead of ‘Konnichiwa!’

title: Justice Ninja Casey
description: The 16-bit classic comes to the West for the very first time! A princess in a castle has been kidnapped by a group of mysterious ninjas. Luckily for her, a young ninja named Casey is aware of the situation, and embarks on a mission to save her because... He is the Ninja of Justice!

title: Feudal Bros: Tonosama #1
description: Japan. Edo period. After many years of violent wars, peace has returned to the land, but it doesn’t seem like it will last for long. A new danger lurks in the shadows, and only two noblemen can stop it: Lord Baka, a Japanese feudal lord, and Prince Bouffon, a prince from the faraway land of France.

title: Dreams of Saturn 2.0
description:
Inspired by Shenmue, this brand-new edition of Dreams of Saturn features an entirely new chapter that takes Ryo to Yokosuka Harbor for another fun-filled Christmas story! Packed with SEGA references and Easter eggs, including the legendary Segata Sanshiro, and follow the tale of Santa Maeno as he embarks on a mission to save Christmas for the residents of Yokosuka!

This release includes both Dreams of Saturn 1 and 2.0 as one full game, allowing you to select a starting point depending on if you are playing the entire game fresh or for the first time, or already experienced Dreams of Saturn 1 and wanted to jump straight ahead to the 2nd chapter.

title: Crosstown Carnage
description:
Crosstown Carnage is 1 large map that was originally conceived as a mini-episode.
After clearing the aliens out of the West Coast of the USA, Duke heads back east to start the cleanup there. From the tops of skyscrapers, Duke will have to navigate the city's old subway system to find where the Battlelord has been hiding.

Crosstown Carnage contains two new alien types: the Freeze Trooper and the Expander Trooper. The Freeze Trooper fires freezer blasts at Duke. These pack a punch, but won't immediately kill you. The Expander Trooper fires blasts of microwaves which will fry Duke. Hit enough, and Duke expands until he explodes. Both may drop their respective ammo when they die.

title: Yarışçı Arazi
description: Yarışçı Arazi (Racer Off-Road) is a video game refers to the originally Turkish Radio Television (TRT)'s interactive entertainment show "Yarışçı".

title: Replikant Chat
description: A fun and immersive experience for all, where you can interact in real-time with 3D characters like never before.

title: Throneheir
description: As the Champion of Avalon Kingdom, the knight Jethro is entrusted with the task of raising and training Prince Magnus, he who carries in his blood the prophecy that shall set the Kingdom free. On his journey to prepare the young Prince, he will learn about fatherhood, love and betrayal.

title: Thesaurus
description: Help Joan the warrior and her best friend Krista find peace and redemption in this RPG tale worth about 10-15 hours of playtime.

title: Sister's Little Helper
description: Sister's Little Helper is about Chloe, a girl who has trouble sleeping. Help her by performing her daily ritual: rolling a joint and then telling a story. There are 45 unique stories to discover!

title: Clueless Crew
description: Scavenge through abandoned locations with your friends, buy tools, and venture further into eerie corridors and rooms filled with monsters and ghosts, then haul the loot back to the truck before dawn.

title: Ninja Ming
description: Embark on a thrilling 2D platforming adventure as Ninja Ming, a master of teleportation in this precision-based game. Navigate the challenging Path of Transcendence, where your teleportation skills are key to conquering obstacles and reaching new heights. As you progress through the Forest, Wind, Mountain, and Fire trials, each step is a chance to refine your skills and become even more formidable. Use your teleportation abilities to maneuver with speed and style, overcoming each new challenge that comes your way. The harder the trials, the greater your growth.

title: Tavern Legends
description: Tavern Legends is a medieval tavern simulation. Fulfill the needs of various patrons and design taverns according to your vision. Create your own meals, manage your inventory, and hire workers. Become a legendary tavern keeper!

title: Past Hope
description: A short story about a hopeless yandere.

title: Mech Explorer
description:
In a post-apocalyptic world, a mercenary explores the ruins of an underground city,
piloting her mech, in search of her missing partner.

title: Polar Roller
description: You're a snowman's head trying to get to your body. Collect snowflakes to get bigger and snowman parts (hat, nose, etc) to be more than just a pile of snow.

title: Mineral Defense
description: Mineral Defense combines tower defense with roguelite elements and procedural generation. Build paths, unlock upgrades, and unleash powerful synergies to conquer evolving challenges in an ever-expanding world.

title: Meatshot
description: MEATSHOT is a gory, action-packed shooter where you embody an unstoppable beast in a digital realm. Run along walls, dodge bullets, and pull off acrobatic gunfights in slow motion with pinpoint accuracy as you unleash carnage, taking down elite soldiers.

title: Zundamon Castle
description: A very cute RTS! Modify the voxel ground and defend your castle with Zundamons! A game set in Japan's medieval period, created by Japanese developers.

title: Tower of the Ice Lich
description: A pixelated homage to 16-bit RPGs, this former print-and-play card game has come full circle as a digital experience! Choose your champion, enter the tower, and make wise decisions on your ascent to face the Ice Lich at the top

title: Space Misadventures
description: a NSFW Space Adventure!

title: Space Misadventures DX
description: Space Misadventures is a classic Point and Click adventure game... for adults.

title: Tie: A Game About Depression
description:
TIE is a game about depression and the daily grind we are all forced too endure. Experience a week of more of the same, every day, through the eyes of our main character as the world and its inhabitants slowly start too become increasingly unfamiliar. Irregularities in the world and from deep within plague your day to day and a strange force seems to tear the very fabric of reality itself, as it becomes apparent that not all is as it seems in this short, atmospheric game about depression and existential dread.

An intricately detailed and beautiful pixel art world to explore.
An atmospheric narrative about the routine we all face and the void beyond.
A wonderful, hauntingly melancholy soundtrack composed by Meat Analogue.
We become aware of the void as we fill it. Embrace life. Embrace work. Embrace routine. Embrace the unnatural but strangely compelling voice of the void that calls to you from beyond; a place neither here nor there, but rather simply... just is. After you...

title: Mousegun
description:
Mousegun is a retro FPS in which you take control of the titular character in an action filled adventure.

The renegade robots are lose after the attack by Doctor Deabeat on the Drumstar system. Mousegun have been tasked to retreive their stolen documents and bring peace once more to the system. Can you stop the rebel robots ?

title: Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid - Adam Park
description: This unlocks Adam Park - MMPR Black Ninja Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Power Rangers: Battle For the Grid - Jen Scotts: Time Force Pink Ranger
description: This unlocks Jen Scotts - Time Force Pink Ranger, a full character, to be played in Power Rangers: Battle for the Grid

title: Famulus
description: Famulus is a short retro-style shoot-em-up-and-down adventure game about kebabs made by me (programming, sounds, graphics) in about 2 weeks for Sewer Jam 5.

title: Obama Alien Defense
description: President Obama stars in this exciting game in which he defends against a huge alien invasion. Help the President battle the space aliens to save the world. Use the arrow keys to move and the Z button to shoot.

title: Rusty Drill
description: Rusty Drill is a 32 map community megawad which began development back in 2023 to celebrate Scythe turning 20. ﻿This project was a continuation of the Scythe themed community project "Scythe: Re-sharpened" by EPICALL.

title: Furry Aim Trainer
description: Train your aim with a beautiful selection of Furry girls! Shoot the girls with various weapons, and have a fun time while practicing!

title: Kandinhale
description: Kandinhale is a story-driven short RPG game in which you'll have to escape from the clutches of Kandinhale, the company that owns almost the entire consumable market in this idyllic candy world.

title: Ginger's Letter to Santa
description: "This is it! This year I will cook the best roast Christmas dinner the Zodiacs has ever seen! They will all scream for more and then nobody will try to eat me, no more no more!" Join Ginger, Sullyvan, and the Gonk on this RPG Christmas Adventure as they deliver their letters to Santa's Factory!

title: Tales Beyond the Tomb: The Farm's Secret
description:
"Tales Beyond The Tomb" is a chilling episodic horror series that plunges players into the shadows of real-life cases.

This is the second episode of the series:

Episode 2: The Farm's Secret
Dragged into a web of secrets and lies, Samantha seems to be part of a puzzle impossible to solve. What once seemed obvious soon turns into something far more sinister, and the line between villain and victim begins to blur.

Nothing is as it seems. How far will you go to uncover the truth?

title: CELL 0: Cyber Entertainment Leisure Lounge
description: CELL is a short non-linear visual novel in a post-apocalypse/cyberpunk setting. Kenzo is an artificially grown human who lived his entire life alone isolated with a sweet, but artificial service intelligence. He's not okay. Help him to go through the disturbing situation he's about to get into.

title: DougDoug's Basement: How I Got a Sea Otter A Promotion!
description:
"Created for the DougDoug Rosa Charity Stream of 2024, DougDoug's Basement: How I Got a Sea Otter A Promotion! regales the epic quest of a Bell Pepper, an otter, Pajama Sam, and Luther on their unexpected quest to defeat the three Peggle Masters" - the officaal website.

A visual novel themed after the streamer/comedian DougDoug and the lore, characters, and videos he creates.

title: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
description: A 2D side-scrolling platformer with cute and dreamlike aesthetics. The ever growing colossal tree known as "the witch's hand" is growing out of control. Froggo sets foot on a journey to investigate the tree in hopes of finding a solution to save his home.

title: Clinical Trial
description: A suspense tale about signing up to test psychiatric drugs for money and provider-patient relations.

title: ChronoClock
description: Next in line to manage a multi-million dollar corporation is our protagonist, Rei Sawatari. He inherited one very important heirloom from his late grandfather: a single pocket watch that grants him a mysterious power— The power to go five minutes back in time.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Day One Edition
description: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II - Collectors' Edition
description:
Kingdom Come: Deliverance II Collector’s Edition
This is the ultimate in Kingdom Come: Deliverance II goodness. You’ll get everything that’s found in the Gold Edition – the standard edition, Expansion Pass and Gallant Huntsman’s Kit plus the Lion's Crest Bonus Quest. What’s more, you’ll also get a statue of Henry and his trusty steed, Pebbles; the exclusive cloth map Alleys of Kuttenberg; the enamel pin set Coats of Valor; the iconic Letter of Hope - which Sir Hans Capon was entrusted with; and the King’s Rebels collectable cards set.

title: Stellar Code
description: Mysterious phenomena from space. A researcher's fatal accident. Cryptic codes engraved on an unknown material. Together with your brilliant sister-in-law, you must unravel a mystery that could determine the fate of Earth. A sci-fi mystery visual novel of discovery and suspense.

title: Smoky White
description: A short visual novel set on a snowy winter rooftop, where you meet and part ways with a mysterious upperclassman. The story branches into different endings based on your dialogue choices.

title: Santy is Home
description: It's Christmas day! Your daughter is knocking on your door early in the morning, better go check it out! Wait, what's this note? Where's your daughter? Who's Santy and why do we need to prepare a present for him to get our daughter back? Well, just do what the note says, what could possibly go wrong?

title: Bat Galaxy
description: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

title: Winter Walk 2006
description: Winter Walk 2006 is a short game that was originally developed in November 2020 for the Haunted PS1 Madvent Calendar 2020.

title: Bloons 2 Christmas Expansion
description: Ninja Kiwi brings you a special exclusive pack of Christmas themed Bloons 2 levels. Have a happy and safe Christmas!

title: Hidden Tomatoes
description: Hidden Tomatoes is a relaxing hidden object game where you search for 100 hidden tomatoes in a detailed city environment. Explore the streets, buildings, and alleys at your own pace, with no time limits or pressure. Can you spot all the tomatoes?

title: Bloody Cleanup
description: A co-op roguelike horror game where you descend in an endless elevator and complete assigned tasks. Each floor brings new monsters, new locations, and new challenges.

title: Soul Shuffler
description: In this card-based roguelite, you'll be a demon specializing in the souls of inanimate objects. Explore the ever-changing Limbo, defeat and collect the countless souls within, use them to expand your Domain, and dominate the Infernal Tournament with your mad soul-shuffling skills to make Hell yours!

title: Souten Koihime: Shigen no Ou
description: First title of a new series in the long running Koihime franchise, this time taking place in ancient China.

title: Wind Breaker: Furyou-tachi no Eiyuutan
description: A 3D animation RPG that depicts the world of the TV anime "WIND BREAKER". You can enjoy the story of the TV anime, which is presented in 3D and anime cuts, as well as the original story of Shishitoren. In battles with simple controls, you can use "special moves" and "tag skills" to fight. There are many other elements as well. Protect the city with Sakura and his friends!

title: Luna and the Wasted City of Sin
description: A ruin-delving turn-based RPG. After taking on a request, half-beast Luna heads into the overwhelmingly shady ruins, but finds only evil monsters running rampant within... Each time you enter the ruins, the enemies and traps you encounter will change.

title: Cat Tree
description: Cat Tree is a relaxing indie game. Collect cats, watch them grow on your tree, and unlock new sections of it. Gather rare, epic, and legendary cats to create a unique collection and uncover all the secrets of the tree!

title: Tiled Together
description:
Spend coins to spin the slot machine and earn coins by joining tiles together. Some tiles will give coins for being adjacent to other certain tiles. There are many tile group combinations to discover that each has different adjacency bonuses and point values. Earn as many points as you can before you run out of coins!

There are a handful of tile combinations. Place four of the same tile types together! Or try surrounding your tile on all sides. Bankruptcy is inevitable, but there's always a new map to draw up and new Share your biggest discoveries with other mapmakers, or spread rumors of the creatures that inhabit the deepest waters.

Maps are Tiled Together in this world. Journeys are revealed with the turning of ancient ceremonial tiles. By will alone, you create the landscape for adventurers, merchants, and miscreants. Bring together townsfolk to develop cities, reveal the path to an oasis in the middle of endless sands. Lay the world out in front of everyone. Your craft is a gamble but not without its rewards. A new discovery could result in a windfall of gold and renown!

title: Elflock
description: Elflock is a single-player third-person adventure. You are a princess returning to your home on the brink of war and it's up to you to navigate the machinations of the nobles surrounding the king. Engage in intricate dialogues and uncover mysteries in this branching fantasy tale!

title: Conquest of Elysium 2
description:
Conquest of Elysium is a fantasy game where you and your friends take control of a powerful warlord or wizard and struggle for total control of the continent. Up to eight players may participate and the computer can control any free players. The game is turn-based so you only need one computer to play the game with up to seven friends.

Conquest of Elysium was originally released in 1996 for the Atari Falcon line of computers. The number "II" denotes the version number.

title: Island of Despair
description: An episode 3 replacement for Heretic to celebrate its 30th anniversary.

title: Slugger 2
description: The sequel to Chris Hansen's first Slugger map

title: Deck the Underhalls
description: 34 festive Underhalls tributes in MBF21 format. Explore endless underground tunnels, collect more super shotguns than you'll ever know what to do with﻿, an﻿d marve﻿l at the shotgunners stuck in ﻿the walls!﻿

title: Wordlike
description: A word roguelike. Make words, tune your bag of letters, and collect power-ups to beat increasingly difficult levels.

title: Pure Chaotix
description: Pure Chaotix is a fan-game that aims to blend 2D side-scrolling and 3D graphics. Gameplay is fast-paced while focusing on teamwork and puzzle solving.

title: Sonic Rebirth
description: Sonic Rebirth is a remake of Sonic 1 created by Power Sonic Team / Gabriel Ludwig.

title: Minecraft Create: Above and Beyond
description:
Create: Above and Beyond adds a variety of mods and compiles them into an epic technological journey toward space travel.

About fifty inventions lie between you and the moon. Thousands of components will flow into and through the ever-growing sequence of your machines, providing the means to explore the next level of technology.

Your entire factory will be put to a test as final products flow into the Data Centre, programming the Guidance computer of your Spaceship. Every step of the way is different, some may even differ depending on the generation seed of your World.

Tired of the grind? Fund the operation with coin provided either from various errands, or your chosen professions. Automatically ship produce from your farms or gather other players to aid you in your mission. Then you can purchase all manner of resources, artifacts and building blocks from the market.

title: Yet Another Sonic the Hedgehog Minigame
Sonic the Hedgehog: Rebirth of the Azure Wind
Ember Fall
description: Step into the shoes of a lone wanderer in a ruined world, guarding the last ember of hope. Solve creative light-based puzzles, battle predators lurking in the shadows, and uncover the forgotten secrets of a broken land in this emotional platformer adventure.

title: PR: Rivenverse
description:
PR:Rivenverse is a story-focused RPG developed in RPGMaker(MV).

Taking place thousands of years after the annihilation of Humanity, focusing on a new 'elemental' based society built over the remains of the Earth, created by several Gods and ruled by its twelve Maintainers.

But we all know that there is rarely any society that thrives completely devoid of threat, as a recently formed organization known as the Fatali Stellae has been participating in a handful of questionable activities under the guise of their organization simply being business-related.
Thankfully, there are a few who are already aware of their true intentions and misdeeds, and may even soon put everything about them into light.

title: Fading Remnants
description: The earth has changed these past few years. Humanity is a lonely shell of what it once was, and the world is a very different place. In the face of such hardship, how does one cope with loss, and how far would you go for family?

title: Secret of the Abbey
