The dream-filled Tree of Savior now continues with its official masterpiece, "Tree of Savior: Neverland"!

Produced by Kim Hakkyu, with music by Motoi Sakuraba, featuring masterful visuals and soundtracks, it's a heartwarming MMO filled with joy and wonder!

title: Hentai: Nazi Girl
description: HENTAI: NAZI GIRL is a satirical 3rd person shooter where you play as a sexy naked girl. You will have to destroy the enemies, evil and dangerous, also go to their base, where you need to kill everyone (unexpectedly, right?), you need to collect propaganda posters (and they contain jokes with elements of black humor, be sure to read it). After collecting all the propaganda posters, you need to find the hidden invitation to the club. And then a new big enemy will appear and you will be allowed to destroy the eyes lying on the ground, which indicate a connection with the enemy.

title: Sister Lumina and the Hypnosis Cult
description: When Lumina is forced to open a forbidden book passed down by her grandmother in order to rescue her best friend, she will have to pay a hefty price to gain the power to free her and ensure her safety.

title: Reksio i Kretes: Sermageddon
description: The statue of the Cheese God has been stolen! The weather is going crazy… Could it be that the enraged Cheese God is bringing Cheesemageddon down upon the Earth? Who would dare commit such a sacrilege? Pirates? Aliens? One thing is certain — our heroes will be forced to return to the darkest location of all their adventures — Paris.

title: Catcha
description: Catcha is a catching game where you shoot bombs and bosses, not your average catching game...

title: Submerged Mystery: Takodachi
description: Submerged Mystery: Takodachi is a top-down dungeon-crawling RPG featuring the Takodachis by Ninomae Ina'nis from hololive English. Players explore a sprawling labyrinth filled with puzzles, powerful enemies, and secrets tied to the enigmatic Ancient Ones. As you delve deeper, you unlock new abilities and summon skills from past Takodachis to aid in your journey. Elemental Affinities play a crucial role in combat, allowing players to strategize against the unique challenges posed by the Takodachis guarding the labyrinth.

title: Saintess of the Golden Bow
description:
Celine thought her life as an American office worker was mundane, but after a fatal accident, she wakes up as an extra character in her favorite web novel a BL tragedy fantasy. Expected to die early as part of the protagonist's backstory, Celine defies fate and survives her death event, causing a butterfly effect that catapults her into the role of the Saintess of the Golden Bow.

Joined by an unforgettable cast of characters including the valiant knight Levi, the enigmatic Mad Prince Noah, and the devout High Priest Elijah you must lead a quest to defeat the Demon Queen and bring peace to the realm. Each choice you make weaves a complex web of romance, friendship, and sacrifice, offering a deeply personal and replayable journey.

title: Frosted Love
description: A short visual novel featuring Dizzy Dokuro, Kaneko Lumi, Hoshiumi Jelly and Ember Amane from the VTuber agency Phase-Connect.

title: The Big Gay Adventure
description: The Big Gay Adventure is a bright and silly, JRPG-inspired game that explores identity, community, and free queer expression.

title: Megabonk
description: Smash your way through endless waves of enemies and grow absurdly powerful! Grab loot, level up, unlock characters and upgrade to create unique and crazy builds as you fend off hordes of creatures!

title: Beneath a Dead City
description: Run your own Adventurer's Guild in this fantasy colony sim with a focus on dynamic storytelling. Recruit heroes to explore a ruined city, but keep an eye on those murder hobos. An unhappy hero could turn to arson, violence, and jaywalking.

title: Archwizard
description: Fast paced "Hyper Shooter" complemented with esoteric exploration experience. Take a quest to become Arch Wizard: dominate surrounding realms, reverse Time, escape Death, befriend Chaos, face the End of the World. Knowledge based progression. High scores. Full of secrets.

title: ESHQ
description:
Unknown government spy must steal secret files from the building called “Evil scientists headquarters”. But his job gonna be a bit more difficult and long...

ESHQ is an abbreviation that means “Evil scientists headquarters”. This is the name for the fake experimental center, used for distraction from the real infrastructure complex:

title: Fentanyl Edition
description: Fentanyl Edition is a Fast-Paced Arena Shooter. With the most surreal visuals you may lay your eyes upon.

title: City of Voices
description: A short Golden Idol-like deduction game about a young girl who is catapulted from her suburban life into the mysterious world of the ancient Maya. Investigate a series of moments frozen in time. Examine clues and solve puzzles to uncover a story full of twists and turns. Co-developed by one of the writers and designers of The Rise of the Golden Idol.

title: Tron 2.0: Killer App Mod
description:
The objective of the Killer App Mod for TRON 2.0 on the PC, is to incorporate elements from TRON 2.0: Killer App for the Xbox platform that were never released for the PC version of TRON 2.0.

It also includes other fixes and additions for the game, such as 16:9 and 16:10 Widescreen support.

New to Version 1.1a of the mod is compatibility with the Steam version of TRON 2.0, easier installation, v1.1 bug fixes, and restored Multiplayer support in-game on both the CD/DVD and Steam versions.

title: Yuurou: Transient Sands
description: Riku is a knight of the Yuurou empire, part of a medieval fantasy world known as Varcias. One day, returning to Yuurou through the desert, Riku found a girl lying nearly unconscious on the sand. This girl is revealed to be Azusa, a modern-day Japanese schoolgirl who, thanks to a time warp, ended up in Varcias. Riku must now help Azusa return to her home world. But enemy forces are attacking Yuurou, and the Empress is in desperate need of assistance...

title: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City 2001
description: Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City 2001 is a lore friendly total conversion mod for Grand Theft Auto 3 that attempts to make the game more in line with its counterparts from later in the 3D era by updating gameplay as well as design direction to match that of its successors.

title: To the End of the Way
Table Game End
description: After school today, I talk with her again. Through the window, I see the sunset and someone playing in the schoolyard. We simply watch the scene or share memories from the past."TABLE GAME END" is an adventure game.

title: Journey of Johann: Grasslands
description:
Journey of Johann is an action adventure platformer with puzzle elements.
Make your way through levels and a boss with different challenges and obstacles.
Collect goblets, secrets and beat time trials.
Use your weapons as tools such as climbing, blocking hits, and defeating enemies.

title: Steamboat Willie Incident
description: Steamboat Willie Incident is a 3D horror survival game where you are captured in a steamboat and you have to find ways to escape without alerting Willie. Try to find clues, solve puzzles and hide from Willie in a claustrophobic steamboat where you are surrounded only by sea. Will you be able to?

title: Wobbly Construction!
description: Reach the top of the construction site. Carefully place each step, watch out for obstacles on your way up, and try not to quit the game out of frustration.

title: Casino Heist: Aruba
description: *Casino Heist: Aruba* is a comedic heist Visual Novel and dating sim where every choice counts. Assemble a team, craft the perfect plan, and tackle a high-stakes robbery targeting a shady casino. Can you outsmart the odds, secure a fortune, and maybe even find love? The score of a lifetime awaits!

title: Acid Web
description: Defend your web from an onslaught of strange creatures to the beat of a dynamic, generative acid techno soundtrack in this all-nonsense arcade-style twin stick shooter.

title: Net Raiders
description: Net Raiders is a single-player game that combines RPG, deck-building, and roguelike elements. In order to survive the dangers of the ruined virtual world, you must synthesize the cards in your hand to find the best move and defeat the enemies you encounter!

title: FleshBound
description: FleshBound is a fast paced and blood pumping demon-slaying speed running first person action platformer with a unique “splatterpunk” aesthetic. Fight, jump and sprint your way through the levels using your hookshot and wall-running skills.

title: Diddy
description: Destroy a dark party in Diddy's mansion. Gather your comrades Eminam and 51 Cent and save Justin B from Diddy! You can destroy the party with your friends by experiencing co-op

title: REVEREX: DX
description: REVEREX: DX is a 2-player asymmetric experience that blends platforming action and microgames on a visually stunning trip through the mind. Don the roles of Lab Technicians operating an experimental Coma Treatment device, explore the deepest reaches of the subconscious and rescue your patient!

title: Honkai Impact 3rd: In Search of the Sun
description:
Version 8.0 of Honkai Impact 3rd, which includes
• New Part 2 Story Chapter VII: Bouquets of Unfulfilled Wishes
• New Part 2 Open World: Tower of Ruimu: God
• New S Rank Valkyrie: Reign Solaris (Durandal)
• New Featured Event: Countdown: To Sweet Dreams!
• ...and more!

title: Go!Go!Pizzaboy!
description:
The story unfolds as a young man takes on a part-time job as a Pizzaboy, prompting his move to a new city.
However, things take an unexpected turn when he finds himself entangled with a resort run by women, eccentric scientist, and even... code bugs?

title: Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop: Deluxe Edition
description:
Collect everything Uncle Chop's Rocket Shop has to offer in this convenient (if we don't say so ourselves) bundle. It contains the following:
• Base Game
• Soundtrack
• Deluxe Skin and Artbook

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Special Edition
description:
After 26 years, FATAL FURY is back!

Contents:
- Base game
- Season Pass 1
- DLC Character 1 "ANDY BOGARD"(Scheduled for: Summer 2025)
- DLC Character 2 "KEN" (Scheduled for: Summer 2025)
- DLC Character 3 "JOE HIGASHI" (Scheduled for: Fall 2025)
- DLC Character 4 "CHUN-LI" (Scheduled for: Winter 2025)
- DLC Character 5 "Mr. BIG"(Scheduled for: Early 2026)

[Special Bonus]
- Pre-order Bonus
Early Access: 3 Days (Playable from April 21, 2025)

- DLC Costume: “FATAL FURY 2: TERRY”
* Digital Version: Bonus included if you purchase the game by April 23, 2025.
* Preorder costume bonus may be released as paid DLC in the future.

title: The Storied Sword
description:
The Storied Sword is an action-platformer for retro consoles. Developed by Bite The Chili Productions and Raft Labs Interactive and published by Orc Face Games.

Assume the mantle of the mysterious folk hero Candlemaster Cedric or the elusive Orchid of Mourning, and wall-jump your way through the trials this fast-paced, multi-scrolling platformer has to offer.

Inspired by classics like Tecmo’s Ninja Gaiden and Sunsoft’s Batman, The Storied Sword is sure to raise the challenge level for NES Homebrew platformers and bring players the 8-bit twitch-combat style they know and love.

title: GlitchGuesser
description:
Step back into the nostalgia of the early internet with GlitchGuesser, the ultimate party game that turns pixelated chaos into a thrilling guessing competition! As distorted, compressed images gradually become clear, it’s a race against time to figure out what you’re seeing. Can you guess before anyone else?

Whether it’s a movie still, an anime character, a famous brand, or even custom creations, GlitchGuesser offers endless fun for players of all skill levels.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Director's Cut
description: Grand Theft Auto: Director's Cut is a video game compilation, developed by DMA Design and published by Rockstar Games. It was first released in May 1999. The compilation contains two discs - Grand Theft Auto and Grand Theft Auto: London 1969.

title: Make Good Choices
description: You’re just trying to get home. It’s only a quarter mile. One street. What could go wrong.

title: Mega Man New Menace
description: It's a Mega Man fan game!

title: Trapped on the Balcony
description: A classic point and click adventure

title: Debug Deadline
description: The main character is hired as a debugger at the game company “Dokidoki Games”! With a time limit of one week, will he be able to find the bug safely? The debugging work with fate on the line begins now!

title: Threefold Recital
description: Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms. A 2D platformer with puzzles.

title: Can We Still Get High
description: Embark on an exciting journey with your friends or on your own! To reach the top, you'll have to solve challenging puzzles, overcome dangerous obstacles, and coordinate with each other. Laser communication is both a blessing and a challenge!

title: The Treasures of Montezuma
description:
The objective in this tile matching game is to collect all of the sparkling gems in a level before the time runs out on the ticking pocket watch. The number needed for the level is displayed above the main grid. Swap one stone at a time by choosing a pair, which trade places with a click, slowly eliminating all those which contain gemstones. The entire board can be shuffled twice and hints can be purchased for the cost of points.

There are also timed mini-games sprinkled throughout the game which provide more opportunities to earn gold stars.

title: Stewie Kills the Griffins!
description: Damn you vile woman! In fact, DAMN THE WHOLE LOT OF THEM for that matter! Stewie Griffin has finally had it with the family, and he's looking to make good on some longstanding threats! Paint Quahog RED in this over the top, visceral cartoon murder sim that continues in the bloody footsteps established in the prior "KILLS" game series!

title: Endless Mind
description:
Explore a labyrinth filled with dangers.
Deadly traps, constant pressure, time is against you: every second counts to move forward. Will you be able to escape the multiple threats and regain your freedom?

title: Götz
description:
Goetz is a challenging game. But if you have a soft spot for planning ahead and making your units help each other to create a choreography that will bring the enemies to their knees, Goetz is for you.

Each solved mission is accompanied by a rewarding narrative piece, lovingly illustrated and fully voiced by a cast of over 12 voice-over artists. These not only seamlessly tie into the gameplay, but will draw you into a captivating story of friendship and intrigue that never takes itself too seriously.

title: Terminator 2D: No Fate
description: Experience the thrill of Terminator 2: Judgment Day with arcade action & pixel-perfect graphics! In this unique story blending iconic scenes from the movie with original scenarios and multiple endings, humanity’s fate is yours to decide.

title: Chinese Online Game
description: The player will play the role of an older unmarried young man Lao Wang, because of the lack of money for marriage in thinking of ways to accidentally be attracted by the pop-up ads of an online game endorsed by a certain celebrity, and the gears of destiny began to turn at that moment.

title: Wukong Fight in Kaoria
description: This is a single player action adventure game that includes mythological themed character actions and role-playing, You can use regular attacks and skills, spells, such as magic, celestial phenomena, and body fixing spells, to Fight and defeat the enemies you encounter.

title: The Simpsons: Night of the Dolphin!
description:
It's the ultimate battle for Springfield!

Based on the TREEHOUSE OF HORROR episode segment, choose a citizen and duke it out with some deadly dolphins looking to take over the town! Stand your ground against the endless streaming horde of aquatic attackers and push them back to the ocean!

title: The Dropouts
description: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

title: Louise Kills The Belchers!
description:
An afternoon nap interrupted by orders...to kill!
It's a bloody day on Ocean Avenue as Louise takes down the Belcher family. Her favorite toy Kuchi Kopi speaks to her and demands sacrifice. Armed with items found around the house and a dangerous mind, she's serving up murder and its a taste that can't be beat!

title: Doors: The Game!
description: Doors is a 2D platformer based on the animated series of the same name. For over 10 years Doors has been a collaborative effort featuring a record-breaking amount of artists coming together, each designing and animating their own room linked together to form one long adventure!

title: Roger Kills The Smiths!
description: Murder the members of the Smith Family from the hit tv show "American Dad". Explore the residence and destroy your targets using a variety of weapons.

title: The Coyote Kills The Road Runner!
description: After so many years. So many failed attempts. The coyote is going to do it. Finally, the Coyote will KILL the Road Runner! But is it just the law of the jungle, survival of the fittest? Or is there something more...sinister...behind the Wiley old coyote's motivations?

title: We Are Alive
description: We Are Alive is a Co-Op horror game, that can be played with at least 1 and up to 4 players. You are a detective and your mission is to investigate the old psychiatric hospital and find out the truth. Your standard equipment is a flashlight and a gun.

title: Bewilder House: Enhanced Edition
description:
Bewilder House is a classic first-person horror puzzle game that challenges your perception and willpower. Trapped in shifting mazes where the walls open and close when you're not looking, you'll need to rely on your mind and first-person controls to navigate a deceptive funhouse that manipulates your surroundings and your sense of reality. Every corner hides a new obstacle; every escape is just another illusion.

This enhanced edition brings minor improvements that breathe new life into the classic Bewilder House experience, making it easier to immerse yourself in the twisted horrors lurking within. Key Features:

Immersive Horror Atmosphere: Feel the pressure as you confront the unsettling twists and turns of a world that isn’t as it seems.

Challenging Puzzles: Solve mind-bending puzzles that play with both your sense of direction and your reality.

Enhanced Performance: Smoother frame rates and optimized controls for a more responsive and enjoyable experience.Note: The enhanced edition has no extra in-game content compared to the original.

title: Jianling: The Chosen Soul
description: Jianling is a Taiwanese RPG set in Chinese mythology.

title: Pomegranates
description: Set in Gaza, Palestine, travel between the past and the future to restore the community you come from. The game was created to memorialize the Palestinians lives lost since October 7th, 2024.

title: Jolly Essentials
description: A game about scratch-off lottery cards.

title: The Sisterhood Pasture
description: Inspired by the folklore of Southwestern China, The Sisterhood Pasture is a cozy pixel-art farming game that blends life simulation with management. Tend your farm, embrace rural traditions, and build bonds with a vibrant community in a tranquil pastoral world.

title: Jumpo World
description: Run, jump & hide! get as far as possible in the bizarre world of jumpo world. you only have one life, make it count.

title: 30 Second Life
description: Live your entire life, from birth to death, in 30 seconds. At every moment, your choices determine where your life will lead.

title: Sanguis Luna
description:
Wake up in the darkness of a cold, unfamiliar cellar, with the distant echo of footsteps that shouldn't be there.

Sanguis Luna throws you into a living nightmare, where every shadow hides a secret and every sound fills you with growing terror. You are alone, with no memory of how you ended up in that cursed house, but one thing is certain: someone, or something, is watching you...

title: Dragons vs. Balloons TD
description: Defend your kingdom with powerful dragons and crush waves of balloons

title: Bright Side: Quiz
description: Compete with family and friends to uncover the ultimate quiz champion!

title: Cursed Digicam
description: You receive a cursed digital camera that captures ghosts from a strange website. The website allows you to liberate your loved ones by uploading images of their spirits using the camera. You decide to go to the nearest park where your girl was last seen.

title: Clothing Supermarket Store Simulator
description: Unleash your inner fashion mogul in Clothing Supermarket Store Simulator! This immersive game combines the bustling world of supermarket management with the exciting world of fashion retail. Build your dream clothing empire, from a cozy boutique to a sprawling fashion megastore.

title: Dead Estate Classic
description: Cornered with nowhere else to turn, can you escape the monster-filled mansion?

title: Ketz: Galactic Overlords
description: Ketz: Galactic Overlords is a roguelite RPG bullet heaven with a universe blending Science and Fantasy, where you challenge the dark forces that disrupt the galactic balance on the planet Ketz. Witness the deep stories of Galactic Leaders who oppose the disruption of galactic balance and support you with various blessings. Discover the dynamic connections between them and uncover the mysterious secrets of the planet Ketz!

title: MyPawnShop
description:
Have you always dreamed of running your own pawn shop? Now it's possible with MyPawnShop!

You can buy and sell hundreds of items of many different types. Musical instruments, weapons, art objects and much more!

Become rich by negotiating with your customers when buying and selling.

Clean and repair your items to earn even more money, with different tools at your disposal (found at different vendors in the game).

Manage your store as you wish with different storage units available as well as your storage reserve to temporarily store your items to be repaired or cleaned.

title: Stranger Watch
description: In 'Stranger Watch' players step into the shoes of an elementary school student in a town plagued by recent sightings of suspicious figures. As they make their way home, it’s up to them to spot and report these lurking dangers

title: Please Knock: Before Entering My Room
Spectrum of the Puddle
description: "Spectrum of the Puddle" is an exhilarating action game where water and light bounce around. Customize the protagonist to match your playstyle and swing your umbrella to take down countless enemies.

title: Dungeon Raze
description: Here’s a fast-paced dungeon destruction shooter you can clear in as little as 30 minutes! Break walls for shortcuts, detours, or direct paths. Double ammo, halve reload time, and power up to smash through even the toughest walls!

title: Aural to Hikari no Ryuu: Gathering Light
description: Auraru and the Dragon of Light: Gathering Light is a Japanese RPG where monster girls and supernatural beings journey together through a fantasy realm. The story follows their quest as they engage in side-view turn-based battles, with each character bringing their distinct abilities to the party as the tale of light unfolds.

title: Videophobia
description: You are in a room without windows or doors. The TV dimly illuminates the room. What is this, a box? How to open it? After solving the riddle, you find the TV remote control. Click... a door appeared. You step into the darkness and hear laughter... turn around and find out what's behind the screen.

title: Writer: Chapter 1
description: You, the legendary writer, the “King of Horror,” find yourself at the center of a nightmare. A mysterious place, frighteningly familiar, hides sinister secrets. Explore locations, solve riddles, escape from the monster, collect a story that will become a new masterpiece... if you survive.

title: Fantasy Online 2
description: A rich 2D pixel art MMORPG full of adventure. Master diverse skills, join a guild, explore pixelated zones, and engage in simple fun MMORPG combat. Hundreds of items are waiting for you to collect across 4 characters! Join the fun today!

title: Doom: The Gallery Experience
description:
DOOM: The Gallery Experience was created as an art piece designed to parody the wonderfully pretentious world of gallery openings.

In this experience, you will be able to walk around and appreciate some fine art while sipping some wine and enjoying the complimentary hors d’oeuvres in the beautifully renovated and re-imagined E1M1 of id Software's DOOM (1993).

title: Legion Defense
description: Legion Defense is a TD game made with the Y3 Editor that swaps boring mercenaries for epic hero showdowns! In special rounds, you’ll face enemy heroes and feel the thrill of battle. The KOF mode allows for 3v3 matches to compete for the top spot. join the ultimate battle now!

title: Sterling Shroud
description: Sterling Shroud is a point-and-click atmospheric horror game with a focus on navigation and puzzle solving. Can you escape the forest alive?

title: Mini Gunn
description: A fan-made, fun-sized version of Samurai GUNN 2.

title: Beat Around the Bush
description: Beat Around the Bush is a series done over YouTube shorts where the top comment got the next addition to the game. Beat Around the Bush is a game where your primary goal is to Beat around the Bush. Once you do, you did it. You won. Therefore, there's no more reason to keep playing this game.

title: Astropulse: Reincarnation
description: Set on a war-torn future Earth where the planet's biological evolution was drastically altered by a meteorite strike

title: Project Deniz
description: Deniz, seeks redemption in a near-future world on the brink of collapse. Betrayed by those in power, she embarks on a journey of revenge, aiming to uncover the truth behind her betrayal.

title: Cat Syndicate: Istanbul
description: Get ready for a mix of chaos, strategy, and cuteness in the heart of Istanbul. Run your own cat business among the city's legendary street cats, grow your lira income. It may look adorable... but underneath lies a game that rewards careful planning, just like navigating the Grand Bazaar itself.

title: Sheep Seeker
description: Sheep Seeker is a fast-paced, 3D platformer where you race through dynamic levels to catch every sheep as fast as possible with a friend or solo. Unlock unique abilities to Run, Jump, Explode, and Warp to compete for the top spot on the global Sheep Seeker leaderboard!

title: Brew in Blizzard
description: Temporary seasonal job with a chance of a continuing connection

title: My Bed, Your Grave
description: Lethia holds forever against her chest.

title: Progress Knight: Multiplayer
description:
Progress Knight: Multiplayer is an exciting incremental player versus player game that builds on the success of its predecessor, Progress Knight: Mobile. Set in a rich fantasy/medieval world, players must gather gold and progress their skills to fight against their opponents.

As a novice of The Order, you start at the bottom rung of the ladder. However, through your faith and dedication, you can discover new skills and abilities that allow you to overpower your rivals and climb the ranks of The Order. You must choose whether to rely on their wits and skills alone, embrace your belligerent side, or use your dedication to deter potential attackers.

title: Ropebound
description: Swing through ropes and overcome obstacles.

title: Korolevskaya Noch
description: "Royal Night" is a Russian visual novel in the horror genre. The story takes place in a remote pioneer camp on the Volga River. The boy Anton, full of hopes to find real friends, goes there, but unwittingly learns about the terrible past of this camp...

title: Lingo 2
description: Lingo 2 blends word puzzles and impossible geometry, with brand new puzzle mechanics and a large, colorful world to discover. Welcome back!

title: Madness on Display
description: Venture into the world of chilling psychological horror, where the line between reality and nightmare is thinner than a spider's web. Grandview is not just a game, it is a test for your nerves and mind.

title: Bipolar: The Tube
description: East-Asia-theme horror visual novel with tarot elements. This game shares the same world with When the Wind Knocks (Ready to Kill) and The Dead Daughter. If you have played that game, you will meet an old friend here.

title: Labyrinth of Wild Abyss: LayeRedux
description: A horror game about paranoia and endurance predation. You cannot beat the monsters, you can only outrun. They are slow, they aren't smart, but they are patient, they are many, and they are powerful.

title: Bug Fables: Vi Simulator
description:
You can now BULLY VI in 3D!

Launch Vi into the air with a kick. Kicking with more power will send her flying further away, with four different possible locations for her to crash land.

title: Liminal Shift
description: A unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - The Contempt of Court HD
description: This is an HD remaster of The Contempt of Court, a game made by Cardiovore in the game engine PyWright, featuring 4 cases and being set a month and a half after Bridge to the Turnabout with the death of Marving Grossberg.

title: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Untold Secrets
description: Untold Secrets is a 8-case Ace Attorney fangame of my own that is set in a slightly altered universe with the events of The Contempt of Court as canon, 8 days after Turnabout Time Traveler.

title: Chalga Killer
description: Chalga Killer is a basic game with chalga idols. A cool idea, music, and performance. You'll have fun, even if you're a chalga fan! The game is made for entertainment and its sole purpose is just that! The trick in the game is to shoot as many folk guys as possible before you run out of bullets and bombs.

title: A Merchant's Promise
description: Physics-Based Medieval Trading & Transport Simulator. Start as a Worthless Merchant and work your way up as you carefully handle and transport your goods through a stylized Medieval World!

title: Sezhar's Shell Cells
description:
Just imagine that you died and some day just woke up, but not at home like you wanted to, but in an endless void of... nothing?
Sezhar isn't mad at you, she is just frustrated.
Be so nice and endure her wrath a bit longer. :)

title: Amenti
description: A photographer enters the Great Pyramids to photograph Pharaoh Rudamon’s remains, but is soon overwhelmed by a sinister curse, as the ancient tomb awakens dark forces that claw at his sanity.

title: Pokémon Chaos in Vesita
description:
Vesita, a once-idyllic island paradise, now bears the scars of a cataclysmic past. Years ago, a malevolent force plunged the region into chaos, turning Pokémon against their human companions and plunging the land into an icy grip of despair. Three legendary Pokémon, champions of balance, emerged to vanquish the chaos, but at a terrible cost.

Now, peace is fragile. Team Duplica, led by the ambitious and ruthless Master Ilan, seeks to exploit the region's vulnerabilities. Defeated in the recent presidential election by the popular Alexo, Ilan plots a desperate gamble to seize control, threatening to unleash a new era of chaos upon Vesita. As a winner of a prestigious PokéVentur training experience, you'll embark on a thrilling journey across the breathtaking landscapes of Vesita, encountering unique Pokémon, forging rivalries, and ultimately deciding the fate of this war-torn region. Can you prevent Ilan from plunging Vesita back into the abyss?

title: Fruity Rogue
description: Fruity Rogue is a fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter where everything revolves around fruits! Explore randomly generated levels, battle fruit enemies, collect items, and discover game-changing synergies. With each run, unlock characters and weapons, each with their own playstyle and abilities.

title: 3001: A MILF Odyssey
description: In this adult visual novel, you will play as Ensign [Your Name], and explore the Alpha Quadrant, under Captain Kateway's orders, with the help of her sexy crew. Protect the Federation and uphold its values by joining the newly created Mobile Interstellar Liaison Force (MILF). Do a good job and you won't stay an Ensign for long!

title: Vida
description: In a future where memories are the last connection to a lost humanity, you are an advanced AI exploring fragments of past lives. Understand emotions, traumas, and choices in a journey to uncover what it means to be alive.

title: Hello Love: 18 Again
description: Unexpectedly back at 18, you embark on a thrilling and sweet campus rebirth journey with the memories! The campus goddess, the sexy girl, the childhood sweetheart, the frigid CEO, the gentle teacher. Who will ignite your heart among the dreams and regrets of youth? Relive old dreams without regrets!

title: Pio
description: Prove your strength in the world of stars and become the brightest one of all! PIO faces trials to show his light and challenges himself to become the most radiant star.

title: Monster Crown: Sin Eater
description: Explore the beautiful and detailed environments of Crown Nation, breed endless monsters with the most robust and polished true crossbreeding system devised in a video game.

title: Snekmek
description: A thrilling twist on the classic Snake game. Dodge bullets from evil fruits, collect weapons to arm your snake, and if hit, switch to platformer mode, flying with a jetpack to defeat the fruit enemies!

title: Dino Running from a Furry: Gamesforfarm
description: Run, Dino, run! You can't fall into the clutches of Mr. Furry

title: An Outland Village
description: A father and mother visit their daughter's home in Beijing to discuss their father's understanding of life and memories of their past relationship with their mother. A short, free narrative-focused game.

title: A Gracewind Tale: Midnight Shift with Lenny Motts
description: It's a cold December night in Gracewind. You're about to close shop at the Gracewind Video, when a man named Lenny Motts appears on all the television screens. He has decided to play a little game with you, will you play or not?

title: A Gracewind Tale: The Leeds Murder
description:
The Leeds Murder is a direct sequel to "Do You Copy?" in the Gracewind Universe.

You play as a detective looking for a missing person lost in Gracewind Park. Use your investigative skills to find out the truth.

Discover more history of Gracewind as you discover the truth of Michael Leeds.

title: Sit-Back Attack
description:
Sit-Back and Relax while the game grinds for you!
It is an Idle RPG WITHOUT any MTX!

Features 60+ different classes, 500+ different skills, unlimited amount of build options to help make the team of 4 heroes you control defeat over 300 monsters!

A very in-depth interface that allows you to see every facet of battle, stats, and more to help you decide how to make your team even stronger!

All classes have unique character art and their own skills, strengths, and weaknesses.

You can choose from 1 of 4 pets to help bolster your team and you control when it uses it's special attack.

An alchemy craft that allows you to use potions on your allies and enemies manually! This craft can be improved with a characters skills and gear.

So much more!

title: Maze Mice
description: Maze Mice is a bullet heaven roguelite where time only moves when you move. Collect dots, level up, choose upgrades, and avoid cats. All at your own pace.

title: Everything Ends In 0
description: The world ends in 1 hour. It can't be saved. Wanna chat?

title: Cataclysm Wars
description: The Empire is under attack, and only its mighty armies can save it! Shame you aren't in charge of those, then. Lead an outmatched militia through overwhelming odds in this turn-based strategy game, and save your nation from collapse. Or, lead the dogged Syrinx foe and crush the Empire!

title: Yedesna Shoots 3
description: Yedesna shoots 3 is an asteroids like game where you play as, uh, Yedesna!

title: Total Loadout
description: Total Loadout is a PvP inventory management auto battler where heroes and villains from across space and time clash with powerful weapons! Choose your Celebrity with special abilities and items, then outwit opponents turn by turn by arranging your inventory tactically to build an unbeatable Loadout.

title: The Travelers
description: The travelers is a 2d mmo and text-based adventure. explore a massive wasteland full of history and danger. discover items, build bases, engage in combat, or work together to solve the world's hidden mystery.

title: Windy Creator
description: With just 1 year left to live, the terminally ill Wind I's seemingly incurable illness has endlessly vexed Heal III, the greatest doctor in the land. But one fateful day, Heal III hatches a plan to even the odds against Windi's sickness, and to cure her once and for all. 9999 Wind Is are better than 1... right? But cures for such ails don't come cheap. Raise a legion of mighty Wind I clones, expand your clinic, and send Wind I to work and on adventures to secure funding as you research and develop the cure to end all cures! Part raising sim, part board game-esque RPG, and 100% classic VIPRPG fun in Kiito's signature style.

title: DC Task Force
description: DC Task Force is a game where you explore the DC universe, visiting classic cities and planets, assembling your own Justice League team and recruiting members to protect planet Earth from an alien invasion. This campaign can be completed in just over an hour, but would require at least 7 hours to explore the entire universe and recruit all possible characters.

title: Re:Ver Project - Tokyo
description: Co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

title: Astra: Era of Anguish
description: Astra: Era of Anguish is an RPG prequel set in the GOR3 universe. Explore the valley of Laywind and unravel a grand mystery.

title: Sledding Game
description: Sledding Game is a cozy, online multiplayer game about sledding, relaxing, and hanging out with your friends.

title: Burrow Wing
description:
You wake up, feeling a bit hollow – and stumble down a hole. Now you're stuck here. Burrow Wing is an atmospheric exploration/adventure game about getting lost in a desolate subterranean expanse.

In a tightly packed hand-crafted map with two square kilometers of vertically interconnected sprawling caverns filled with branching paths to explore at your leisure, as well as over fifteen smaller areas accessible from the main map - each meticulously crafted and filled with collectables, enemies and quests.

title: TheLostWoods
description: You find yourself lost deep in a strange forest. Will you be able to find the right path and escape this mysterious forest safely?

title: Super Karate Kid
description: Super Karate Kid is a fan-made remake of the 1987 game "The Karate Kid", which was developed by Atlus and published by LJN for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

title: Puck
description:
Puck is a multiplayer hockey game that trusts the player to do the hard work. The puck has weight and momentum, so plays are never automatic. A pass that looks perfect can skid wide if you misjudge speed or angle, and a shot that seems routine can bounce off the post in a heartbeat. That unpredictability is the point. It makes every successful play feel earned and every mistake teachable.

Controls are deliberately precise rather than flashy. Small adjustments to stick angle and body position change outcomes in meaningful ways. You learn to read the ice, to nudge the puck into space, to sell a fake with your shoulders and then thread a pass through a seam. Goaltending is its own discipline. Good goalies win games by staying calm, cutting angles, and trusting timing instead of spamming saves.

title: Assassin's Creed Origins: Secrets of the First Pyramids
description: Bayek meets a scholar named Merkes, who reveals that he is on a quest to uncover a vault that once belonged to the Pharaoh Sneferu, credited with building three revolutionary pyramids. Bayek agrees to help Merkes bring closure to his findings.

title: Bad Manors
description: On Friday the 13th, your plans for a spooky Halloween night are dashed when you show up alone at the escape room reserved by your friend. You consider going home when a handsome stranger offers to accompany you. Maybe the night is saved after all… Or so you thought.

title: Pokemon RBGenesis+
description: Re-experience Kanto in an all new light! Pokémon RBGenesis aims to recreate the feeling of playing Pokémon Red and Blue on your Gameboy for the first time. Using the colorful art style of the Gen 2 GSC games; Pokémon from gens 1-8, And all new events and characters, Kanto will feel nostalgic and fresh at the same time! RBG ups the expected difficulty of the Kanto region to bring a new challenge to returning players. Search the region for new wild Pokémon encounters based on the Day/Night cycle, or for the various Mega Stones and battle items scattered across the region! Discover all new areas, such as the River Valley, Deep Forest, or Mt. Moon Summit! Become the Champion of the Kanto region in a brand new way, and explore all new mysteries!

title: Skrunkly Fighters
description: Skrunkly Fighters in a platform fighting game, similar to those of Smash Brothers, and Rivals of Aether. The game features over 60 fighters, and several stages. The game is a direct sequel to Skrunkly Royale, another game by LemonadeCatYT.

title: Under Your Spell
description: "Under Your Spell" is an immersive text-based magic school and dating simulator, drawing inspiration from beloved games like True Love 95 and Persona 4. As the protagonist, you'll juggle the challenges of school life while navigating the complexities of romance and participating in the highly anticipated "Cup of Cathal"

title: cr4nkup
description: Cr4nkup is a cycling program that combines real training and elements from the gaming world in a huge virtual world. Train online with your friends from all over the world and compete in various competitions.

title: The Conundrum Collection
description:
The Conundrum Collection is a browser-based Choose Your Own Adventure series of two short stories offering multiple endings and branching pathways based on the decisions of the reader.

Grimm - Neil Burkman is forced to confront the outcomes of past actions that led him to a seemingly fatal end. He's given a chance to alter this unfavorable outcome. But at what cost?

Hoodie Seize'N - Ella Gray lives in the slums of Proctor City. An area where kidnappings involving young women is at an all time high. After a close friend's disappearance, Ella dives into the hidden criminal underworld in an attempt to rescue her friend before it's too late.

title: Kingdom Rush Vengeance: Pirate Kings
description: It's time to hoist the sails and reclaim the seas in the name of the Dark Lord: pillage all 5 Pirate King’s islands for their hidden treasures!

title: Ultimate Firefight Series
description: New SPV3-Inspired Roguelite Co-Op Firefight mode for Halo 3, featuring a Random Enemy Squad generator, an ODST drop system, revive system, Hero campaign characters, 7 Boss Fights, H2A, Halo Wars, Reach and Halo 4 characters and vehicles, custom content from other tag releases, and much much more!

title: 2Unreal5Underground
description:
A fangame that aims to remake the gameplay and story of Need for Speed: Underground 2. It originally started in Unreal Engine 4, titled 2Unreal4Underground, but it has since moved to a custom version of UE5 to utilize its features.

TUFU is in active development and had an alpha release at the end of 2024.

title: Five Nights at Raiden's
description: Five Nights at Raiden's is a Genshin Impact themed Five Nights at Freddy's fangame.

title: Project Butterfly
description: An open-ended, super fast-paced 2D platformer set in a futuristic world of strange, insect-like people. Take the role of several members of the local gang and shower the city in graffiti art while completing missions, doing stylish tricks and gaining experience to unlock new skills that will help you along the way, as you explore the open-ended streets of Graff City.

title: The Ghost Treasure
description: Use your soul as a stake to gamble for a treasure of the undead captain. As long as you take the randomly distributed flintlock gun and fight a duel with the ghost pirates, you can leave with the treasure, or your soul will remain on the undead ship forever. Good luck.

title: Marvel Rivals: Season 1 - Eternal Night Falls
description: Darkness engulfs New York as the Timestream Entanglement leaves Doctor Strange trapped in the Entangled Astral Plane, scattering the Darkhold pages. Dracula and Doctor Doom disrupt the moon’s orbit, plunging the city into eternal night and unleashing an army of vampiric creatures. With the world on the brink, the Fantastic Four join forces with iconic Marvel heroes, standing together in the epic battle to break the mystical darkness with science. Ignite the battle against Dracula with the Fantastic Four in Marvel Rivals!

title: Cybrlich and the Death Cult of Labor
description: An adrenaline fueled FPS/boomer shooter about a buff barbarian hacker taking down an evil undead corporate overlord

title: Null State
description:
Null State is a moddable CRPG built on classic gameplay styles and themes found in cyberpunk games from the late 80s and early 90s.

Inspired by classic cyberpunk stories (& other, older tales of downtrodden folk heroes), you will be tasked with helping the people in your community until you discover that your world is barely holding together — and about to be pushed over the brink.

title: The House of the Dead 2: Remake
description: The House of the Dead 2: Remake is a remake of the second entry in the well-known and popular rail-shooter series. Take on the lone role of a secret agent as James or Gary, or team up in co-op mode to neutralize the dangerous undead monsters standing in your way.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 1.5 - Astra-nomical Moment
description:
Version 1.5 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:

• New Characters: Astra and Evelyn
• New Outfits for Ellen, Nicole and Astra
• New Events
• ...and more!

title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Bitosaurus
description:
The ultimate clash between Dinos and Robots continues and this time it visited Byteland!

Grab the "Bitosaurus" DLC which unlocks a special skin that will automatically appear in your wardrobe so you can unleash your inner Dino and rawr your way in both Single Player and Co-Op mode!

title: Boti: Byteland Overclocked - Bit Racing
description:
Buckle up everyone, we got some hovercraft races to do! The Bit Racing DLC adds a hovercraft garage and a collection of intricate race tracks to test your skills on.

Take on the clock to get the best time and reap the rewards for finishing in bronze, silver or gold. Collect and equip a slew of unique skins for your hovercraft to add some extra flair.

title: OnAir Airline Manager
description: Create and manage your very own airline in a persistent online world. Start small with a single aircraft, grow your fleet, and explore endless opportunities to build a thriving aviation empire.

title: Hell Maiden
description: Traverse the depths of Hell and beat its toughest demons on your way to Heaven in this horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy.

title: Deficit
description: You are a corporate espionage freelancer. Your latest assignment: steal the reality-shifting Interpolator from the sprawling research labs of Project Sidereal. Use the device to escape the grueling defensive layers of Hadrian's Wall and cross the threshold into the strangest frontiers of reality.

title: Demon Dust
description: Demon Dust is a Survival Horror Dungeon Crawler with a unique, mouse driven interface. Scavenge the depths of concrete and metal while rationing supplies to stay alive.

title: Terry's Other Games
description: Hi, I'm Terry Cavanagh! You might remember me from such videogames as Dicey Dungeons, Super Hexagon, and VVVVVV. Here are a few other things I've made over the years!

title: Zombies and Orcs
description: You have discovered ways to quickly move using teleportation and when visiting new lands you will have to protect your portals so that aggressors do not penetrate them.

title: Maniac Path 3
description: Go into the abyss of madness to go through the difficult path of a broken beast that spares no one

title: Freedom Maker
description: Seek freedom and build an infinite deck. In a cyberpunk future, use strategy and skill to overthrow AI's domination. Freedom Maker is a unique RPG blending puzzles and action.

title: Difficult times
description: Monsters are attacking!

title: Dangerous Line
description: You are a hero who faces waves of enemies who are trying to get into your kingdom and seize power in it.

title: The Mythical City 4
description: Hordes of monsters are moving towards your cities to stop them, build walls, place magic books that will attack the enemy, hire soldiers!

title: Knight's Night!
description: Knight's Night! is a retro-style 1-bit platformer. Collect items, unlock new abilities, and make your way into the evil wizard's castle to save the kingdom!

title: Yamizome Liberator
description: Yamizome Liberator is a modern visual novel with real-time deckbuilding combat. Plan and unleash skills in tactical 1v1 battles against magical girls, manage daytime events, and liberate heroines in a race against time. A bold mix of tactical gameplay, dark humor, and captivating storytelling!

title: Undead Realm: Ego
description: Time stands still, space warps, whispers in the dark and indescribable things are approaching you step by step. You will embark on a survival journey with several strangers in a desolate and mysterious place, and immerse yourself in a horrible battle royale full of despair from the first perspective

title: JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator
description: JoshGeoff Weiner Simulator is a quirky and humorous simulation game that lets players step into the shoes of JoshGeoff's unique worker, a character navigating through bizarre cities and locations. Set in the UK, the game blends elements of exploration and interaction with an emphasis on comedic storytelling and quirky dialogue. Players are tasked with completing unusual challenges, all while collecting things for your boss.

title: A Dual Ascent
description:
"Once upon a time, there was a mountain; a mountain so tall, it touched the sky. It was the Great Mountain of Wonders.

An Old Pilgrim, who came from a land far away, was on his way to the summit.

But a fallen Little Star had the exact same idea, for she thought she might return home, if she reached the top of the Mountain..."

title: Burger Race
description: Get ready to race at top speed in Burger Race! Which machine will be the first to cross the finish line?

title: Timelake: Time Travel Tactics
description: Timelake: Time Travel Tactics is a roguelite strategy game where you control time itself to outsmart enemies and navigate a shifting city. Predict enemy moves, set traps, and execute synchronized combos. Manage precious resources as you explore a dreamlike world filled with mystery, cosmic horror, and ever-changing challenges. Every decision ripples through time, offering endless strategic possibilities.

title: Red Blue Cell
description: This is a retro barrage flying shooting game. Drive a space fighter plane, shuttle between planets and space stations, and use powerful firepower to destroy enemy space battleships!

title: TransGenDeer
description: TransGenDeer is an educational game about the everyday struggle trans people have to go through.

title: Chaos Ascension
description: Survive relentless waves of monsters in this fast paced rogue lite action game. Choose your hero, defeat epic bosses, and unlock powerful upgrades in a dark, procedurally generated world.

title: Since November
description:
What are you doing with your time on Earth? Are you happy? Stay inside. We have pizza.

"Since November" is a short furry visual novel with about 12k words and four endings. It is written to be conclusive, so there will be no additional chapters. It is a game that was developed for the NovemBear 2024 Furry Visual Novel Jam.

title: Base Blitz
description: Two teams battle it out in a high-stakes capture-the-flag competition. Set on resource-filled battlegrounds, each team must protect their base while devising strategies to infiltrate the enemy's. Your flag is perched on the roof of your base just out of enemy reach, but so is theirs. The only way in? Tear down their walls by gathering resources, crafting items such as pickaxes, bombs and cannons, and launch a full-scale blitz!

title: Dataclysm
description: A tech-themed artillery game where players take turns launching computer components at opponents across destructible terrain. Aim carefully, manage your jetpack fuel, and master physics-based projectiles to be the last techie standing in this modern tribute to classics like Worms.

title: Themis
description: THEMIS is a 3rd person puzzle platformer filled with mind-boggling challenges and non-linear narrative. Inspired by games like Portal and Dark Souls, players will be tasked with overcoming death traps and obstacles employing both wits as well as quick reflexes.

title: A Magical Friday Night: Vs. Holy Quintet
description: A Magical Friday Night Vs Holy Quintet is a mod directed by Kixel & Ryoku 05. The mod is based on the main team of the Puella Magi Madoka Magica series. The mod serves as a massive love letter to the franchise as a whole with GameJolt achievement support, A Leaderboards system, multiple timelines, & Girlfriend's vast adventure as a Magical Girl.

title: Persona 5: Funkin' in Starlight
description:
The Phantom Thieves have gotten another anonymous request on the Phan-Site, this time, a worried father asking that his daughter's boyfriend's heart be taken, due to his twisted desires. Doesn't seem like much trouble, so Joker takes on this request solo! Little did he expect, someone familiar to us was waiting for him...

Waiting on the shadows, the other wildcards await for a challenge in the velvet room.. The VS. Joker Full Week is here!

title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Threads of Destiny
description:
• French Campaign
Switch sides and swear allegiance to the French king, continuing your military career under a new banner - that of kingdom of France. Go on a new ambitious campaign against Paris' numerous rivals in order to, one by one, bring them all to submission, earning wealth and glory in the process. But don't let the glitter of gold blind you as, in the royal service, the cloaks and daggers of maligners and ill-wishers might prove to be way more dangerous than even the sharpest swords and spears of the best enemy knights.

• Bounty Hunting
Accept the offer of Grace & Glory and abandon the military career in favour of bounty hunting. Accompany your new colleagues on their travels around medieval Europe and complete various contracts, some of which might take you to rather unexpected places. They say that bounty hunters die young — find out if you got what it takes to become an exception from this rule.

• From a peasant to a king
Betrayal is the worst possible sin. However is it really that bad if the crown of the whole kingdom is at stake? Stop being a pawn in somebody else's game and make your own dash for the throne. Seizing the crown will be a challenging task, holding onto it will be even harder. But, if you've got a true monarch's ambition, the battle is worth the blood. True greatness is now within your reach — it's time to become the king or die trying!

title: The Zombie Fortress
description: A zombie game where killing means surviving.

title: Skystead Christmas
description: In this festive-themed hidden object game, every click costs a snowball, and every snowball requires some snow! Collect snowflakes as they are falling and try and find all 24 Skylets to win!

title: The Apartment 57
description: The Apartment 57 is a psychological horror game set in an abandoned hotel. Players explore dark hallways and uncover dark secrets. The game features immersive storytelling, classic horror elements, and a growing horror atmosphere, inspired by games like Fears to Fathom.

title: Desierto
description: This is a game about getting lost.

title: Havoc Monkeys
description: Havoc Monkeys is a VR game which has a unique movement system, the game has multiple gamemodes and maps to ensure a long lasting play time. There's frequent updates so stay tuned!

title: Tap Derby
description: Tap Derby allows you to step into the shoes of a rookie horse trainer. Under the guidance of legendary trainer, Rusty Hayes, buy, train, and race as you grow your stable. Conquering prestigious racing events and rising to Horse Racing Stardom.

title: Pokemon Empire
description:
What is right and wrong? Who gets to decide? And why does everyone follow so blindly? Welcome to the Telius region, only months removed from a bloody civil war sparked by the actions of the tyrannical King, Tobias II. A once benevolent man who ushered in an era of prosperity and industry, he eventually plunged the region into division and violence. In the end, he was overthrown by his own people. Amidst the ensuing chaos and turmoil, a new council of representatives has taken power, supported by the revolutionaries that overthrew the king's regime. This 'grand council' is now in charge of overseeing the reconstruction of the region and establishing a new Pokemon league. But even under this supposed new stability, old fissures remain. Many Telius citizens detest the new government and how it operates and remain loyal to the longstanding traditions of supporting the nobility. This nobility and their soldiers, now on the outside looking in, has adopted the moniker 'Team Royale'. Operating from the shadows, they are a group intent on restoring the region to its former glory days under a new king. So with the region war-torn and divided, how will Telius move into the future? Enter YOU the player: the child of a noble family, you were sent away before the war began. Now that the war has ended, you, along with your best friend Alanah, return to Telius to fulfill a promise to conquer the Pokemon league and to bring the entire region of Telius into harmony once more. Can you solve the mysteries of the war, work your way through the shadows of the past, and become champion of the Telius League? Will you support the grand council, fight for the Royale loyalists, or take matters into your own hands? How will you define your legacy in Pokemon Empire?

RPG Maker Pokemon fangame with Pokemon up through Generation 9 with several rebalances to both individual Pokemon and the general systems.

title: Forklift Certified
description: Welcome to Forklift Certified, a unique single-player 3D top-down puzzle experience where you can kick back, unwind, and enjoy clever challenges at your own pace. Take control of a forklift to navigate intricate puzzles, activate mechanisms, and conquer challenges in handcrafted levels

title: Kozue's Strange Journey 2
description:
One year after taking down the supernatural threat behind a series of disappearances, Sayuri Shirasagi joins back up with her friends to fight the Shadows and unravel the mystery distorting the world once more!

Explore labyrinths filled with treasure and danger alike. Climb, lockpick, jump, navigate hidden passages, and negotiate with monsters for new items. Fight strategic turn-based battles to seize victory! Outside the labyrinth, nurture social stats like Courage and Kindness to develop relationships with people around town. It's not just a chance to make new friends: your relationships can open up lucrative new jobs and boost your abilities in combat!

In 2015, aliens visited the United States.

In 2115, they came back.

title: Noir: Dead On Arrival
description: Noir/Horror themed story rich interactive adventure indie game with party-based RPG elements. As you investigate various mysterious cases, you will learn more about the secrets of this dystopian world and maybe discover why most of mankind has turned into zombies. Each of your choices really matters. In NOIR: Dead On Arrival, inspired by the 1950s classic film D.O.A., the story centers on the murder of Frank Bigelow, a government employee caught in a deadly web of intrigue.

title: Cruft
description: Cruft is a 2D, pixel-art crafting game. It has a minimalist aesthetic and boasts tons of crafting recipes. While moment-to-moment play is open-ended, it features a prestige system that grants bonuses on future playthroughs.

title: Gas Station Manager
description: An ultimate 1-4 player Co-op Simulation game where you build and manage your gas station completely from scratch. Team up with your friends, provide exceptional service and grow your business! Collaboration (and some chaos!) is the key to success—fuel up, have your fun and rise to the top!

title: Crestfall
description: Turn based strategy game of capture the flag. All pieces are hidden at the start

title: Dekiai Heart Candy Kun.
description: This is the otome game that you can experience living together with a slightly twisted boyfriend.

title: That New Diner
description: You're struggling for friends in a new town and decide to check out a cute diner! - A short murder sim visual novel.

title: Taking Over Her Heart
description:
I have a crush on my best friend, Amelie.

I have a crush and I am so scared to ruin what we have.

...So scared that I'll probably never tell her that I love her.

Not unless someone helps me.

...Will you help me?

title: Customized Girlfriend
description: A stroke of luck presents you with a chance to receive a prototype mechanical maiden for testing, propelling you into a romantic adventure. As crises loom, will you protect the idol of a girl group or the mechanical maiden? Who will become your guiding light?

title: Black Mesa: Military
description: Experience the consequences of the resonance cascade scenario once again, and play as one of Hazardous Environments Combat Unit marines, Steven Mills. You are not a survivor, you are sent on a mission. Secure Black Mesa Research Facility with the rest of your squad and eliminate any hostile forces. This mod is not a recreation of any existing mods. It's the mod developers own creation and all maps and plot are being developed by them. You will experience Black Mesa disaster from a perspective of the villains and even see Gordon Freeman in person.

title: World Pole Stone Dusk: Diadem of the Pole
description:
The World Pole shattered, and from its destruction rose a rusted fog that settled fast throughout the world.

Traverse the desolate Stone Dusk to retrieve the sacred artifact destined for your grasp.

title: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
description: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.

title: Memory Girl +
description: A tragic love story of Memory and her search for the missing "him." Fully conscious but trapped in the data of a game someone abandoned, Memory searches for "him."

title: Null Path
description: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers and metroidvanias! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

title: League of Legends: 2025 Season One - Welcome to Noxus
description: Welcome to Noxus is the first thematic season of 2025 in League of Legends.

title: Red Planet: Survive
description:
Red Planet: Survive is a first person survival game for Microsoft Windows.

Surviving in the harsh conditions of the Red Planet will be hard, but if you are strong enough, you will succeed.

title: Koko kara Natsu no Innocence!
description:
Not so long ago, as the urban areas progressed in their development towards being an information society, there were many places in the mountainous area which kept the same olden feeling. Yoshitsugu was a visitor from 100 years in the future who came to the mountain village Akio-mura. He had been labelled as a failure in the ultra-competitive society in the future, so it was unknown how he was able to travel to the past, an opportunity open only to those with high social positions.

Yoshitsugu, a "naturally born child" in age of artificial birth, wandered about in the mountains in the dark in confusion. He followed a firefly, which led him to a young girl in a small lake. The girl Iroha took him into her home for the night. Afterwards, he was granted special permission to stay in the village and enjoy life in the village for a little while. He got to know Iroha better, along with the actual visitors from the future, sisters Arika and Yuno, as well as the village chief’s daughter, Kotobuki. It was much different than the time he lived in: he felt soothed by the slow and carefree days.

Was it luck that brought him to the past? He thought that even he would be able to accomplish something here, like maybe fall in love with a girl. Their summer love story begins here.

title: Yoru no Rojiura Annai
description:
On a winter day near christmas, guide a young girl lost through the back alleys and protect her from thugs and witches.
A visual novel with multiple endings.

title: Condor 3
description: Condor Soaring Simulator simulates the complete gliding experience on your computer. With it you can learn to fly gliders and progress up to a high level of competition skill. The core of the simulator is the state of the art physics model and advanced weather model aimed at soaring flight.

title: Forgotten Spirit
description: Forgotten spirit is a first-person hardcore action game set in a fantasy world. Become a disturbed ghost and get ready to fight your enemies, parkour and explore.

title: AliveZ
description: Fifteen years ago, a mysterious shrine suddenly appeared. It emitted an evil air and people were transformed one after another.... Yin, a group of evil people, and Yang, a group of people who has an opposite nature to Yin. The story takes place in the midst of slaughter happened in the town....

title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey: The Fate of Atlantis - Episode 2: Torment of Hades
description:
The Fate of Atlantis – Episode 2: Torment of Hades is the second of three downloadable content packs in The Fate of Atlantis DLC for Assassin's Creed: Odyssey.
This episode focuses on the visit to Tartaros to face Hades and reveal more of the mystery surrounding the sunken city of Atlantis.

title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey: The Fate of Atlantis - Episode 1: Fields of Elysium
description:
The Fate of Atlantis – Episode 1: Fields of Elysium is the first of three downloadable content packs in The Fate of Atlantis DLC for Assassin's Creed: Odyssey.
This episode focuses on the visit to Elysium to face Persephone and reveal some of the mystery surrounding the sunken city of Atlantis.

title: Dragon Ball: Xenoverse 2 - Future Saga: Chapter 2
description: The second chapter in the FUTURE SAGA series depicts an unprecedented alteration of history! Includes new Playable Characters, new Extra Missions, Parallel Quests, Additional Moves, and Costumes!

title: Stories to Tell: Greyville Stay
description:
"Stories to Tell" is a series of psychological horror games developed by a 15-year-old boy in which each installment is based on a dream or nightmare that I, the developer, have had. This is a game you won't want to miss...

Stories to Tell is a walking simulator, with dialogues between the character and npc`s. The game is in first person and it includes things such as being able to play games in your in-game pc and more...

title: Super Star Wars Holiday Special
description:
Super Star Wars Holiday Special is a SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis homebrew game that works like an unofficial game from the cult-classic Super Star Wars series that was released originally for the Super Nintendo, but now, loosely based on the outrageous The Star Wars Holiday Special from 1978.

Super Star Wars Holiday Special was developed for the SEGA Mega Drive / Genesis with the Scorpion Engine by earok.

title: Egress Protocol
description:
“Ah, you’ve stumbled in, have you? Welcome, welcome… to my escape room.

Don’t look so nervous. You like puzzles, don’t you? Locks, codes, switches... oh, the lot. You’ll have your chance to fiddle with them while I sit back and watch. It's all part of the fun.

But I must admit, I’m most curious about you. How long can you keep up that little mask of yours? How long before you stop pretending to be frightened, and simply enjoy yourself? I know what you are. And soon enough, so will you.

Oh, don’t pout… it’s nothing personal, is it? You were invited. And now, you’re part of the protocol.

So, shall we begin?”

This game was created in just three days as part of a personal challenge. The theme, gameplay and scenario was chosen with a random game ideas generator. It’s a short experimental project, so expect a focused experience rather than a full-length game.

All credits for assets, 3D models, and music are listed in the About menu.

title: Pual Blarp Ghoul Cop
description:
Have you ever felt trapped?
Have you ever gelt emotions?

You are PUAL and you work at the MUALL
Due to golin related reasons, you are now a GHOUAL.

Over 100 LEVELS and games on your journey into madness.

title: Mystic Rest Stop
description: Welcome to your new summer job. Arthur Brooks, a 22 year old, starts a night job at Moon Gas Station. As he settles in, he experiences strange events that unsettle him. The urban legends about the gas station seem to come to life. Dealing with customers at night is deeply unsettling.

title: Imaginytes
description: Tower defense meets roguelite deckbuilder! Collect, summon and evolve your Imaginyte creatures, and use them to create intricate mazes to defeat the nightmares.

title: Once Upon a Dungeon: Infinity
description: Travel through dark dungeons, defeat dangerous creatures, and collect unique loot as you play endlessly in this hardcore, traditional roguelike.

title: Haze Man: The Local Hero
description:
Every day Shoutarou does many part-time jobs just to get by. Even though he is quite skilled at hand-to-hand fighting, he doesn’t make much use of it and lives a simple life, while watched over by his childhood friend Renka. One day, he met an intelligent life form from another planet, Fara, who hailed from a planet called Perel. He risked his life to save her from a thug’s attack and his life then changed completely.

By joining with Fara, he gets an immense increase in his physical ability and also special powers. She transforms into his armor and protects his body from harm. While normally these powers would not be needed in daily life, this resulted in the sudden appearance of Jil, who planned to take Fara back to Perel with him. He must fight Jil’s henchman every day and their heated battles caused a big disturbance in the shopping street. However, it was promoted as a hero show by his company boss Tooko to attract visitors.

What will happen to Shoutarou and Fara? Will they be able to fight off Jil? How will the town revitalization event turn out?

title: Galaxy Princess Zorana
description: You are the Evil Emperor's only daughter, but can you claim the throne? Raise stats, make deals, appoint advisors, and scheme your way through the Imperial Election - unless an assassin gets you first. Rule the galaxy or die trying!

title: Cats vs Cthulhu
description: Cats vs Cthulhu is a casual survivor-like where you play as a cat the Destroyer of the Great Old Ones. Arm yourself with yarns, fruits and other delicacies. Dress up in the most stylish outfit possible. Find a way to become the ultimate weapon.

title: DuckWorld Smart Adventures
description:
DuckWorld Smart Adventures is an online Dutch educational adventure game and is a digital spinoff of the Donald Duck comics world full of exciting, funny and enlightening games with Donald Duck and other familiar Duckburg characters.

With over twenty 3D mini-games, Donald Duck Weekly ensures that your child, as a true citizen of Duckburg, can play in a safe, responsible and rich game environment.

title: DuckWorld Revive
description:
DuckWorld Revive is an online world full of exciting, funny and enlightening games with Donald Duck and other familiar Duckburg characters.

With over twenty 3D mini-games, Donald Duck Weekly ensures that your child, as a true citizen of Duckburg, can play in a safe, responsible and rich game environment.

title: D.C. Re:tune
description: Remake of the first Da Capo game featuring a new heroine and a new voice cast

title: Apocalypse Express
description: Conduct, upgrade and repair your train through endless waves of enemies in a post-apocalyptic setting. In this action management roguelike, the player decides to embark on a journey through the wasteland looking to fulfill the dream of seeing the remains of the outside world.

title: Minutescape
description: Dodge bullets and upgrade yourself in Minutescape, a retro-inspired incremental game that keeps unfolding. Unlock new abilities and keep upgrading yourself to survive for 5 consecutive minutes.

title: Beautiful Sakura: Fashion Club
description: A continuation of Kaito's journey.

title: Beautiful Sakura: Running Club
description:
A continuation of Kaito's journey, where he embarks on a new hobby. This visual novel delves into themes of love, friendship, and self-discovery.

Players once again step into Kaito's shoes, guiding him through the ups and downs of his new life, where every run brings him closer to understanding himself and those around him.

title: Mr.Slime in Dungeon
description: A 2D side-scrolling adventure. Run, jump, and slide as you explore dungeons, collect coins, and unlock the portal chest to advance to the next stage. Help Mr. Slime achieves his goal of becoming the richest slime in the dungeon.

title: Stellar Docks
description: Stellar puzzles, logic without limits!

title: Sokorobot
description: In this puzzle game, a robot need to clear paths to unlock new levels!

title: Unaccessible
description: Unaccessible is a third-person wheelchair platformer about struggling to get a health insurance claim approved on a mysterious island without accessibility ramps. Tackle stairs, climb obstacles and hop your way through the pain of the claims approval process.

title: Super Galaxy Ranger Luna
description:
Its time to return to the late 90's! A time where low polygons and big pixels ruled.

Super Galaxy Guardian Luna is a third-person-shooter/adventure game, taking place across several worlds. You play as Luna a new Guardian recruit just out of the Academy. You travel across the galaxy in her personal ship liberating worlds from the massive Xhomic Empire. Meeting new species and friends along the way.

title: Discopup
description: In DISCOPUP, you're a seal eager to party, making your way to the most famous nightclub in the city: DiscoPup. However, tonight, the bouncer is only letting dogs in. How will you make it past him?

title: Slender: Reborn
description: Rediscover terror in this reimagined classic survival horror. Collect eight pages and evade the relentless Slenderman in a hauntingly realistic world rebuilt with updated graphics, adaptive AI, and immersive sound design. Prepare for unpredictable scares and a chilling atmosphere that redefines fear

title: MechAnimals
description: Gear up for mayhem: From the creative minds behind Kung Fu Panda and The Mario Movie, MechAnimals combines Roguelite progression and Beat 'Em Up action featuring cute tiny animal MECH PILOTS!

title: Palpus X: Annihilation
description: An isometric brutal horde shooter with light RPG elements. Kill tons of aliens, find over a dozen weapons, skill up your character & unveil the secrets of an abandoned research lab!

title: Itacante: La Cité des robots
description: In this adventure and puzzle game made for children, players need to save the citizens of Itacante and fight against the tyrant Vulcor. Helped by their companions, they must construct and use robots to solve various puzzle boards, while being introduced to multiple scientific concepts.

title: Kota's New Journey
description: An elven sorceress decides to visit her old friend, but gets caught up in a series of exciting (and slightly lewd) adventures, where she finds new friends, rare spells... and loses her swimsuit.

title: ColdWire
description: ColdWire is a limit-removing mapset that aims to combine modern visuals with classically inspired gameplay. Boasting a bespoke custom palette and a tailor-made texture set, the maps in ColdWire aim to create a strong and inviting atmosphere while keeping the player on their toes with IWAD-esque but nonetheless thrilling combat. The player is going to traverse through roughly an episode's worth of techbases and urban environments in search for answers to a traffic accident of historical magnitude.

title: Precept
description: Precept is a first-person psychedelic action horror game with a heavy focus on exploration. Players take control of a night guard whose purpose is to finish his daily task. The player must find way to escape and survive from mysterious company's environment and entities.

title: Mint's Hints 3
description: Hunt down rogue androids, save trapped spirits, and uncover shocking truths about your past. Mysteries unfold as you fight to free your friends and survive a twisted world. Can you trust yourself? The show’s not over yet...

title: Paranormal Night Shift
description: Paranormal Night Shift is an observation and spot the anomaly game set in a haunted house in the 1980s.

title: Trapped: Family Vacation
description: Spot the differences, but each room has a survival rule.

title: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic
description: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

title: Zak McKracken: A Mansion, a Meteor and the Alien Mindbenders
Palace of a Thousand Curses
description:
Palace of a Thousand Curses is a 2.5D narrative swashbuckling adventure set in an Andalusian fairy tale.

You play as a desperate beggar that has been trapped in an old storybook, where you will duel strange creatures, avoid deadly traps, and confront that most unexpected of enemies: the Spanish Inquisition.

title: Tanks 3D
description:
