description: This is a tower defense building game. The game controls the movement of the protagonist through the arrow keys on the keyboard or the left mouse button, and interacts with characters and objects in the scene through the space bar.

title: Bad Dream
description: You're stuck in school. What has trapped you is a non-human creature. Run away from him (her?). Find the key and escape from the school to survive. Use w,a,s,d, ESC, left shift, mouse

title: In a Barrel
description: In a Barrel is a hellish game about desperately trying to survive as a fish in an unfair world that only wants you dead. As you play and die, you will be able to upgrade your fish for a better chance of survival. If you're fast and lucky enough, you may just reach freedom.

title: Catch the Dustling
description: Due to an experiment gone wrong, dust creatures from a parallel world have appeared in the laboratory. They pose a threat because of their bad temper and their habit of ignoring certain laws of physics

title: SpaceFire Fury
description: Take control of a powerful spaceship, face relentless waves of cosmic enemies, and battle colossal bosses in this intense, action shoot-'em-up. Use unique powerups, and save the galaxy in SpaceFire Fury.

title: Bugboy
description: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

title: Palingenesis
description: PALINGENESIS is an interactive music video. Each level is sound tracked with a different song from the album PALINGENESIS, by GRIGS.

title: Time Re:Quest
description: A survival game with a classic style of the graphic adventures of the 80s. Current graphics, updated to the new generations and with a simple way to play. Two game modes. Discover your way and one great game. Procedural game, it is generated as you progress. Every game is different. Survive!

title: Black Light Wave
description: This is a casual and relaxing game based on the classic fable of a turtle and rabbit race

title: Gear of Time
description: It is an Isometric Dungeon Crawler with a few RPG elements in which the character must escape from a great tower after stealing the hourglass.

title: Last Victim: House of Fear
description: This is an indie horror game in which you have to face your fear and escape from house by solving puzzles and escaping from a ghost. Find out the story of a serial killer...

title: TaekwonGirl
description: A cute and sexy Taekwondo girl defeats enemies with Taekwondo power. Defeat enemies with only a mouse.

title: Fuse The Bomb
description: A reverse arcade where you have to make bombs and prevent the special forces from defusing it. Make life difficult for the special forces by making them play mini-games.

title: Cake Platformer
description: Be a Ninja character in this 3rd person platformer. Avoid traps, enemies, solve puzzles and finish maps

title: Skibidi
description: SKIBIDI is a clicker game where you click on toilets! Click more on the toilet and get even more toilets!

title: Normal Days
description: Sometimes you encounter anomalies. Find them or none and react correctly to go back to normal days.

title: Spell Boy
description: Wizard/Mage RPG - combat centric - dungeon crawler where you have to master your spells to conquer the dungeons. It comes with handpicked spells and enemies to make enjoyable gameplay. Master the spells and conquer the dungeons!! Its a game of timing, coordination and strategy!!

title: Safety Corp. VR
description: "Safety Corp." is a VR action game with realistic weapon mechanics, physics, and puzzle elements.

title: Single-handedly Challenge Ultimate World
description: It is a idle cultivation game set in a mythical ultimate world by Chinese mythology, historical biographies, folk tales, and artistic creations.

title: Box Dog
description: Do you love difficult hidden object games? Then this is definitely the game for you! Box Dog is a classic hidden object game at heart. Each level is hand drawn so they are full of surprising details to discover while you are looking for that last object.

title: Latest Issue
description: LATEST ISSUE is a psychological horror in which the protagonist has to descend into underground tunnels to disprove or confirm sinister rumors about the place.

title: Samurai Elemental
description: Samurai Elemental is an action-adventure game in which the player must explore the map to defeat giant insects, collect the elemental soul from them to restore the forest, complete levels, defeat bosses, and save the forest.

title: Furry Farm
description: Furry Farm is a farming simulator RPG!Start your adventure in Tail Town and bring Furry Farm back to its paws! Roll up your sleeves, grab your tools, and get ready for hard work. Can you give this abandoned farm a new breath of life?

title: Keziah's Realm
description: Forage, craft, fight, form clans, and expand your settlements in a dynamic, ever-changing ecosystem. Keziah’s Realm offers a unique gaming experience where you must survive in a rich, procedurally generated world, alongside intelligent NPCs who possess abilities equal to those of the player.

title: Rod Roll
description: Keep rolling! Gift drops every hour!

title: American FKN Election
description: American FKN Election is a clicker game in which you click on your favorite politician and get handsomely rewarded! Between 2 and 12 hours, you get a dollar bill of multiple rarities. The dollar bill drops will change once every 7 days. Join our community and collect them all!

title: KingdomScape
description: KingdomScape is turn based roguelike card game with medieval fantasy settings. Each turn you advance your kingdom by strategically picking a card representing various aspects of your realm.

title: Spider Caro
description: "Spider Caro" is a 2D platform strategy game. In this captivating world, you become a mysterious experimental spider abandoned in a laboratory. Using your exceptional silk-spinning and web-weaving abilities, you must skillfully avoid various traps and obstacles, successfully escape the lab, and embark on a thrilling journey to explore a human world filled with danger and adventure. Endless challenges await your wisdom and courage; use your agility and strategic mind to unravel puzzles and write the legendary story of Spider Caro.

title: Railink
description: Railink takes you on a colorful puzzle/strategy adventure across deserts, icescapes and everything in between. Your job is to link up the remote Railink inhabitants to the rail network, one house at a time. Along the way you will face steep cliffs, vast waterways and tall mountains.

title: Order 13
description: Pack orders and ship them out. But the warehouse holds more than just inventory.

title: Night Hazard
description: A Dark Fantasy Action Hack N' Slash RPG Discover powerful weapons and tear demons and monsters apart in a stylish frenzy as you explore a mythical dystopian world.

title: Torchless
description: Torchless is a dark and gothic dungeon crawler RPG played through a text-based retro console. Forge your party and take up arms against the horrors lurking within the dungeon halls in strategic, turn-based combat, clinging on to survival using everything at your disposal.

title: Bonnie Fell
description: Behind this cute potion-making game lies a choice-driven RPG. Will you solve problems or swindle customers with devious tricks?

title: Over the Hill
description: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

title: The Unexpected (But Not Entirely Surprising) Demise of Jacques du Schnozzle
description: Jacques Du Schnozzle is the worst person in the world. Thankfully though, he’s just been murdered. Do you have what it takes to catch his killer, or will the forces of evil stop you in your tracks?

title: Boo! Are you scared?
description: "Boo! Are you scared?" – game with realistic physics of collisions and destruction, where every step can be the last. Gloomy levels full of dangerous obstacles and bottomless abysses await you.

title: Hero World 2
description: Join Tom and Lisa in Hero World 2, a thrilling new adventure! Unlike the story-driven first installment, this sequel focuses on helping the duo collect fruits while introducing numerous upgrades and fresh features.

title: Ninja Gaiden 4
description: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with Ninja Gaiden 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

title: Star Crafter
description:
A space survival crafting mining base building and star system building game.
Craft rockets to create planets and Dyson Rings, mine and craft advanced materials, terraform the terrain, manage electricity, farm food, and more as you watch the star system evolve into stunning, everchanging views.

title: Ninja Gaiden II Black
description: Using Unreal Engine 5 to significantly enhance graphic expression, this is the definitive version of "NINJA GAIDEN 2," featuring additional playable characters and enhanced battle support functions.

title: Thyranya
description:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

title: South of Midnight: Weaver's Edition
description: Weaver's Edition: Immerse yourself in the macabre and fantastical world of South of Midnight.

title: Benign Land
description: A short, dreamlike experience where you drift through haunting scenes set in Ireland, from pagan times to recent historical events, revolving around the Troubles of Northern Ireland.

title: Endless Legend 2
description: With a mysterious, ever-changing world, unique factions, and epic storytelling, the much-awaited sequel to the strategy game classic ENDLESS Legend is here, opening a new chapter of the award-winning ENDLESS universe. Write your legend and unveil the secrets of a dreamlike ocean-planet on the verge of extinction.

title: The Black Vault
description: You play as a software engineer who just came back from his job and got a message from his friend that a hacking group called "The Black Vault" is recruiting new members. Throughout the night you'll be given different tasks you'll have to complete in order to get into the group. As the night continues, you gather the attention of some shady people that will try to stop you from getting into The Black Vault. You must crack into servers and devices in order to obtain valuable information while avoiding getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

title: Golden Sails
description:
Golden Sails is a naval crew life-sim with ship battles and trading.
Customize your crew (or use a randomized one) and manage their different traits, needs, and desires so they can have high morale for when it's time for battle.

title: Drone Sector
description: Drone Sector is a futuristic gunship game. Provide close air support by firing variety of weapons at the enemies and guide your allied troops via commands. Keep your troops alive, complete objectives, collect resources and recruit engineers. Research better weaponry for the gunship and the troops.

title: Friday Night Funkin': vs. Zardy
description:
You find yourself lost in a cornfield maze, and what do you find. It's Zardy! Though he's not here to scare you in the traditional way you would think.

Can you fight him off? Or will he reign victorious?

This mod is based on Zardy's Maze a game by SwankyBox.

title: The Slowpoke Shack
description:
Archer and his partner Growls the Growlithe have recently moved to Silverspring Town and opened The Slowpoke Shack.

Running a successful restaurant was never going to be easy, but Archer never expected so many difficult challenges to come his way...

title: Friday Night Funkin': The X Event
description:
The X Event mod is a mod bringing your favorite characters from the Undertale AUs Underverse and XTale into the Friday Night Funkin' universe!

The full week contains everything from previews weeks (Overwrite with X Chara and Inking Mistake with Ink!Sans), and now includes a custom RPG overworld, better charting tools, and a new character: X Gaster, with his theme Relight.

title: Woods of War
description: Woods of War is tower defense meets deck builder. Build your tree's defenses from cards you are dealt. As you defeat the orcs, earn new cards, customize your deck and unlock new levels of power. It is your elvish duty to fend off the deadly horde for in this forest, sap runs thicker than blood.

title: Varyznex
description: A horizontal scrolling 2D shmup

title: Xontainer Meta Space
description: Xontainer Meta Space is a logistics simulation game with advanced AI NPCs you can interact with via voice or text. Manage trucks, customize vehicles, complete warehouse missions, operate forklifts, generate energy, and use an in-game smartphone for tasks, calls, and money transfers.

title: Hullbreaker
description: A fusion of arena PvP combat on the high seas and roguelite mechanics. Outfit your ship with powerful weapons, clash with rival captains on the high seas, and create your own flag to hoist over the shipwrecks!

title: Emergency Exit
description: Communicate. Cooperate. Escape. aEmergency Exit is an online cooperative escape/puzzle game with asymmetric gameplay. Separated and unable to see each other’s actions, players must cooperate to reach the exit before time runs out, solving puzzles and uncovering hidden secrets.

title: T1wre3: Noname
description: Hi, I am Noname! Can you solve my puzzle? Dive into a world of riddles and uncover the hidden six-digit keys to advance. With challenging puzzles, hints to guide you, and secrets to discover, this game tests your logic and wit. Solve every enigma and claim for the victory.

title: Snarewaves' Shooting Challenge
description: A short, free high-score chasing 2D shooter set to a punk rock soundtrack.

title: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Valentine
description: Lovely Anime Puzzle: Valentine is a fun and rewarding puzzle game. Assemble charming St.Valentine Day-themed pictures, sharpen your attention, and immerse yourself in a festive holiday world.

title: More Panda: Slot Creator
description: More Panda Slot Creator, Bigger, Better, Brighter, and easier to create and play. Ever wanted to create a slot game but did know how to program. Here is the next best thing. More Panda Slot Creator is a great app to create a slot game for the gaming community now includes save game option.

title: Do or Die: Frontal Warfare
description: Do or Die Frontal Warfare is a FPS game with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted around the world. It brings a grounded, wide variety combat experience to the players.

title: Dating Sim
description: You play as a guy who is conflicted between fantasy and reality, and tries to get a girlfriend. There are three girls and three endings. Who will you end up with?

title: Billgard
description: Smash your friends in Billgard, a chaotic physics-based party brawler for couch and online multiplayer with up to 8 players. Kick your opponents off the table across different game modes!

title: Dating Sim! Re:Mastered
description:
After a particularly rough night, the protagonist of Dating Sim crawls into bed to forget his loneliness as yet another day of him being single passes by. When he awakens, the protagonist discovers that it’s actually May 30, 2020, twelve years after his nap!

What’s more, the protagonist finds that he’s still in college and still hasn’t found a girlfriend. While usually a successful student, the protagonist is now struggling to maintain his grades and his luck with the ladies hasn’t improved one bit.

Polishing up his grades may be hard but with your help, finding a girlfriend may not be! Can the protagonist win over his dream girl with this new chance he’s been given?

title: Dating Sim! Luna's Lovely Summer
description:
Despite getting friend-zoned by Luna in Dating Sim! Re:Mastered, the protagonist decides that he should be “just friends” with her at first. It’s still a win for him, as Luna is among the top students in college and is willing to tutor him for his summer classes. His grades are already terrible and they could really use a boost from her. Not only that, but since Luna’s such a sex freak he feels that she could eventually become his girlfriend. The protagonist thinks it’s all gonna work out – he’ll graduate, AND he’ll finally have a girlfriend!

…Not so fast, though!

The protagonist finds himself having to put up with Luna’s unpredictable antics. She tends to postpone study sessions with him because if she’s not completely drunk, then she’s busy with her cybersex sessions! It’s summer, and Luna just wants to have fun before the next semester starts. Even though he’s tempted to join in with her craziness and lose his virginity to her, the protagonist’s studies come first. He begins to doubt if Luna really is at the top of her class…

With your help, can the protagonist improve his grades over the summer…and finally earn himself a girlfriend?

title: Seafarer's Gambit
description: Play as a captain who ventures into new lands with his crewmates until a storm passing by mysteriously parts him away from his ship and crew. Help the captain find his missing crew and overcome the challenges on the path by fighting unwanted guests using his trusty old sword.

title: Galactic Striker
description: Galactic Striker is an action-packed top-down space shooter where you battle enemy fleets, upgrade your spaceship, and save the galaxy. Experience thrilling combat, epic boss fights, and retro-style graphics in this exciting space adventure.

title: Yes Comrade
description: Yes Comrade is a 1 - 4 player cooperative survival sandbox where you and your fellow Comrades are re-assigned to a remote sea outpost. Guard the great Belegovskain coastline, process the ships, keep the Supreme Leader happy, and try not to think too hard about what happens on the island…

title: Pogo Epoch: Impossible 99%
description: It’s a game where you bounce on a Pogo Stick and try to climb a massive tower full of tricky obstacles. Take on the impossible challenge—one unlucky slip, and you’re back at the bottom. Pure focus solo or chaotic fun with friends

title: Danger Horizon
description: Danger Horizon is a multiplayer, first-person shooter game made using Unreal Engine 5. The game features realistic gunplay, and advanced blood and gore features that everyone can enjoy.

title: Angry Video Game Nerd 8-bit
description: The Angry Video Game Nerd is back in 8-bits! Battle through frantic platforming levels, defeat classic AVGN bosses, and save all of gaming from a corrupted monstrosity.

title: Screaming in the Basement
description: The main character is mike, an experienced journalist who always strives to uncover the truth, According to locals, restless souls inhabit this place, but this needs to be confirmed., the game takes place in 1991.

title: I Wanna Lap Around
description: A gloomy and minimal take on the needle style pioneered by Fly the Far Away, but with a higher focus on precision and density.

title: Ultimate Ragdoll Game
description: Ultimate Ragdoll Game is a sandbox game without any limitations. The game has no specific way to play or end, your goal is to have a good time!

title: Rance VI Sonogo
description: Collection of short stories related to Rance VI. Included in Alice no Yakata 7.

title: Jumpng Disable
description:
"Casual 3D JUMPNG game"

A game that feels familiar yet refreshingly new—and occasionally downright crazy. No further explanation needed.
Let's JUMPNG!

title: Fragile Sun
description: Autumn is coming

title: Mandragora Seeker in the Creep Zone
description: A timid gravedigger’s strange adventure to claim the Mandragora Gold Prize! Grow Mandragoras affected by weather, moon phases, and time, while fending off ghosts and fireballs to win the ultimate prize!

title: Southside Racing
description: Race and battle using weapons and karts themed after Vtubers and content creators! All characters in game can be found livestreaming on Twitch. Race through different Vtuber themed levels like TomaKey's Liminal Spaces or Meat's Silly Safari and slow each other down with weapons!

title: A Few Days With: Bianca
description: Embark on a sensual butterfly-hunting adventure with Bianca, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Bianca's enticing layers.

title: The 8ight
description: Max, who suffers from schizophrenia due to childhood trauma, decides to break free from the endless torment of hallucinations and delusions.

title: Parkour Assassin: Sprint Run
description: A 3D parkour game in a cyberpunk style, where you can experience breathtaking speeds, dodge various traps, and continuously break through to achieve the furthest distance. Terrifying bombs and robotic enemies will stand in your way, but you can use the quick blade in your hand to slash through them!

title: Rome: Nightmares of Empire
description: Rome: Nightmares of Empire is an Action game with RPG elements, charming pixel graphics and interesting mechanics. Defeat your opponents, acquire and create equipment, improve your skills to face the great threat, rise up, hero and save Rome !

title: Hack and Slash Fury
description: Heavy Metal! Deep Combo System! Lot of Cinematics! Discover Legendary Warriors Forged in War! Destroy the dark empire! and save the world of his tiranity!!! Dark or Light?! Only one will Survive!!! Prepare your sword! And Anihilate all your enemies!

title: Little Robot
description: Join me on my first game as an Indie Dev with this casual 15-minute exploration game where players navigate the backyard, as our favorite sad robot, collecting essential components to successfully return indoors!

title: Paranormal Mutagens: Cargo
description: Paranormal Mutagens: Cargo is a first-person eldritch horror game. Manage a spacecraft and its passengers while battling eerie anomalies and struggling to survive the chaos unfolding aboard. Can you endure the horrors and complete your mission?

title: Muffles' Life Sentence
description: Take back your identity in Muffles’ Life Sentence- a darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are remade to match their crimes.

title: Perdition's Gate Resurgence
description: Perditions Gate Resurgence is a vanilla compatible megawad that serves as an unofficial community sequel to Perdition's Gate. The story takes place immediately after Perdition's Gate map 30, where the player had just set off the bomb meant to destroy the Earth in the bomb facility of Hell.

title: Don't Get Got
description: DON’T GET GOT is a multiplayer co-op horror game of deception. You’re locked inside and something is out to get you. Find the key. Use the environment and collaborate with other players until they no longer serve your needs. Make it to the safe room. Survival not guaranteed.

title: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
description: At nightfall, the sieged city falls. Yaoguai came to massacre. You are nothing but a scholar on the brink of madness, trying to survive alongside a courtesan you met years ago. Experience two intertwined storylines in this sequel to the visual novel "The Hungry Lamb".

title: The Rogue of Nexus
description: Inspired by the frenetic pace of Half-Minute Hero and the addictive replayability of The Binding of Isaac, The Rogue of Nexus throws you into procedurally generated dungeons filled with loot, traps and hordes of bizarre creatures.

title: Dream Cage
description: Robert battles early Alzheimer's and nightly sleep paralysis. Each night reveals fragments of his past. Uncover the truth and help him solve the mysteries haunting his mind.

title: The Case of the Twisted Children
description:
Four children went missing in 1930. The case was never solved.

Now, in 2022, new clues have emerged and you might be the one to solve the case of the Twisted Children.

Take on the role of the Detective, the great-grandchild of the detective who failed the case in 1930, and finally uncover the truth.

title: Tired to Fall
description: Tired to Fall is a puzzle-platformer where you collect, launch, and transform buddy-leaves into platforms to help a little leaf climb back to its tree. Jump, glide and solve puzzles in an undergrowth packed with spiky chestnuts, acorns, and cannon-mushrooms!

title: City of None
description: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

title: Kanji de Go! Shueisha Manga-sai
description: The popular kanji quiz game "Kanji de GO!" teams up with Shueisha manga in a dream collaboration! Challenge yourself with furigana quizzes featuring tricky kanji from a wide range of Shueisha's classic and modern hit manga!

title: Royal Wars: Farm TD
description: Royal Wars: Farm TD is a free-to-play tower defense game where strategy meets luck. Place randomly selected towers, merge them to unlock higher tiers, and defend your kingdom through multiple levels. Plant crystals, manage resources, and prepare for epic battles.

title: House of Ghosts and Cats
description: Protect your cat, defeat the monsters, and build a happy home for your cat. Battles, crafting, exploration and conversations lead to the truth of the mansion and the whereabouts of your cat. A dark and heartwarming mansion-robbing horror adventure begins.

title: Near-Death-Expedition
description: After quitting the job, you were casually browsing a video site when you saw a strange video with a blank thumbnail. "Can you hear me? Can you see me...?" The next day, you receive a message requesting you to be the manager of the mysterious VTuber "Owarino Rinne". The endless journey begins.

title: Shinya Ichi-ji no Koukanshu
description: Have you heard the rumor? If you call a certain number at 1am, you will be connected to a person called the 1am operator. This person is said to be able to connect you to the past.

title: Rolling Star
description: Bursting with hilarious dialogue and comical encounters! The second installment of the super-exhilarating Metroidvania series is here!!

title: A Directionless Cycle
description: A Directionless Cycle is a 2D Sokoban game where you explore a game that's slowly degrading, while you control multiple tiles with different directions at the same time.

title: BrebeMan
description: Save the world with breakbeats.

title: Twisted Jam
description: Twisted Jam is a fast-paced, arcade-style Frisbee like game set in a digital world. Contestants will battle it out for the top spot by scoring points within the goals.

title: Guild Receptionist 2: Stardust Liberate
description: Become the receptionist of the guild and protect your precious daily life! This is a simulation game of a receptionist. Whether you run around to protect your village, follow the king, or expose the darkness that pervades the country, the future depends on your choice!

title: Connect Collect
description: Situational card battle and adventure to find the best combo from a randomly dealt hand. Deck editing is not required....... To use your cards well, you need to bond with your friends. Only time will tell.......

title: Slug's Sister Defense
description: A spin-off from the asymmetric party action game "Goonya Monster," with character designs by Terada Tera! Experience exhilarating roguelike tower-defense action! Defend the captive Snail from enemies approaching from all directions by acquiring and upgrading a variety of weapons and gear!

title: Bananitro
description: Bananitro is a 2D game where you control Monkey on his bicycle, using Bananitro to perform maneuvers and conquer obstacle-filled tracks, with creativity as the key to success.

title: Merchant 64
description: Merchant 64 a tiny retro inspired traveling merchant game! Take control of Merchant as you buy goods at low prices and sell them in different towns at higher prices.

title: Donna: The Canine Quest
description: Embark on a paw-some journey in Donna: The Canine Quest! Dive into a world of heroic hounds, where each thrilling battle and loot discovery keeps the excitement at its peak. With cute pixel-art graphics and satisfying gameplay this tail-wagging adventure will have you barking for more!

title: Freja And The Sequel
description:
A complete stranger threatens to blow up the biscuit placebos offices, if they don't make a sequel to the classic cult game "Crystal Raven Quest". Freja, a nerdy and insecure girl with big black hair and a degree in computer science, is pulled into the mess and is given the task to develop the sequel.

The more absorbed she gets in her work, the more questions arise. Who's actually developing the game, and who is a character in the game? Who is the stranger who threatens to blow up the office? Where is the art director hiding the gold can opener? Is the sequel really supposed to be "on ice"? Why are the goblins in the labyrinth of death keeping their garbage in the dungeon? And perhaps most importantly: who is really Crystal Raven?

Freja and the sequel is a funny, scary (and surreal) story-driven point and click-adventure for iOS (iPad and iPhone), Windows, Linux, Mac and Android.

title: Plumbum
description: Plumbum is a retro top-down shooter roguelike where you'll have to survive the innumerable hordes of mooks and goons in the cursed corridors of this cursed game. Will you survive as long as you can, or will you die trying?

title: Labyrinth of Touhou Rebirth
description:
This is a mod of Labyrinth of Touhou by Ethan Silver.

The characters are expanded with new characters; PC-98 characters and future mainline Touhou characters from Touhou 12 onward, new skills, dialogue, and etc. Along with re-done dungeons and reduced encounter rate.

title: Mario Land Fun
description:
It's a remake of Super Mario Land!

Made using the same engine Perennial uses. It runs a lot better than the gameboy version, and has some neat features, 4-player couch co-op, parallax backgrounds, joystick support, wide screen support and high refresh rate support.

The graphics have been improved slightly. The goal was to recreate the game how you remember it, not how it was or how it would have been on a more modern system.

There is also an option to make it look like the original gameboy graphics, complete with greenish tinge and pixel grid.

title: Room Washer
description: A thrilling game full of satisfaction as you become a sponge character and clean up rooms! Clear stages by scrubbing away dirt with a cute character while dodging enemies. Once you play, you’ll be hooked on the fun!

title: Boulder Crash
description: Collect diamonds and avoid monsters! You need to collect all the diamonds to exit the level. Rocks and diamonds can fall and kill you.

title: Idun: Frontline Survival
description: A defense RTS where you can move turrets at will. Extract resources, upgrade technology, and defend against enemy swarms in a gripping space campaign. Hold the line, set up your turrets, and brace for screen-filling hordes!

title: Bookbound
description: Bookbound is the power of imagination. Every level — a new world, new rules. From space to ancient ruins. From black hole to wild jungle.

title: Minecraft: Hello Kitty and Friends
description: Step into Hello Kitty's World in this sweet DLC! Build a cozy farm, grow crops, and raise Animals with Hello Kitty and Friends. Upgrade your House with Cute new Furniture and enjoy Fun Seasonal events like egg hunts and pumpkin carving!

title: Clowned King
description: In a world made of glass, an exiled Prince becomes a clown to conceal his bloody past behind a mask of laughter. In this tactical JRPG inspired by Brazilian culture, play as the Clown Prince Matheus, as he tries to save his kingdom from his father, the mad King Marduk.

title: Mashina
description: A little robot digs to repair her world. Dig, build, discover and mend in a chill, stop-motion world.

title: Mega Man X8 Demake: Axl Mod
description: A mod for AlyssonDaPaz's Mega Man X8 Demake that adds Axl as a playable character.

title: Doctor Pain
description:
A guy named Ben went to the dentist one day, but the examination procedure suddenly turned into a nightmare.

Will Ben be able to leave the hospital alive, or is it going to be his last doctor's appointment ever?

title: Fear The Reaper
description: Fear The Reaper is a PVP multiplayer horror game in which players take on unique roles and live out the experience of starring in a slasher film.

title: C-Beams
description: Pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system in this Space Action RPG. Engage in advanced ship combat, haul rare elements, and upgrade your vessel to survive. Stunning visuals, a deep narrative, and a rewarding progression system await as you uncover the abyss's dark secrets.

title: Hope Town
description: Hope Town is a highly challenging Rogue-like turn-based RPG. Recruit, train, and lead a team of heroes to explore procedurally generated maps, uncover stories through dynamic events, and battle formidable enemies. Collect resources to upgrade your stronghold, craft powerful gear.

title: Pirates Never Die
description: Pirates Never Die is a third-person horror zombie game set in a chilling, atmospheric world where players must uncover the mysteries of a cursed island. Play as Deacon, a young pirate in search for his brother after rumors of his disappearance. Faced with a new reality the fight for survival begins.

title: Doom: The Dark Ages - Premium Edition
description:
DOOM: The Dark Ages Premium Edition INCLUDES:
- Base Game
- Campaign DLC **
- Digital Artbook and Soundtrack
- Divinity Skin Pack

**DLC availability to be provided at a later date.

title: Turbotz Testing 20XX
description:
Turbotz Testing 20XX is a tower defense game infused with clicker gameplay and rogue-lite elements. Join the Turbotz Institute in researching the explosive potential of turret robots by testing them under diverse conditions and parameters.

Collect research, unlock new elements to experiment with, and push the limits of existing turbotz through dynamic transformations. Discover the countless varieties of antroids and the creative ways to obliterate them!

Change the world—one explosion at a time.

Twitch Integration: Connect with Twitch to enable full audience participation in a 'Twitch Plays'-style experience with advanced customization options. Decide how viewers can interact—whether through structured voting or pure chaos.

Viewers can join the side of the Turbotz or the Antroids, with their chosen allegiance displayed alongside their username. Their contributions are tracked on a leaderboard, highlighting kills and damage dealt.

title: Crisis Command
description: Blast your way through over 6 stages of mayhem to rescue civilians and push those robots out. Use their own powers against them and help reclaim peace to the island.

title: Academy of Magic: Ring of Darkness
Downhill
description: Experience unlimited power in DOWNHILL, a unique 4th wall breaking action RPG. Take control of a human girl named Fade and become her best friend or her worst enemy as you guide her down the mountain. Her fate is yours to decide, as well as the entire realm's.

title: Wilbur Soot's Incelbur
description: Wilbur Soot's Incelbur is a Friday Night Funkin' mod based on Minecraft YouTuber Wilbur Soot.

title: Pantocrator 3D
description:
Slash robots with a katana
...in this absolutely mindless first-person slasher.

title: Escape from Duckov
description: A single-player top-down looter-shooter game. Loot, escape, build, and eventually become a mighty bird soldier. Beware! If you are knocked down, items in your inventory will be lost! But don't worry. With your infrastructure built nicely, you will rise again soon.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Claws of Awaji
description:
The first expansion for Assassin's Creed Shadows.
Add over 10 hours of additional content with a new location, quests, enemies and gears.

title: Chipped
description:
Premise
In the very near future, humanity has finally discovered a way to sync the human brain with robots using a brain implant. Play as a volunteer in the test program.

title: Train Sim World 5: Antelope Valley Line - Los Angeles - Lancaster Route Add-On
description: Experience the hefty power of modern American diesel! Tackle the tough terrain of Californian canyons with the Antelope Valley Line, between the sprawling Los Angeles cityscape and desert bushes of Lancaster in almighty Metrolink traction.

title: Train Sim World 5: East Coast Main Line - Peterborough - Doncaster Route
description: Feel the high-speed thrill of British inter-city travel in Train Sim World 4! Express services await on the iconic East Coast Main Line, hurry between Peterborough and Doncaster, and through the English countryside, in the sleek and flashy LNER Azuma.

title: Backrooms Level X
description: Enter the disturbing world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person narrative survival horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and liminal spaces. 13 levels and giant enemies await you in this unique experience.

title: Abyss of Twisted Fates
description: It is a game based on the theme of Sword Art Online. The story revolves around Kirito finding Cardinal's message in a large library, revealing that the secret chamber in the Western End Mountains requires three keys to unlock. Kirito and Eydis embark on a journey to unravel the mystery of the seal.

title: An Ordinary Sonic Fangame
description: Evade Sonic.EXE in warped versions of the original Sonic the Hedgehog (1991) zones. Inspired by "Ordinary Sonic ROM Hack" (2013) by Cinossu.

title: Train Sim World 5: Linke Rheinstrecke - Mainz - Koblenz Route Add-On
description: Wind the clock back to the 1990s and experience the flagship of the Deutsche Bundesbahn; be enveloped by stunning Rheinland countryside, from the shimmering river to castle-topped hills, and serve historical towns in style with Train Sim World 3: Linke Rheinstrecke: Mainz - Koblenz!

title: Train Sim World 5: LNER Class A3 60103 Flying Scotsman Steam Loco Add-On
description: Drive the most famous steam locomotive in the world! Flying Scotsman, 100 years of speed, endurance and elegance summed up in 97 tons of legendary steam traction. In its centenary year and beyond, bring the power and glory of this iconic loco into your own home with Train Sim World!

title: Train Sim World 5: Nahverkehr Dresden - Riesa Route Add-On
description: Experience complex operations out of the iconic Dresden Hbf, with passengers converging to make a hustle and bustle mix of S-Bahn, regional, inter-city, and freight traffic. Be in control of modern traction and explore the countryside of Train Sim World: Nahverkehr Dresden - Riesa.

title: Train Sim World 5: Northeast Corridor: Boston - Providence Route Add-On
description: Experience the fastest rail line in America, from modern suburbia to sprawling countryside, linking the state capitals of Massachusetts and Rhode Island, in command of both Amtrak Regional and MBTA Commuter operations with Train Sim World: Northeast Corridor: Boston - Providence.

title: Train Sim World 5: Railpool BR 193 Vectron Loco Add-On
description: Venture on all-new heavy freight services aboard the most iconic and modern locomotive to grace European rails in the 21st Century – the famous and popular Siemens Vectron rolls into Train Sim World, sporting the azure accents of Railpool for drop-in cargo leasing duty!

title: Train Sim World 5: S-Bahn Vorarlberg: Lindau - Bludenz Route Add-On
description: Take the train to Austria! Spanning cross-border, the busy Vorarlberg S-Bahn line shuttles from quaint German island life to the foothills of the Austrian Alps. All-new and bustling ÖBB traffic awaits in Train Sim World.

title: Train Sim World 5: Sherman Hill: Cheyenne - Laramie Route Add-On
description: Experience all the grandeur of big-time, modern American freight railroading – bustling and constant action, tough grades, powerful diesels, majestic western scenery, and extraordinary history – come together on Union Pacific’s legendary Sherman Hill for Train Sim World .

title: Train Sim World 5: Southeastern Highspeed: London St Pancras - Ashford Intl & Faversham Route Add-On
description: Experience the unique and exciting blend of classic main line running and thrilling high-speed commuting, aboard state-of-the-art motive power, in London and the Garden of England with Train Sim World: Southeastern Highspeed – now including Ashford International and Dartford!

title: A Robot's Tiny Adventure
description: A Robot's Tiny Adventure is a calming, short and peaceful game where you take on the role of a tiny robot created to help others. Explore a small open world at your own pace, interact with NPCs and help them solve their problems, while enjoying a relaxing experience focused on exploration.

title: Viande Crue
description: VIANDE CRUE (Raw meat) is a narrative-driven game. You visit a 3D handcrafted world, discovering bits of stories about a dog and his family.

title: E-Commerce Simulator 2025
description: Build your own digital retail empire and serve customers from around the globe! E-commerce Simulator 2025 offers you a comprehensive virtual trading experience where you can showcase and sell various products.

title: Bahamut: Remake
description: In this land where magic and crisis intersect, a blue-haired boy fearlessly joins the ranks of adventurers with the ambition of defeating the legendary Dragon God Bahamut. Facing countless trials and challenges of fate, he will uncover the hidden truth and embark on his own destiny journey.

title: Love, Money, Rock'n'Roll: Summer '94
description:
7 years have passed. Nikolai's life has changed: he has left much behind and now simply goes with the flow, avoiding stress and upheaval. However, fate has its own plans for our hero! New and old acquaintances will rush into his life like a gust of summer wind, bringing with them long-forgotten emotions and love!

An all-new story taking place across over more than two in-game weeks.

The opportunity to learn what fate befell the characters after the end of the game.

New characters, environments, music tracks, and illustrations.

A chance to see Nikolai from a different perspective and help him find new love.

title: Campus Fantasy
description: Start with one billion! You will transform into the male protagonist of Shuangwen and go to school. Sports cars and airplanes are just your means of transportation. Villa beauties are also your standard equipment. With the ability to make money, you are the Veyron for school!

title: Only Out
description: “Only Out” is a cooperative survival game for two players. Set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, you and your partner must navigate a desolate village plagued by scarcity and danger. Trust each other, strategize together, face the relentless zombie threat, and uncover the only path to survival.

title: Emissary Zero
description: Co-op horror (1-4 players). You are sent to explore a mysterious building at night. Find the Moon and try to return alive.

title: Choose Cthulhu Files: The Call of Cthulhu
description: Choose Cthulhu Files is a visual novel / adventure videogame adaption of the internationally acclaimed gamebook series Choose Cthulhu, based on the original works from H.P. Lovecraft and the Cthulhu Mythos, where you experience the story as the protagonist deciding how the story ends depending on your choices during the adventure.

title: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Nextgen Edition
description: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - Nextgen Edition is a total conversion mod for Grand Theft Auto IV. It includes every mission and side content from the 2002 original game. Bringing the city, pedestrians, cars and even radio stations to the Rockstar Advanced Game Engine (RAGE).

title: Fright House
description: Probably not your cup of tea! Includes 6 games.

title: Goddess Of Swing
description: A Highscore Chaser game, made from german group of students.

title: The Auto Sort Is Broken
description: Set in a universe parodying poorly managed MMORPGs, even the inventory sort feature has stopped working. It's now up to you to organize the players' messy bags and handle their occasional complaints.

title: Walk Zero1
description: The distant future... There are almost no people left on planet Earth, everyone has moved to Mars. The age of prosperity, the age of robots, androids, technology. And then one day, robot Zero1 decided to take a walk around planet Earth. What awaits him? Desert? Vast forests? Who will he meet on his way? All this is to be found out in the walking simulator.

title: Took: The Immortal Hero
description: A hardcore 2D action platformer developed by one person. Play as a memoryless rabbit TOOK to explore the vast Moon Cave world and defeat dozens of powerful enemies, collect the treasures scattered in this world and regain the glory of the Moon Up Group!

title: The Demon Lord’s Daughter and the Tower of Seals
description: In the wake of the Demon Lord’s defeat, his daughter, Lilina, finds herself leading a miserable existence without any of the comforts of the castle she once called home. Now she has to make an honest living while seeking out six fabled talismans in an attempt to regain her lost powers!

title: Method of Entry
description:
"Method of Entry" is an upcoming 5v5 tactical shooter aimed at revitalizing the genre with a focus on competitive play, enhanced by authentic mechanics. The game's development is guided by our 'C.F.R.F' principle: 'Competitive First, Realism Follows,' which prioritizes competitive elements in gameplay decisions and design.

MoE is designed to be accessible and engaging, avoiding the complex hero abilities or arcade-style power-ups that have infiltrated the genre, and instead emphasizing realistic Special Forces or Counter-Terrorist scenarios that enforce, or dare we say, demand genuine skill. Drawing inspiration from foundational titles like the SWAT and the Rainbow 6 series, as well as classics like Counter-Strike and contemporary games like Escape from Tarkov and Rainbow Six Siege, "Method of Entry" taps into a deep well of tactical shooter heritage.

This project is a response to the competitive community's desire for a streamlined, 5v5 tactical shooter where competitive elements take precedence. Realism is then seamlessly integrated, with attention to weapon dynamics, player movement, environmental design, hit detection, and overall intensity. However, this integration never overshadows MoE’s core competitive mechanics, ensuring a balanced and stable competitive experience.

title: Cubic Odyssey
description: Embark on a galactic journey in Cubic Odyssey, an open-world adventure where you explore vibrant planets, craft tools, build vehicles, and fight the Red Darkness. Uncover ancient mysteries, and shape a universe full of life, danger, and limitless possibilities!

title: Nautikin Adventures
description: You are the Nautikins, the dominant species on this ocean planet! Build boats, planes, and helicopters to explore a vast sea filled with islands and mysteries. Play in a sandbox with unlimited parts or a campaign where you strive to reach your goals. Embark with online multiplayer or singleplayer.

title: MeiaUm: Escaping the Pix
description: In MeiaUm: Escaping the Pix, you dive into a digital world where precious bits are scattered across every level. Your mission? Collect them—but there's a big risk: the Pix. One touch from this ruthless system can be fatal, and the threat is always lurking. As you progress, the challenges grow tougher, and you'll need agility and sharp thinking to dodge the danger and grab all the bits before the Pix catches you. Every move could be your last chance.

title: In Death We Love
description: Death rides forth. Cities crumble, forests fall. At the edge of shadows, tears spill, and the barren lands bloom to color. Loss. Love. Birth. We start again? A short 10-15 minute bw cinematic sidescrolling adventure.

title: Laser Tag Massacre
description: Halloween night turns deadly when five friends decide to throw a party in an abandoned arcade deep in rural Campinas, Brazil. What was meant to be just a game turns into their worst nightmare, proving that sometimes, play time can be deadly.

title: In Ashes
description: An unexpected quest has reached your sleepy town. Once again, you must raise your weapon and step into the boots of a weary, burnt out adventurer. When faced with a choice, what kind of hero will you be? In Ashes is a choice-driven fantasy visual novel about adventurers, monsters, and the forgotten.

title: Solomania
description: Solomania is a romance drama about flawed heroes and their collateral damage. With your new reluctant partner, prove that you're not as messed up as everyone thinks. Your mission? Investigate a strange civilian report in the woods, smoothly and without issue. Playing nice is optional.

title: Jump on the Ball
description:
Try and balance on the ball for more than FIVE seconds! Can you beat all three WHACKY levels?!

Jump on the Ball is the first video game launch from indie studios Literally Nothing and Twitzor Games. What started as an idea for a meme game quickly turned into reality as it became a mission to release a first game, no matter how simple or mundane.

title: StompyBoy
description: Pilot a big stompy mech, and shoot other big stompy mechs with your various lasers. That's about it.

title: CitaDrill
description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

title: Lost Traces: Unsolved Cases - Genesis
description: Experience the beginning of the "Lost Traces" series through the eyes of Evelyn Strom in an immersive first-person view. Explore and collect clues to assist you in the search for Evelyn’s brother and help you unravel the mystery of what is really going on.

title: Global Transport
description: Global Transport is a fun and engaging game that will test your problem-solving and time-management skill

title: Subway Exorcist Girl
description: A subway train plagued by strange occurrences. A part-time exorcist girl arrives to confront the supernatural chaos, with the unknown ahead.

title: Suspense: Madman's Dreams
description: This psychological adventure, focused on narrative, is based on a scientific representation of mental disorders. Are you ready to face the fears of people suffering from mental illnesses? Use your voice as the voice of the main character to get as close to them as possible.

title: Living With It
description:
Welcome
Instructions for this training will be delivered via memo.

title: The Flayed Man
description: The Flayed Man is a short narrative-driven point and click horror game. Awaking without memories (or skin), you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this macabre adventure.

title: Salvagers
description: In Salvagers, you command a small crew of greedy explorers that land on abandoned space stations that litter the galaxy, and it's your job to loot them for anything worth a credit. Scrap tech, lost weapons, forgotten treasures—everything has a price.

title: Skye Revival
description: A cyberpunk 2D Beat Em Up Platformer by Komic Studios. Control Vega, a Skye City Defender and restore your city from corruption.

title: Sproing
description:
Sproing is a foddian-inspired speedrun rage bouncing physics platformer.

Take control of an evolving alien creature as you escape an experimental bio lab, bouncing your way up through an alien planet, mutating with new abilities, to reach your space ship and launch off planet.

Developed by Funk Games, currently in Alpha state, released on itch: https://funkgames.itch.io/sproing

title: Blades, Bows & Magic
description: Blades, Bows & Magic is a casual medieval fantasy multiplayer / singleplayer strategy card battler. Based on the mechanic of Rock, Paper, Scissors - but with Warriors, Archers, Mages - fighting with special abilities.

title: Toasty Tires
description:
You're playing with your toys in your bedroom when your parent comes in and asks you to clean up. Can you pick up your room and escape before it's too late? Or take your car for a spin in endless mode, where the carpet is never-ending. Just enjoy the ride.

Zip around the carpet and hardwood floor across Five unique levels as things get weirder and weirder. Explore and maybe by the end you'll uncover what's wrong with your parent before it's too late. Add avocado (and a little extra challenge) to your Toasty Tires experience with Avocado Edition!

title: Yet Another Killing Game
description: Inspired by popular mystery adventure game series such as Ace Attorney, Danganronpa, and Zero Escape, YAKG's gameplay offers a mix of immersive dialogue branches, point-and-click room investigations, and some mystery solving--if you can keep everyone from killing each other!

title: The Little Moon
description: Storytelling, Side-scroller, Universe, Travel, Fishing, Action, Adventure.

title: Infected Ones
description: Infected Ones is a zombie apocalypse game by William Jacob. Get through the zombie-infested areas while you gather resources, save any survivors left and fuel up your escape vehicle before the military nukes the city.

title: Panic+19
description: Panic+19 is a hospital simulator game by William Jacob. As a doctor, welcome all critically ill patients as they arrive and attend to their needs to ensure their survival.

title: Parkour Civilization
description: Progress from a noob to a god by mastering parkour courses, crafting parkour gadgets, and solving parkour puzzles.

title: Masked Devourer
description: You play as a young blogger who loves filming her careless travels in forgotten and forbidden places. She doesn't believe in mysticism and all sorts of superstitions, but one day, wandering into a strange Japanese city, she completely changes her mind...

title: Artifact Seeker
description: Artifact Seeker is a 3D Roguelike Survivor RPG game.You can obtain artifacts by slaying enemies. Use the power of artifacts, to play the game of gods or to end the game ? Your choice.

title: Casual Sport Series: Tennis
description: Ready your racket, find your rhythm, and dominate the court!

title: Cho Aniki Collection
description: The Cho Aniki Collection on Nintendo Switch marks the first time the beloved cult-classic shoot 'em up games Cho Aniki (1992) and Ai Cho Aniki (1995) have been officially translated and released in English. This collection compiles the iconic muscle-themed and surreal shooters originally by Masaya for PC Engine.

title: The SS Destiny Disaster
description: Humanity's ambition for the stars turns into a brutal fight for survival. The crew of The SS Destiny discovers a bacteria that turns their mission into a nightmare. Find resources, battle infected, and escape the doomed ship as it spirals into chaos.

title: Back in Service: A Metro Driver
description: Join the adventure and become the master of the Prague metro in our game, which takes you into the underground world of the capital city. Explore stations and overcome challenges on the tracks from the cabin of a historic train. Can you complete the route, transport all passengers, and avoid delays?

title: Chat is Real
description: A short horror game of a few minutes, with elements of combat and fear. You play as a streamer known as "Gargamelovo let's play šílenství" He always felt like an outsider, whether at school or at work. So he started talking to chat.

title: Dice Eater
description: Dice Eater is a mystery card game based around supernatural powers where players must use their power to uncover the other player's tricks. Use your opponent's tricks against them to turn the tables and win.

title: Lored
description: An idle game about collecting cancer with quirky stickfigures!

title: Squaser 3
description: Squaser 3 is a minimalist puzzle game where you control a white square and erase the darkness on each level. Clear your path using logic and memory!

title: Evaluate
description: This game provides players with a simple yet highly attractive stress relieving experience.

title: Fractious
description: This game plunges players into a challenging dungeon world where they play as a brave skeleton,

title: Tragedy at Ashville Lane
description: Dive into a psychological horror experience and try to uncover the mystery at Ashville Lane. Step into the shadows of your fears and face them to figure out what happened that day. Survival is your only option and remaining hidden is a must.

title: Idle Research 2
description: Idle Research 2 is an addictive, heavily-layered, incremental game themed around energy and resource management. It brings strategy, QOL, and feature synergism to the next level. The game takes place in 2070 on planet Mu Ra Tempel after the devasting Earth-27 Mutually Assured Destruction incident.

title: Dagga
description:
Dagga is a 2D MMORPG. Live a great adventure in a magical and enchanting world.​ Discover its secrets and hidden treasures. Become the greatest of adventurers!
Play as one of the many character classes. Each of them has unique spells and specialities, which evolve according to the way you play.

title: Musume
description:
The word "娘 (musume)" primarily means the following:

One's Daughter

A parent uses "musume" to refer to their female child.

Musume is a short dating game.

Get to know the daughter through her father, Itaru.

You can also flirt with her dad

Enjoy the game!

title: Conjunctivitalizer
description: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

title: Vector Strike
description: Vector Strike is a fast-paced, physics based, non violent digital sport where mastery and teamwork are key to win. Shoot, double-jump, wall run, slide, dash, pass and score goals in intense matches where every decision counts. Pick your striker from a roster of powerful characters, each with unique abilities to master.

title: Lilac 0
description: The machine world of Molybdion has fallen into disarray. As Nidhogg eats the root of the planet, unending wars rage on the surface! Slice your way through hordes of metallic foes in five frantic levels, defeat fearsome bosses, and dodge countless bullets in this vintage vertical shoot 'em up.

title: Slime Attack: Survivor
description: Fast-paced arena roguelike bullet heaven! Battle relentless waves, tackle mid-run challenges, unlock unique heroes with their own combat pets, equip powerful gear, weapons, and spells, and take on mighty Yonian bosses.

title: My Make Believe Treasure Isle
description:
More make believe fun and learning is here from the publishers of My Make Believe Castle. Bursting with never-ending creative play, My Make Believe Treasure Isle uses the power of a child's imagination to propel learning adventures on a treasure island. Problem solving and logical reasoning skills are reinforced through a series of challenging activities.

"At last, software where the child programs the computer and not the reverse... a software toy that puts children's imagination in charge".

Dr. Seymour Papert MIT Media Lab Cambridge, MA

title: My Make Believe Castle
description: An iconic environment and child-friendly, real time animation lets pre-readers, grades Pre-K to grade 2, bring to life a friendly dragon, princess, good and bad knights and horses as they play and learn in their own musical, castle play world. Children control the actions, mood and speech of a delightful cast of castle inhabitants. The near endless variations mean hours of ever-changing creative play. Each room of the castle features a fun, skill-building activity. Develops creativity, problem-solving, critical-thinking skills, sequential planning and memory.

title: In the Facade we Trust
description: You’re torn between a girl who obsessed with you and a creature. Whose words can lead you out of this endless and dangerous loop? Which "you" are you? Who is the real monster? Trust the right person in the right cycle to get closer to the exit, or be misled by facades, complicating your next loop.

title: Ropuka's Idle Island
description: A cozy idle game that sits anywhere on your desktop. Watch the frog cut grass, upgrade his tools, and decorate the island while you work or relax.

title: Affection: San Shimai to Juusha no Shoujo
Looking For Fael
description:
Upon receiving a cryptic voicemail from your missing roommate, the ordinary confines of your apartment transform into a surreal labyrinth. Guided by his voice and a custom retro console in hand, embark on a journey to decipher the mysteries that have twisted your home into an enigmatic maze.

But beware. The further you venture into other realities, the harder it will be to find your way back.

title: You. Me. Hell.
description:
One boy. One girl. Two things in common: they are both trapped in their personal hells, and they want to get out.

"You. Me. Hell." is a classic crazy point-and-click-adventure and interactive story, with two playable protagonists. Tova and Tor have a shaky relationship. Tor lives in the future and in his own made-up-past. Tova is irritable, aggressive and dangerous to herself and every one else.

"You. Me. Hell." is not a game about saving the world. It's a game about a relationship, about how things can go wrong, and how they can be set right again.

title: Undying Flower
description: Would you forgive yourself if you killed someone you love? Enter the traumatic memories of The Flower, experience death as the killer and the killed, and submerge yourself in a dark, interactive adventure of emotions, suffering, and regret - looking for a way to forget.

title: You. Me. Heaven.
description:
Tova used to be a real bully back in school, many years ago. One day a strange shadow knocks her door and brings back a slice of her dirty past.

Visit the fearsome Castle Death Spider(tm), meet lots of zany characters, play rock paper and scissors against an evil warlock, participate in the surreal family show ”Guests with chests”, find out what’s behind the secret door in Tovas basement (but there IS no basement… or is there?), go beyond space and time to a secret alternative dimension… and make choices that shapes the story and it’s resolution.

”You. Me. Heaven.” is an independent follow-up on the critically-acclaimed surreal point-and-click-adventure ”You. Me. Hell.”, but doesn’t require you to have played the first game first.

This is not a game about heroes. This is a game about a shy bullied girl, and about a former bully’s journey through anguish and remorse.

title: Neptunian Nightmare
description: Neptunian Nightmare is a vanilla mapset and partial conversion for The Ultimate Doom (-complevel 3). It's an atmospheric romp heavily inspired by the Doom Bible and its associated prototypes, as well as Team TNT's TNT: Evilution and Icarus: Alien Vanguard.

title: Agoraphobia: Director's Cut
description:
A story of fear and doubts about reality, decisions and regrets, dreams and darkness.
~
A psychological horror adventure that takes the player through the wide corridors of a mysterious estate and confronts the protagonist with far-reaching decisions.
~
Find your own path, explore the sinister estate and uncover some of its deep-rooted secrets.
~
Leave this waking nightmare behind you, or slide further and further down into the rabbit hole of the Labyrinth of Agoraphobia.

title: 1-2-3 Bumblebee
description:
1-2-3 Bumblebee is a computer game designed to help toddlers learn how to use the mouse.
The Bumblebee behaves just like a "grown up" mouse pointer: Moving the mouse makes the Bumblebee fly, and clicking on squares will make colorful shapes appear.

The feedback is reinforced by multi-tone sounds and voice recordings. Once your child progresses through all three "pages", they are rewarded with a little song.

The game runs in fullscreen mode and the keyboard is locked to prevent your child from accidentally leaving the program.

title: Speedrun Academie
description:
In this first-person game, you’ll need to master every movement, optimize your trajectory, and maintain your momentum if you want to reach the finish. Every level is a challenge where slowing down isn’t an option, and mistakes aren’t forgiven.

Your mission is simple: start at point A, reach point B as fast as possible… but only a true speedrunner can shine.

title: Uncursed
description: Uncursed is a first-person psychological horror game blending immersive storytelling, environmental exploration, and puzzle-solving. Navigate a house filled with unsettling secrets, uncover the dark past hidden beneath its walls, and escape before history repeats itself.

title: Everspace 2: Wrath of the Ancients
description: The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion DLC as the Cluster readies for war once again in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients.

title: Underward
description: UNDERWARD is a 1-4 player co-op horror exploration game. Investigators must carry «TEST-SUBJECT» monsters from a deadly underground abandoned hospital ward.

title: Polish Simulator
description: In Polish reality, cunning and creativity matter—solve tasks in various ways, save time, and show your neighbor who's in charge. Hunt for deals, organize barbecues, and prove that a true Pole always finds a way to make life easier for themselves and harder for their neighbor.

title: Grand Theft Auto III Toughened
description: Hard mod for the original GTA III.

title: Forsaken Facilities
description: Find your fate in the Forsaken Facilities. Explore vast dungeons to gather a valuable resource for your mysterious kidnappers. Each day you enter a facility the only way to return is if you find the required resource. Test your luck to see how long you can survive through a variety of facilities.

title: Fox Legend
description: The gamescore is achieved separately, that is, for each version you will earn an exclusive gamescore.

title: Torii Guardian
description: Torii Guardian is a top-down tower defense action game where you need to defend the Torii gate to another world from hordes of evil spirits.

title: FlipCat
description: FlipCat is a 2D platformer with a unique perspective rotation mechanic. Explore 30 challenging levels as a curious cat, overcoming obstacles, solving puzzles, and uncovering hidden paths in a vibrant pixel art world. Fun for all ages!

title: Quartz Caverns
description:
Quartz Caverns is an action-adventure puzzle game where you guide the main character through a series of ancient caves in search of mystical crystals. The caverns are filled with tricky puzzles, dangerous slimes, and other hazards that test your wits and reflexes. As you explore, you'll uncover hidden paths, discover powerful relics, and face numerous threats lurking in the shadows. Only the bravest can retrieve the legendary crystals and uncover the secrets of the Quartz Caverns.

Are you up for the challenge?

title: Factory Escape
description: Has work ever tried to kill you? Max is trapped in a deadly factory. Use your rolling skill, dodge traps, and find the key to escape!

title: Ballotron Galaxy
description:
Discover the newest challenge in your favorite arcade!
Blast off into space and put your skills to the test once again.
Shoot small balls to strike larger balls and blocks.
Uncover creative solutions to connect the blue and green ball.
Experiment with unique strategies to overcome challenging, logic-based puzzles.

title: Boundland
description: Boundland is a fun physics-based platform game where you navigate your multi-shaped character through lots of dark levels and scary boss fights.

title: Ancient Ants Adventure
description: Your task is to become the leader of this great colony, rebuild your army and learn to use magic to protect your comrades in order to turn the tide of battle with terrible enemies.

title: Perfect Ninja Painter 3
description: New part of the puzzle platformer about ninja painters with new character, new features and new puzzles.

title: Pokémon: Salt & Shadow
description:
Pokémon meets Dark Souls.

Defy the perils of Cradle Island in Pokémon: Salt & Shadow. Explore a vast, interconnected world with dozens of possible paths to the end.
Be warned, the challenges ahead are unfair and some may seem truly impossible.

title: JaygiWare
description: After spending some time on his own, Jaygi decided to create his own game after hearing that the game industry was booming. Play over 10 microgames using your keyboard and mouse. Take a crack at it on Endless and get the best high score in Jaygi's game.

title: Pyramid Platformer: The Gem Heist
description: Explore the pyramid world in Pyramid Platformer, a challenging 2D pixel art game. Face 40 levels filled with traps like spikes and spinning saws. Unlock skills like Double Jump and Dash, and collect gems to advance on this thrilling journey full of challenges!

title: Take a Walk
description: Take a Walk brings nature trails to the comfort of wherever you are! This cozy, open-world walking simulator is the next best thing to touching grass. Embrace the calm, uncover hidden treasures and enjoy your walk.

title: Yosuga no Sora
description: The censored port for Yosuga no Sora.

title: The Motel
description: Work the late-night shift at The Motel, an old roadside stop near Oakhill Grove. Complete simple tasks until a news broadcast reveals a dangerous killer is nearby. Can you survive the night?

title: Wendigo Blue
description: Action-packed 2D beat-em-up with intense boss battles and a large variety of customizable equipment and skills. Up to 4 players with local co-op.

title: Into The Depths
description: A roguelite city builder, where you colonize the mysterious underworld. Build your settlement, explore the caves and colonize the deepest caverns. Overcome the dangers hidden in the dark and make the riches of the Depths yours!

title: Laundry Room Dilemma
description: You find yourself amnesiac and trapped in a laundry room. You can earn food by working. Who built this place? How do you escape?

title: Shadows Over Whispering Pines
description: A first-person mystery adventure where you solve puzzles, answer calls, and navigate dangers as a nightwatch in a secluded wilderness park.

title: Shotball
description: Blast your way to victory in Shotball, the adrenaline-pumping 3v3 class-based shooter sport game where football meets shotguns. Outplay, outmaneuver, and outgun your opponents to dominate the field!

title: I Am Here, I Won't Disappear. I Am Here, I Won't...
description: A black-white-and-red visual novel about a girl afraid of disappearing. And a bit about her cat.

title: /R
description: Run, hide, adapt and survive in a mansion of endless night and bizarre brain-twisting phenomena in this 2D hand-drawn psychological horror title.

title: Popoposan
description: 'She' spoke 'something' and chased after me. Back then, running away was the only thing I was good at. At home and at school, I had no place where I belonged, and I always wanted someone to play with. "POPOPOSAN" is an adventure game based on urban legends.

title: Inside Intruder
description: Inside Intruder - is a psychological horror game that mostly focuses on atmosphere. Game takes place in your own home, where a uninvited guest comes in.

title: Escape from Irene
description: Escape from Irene is a psychological thriller where you wake up in a mysterious place, with no memory, under the watchful eye of Irene. Explore the house, uncover its secrets, and try to escape without alerting Irene—because if she catches on, something terrible will happen.

title: Hentai Shop Simulator
description: Ever dreamt of running a shop that’s a little… spicier? In Hentai Shop Simulator, you’re the proud owner of a one-of-a-kind store catering to anime fans with a taste for the bold. Stock shelves with eye-catching magazines and cheeky merchandise, manage your inventory like a pro, and watch your profits soar. Just remember—your niche is adult content, so keep it classy...ish.

title: Electro Bop Boxing League
description: Climb the ranks and claim your spot among the greatest mechanical fighters in this Atompunk / Electro Swing themed auto-boxer! Outfit your boxer with a variety of parts, abilities, belts and crew upgrades earned through single matches or career mode!

title: Waifu App: 90 Days to Escape a Lonely Fate
description: Hiyori lives a very quiet and lonely life, but she decides enough is enough... She wants to change! And everything indeed changes when a spirit visits her and installs a strange app on her phone! The clock's ticking now... There are 90 days left!

title: The Backrooms: Forsaken
description: What would you do if you were trapped in a dimension of seemingly endless rooms that went on for eternity?

title: Gravity Storm: First Mission
description: Break the laws of physics, dash and shoot your way through levels full of hazards and machines gone rogue. In this retro game, you control Project Gravity Storm an advance machine able to control gravity itself; however, the mother computer will not make things easy for you.

title: Sprout Crafter
description: A farm simulation game where you cultivate nature, run a farm, and enjoy colorful interactions. Develop your farm by planting crops, harvesting, caring for animals, crafting, and exploring.

title: Elevator Music
description: You make the elevator go up, go down, go fast, and go slow. And yet, by the end of the week in an old hotel below looming Edelfaustian mountains, you'll have been the deciding factor in either war, or peace.

title: Steel Judgment
description: Steel Judgment is an ultra-fast roguelike movement FPS full of wacky combos and weapons that combines the expressive combat of beat-em' ups with the unhinged chaos of a roguelike. Wipe out hordes of enemies with a diverse moveset and arsenal while collecting powerful items with unique effects.

title: Final Redoubt: Zombie Apocalypse
description: Survive the onslaught, manage your ammo, and endure in Final Redoubt, a relentless survival shooter where every bullet, every swing, and every decision counts!

title: Can No One Hear Me?
description: All you have to do is press a key and speak into your microphone... But which key?

title: Slide to Solve
description: Slide to Solve is a minimalistic & relaxing puzzle game

title: Satan's Dungeon
description: First-person Philosophical Horror. Explore, solve puzzles, escape enemies, and uncover 5 unique endings.

title: Trashcan Simulator
description: The moment you throw something into the trash can is an exciting moment in your daily life. Through this game, you can enjoy the exciting moments of your life over and over again! You might discover something new by staring at the trash can in the room.

title: Galactic Simulator
description: Galactic Simulator is a clicker game based on the Fermi Paradox and the Great Filter theory. Players can simulate the evolution of celestial bodies and civilizations in the galaxy from an observer's perspective. The game supports multiplayer mode. Create a unique galaxy with friends!

title: Zombie Tide Incoming Final Defense
description: This is a refined third-person shooter game combined with tower defense elements.

title: Crashed
description: Crashed is a third-person stealth game where you play as B.O.B., stranded on the quirky planet SnamSam. The mission? Rebuild the craft and escape! You'll sneak through restricted areas and take daring routes. A splash of humour as B.O.B.'s detachable head knocks off the Snailmen's heads!

title: Max Manos
description: Max Manos is an incremental destruction game where you play as a powerful hand, known as Max Manos, eliminating shapes. Chain explosive reactions, collect shards, and upgrade your abilities to destroy shapes even faster.

title: Petal Crash 2
description: The freshest in arcade puzzle action blossoms again! Crash blocks together into dazzling chain reactions in a puzzle like no other - now completely refreshed with refined gameplay, arcade graphics, brand new game modes, and dazzling special attacks!

title: Dual Cat: Max
description: Join Max, the brave and clever cat, on a puzzle-platformer adventure to save his best friend, Erwin

title: Miiverse Clone RPG
description: Miiverse Clone RPG is a turn-based RPG based on Miiverse Clones, with a battle system similar to that of Undertale.

title: Vision Crew's Deltarune: Alternate Chapters
description:
Vision Crew's Deltarune: Alternate Chapters is a fangame project aiming to interpret Toby Fox's earlier concepts and Chapters, it's entirely speculative and plans to be worked on even once his own content is out!

It includes familiar characters, even ones Toby has namedropped without a design... or vice versa! But you'll also meet a ton of brand new characters!

title: Deltafall
description:
Deltafall is a Deltarune AU where the original trio discovers that their school was built after a science facility that conducts dangerous experiments with the dark world.

In 1977. A top secret corporation has found a way to harness the power of dark worlds to create any worlds they wanted. IDEATION INC has one goal. To create the perfect world. For all lifeforms. Not bound by reality. But bound by imagination.

title: Deltamon
description: Explore the vast region that Kris calls home as you aid them in becoming champion! Your rivals Susie, Noelle and Berdly join alongside you to see and catch over 200+ pokémon from Kanto to Paldea!

title: Deltarune: Hypothesis
description: A Deltarune fangame featuring a collection of hypothetical scenarios, each imagined as a fully playable segment of gameplay. Discover the hidden mysteries that connect these scenarios as you dive into each one, unraveling an existential truth about you and every adventure you’ve been on so far.

title: Undertale: Call of the Void - Placek's Take
description: Undertale: Call of the Void [Placek's Take] is an alternate interpretation of Undertale: Call of the Void, originally created by Saster and J-Bug. Developed by Placek and the COTW Team, this version introduces multiple unique endings, enhanced graphics, and fresh twists while preserving the signature Call of the Void style.

title: Abashed
description: Abashed is a 2.5D narrative-driven side-scrolling game that lets you explore the life of Issac, a man living with psychosis.
