One day waking up all alone, he sets out to find the truth behind his missing partner. On the way he finds himself needing to confront his deepest fears and the darkest secrets. Join Issac in this story of love, loss, fear, and acceptance. Reality is not what it seems.

title: The Outer Side
description: Explore an abandoned black-n-white world, utilize your abilities to fight danger, and find the truth about this place.

title: Clover Reset
description: "Hey, do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?" Set at "Shonan Saika Academy," a prestigious school in Shonan, Kanagawa Prefecture, this is a youthful story of girls wavering between friendship and love.

title: Undertale Green: The Pre-Show
description: Experience a one-shot adventure setting up the vibrant characters of Undertale Green through a drab snippet of the surface! Interact with an unorthodox battle system, make new friends, and prepare for the long road ahead.

title: Coloring Game 5.2
description:
An additional set of images for Coloring Game 5.
Size: 20 images / 550,000 px.
Duration: 15 hours (Pen Mode) / 8 hours (Fill Mode)

title: Coloring Game 5.3
description:
An additional set of images for Coloring Game 5.
Size: 20 images / 550,000 px.
Duration: 15 hours (Pen Mode) / 8 hours (Fill Mode)

title: Plane Destroyer
description: Plane Destroyer is an Infinite-Runner indie game where the galaxy is in trouble and you are the one to save it!

title: Grand Theft Auto Tightened Vice
description: GTA Tightened Vice is a sequel to the mod GTA III: Toughened, the goal of both mods is to make the game much more difficult.

title: Grand Theft Auto Tightened Thrice
description: 'Tightened Thrice' is a 'Tightened Vice' prequel mod for GTA 3, that seeks to make every single mission in the game harder, with a focus on ruining the muscle memory of speedrunners...

title: Vendrán las aves
description: You bought a guitar with your severance pay. And you have enough savings to do without a job for a year. So you've decided to devote some time to yourself.

title: The Land Before Time Animated MovieBook
description: The Land Before Time Animated MovieBook is an educational game for Windows-based PCs released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in 1996. The title contains full-motion video clips of the original Land Before Time (making it the Sound Source Interactive software adaptation of the first film in the film series), as well as puzzles and activities intended for players aged 3-6.

title: Your Android
description: Your life is changed forever when a mysterious package arrives at your front door. Go on many different outings with your new android companion as you both form unforgettable memories in this beautiful visual novel.

title: The Land Before Time: Math Adventure
description: The Land Before Time: Math Adventure is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 4-8. It was released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in 1998. It contains a series of math-oriented minigames that, like The Land Before Time Activity Center, reward the player with "tree stars" and "dino bucks" that can be used to unlock video clips (once again). The game was mentioned in the book Gadgets, Games and Gizmos for Learning by Karl M. Kapp as an example of electronic learning that can allow up-and-coming students to develop problem-solving skills.

title: The Land Before Time: Preschool Adventure
description: The Land Before Time: Preschool Adventure is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 3-5. It was developed by WayForward Technologies and was originally released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in 1999. Designed for players to "have fun, develop their creativity, and learn about teamwork", the game features activities that contain story construction, musical games, and crafts. The game was re-released in October 2005 by Brighter Child.

title: The Land Before Time: Toddler Time
description: The Land Before Time: Toddler Time is an educational game for Windows-based PCs intended for children ages 2-4. It was released by Sound Source Interactive in North America in October 1999. It features a series of five minigames, each with three difficulty settings featuring characters from the series. In their review of the title, Discovery Educational declared that "we found the label of 'toddler' for this software to be somewhat of a misnomer. Most toddler software titles require very little mouse/keyboard skills and feature very basic concepts", saying that the game was more appropriate for players over 3 years old, and that "children in the upper end of the suggested age group will find a fair amount to do".

title: Plot Twist
description: Welcome to Plot Twist, where you take on the role of an ambitious writer in a world of stories and inspiration. You will manage your own writing career, create bestsellers, gain fans, and shape the history of literature! Your success depends on making the right decisions and your creativity!

title: The Land Before Time: Prehistoric Adventures
description: The Land Before Time: Prehistoric Adventure is a children's PC bundle game, based on The Land Before Time film series, released on October 1st, 2004. It contains the games The Land Before Time: Preschool Adventure and The Land Before Time: Kindergarten Adventure bundled onto three discs. The game was designed to "increase matching skills, reinforce alphabet, shape and number recognition" and was packaged with two accompanying card games.

title: Team Delusional's Dusttale
description: Team Delusional's Dusttale is our own take on the well-known AU: Dusttale, which in itself is a fangame of Toby Fox's Undertale. You will face many new roadblocks as the entirety of the underground questions your motives, and a familiar hooded figure looms over your every move. Will you choose the easy way out this time, or will you strive for a better tomorrow?

title: Undertale Plus
description: Undertale Plus is a mod that allows you to have your own completely customized Undertale experience! Bringing all-console exclusive content of the original, with widescreen support, colored sprites, custom battle backgrounds, bug fixes, and many more with add-ons.

title: Underswap: Echoed
description: “Underswap: Echoed” is the Breakfast Bunch’s reimagining of the popular Undertale AU, Underswap.

title: Desktoptale
description: Desktoptale is a tiny program that puts a fully controllable Undertale, Undertale Yellow or Deltarune character of your choice on your Windows desktop!

title: Goog Clicker Deluxe
description: goog want click

title: Out of the Park Baseball 26
description: 26 years of sports gaming excellence! Out of the Park Baseball 26 is here - officially licensed by MLB, the MLB Players Inc., and KBO! This year's brand new version puts you firmly in charge of your favorite baseball franchise. Your team, your way, your rules.

title: Dusttale Reimagined
description:
Ever wanted an Undertale fangame that completely re-builds (or rather, REIMAGINES) the concept of Dusttale from the ground up?
Well you're in luck! This game is just for you!
Explore the Underground, meet old friends in new situations and join us in this race for DETERMINATION against Flowey your best friend in Dusttale Reimagined!

title: Undertale Together: Next Soul
description: A mod of Undertale where you can play with two characters!

title: Depper Jar
description: Depper Jar is a turn-based RPG with fast QTE-based battles and different game modes inspired by Mario & Luigi and Undertale.

title: Sonic 3 & Tenna
description:
Eggman's off on vacation, Ring Racing, so Tenna came out of Eggman's TV and took everything while he was gone.

Blast through Sonic 3 with a Deltarune twist! With over 18 completely new bosses to fight, 6 new gameplay gimmicks to endure, and a modified story, Sonic 3 & Tenna completely transforms the game into a new, yet familiar experience! Not a Undertale, Deltarune or UTDR fan-content fan? That's okay! The bosses have been designed with Sonic gameplay philosophy in mind, and the entire experience itself is stand-out enough to not require any prior UTDR knowledge.

title: Underswap: The Reckoning
description: Out of all the possible paths you can possibly entwine yourself into, this one in particular will prove to really challenge your palette.

title: Backyard Boxing
description: Backyard Boxing" is a gritty urban boxing game where you fight to rise through an illegal league while hustling in the streets. Battle fierce opponents, gamble, race, deal, and travel to new cities, gaining fans and respect. Dominate the league and become a street legend!

title: Deltarune: The Upper Hand
description: Dive into the capitalist utopia of New Yolk and engage in the short story of Sockswald. Building up to the climactic fist-clenching bossfight against HANDROMEDA.

title: NightFell
description:
Trapped in a forgotten world atop an enchanted mountain, Monsters have been confined to an endless darkness. Life on the CROWN is dangerous and hopeless, with many monsters turning to cruelty to stay sane.

On Halloween night, Jackie accidentally stumbles into this terrifying realm. They're told the only way out is at the highest peak of the mountain. With that in mind, Jackie sets out to climb to the top with their best Friend, Flowey.

Will they forge friendships with the battle-worn residents that call this Hell a home? Or will they succumb to the ruthless law of this land... "Kill or Be Killed?"

title: Num Dá Véi!
description: Num Dá Véi! is a 3D platformer game by William Jacob. Created as a birthday present for the Bart GameDev channel on 10/30/2023, the game challenges you to dodge and destroy obstacles that stand in your way. But be careful—anything dangerous that touches you could be fatal!

title: Wizards of Nature
description: Wizards Of Nature is an open-world, first-person, fantasy RPG game by William Jacob. Recover the fallen Cities of Ziran by defeating terrible monsters that the Necromancer left behind.

title: Dusttrust X
description: From the developers behind the fangame Green Snas, Dusttrust X is a revitalization of the original Dusttrust AU as well as a spiritual successor to Legacy Underswap: Thanatos. You play as both Chara and Sans as you explore a broken version of the world you once knew and see how they both react to the new situation they put themselves in of their own doing.

title: Star Iliad
description:
Star Iliad is a Metroidvania adventure game set within this celestial leviathan - now in development!

Dive into the guts with Star Iliad, a retro-future action adventure game. Play as Blythe Braves, a star ranger stranded within the labyrinthine organs of the mythical Star Whale. Fight fearsome foes, sling spells and bullets, and befriend a charming set of castaways in your quest to escape.

title: Promessa
description: Promessa is a narrative platformer game by William Jacob where you play as Levi, a warrior who is under control of the forces of evil and who must defeat the forces of light to get his deceased wife back.

title: Nikola's Fate
description: Nikola's Fate is a wave combat platformer adventure game by William Jacob, where you play as Nikola Tesla and try to stop his co-workers from stealing his greatest creation: The Tesla Coil!

title: Collect Baby Oil
description: Collect Baby Oil is a fast-paced runner where you have to run away from the police. Collect bottles of baby oil scattered along your path to unlock a variety of funny and unique characters such as Quandale Dingle. Avoid obstacles, time your jumps perfectly, and see how far you can go before the cops catch up.

title: Word Brawl
description: Word Brawl is an action-packed word game by William Jacob. Collect letters, form words, and outsmart your rivals in chaotic, fast-paced battles. Punch your way to victory and prove you’re the best!

title: Witch Stories
description: First-person retro horror RPG. Non-linear, open world, branching dialog, voice acted, simple controls, and tons of easter eggs to discover. Set in the 1700s. You are a woman living in a cottage in the forest with your husband and newborn baby. Your story unfolds over two days, whether you choose to act or not.

title: A Whole Wolfrush
description: Four friends battle their way across space to claim a once-in-a-lifetime wish. Their lives are in your hands.

title: Sweep City
description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

title: Eve Online: Revenant
description: The Revenant expansion for EVE Online is live! Join forces with the Deathless and strike at the heart of darkness as you explore thrilling new opportunities, fearsome ships, powerful weapons, mercenary dens that harness new resources, and new ways to activate and unify your corporation.

title: D.I.M.
description: Made in collaboration between game developer Conner Rush, 3D artist Cody Reader, and 2D Artist Denice Stout, D.I.M. is a short first-person narrative experience about life, death, and artificial intelligence.

title: From The Past
description: What hides in the depths of the forest?!

title: WWE 2K25
description: Celebrate The Bloodline in Showcase. Compete online in MyGM. Expanded gameplay includes intergender wrestling, chain wrestling, barricade diving, the return of Promos + much more!

title: Hapunan
description: A balut vendor's simple life turns into a nightmare—can you survive the shadows of Barangay Sak Dudol?

title: Am I Nima
description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

title: Carnal Sins: Malum Incarnatum + Carne Vescens
description: Dive into the twisted perceptions of love from two lost souls: Unravel a life torn apart by the desire to love and be loved, and help a mother feed her insatiable child by paying the ultimate price.

title: Little Lighthouse of Horror
description: A pixel art psychological horror game inspired by the Flannan Isles mystery. Manage a remote lighthouse, handle limited resources, and confront eerie occurrences as isolation erodes your sanity. Multiple endings await based on your choices and actions. How long can you last?

title: Aura Farmers
description: Outlast your rivals, lock down the zone, and farm that aura. Forget hunting for kills—this is a high-speed battle for absolute control. Engage in intense 1v1 duels, coordinate brutal team assaults, or unleash chaos in frantic multi-team brawls! Every round is a wild, skill-testing party.

title: A Simple Garbage Sorting Game
description: We are recruiting a large number of testers from around the world to participate in an unprecedented secret experiment.. Join us and embark on this journey of exploration that is crucial to survival. In this unknown experiment, your choices will determine the fate of the Earth

title: No Man's Sky: Worlds Part II
description:
Update 5.50, WORLDS PART II, transforms the universe with new stars, new story, and new planets. Explore ancient ruins, gas giants and water worlds, and discover strange creatures, varied biomes and dramatic terrain. Featuring new gameplay, huge improvements in lighting and water rendering, and much more.

Our journey continues.

title: Mariostro Strikers: Soccer League
description:
Dive into the thrilling world of arcade-style soccer with [Your Game Name Here]! Experience the excitement of 4v4 matches, where every player counts. With 10 unique and fun teams to choose from, you’ll dribble, pass, and shoot your way to victory while defending your goal with a skilled goalkeeper.

Designed for fast-paced fun, this game focuses on easy-to-learn controls and engaging gameplay. Whether you’re sprinting down the field, setting up the perfect assist, or unleashing a powerful shot on goal, every moment is packed with action and excitement.

title: Grand Theft Bubble
description: Join an ordinary person as he goes about his work: wrapping objects in bubble wrap. Maybe then you can relax after a hard day preparing orders...

title: Scar-Lead Salvation
description: Hard difficulty TPS roguelike with randomly generated dungeons. The protagonist, Willow Martin, has no memory of her past, but when a fight begins, her body moves naturally and she displays exceptional combat abilities.

title: Ariana and the Elder Codex
description:
The Librarian Ariana’s mission is to repair the Seven Hero Codices, which have been altered. Due to the terrible damages, magic has vanished from the world.

By utilizing special Librarian magic that allows her to enter Codices, Ariana seeks to mend the books to bring back magic. Can Ariana safely repair each tome and unravel the mysteries hidden within the Library?

title: Maze of Mayhem
description:
-Your mission is clear: explore, survive, and escape.
Collect scattered keys hidden within the maze.
Outsmart a relentless creature stalking the maze, hunting you in the shadows.
Hide to survive, hide in the corner, and wait until it's out of your sight.
Find the exit and escape the nightmare before it’s too late.
Can you navigate the maze's twists and turns, or will you become a permanent part of its deadly legend?

title: Going for Nuts
description: Do you like playing platform games and especially the old ones? A brand new and yet old game (in appearance) in 16-bit cartoon graphics. Experience a crazy adventure with an unusual hero.

title: Project Shikai
description: A multiplayer first-person arena fighter delivering competitive, fast-paced anime-inspired combat with the strategic depth of traditional fighting games.

title: Town to City
description: Build an idyllic 19th century Mediterranean town and help it flourish into a prosperous city. Freely place and customise each element to create the perfect home for your growing population in this cozy city builder from the creators of Station to Station.

title: Neon Spellstorm
description: Neon Spellstorm is an action roguelite where you race along a crumbling neon path as a powerful wizard, wielding limitless magic. Unleash devastating spells, stack wild synergies, and reshape a destructible, otherworldly terrain that falls away behind you!

title: Tales Beyond the Tomb: The Last Vigil
description: Nick Harrison, a new security guard at the Guadalupe Cemetery, believes he is taking on a peaceful night shift. However, as night falls, he soon discovers he was very wrong. Nick realizes the cemetery holds more than just the dead.

title: Sniper at Work
description: Sharpen your aim and embrace chaos in this action-packed single-player sniping experience. Scout targets, plan creative kills, and adapt when things go sideways. With dynamic missions, tactical freedom, and explosive surprises, every shot tells a story. Precision or mayhem - the choice is yours!

title: Secret Cats: Spring Festival
description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Spring Festival" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

title: Projekt Godhand
description: An extremely high-speed "keyboard destruction rhythm game" in which any key on the same half of the keyboard can be used to input notes.

title: Amy Galore
description: Enjoy your favorite levels in Sonic 3 while playing as the iconic pink hedgehog, as you jump, spin, glide, and smash your way through obstacles!

title: Mr. T-Shirt
description: Help Mr. T-Shirt in a world of paper and doodles. Collect the key and move on to the next level, facing unique challenges in every stage!

title: Theralite
description: A turn based Sci-fi Roguelike where players explore the deep mines on a distant planet, find/trade equipment, battle monsters and try to survive.

title: Puzzle Spy International
description: Pursue a ring of diamond thieves and their trail of cryptic puzzles in this ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Decode cryptograms, decipher clues and deduce answers as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!

title: DevTycoon
description: DevTycoon is a software development business simulation with a charming pixel art style, which challenges you to build and manage your own company in a world where competition is fierce and the challenges reflect real life.

title: Grandpa
description: Grandpa is a first-person horror game where players must escape from an old, abandoned house while being hunted by a terrifying old man. The game challenges players with puzzles, stealth mechanics, and limited resources as they navigate through a dark and eerie environment.

title: Y2Roll
description: Y2Roll is an N64-style minimalistic physics-based arcade-style marble rolling game that will take you back to the turn of the millennium.

title: Tower of Babel: Survivors of Chaos
description: Battle hordes of monsters, acquire new skills, and upgrade your abilities. Customize your build with hundreds of item combinations and reach the top to fulfill your deepest desires. Conquer the tower in this thrilling roguelite hack and slash survivors game!

title: Eve Online: Special Edition
description:
A collection of all ten free updates to EVE Online, up to early 2009's Apocrypha expansion.

The Special Edition includes:
- Exclusive digital Career Guide, roughly equivalent to a hint book (giving goals and suggestions for careers and playing the economy)
- 60 days of free game time, and a VIP code for 30 more days if a friend also subscribes. - Brand new accounts also receive an exclusive ship
- Certificate for instant access to the factional warfare system

title: Eve Online: Apocrypha
description: At Fanfest 2008 it was announced that instead of a six-month gap between expansions the subsequent expansion to Quantum Rise, Apocrypha, would be released on March 10, 2009. This expansion included a training queue, Tech 3 vessels, and exploration of uncharted space through unstable wormholes. Apocrypha has improved NPCs' artificial intelligence and has added a new NPC faction to the game, the Sleepers.

title: Eve Online: Crucible
description: The Crucible expansion was introduced to refine the existing game aspects. New nebulae graphics, an improved UI, time dilation and gameplay balancing were included in the expansion. CCP also added a line of third tier battlecruisers, which can fit battleship weapons, and the remaining Captain's Quarters for the Amarr, Gallente, and Caldari races. In addition to this, the engine trail effect was reintroduced.

title: Eve Online: Dominion
description:
Dominion enhances the tools of communication and evolves the dynamics of war, altering the very way in which pilots interact with each other through warfare or cooperation. The vast riches of sovereign authority await for those bold enough to seize them amidst a beautiful, deadly universe of possibility.

The main focus of Dominion, the 11th expansion, is an overhaul in the alliance warfare sovereignty mechanics. It also includes the introduction of pirate epic arcs, an artistic redesign of planets and a social networking platform called COSMOS (previously called New Eden). Dominion updates the In Game Browser (IGB) with Awesomium (a browser toolkit based on Chromium), allowing the IGB to behave more like a true browser and properly render HTML, javascript and stylesheets.

This update includes:
- Sovereignty Evolves
- Sovereignty Infrastructure System
- New Doomsday Devices and Capital Ship Changes
- Improved Fleet Tools
- Exploration and Advanced PVP Tutorials
- Faction Ships Revisited
- Pirate Faction Epic Arc Missions
- Upgraded Planets and Starfields
- Improved In-Game Mail System
- Full Featured In-Game Browser

title: Zero Jikan he...
description: A gigantic meteorite will fall on the Earth in 3 days destroying it forever. At this time one amateur astronomer's photo of the comet tail initiated a series of full-scale riots and mayhem. How will you live three last days in such a world?

title: Eve Online: Incarna
description:
The overall Incarna feature revolves around allowing players to leave their pods and walk around in their station HQ. Currently 'face to face' interactions with other pilots is not possible. This feature has been in development for the majority of the life of Eve.

In the initial Incarna release all Captains Quarters were of Minmatar design. The captain's quarters are a private single player environment to introduce players to Incarna. As with the previous expansion (Incursion) this expansion will follow a segmented roll out. This allows for testing of each major feature under the stress of the live server separately.

Incarna also included a major visual revamp of all turrets, mining lasers, tractor beams and salvagers design and animation (including the firing animation).[48]

One of Incarna's changes, the introduction of the "Noble Exchange" (NeX) as an in-game market allowing players to buy vanity items, received negative reaction from players and prompted in-game riots.[49][50]

Other changes include:
- New design for the Maller hull, an Amarr cruiser size ship.
- Change of jumpbridge mechanics to a limit of one jumpbridge per system but in return a fuel bay increase to 30,000m3 from the original 10,000m3.

title: Eve Online: Incursion
description:
Incursion was announced on September 21, 2010. The expansion featured the "escalating attacks of the deadly Sansha's Nation". Players are able to join public fleets and co-operate to repel the Sansha incursions, receiving bounties and earning loyalty rewards. Incursion also includes many improvements as suggested by the CSM, as well as hardware upgrades, software improvements and new cluster components aimed at increasing game performance.

Additionally, the character creator was updated with CCP's Carbon character technology for new pilot portraits. Finally, CCP added a Sansha Mothership, the Revenant, Fighter-bombers, the Noctis salvaging vessel, improvements to NPCs and their AI, new loot and rewards, storyline events and a more dynamic and simplified system for Planetary Interaction. The web-based social networking platform, EVE Gate, and the official forums received updates in the Incursion expansion as well.

CCP released the Incursion expansion in three phases: a first-step patch with a collection of player-requested improvements on November 30, a second-step patch with hidden features before December 25, and a third-step patch that included key features of the expansion (Incarna Character Creator, Sansha Incursions) on January 18, 2011. CCP has stated that this method of implementation prevents a large number of bugs from infiltrating the code, and the key features "will benefit greatly from an additional level of polish."

During the second-step patch the learning skills were removed. Players were reimbursed in two ways, they got their invested skill points back which they then could redistribute to their liking or, when they hadn't already inserted the skillbook, they got the NPC price back.

title: Eve Online: Inferno
description:
The 2012 summer expansion was announced with the name "Inferno" on February 22.Inferno brought a complete overhaul of the war declaration and factional warfare systems, addition of 17 new modules and 3D models for missile launchers and missiles along with a mercenary marketplace, unified inventory and graphical updates.

A list of the additions and modifications from the Inferno feature page:
- 3D models for missile launchers and missiles including animations, effects and sounds
- Graphics update including V3 textures for the majority of the Amarr fleet
- Overhaul of the war declaration system including the addition of war reports
- Update of kill mails to kill reports which add a graphical interface in addition to other features
- Mercenary marketplace for corporations and alliances to hire themselves out for mercenary jobs in a more official manner
- Factional warfare overhaul allowing players to spend LP points to upgrade empire systems along with a new UI interface
- Addition of 17 new modules in the categories of defense, offense and support which now make it possible for every fit to have a counter fit
- Additions to the character creator including new skin tones and a full resculpture for every character
- Unified inventory allowing players to see all the contents of containers they have access to at a station along with filtering and sorting
- Updated incursions which yield greater rewards for players than before
- Additions of an effects bar so players can easily tell what effects are being cast upon their ship
- More opportunities for players both rookie and veteran to earn income
- More UI enhancements to bring them into line with performance and aesthetic goals

title: Eve Online: Quantum Rise
description: The Quantum Rise expansion includes features such as a new certificate system that allows verification of a player's proficiency in certain defined groups of skills by other players and a medal system for awards by corporations. Industrial ships were rebalanced and optimized, with addition of the Orca-class ship, "a sub-capital logistical ship with a mining command focus." The staged delivery of the expansion began with the recent implementation of new technology such as StacklessIO and EVE64 which upgraded the server hardware and streamlined communication between server and client to reduce lag. These improvements provide performance allowing for player vs. player battles with thousands of participants. Further hardware and software improvements are planned. Other features of the expansion include further graphics updates as started in the Trinity expansion; the ability for players to group their vessels' weapons for easier interaction; changes to autopilot routes and avoidance of player-defined solar systems. This patch also brought a controversial overhaul of the speed system.

title: Eve Online: Retribution
description:
Retribution brought a revamped bounty system, a new "crimewatch" system, added 4 new destroyer ships and a new mining frigate, rebalanced the frigate, cruiser and destroyer ship roles and improved enemy AI.

A list of the additions and modifications from the Retribution feature page:
- A revamp of the bounty system, which deals out payment on financial loss
- A revamp of the criminal warning system, dubbed "crimewatch"
- A rebalance of ships in the frigate, cruiser and destroyer classes
- Addition of four new destroyers for each of the races with different attributes
- Addition of a new ORE mining frigate
- Improvements to the combat UI
- Improvements to NPC AI
- Addition of a new music audio system which works on location rather than a linear playlist. Removal of the jukebox
- Other minor features such as new items, the addition of a new safety system, a new salvage drone, and various performance improvements

title: Eve Online: Trinity
description: Features include an updated graphics engine and 5 new ship classes totaling 20 new ships. The 5 classes are interdictor cruisers (Heavy Interdictors) and electronic warfare frigates (Electronic Attack Ships) as well as battleships (Black Ops, designed for covert operations and Marauders, designed for long-range deployment) and freighters (Jump Freighters). Although "Factional Warfare," a major addition to game mechanics, had been planned for this patch it has since been announced that it will now be included in a future patch, along with Ambulation (walking in stations and Full Human Representation, announced on the Eve Online Fanfest 2007). Starting with the release of Trinity CCP offers two editions of the Eve Online client. One with regular graphics content, called Trinity 1.0 Classic, and one with updated graphics, called Trinity 1.0, also referred to as Premium. Players who run a Shader Model 3-capable graphics card can choose whether they want the Classic or Premium content. Without such a graphics card the client uses the Classic content.

title: Simp: Leveling Up on a Dating App
description:
FMV (Interactive Movie)

"It's not that I can't date; I just won't date just anyone!"
Meet Tesu Kang, a simp who's never had a girlfriend in his 30 years. Now facing the harsh reality of aging without any prospects for romance. he realizes that if there's no path, he must forge his own. Determined to find new love through a dating app, Tesu embarks on what could be the biggest challenge of his life.

Join in and see how your choices will change his destiny!

title: Monochrome Nemesis
description:
Dive into the Darkness!

Enter the captivating universe of Monochrome Nemesis, a die and retry game in black and white pixel art, offering a retro black and white experience. Relentlessly face a formidable knight who gains strength and strategy with each duel. Each victory makes your Nemesis more powerful, ensuring a constant and renewed challenge.

For Challenge Seekers, Monochrome Nemesis is designed for those who seek a true challenge. Each combat demands skill and perseverance, putting your abilities to the test.

A Game Without Limits, Except Yours. Monochrome Nemesis is a record game, with no mechanical limits other than your own endurance. How far will you go to defeat your Nemesis?

Prepare to take on the ultimate challenge and prove your worth against your Nemesis.

Created with Godot by an Independent Developer.

title: Eve Online: Tyrannis
description: Tyrannis expands the universe of EVE Online in ways never before imaginable. Within New Eden, pilots will now be able to descend on planets, construct colonies and harvest their hidden treasures. Beyond New Eden lies EVE Gate, a central portal for the EVE community to interact, organize and communicate even when they are not in game. Tyrannis introduces new platforms and new technology, setting the stage for even bigger things to come.

title: Three Verses3
description: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

title: Super Clew Land
description:
Eat, evolve, and explore in this happy-go-lucky exploration-based platformer.

Game available on Retro Game Crunch.

title: Morsomnia:0
description: Interacting with the unidentified life form “Kuon”, we move forward with the pain. A surreal, mysterious fancy adventure.

title: The Bench
description: Relax on a park bench, find hidden objects, solve quirky puzzles, and fend off pesky pigeons in this charming, interactive adventure. Enjoy beautifully stylized, colorful levels keeping you entertained!

title: Starling
description: Starling is a student made third person base-building exploration game. As an employee of Starling Corp., your mission is to gather resources from across the galaxy. After an unexpected turn of events, you will need to rebuild your base while being assisted by adorable creatures known as starlings.

title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate - Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam
description: Casey Jones joins the fight in this fast-paced, action-packed DLC! Battle through the Junkyard, face new enemies and bosses, and collect new powerful artifacts. Master Casey's hard-hitting moves and team up with the Turtles in co-op to take on the Punk Frogs!

title: The Treehouse
description:
One of the best edutainment titles ever made for pre-shoolers (aged 5-8), The Treehouse was designed to prepare First and Second graders to develop a positive experience toward learning, as well as impart knowledge on basic subjects they are learning in schools.

Kids will enjoy discovering many mini-games and and activities that are cleverly presented as objects in the treehouse. The games cover a wide range of subjects. In one game, for example, kids will learn new words, arrange them in sentences, and see them performed by eccentric bug actors. In another, they will practice elementary math skills and identify coins to outwit pirates. They will learn about the animal kingdom and watch over ninety animals animate as they are placed in different natural backgrounds. Afterwards, kids can show off their natural science knowledge in a fun game show, WhatUs My Animal!

In addition to mini-games, The Treehouse also features many activity centers that are there just for fun. In the Music Studio, kids can explore their musical talents as they compose songs using a variety of instruments and styles. In the theatre, they can create a play by mixing and matching a range of characters, objects, and scenery, as well as write their own movie script.

With a staggering range of activities, games, and cute animations, The Treehouse will keep preschoolers enthralled for hours on end without realizing that they're learning useful skills along the way. It is no wonder that the program went on to become one of the best selling programs from Brøderbund, and went on to inspire many sequels and CD-ROM remakes. Two thumbs up!

title: Winter Hubris
description: A point-and-click horror game where you must survive in an isolated base as you wait for rescue.

title: 10 Seconds
description: Time loop puzzle horror, where you're stuck in a failed experiment and must escape or face being eaten for eternity.

title: Apple Orchard Escape
description: Overview: Run around an apple orchard as Val, she is the pumpkin headed mascot of a rival pumpkin patch to the apple orchard that she finds herself at. Don't make too much noise or you'll be caught!

title: Somnus
description: SOMNUS is a first-person indie game in the genre of adventure with elements of horror. The protagonist, a young boy, faces a difficult ordeal: his mother is seriously ill, and in order to pay for her treatment, he takes a job as a night guard.

title: The End of Infinity Return
description: The End of Infinite Return is a story that unravels the fate and secrets of the secret agent Lexy as she goes on missions in a simulated world.Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies and solve puzzles while deciding your own fate.

title: Isles of Krom
description: Isles of Krom is a top-down action roguelike that combines the visceral and demanding combat of a Souls-like games with the deep character-building and progression systems of the best roguelikes.

title: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 2 HD
description: A young girl confronts eerie manifestations and deciphers cryptic puzzles as she sets out to defeat three cursed toys and rescue her friends.

title: Before Arthur
description:
Lead your people through the dark ages in this blend of medieval grand strategy and RPG simulation. Rule your kingdom while navigating the life of a monarch; battling the elements, religious strife, disease, and political treachery. Will you survive as a Briton, or conquer as a Saxon?

Set in the dark ages during the Saxon invasion of Britain, you choose your faction and design your first character who will forge your dynasty. As you go about living your character's daily life you will be building and managing your small kingdom, deciding where to place buildings, what laws to pass and who's other kingdoms to invade.

title: Articrafty
description: What will you create? Combine realism and fantasy. Combine characteristics with abilities. Create unique items. Achieve "Legendary" mastery. Breathe life.

title: Lifter
description: Lifter is an Adventure RPG where you play as a desperate thief trying to save your home from eviction. Outsmart employees, and decide who to steal from in a world full of secrets. Will you be a hero, a rogue, or something in between? The future is in your hands.

title: Skopje '83
description: Explore a city thrust into disarray by an unknown event and survive the hordes of mutated abominations that lurk at every corner. You’ll have to fight through enemies & bosses, scavenge loot and survive the hostile city.

title: Eve Online: Castor
description:
Castor was the first major content addition. It focused on refining current functions along with adding "Tech 2" elite components and ships. With its release, Eve players saw conquerable stations in 0.0 (deep space) security systems, the introduction of the agent mission running system, the introduction of research agents, and many other features released between the launch of Castor and its follower, Exodus.

This update includes:
- Tech Level 2
- Player Owned Conquerable Stations
- New Ship Classes
- New Agent Features
- Market Changes
- Updated Ship Technology
- Crime Fighting
- Advanced Skills
- Weapon Upgrades
- Auto-cloak

title: Hentai Mikky
description:
Hentai Mikky is a single player, mouse controlled, casual, adult puzzle game.

This is a Sliding block puzzle game. Images of a scantily clad or naked Mikky are cut into rectangular tiles and scrambled. The player's task is to restore the picture by sliding the pieces around until the picture is fully formed.

title: Is This Seat Taken?
description: Is This Seat Taken? is a logic puzzle game where you play matchmaker for groups of hilariously particular people. Each character has pet peeves that make seating them a delightful challenge. Find the perfect spot for each person to unlock new levels in this cozy, silly, and relatable experience.

title: Eve Online: Exodus
description:
Exodus is considered by the developers to be the first major game expansion. The expansion added multi-level "deadspace" scenarios, new environments and ships, better handling of conflicts, additional market functionality, user interface improvements, and an updated in-game web browser. A formalized method for alliances between corporations and the ability to claim sovereignty of a solar system via new "player owned starbases" was also added. Prior to its official release, this expansion was codenamed "Shiva."

This update includes:
- New Ships
- Starbases
- New Helper Applications
- New Multi-level Scenarios
- System Scanning
- Mining Improvements
- Corporation Improvements
- Alliance Systems
- War Declaration
- User Interface Improvement
- New Agent Functionality
- New Aggression System
- New NPC Types
- Market Improvements
- Fleet Command and Tactical View
- Updated In-game Browser

title: Eve Online: Cold War
description:
Cold War Edition contained an extensive new tutorial sequence and a storyline background introduction. Challenging "level 4" agent missions were added for experienced players, as well as "COSMOS" constellations where in-space agents began giving out story-driven missions and unique rewards. The freighter and dreadnaught capital ships, full-fledged player-owned "outposts," and improved NPC pirate factions brought deep space play to a new level. This expansion also added Unicode chat support, allowing communication in Asian, Cyrillic, and Greek languages.

This update includes:
- Combat Improvements
- Outposts
- Pirate Factions Upgrades
- New World Order
- Cosmos Constellations
- Dreadnoughts
- Encounters In Space
- Leadership Overhaul
- Freighters
- Mini-professions
- New Complexes
- Convoy Raiding Lucrative
- System Sovereignty
- Unicode Chat & Client Improvements
- Research Breakthroughs & Skills

title: Eve Online: Red Moon Rising
description:
Red Moon Rising was split off from the "Kali" expansion in order to maintain a more regular patch schedule. It included many performance optimizations and updates to combat, research, and manufacturing gameplay. Unicode support was also expanded from the chat system to game-wide. A major focus of the expansion was revamping existing ships and adding many additional ship classes. Twenty-three new Tech 2 ships were added including Exhumers, Force Recon cruisers, Command Ships, Interdictors, and most notably, the capital ships Carrier, Mothership, and Titan.

This update includes:
- Carriers & Motherships
- Titans
- Bloodlines
- Starbases And Sovereignty
- Tech 2 Ships
- Project Rebirth
- Cosmos Constellations
- Next-gen Manufacturing & Research Facilities
- Optimizations
- Fighters
- Combat Revisited
- Drones Revisited
- Needful Things For Mining
- NPCs Revisited
- Eye For An Eye
- Tech 2 Ammunition
- Unicode Client
- New Corp Logos
- Jettison Canister Flagging
- UI Improvements
- Tractor Beam

title: Great Deceiver
description: A visual novel about what happens when a modern-day empress meets an ordinary man.

title: Eve Online: Revelations II
description:
Revelations II is the second of three expansions, designed to show the increased tensions between the empires within the game universe. Several new features were introduced; including a mechanism for overloading modules and area of effect bombs. A number of existing features have been extended including Level 5 agents, changes to sovereignty, starbases outposts, and balancing changes to the Amarr race. Revelations II also changed the way new players start the game, in addition to new optional tutorials the existing tutorial has been shortened and refined, and players now start in a private dungeon to allow new players to get used to the controls in a protective environment.

This update includes:
- Heat
- Anti-Fleet Warfare
- Structure Warfare Enhancements
- Starbase Warfare
- Outpost Warfare
- Outpost Upgrades
- Expanding the Frontiers of Exploration
- Agent Mission Improvements
- Broader Sovereignty Scope
- Improved Corporation & Alliance Management
- Need for Speed
- Immersive New Player Experience
- General Improvements

title: Eve Online: Empyrean Age
description:
Empyrean Age, previously named Kali 4, is the name of the 8th expansion of Eve Online and the last one in the Kali tetralogy. CCP has included Factional Warfare in this release. In this expansion the in-game story plays a key role and the situation in the game reflects events depicted in the novel of the same title by Tony Gonzales. The expansion allows both individual players and whole corporations to fight for certain NPC factions and battle for control of certain regions of space. Agents provide missions and objectives which alter player and corporation standings with the factions accordingly.

This update includes:
- Factional Militias
- Ranks
- Factional Warfare Agents
- Statistics
- System Occupancy
- Combat Zones
- Factional Warfare Complexes
- World Shaping

title: Skufs vs. Quadrobers
description: This isn't what our grandfathers fought for! Rise from your soulful, old apartment and resist the Western heathens – the Quadrobers, who are trying to impose their rules! Or, join the modern Quadrobers and show the Skufs that the era of sweaty, beer-bellied men is over!

title: Tokoyo no Hoshizora
description:
This is how the most selfish girl in the world and the most selfish boy in the world make peace:

Bells in the darkness that ensnare Heaven's silver light inside the inscrutable polyphony of far-off constellations.

title: Worm Girlfriend Dating Simulator
description: A short visual novel with physics-based movement about waking up as a worm and finding love.

title: Yukibana: Kira
description: A town covered in snow, a man, a mysterious little girl, and their entanglement.

title: Eve Online: Odyssey
description:
Dominion represents the type of conquest never realized by pretty words and poetry. It is true power born from the broken hulls of a thousand starships, the genes of the ambitious and the hubris of the greedy. EVE's 12th free expansion offers the power of control to anyone bold enough to seize it, bringing you the tools for you to rally legions together and carve out your own space.

Will your ambitious new Alliance rise up to the challenge and stake their claim, evolving territory to suit it's needs? Will your established empire hold fast against the fleets that press at your borders, hungry for the wealth you protect? Will you call old friends to your side and convince them to join you once more in battle? Or are you the clever entrepreneur who sits clear of the danger and fuels the war from the periphery?

Dominion enhances the tools of communication and evolves the dynamics of war, altering the very way in which pilots interact with each other through warfare or cooperation. The vast riches of sovereign authority await for those bold enough to seize them amidst a beautiful, deadly universe of possibility.

title: Mukou no Yume
description: For reasons completely unknown, Chisato Mikogami kills herself. She comes back as a ghost and wanders the earth, meeting the many interesting spirits and ghosts that make up the afterlife. Like Fishman, a fish spirit with a grudge against Chisato; Chisato's crazy sister who experiments on her, Chiyu; and their insanely powerful Mom.

title: Eve Online: Rubicon
description: Rubicon brought major updates and changes to core game elements, the certificates system was overhauled along with the player login screen. New features included the addition of player owned high-sec customs offices, ghost sites, new hacking mechanics, Twitch streaming. The update is also the first steps towards colonisation, as stated in CCP Seagull's vision.

title: Eve Online: Citadel
description:
This update includes:
- Added citadels: Astrahus, Fortizar and Keepstar
- Added special Palatine Keepstar
- Alterations of structure assault mechanics - dev blog
- Added asset safety
- Added Access Lists for citadel control
- Added Force Auxiliaries: Apostle, Minokawa, Lif and Ninazu
- Reworking of capital ships
- Visual effects alterations for combat feedback
- New faction NPC capital ships
- New capital ship weapons
- Visual effect alterations for station hangars
- New structure fitting window
- New superweapons for capital ships

title: Eve Online: Ascension
description:
This update includes:
- Added Alpha and Omega Clone States - dev blog
- Added Engineering Complexes - dev blog
- Added complete new player experience Inception - dev blog
- Added Command Bursts - dev blog
- Alterations to fleet boosts
- Added fitting simulator
- Rebalance of Tactical Destroyers
- New effect generator for Titans
- New visual feedback from command bursts, combat logs and effects bar
- Visual and audio effects update to explosions and wrecks
- Rebalance of Rorqual
- Added Pulse Activated Nexus Invulnerability Core (PANIC)
- Rehaul of character sheet - dev blog
- Added NPC Mining Operations

title: Life's Too Short: On Reflection
description:
A little ghost answers a mysterious call...

The residents of a medieval tower are being taunted by what lies on the other side of a mysterious mirror. Reflection can come in many forms and the voice on the other side of the mirror is not always a friend. Maybe the mirror and the residents need your help?

title: Eve Online: Onslaught
description:
New Eden is in an ever-evolving state and as we push toward the third decade, the next expansion for EVE Online is right on the horizon.

More quality of life changes, fresh balance, new precursor ships and content and more iteration on abyssal deadspace are right around the corner with EVE Online: Onslaught, as well as a whole host of new navigation structures that further enable capsuleers to become masters of their domain.

This update includes:
- Added frigate trio Abyssal Deadspace and Abyssal PvP (dev blog)
- New Triglavian Destroyer (Kikimora) and Battlecruiser (Drekavac)
- New Activity Tracker (dev blog)
- Buffs to ECM strength and to Powergrid, CPU, and signature radius for many ECM-bonused ships (CCP forum post)
- Force Auxiliary and some capital tanking modules nerfed (CCP forum post)
- New Upwell FLEX Structures for player-owned jump gates, cyno inhibitors, and cyno beacons, replacing older equivalents

title: Eve Online: Zenith - Quadrant 3
description:
This update includes:
- Armor hardener module tiericide
- Triglavian Invasion Chapter 3: EDENCOM Prepares for Triglavian Invasion and EVE PULSE - Invasion Ch.3, Graphical Update, CSM15
- A special 17th Birthday Celebration version of Capsuleer Day

title: Eve Online: Eclipse - Quadrant 2
description:
This update includes:
- Associated Event / Lore Update: Black Friday Boosts: Skill Points, Boosts, tax reduction. Invasion Chapter 2
- New Triglavian Dreadnaught Zirnitra
- New system for bookmarks with comfort features (easy sharing, ...)
- Updates to Micro Jump Field Generators, Bosonic Field Generators, and Support Fighters
- Stabber Fleet Issue and Tempest Fleet Issue have now and extra damage bonuses to rate of fire
- Medium Autocannons are improved (rate of fire, range, fallof)
- New Player Experience now has a login campaign with minor rewards.

title: Gold Drop Mania
description:
Gold Drop Mania brings the thrill of coin dropping straight to your screen. Experience the ultimate coin pusher machine, inspired by the classic amusement arcade, carnival, and circus attractions!

In Gold Drop Mania, every coin you drop onto the platform adds to your wealth. Your goal is to strategically time your drops to push other coins, gem and gold bars off the edge, racking up your score. Precision and timing are the keys to mastering the art of the coin pusher. Drop into this dungeon themed coin pusher game, where each drop could lead to a cascade of rewards!

title: Eve Online: Gateway
description:
The update includes:
- Secure Key Storage sites balance
- AIR New Player Experience launched
- Increased availability of Ice Belt locations, increased respawn time
- Mercoxit in asteroid belts increased by 200%
- Mercoxit anomalies spawn rate increased by 200%
- Mykoserocin gas site spawn chance reduced by 60%
- Introduction of Skill Plans, and Skill Catalogue features
- Skill training queue limit increased to 150 skills
- 24 hour limit removed from Alpha Training Queue
- Personal deployables barred from new player starting systems

title: Bloodpath
description: An intense and challenging shooter with slow mo and lots of blood, inspired mainly by SUPERHOT and Hotline Miami

title: Eve Online: Reign
description:
This update includes:
- Fleet Finder tool to better find available fleets
- 50% DPS increase to Marauders' Bastion Module
- Removed cost to set Home Station which can now be set without Clone Bay Service

title: Eve Online: New Dawn
description:
This update includes:
- Added AEGIS Secure Transfer Facility, AEGIS Secure Capital Construction Forge, AEGIS Capital Ship Security Facility, and Overmind Nursery Groves sites
- ESS activation causing Capsuleer Combat Timer replaced with Weapons Timer instead
- Drag and Drop ship fittings to skill plan
- Increased Rogue Drone NPC buy orders
- Corporation Recruitment changes

title: Iktsua
description:
"The feeling of anticipation that leads you to go outside and check if anyone is coming".

A coming of age story, where an Inuit boy goes into the wilderness to become a man while his family anxiously waits for his return.

title: Eve Online: Havoc
description:
This update includes:
- Added new content: enlist with Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates in Faction Warfare
- Added new content: Deathless HQ station & Zarzakh system
- Added new content: Pirate Insurgencies
- New ships: Mekubal; Mamba; Khizriel; Alligator; Azariel
- Altered ship industry requirements:
-- Titans: Vanquisher; Komodo; Molok
- Updated content: AIR New Player Experience
- and more

title: BS2
description: A hectic vertical space shooter where you steal powers from your slain foes. Each enemy will have 2 powers, and when you defeat it you will have to quickly choose which power up you want by flying to that side of the screen. However some combinations of powers are much more exciting than others, and sometimes you have to take a big risk to be able to fly to the better power up. The power ups can also be used or expire, so this leads to ever changing “builds” to explore and use on the enemies.

title: Eve Online: Equinox
description:
The rejuvenation of nullsec has begun! New Upwell structures are now available to corporation and alliance leaders, to shape sovereign space in their image, and pilots can fly new defense-capable industrial ships into a new era. Creative capsuleers are empowered to design personalized ship SKINs for themselves or their organization and tackle new and improved goals and Corp Projects. In addition, the biggest update to EVE Vanguard since December is coming in the Solstice event, introducing a new map, weapon modifications, and more.

This update includes:
- New feature: SKINR Ship Personalisation (custom ship SKINs)
- New structures: Orbital Skyhook, Sovereignty Hub, Metenox Moon Drill
- Major changes to Nullsec Sovereignty, iHubs and TCUs
- New Upwell Haulers: Squall, Torrent, Deluge, Avalanche
- Carrier balance reworks with new modules: Capital MJD, Capital MJFG
-- New carrier-based Faction fighters
- Daily Logins replaced by Opportunities/Daily Goals
And more

title: Ambuuu
description: Ambuuu is a chaotic adventure where the goal is to save as many people as possible by picking them up in your Ambulance. Run into someone to pick them up and bring them back to the hospital before the time runs out in this hectic physics adventure. Play long enough and you may experience the very intense AMBUUU mode!

title: The Black Lamb
description: The Black Lamb is a folklore horror game inspired by eerie childhood tales and real-life events. After a tragic accident, you find yourself drawn to a mysterious black lamb. Following it leads you to an unsettling village—but this is no ordinary village. Dark secrets lurk within, and your only choice is to uncover the truth or succumb to the horrors around you.

title: Star Crew
description: Star Crew is a 1-8 player co-op sci-fi roguelite. Maintain subsystems, fend off enemies, and stay alive long enough for evac to arrive. Powerful upgrade choices, procedurally-generated ships, and permanent progression. Survive with friends or handle things all by yourself.

title: Jerma Rancher
description:
A game inspired by "Monster Rancher" & filled with references to Twitch streamer Jerma985.
Feed & train your Jerma-lore based monster, & win in the arena with it.
Answer Jerma Trivia when a Jerma Clone visits your ranch.
Create and discover all 16 monsters.
If you're a Jerma fan, why not try it out?

title: Jaghund Armoured Organ Delivery Service
description: Since the MAW Lojackers, a group of low-tech anarchists lost control of their insect horde all of society has crumbled into a battle of survival. You have one mission, and one only; you must stay alive to deliver the heart. Travis, the CEO of Orbital Biotech Deliveries, requires a heart transplant and you are the last functional drone capable of completing such a request. The Lojackers will stop at nothing to capture your cargo. Use what power you can gather to charge up any of Fujisaki Corp’s bots you might find.

title: Run! Run! Don't Die!
description: Run Run is a short platform runner that features a speedrun-style timer and online high scores so that players can compare their best runs against each other. Run, jump, throw your hat/bounce on it, and avoid/defeat enemies as you race for the fastest time!

title: Error Loop
description:
You can't quit the game, but you can't play it either. You're stuck forever in endless menus full of glitches, unless you manage to break the code open.

It's a very unusual action-puzzle game that will make you think outside the box. Each screen is a new surprise, although not always a pleasant one. An ominous presence, taking the shape of an insufferable smiley face, will constantly taunt you and prevent you from progressing. You'll need to find a way to make it glitch!

title: Deltarune: Broken Destiny
description:
Deltarune: Broken Destiny is a tale set in the original Deltarune universe.
We see a new part of Deltarune's world away from Hometown.

title: Mitsuge! Megami-sama
description: "Ogiri Adventure Game" is a quest to gather and donate items to please the Goddess. Find theme-based items highlighted in red, donate within the budget, and raise the emotion meter. A high meter brings joy, while a low one may cause anger. Keep trying!

title: The Sims: Legacy Collection
description: The original game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. Create a neighborhood of Sims and guide their lives through careers and romance — or create chaos with open-ended gameplay that lets you shape their destinies.

title: The Sims 2: Legacy Collection
description: The game you know and love. For Windows 10/11. In The Sims 2, you direct your Sims over a lifetime. Give them a long existence or leave their lives in shambles. Guide their characteristics from one generation to the next.

title: The Zombie Slayers
description: The Zombie Slayers is a wild top-down shooter where you battle zombies, make babies and show off your dance moves, while dressed in (sometimes) ridiculous costumes. Team up with friends, adopt pets, and survive waves of undead chaos. It's crazy, colorful, and just the right amount of hilarity!

title: Jumpers League
description: A competitive online multiplayer platformer where every jump is a gamble. Climb to the top while using strategic abilities to outsmart your opponents, but beware: one misstep can cost you all your progress.

title: Hawks of Bruyland
description: A Dungeon Crawler/Management game hybrid. Run an inn, meet amazing characters and unveil the mystery of the Land of Mists!

title: Supercar Collection Simulator
description: Supercar Collection Simulator is a game where you sell surprise car boxes to earn money, build a car collection and engage in exciting races with rivals.

title: Hoover Heroes
description: Hoover Heroes is a physics-based multiplayer party game for up to 8 players to play online, featuring cute and silly cleaners. Funny animations, colorful graphics, and fun mechanics will keep you laughing every moment.

title: Withering Realms
description: A ghost and her doll guardian explore the mysterious town of Penwyll and the sprawling graveyards, tombs, caves and rotting estates that surround it in this Horror Action RPG from the creator of Withering Rooms.

title: Trail of Stars
description: Trail of Stars is a short, bittersweet fairy-tale about two vulnerable souls navigating first love, growing up, and protecting what they have—when all they have is each other.

title: Isadora's Edge
description: Can you keep going when all hope is lost? Isadora's Edge is a 2D Action Platformer with a unique future fantasy setting. Explore an alien world, battle against the corrupted forces bringing it to the edge of destruction, and uncover the secrets behind its impending demise!

title: Whisperstring
description: Whisperstring is an 80s inspired text adventure game that takes place inside a “chat room”. You’re connected to Adam, a "jock" with a severe fear of strings, who seems to have been the victim of a supernatural kidnapping. Will you be able to help him escape?

title: The Way To Life
description: The Way To Life is a short, but meditative experience. Leave the world behind as you enter the desert, meeting monks, learning about their struggles, and gaining wisdom along the way.

title: SkullSP
description: SkullSP is a PVP survival video game, base building and base raiding,.

title: Tamashika
description:
The game is about keeping your mind at one place.

Patterns in sensate experience reinforce an illusion of continuity. The dream is a construction of the mind that perpetuates the illusion.

The cartesian prison is a hall of mirrors, a recursive labyrinth. Each a reflection of me—only patterns and processes.

The present moment is the only thing that is real—focus. Chaotic attractors are seizing your attention. Don’t push or pull at it.

You have to reduce model complexity, you must cultivate flow. The game is about keeping your mind at one place!

Concentrate… and remember… Attention is all you need.

title: Yaku Slap
description: Yaku Slap – A rogue-like card battler where you duel monsters, master Hanafuda combos, and slap down the perfect hand! Unlock new perks, and classes as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a Yaku Master!

title: X-Mode
description: Free-to-play action packed multiplayer FPS featuring a variety of gamemodes. Perfect for quick casual games with friends.

title: Tatoe Sore ga Unmei de Atte mo
description: Miyako, an alpha, has a happy relationship with her childhood friend and boyfriend Toto, a beta. But when Utsuro, an omega, transfers to their school, Miyako realizes that he's her fated mate.

title: The Tower Of The Gods
description:
In The Tower Of The Gods, embark on a legendary mission to ascend a towering, mystical fortress. Each level of the tower is guarded by a formidable boss, an ancient deity, or a mythical creature, each with unique abilities and lethal strategies. With no minor enemies to slow you down, every battle is a titanic showdown that will test your skill and courage.

With every victory, you climb closer to the summit, where your destiny as a legendary hero awaits. The tower challenges not only your combat prowess but also your ability to unravel the mysteries and secrets of the gods. Will you overcome all the challenges and claim your place among the legends?

title: Make Up Human
description:
Make up a person by combining body parts!

"Make Up Human" is a 3D puzzle game.
Drop human body parts such as eyes and ears into a box.

When the same parts come into contact with each other, they will change into the next level part.

Parts will age over time and will never be able to change again.
Be careful, as in rare cases they may not age and become cancerous!

If you're lucky, you might find a special part that can change any part.

If even one part falls outside the box, it's game over.

title: Dead Lamb Walking
description:
You are alone and vulnerable. Beware of the big bad wolf.

A short, free, thriller-suspense interactive fiction made in RPG Maker.

title: ColdTV
description:
You have connected to every country on the planet,
Could there be something left?
DLC Features
+ 2 New Areas
+ 2 Exclusive Tracks
+ 2 New Base Colors (Yes, we added Pink)
+ 4 New Mechanics
+ 16 New Achievements

title: Puss The Way Id Did
description: PUSS The Way Id Did﻿ is a set of 62 Limit Removing speedmaps inspired by the original!

title: Roulette Dungeon
description: Roulette Dungeon is a turn-based rogue-like where you spin a roulette wheel to defeat your enemies. Master the balance between strategic planning and unpredictable luck by placing bets, using special abilities, and collecting items to outsmart your foes and conquer the dungeon.

title: Guilty as Sock!
description: Enter a chaotic courtroom where socks play lawyers, prosecutors, and judges! Use absurd evidence, craft wild arguments, and deliver verdicts in this hilarious online party game. Improvise, strategize, and shout "Objection!"—because in Guilty as Sock!, chaos always wins!

title: Świrus
description:
Świrus is the first polish adventure game designed for Windows. A mad scientist seeks ransom under threat of release of a lethal virus. Politicians do not meet his demands and the professor executes his plan. Many years later, the remnants of humanity invent time travel technology. The protagonist of the game goes back in time to a period of a few days before the attack in order to save the world. During the adventure the player will move to the Middle Ages to finally get the antidote.

The game utilizes the command verb-based SCUMM-like interface. The player constructs commands by selecting an appropriate verb and then combining it with an object or an inventory item. Objects that can be interacted with are highlighted when the player places a cursor over them. By pressing the right mouse button directional arrows appear. They allow the player to move between sites. The right mouse button can also be used for studying objects.

The disc version was extended with a stage played in the future in a totalitarian police state (between Middle Ages and game's finale).

title: Vampires in your area
description: Single vampires nearby are waiting to chat with you!

title: False Princess Iruruu
description: Iruruu, daughter of a nomadic khan, is summoned by the Imperial court to become consort to the divine emperor. However, she soon finds herself targeted by various factions, and it seems that this summons may be more than a simple political move...

title: Stains of Regret
description: Stains of Regret is a short 2D horror experience following the story of a father looking for his daughter. Follow his journey learning more about the world and its characters as you attempt to find your daughter, all whilst having to face unspeakable horrors and personal demons.

title: Auto-Crisis
description: You're driving away on a forest road, late at night, under a heavy storm. Your car breaks down. Luckily, there might be a gas station nearby. But a misfortune never comes alone. The storm has brought something else, something otherworldly that oddly smells of spilled diesel oil.

title: Demiurgos
description: Demiurgos is a competitive strategy god game where you wield divine powers to convert followers, outmaneuver rival deities, and reshape the world. Choose Good or Evil, Chaos or Order, and forge your path to dominance. Inspire devotion or instill fear—the choice is yours.

title: Old World: Wrath of Gods
description: Empires rise and fall through military might, political aptitude, and diplomatic savvy – but all know to fear, above all, the Wrath of Gods. Experience devastating natural disasters, a unique scenario that explores stories of legend, and the playable kingdom of Aksum.

title: Directorate Novitiate
description: Become Mercury, a ruthless enforcer with deadly arcane power in this thrilling third-person action RPG. By night, hunt killers and battle supernatural Syndicates in the underworld of early 2000s Los Angeles. By day, keep your real life from falling apart.

title: Night of the Witch's Invasion
description: Defeat the evil witches, rescue the trapped bunnies, and defend the peace of the town!

title: Piczle Cross: Rune Factory
description: Experience the character, monsters and world of the Rune Factory series through nonogram logic-puzzles.

title: Anthropoda Power Fantasy
description:
Anthropoda Power Fantasy is a community project where mappers would make maps with MundyC's Adventures In Moth Sorcery mod (Also known as AIMS for short), along with it's own unique resource pack. Featuring a variety of gameplay changes, new sprites, and textures!
The final result is featuring 13 MBF21 maps of varying challenge and mapping style. Are you ready to follow Sanahaid's newest adventure?

title: Colorbox Mustard
description: Colorbox Mustard is a music creation platform heavily based on Incredibox that allows you to compose unique tracks using a variety of character-based sound elements. It calls itself a parody of the Incredibox mod series "Colorbox" by Baggerhead.

title: Calcification
description: Calcification is a short exploration of waiting, losing faith, and watching all around you turn to dust. After the failure of the villain’s plan, you play as a boss in a dungeon. Abandoned by the interest of heroes you languish awaiting a fate that will never come. Made in RPG Maker MZ.

title: Necrosis: Dawn of Dread
description: Necrosis: Dawn of Dread is a full-length co-op survival horror experience inspired by the golden age of zombies. 15+ hours of missions, vehicles, puzzles, with many playable survivors await across a world consumed by the dead. No microtransactions, no shortcuts: just pure survival.

title: Moral Dilemma: The Interview
description: A fourth-wall-breaking narrative adventure. It’s interview day, and you really need this job—enough to ignore the talking printer, the anomaly corridor, and the ridiculous life-or-death trials your interviewer keeps putting you in. But deep down, you know... something here is very, very wrong.

title: When Heaven Knocks
description:
One year prior, the town of [REDACTED] suffered from an odd incident, where students from the local school were compelled to dance... Evidently, against their own will. Only one student was unaffected by this mass hysteria.

Now a year after the incident, a mysterious man visits an old abandoned church...

title: Pexit 8
description:
A piece of Exit 8-like where all the anomalies are related to the penguins.A piece of Exit 8-like where all the anomalies are related to the penguins.

Horror game Penguin Hotel extravaganza

title: Search Account
description: Real Escape Game.

title: Queen of Treasure Isle
description:
Queen of treasure isle is a simple, small-scale metroidvania that mainly consists of bomb throwing and jumping.

You can retrieve the treasure hidden in various places and return home in a balloon when you are done.

title: UnderTale: DoctorTale
description:
DoctorTale is a crossover fan-game based on the sci-fi series Doctor Who (by BBC) and the RPG game UnderTale (by Toby Fox).

The plot tells of the Time Lord from Gallifrey, traveling across different planets that are imprisoned in one large Pocket Universe which is on the verge of self-destruction. In this world, you can go the way of mercy to save everyone, or you can use brute force to achieve personal freedom. You decide, the fate of the universe is in your hands.

title: Undertinge
description: Play as the Wizard named Frisk. Welding magic as a weapon, you have to end the Eternal Night, destroying the heart of darkness that plagues the land, freeing the world from the wicked clutches of the ancient curse. Will you let the darkness blind you? Will you make it out alive? Well, that, my friend, is up to you to decide.

title: Dustswap: Dusttrust
description:
You pushed the limits of this world one too many times.

And now you must deal with the consequences of your actions.

title: The Gleaming Grill
description: The Gleaming Grill is a cooking, 4 player Co-Op game where you need to keep the increasing amount of customers happy to prevent your restaurant from going bankrupt. Work with your friends as fast as you can to ensure all your customers leave with a smile on their face!

title: Bad-Draw
description: This game is in the type of 2D platformer. It's about the revenge of a character made of drawings.

title: Starpatch
description: A short, cute and relaxing puzzle RPG about a fallen astronaut (and even more fallen stars) and their journey finding shelter!

title: Candleholder
description:
You play as Spamton, who has fallen in a Neo Dark Fountain inside Kris's pocket, and now explores a strange, dreamy place called the Cluttersphere.

With your perspective shifted, having Jevil as your ally (?) and being tasked with protecting Kris's lifeforce in the form of a candlelight, you must use the SOUL to guide Spamton into making it back to the Dark World safely.

title: Unmourned
description: Unmourned is a first person psychological horror game where you play as Jason, a man who moves into a new house only to be haunted by escalating paranormal activities. As the disturbances grow more intense, Jason discovers that the house's previous owners mysteriously vanished. Driven by terror and desperation, Jason must uncover the truth behind the family’s disappearance and find a way to break the curse that now haunts him. Can he solve the mystery before it's too late?

title: Castlevania: The Adventure - Masque of Retribution
description:
Battle against Dracula's forces once more as Christopher Belmont in Castlevania The Adventure - Masque of Retribution!
Enhanced Visuals, smoother controls and gameplay, remixed and remastered OST, a completely overhauled set of bosses; Castlevania The Adventure - Masque of Retribution is the definitive way to play this reimagined classic by Konami!
As with the previous WarMachine Studios releases, this is a NON-PROFIT FAN REMAKE. No monies were exchanged in any way for the creation of this game. Like the others, it was done out of fun and love for a forgotten game series.

title: Tronix Carnival Games
description: Tronix Carnival Games is a rogue-like TPS gameplay in a dystopian robotic world. Set in a ruined carnival overtaken by Tronix robots, it’s now a deadly playground. Players uncover its secrets, battle enemies, and survive unique challenges.

title: Samui kara Nabe Kuitai ne Joon-chan to!!
description:
Let's complete a tasty nabe that will satisfy Joon-chan.
This is such a non-stop shiritori dark nabe simulation.

title: Rayman Garden Plus
description:
Lost and Found the first mobile Rayman game... IS BACK!

Find the magic lums (blue balls) hidden in the Rayman Garden as quickly as possible. Advance using the arrow keys. Use your swords to fight the enemies: press on X to attack (Sword) and on C to carry out a super attack (Fire Sword). You can advance using the arrow keys. Each fight or obstacle will cost you a sword. Beware, as they are quickly used up. To save your swords, return walk mode by pressing on Z. Again, beware, if you come across an enemy without a sword, you'll lose two lives from a red monster, one life from a normal enemy. It is therefore up to you to manage your swords and avoid the enemies. One lum will win you one life. Watch out for the black hole which warrants a return penalty. But above all else you are being chased by your mortal enemy - Dark Rayman. Do not let yourself be caught or you're dead!

New features:

10 locations: Forest (Garden), Swamp (Garden), Mountain (Garden), Plant (Garden), Wood (Garden), Volcano (Garden), Candy (Rayman 1), Pirate Ship (Rayman 2: The Great Escape), Nuthouse (Rayman: The Animated Series) and Bowling (Rayman Bowling 2 by Ryemanni);

title: Rayman Lum'o'Grams
description:
Rayman Lum'o'Grams is a puzzle fan game for PCs running Microsoft Windows currently in development by Rayman Universe, or RUNI.

The game belongs to the Picross/Nonograms genre and uses both its own and assets of most 2D projects from Rayman series, with the exception of UbiArt games. The game was first announced at Rayman Alive 2022 as part of the RUNI Showcase segment presenting Rayman Universe projects, which featured a concept trailer. The project's World Premiere took place at Rayman Alive 2023, revealing most of the details of the game.

The first public demo version has been announced for early 2024, but its released has been postponed, and was instead released for Rayman Alive 2025, celebrating the 30th anniversary of Rayman.

title: Virgin Simulator
description: Virgin wants to find a girlfriend

title: Cat Me If You Can
description: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

title: Regenti Rebelia
description: Adelia has never quite understood her place in the world—raised with lofty expectations and forced into a mold she's desperate to break. She often dreams of a different life of normalcy, self-expression, and a weight lifted off her shoulders. Two things stand in her way—her royal title and her overly protective personal knight.

title: How to Date an Entity (and stay alive)
description: This game is a Visual Novel game with a length of about 15 to 20 minutes (per ending—so it actually takes some time to get all of them). It’s about an MC who wakes up in their room and encounters a tall mysterious woman. He must date her to survive. The game incorporates elements of both Dating Sim and analog horror, featuring a total of 10 possible endings. All endings based on "Interest Meter", so you need to be aware of it.

title: Pico Drift
